# Arcane Text Editor Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A Sublime-Text-4-class text document inside the Arcane Editor -- own rope core, data-driven `.arcsyntax` grammars on PCRE2, Sublime multi-cursor, split view, a user-chosen opener per file type (the Arcane Text Editor, Visual Studio, the system default or a custom program; C/C++ default to Visual Studio), and an opt-in near-full vim layer (Neovim defaults) -- shipped through a release gate after step 4 + step-6 essentials, with vim behind "Experimental" until its own gate.

**Architecture:** A pure C++ static library `ArcaneText` (Core, Syntax, Vim; no ImGui, no Win32) holds the rope, buffer/undo, selections, the single `TextCommands` mutation layer, display map, grammar engine and vim state machine; it is unit- and property-tested in `ArcaneTests`. The ArcaneEditor exe adds the ImGui view, the `TextDocument`, Windows file I/O, keyboard/layout input, the `FileOpener` service every open goes through, the action-table rows and the reflected settings (`TextSettings`, exe-side). Every tunable is a reflected setting under `editor.text.*` (openers: `editor.files.*`).

**Tech Stack:** C++23 (MSVC, /MD), premake5, Dear ImGui, SDL3 (Windows message hook), PCRE2 10.49 (vendored, JIT), Catch2 + rapidcheck, Arcane settings reflection (`ARC_REFLECT_TYPE_ATTR(Settings, ...)`), Arcane `EditorActions` table, headless Neovim (dev-time oracle only).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-text-editor-design.md` (revision 6 -- revision 5 added D15 user-chosen openers, s5.6; revision 6 folds in this plan's reconciliation, s17). Every task cites the spec section it implements as `(spec sX.Y)`. Executors read the spec section before the task.

**Size:** 198 tasks in seven chunks -- TE1 Core (19), TE2 First visible editor (21), TE3 Syntax (32), TE4 Editing features (24), TE7 Openers (18), TE6 Polish + gates (26, including GATE-1, VIM-GATE and TE-CLOSE), TE5 Vim (58). The "Task index" below gives the execution order.

---

## Where the work happens

- **Base:** the text editor needs the settings arc (reflected settings, `EditorActions` incl. `ChordOf`, `ActionContext`, Preferences window, sweep tests, the frozen settings inventory). Start from Arcane `main` **after** `feat/settings` (+ `feat/settings-s7`) has merged; if it has not merged yet when execution starts, branch from the `feat/settings-s7` tip and rebase onto `main` once it lands. Line numbers cited for existing files come from the settings tip; re-locate them after the rebase.
- **Worktree:** `D:\dev\starworks\Arcane-text`, branch `feat/text-editor` (`git worktree add D:\dev\starworks\Arcane-text -b feat/text-editor <base>`). Parallel lanes (see the Task index) use their own worktrees/branches and merge into `feat/text-editor` at the position shown.
- **Build (PowerShell, from the worktree root):**
  ```powershell
  $env:ARCANE_SDK = 'D:\dev\starworks\Arcane-text'
  .\ThirdParty\premake5\premake5.exe vs2026          # run directly; never via cmd /c GenerateProjects.bat
  & 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe' Arcane.slnx -p:Configuration=Debug -p:Platform=x64 -m:8 -nr:false -v:m
  ```
  Re-run premake whenever a task adds a file, a project, or a ThirdParty lib.
- **Tests (always from the exe dir, with TEMP and TMP set):**
  ```powershell
  Set-Location bin\Debug-windows-x86_64-md\ArcaneTests
  $env:TEMP = 'D:\dev\starworks\Arcane-text\.tmp-tests'; $env:TMP = $env:TEMP; $env:RC_PARAMS = 'seed=1'
  .\ArcaneTests.exe "[text-rope]" --rng-seed 1 -r compact
  ```
  Record the Catch2 and rapidcheck seeds of every run in the task report. Full suite before every commit that touches shared code: `.\ArcaneTests.exe "~[gpu]"`.
- **Commits:** stage files **by name** (never `git add -A` / `git add .`); message ends with the two attribution lines the controller supplies; never push; never amend.
- **Untouchable:** `ArcaneAssetPipeline/ArcaneAs.*`, `ArcaneEditor/ArcaneEditor/`, `out.txt`, `out/` are the user's untracked files.

## Global Constraints

- C++23, MSVC v145 toolset, `/MD` everywhere, no `/fp:fast`, UTF-8 without BOM, ASCII-only comments (spec s2, workspace rules).
- Namespaces: `Arcane::Text` for the `ArcaneText` library (Core/Syntax/Vim); `Arcane::Editor` for view/document/editor wiring and `TextSettings`; `Arcane::Editor::Openers` for the opener service.
- **Openers (D15, spec s5.6; supersedes the old "never opens C/C++" constraint):** every open of a file -- tabs, Asset Browser, Inspector, Problems rows, automation `--open-path`, vim `:e` and global marks, recovery restore -- goes through `Openers::FileOpener` (`Open` / `OpenWith(path, opener, FilePosition{line, column})`, 1-based, column in characters). C/C++ (`.c .cc .cpp .cxx .h .hh .hpp .hxx .inl`; `.h` is C++) default to Visual Studio; the user may choose the Arcane Text Editor (or any opener) per extension under Preferences > Editor > Files > Open With. `DocumentHost::OpenAt` is internal. No open path may bypass `FileOpener`: the `[openers-guard]` test (TE7-10) is the GATE-1 sweep.
- No other editors' file formats are loaded: no `.sublime-syntax`, `.tmLanguage`, `.tmTheme`, VS Code themes, `.vimrc` (spec D5).
- Zed GPL crates (`rope`, `text`, `editor`, `vim`, `language`, grammars, themes) are design reference only -- no code, query or keymap file copied or translated. `sum_tree` (Apache-2.0) only informs `Rope`; attribution in `NOTICE.md` (spec s10; not `ThirdParty/NOTICES`).
- One mutation path: only `TextCommands` (and the `TextBuffer` primitives it calls) change text or move selections (spec s2.1).
- **Settings ownership:** `TextSettings` (one block, category `editor.text`, categoryPath `"Text Editor"`) and `TextVimSettings` (`editor.text.vim.*`, categoryPath `"Text Editor/Vim"`, PreferencesMachine) live **exe-side** in `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.{hpp,cpp}` (a static library's self-registering statics would be dropped by the linker; editor-audience settings belong to ArcaneEditor). Every chunk adds its rows to that one block (CANON A12 lists each row's owning task). `ArcaneTests` source-compiles `TextSettings.cpp`. The core library takes plain option structs (`UndoPolicy`, `DecodeOptions`, `EditContext`) mapped by `ToUndoPolicy` / `ToDecodeOptions` / `ApplyEditSettings`; it never reads a cvar.
- **Integral settings are `std::uint32_t`** (sweep values `CVarValue::UInt32`); seconds are `double`; `fontSize` is `float`.
- Every tunable is a reflected setting under `editor.text.*` (vim: `editor.text.vim.*`; openers: `editor.files.*`), registered via `ARC_REFLECT_TYPE_ATTR(Settings, ...)`, covered by the settings sweep tests; budgets and limits carry `CVarFlags::Dev`; defaults for budgets come from measurements recorded in task reports, not guesses (spec s8, user rule 2026-10-07).
- **Frozen inventory route:** the settings inventory is frozen (settings arc S5-2). New `editor.text.*` / `editor.files.*` rows go into a new Part 3 section of the inventory plus its "Post-freeze amendments" table, and `scripts/settings-frozen-names.txt` is regenerated by the inventory lint -- tell the user this route was used (they confirm it at GATE-1).
- Defaults: `undoGroupMs` 300, `undoMemoryMB` 64, `syntaxMaxMB` 32, `openMaxMB` 512, `longLineMaxBytes` 65536, `multilineSearchMaxMB` 64, `maxCursors` 10000, `syncCatchUpLines` 200, `recoveryMaxMB` 16, `recentWriteSeconds` 10; the time budgets (`tokenizeLineBudgetUs`, `highlightFrameBudgetMs`, `syncCatchUpBudgetUs`) and regex limits (`regexMatchLimit`, `regexDepthLimit`) get measured defaults in their tasks (TE3-32) (spec s3, s4, s8).
- **Report schema:** the automation report's schema bump (TE2-21's `textDocuments`) is "current `ReportSchemaMax` + 1 at execution" -- the settings arc may already have bumped it (S6-GATE to 14); `VerifyReportTest` and `golden-gate.ps1`'s `ReportSchemaMax` move together. Golden lane counts are derived at execution, never hard-coded.
- **Chords:** `text.toggleFollow` and `text.convertLineEndings` ship **unbound**; split view has no action row (status-strip toggle + vim `:sp`); column select is Ctrl+Shift+Alt+arrows, expand to brackets Ctrl+Shift+M, zoom Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0 (spec s7, rev 6).
- **Reopen with Encoding clears undo history** (`TextBuffer::ClearHistory`): the old text was decoded under another encoding, so Ctrl+Z must never restore it under the new label (Review Focus F3).
- **Grammar detection order:** the user's remembered per-extension language first, then the grammar's `files`, then `firstLine`, then Plain Text (spec s4.1, rev 6) -- otherwise the picker could never override a claimed extension.
- **Out of scope for v1 (owed follow-up):** typing characters outside the BMP. ImGui is built with 16-bit `ImWchar`; such characters are dropped with a one-time warning. `IMGUI_USE_WCHAR32` is a workspace-wide decision (likely an engine ABI bump across the ArcaneClient/game DLL boundary) for the user to take after GATE-1.
- Vim flavour = Neovim defaults (`Y`=`y$`, `hlsearch`+`incsearch` on, `startofline` off, `&`=`:&&`, `nrformats=bin,hex`, `formatoptions+=j`, `autoindent`, `nojoinspaces`); shift width **is** `editor.text.tabSize` (spec D13, s6.4, s11.3). The pinned headless Neovim (`scripts/vim-oracle.ps1`) is a dev-time oracle: every TE5 task's Step 2b runs `vim-oracle.ps1 -Mode verify` on its table first, and where Neovim and a hand-written expectation disagree, Neovim wins.
- Release gate after step 4 + step-6 essentials; vim behind an "Experimental" badge until the vim gate (spec D12, s12.2). Vim goldens are blessed with the badge and re-blessed by VIM-GATE.
- The base branch's `EditorActions::ChordOf(std::string_view) const -> std::optional<KeyChord>` exists only on the settings-arc tree (verified on `feat/settings-s7`); the plan's base is `main` after that arc merges.

## Review Focus

User-facing failure modes that only a dedicated test catches (CANON Section F). Each names its owning task and test; reviewers check these first.

1. **F1 -- Follow never shows a log that is still being written.** TE2-17 acts only after two equal stamps; a game logging continuously changes the stamp every poll, so Follow (and plain append) never fires. Test owner: **TE2-17** (C TE2 #12: growth between every poll appears after each poll, document stays clean, history intact); witness reinforcement in **TE6-5** (writer appends every 100 ms for 3 s, lines visible before it stops).
2. **F2 -- Following a UTF-16 log garbles or freezes the document.** An appended UTF-16 tail has no BOM; decoding it through `DecodeFile` treats it as UTF-8 with NULs (binary). Test owners: **TE1-11** (`DecodeFragment` cases) and **TE2-17** (a UTF-16LE file grows by an odd byte count across two polls; the buffer holds exactly the decoded complete lines).
3. **F3 -- Ctrl+Z after "Reopen with Encoding -> Windows-1252" puts raw invalid bytes back under a 1252 label, making the file editable but unsavable (or saved wrong).** Test owner: **TE2-15** (after `ReopenAs1252`, `CanUndo()` is false and a save is byte-identical).
4. **F4 -- Opening a grammar (or any asset) as text silently disconnects one of the two after-save behaviours** (grammar live reload vs dedicated-editor asset reload) if a later wiring assigns `afterSave` over the earlier one. Test owner: **TE6-12** (save an unlocked `.arcsyntax` opened as text: the registry generation moves AND `ApplyExternalAssetChange` ran).
5. **F5 -- Vim Normal mode on a Japanese/Chinese IME turns `j` into a composition** because `SetImeAllowed(false)` only hides the candidate window. Test owner: **TE2-10** (IME context disassociated on a test window), consumed unchanged by TE5a-22's keyboard tests.

(Also worth a reviewer's eye, covered by the C edits rather than new focus items: a far-scrolled split view stays uncoloured unless TE4-17 passes the union of visible rows to `UpdateHighlight`; TE4-22's auto-closer bypassing `TextCommands`.)

`ArcaneText` is a new premake StaticLib project (`/MD`, C++23) over `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/{Core,Syntax,Vim}/**`; `ArcaneEditor` removes those folders from its own `files` and links `ArcaneText` (and `pcre2`); `ArcaneTests` links `ArcaneText` and source-compiles only the View/Document/Settings files a test needs (the existing per-file pattern in its `files` list; `TextSettings.cpp` always).

(Dropped in reconciliation: TE6-1, TE6-2, TE6-25 -> 198 tasks.)

**Why this deviates from the spec's step order:** TE7-9 consumes TE6-12's `EditorApp::OpenAsText` / `OpenAsTextFlow`, so TE6-6..12 precede TE7; TE6-14/15/23 open files and so follow TE7; TE5's glue consumes TE4 (split, strip slot, overlays, `MakeEditContext`, `FoldCommands`) and TE7 (FileOpener), so "TE5 may run once TE2 lands" holds only for the pure vim library (lane L7).

## Chunk TE1: Core

Delivers the pure C++ core of the text editor as the new `ArcaneText` static library: UTF-8 and grapheme handling, the persistent rope (with its leaf size fixed by a measured benchmark), anchors, the `EolMap`, selections, the `TextBuffer` (edits, nested transactions, grouped and memory-capped undo, dirty and version tracking, edit log, external append and reload, line-ending conversion), the file codec (UTF-8 with or without BOM, UTF-16 LE/BE, Windows-1252, raw bytes kept read-only), the fold model, the display map, and `TextCommands`, the single layer that changes text or moves selections (spec s2, s2.1, s3.1-s3.6, s4.6, s5.1, s11.1; step 1 of s12.1).
Depends on: the settings-arc tree only (reflected settings, sweep helpers, the inventory lint). Nothing in this chunk draws or opens a window.
TE2 gets a tested core: `Rope`, `TextBuffer`, `SelectionSet`, `TextCommands`, `FileCodec`, `FoldModel`, `DisplayMap`, and the `editor.text.*` settings block (`TextSettings`) with mappers onto the core's option structs.
Reconciled against `CANON.md` (2026-10-07): no TE1 task is dropped; TE1-8, TE1-10, TE1-11, TE1-12 and TE1-14 carry the CANON additions (see `#### Reconciled against CANON.md` at the end of the self-review).

**Conventions used by every task below**

- Paths are relative to the worktree `D:\dev\starworks\Arcane-text` (skeleton "Where the work happens"). Line numbers cited for existing files are from the settings tip `19716cf2`; after the rebase onto `main` they may shift. Find the cited text and edit there.
- Build. Run premake whenever the task adds a file:
  ```powershell
  Set-Location D:\dev\starworks\Arcane-text
  $env:ARCANE_SDK = 'D:\dev\starworks\Arcane-text'
  .\ThirdParty\premake5\premake5.exe vs2026
  & 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe' Arcane.slnx -p:Configuration=Debug -p:Platform=x64 -m:8 -nr:false -v:m
  ```
- Tests always run from the exe directory with TEMP/TMP set, the Catch2 seed fixed, and rapidcheck's seed fixed through `RC_PARAMS`. Put both seeds in the task report:
  ```powershell
  Set-Location D:\dev\starworks\Arcane-text\bin\Debug-windows-x86_64-md\ArcaneTests
  $env:TEMP = 'D:\dev\starworks\Arcane-text\.tmp-tests'; $env:TMP = $env:TEMP; $env:RC_PARAMS = 'seed=1'
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $env:TEMP | Out-Null
  .\ArcaneTests.exe "<tags>" --rng-seed 1 -r compact
  ```
- `ConstantGuardTest` scans `ArcaneEditor/src`. Every `constexpr` or `static const` numeric constant in these files carries `ARC_CONSTANT("why")` (`<Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>`, a macro that expands to nothing) on the line directly above it. Tunables are settings, never constants.
- Comments are ASCII. Test strings that need non-ASCII text build it from code points with the `S({...})` helper (each test file defines it the same way), never with `\x` escapes that a following hex letter would extend.
- Namespaces: `Arcane::Text` for the library; `Arcane::Editor` for `TextSettings` (exe side).

```cpp
TEST_CASE("Utf8: DecodeAt decodes every length and rejects the Table 3-7 holes", "[text-utf8]")
{
    struct Row { std::string bytes; bool valid; std::uint32_t cp; std::uint32_t length; };
    const std::vector<Row> rows = {
        { Bytes({ 0x41 }), true, 0x41, 1 },
        { Bytes({ 0xC3, 0xA9 }), true, 0xE9, 2 },
        { Bytes({ 0xE2, 0x82, 0xAC }), true, 0x20AC, 3 },
        { Bytes({ 0xF0, 0x9F, 0x98, 0x80 }), true, 0x1F600, 4 },
        { Bytes({ 0xC0, 0xAF }), false, 0xC0, 1 },               // overlong '/'
        { Bytes({ 0xC1, 0xBF }), false, 0xC1, 1 },
        { Bytes({ 0xE0, 0x80, 0xAF }), false, 0xE0, 1 },         // overlong 3-byte
        { Bytes({ 0xED, 0xA0, 0x80 }), false, 0xED, 1 },         // surrogate D800
        { Bytes({ 0xF4, 0x90, 0x80, 0x80 }), false, 0xF4, 1 },   // above U+10FFFF
        { Bytes({ 0xF5, 0x80, 0x80, 0x80 }), false, 0xF5, 1 },
        { Bytes({ 0x80 }), false, 0x80, 1 },                     // lone continuation
        { Bytes({ 0xE2, 0x82 }), false, 0xE2, 1 },               // truncated
        { Bytes({ 0xFF }), false, 0xFF, 1 },
    };
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < rows.size(); ++i)
    {
        INFO("row " << i);
        const Utf8::Unit u = Utf8::DecodeAt(rows[i].bytes, 0);
        CHECK(u.valid == rows[i].valid);
        CHECK(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(u.cp) == rows[i].cp);
        CHECK(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(u.length) == rows[i].length);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Utf8: every invalid byte is its own unit", "[text-utf8]")
{
    const std::string s = "a" + Bytes({ 0xE2, 0x82 }) + "b" + Bytes({ 0xFF, 0x80 }) + S({ 0xE9 });
    CHECK(Utf8::CountUnits(s) == 7u);   // a, E2, 82, b, FF, 80, e-acute
    CHECK_FALSE(Utf8::IsValid(s));

    CHECK(Utf8::IsValid(S({ U'a', 0xE9, 0x20AC, 0x1F600 })));

TEST_CASE("Utf8: IsIncompletePrefix only accepts a prefix more bytes could complete", "[text-utf8]")
{

    CHECK(Utf8::IsIncompletePrefix(Bytes({ 0xE2, 0x82 })));
    CHECK(Utf8::IsIncompletePrefix(Bytes({ 0xF0, 0x9F, 0x98 })));
    CHECK_FALSE(Utf8::IsIncompletePrefix(Bytes({ 0xE2, 0x41 })));
    CHECK_FALSE(Utf8::IsIncompletePrefix(Bytes({ 0xC0 })));

TEST_CASE("Utf8: PrevUnitStart walks back over exactly the forward segmentation", "[text-utf8]")
{
    rc::prop("backward boundaries == forward boundaries", [](const std::vector<unsigned char>& raw) {
        std::string s(raw.begin(), raw.end());
        std::vector<std::size_t> forward{ 0 };
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size();)
        {
            i += Utf8::DecodeAt(s, i).length;
            forward.push_back(i);
        }
        std::vector<std::size_t> backward{ s.size() };
        for (std::size_t i = s.size(); i > 0;)
        {
            i = Utf8::PrevUnitStart(s, i);
            backward.push_back(i);
        }
        std::reverse(backward.begin(), backward.end());
        RC_ASSERT(backward == forward);
    });
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text editor's position vocabulary (spec s3.2): byte offsets, half-open
// byte ranges, rows with BYTE columns, and the anchor bias. Display columns
// (tab width, wide glyphs) belong to the view, never to these types.

#include <compare>
#include <cstdint>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    using ByteOffset = std::uint64_t;

    struct ByteRange
    {
        ByteOffset begin = 0, end = 0;   // half-open

        [[nodiscard]] constexpr ByteOffset Size() const noexcept { return end - begin; }
        [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool Empty() const noexcept { return begin == end; }
        friend constexpr bool operator==(const ByteRange&, const ByteRange&) = default;
    };

    struct Point
    {
        std::uint32_t row = 0;
        std::uint32_t col = 0;   // BYTES from the row's first byte

        friend constexpr auto operator<=>(const Point&, const Point&) = default;
    };

    // Which side of an insertion at its own offset an anchor keeps (spec s3.2):
    // Left stays before the inserted text, Right moves after it.
    enum class Bias : std::uint8_t { Left, Right };
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// UTF-8 units (spec s3.5, s5.1). A unit is a valid scalar value (1..4 bytes)
// or ONE invalid byte. Overlongs, surrogates (ED A0..BF), values above
// U+10FFFF, stray continuation bytes and truncated sequences are invalid, and
// each of their bytes is its own unit, so an invalid file keeps its raw bytes
// and every cursor steps over them one at a time.

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Text::Utf8
{
    struct Unit
    {
        char32_t     cp = 0;        // the scalar value, or the invalid byte's value
        std::uint8_t length = 1;    // bytes; always 1 when !valid
        bool         valid = false;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsContinuation(unsigned char b) noexcept { return (b & 0xC0u) == 0x80u; }

    // i < s.size().
    [[nodiscard]] Unit DecodeAt(std::string_view s, std::size_t i) noexcept;

    // The start of the unit that ends at i (0 < i <= s.size(), i a unit boundary
    // of the forward segmentation).
    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t PrevUnitStart(std::string_view s, std::size_t i) noexcept;

    [[nodiscard]] bool IsValid(std::string_view s) noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t FirstInvalid(std::string_view s) noexcept;   // std::string_view::npos when valid

    // True when s (1..3 bytes) is a proper prefix of a valid sequence that more
    // bytes could complete. The file encoder carries such a tail into the next chunk.
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsIncompletePrefix(std::string_view s) noexcept;

    // Appends cp as UTF-8. A surrogate (D800..DFFF) is written as its 3-byte
    // WTF-8 form, which FileCodec uses to round-trip lone UTF-16 surrogates.
    void Append(std::string& out, char32_t cp);

    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t CountUnits(std::string_view s) noexcept;
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/Utf8.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Text::Utf8
{
    namespace
    {
        // A lead byte's sequence length and its second byte's legal range
        // (Unicode Table 3-7). length 0 = never a lead (80..C1, F5..FF).
        struct LeadInfo
        {
            std::uint8_t length;
            std::uint8_t lo;
            std::uint8_t hi;
        };

        constexpr LeadInfo Lead(unsigned char b) noexcept
        {
            if (b < 0x80) return { 1, 0, 0 };
            if (b >= 0xC2 && b <= 0xDF) return { 2, 0x80, 0xBF };
            if (b == 0xE0) return { 3, 0xA0, 0xBF };
            if ((b >= 0xE1 && b <= 0xEC) || b == 0xEE || b == 0xEF) return { 3, 0x80, 0xBF };
            if (b == 0xED) return { 3, 0x80, 0x9F };
            if (b == 0xF0) return { 4, 0x90, 0xBF };
            if (b >= 0xF1 && b <= 0xF3) return { 4, 0x80, 0xBF };
            if (b == 0xF4) return { 4, 0x80, 0x8F };
            return { 0, 0, 0 };
        }

        unsigned char At(std::string_view s, std::size_t i) noexcept { return static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]); }
    }

    Unit DecodeAt(std::string_view s, std::size_t i) noexcept
    {
        const unsigned char b0 = At(s, i);
        const LeadInfo li = Lead(b0);
        if (li.length == 1) return { b0, 1, true };
        if (li.length == 0 || i + li.length > s.size()) return { b0, 1, false };
        const unsigned char b1 = At(s, i + 1);
        if (b1 < li.lo || b1 > li.hi) return { b0, 1, false };
        if (li.length == 2) return { (char32_t(b0 & 0x1Fu) << 6) | (b1 & 0x3Fu), 2, true };
        const unsigned char b2 = At(s, i + 2);
        if (!IsContinuation(b2)) return { b0, 1, false };
        if (li.length == 3)
            return { (char32_t(b0 & 0x0Fu) << 12) | (char32_t(b1 & 0x3Fu) << 6) | (b2 & 0x3Fu), 3, true };
        const unsigned char b3 = At(s, i + 3);
        if (!IsContinuation(b3)) return { b0, 1, false };
        return { (char32_t(b0 & 0x07u) << 18) | (char32_t(b1 & 0x3Fu) << 12) | (char32_t(b2 & 0x3Fu) << 6) | (b3 & 0x3Fu),
                 4, true };
    }

    std::size_t PrevUnitStart(std::string_view s, std::size_t i) noexcept
    {
        // A valid multi-byte sequence ending exactly at i starts 2..4 bytes back
        // at a lead byte. A lead byte can never sit inside an earlier valid
        // sequence, so the forward segmentation also lands on it. Anything else
        // makes byte i-1 a one-byte unit.
        for (std::size_t len = 2; len <= 4 && len <= i; ++len)
        {
            const Unit u = DecodeAt(s, i - len);
            if (u.valid && u.length == len) return i - len;
        }
        return i - 1;
    }

    bool IsValid(std::string_view s) noexcept { return FirstInvalid(s) == std::string_view::npos; }

    std::size_t FirstInvalid(std::string_view s) noexcept
    {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size();)
        {
            const Unit u = DecodeAt(s, i);
            if (!u.valid) return i;
            i += u.length;
        }
        return std::string_view::npos;
    }

    bool IsIncompletePrefix(std::string_view s) noexcept
    {
        if (s.empty() || s.size() > 3) return false;
        const LeadInfo li = Lead(At(s, 0));
        if (li.length <= s.size()) return false;   // not a lead, ASCII, or already long enough
        if (s.size() >= 2 && (At(s, 1) < li.lo || At(s, 1) > li.hi)) return false;
        if (s.size() >= 3 && !IsContinuation(At(s, 2))) return false;
        return true;
    }

    void Append(std::string& out, char32_t cp)
    {
        if (cp < 0x80)
        {
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>(cp));
        }
        else if (cp < 0x800)
        {
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>(0xC0u | (cp >> 6)));
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>(0x80u | (cp & 0x3Fu)));
        }
        else if (cp < 0x10000)
        {
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>(0xE0u | (cp >> 12)));
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>(0x80u | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3Fu)));
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>(0x80u | (cp & 0x3Fu)));
        }
        else
        {
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>(0xF0u | (cp >> 18)));
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>(0x80u | ((cp >> 12) & 0x3Fu)));
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>(0x80u | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3Fu)));
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>(0x80u | (cp & 0x3Fu)));
        }
    }

    std::size_t CountUnits(std::string_view s) noexcept
    {
        std::size_t n = 0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++n) i += DecodeAt(s, i).length;
        return n;
    }
}
```

```cpp
        for (const char32_t cp : { char32_t(0xE9), char32_t(0x20AC), char32_t(0x1F600) })
        {
            std::string s;
            Utf8::Append(s, cp);
            p.push_back(s);
        }
        p.push_back(std::string(1, static_cast<char>(0xFF)));
        return p;
    }

    std::string RandomText(std::size_t maxPieces)
    {
        static const std::vector<std::string> pieces = Pieces();
        const auto n = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, maxPieces + 1);
        std::string s;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) s += pieces[*rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, pieces.size())];
        return s;
    }

    Point ModelPoint(const std::string& s, std::size_t offset)
    {
        Point p;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < offset; ++i)
        {
            if (s[i] == '\n') { ++p.row; p.col = 0; }
            else ++p.col;
        }
        return p;
    }

    std::size_t ModelLineStart(const std::string& s, std::uint32_t row)
    {
        const auto newlines = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::count(s.begin(), s.end(), '\n'));
        std::size_t at = 0;
        for (std::uint32_t r = 0; r < std::min(row, newlines); ++r) at = s.find('\n', at) + 1;
        return at;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Rope: summaries, rows and seeks on a small text", "[text-rope]")
{
    const Rope r = Rope::FromUtf8("ab\ncde\n\nf");   // a0 b1 \n2 c3 d4 e5 \n6 \n7 f8
    CHECK(r.Size() == 9u);
    CHECK(r.LineCount() == 4u);
    const TextSummary s = r.Summary();
    CHECK(s.newlines == 3u);
    CHECK(s.firstLineBytes == 2u);
    CHECK(s.lastLineBytes == 1u);
    CHECK(s.longestLineBytes == 3u);
    CHECK(r.LineStart(0) == 0u);
    CHECK(r.LineStart(1) == 3u);
    CHECK(r.LineStart(2) == 7u);
    CHECK(r.LineStart(3) == 8u);
    CHECK(r.LineStart(9) == 8u);   // clamped to the last row
    CHECK(r.LineEnd(0) == 2u);
    CHECK(r.LineEnd(1) == 6u);
    CHECK(r.LineEnd(2) == 7u);
    CHECK(r.LineEnd(3) == 9u);
    CHECK(r.OffsetToPoint(4) == Point{ 1, 1 });
    CHECK(r.OffsetToPoint(7) == Point{ 2, 0 });
    CHECK(r.OffsetToPoint(9) == Point{ 3, 1 });
    CHECK(r.OffsetToPoint(99) == Point{ 3, 1 });
    CHECK(r.PointToOffset({ 1, 2 }) == 5u);
    CHECK(r.PointToOffset({ 1, 99 }) == 6u);   // column clamped to the row
    CHECK(r.PointToOffset({ 7, 0 }) == 8u);    // row clamped
    CHECK(r.ByteAt(3) == 'c');
    CHECK(r.LineLength(1) == 3u);
    const Rope empty;
    CHECK(empty.Size() == 0u);
    CHECK(empty.LineCount() == 1u);
    CHECK(empty.OffsetToPoint(0) == Point{ 0, 0 });
    CHECK(empty.LineEnd(0) == 0u);
}

TEST_CASE("Rope: a long text at a tiny leaf target is a balanced multi-level tree", "[text-rope]")
{
    std::string text;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2000; ++i) text += (i % 37 == 0) ? '\n' : static_cast<char>('a' + i % 26);
    const Rope r = Rope::FromUtf8(text, 8);
    CHECK(r.CheckInvariants().empty());
    CHECK(r.Height() >= 3u);
    CHECK(r.ToString() == text);
    CHECK(r.Summary() == Summarize(text));
    CHECK(r.LeafCount() >= 2000u / 8u);
}

TEST_CASE("Rope: random Replace sequences match a std::string model", "[text-rope]")
{
    for (const std::uint32_t target : { 8u, 16u, 64u, 512u })
    {
        INFO("leaf target " << target);
        rc::prop("text, summary, seeks and shape match the model", [target] {
            std::string model = RandomText(60);
            Rope rope = Rope::FromUtf8(model, target);
            const int steps = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 30);
            for (int i = 0; i < steps; ++i)
            {
                const auto b = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, model.size() + 1);
                const auto e = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(b, model.size() + 1);
                const std::string text = RandomText(20);
                rope = rope.Replace({ b, e }, text);
                model.replace(b, e - b, text);
                RC_ASSERT(rope.ToString() == model);
                RC_ASSERT(rope.CheckInvariants().empty());
                RC_ASSERT(rope.Summary() == Summarize(model));
                RC_ASSERT(rope.LeafTarget() == target);
            }
            const auto probe = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, model.size() + 1);
            const Point p = ModelPoint(model, probe);
            RC_ASSERT(rope.OffsetToPoint(probe) == p);
            RC_ASSERT(rope.PointToOffset(p) == probe);
            const auto row = *rc::gen::inRange<std::uint32_t>(0, rope.LineCount() + 2);
            RC_ASSERT(rope.LineStart(row) == ModelLineStart(model, row));
            if (!model.empty())
            {
                const auto at = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, model.size());
                RC_ASSERT(rope.ByteAt(at) == model[at]);
            }
        });
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Rope: Replace is persistent and copies are O(1)", "[text-rope]")
{
    const Rope a = Rope::FromUtf8(std::string(5000, 'x'), 16);
    const Rope b = a.Replace({ 100, 200 }, "hello");
    CHECK(a.ToString() == std::string(5000, 'x'));
    CHECK(b.Size() == 4905u);
    CHECK(b.Substr({ 100, 105 }) == "hello");
    const Rope c = a;
    CHECK(c.SharesRootWith(a));
    CHECK_FALSE(b.SharesRootWith(a));
    CHECK(a.Append("!").Size() == 5001u);
    CHECK(a.Slice({ 10, 20 }).ToString() == std::string(10, 'x'));
}

TEST_CASE("Rope: chunks over any range concatenate to the substring", "[text-rope]")
{
    rc::prop("ForEachChunk / CopyTo / ForEachChunkWhile", [] {
        const std::string model = RandomText(80);
        const Rope rope = Rope::FromUtf8(model, 8);
        const auto b = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, model.size() + 1);
        const auto e = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(b, model.size() + 1);
        std::string joined;
        rope.ForEachChunk({ b, e }, [&](std::string_view c) { joined.append(c); });
        RC_ASSERT(joined == model.substr(b, e - b));
        std::string copied = "stale";
        rope.CopyTo({ b, e }, copied);
        RC_ASSERT(copied == joined);
        std::size_t calls = 0;
        rope.ForEachChunkWhile({ 0, rope.Size() }, [&](std::string_view) { return ++calls < 2; });
        RC_ASSERT(calls <= 2u);
    });
}

TEST_CASE("Rope: leaf splits prefer code point starts", "[text-rope]")
{
    std::string text;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4000; ++i) Utf8::Append(text, 0xE9);
    const Rope r = Rope::FromUtf8(text, 64);
    bool allStart = true;
    r.ForEachChunk({ 0, r.Size() }, [&](std::string_view c) {
        allStart = allStart && !Utf8::IsContinuation(static_cast<unsigned char>(c.front()));
    });
    CHECK(allStart);
    CHECK(r.CheckInvariants().empty());
}

TEST_CASE("Rope: snapshots stay intact on other threads while the owner edits", "[text-rope]")
{
    std::string model;
    for (int i = 0; i < 20000; ++i) model += static_cast<char>('a' + i % 26);
    Rope rope = Rope::FromUtf8(model, 64);
    const Rope snapshot = rope;
    std::atomic<bool> ok{ true };
    std::vector<std::thread> readers;
    for (int t = 0; t < 4; ++t)
        readers.emplace_back([snapshot, model, &ok] {
            for (int k = 0; k < 50; ++k)
            {
                const Rope local = snapshot;
                if (local.ToString() != model) ok = false;
            }
        });
    for (int i = 0; i < 2000; ++i)
    {
        const auto at = static_cast<ByteOffset>(i * 7 % 15000);
        rope = rope.Replace({ at, at + 3 }, "XY");
    }
    for (std::thread& t : readers) t.join();
    CHECK(ok.load());
    CHECK(snapshot.ToString() == model);
    CHECK(rope.CheckInvariants().empty());
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// The text editor's rope (spec s3.1): a persistent, balanced B+ tree of byte
// leaves. A concrete rope written for Arcane, INFORMED BY the design of Zed's
// sum_tree (Apache-2.0; attribution in NOTICE.md). It is not a port of
// sum_tree's generic Summary/Dimension machinery, and Zed's GPL rope/text
// crates were design reference only.
//
// - Leaves hold raw bytes: normally UTF-8, and an invalid-UTF-8 file keeps its
//   bytes unchanged (spec s3.5). Leaf splits prefer a byte that is not a UTF-8
//   continuation byte, but nothing relies on that: readers that decode across
//   a chunk boundary copy a window first (Graphemes, FileCodec).
// - Every node caches a TextSummary. Offset <-> Point seeks are O(log n) by
//   seeking on one dimension while accumulating the other, so no line table is
//   rebuilt per edit.
// - Persistent: Replace copies only the touched path. A copy of a Rope is O(1)
//   and immutable, and node refcounts are atomic, so a RopeSnapshot can be read
//   on another thread while the owner keeps editing.
// - Shape: every leaf of a multi-leaf rope holds [leafTarget/2, leafTarget]
//   bytes, every non-root internal node has [kRopeMinChildren, kRopeMaxChildren]
//   children (an internal root has at least 2), and all leaves sit at one depth.
//   CheckInvariants() verifies all of it.

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextTypes.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    ARC_CONSTANT("data-structure shape; TE1-3's leaf-size benchmark (spec s3.1, s11.5) fixes it -- not a user tunable")
    inline constexpr std::uint32_t kRopeLeafTarget = 512;
    ARC_CONSTANT("B+ tree fan-out: a data-structure invariant; min = max / 2 keeps every split legal")
    inline constexpr std::uint32_t kRopeMaxChildren = 12;
    ARC_CONSTANT("B+ tree fan-out: half of kRopeMaxChildren (the split invariant)")
    inline constexpr std::uint32_t kRopeMinChildren = 6;
    ARC_CONSTANT("smallest accepted leaf target: the +-3 byte code-point search must fit inside [target/2, target]")
    inline constexpr std::uint32_t kRopeMinLeafTarget = 8;
    ARC_CONSTANT("largest accepted leaf target: leaf summaries count bytes in 32 bits with room to spare")
    inline constexpr std::uint32_t kRopeMaxLeafTarget = 65536;

    struct TextSummary
    {
        std::uint64_t bytes = 0;
        std::uint32_t newlines = 0;
        std::uint32_t lastLineBytes = 0;      // bytes after the last '\n' (all of them when there is none)
        std::uint32_t longestLineBytes = 0;   // the longest row, its '\n' excluded
        std::uint32_t firstLineBytes = 0;     // bytes before the first '\n' (all of them when there is none)

        friend constexpr bool operator==(const TextSummary&, const TextSummary&) = default;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] TextSummary Summarize(std::string_view bytes) noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] TextSummary Combine(const TextSummary& a, const TextSummary& b) noexcept;

    namespace Detail
    {
        struct RopeNode;
        void DestroyNode(const RopeNode* node) noexcept;   // Rope.cpp

        // An intrusive, thread-safe reference to an immutable node.
        class NodeRef
        {
        public:
            NodeRef() noexcept = default;
            explicit NodeRef(const RopeNode* adopt) noexcept;
            NodeRef(const NodeRef& other) noexcept;
            NodeRef(NodeRef&& other) noexcept : m_node(std::exchange(other.m_node, nullptr)) {}
            NodeRef& operator=(NodeRef other) noexcept
            {
                std::swap(m_node, other.m_node);
                return *this;
            }
            ~NodeRef();

            [[nodiscard]] const RopeNode* get() const noexcept { return m_node; }
            const RopeNode* operator->() const noexcept { return m_node; }
            const RopeNode& operator*() const noexcept { return *m_node; }
            explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return m_node != nullptr; }

        private:
            const RopeNode* m_node = nullptr;
        };

        struct RopeNode
        {
            mutable std::atomic<std::uint32_t> refs{ 0 };
            std::uint32_t        height = 0;   // 0 = leaf
            TextSummary          summary{};
            std::string          leaf;         // height 0 only
            std::vector<NodeRef> children;     // height > 0 only
        };

        inline NodeRef::NodeRef(const RopeNode* adopt) noexcept : m_node(adopt)
        {
            if (m_node) m_node->refs.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        }

        inline NodeRef::NodeRef(const NodeRef& other) noexcept : m_node(other.m_node)
        {
            if (m_node) m_node->refs.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        }

        inline NodeRef::~NodeRef()
        {
            if (m_node && m_node->refs.fetch_sub(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel) == 1) DestroyNode(m_node);
        }

        // Calls f on every leaf piece inside [b, e); stops early when f returns false.
        template <class F>
        bool VisitChunks(const RopeNode& n, ByteOffset base, ByteOffset b, ByteOffset e, F& f)
        {
            if (n.height == 0)
            {
                const ByteOffset lo = std::max(b, base) - base;
                const ByteOffset hi = std::min<ByteOffset>(e, base + n.leaf.size()) - base;
                if (lo < hi) return f(std::string_view(n.leaf).substr(static_cast<std::size_t>(lo), static_cast<std::size_t>(hi - lo)));
                return true;
            }
            for (const NodeRef& c : n.children)
            {
                const ByteOffset size = c->summary.bytes;
                if (base + size > b && base < e && !VisitChunks(*c, base, b, e, f)) return false;
                base += size;
                if (base >= e) break;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    class Rope
    {
    public:
        Rope() = default;

        static Rope FromUtf8(std::string_view text);
        // Benchmark and tests: an explicit leaf target, clamped to [kRopeMinLeafTarget, kRopeMaxLeafTarget].
        static Rope FromUtf8(std::string_view text, std::uint32_t leafTarget);

        std::uint64_t Size() const;
        std::uint32_t LineCount() const;   // newlines + 1
        TextSummary Summary() const;

        Point OffsetToPoint(ByteOffset offset) const;   // offset clamped to Size()
        ByteOffset PointToOffset(Point p) const;        // row clamped to the last row, col to that row's length
        ByteOffset LineStart(std::uint32_t row) const;  // row clamped
        ByteOffset LineEnd(std::uint32_t row) const;    // the row's end, '\n' excluded; row clamped
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t LineLength(std::uint32_t row) const { return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(LineEnd(row) - LineStart(row)); }
        [[nodiscard]] char ByteAt(ByteOffset offset) const;   // '\0' when offset >= Size()

        Rope Replace(ByteRange range, std::string_view text) const;   // range clamped to [0, Size()]
        [[nodiscard]] Rope Slice(ByteRange range) const;
        [[nodiscard]] Rope Append(std::string_view text) const { return Replace({ Size(), Size() }, text); }

        void CopyTo(ByteRange range, std::string& out) const;   // REPLACES out with the bytes in range (clamped)
        std::string ToString() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string Substr(ByteRange range) const
        {
            std::string s;
            CopyTo(range, s);
            return s;
        }

        template <class F> void ForEachChunk(ByteRange range, F&& f) const;        // f(std::string_view)
        template <class F> void ForEachChunkWhile(ByteRange range, F&& f) const;   // bool f(std::string_view); false stops

        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t LeafTarget() const noexcept { return m_leafTarget; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t Height() const noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t LeafCount() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t NodeCount() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t HeapBytes() const;     // node structs + leaf and child-vector capacity
        [[nodiscard]] std::string CheckInvariants() const; // "" when every shape and summary rule holds
        [[nodiscard]] bool SharesRootWith(const Rope& other) const noexcept { return m_root.get() == other.m_root.get(); }

    private:
        Rope(Detail::NodeRef root, std::uint32_t leafTarget) : m_root(std::move(root)), m_leafTarget(leafTarget) {}

        Detail::NodeRef m_root;   // null = empty
        std::uint32_t   m_leafTarget = kRopeLeafTarget;
    };

    struct RopeSnapshot
    {
        Rope rope;
        std::uint64_t version = 0;
    };

    template <class F>
    void Rope::ForEachChunk(ByteRange range, F&& f) const
    {
        auto adapter = [&f](std::string_view chunk) {
            f(chunk);
            return true;
        };
        if (m_root) Detail::VisitChunks(*m_root, 0, range.begin, std::min<ByteOffset>(range.end, Size()), adapter);
    }

    template <class F>
    void Rope::ForEachChunkWhile(ByteRange range, F&& f) const
    {
        auto adapter = [&f](std::string_view chunk) { return static_cast<bool>(f(chunk)); };
        if (m_root) Detail::VisitChunks(*m_root, 0, range.begin, std::min<ByteOffset>(range.end, Size()), adapter);
    }
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/Rope.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"

#include <cstring>
#include <iterator>
#include <span>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    TextSummary Summarize(std::string_view bytes) noexcept
    {
        TextSummary s;
        s.bytes = bytes.size();
        std::size_t lineStart = 0;
        bool sawNewline = false;
        const char* const base = bytes.data();
        for (std::size_t at = 0; at < bytes.size();)
        {
            const void* hit = std::memchr(base + at, '\n', bytes.size() - at);
            if (!hit) break;
            const auto nl = static_cast<std::size_t>(static_cast<const char*>(hit) - base);
            const auto len = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(nl - lineStart);
            if (!sawNewline)
            {
                s.firstLineBytes = len;
                sawNewline = true;
            }
            s.longestLineBytes = std::max(s.longestLineBytes, len);
            ++s.newlines;
            lineStart = nl + 1;
            at = nl + 1;
        }
        s.lastLineBytes = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(bytes.size() - lineStart);
        if (!sawNewline) s.firstLineBytes = s.lastLineBytes;
        s.longestLineBytes = std::max(s.longestLineBytes, s.lastLineBytes);
        return s;
    }

    TextSummary Combine(const TextSummary& a, const TextSummary& b) noexcept
    {
        if (a.bytes == 0) return b;
        if (b.bytes == 0) return a;
        TextSummary s;
        s.bytes = a.bytes + b.bytes;
        s.newlines = a.newlines + b.newlines;
        s.firstLineBytes = a.newlines > 0 ? a.firstLineBytes : a.lastLineBytes + b.firstLineBytes;
        s.lastLineBytes = b.newlines > 0 ? b.lastLineBytes : a.lastLineBytes + b.lastLineBytes;
        s.longestLineBytes = std::max({ a.longestLineBytes, b.longestLineBytes, a.lastLineBytes + b.firstLineBytes });
        return s;
    }

    namespace Detail
    {
        void DestroyNode(const RopeNode* node) noexcept { delete node; }
    }

    namespace
    {
        using Detail::NodeRef;
        using Detail::RopeNode;

        NodeRef MakeLeaf(std::string bytes)
        {
            auto* n = new RopeNode;
            n->summary = Summarize(bytes);
            n->leaf = std::move(bytes);
            return NodeRef(n);
        }

        NodeRef MakeInternal(std::vector<NodeRef> children)
        {
            auto* n = new RopeNode;
            n->height = children.front()->height + 1;
            TextSummary s{};
            for (const NodeRef& c : children) s = Combine(s, c->summary);
            n->summary = s;
            n->children = std::move(children);
            return NodeRef(n);
        }

        bool IsOkChild(const RopeNode& n, std::uint32_t target) noexcept
        {
            return n.height == 0 ? n.leaf.size() >= target / 2 : n.children.size() >= kRopeMinChildren;
        }

        // The split position in [lo, hi] nearest `ideal` whose byte is not a UTF-8
        // continuation byte, searching +-3; the clamped ideal when none is. Every
        // candidate p is < s.size(), so s[p] exists.
        std::size_t ChooseSplit(std::string_view s, std::size_t lo, std::size_t hi, std::size_t ideal)
        {
            ideal = std::clamp(ideal, lo, hi);
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d <= 3; ++d)
            {
                if (ideal >= lo + d && !Utf8::IsContinuation(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[ideal - d]))) return ideal - d;
                if (ideal + d <= hi && !Utf8::IsContinuation(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[ideal + d]))) return ideal + d;
            }
            return ideal;
        }

        // Leaves of [target/2, target] bytes (one shorter leaf only when the whole
        // text is shorter than target/2), sizes spread evenly.
        std::vector<NodeRef> BuildLeaves(std::string_view text, std::uint32_t target)
        {
            std::vector<NodeRef> leaves;
            if (text.empty()) return leaves;
            leaves.reserve(text.size() / target + 1);
            std::size_t pos = 0;
            while (text.size() - pos > target)
            {
                const std::size_t remaining = text.size() - pos;
                const std::size_t pieces = (remaining + target - 1) / target;   // >= 2
                const std::size_t ideal = remaining / pieces;                    // in [target/2, target]
                const std::string_view rest = text.substr(pos);
                const std::size_t hi = std::min<std::size_t>(target, remaining - target / 2);
                const std::size_t cut = ChooseSplit(rest, target / 2, hi, ideal);
                leaves.push_back(MakeLeaf(std::string(rest.substr(0, cut))));
                pos += cut;
            }
            leaves.push_back(MakeLeaf(std::string(text.substr(pos))));
            return leaves;
        }

        // Groups one level into nodes of [min, max] children until one root remains.
        NodeRef BuildTree(std::vector<NodeRef> level)
        {
            if (level.empty()) return {};
            while (level.size() > 1)
            {
                const std::size_t n = level.size();
                const std::size_t groups = (n + kRopeMaxChildren - 1) / kRopeMaxChildren;
                std::vector<NodeRef> next;
                next.reserve(groups);
                std::size_t at = 0;
                for (std::size_t g = 0; g < groups; ++g)
                {
                    const std::size_t take = n / groups + (g < n % groups ? 1 : 0);
                    std::vector<NodeRef> kids(std::make_move_iterator(level.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(at)),
                                              std::make_move_iterator(level.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(at + take)));
                    next.push_back(MakeInternal(std::move(kids)));
                    at += take;
                }
                level = std::move(next);
            }
            return std::move(level.front());
        }

        std::vector<NodeRef> Join(std::span<const NodeRef> a, std::span<const NodeRef> b)
        {
            std::vector<NodeRef> all;
            all.reserve(a.size() + b.size());
            all.insert(all.end(), a.begin(), a.end());
            all.insert(all.end(), b.begin(), b.end());
            return all;
        }

        // Children of one height, 2 <= count <= 2 * kRopeMaxChildren.
        NodeRef MergeNodes(std::vector<NodeRef> all)
        {
            if (all.size() <= kRopeMaxChildren) return MakeInternal(std::move(all));
            const std::size_t split = std::min<std::size_t>(kRopeMaxChildren, all.size() - kRopeMinChildren);
            std::vector<NodeRef> right(std::make_move_iterator(all.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(split)),
                                       std::make_move_iterator(all.end()));
            all.resize(split);
            std::vector<NodeRef> two;
            two.push_back(MakeInternal(std::move(all)));
            two.push_back(MakeInternal(std::move(right)));
            return MakeInternal(std::move(two));
        }

        NodeRef MergeLeaves(const RopeNode& a, const RopeNode& b, std::uint32_t target)
        {
            std::string both;
            both.reserve(a.leaf.size() + b.leaf.size());
            both.append(a.leaf).append(b.leaf);
            if (both.size() <= target) return MakeLeaf(std::move(both));
            const std::size_t lo = std::max<std::size_t>(target / 2, both.size() - target);
            const std::size_t hi = std::min<std::size_t>(target, both.size() - target / 2);
            const std::size_t cut = ChooseSplit(both, lo, hi, both.size() / 2);
            std::vector<NodeRef> two;
            two.push_back(MakeLeaf(both.substr(0, cut)));
            two.push_back(MakeLeaf(both.substr(cut)));
            return MakeInternal(std::move(two));
        }

        // Joins two balanced trees into one. The shorter tree merges along the
        // taller one's near edge, so the result keeps one leaf depth.
        NodeRef Concat(const NodeRef& a, const NodeRef& b, std::uint32_t target)
        {
            if (!a || a->summary.bytes == 0) return b;
            if (!b || b->summary.bytes == 0) return a;
            const std::uint32_t ha = a->height;
            const std::uint32_t hb = b->height;
            if (ha < hb)
            {
                const std::vector<NodeRef>& bc = b->children;
                if (ha + 1 == hb && IsOkChild(*a, target)) return MergeNodes(Join(std::span(&a, 1), bc));
                const NodeRef joined = Concat(a, bc.front(), target);
                const std::span<const NodeRef> rest(bc.begin() + 1, bc.end());
                if (joined->height + 1 == hb) return MergeNodes(Join(std::span(&joined, 1), rest));
                return MergeNodes(Join(joined->children, rest));
            }
            if (ha > hb)
            {
                const std::vector<NodeRef>& ac = a->children;
                if (hb + 1 == ha && IsOkChild(*b, target)) return MergeNodes(Join(ac, std::span(&b, 1)));
                const NodeRef joined = Concat(ac.back(), b, target);
                const std::span<const NodeRef> rest(ac.begin(), ac.end() - 1);
                if (joined->height + 1 == ha) return MergeNodes(Join(rest, std::span(&joined, 1)));
                return MergeNodes(Join(rest, joined->children));
            }
            if (IsOkChild(*a, target) && IsOkChild(*b, target))
            {
                std::vector<NodeRef> two{ a, b };
                return MakeInternal(std::move(two));
            }
            if (ha == 0) return MergeLeaves(*a, *b, target);
            return MergeNodes(Join(a->children, b->children));
        }

        // The tree of n's bytes [b, e) (relative to n), sharing every whole subtree.
        NodeRef SliceNode(const NodeRef& n, ByteOffset b, ByteOffset e, std::uint32_t target)
        {
            if (b >= e) return {};
            if (b == 0 && e == n->summary.bytes) return n;
            if (n->height == 0) return MakeLeaf(n->leaf.substr(static_cast<std::size_t>(b), static_cast<std::size_t>(e - b)));
            NodeRef acc;
            ByteOffset base = 0;
            for (const NodeRef& c : n->children)
            {
                const ByteOffset size = c->summary.bytes;
                const ByteOffset lo = std::max(b, base);
                const ByteOffset hi = std::min(e, base + size);
                if (lo < hi) acc = Concat(acc, SliceNode(c, lo - base, hi - base, target), target);
                base += size;
                if (base >= e) break;
            }
            return acc;
        }

        void CountNodes(const RopeNode& n, std::size_t& nodes, std::size_t& leaves, std::uint64_t& heap)
        {
            ++nodes;
            if (n.height == 0) ++leaves;
            heap += sizeof(RopeNode) + n.leaf.capacity() + n.children.capacity() * sizeof(NodeRef);
            for (const NodeRef& c : n.children) CountNodes(*c, nodes, leaves, heap);
        }

        void Check(const RopeNode& n, bool isRoot, std::uint32_t target, std::string& err)
        {
            if (!err.empty()) return;
            if (n.height == 0)
            {
                if (!n.children.empty()) err = "leaf with children";
                else if (n.leaf.size() > target) err = "leaf over target: " + std::to_string(n.leaf.size());
                else if (!isRoot && n.leaf.size() < target / 2) err = "leaf under half the target: " + std::to_string(n.leaf.size());
                else if (n.summary != Summarize(n.leaf)) err = "leaf summary differs from its bytes";
                return;
            }
            if (!n.leaf.empty())
            {
                err = "internal node holds bytes";
                return;
            }
            const std::size_t k = n.children.size();
            if (k > kRopeMaxChildren || k < (isRoot ? 2u : kRopeMinChildren))
            {
                err = "child count " + std::to_string(k) + " at height " + std::to_string(n.height);
                return;
            }
            TextSummary s{};
            for (const NodeRef& c : n.children)
            {
                if (c->height + 1 != n.height)
                {
                    err = "uneven leaf depth";
                    return;
                }
                Check(*c, false, target, err);
                s = Combine(s, c->summary);
            }
            if (err.empty() && s != n.summary) err = "internal summary differs at height " + std::to_string(n.height);
        }
    }

    Rope Rope::FromUtf8(std::string_view text) { return FromUtf8(text, kRopeLeafTarget); }

    Rope Rope::FromUtf8(std::string_view text, std::uint32_t leafTarget)
    {
        const std::uint32_t target = std::clamp(leafTarget, kRopeMinLeafTarget, kRopeMaxLeafTarget);
        return Rope(BuildTree(BuildLeaves(text, target)), target);
    }

    std::uint64_t Rope::Size() const { return m_root ? m_root->summary.bytes : 0; }
    std::uint32_t Rope::LineCount() const { return (m_root ? m_root->summary.newlines : 0) + 1; }
    TextSummary Rope::Summary() const { return m_root ? m_root->summary : TextSummary{}; }
    std::uint32_t Rope::Height() const noexcept { return m_root ? m_root->height : 0; }

    Point Rope::OffsetToPoint(ByteOffset offset) const
    {
        if (!m_root) return {};
        offset = std::min(offset, Size());
        std::uint32_t row = 0;
        std::uint64_t col = 0;   // bytes since the last '\n' before the position
        const RopeNode* n = m_root.get();
        while (n->height > 0)
        {
            const std::vector<NodeRef>& kids = n->children;
            std::size_t i = 0;
            for (; i + 1 < kids.size() && offset >= kids[i]->summary.bytes; ++i)
            {
                const TextSummary& s = kids[i]->summary;
                offset -= s.bytes;
                row += s.newlines;
                col = s.newlines > 0 ? s.lastLineBytes : col + s.bytes;
            }
            n = kids[i].get();
        }
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < offset; ++i)
        {
            if (n->leaf[i] == '\n')
            {
                ++row;
                col = 0;
            }
            else
            {
                ++col;
            }
        }
        return { row, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(col) };
    }

    ByteOffset Rope::LineStart(std::uint32_t row) const
    {
        if (!m_root) return 0;
        std::uint32_t need = std::min(row, m_root->summary.newlines);   // the '\n' the row starts after
        if (need == 0) return 0;
        ByteOffset base = 0;
        const RopeNode* n = m_root.get();
        while (n->height > 0)
        {
            const std::vector<NodeRef>& kids = n->children;
            std::size_t i = 0;
            for (; i + 1 < kids.size() && kids[i]->summary.newlines < need; ++i)
            {
                need -= kids[i]->summary.newlines;
                base += kids[i]->summary.bytes;
            }
            n = kids[i].get();
        }
        std::size_t i = 0;
        for (std::uint32_t seen = 0; i < n->leaf.size(); ++i)
            if (n->leaf[i] == '\n' && ++seen == need) break;
        return base + i + 1;
    }

    ByteOffset Rope::LineEnd(std::uint32_t row) const
    {
        const std::uint32_t newlines = m_root ? m_root->summary.newlines : 0;
        if (row < newlines) return LineStart(row + 1) - 1;
        return Size();
    }

    ByteOffset Rope::PointToOffset(Point p) const
    {
        const ByteOffset start = LineStart(p.row);
        const ByteOffset end = LineEnd(std::min(p.row, LineCount() - 1));
        return std::min<ByteOffset>(start + p.col, end);
    }

    char Rope::ByteAt(ByteOffset offset) const
    {
        if (!m_root || offset >= Size()) return '\0';
        const RopeNode* n = m_root.get();
        while (n->height > 0)
        {
            const std::vector<NodeRef>& kids = n->children;
            std::size_t i = 0;
            for (; i + 1 < kids.size() && offset >= kids[i]->summary.bytes; ++i) offset -= kids[i]->summary.bytes;
            n = kids[i].get();
        }
        return n->leaf[static_cast<std::size_t>(offset)];
    }

    Rope Rope::Replace(ByteRange range, std::string_view text) const
    {
        const ByteOffset size = Size();
        const ByteOffset b = std::min(range.begin, size);
        const ByteOffset e = std::clamp(range.end, b, size);
        if (b == e && text.empty()) return *this;
        const NodeRef left = m_root ? SliceNode(m_root, 0, b, m_leafTarget) : NodeRef{};
        const NodeRef right = m_root ? SliceNode(m_root, e, size, m_leafTarget) : NodeRef{};
        const NodeRef mid = BuildTree(BuildLeaves(text, m_leafTarget));
        NodeRef root = Concat(Concat(left, mid, m_leafTarget), right, m_leafTarget);
        if (root && root->summary.bytes == 0) root = NodeRef{};
        return Rope(std::move(root), m_leafTarget);
    }

    Rope Rope::Slice(ByteRange range) const
    {
        const ByteOffset size = Size();
        const ByteOffset b = std::min(range.begin, size);
        const ByteOffset e = std::clamp(range.end, b, size);
        return Rope(m_root ? SliceNode(m_root, b, e, m_leafTarget) : NodeRef{}, m_leafTarget);
    }

    void Rope::CopyTo(ByteRange range, std::string& out) const
    {
        out.clear();
        const ByteOffset b = std::min(range.begin, Size());
        const ByteOffset e = std::clamp(range.end, b, Size());
        out.reserve(static_cast<std::size_t>(e - b));
        ForEachChunk({ b, e }, [&out](std::string_view chunk) { out.append(chunk); });
    }

    std::string Rope::ToString() const { return Substr({ 0, Size() }); }

    std::size_t Rope::LeafCount() const
    {
        std::size_t nodes = 0, leaves = 0;
        std::uint64_t heap = 0;
        if (m_root) CountNodes(*m_root, nodes, leaves, heap);
        return leaves;
    }

    std::size_t Rope::NodeCount() const
    {
        std::size_t nodes = 0, leaves = 0;
        std::uint64_t heap = 0;
        if (m_root) CountNodes(*m_root, nodes, leaves, heap);
        return nodes;
    }

    std::uint64_t Rope::HeapBytes() const
    {
        std::size_t nodes = 0, leaves = 0;
        std::uint64_t heap = 0;
        if (m_root) CountNodes(*m_root, nodes, leaves, heap);
        return heap;
    }

    std::string Rope::CheckInvariants() const
    {
        if (!m_root) return {};
        if (m_root->summary.bytes == 0) return "an empty rope must have no root";
        std::string err;
        Check(*m_root, true, m_leafTarget, err);
        return err;
    }
}
```

### Task TE1-3: Rope leaf-size benchmark fixes `kRopeLeafTarget` (spec s3.1, s11.1, s11.5)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/RopeBenchTest.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp` (the `kRopeLeafTarget` line and its `ARC_CONSTANT` reason)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Rope::FromUtf8(text, leafTarget)`, `Replace`, `LineStart`, `OffsetToPoint`, `CopyTo`, `HeapBytes`, `LeafCount`, `CheckInvariants` (TE1-2).
- Produces: the measured `kRopeLeafTarget` value, plus a benchmark table (CSV) recorded in the task report. Later tasks rely only on the constant.

The workloads are the spec's s11.5 set: a 100 MB log build, random edits, row seeks, and snapshot cost across threads. Leaf targets measured: 128, 256, 512, 1024 bytes. **Decision rule, fixed before measuring:** take the medians over 3 runs. Pick the LARGEST target whose random-edit time, row-seek time and cross-thread edit+snapshot time are each at most 1.25x the best target's time on that workload. Larger leaves win ties because they cut node count and memory on the 512 MB ceiling (spec s3.1). If no target passes all three, pick the one with the smallest sum of the three ratios to the best.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

`ArcaneTests/src/Text/RopeBenchTest.cpp`:
```cpp
// Rope leaf-size benchmark (text-editor spec s3.1, s11.5). The hidden
// [.][text-bench] case measures 128..1024-byte leaf targets on a 100 MB
// synthetic log and writes rope-leaf-bench.csv to TEMP; run it in RELEASE.
// The [text-rope] smoke case runs the same harness at 1 MB in every suite run,
// so the harness itself stays correct.

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <deque>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <mutex>
#include <random>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;

    double MsSince(Clock::time_point t0) { return std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(Clock::now() - t0).count(); }

    // Lines shaped like Arcane's logger output (spec s11.5: "open a 100 MB log").
    std::string MakeLog(std::size_t targetBytes)
    {
        static const char* const levels[] = { "info", "warn", "error", "debug" };
        std::string s;
        s.reserve(targetBytes + 256);
        std::mt19937_64 rng(42);
        char line[256];
        for (std::uint64_t i = 0; s.size() < targetBytes; ++i)
        {
            const char* msg = (rng() % 5 == 0) ? "asset cook finished for Content/Textures/stone_albedo.png (2048x2048, BC7)" : "tick";
            const int n = std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[2026-10-07 12:%02u:%02u.%03u] [%s] [Editor] frame %llu: %s\n",
                                        static_cast<unsigned>((i / 60000) % 60), static_cast<unsigned>((i / 1000) % 60),
                                        static_cast<unsigned>(i % 1000), levels[rng() % 4],
                                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(i), msg);
            s.append(line, static_cast<std::size_t>(n));
        }
        return s;
    }

    struct BenchSize { std::size_t logBytes; int edits; int seeks; int threadedEdits; };

    struct BenchResult
    {
        std::uint32_t leafTarget = 0;
        double buildMs = 0;
        double editNs = 0;          // per random edit
        double rowSeekNs = 0;       // per LineStart(random row)
        double pointSeekNs = 0;     // per OffsetToPoint(random offset)
        double threadedEditNs = 0;  // per edit + snapshot hand-off while 3 readers copy 4 KB from snapshots
        double heapBytesPerByte = 0;
        std::size_t leaves = 0;
        bool correct = false;       // the rope still equals a model after the edits
    };

    BenchResult RunLeafBench(std::uint32_t target, const std::string& log, const BenchSize& size)
    {
        BenchResult r;
        r.leafTarget = target;
        auto t0 = Clock::now();
        Rope rope = Rope::FromUtf8(log, target);
        r.buildMs = MsSince(t0);
        r.heapBytesPerByte = double(rope.HeapBytes()) / double(log.size());
        r.leaves = rope.LeafCount();

        // Random edits: 90% one-byte insert, 9% one-byte delete, 1% 1 KB paste.
        std::mt19937_64 rng(7);
        const std::string paste(1024, 'p');
        std::string model = size.logBytes <= (1u << 20) ? log : std::string();   // the model is kept only for the small smoke size
        t0 = Clock::now();
        for (int i = 0; i < size.edits; ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset at = rng() % (rope.Size() + 1);
            const unsigned kind = static_cast<unsigned>(rng() % 100);
            if (kind < 90)
            {
                rope = rope.Replace({ at, at }, "x");
                if (!model.empty()) model.insert(static_cast<std::size_t>(at), "x");
            }
            else if (kind < 99 && at < rope.Size())
            {
                rope = rope.Replace({ at, at + 1 }, "");
                if (!model.empty()) model.erase(static_cast<std::size_t>(at), 1);
            }
            else
            {
                rope = rope.Replace({ at, at }, paste);
                if (!model.empty()) model.insert(static_cast<std::size_t>(at), paste);
            }
        }
        r.editNs = MsSince(t0) * 1e6 / size.edits;
        r.correct = rope.CheckInvariants().empty() && (model.empty() || rope.ToString() == model);

        // Row and point seeks.
        const std::uint32_t rows = rope.LineCount();
        volatile ByteOffset sink = 0;
        t0 = Clock::now();
        for (int i = 0; i < size.seeks; ++i) sink = sink + rope.LineStart(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rng() % rows));
        r.rowSeekNs = MsSince(t0) * 1e6 / size.seeks;
        t0 = Clock::now();
        for (int i = 0; i < size.seeks; ++i) sink = sink + rope.OffsetToPoint(rng() % (rope.Size() + 1)).row;
        r.pointSeekNs = MsSince(t0) * 1e6 / size.seeks;

        // Snapshot cost across threads: after each edit the owner publishes a
        // snapshot (an O(1) copy) into a bounded queue; 3 readers each copy 4 KB
        // out of whatever snapshot they take and drop it, so node releases (the
        // atomic decrements) happen on reader threads too.
        std::mutex mu;
        std::condition_variable cv;
        std::deque<Rope> queue;
        bool done = false;
        std::atomic<std::uint64_t> readBytes{ 0 };
        std::vector<std::thread> readers;
        for (int t = 0; t < 3; ++t)
            readers.emplace_back([&, t] {
                std::mt19937_64 local(100 + t);
                std::string buf;
                for (;;)
                {
                    Rope snap;
                    {
                        std::unique_lock lock(mu);
                        cv.wait(lock, [&] { return done || !queue.empty(); });
                        if (queue.empty()) return;
                        snap = std::move(queue.front());
                        queue.pop_front();
                    }
                    const ByteOffset at = local() % (snap.Size() + 1);
                    snap.CopyTo({ at, at + 4096 }, buf);
                    readBytes += buf.size();
                }
            });
        t0 = Clock::now();
        for (int i = 0; i < size.threadedEdits; ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset at = rng() % (rope.Size() + 1);
            rope = rope.Replace({ at, at }, "y");
            {
                std::lock_guard lock(mu);
                if (queue.size() >= 64) queue.pop_front();   // the owner never waits on a slow reader
                queue.push_back(rope);
            }
            cv.notify_one();
        }
        r.threadedEditNs = MsSince(t0) * 1e6 / size.threadedEdits;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(mu);
            done = true;
        }
        cv.notify_all();
        for (std::thread& t : readers) t.join();
        r.correct = r.correct && rope.CheckInvariants().empty();
        return r;
    }

    std::string CsvRow(const BenchResult& r)
    {
        char line[256];
        std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "%u,%.1f,%.0f,%.0f,%.0f,%.0f,%.3f,%zu", r.leafTarget, r.buildMs, r.editNs, r.rowSeekNs,
                      r.pointSeekNs, r.threadedEditNs, r.heapBytesPerByte, r.leaves);
        return line;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Rope bench harness: every leaf target survives the workloads at 1 MB", "[text-rope]")
{
    const std::string log = MakeLog(std::size_t(1) << 20);
    for (const std::uint32_t target : { 128u, 256u, 512u, 1024u })
    {
        INFO("leaf target " << target);
        const BenchResult r = RunLeafBench(target, log, { std::size_t(1) << 20, 2000, 2000, 500 });
        CHECK(r.correct);
        CHECK(r.leaves >= log.size() / target);
        CHECK(r.leaves <= 2 * log.size() / target + 1);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Rope leaf-size benchmark: 100 MB log, 128..1024 B leaves (Release)", "[.][text-bench]")
{
    const BenchSize size{ std::size_t(100) << 20, 200000, 1000000, 20000 };
    const std::string log = MakeLog(size.logBytes);
    std::vector<std::string> rows{ "leafTarget,buildMs,editNs,rowSeekNs,pointSeekNs,threadedEditNs,heapBytesPerByte,leaves" };
    for (const std::uint32_t target : { 128u, 256u, 512u, 1024u })
    {
        std::vector<BenchResult> runs;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) runs.push_back(RunLeafBench(target, log, size));
        const auto median = [&](double BenchResult::*field) {
            std::vector<double> v;
            for (const BenchResult& r : runs) v.push_back(r.*field);
            std::sort(v.begin(), v.end());
            return v[1];
        };
        BenchResult m = runs[0];
        m.buildMs = median(&BenchResult::buildMs);
        m.editNs = median(&BenchResult::editNs);
        m.rowSeekNs = median(&BenchResult::rowSeekNs);
        m.pointSeekNs = median(&BenchResult::pointSeekNs);
        m.threadedEditNs = median(&BenchResult::threadedEditNs);
        CHECK(m.correct);
        rows.push_back(CsvRow(m));
        WARN(rows.back());
    }
    const char* temp = std::getenv("TEMP");
    REQUIRE(temp != nullptr);
    std::ofstream out(std::filesystem::path(temp) / "rope-leaf-bench.csv");
    for (const std::string& line : rows) out << line << '\n';
}
```

### Task TE1-4: Grapheme clusters, a UAX #29 subset (spec s5.1, s3.5)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/Graphemes.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/Graphemes.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/GraphemesTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Utf8::DecodeAt`, `Utf8::PrevUnitStart` (TE1-1); `Rope::Size`, `Rope::CopyTo` (TE1-2).
- Produces:
  - `enum class GraphemeClass { Other, CR, LF, Control, Extend, ZWJ, SpacingMark, RegionalIndicator, ExtendedPictographic }`, `GraphemeClass ClassifyGrapheme(char32_t)`, `struct CodePointRange { char32_t lo, hi; }`, `Detail::GraphemeTable(GraphemeClass) -> std::span<const CodePointRange>`.
  - String level, where index 0 is a cluster boundary: `std::size_t NextGraphemeBoundary(std::string_view, std::size_t)`, `std::size_t PrevGraphemeBoundary(std::string_view, std::size_t)`, `std::size_t CountGraphemes(std::string_view)`.
  - Rope level: `ByteOffset NextGraphemeBoundary(const Rope&, ByteOffset)`, `ByteOffset PrevGraphemeBoundary(const Rope&, ByteOffset)`. TextCommands (TE1-14..) and vim motions (TE5) step the cursor with these.

Subset (spec s5.1): GB3/GB4/GB5 (CR LF, controls), GB9/GB9a (combining marks: the Grapheme_Extend ranges plus a SpacingMark subset for the Indic, Southeast Asian and Javanese blocks), GB11 (ZWJ emoji sequences), GB12/GB13 (regional-indicator pairs), GB999. Not covered, and stated in the header: Hangul L/V/T jamo sequences (GB6-8; precomposed syllables are single code points), Prepend (GB9b), Indic conjunct breaks (GB9c). Each invalid UTF-8 byte is its own cluster, with a break before and after it (spec s3.5).

```cpp
// Grapheme clusters (text-editor spec s5.1): the UAX #29 subset, invalid bytes
// as their own clusters (s3.5), and the rope-level walk across leaf seams.

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>

#include "TextEditor/Core/Graphemes.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <initializer_list>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    std::string S(std::initializer_list<char32_t> cps)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const char32_t cp : cps) Utf8::Append(out, cp);
        return out;
    }

    std::vector<std::size_t> Forward(std::string_view s)
    {
        std::vector<std::size_t> b{ 0 };
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size();)
        {
            i = NextGraphemeBoundary(s, i);
            b.push_back(i);
        }
        return b;
    }

    std::vector<std::size_t> Backward(std::string_view s)
    {
        std::vector<std::size_t> b{ s.size() };
        for (std::size_t i = s.size(); i > 0;)
        {
            i = PrevGraphemeBoundary(s, i);
            b.push_back(i);
        }
        std::reverse(b.begin(), b.end());
        return b;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Graphemes: the range tables are sorted and disjoint", "[text-grapheme]")
{
    for (const GraphemeClass c : { GraphemeClass::Control, GraphemeClass::Extend, GraphemeClass::SpacingMark,
                                   GraphemeClass::ExtendedPictographic })
    {
        const std::span<const CodePointRange> t = Detail::GraphemeTable(c);
        REQUIRE_FALSE(t.empty());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < t.size(); ++i)
        {
            INFO("range " << i);
            CHECK(t[i].lo <= t[i].hi);
            if (i > 0) CHECK(t[i - 1].hi < t[i].lo);
        }
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Graphemes: UAX #29 subset boundaries, forward and backward", "[text-grapheme]")
{
    struct Row { const char* name; std::string text; std::vector<std::size_t> bounds; };
    const std::vector<Row> rows = {
        { "ascii", "abc", { 0, 1, 2, 3 } },
        { "combining acute joins its base", S({ U'e', 0x301, U'x' }), { 0, 3, 4 } },
        { "CR LF is one cluster", "\r\n", { 0, 2 } },
        { "LF CR is two", "\n\r", { 0, 1, 2 } },
        { "tab is a control", "a\t", { 0, 1, 2 } },
        { "emoji with a skin-tone modifier", S({ 0x1F44D, 0x1F3FD }), { 0, 8 } },
        { "family ZWJ sequence", S({ 0x1F468, 0x200D, 0x1F469, 0x200D, 0x1F467 }), { 0, 18 } },
        { "two flags", S({ 0x1F1E9, 0x1F1EA, 0x1F1EB, 0x1F1F7 }), { 0, 8, 16 } },
        { "an odd regional indicator stands alone", S({ 0x1F1E9, 0x1F1EA, 0x1F1EB }), { 0, 8, 12 } },
        { "an invalid byte stands alone", "a" + std::string(1, static_cast<char>(0xFF)) + S({ 0x301 }), { 0, 1, 2, 4 } },
        { "a truncated sequence is two invalid bytes", std::string("\xE2\x82", 2), { 0, 1, 2 } },
        { "devanagari spacing mark", S({ 0x915, 0x93F }), { 0, 6 } },
        { "heart with variation selector 16", S({ 0x2764, 0xFE0F }), { 0, 6 } },
        { "ZWJ after a letter does not join the next letter", S({ U'a', 0x200D, U'b' }), { 0, 4, 5 } },
        { "a lone ZWJ", S({ 0x200D }), { 0, 3 } },
    };
    for (const Row& r : rows)
    {
        INFO(r.name);
        CHECK(Forward(r.text) == r.bounds);
        CHECK(Backward(r.text) == r.bounds);
    }
    CHECK(CountGraphemes(S({ 0x1F468, 0x200D, 0x1F469 })) == 1u);
    CHECK(ClassifyGrapheme(0x200D) == GraphemeClass::ZWJ);
    CHECK(ClassifyGrapheme(0x1F1E6) == GraphemeClass::RegionalIndicator);
    CHECK(ClassifyGrapheme(U'a') == GraphemeClass::Other);
}

TEST_CASE("Graphemes: rope-level boundaries match the string walk across leaf seams", "[text-grapheme]")
{
    rc::prop("rope walk == string walk", [] {
        static const std::vector<std::string> pieces = {
            "a", " ", "\n", S({ U'e', 0x301 }), S({ 0x1F468, 0x200D, 0x1F469 }), S({ 0x1F1E9, 0x1F1EA }),
            S({ 0x1F1EB }), std::string(1, static_cast<char>(0xFF)), S({ 0x2764, 0xFE0F }), S({ 0x915, 0x93F }),
            S({ 0x301 }), S({ 0x200D }),
        };
        std::string text;
        const auto n = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, 60);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) text += pieces[*rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, pieces.size())];
        const Rope rope = Rope::FromUtf8(text, 8);
        const std::vector<std::size_t> expected = Forward(text);
        std::vector<std::size_t> walk{ 0 };
        for (ByteOffset at = 0; at < rope.Size();)
        {
            at = NextGraphemeBoundary(rope, at);
            walk.push_back(static_cast<std::size_t>(at));
        }
        RC_ASSERT(walk == expected);
        std::vector<std::size_t> back{ static_cast<std::size_t>(rope.Size()) };
        for (ByteOffset at = rope.Size(); at > 0;)
        {
            at = PrevGraphemeBoundary(rope, at);
            back.push_back(static_cast<std::size_t>(at));
        }
        std::reverse(back.begin(), back.end());
        RC_ASSERT(back == expected);
    });
}

TEST_CASE("Graphemes: a cluster longer than the scan window is still found whole", "[text-grapheme]")
{
    std::string text = "a";
    for (int i = 0; i < 300; ++i) Utf8::Append(text, 0x301);
    text += "b";   // 1 + 600 + 1 bytes
    const Rope rope = Rope::FromUtf8(text, 16);
    CHECK(NextGraphemeBoundary(rope, 0) == 601u);
    CHECK(PrevGraphemeBoundary(rope, 601) == 0u);
    CHECK(PrevGraphemeBoundary(rope, 602) == 601u);
}
```
