- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/Graphemes.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// Grapheme cluster boundaries (spec s5.1): a UAX #29 SUBSET -- CR LF and
// controls (GB3-5), combining marks (Grapheme_Extend plus a SpacingMark subset,
// GB9/9a), ZWJ emoji sequences (GB11) and regional-indicator pairs (GB12/13).
// NOT covered: Hangul L/V/T jamo sequences (GB6-8), Prepend (GB9b), Indic
// conjunct breaks (GB9c). Each invalid UTF-8 byte is its own cluster with a
// break on both sides (spec s3.5), so cursors step over invalid bytes one at a time.
//
// Grapheme-correct cursor movement does not fix rendering: complex shaping,
// bidi and colour emoji are ImGui display limits (spec s1.2).

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class GraphemeClass : std::uint8_t
    {
        Other,
        CR,
        LF,
        Control,
        Extend,
        ZWJ,
        SpacingMark,
        RegionalIndicator,
        ExtendedPictographic,
    };

    struct CodePointRange
    {
        char32_t lo, hi;   // inclusive
    };

    [[nodiscard]] GraphemeClass ClassifyGrapheme(char32_t cp) noexcept;

    namespace Detail
    {
        // The sorted range table behind a class (Control, Extend, SpacingMark,
        // ExtendedPictographic); empty for the others. For the tests.
        [[nodiscard]] std::span<const CodePointRange> GraphemeTable(GraphemeClass c) noexcept;
    }

    // In a string whose index 0 is a cluster boundary.
    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t NextGraphemeBoundary(std::string_view s, std::size_t i) noexcept;   // i a boundary < size
    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t PrevGraphemeBoundary(std::string_view s, std::size_t i) noexcept;   // 0 < i <= size
    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t CountGraphemes(std::string_view s) noexcept;

    // Over a rope; `at` is a cluster boundary (every cursor position is).
    [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset NextGraphemeBoundary(const Rope& text, ByteOffset at);   // Size() when at >= Size()
    [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset PrevGraphemeBoundary(const Rope& text, ByteOffset at);   // 0 when at == 0
}
```

```cpp
            { 0x1F22F, 0x1F22F }, { 0x1F232, 0x1F23A }, { 0x1F23C, 0x1F23F }, { 0x1F249, 0x1F3FA }, { 0x1F400, 0x1F53D },
            { 0x1F546, 0x1F64F }, { 0x1F680, 0x1F6FF }, { 0x1F774, 0x1F77F }, { 0x1F7D5, 0x1F7FF }, { 0x1F80C, 0x1F80F },
            { 0x1F848, 0x1F84F }, { 0x1F85A, 0x1F85F }, { 0x1F888, 0x1F88F }, { 0x1F8AE, 0x1F8FF }, { 0x1F90C, 0x1F93A },
            { 0x1F93C, 0x1F945 }, { 0x1F947, 0x1FAFF }, { 0x1FC00, 0x1FFFD },
        };

        ARC_CONSTANT("speed hint for the rope-level scans: the window doubles until the answer is determined, so it bounds nothing")
        constexpr ByteOffset kScanWindowBytes = 64;

        bool InTable(std::span<const CodePointRange> table, char32_t cp) noexcept
        {
            const auto it = std::upper_bound(table.begin(), table.end(), cp,
                                             [](char32_t v, const CodePointRange& r) { return v < r.lo; });
            return it != table.begin() && cp <= std::prev(it)->hi;
        }

        // A cluster always begins at q: break before it under every covered rule.
        bool IsSafeStart(std::string_view s, std::size_t q) noexcept
        {
            const Utf8::Unit u = Utf8::DecodeAt(s, q);
            if (!u.valid) return true;
            switch (ClassifyGrapheme(u.cp))
            {
            case GraphemeClass::Other:
            case GraphemeClass::CR:
            case GraphemeClass::Control:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;   // LF (CR LF), Extend/ZWJ/SpacingMark (GB9/9a), RI (GB12/13), ExtPict (GB11)
            }
        }

        // The previous boundary, or nullopt when the backward scan reached the
        // window start without proof that it is a boundary. minSafe keeps the
        // scan away from a window start that may cut a UTF-8 sequence.
        std::optional<std::size_t> PrevIn(std::string_view s, std::size_t i, bool startIsBoundary, std::size_t minSafe) noexcept
        {
            std::size_t q = Utf8::PrevUnitStart(s, i);
            while (q > 0 && !(q >= minSafe && IsSafeStart(s, q))) q = Utf8::PrevUnitStart(s, q);
            if (q == 0 && !startIsBoundary) return std::nullopt;
            std::size_t b = q;
            for (;;)
            {
                const std::size_t n = NextGraphemeBoundary(s, b);
                if (n >= i) return b;
                b = n;
            }
        }
    }

    GraphemeClass ClassifyGrapheme(char32_t cp) noexcept
    {
        if (cp == U'\r') return GraphemeClass::CR;
        if (cp == U'\n') return GraphemeClass::LF;
        if (cp == 0x200D) return GraphemeClass::ZWJ;
        if (cp >= 0x1F1E6 && cp <= 0x1F1FF) return GraphemeClass::RegionalIndicator;
        if (InTable(kControl, cp)) return GraphemeClass::Control;
        if (InTable(kExtend, cp)) return GraphemeClass::Extend;
        if (InTable(kSpacingMark, cp)) return GraphemeClass::SpacingMark;
        if (InTable(kExtPict, cp)) return GraphemeClass::ExtendedPictographic;
        return GraphemeClass::Other;
    }

    namespace Detail
    {
        std::span<const CodePointRange> GraphemeTable(GraphemeClass c) noexcept
        {
            switch (c)
            {
            case GraphemeClass::Control: return kControl;
            case GraphemeClass::Extend: return kExtend;
            case GraphemeClass::SpacingMark: return kSpacingMark;
            case GraphemeClass::ExtendedPictographic: return kExtPict;
            default: return {};
            }
        }
    }

    std::size_t NextGraphemeBoundary(std::string_view s, std::size_t i) noexcept
    {
        if (i >= s.size()) return s.size();
        const Utf8::Unit first = Utf8::DecodeAt(s, i);
        std::size_t pos = i + first.length;
        if (!first.valid) return pos;   // an invalid byte is its own cluster
        GraphemeClass prev = ClassifyGrapheme(first.cp);
        if (prev == GraphemeClass::CR) return (pos < s.size() && s[pos] == '\n') ? pos + 1 : pos;   // GB3, GB4
        if (prev == GraphemeClass::LF || prev == GraphemeClass::Control) return pos;                // GB4
        bool pict = prev == GraphemeClass::ExtendedPictographic;   // "ExtPict Extend*" so far
        bool pictZwj = false;                                       // "ExtPict Extend* ZWJ" so far
        std::size_t regional = prev == GraphemeClass::RegionalIndicator ? 1 : 0;
        while (pos < s.size())
        {
            const Utf8::Unit u = Utf8::DecodeAt(s, pos);
            if (!u.valid) break;   // break before an invalid byte
            const GraphemeClass c = ClassifyGrapheme(u.cp);
            bool join = false;
            switch (c)
            {
            case GraphemeClass::Extend:
            case GraphemeClass::ZWJ:
            case GraphemeClass::SpacingMark:
                join = true;   // GB9, GB9a
                break;
            case GraphemeClass::ExtendedPictographic:
                join = pictZwj;   // GB11
                break;
            case GraphemeClass::RegionalIndicator:
                join = prev == GraphemeClass::RegionalIndicator && regional % 2 == 1;   // GB12, GB13
                break;
            default:
                join = false;   // GB5, GB999
                break;
            }
            if (!join) break;
            pictZwj = c == GraphemeClass::ZWJ && pict;
            pict = c == GraphemeClass::ExtendedPictographic || (pict && c == GraphemeClass::Extend);
            if (c == GraphemeClass::RegionalIndicator) ++regional;
            prev = c;
            pos += u.length;
        }
        return pos;
    }

    std::size_t PrevGraphemeBoundary(std::string_view s, std::size_t i) noexcept
    {
        if (i == 0) return 0;
        return *PrevIn(s, std::min(i, s.size()), true, 0);
    }

    std::size_t CountGraphemes(std::string_view s) noexcept
    {
        std::size_t n = 0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++n) i = NextGraphemeBoundary(s, i);
        return n;
    }

    ByteOffset NextGraphemeBoundary(const Rope& text, ByteOffset at)
    {
        const ByteOffset size = text.Size();
        if (at >= size) return size;
        std::string window;
        for (ByteOffset w = kScanWindowBytes;; w *= 2)
        {
            const ByteOffset end = std::min(size, at + w);
            text.CopyTo({ at, end }, window);
            const std::size_t n = NextGraphemeBoundary(window, 0);
            if (n < window.size() || end == size) return at + n;   // a cluster ending AT the window end may continue
        }
    }

    ByteOffset PrevGraphemeBoundary(const Rope& text, ByteOffset at)
    {
        at = std::min(at, text.Size());
        if (at == 0) return 0;
        std::string window;
        for (ByteOffset w = kScanWindowBytes;; w *= 2)
        {
            const ByteOffset start = at > w ? at - w : 0;
            text.CopyTo({ start, at }, window);
            // A window that does not start the text may start inside a UTF-8
            // sequence: units within its first 4 bytes are not trusted.
            if (const auto b = PrevIn(window, window.size(), start == 0, start == 0 ? 0 : 4)) return start + *b;
        }
    }
}
```

### Task TE1-5: Anchors and edit shifting (spec s3.2)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/Anchor.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/AnchorTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ByteOffset`, `Bias` (TE1-1).
- Produces:
  - `struct Anchor { ByteOffset offset; Bias bias; }`.
  - `struct EditShift { ByteOffset begin, end, newLength; }`: one replaced range of an edit batch in PRE-edit coordinates. A batch's shifts are sorted, disjoint, and have strictly increasing begins.
  - `class EditShiftMap { explicit EditShiftMap(std::span<const EditShift>); ByteOffset Map(ByteOffset, Bias) const; }`: O(log edits) per offset.
  - `ByteOffset ShiftOffset(ByteOffset, Bias, std::span<const EditShift>)`.
  - `class AnchorSet { using Id = std::uint32_t; Id Add(Anchor); void Remove(Id); bool Contains(Id) const; Anchor Get(Id) const; void Set(Id, Anchor); std::size_t Size() const; void Clear(); void Shift(std::span<const EditShift>); template<class F> void ForEach(F&&) const; }`. Vim marks (TE5b) and bookmarks (TE4) own one; `FoldModel` (TE1-12) uses `Anchor` directly.

Bias rule (spec s3.2), for a single replaced range `[b, e)` with `n` new bytes:
- an offset before `b` is unchanged;
- at `b`, or strictly inside `(b, e)`: Left maps to `b`, Right maps to `b + n` (a pure insertion is the `b == e` case);
- at or after `e` (when `e > b`): shifted by `n - (e - b)`.

`ArcaneTests/src/Text/AnchorTest.cpp`:
```cpp
// Anchors (text-editor spec s3.2): the bias rules at edit boundaries, batched
// edits against a one-edit-at-a-time model, and AnchorSet bookkeeping.

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>

#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"

#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    // The single-edit rule, applied to one edit.
    ByteOffset ModelOne(ByteOffset o, Bias bias, const EditShift& e)
    {
        if (o < e.begin) return o;
        if (o == e.begin || o < e.end) return bias == Bias::Left ? e.begin : e.begin + e.newLength;
        return o + e.newLength - (e.end - e.begin);
    }

    // Edits applied one at a time from the LAST to the first, each in pre-edit
    // coordinates: a later edit never moves an earlier one's offsets.
    ByteOffset Model(ByteOffset o, Bias bias, const std::vector<EditShift>& edits)
    {
        for (auto it = edits.rbegin(); it != edits.rend(); ++it) o = ModelOne(o, bias, *it);
        return o;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Anchor: bias at an insertion point", "[text-anchor]")
{
    const std::vector<EditShift> ins{ { 5, 5, 2 } };   // "XY" inserted at 5
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(4, Bias::Left, ins) == 4u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(5, Bias::Left, ins) == 5u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(5, Bias::Right, ins) == 7u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(6, Bias::Left, ins) == 8u);
}

TEST_CASE("Anchor: deletion and replacement collapse to the edit's edges", "[text-anchor]")
{
    const std::vector<EditShift> del{ { 3, 6, 0 } };
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(3, Bias::Left, del) == 3u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(3, Bias::Right, del) == 3u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(4, Bias::Left, del) == 3u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(4, Bias::Right, del) == 3u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(6, Bias::Left, del) == 3u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(7, Bias::Right, del) == 4u);
    const std::vector<EditShift> rep{ { 3, 6, 2 } };
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(3, Bias::Left, rep) == 3u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(3, Bias::Right, rep) == 5u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(4, Bias::Left, rep) == 3u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(4, Bias::Right, rep) == 5u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(6, Bias::Left, rep) == 5u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(9, Bias::Left, rep) == 8u);
}

TEST_CASE("Anchor: a batch maps like one edit at a time", "[text-anchor]")
{
    const std::vector<EditShift> batch{ { 1, 2, 0 }, { 5, 5, 2 } };
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(5, Bias::Left, batch) == 4u);
    CHECK(ShiftOffset(5, Bias::Right, batch) == 6u);
    rc::prop("EditShiftMap == sequential model", [] {
        std::vector<EditShift> edits;
        ByteOffset at = 0;
        const int n = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 6);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        {
            // Strictly increasing begins; a non-empty edit may be touched by the next one.
            const ByteOffset minGap = (i > 0 && edits.back().end == edits.back().begin) ? 1 : 0;
            const ByteOffset begin = at + *rc::gen::inRange<ByteOffset>(minGap, 6);
            const ByteOffset end = begin + *rc::gen::inRange<ByteOffset>(0, 5);
            edits.push_back({ begin, end, *rc::gen::inRange<ByteOffset>(0, 5) });
            at = end;
        }
        const EditShiftMap map(edits);
        for (ByteOffset o = 0; o <= at + 3; ++o)
        {
            RC_ASSERT(map.Map(o, Bias::Left) == Model(o, Bias::Left, edits));
            RC_ASSERT(map.Map(o, Bias::Right) == Model(o, Bias::Right, edits));
        }
    });
}

TEST_CASE("AnchorSet: ids are stable, removed ids are reused, Shift moves live anchors only", "[text-anchor]")
{
    AnchorSet set;
    const AnchorSet::Id a = set.Add({ 10, Bias::Left });
    const AnchorSet::Id b = set.Add({ 10, Bias::Right });
    const AnchorSet::Id c = set.Add({ 20, Bias::Left });
    CHECK(set.Size() == 3u);
    set.Remove(b);
    CHECK_FALSE(set.Contains(b));
    CHECK(set.Size() == 2u);
    const AnchorSet::Id d = set.Add({ 0, Bias::Right });
    CHECK(d == b);   // the freed slot
    const std::vector<EditShift> ins{ { 10, 10, 4 } };
    set.Shift(ins);
    CHECK(set.Get(a).offset == 10u);
    CHECK(set.Get(c).offset == 24u);
    CHECK(set.Get(d).offset == 0u);
    set.Set(a, { 3, Bias::Right });
    CHECK(set.Get(a) == Anchor{ 3, Bias::Right });
    std::size_t visited = 0;
    set.ForEach([&](AnchorSet::Id, const Anchor&) { ++visited; });
    CHECK(visited == 3u);
    set.Clear();
    CHECK(set.Size() == 0u);
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// Anchors (spec s3.2): an offset that survives edits. Everything that must
// outlive an edit -- selections in other views, vim marks, folds, bookmarks --
// shifts through these rules. Search matches are never anchors (s3.2): they
// are recomputed per snapshot instead.
//
// For one replaced range [b, e) with n new bytes:
//   o <  b              -> o
//   o == b or b < o < e -> Left: b, Right: b + n   (b == e is a pure insertion)
//   o >= e (e > b)      -> o + n - (e - b)

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextTypes.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct Anchor
    {
        ByteOffset offset = 0;
        Bias       bias = Bias::Left;

        friend constexpr bool operator==(const Anchor&, const Anchor&) = default;
    };

    // One replaced range of an edit batch, in PRE-edit coordinates. A batch's
    // shifts are sorted by begin, disjoint (end_i <= begin_i+1), and begin at
    // strictly increasing offsets.
    struct EditShift
    {
        ByteOffset begin = 0;
        ByteOffset end = 0;
        ByteOffset newLength = 0;

        friend constexpr bool operator==(const EditShift&, const EditShift&) = default;
    };

    class EditShiftMap
    {
    public:
        explicit EditShiftMap(std::span<const EditShift> edits);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset Map(ByteOffset offset, Bias bias) const noexcept;

    private:
        std::span<const EditShift> m_edits;
        std::vector<std::int64_t>  m_deltaBefore;   // [i] = net length change of edits [0, i); size = edits + 1
    };

    [[nodiscard]] inline ByteOffset ShiftOffset(ByteOffset offset, Bias bias, std::span<const EditShift> edits)
    {
        return EditShiftMap(edits).Map(offset, bias);
    }

    class AnchorSet
    {
    public:
        using Id = std::uint32_t;

        Id Add(Anchor a);
        void Remove(Id id);
        [[nodiscard]] bool Contains(Id id) const noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] Anchor Get(Id id) const;   // id must be live
        void Set(Id id, Anchor a);               // id must be live
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t Size() const noexcept { return m_count; }
        void Clear() noexcept;
        void Shift(std::span<const EditShift> edits);

        template <class F>
        void ForEach(F&& f) const
        {
            for (Id i = 0; i < static_cast<Id>(m_slots.size()); ++i)
                if (m_live[i]) f(i, m_slots[i]);
        }

    private:
        std::vector<Anchor> m_slots;
        std::vector<bool>   m_live;
        std::vector<Id>     m_free;
        std::size_t         m_count = 0;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/Anchor.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    EditShiftMap::EditShiftMap(std::span<const EditShift> edits) : m_edits(edits)
    {
        m_deltaBefore.resize(edits.size() + 1);
        std::int64_t d = 0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < edits.size(); ++i)
        {
            m_deltaBefore[i] = d;
            d += static_cast<std::int64_t>(edits[i].newLength) - static_cast<std::int64_t>(edits[i].end - edits[i].begin);
        }
        m_deltaBefore[edits.size()] = d;
    }

    ByteOffset EditShiftMap::Map(ByteOffset o, Bias bias) const noexcept
    {
        // k = the edits that begin at or before o; edit k-1 is the only one that can contain o.
        const auto it = std::upper_bound(m_edits.begin(), m_edits.end(), o,
                                         [](ByteOffset v, const EditShift& e) { return v < e.begin; });
        const auto k = static_cast<std::size_t>(it - m_edits.begin());
        if (k == 0) return o;
        const std::size_t m = k - 1;
        const EditShift& e = m_edits[m];
        if (o == e.begin || o < e.end)
        {
            const auto begin = static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(e.begin) + m_deltaBefore[m]);
            return bias == Bias::Left ? begin : begin + e.newLength;
        }
        return static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(o) + m_deltaBefore[m + 1]);
    }

    AnchorSet::Id AnchorSet::Add(Anchor a)
    {
        ++m_count;
        if (!m_free.empty())
        {
            const Id id = m_free.back();
            m_free.pop_back();
            m_slots[id] = a;
            m_live[id] = true;
            return id;
        }
        m_slots.push_back(a);
        m_live.push_back(true);
        return static_cast<Id>(m_slots.size() - 1);
    }

    void AnchorSet::Remove(Id id)
    {
        if (!Contains(id)) return;
        m_live[id] = false;
        m_free.push_back(id);
        --m_count;
    }

    bool AnchorSet::Contains(Id id) const noexcept { return id < m_slots.size() && m_live[id]; }

    Anchor AnchorSet::Get(Id id) const
    {
        assert(Contains(id));
        return m_slots[id];
    }

    void AnchorSet::Set(Id id, Anchor a)
    {
        assert(Contains(id));
        m_slots[id] = a;
    }

    void AnchorSet::Clear() noexcept
    {
        m_slots.clear();
        m_live.clear();
        m_free.clear();
        m_count = 0;
    }

    void AnchorSet::Shift(std::span<const EditShift> edits)
    {
        if (edits.empty() || m_count == 0) return;
        const EditShiftMap map(edits);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_slots.size(); ++i)
            if (m_live[i]) m_slots[i].offset = map.Map(m_slots[i].offset, m_slots[i].bias);
    }
}
```

**Interfaces:**

Row `r`'s entry describes the line break that ENDS row `r` (the r-th `'\n'` in the rope). An edit starting on `firstRow` that removes `d` line breaks and inserts `k`:
- the breaks at rows `[firstRow, firstRow + d)` are deleted, along with their exceptions;
- the `k` new breaks take the dominant style;
- breaks at rows `>= firstRow + d` shift by `k - d`.

The break that ends the last edited row is the first one after the edit, so it keeps its own style.

```cpp
#pragma once

// Line endings (spec s3.5). The rope stores '\n' only; EolMap records what each
// line break was in the file: a dominant style plus sparse exception rows (CRLF
// in an LF file, LF in a CRLF file, lone CR). Row r's entry describes the break
// that ENDS row r (the r-th '\n'). Edits shift the exceptions like anchors, and
// new breaks take the dominant style. So an unedited file saves back
// byte-identical, and an edit changes only the lines it touched. Converting is
// explicit (TextBuffer::ConvertLineEndings, one undo step); nothing normalises
// silently.

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class Eol : std::uint8_t { LF, CRLF, CR };

    struct EolException
    {
        std::uint32_t row = 0;
        Eol eol = Eol::LF;

        friend constexpr bool operator==(const EolException&, const EolException&) = default;
    };

    class EolMap
    {
    public:
        EolMap() = default;
        explicit EolMap(Eol dominant) : m_dominant(dominant) {}

        [[nodiscard]] Eol Dominant() const noexcept { return m_dominant; }
        [[nodiscard]] Eol StyleOf(std::uint32_t row) const noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] std::span<const EolException> Exceptions() const noexcept { return m_exceptions; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsMixed() const noexcept { return !m_exceptions.empty(); }

        void SetStyle(std::uint32_t row, Eol eol);   // an exception, or none when eol == Dominant()

        // An edit starting on firstRow removed `removed` line breaks and inserted
        // `inserted`. Returns the exceptions it removed, in pre-edit rows.
        std::vector<EolException> ApplyEdit(std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t removed, std::uint32_t inserted);
        void Restore(std::span<const EolException> exceptions);

        // AppendExternal: the tail's `tailBreaks` breaks become rows firstRow.. with tail's styles.
        void AppendRows(std::uint32_t firstRow, const EolMap& tail, std::uint32_t tailBreaks);

        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t MemoryBytes() const noexcept
        {
            return sizeof(EolMap) + m_exceptions.capacity() * sizeof(EolException);
        }
        [[nodiscard]] static std::string_view Bytes(Eol eol) noexcept;

        friend bool operator==(const EolMap&, const EolMap&) = default;

    private:
        Eol m_dominant = Eol::LF;
        std::vector<EolException> m_exceptions;   // sorted by row, unique rows, never the dominant style
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/EolMap.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/EolMap.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        auto LowerBound(std::vector<EolException>& v, std::uint32_t row)
        {
            return std::lower_bound(v.begin(), v.end(), row, [](const EolException& e, std::uint32_t r) { return e.row < r; });
        }
    }

    Eol EolMap::StyleOf(std::uint32_t row) const noexcept
    {
        const auto it = std::lower_bound(m_exceptions.begin(), m_exceptions.end(), row,
                                         [](const EolException& e, std::uint32_t r) { return e.row < r; });
        return (it != m_exceptions.end() && it->row == row) ? it->eol : m_dominant;
    }

    void EolMap::SetStyle(std::uint32_t row, Eol eol)
    {
        if (!m_exceptions.empty() && m_exceptions.back().row < row)   // the decoder's append path
        {
            if (eol != m_dominant) m_exceptions.push_back({ row, eol });
            return;
        }
        const auto it = LowerBound(m_exceptions, row);
        const bool present = it != m_exceptions.end() && it->row == row;
        if (eol == m_dominant)
        {
            if (present) m_exceptions.erase(it);
            return;
        }
        if (present) it->eol = eol;
        else m_exceptions.insert(it, { row, eol });
    }

    std::vector<EolException> EolMap::ApplyEdit(std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t removed, std::uint32_t inserted)
    {
        const auto lo = LowerBound(m_exceptions, firstRow);
        const auto hi = std::lower_bound(lo, m_exceptions.end(), firstRow + removed,
                                         [](const EolException& e, std::uint32_t r) { return e.row < r; });
        std::vector<EolException> gone(lo, hi);
        const auto rest = m_exceptions.erase(lo, hi);
        const std::int64_t delta = static_cast<std::int64_t>(inserted) - static_cast<std::int64_t>(removed);
        if (delta != 0)
            for (auto it = rest; it != m_exceptions.end(); ++it) it->row = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(it->row) + delta);
        return gone;
    }

    void EolMap::Restore(std::span<const EolException> exceptions)
    {
        for (const EolException& e : exceptions) SetStyle(e.row, e.eol);
    }

    void EolMap::AppendRows(std::uint32_t firstRow, const EolMap& tail, std::uint32_t tailBreaks)
    {
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < tailBreaks; ++i) SetStyle(firstRow + i, tail.StyleOf(i));
    }

    std::string_view EolMap::Bytes(Eol eol) noexcept
    {
        switch (eol)
        {
        case Eol::CRLF: return "\r\n";
        case Eol::CR: return "\r";
        default: return "\n";
        }
    }
}
```

### Task TE1-7: `Selection` and `SelectionSet` (spec s3.4)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ByteOffset`, `ByteRange`, `Bias` (TE1-1); `EditShift`, `EditShiftMap` (TE1-5).
- Produces:
  - `struct Selection { std::uint32_t id; ByteOffset anchor; ByteOffset head; std::optional<std::uint32_t> goalColumn; }` (binding), plus `Start()`, `End()`, `Empty()`, `Reversed()`, `Range()`, and `==`.
  - `class SelectionSet` with: `SelectionSet()` (one cursor at 0), `explicit SelectionSet(std::vector<Selection>)`, `static Cursor(ByteOffset)`, `All() -> std::span<const Selection>`, `Size()`, `Primary()` (the newest, i.e. the highest id), `PrimaryIndex()`, `AllocateId()`, `Add(anchor, head, goal) -> id` (becomes primary), `SetSingle(anchor, head)`, `Replace(std::vector<Selection>)` (keeps ids, normalizes), `ForEach`, `MoveWith(f(Selection&))`, `MoveHeadsWith(f(head, goal) -> std::pair<ByteOffset, std::optional<std::uint32_t>>)`, `MoveCursorsWith(same)`, `ApplyEdits(std::span<const EditShift>)`, `ClampTo(size)`, drag support (`SetPending(anchor, head)`, `ClearPending()`, `Pending()`, `CommitPending()`, `AllWithPending()`), and `==` (compares the selections and the pending one).

Merge rule (spec s3.4): after sorting by start, two selections merge when they overlap, when they start at the same offset, or when a cursor touches the other selection's boundary. Two non-empty selections that only touch (`a.End() == b.Start()`) stay separate. The merged selection keeps the newer id, so the primary survives a merge, and it takes the newer non-empty selection's direction. `ApplyEdits`, used for edits from OTHER views and for external appends, maps a cursor with Right bias, a non-empty selection's start with Right bias and its end with Left bias, so an outside insertion at a boundary never grows the selection. If a deletion swallows the whole selection, it collapses to a cursor.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// Selections (spec s3.4). anchor/head are byte offsets; reversed = anchor > head.
// goalColumn keeps the display column across up/down through short lines. A
// SelectionSet stays sorted and disjoint. Merge rule: overlapping, same start,
// or a cursor touching another selection's boundary (two non-empty selections
// that only touch stay separate). The NEWEST selection (highest id) is primary,
// and the view follows it. A drag in progress is a separate pending selection
// merged on release.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextTypes.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct Selection
    {
        std::uint32_t id = 0;
        ByteOffset anchor = 0;
        ByteOffset head = 0;
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> goalColumn;

        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset Start() const noexcept { return std::min(anchor, head); }
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset End() const noexcept { return std::max(anchor, head); }
        [[nodiscard]] bool Empty() const noexcept { return anchor == head; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool Reversed() const noexcept { return anchor > head; }
        [[nodiscard]] ByteRange Range() const noexcept { return { Start(), End() }; }

        friend bool operator==(const Selection&, const Selection&) = default;
    };

    class SelectionSet
    {
    public:
        SelectionSet();                                        // one cursor at 0
        explicit SelectionSet(std::vector<Selection> sels);    // normalized; empty input -> one cursor at 0
        [[nodiscard]] static SelectionSet Cursor(ByteOffset at);

        [[nodiscard]] std::span<const Selection> All() const noexcept { return m_sels; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t Size() const noexcept { return m_sels.size(); }
        [[nodiscard]] const Selection& Primary() const noexcept { return m_sels[PrimaryIndex()]; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t PrimaryIndex() const noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t AllocateId() noexcept { return m_nextId++; }

        std::uint32_t Add(ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal = std::nullopt);
        void SetSingle(ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head);
        void Replace(std::vector<Selection> sels);   // keeps ids; normalizes

        template <class F>
        void ForEach(F&& f) const
        {
            for (const Selection& s : m_sels) f(s);
        }

        // f(Selection&) per selection, then normalize.
        template <class F>
        void MoveWith(F&& f)
        {
            for (Selection& s : m_sels) f(s);
            Normalize(m_sels);
        }

        // f(head, goal) -> std::pair<ByteOffset, std::optional<std::uint32_t>>; anchors stay.
        template <class F>
        void MoveHeadsWith(F&& f)
        {
            for (Selection& s : m_sels)
            {
                auto [head, goal] = f(s.head, s.goalColumn);
                s.head = head;
                s.goalColumn = goal;
            }
            Normalize(m_sels);
        }

        // Same signature; every selection collapses to a cursor at the new head.
        template <class F>
        void MoveCursorsWith(F&& f)
        {
            for (Selection& s : m_sels)
            {
                auto [head, goal] = f(s.head, s.goalColumn);
                s.anchor = s.head = head;
                s.goalColumn = goal;
            }
            Normalize(m_sels);
        }

        // Edits made through ANOTHER view or an external append: cursors map
        // Right, a non-empty selection's start Right and end Left.
        void ApplyEdits(std::span<const EditShift> edits);
        void ClampTo(ByteOffset size);

        void SetPending(ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head);
        void ClearPending() noexcept { m_pending.reset(); }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::optional<Selection>& Pending() const noexcept { return m_pending; }
        void CommitPending();
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Selection> AllWithPending() const;

        friend bool operator==(const SelectionSet& a, const SelectionSet& b)
        {
            return a.m_sels == b.m_sels && a.m_pending == b.m_pending;
        }

    private:
        static void Normalize(std::vector<Selection>& sels);

        std::vector<Selection> m_sels;
        std::optional<Selection> m_pending;
        std::uint32_t m_nextId = 1;
    };
}
```

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        // a.Start() <= b.Start().
        bool ShouldMerge(const Selection& a, const Selection& b) noexcept
        {
            if (b.Start() < a.End()) return true;                                 // overlap
            if (b.Start() == a.Start()) return true;                              // same start
            if (b.Start() == a.End() && (a.Empty() || b.Empty())) return true;    // a cursor touching a boundary
            return false;
        }

        Selection MergeTwo(const Selection& a, const Selection& b) noexcept
        {
            const Selection& newer = a.id > b.id ? a : b;
            const Selection& older = a.id > b.id ? b : a;
            const ByteOffset start = std::min(a.Start(), b.Start());
            const ByteOffset end = std::max(a.End(), b.End());
            const bool reversed = !newer.Empty() ? newer.Reversed() : older.Reversed();
            Selection m;
            m.id = newer.id;
            m.anchor = reversed ? end : start;
            m.head = reversed ? start : end;
            m.goalColumn = newer.goalColumn;
            return m;
        }
    }

    SelectionSet::SelectionSet() { m_sels.push_back({ 0, 0, 0, std::nullopt }); }

    SelectionSet::SelectionSet(std::vector<Selection> sels)
    {
        if (sels.empty()) sels.push_back({ 0, 0, 0, std::nullopt });
        Replace(std::move(sels));
    }

    SelectionSet SelectionSet::Cursor(ByteOffset at)
    {
        SelectionSet s;
        s.m_sels[0].anchor = s.m_sels[0].head = at;
        return s;
    }

    std::size_t SelectionSet::PrimaryIndex() const noexcept
    {
        std::size_t best = 0;
        for (std::size_t i = 1; i < m_sels.size(); ++i)
            if (m_sels[i].id > m_sels[best].id) best = i;
        return best;
    }

    std::uint32_t SelectionSet::Add(ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal)
    {
        const std::uint32_t id = AllocateId();
        m_sels.push_back({ id, anchor, head, goal });
        Normalize(m_sels);
        return id;
    }

    void SelectionSet::SetSingle(ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head)
    {
        m_sels.clear();
        m_sels.push_back({ AllocateId(), anchor, head, std::nullopt });
    }

    void SelectionSet::Replace(std::vector<Selection> sels)
    {
        if (sels.empty()) sels.push_back({ AllocateId(), 0, 0, std::nullopt });
        for (const Selection& s : sels) m_nextId = std::max(m_nextId, s.id + 1);
        Normalize(sels);
        m_sels = std::move(sels);
    }

    void SelectionSet::ApplyEdits(std::span<const EditShift> edits)
    {
        if (edits.empty()) return;
        const EditShiftMap map(edits);
        const auto shift = [&map](Selection& s) {
            if (s.Empty())
            {
                s.anchor = s.head = map.Map(s.head, Bias::Right);
                return;
            }
            const ByteOffset start = map.Map(s.Start(), Bias::Right);
            ByteOffset end = map.Map(s.End(), Bias::Left);
            if (start > end) end = start;   // a deletion swallowed it: collapse
            const bool reversed = s.Reversed();
            s.anchor = reversed ? end : start;
            s.head = reversed ? start : end;
        };
        for (Selection& s : m_sels) shift(s);
        if (m_pending) shift(*m_pending);
        Normalize(m_sels);
    }

    void SelectionSet::ClampTo(ByteOffset size)
    {
        for (Selection& s : m_sels)
        {
            s.anchor = std::min(s.anchor, size);
            s.head = std::min(s.head, size);
        }
        if (m_pending)
        {
            m_pending->anchor = std::min(m_pending->anchor, size);
            m_pending->head = std::min(m_pending->head, size);
        }
        Normalize(m_sels);
    }

    void SelectionSet::SetPending(ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head)
    {
        if (!m_pending) m_pending = Selection{ AllocateId(), anchor, head, std::nullopt };
        m_pending->anchor = anchor;
        m_pending->head = head;
    }

    void SelectionSet::CommitPending()
    {
        if (!m_pending) return;
        m_sels.push_back(*m_pending);
        m_pending.reset();
        Normalize(m_sels);
    }

    std::vector<Selection> SelectionSet::AllWithPending() const
    {
        std::vector<Selection> all = m_sels;
        if (m_pending) all.push_back(*m_pending);
        Normalize(all);
        return all;
    }

    void SelectionSet::Normalize(std::vector<Selection>& sels)
    {
        std::sort(sels.begin(), sels.end(), [](const Selection& a, const Selection& b) {
            return a.Start() != b.Start() ? a.Start() < b.Start() : a.End() < b.End();
        });
        std::vector<Selection> out;
        out.reserve(sels.size());
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            if (!out.empty() && ShouldMerge(out.back(), s))
            {
                out.back() = MergeTwo(out.back(), s);
                continue;
            }
            out.push_back(s);
        }
        sels = std::move(out);
    }
}
```

### Task TE1-8: `TextBuffer` core: edits, nested transactions, undo/redo, dirty, version, edit log (spec s3.3, s3.5, s4.4)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextBufferTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Rope` (TE1-2), `AnchorSet`, `EditShift` (TE1-5), `EolMap`, `EolException` (TE1-6), `SelectionSet` (TE1-7).
- Produces (binding names unchanged):
  - `struct EditOp { ByteRange range; std::string text; }`.
  - `struct EditRecord { ByteRange range; std::string oldText; std::string newText; ByteOffset newBegin; }`.
  - `struct EditLogEntry { std::uint64_t version; std::uint32_t firstRow; std::uint32_t lastRowBefore; std::int32_t rowDelta; }`.
  - `enum class TransactionKind { Other, Typing, Deleting }`.
  - `class EditObserver { virtual void OnBufferEdited(std::span<const EditShift> edits, std::uint64_t version) = 0; }`.
  - `class TextBuffer` with: `TextBuffer()`, `explicit TextBuffer(Rope text, EolMap eols = {})` (the default argument is a CANON A2 addition to the skeleton signature: an LF-dominant map with no exceptions), `Text()`, `Snapshot()`, `Eols()`, `Version()`, `ChangeId()`, `Dirty()`, `MarkSaved()`, `BeginTransaction(const SelectionSet&)`, `BeginTransaction(const SelectionSet&, TransactionKind)`, `EndTransaction(const SelectionSet&)`, `InTransaction()`, `Edit(std::span<const EditOp>)`, `Undo(SelectionSet&)`, `Redo(SelectionSet&)`, `CanUndo()`, `CanRedo()`, `BreakUndoGroup()`, `UndoDepth()`, `RedoDepth()`, `EditsSince(version)`, `EditLogCovers(version)`, `RegisterAnchors(AnchorSet&)` / `UnregisterAnchors`, `AddObserver(EditObserver&)` / `RemoveObserver`.

Rules this task implements:
- `Edit` takes ops that are in range, sorted, disjoint, and begin at strictly increasing offsets. Anything else asserts in Debug and is refused in Release, so a bad batch can never corrupt history. A no-op op (empty range, empty text) records nothing.
- Transactions nest through a `Begin`/`End` depth. The outermost pair captures the selections before and after. An empty transaction is dropped.
- `version` bumps once per applied batch (edit, undo, redo). `changeId` names a state that undo can reach. Each committed entry gets a fresh id, undo returns to the entry's `idBefore`, and redo to its `idAfter`. `Dirty()` is `changeId != savedChangeId`, so undoing back to the saved state reads clean, and editing after undoing past the save point leaves the saved state unreachable.
- Undo applies the inverse batch back to front. Touching records (two adjacent deletions) become one inverse op, since nothing lies between them. Line-ending exceptions that a batch deleted are restored exactly after its inverse, which keeps undone files byte-identical.
- Every batch shifts every registered `AnchorSet`, notifies observers, and appends an `EditLogEntry` (spec s4.4). The log keeps the newest `kEditLogKeep` entries; `EditLogCovers(v)` tells a consumer whether `EditsSince(v)` is complete.

```cpp
// TextBuffer (text-editor spec s3.3, s3.5, s11.1): edits, nesting, undo/redo
// with selections, dirty semantics, exact line endings through undo, anchors,
// observers, the edit log -- and a property test against a std::string history.

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    std::string RandomText(std::size_t maxPieces)
    {
        static const std::vector<std::string> pieces = [] {
            std::vector<std::string> p = { "a", "b", " ", "\n", "xyz" };
            std::string e;
            Utf8::Append(e, 0xE9);
            p.push_back(e);
            return p;
        }();
        const auto n = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, maxPieces + 1);
        std::string s;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) s += pieces[*rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, pieces.size())];
        return s;
    }

    // 1..3 ops, in range, sorted, disjoint, with strictly increasing begins.
    std::vector<EditOp> RandomOps(std::size_t size)
    {
        const auto want = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(1, 4);
        std::vector<ByteOffset> cuts;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2 * want; ++i) cuts.push_back(*rc::gen::inRange<ByteOffset>(0, size + 1));
        std::sort(cuts.begin(), cuts.end());
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < cuts.size(); i += 2)
        {
            if (!ops.empty() && cuts[i] <= ops.back().range.begin) continue;
            ops.push_back({ { cuts[i], cuts[i + 1] }, RandomText(3) });
        }
        return ops;
    }

    std::string ApplyModel(std::string s, const std::vector<EditOp>& ops)
    {
        for (auto it = ops.rbegin(); it != ops.rend(); ++it)
            s.replace(static_cast<std::size_t>(it->range.begin), static_cast<std::size_t>(it->range.Size()), it->text);
        return s;
    }

    bool RecordsSomething(const std::vector<EditOp>& ops)
    {
        return std::any_of(ops.begin(), ops.end(), [](const EditOp& op) { return !(op.range.Empty() && op.text.empty()); });
    }

    void Commit(TextBuffer& buf, const SelectionSet& sels, std::vector<EditOp> ops)
    {
        buf.BeginTransaction(sels);
        buf.Edit(ops);
        buf.EndTransaction(sels);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("TextBuffer: a batch applies in one pass and logs one entry", "[text-buffer]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("one\ntwo\nthree"), EolMap{});
    const SelectionSet sels;
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Dirty());
    CHECK(buf.Version() == 0u);
    Commit(buf, sels, { { { 0, 3 }, "ONE" }, { { 8, 8 }, "new\n" } });
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "ONE\ntwo\nnew\nthree");
    CHECK(buf.Version() == 1u);
    CHECK(buf.Dirty());
    const auto log = buf.EditsSince(0);
    REQUIRE(log.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(log[0].version == 1u);
    CHECK(log[0].firstRow == 0u);
    CHECK(log[0].lastRowBefore == 2u);
    CHECK(log[0].rowDelta == 1);
    CHECK(buf.EditsSince(1).empty());
    CHECK(buf.EditLogCovers(0));
    CHECK(buf.Snapshot().version == 1u);
    CHECK(buf.Snapshot().rope.ToString() == buf.Text().ToString());
}

TEST_CASE("TextBuffer: the one-argument constructor takes an LF-dominant EolMap", "[text-buffer]")

    const TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb"));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "a\nb");
    CHECK(buf.Eols().Dominant() == Eol::LF);
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Eols().IsMixed());
    CHECK(buf.Eols() == EolMap{});
    CHECK(buf.Version() == 0u);
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Dirty());
}

TEST_CASE("TextBuffer: empty transactions are dropped; nested ones are one undo step", "[text-buffer]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("abc"), EolMap{});
    SelectionSet sels;
    buf.BeginTransaction(sels);
    buf.EndTransaction(sels);
    CHECK(buf.UndoDepth() == 0u);
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Dirty());
    buf.BeginTransaction(sels);
    buf.BeginTransaction(sels);
    buf.Edit(std::vector<EditOp>{ { { 0, 0 }, "1" } });
    buf.EndTransaction(sels);
    CHECK(buf.InTransaction());
    buf.Edit(std::vector<EditOp>{ { { 4, 4 }, "2" } });
    buf.EndTransaction(sels);
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "1abc2");
    CHECK(buf.UndoDepth() == 1u);
    REQUIRE(buf.Undo(sels));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "abc");
    CHECK(buf.Version() == 4u);   // two batches applied, two inverted
}

TEST_CASE("TextBuffer: undo restores the selections before, redo the selections after", "[text-buffer]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("abc"), EolMap{});
    const SelectionSet before = SelectionSet::Cursor(1);
    const SelectionSet after = SelectionSet::Cursor(2);
    buf.BeginTransaction(before);
    buf.Edit(std::vector<EditOp>{ { { 1, 1 }, "X" } });
    buf.EndTransaction(after);
    SelectionSet sels = after;
    REQUIRE(buf.Undo(sels));
    CHECK(sels == before);
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "abc");
    REQUIRE(buf.Redo(sels));
    CHECK(sels == after);
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "aXbc");
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Redo(sels));
}

TEST_CASE("TextBuffer: dirty follows the saved state through undo and an abandoned branch", "[text-buffer]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("x"), EolMap{});
    SelectionSet s;
    const auto type = [&](const char* t) { Commit(buf, s, { { { buf.Text().Size(), buf.Text().Size() }, t } }); };
    type("a");
    buf.MarkSaved();
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Dirty());
    type("b");
    CHECK(buf.Dirty());
    buf.Undo(s);
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Dirty());   // back at the saved state
    buf.Undo(s);
    CHECK(buf.Dirty());
    type("c");                  // "xa" (saved) is now unreachable
    CHECK(buf.Dirty());
    buf.Undo(s);
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "x");
    CHECK(buf.Dirty());
    buf.Redo(s);
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "xc");
    CHECK(buf.Dirty());
}

    Commit(buf, s, { { { 0, 1 }, "" }, { { 1, 2 }, "" } });

TEST_CASE("TextBuffer: anchors and observers see every batch until unregistered", "[text-buffer]")
{
    struct Counter final : EditObserver
    {
        int calls = 0;
        std::uint64_t lastVersion = 0;
        void OnBufferEdited(std::span<const EditShift>, std::uint64_t version) override
        {
            ++calls;
            lastVersion = version;
        }
    };
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("hello world"), EolMap{});
    AnchorSet marks;
    const AnchorSet::Id w = marks.Add({ 6, Bias::Left });
    Counter counter;
    buf.RegisterAnchors(marks);
    buf.AddObserver(counter);
    SelectionSet s;
    Commit(buf, s, { { { 0, 0 }, ">> " } });
    CHECK(marks.Get(w).offset == 9u);
    CHECK(counter.calls == 1);
    CHECK(counter.lastVersion == buf.Version());
    buf.Undo(s);
    CHECK(marks.Get(w).offset == 6u);
    CHECK(counter.calls == 2);
    buf.UnregisterAnchors(marks);
    buf.RemoveObserver(counter);
    buf.Redo(s);
    CHECK(marks.Get(w).offset == 6u);
    CHECK(counter.calls == 2);
}

TEST_CASE("TextBuffer: the edit log keeps a bounded window and says when it no longer covers a version", "[text-buffer]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8(""), EolMap{});
    SelectionSet s;
    for (int i = 0; i < 9000; ++i) Commit(buf, s, { { { 0, 0 }, "x" } });
    CHECK(buf.Version() == 9000u);
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.EditLogCovers(0));
    CHECK(buf.EditLogCovers(buf.Version() - 100));
    CHECK(buf.EditsSince(buf.Version() - 100).size() == 100u);
}

TEST_CASE("TextBuffer: random edit/undo/redo/save sequences match a std::string history", "[text-buffer]")
{
    rc::prop("text, invariants, dirty, undo-to-start and redo-to-end", [] {
        const std::string original = RandomText(30);
        TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8(original, 8), EolMap{});
        SelectionSet sels;
        std::vector<std::string> states{ original };   // the current branch
        std::vector<int> ids{ 0 };                       // one id per state
        std::size_t at = 0;
        int nextId = 1;
        int savedId = 0;
        const int steps = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 40);
        for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step)
        {
            const int what = *rc::gen::inRange(0, 10);
            if (what < 5)
            {
                buf.BeginTransaction(sels);
                std::string model = states[at];
                bool recorded = false;
                const int batches = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 3);
                for (int k = 0; k < batches; ++k)
                {
                    const std::vector<EditOp> ops = RandomOps(model.size());
                    recorded = recorded || RecordsSomething(ops);
                    buf.Edit(ops);
                    model = ApplyModel(model, ops);
                }
                buf.EndTransaction(sels);
                if (recorded)
                {
                    states.resize(at + 1);
                    ids.resize(at + 1);
                    states.push_back(model);
                    ids.push_back(nextId++);
                    ++at;
                }
            }
            else if (what < 7)
            {
                const bool did = buf.Undo(sels);
                RC_ASSERT(did == (at > 0));
                if (did) --at;
            }
            else if (what < 9)
            {
                const bool did = buf.Redo(sels);
                RC_ASSERT(did == (at + 1 < states.size()));
                if (did) ++at;
            }
            else
            {
                buf.MarkSaved();
                savedId = ids[at];
            }
            RC_ASSERT(buf.Text().ToString() == states[at]);
            RC_ASSERT(buf.Text().CheckInvariants().empty());
            RC_ASSERT(buf.Dirty() == (ids[at] != savedId));
        }
        while (buf.Undo(sels)) {}
        RC_ASSERT(buf.Text().ToString() == original);
        while (buf.Redo(sels)) {}
        RC_ASSERT(buf.Text().ToString() == states.back());
    });
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// The text buffer (spec s3.3, s3.5, s4.4): the rope plus edits, nested
// transactions, undo/redo carrying the selections before and after, the dirty
// flag, the version every cache keys on, and the edit log the highlighter maps
// worker results forward through. Line endings travel beside the text in an
// EolMap and come back exactly on undo.
//
// version  -- bumps once per applied batch (edit, undo, redo; appends and
//             reloads too, TE1-10). Caches and snapshots key on it.
// changeId -- names a document STATE undo can reach. Dirty() compares it with
//             the id MarkSaved recorded.
//
// Only TextCommands (and the external-change entry points) call Edit (spec s2.1).

#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/EolMap.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct EditOp
    {
        ByteRange   range;
        std::string text;   // '\n' line breaks only; the caller normalizes
    };

    // One applied op: its range before the batch, the bytes it removed and
    // inserted, and where it begins after the batch.
    struct EditRecord
    {
        ByteRange   range;
        std::string oldText;
        std::string newText;
        ByteOffset  newBegin = 0;
    };

    struct EditLogEntry
    {
        std::uint64_t version;         // the version this batch produced
        std::uint32_t firstRow;        // the first row it touched (pre-batch)
        std::uint32_t lastRowBefore;   // the last row it touched (pre-batch)
        std::int32_t  rowDelta;        // net line-break change
    };

    enum class TransactionKind : std::uint8_t { Other, Typing, Deleting };

    class EditObserver
    {
    public:
        virtual ~EditObserver() = default;
        // After every applied batch, with its shifts in pre-batch coordinates.
        virtual void OnBufferEdited(std::span<const EditShift> edits, std::uint64_t version) = 0;
    };

    class TextBuffer
    {
    public:
        TextBuffer();
        // The default EolMap is LF-dominant with no exceptions (CANON A2), so
        // TextBuffer(Rope::FromUtf8("...")) is the short form for LF text.
        explicit TextBuffer(Rope text, EolMap eols = {});
        TextBuffer(const TextBuffer&) = delete;
        TextBuffer& operator=(const TextBuffer&) = delete;

        const Rope& Text() const;
        RopeSnapshot Snapshot() const;
        [[nodiscard]] const EolMap& Eols() const noexcept { return m_eols; }
        std::uint64_t Version() const;
        std::uint64_t ChangeId() const;
        bool Dirty() const;
        void MarkSaved();

        void BeginTransaction(const SelectionSet& before);
        void BeginTransaction(const SelectionSet& before, TransactionKind kind);
        void EndTransaction(const SelectionSet& after);
        [[nodiscard]] bool InTransaction() const noexcept { return m_depth > 0; }
        void Edit(std::span<const EditOp> ops);   // sorted, non-overlapping; inside a transaction

        bool Undo(SelectionSet& sels);
        bool Redo(SelectionSet& sels);
        [[nodiscard]] bool CanUndo() const noexcept { return m_depth == 0 && !m_undo.empty(); }
        [[nodiscard]] bool CanRedo() const noexcept { return m_depth == 0 && !m_redo.empty(); }
        void BreakUndoGroup();
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t UndoDepth() const noexcept { return m_undo.size(); }
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t RedoDepth() const noexcept { return m_redo.size(); }

        std::span<const EditLogEntry> EditsSince(std::uint64_t version) const;
        [[nodiscard]] bool EditLogCovers(std::uint64_t version) const noexcept;   // false: invalidate everything

        void RegisterAnchors(AnchorSet& set);
        void UnregisterAnchors(AnchorSet& set) noexcept;
        void AddObserver(EditObserver& observer);
        void RemoveObserver(EditObserver& observer) noexcept;

    private:
        struct EditBatch
        {
            std::vector<EditRecord>   records;
            std::vector<EolException> eolRemoved;   // the exceptions its deleted breaks carried (pre-batch rows)
        };

        struct UndoEntry
        {
            std::vector<EditBatch> batches;
            SelectionSet before, after;
            std::uint64_t idBefore = 0, idAfter = 0;
            TransactionKind kind = TransactionKind::Other;
            std::optional<EolMap> eolBefore, eolAfter;   // whole-map changes (convert, reload)
            bool sealed = false;                          // a boundary followed it: it never merges again
        };

        EditBatch ApplyOps(std::span<const EditOp> ops);
        void ApplyInverse(const EditBatch& batch);
        void ApplyForward(const EditBatch& batch);
        void Commit(UndoEntry&& entry);

        Rope m_rope;
        EolMap m_eols;
        std::uint64_t m_version = 0;
        std::uint64_t m_changeId = 0;
        std::uint64_t m_savedChangeId = 0;
        std::uint64_t m_lastIssuedId = 0;
        std::deque<UndoEntry> m_undo;
        std::vector<UndoEntry> m_redo;
        std::optional<UndoEntry> m_open;   // the outermost transaction being built
        int m_depth = 0;
        std::vector<EditLogEntry> m_log;
        std::vector<AnchorSet*> m_anchorSets;
        std::vector<EditObserver*> m_observers;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("capacity hint: edit-log entries kept for EditsSince; an older consumer sees EditLogCovers() == false and invalidates everything")
        constexpr std::size_t kEditLogKeep = 4096;

        std::uint32_t CountNewlines(std::string_view s) noexcept
        {
            return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::count(s.begin(), s.end(), '\n'));
        }

        // In range, sorted, disjoint, strictly increasing begins (spec s3.3).
        bool OpsAreValid(std::span<const EditOp> ops, ByteOffset size) noexcept
        {
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < ops.size(); ++i)
            {
                const ByteRange r = ops[i].range;
                if (r.begin > r.end || r.end > size) return false;
                if (i > 0 && (r.begin < ops[i - 1].range.end || r.begin <= ops[i - 1].range.begin)) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    TextBuffer::TextBuffer() = default;

    TextBuffer::TextBuffer(Rope text, EolMap eols) : m_rope(std::move(text)), m_eols(std::move(eols)) {}

    const Rope& TextBuffer::Text() const { return m_rope; }
    RopeSnapshot TextBuffer::Snapshot() const { return { m_rope, m_version }; }
    std::uint64_t TextBuffer::Version() const { return m_version; }
    std::uint64_t TextBuffer::ChangeId() const { return m_changeId; }
    bool TextBuffer::Dirty() const { return m_changeId != m_savedChangeId; }

    void TextBuffer::MarkSaved()
    {
        m_savedChangeId = m_changeId;
        BreakUndoGroup();   // a save is a grouping boundary (spec s3.3)
    }

    void TextBuffer::BeginTransaction(const SelectionSet& before) { BeginTransaction(before, TransactionKind::Other); }

    void TextBuffer::BeginTransaction(const SelectionSet& before, TransactionKind kind)
    {
        if (m_depth++ > 0) return;
        m_open.emplace();
        m_open->before = before;
        m_open->kind = kind;
        m_open->idBefore = m_changeId;
    }

    void TextBuffer::EndTransaction(const SelectionSet& after)
    {
        assert(m_depth > 0 && "EndTransaction without BeginTransaction");
        if (m_depth == 0 || --m_depth > 0) return;
        UndoEntry entry = std::move(*m_open);
        m_open.reset();
        if (entry.batches.empty() && !entry.eolAfter) return;   // empty transactions are dropped
        entry.after = after;
        Commit(std::move(entry));
    }

    void TextBuffer::Edit(std::span<const EditOp> ops)
    {
        assert(m_depth > 0 && "TextBuffer::Edit outside a transaction");
        if (m_depth == 0) return;
        EditBatch batch = ApplyOps(ops);
        if (batch.records.empty()) return;
        m_open->batches.push_back(std::move(batch));
    }

    TextBuffer::EditBatch TextBuffer::ApplyOps(std::span<const EditOp> ops)
    {
        EditBatch batch;
        const Rope before = m_rope;
        if (!OpsAreValid(ops, before.Size()))
        {
            assert(false && "EditOp ranges must be in range, sorted, disjoint, with strictly increasing begins");
            return batch;
        }
        std::vector<EditShift> shifts;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> firstRows;
        std::int64_t delta = 0;
        std::int32_t rowDelta = 0;
        std::uint32_t lastRowBefore = 0;
        for (const EditOp& op : ops)
        {
            if (op.range.Empty() && op.text.empty()) continue;   // a no-op records nothing
            EditRecord r;
            r.range = op.range;
            before.CopyTo(op.range, r.oldText);
            r.newText = op.text;
            r.newBegin = static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.range.begin) + delta);
            delta += static_cast<std::int64_t>(r.newText.size()) - static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.range.Size());
            shifts.push_back({ op.range.begin, op.range.end, r.newText.size() });
            firstRows.push_back(before.OffsetToPoint(op.range.begin).row);
            lastRowBefore = before.OffsetToPoint(op.range.end).row;
            rowDelta += static_cast<std::int32_t>(CountNewlines(r.newText)) - static_cast<std::int32_t>(CountNewlines(r.oldText));
            batch.records.push_back(std::move(r));
        }
        if (batch.records.empty()) return batch;

        // Back to front: an op never moves the offsets or rows of the ops before it.
        for (std::size_t i = batch.records.size(); i-- > 0;)
        {
            const EditRecord& r = batch.records[i];
            m_rope = m_rope.Replace(r.range, r.newText);
            const std::vector<EolException> gone = m_eols.ApplyEdit(firstRows[i], CountNewlines(r.oldText), CountNewlines(r.newText));
            batch.eolRemoved.insert(batch.eolRemoved.end(), gone.begin(), gone.end());
        }

        ++m_version;
        m_log.push_back({ m_version, firstRows.front(), lastRowBefore, rowDelta });
        if (m_log.size() > 2 * kEditLogKeep)
            m_log.erase(m_log.begin(), m_log.end() - static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(kEditLogKeep));
        for (AnchorSet* set : m_anchorSets) set->Shift(shifts);
        for (EditObserver* o : m_observers) o->OnBufferEdited(shifts, m_version);
        return batch;
    }

    void TextBuffer::ApplyInverse(const EditBatch& batch)
    {
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        ops.reserve(batch.records.size());
        for (const EditRecord& r : batch.records)
        {
            const ByteRange range{ r.newBegin, r.newBegin + r.newText.size() };
            if (!ops.empty() && ops.back().range.end == range.begin)
            {
                // Touching records (two adjacent deletions) invert to one op:
                // nothing lies between them after the batch.
                ops.back().range.end = range.end;
                ops.back().text += r.oldText;
                continue;
            }
            ops.push_back({ range, r.oldText });
        }
        ApplyOps(ops);
        m_eols.Restore(batch.eolRemoved);   // back in pre-batch rows now
    }

    void TextBuffer::ApplyForward(const EditBatch& batch)
    {
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        ops.reserve(batch.records.size());
        for (const EditRecord& r : batch.records) ops.push_back({ r.range, r.newText });
        ApplyOps(ops);
    }

    void TextBuffer::Commit(UndoEntry&& entry)
    {
        m_redo.clear();
        entry.idAfter = ++m_lastIssuedId;
        m_changeId = entry.idAfter;
        m_undo.push_back(std::move(entry));
    }

    bool TextBuffer::Undo(SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        if (m_depth > 0 || m_undo.empty()) return false;
        UndoEntry entry = std::move(m_undo.back());
        m_undo.pop_back();
        for (auto it = entry.batches.rbegin(); it != entry.batches.rend(); ++it) ApplyInverse(*it);
        if (entry.eolBefore) m_eols = *entry.eolBefore;
        m_changeId = entry.idBefore;
        sels = entry.before;
        entry.sealed = true;
        m_redo.push_back(std::move(entry));
        return true;
    }

    bool TextBuffer::Redo(SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        if (m_depth > 0 || m_redo.empty()) return false;
        UndoEntry entry = std::move(m_redo.back());
        m_redo.pop_back();
        for (const EditBatch& b : entry.batches) ApplyForward(b);
        if (entry.eolAfter) m_eols = *entry.eolAfter;
        m_changeId = entry.idAfter;
        sels = entry.after;
        m_undo.push_back(std::move(entry));
        return true;
    }

    void TextBuffer::BreakUndoGroup()
    {
        if (!m_undo.empty()) m_undo.back().sealed = true;
    }

    std::span<const EditLogEntry> TextBuffer::EditsSince(std::uint64_t version) const
    {
        const auto it = std::upper_bound(m_log.begin(), m_log.end(), version,
                                         [](std::uint64_t v, const EditLogEntry& e) { return v < e.version; });
        return { it, m_log.end() };
    }

    bool TextBuffer::EditLogCovers(std::uint64_t version) const noexcept
    {
        if (version >= m_version) return true;
        return !m_log.empty() && m_log.front().version <= version + 1;
    }

    void TextBuffer::RegisterAnchors(AnchorSet& set)
    {
        if (std::find(m_anchorSets.begin(), m_anchorSets.end(), &set) == m_anchorSets.end()) m_anchorSets.push_back(&set);
    }

    void TextBuffer::UnregisterAnchors(AnchorSet& set) noexcept
    {
        std::erase(m_anchorSets, &set);
    }

    void TextBuffer::AddObserver(EditObserver& observer)
    {
        if (std::find(m_observers.begin(), m_observers.end(), &observer) == m_observers.end()) m_observers.push_back(&observer);
    }

    void TextBuffer::RemoveObserver(EditObserver& observer) noexcept
    {
        std::erase(m_observers, &observer);
    }
}
```

### Task TE1-9: Undo grouping, the undo memory cap, and the `TextSettings` block (spec s3.3, s8)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp` (`UndoPolicy`, clock, byte accounting)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.cpp` (`Edit`, `Commit`, `Undo`, `Redo`, new `CanMerge` / `EnforceMemoryCap` / `Weigh`)
- Modify: `premake5.lua:1275` (ArcaneTests: source-compile `TextSettings.cpp`, after `EditorViewportSettings.cpp`)
- Modify: `docs/superpowers/audits/2026-10-03-settings-inventory.md:1606` (a new `### Text editor` section just before `### Existing cvars (e)`), and the "Post-freeze amendments" table (lines 185-204)
- Modify: `scripts/settings-frozen-names.txt` (regenerated by the lint, never by hand)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextBufferUndoPolicyTest.cpp`, `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextSettingsTest.cpp`

**Where `TextSettings` lives, and why:** `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.{hpp,cpp}`, on the EXE side and outside `ArcaneText` (the skeleton's file map already puts it there). A static lib CAN reach the reflection headers: `ArcaneAssetPipeline` is a StaticLib with the reflected `TextureMetaSettings`, through `IncludeDir.ArcaneCore` + `Astra` + `Mosaic`. It still does not belong in the lib, for three reasons:
1. `ARC_SETTINGS` registers from a namespace-scope static initializer. MSVC links an object file out of a `.lib` only when something references a symbol in it, and nothing references a settings-only TU. So a `TextSettings.obj` inside `ArcaneText.lib` would silently never register in `ArcaneEditor.exe`. AssetPipeline escapes this only because its TU also defines functions the cook calls.
2. Editor-audience settings are declared in ArcaneEditor (settings spec s3.2; `EditorSnapshotSettings.hpp`'s header comment). A shipped game holds no Editor settings.
3. The core stays registry-free and testable with plain option structs (`UndoPolicy` here; `DecodeOptions`, `EditContext` later). `TextSettings.hpp` maps the published block onto them (`ToUndoPolicy`, ...). A sweep case proves each mapping once, and a default-equality case pins the core's fallback defaults to the settings defaults.

ArcaneTests source-compiles `TextSettings.cpp` (the existing per-file pattern, `premake5.lua:1258-1275`). ArcaneEditor already compiles it through `src/**`, because `removefiles` only drops Core/Syntax/Vim.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `TextBuffer` (TE1-8).
- Produces:
  - `struct UndoPolicy { std::uint32_t groupMs = 300; std::uint64_t memoryBytes = 64 MiB; }`.
  - On `TextBuffer`: `using Clock = std::function<std::uint64_t()>`, `SetUndoPolicy(const UndoPolicy&)`, `GetUndoPolicy()`, `SetClock(Clock)`, `UndoBytes()`, `DroppedUndoEntries()`.
  - Grouping: an entry of kind `Typing` or `Deleting` merges into the previous entry when all of these hold: same kind; the previous entry is not sealed (no save, explicit break, undo/redo or reload since); this transaction's first edit came within `groupMs` of the previous entry's last edit; and the previous entry's `after` selections equal this one's `before` (the cursor did not move). `groupMs == 0` disables merging. `Other` never merges.
  - The memory cap drops the oldest undo entries while undo + redo bytes exceed `memoryBytes`. This includes the new entry itself when it alone is too big.
  - `Arcane::Editor::TextSettings { std::uint32_t undoGroupMs = 300; std::uint32_t undoMemoryMB = 64; }`, registered as `editor.text.*` (Editor, PreferencesMachine, Live, page "Text Editor"; `undoMemoryMB` is Dev); `Text::UndoPolicy ToUndoPolicy(const TextSettings&)`.

`ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextBufferUndoPolicyTest.cpp`:
```cpp
// Undo grouping and the memory cap (text-editor spec s3.3), driven by an
// injected clock so the 300 ms window is deterministic.

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    struct Typist
    {
        TextBuffer buf{ Rope::FromUtf8(""), EolMap{} };
        SelectionSet sels = SelectionSet::Cursor(0);
        std::uint64_t now = 1000;

        Typist() { buf.SetClock([this] { return now; }); }

        void Type(std::string_view t, TransactionKind kind)
        {
            const ByteOffset at = sels.Primary().head;
            const SelectionSet after = SelectionSet::Cursor(at + t.size());
            buf.BeginTransaction(sels, kind);
            buf.Edit(std::vector<EditOp>{ { { at, at }, std::string(t) } });
            buf.EndTransaction(after);
            sels = after;
        }
    };
}

TEST_CASE("Undo grouping: typing within the window is one step; any boundary starts a new one", "[text-buffer]")
{
    Typist t;
    t.Type("a", TransactionKind::Typing);
    t.now += 100;
    t.Type("b", TransactionKind::Typing);
    t.now += 100;
    t.Type("c", TransactionKind::Typing);
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 1u);
    t.now += 301;
    t.Type("d", TransactionKind::Typing);   // the window passed
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 2u);
    t.now += 10;
    t.Type("e", TransactionKind::Other);    // Other never merges
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 3u);
    t.now += 10;
    t.Type("f", TransactionKind::Typing);   // nor does anything merge into an Other entry
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 4u);
    t.now += 10;
    t.buf.BreakUndoGroup();
    t.Type("g", TransactionKind::Typing);
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 5u);
    t.now += 10;
    t.Type("h", TransactionKind::Deleting); // a different kind
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 6u);
    t.now += 10;
    t.sels = SelectionSet::Cursor(0);       // the cursor moved between keystrokes
    t.Type("i", TransactionKind::Deleting);
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 7u);
    CHECK(t.buf.Text().ToString() == "iabcdefgh");
    SelectionSet s = t.sels;
    for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) t.buf.Undo(s);
    CHECK(t.buf.Text().ToString() == "abc");
    t.buf.Undo(s);
    CHECK(t.buf.Text().ToString().empty());   // "abc" was one step
}

TEST_CASE("Undo grouping: a save seals the group, and groupMs 0 disables merging", "[text-buffer]")
{
    Typist t;
    t.Type("a", TransactionKind::Typing);
    t.buf.MarkSaved();
    t.now += 10;
    t.Type("b", TransactionKind::Typing);
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 2u);
    SelectionSet s = t.sels;
    t.buf.Undo(s);
    CHECK_FALSE(t.buf.Dirty());

    Typist u;
    u.buf.SetUndoPolicy({ 0, std::uint64_t(1) << 26 });
    u.Type("a", TransactionKind::Typing);
    u.now += 1;
    u.Type("b", TransactionKind::Typing);
    CHECK(u.buf.UndoDepth() == 2u);
}

TEST_CASE("Undo memory cap: the oldest entries drop first, and a step bigger than the cap leaves no history", "[text-buffer]")
{
    Typist t;
    t.buf.SetUndoPolicy({ 300, 4096 });
    std::vector<std::string> states{ "" };
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i)
    {
        t.now += 1000;
        t.Type(std::string(1000, static_cast<char>('a' + i)), TransactionKind::Other);
        states.push_back(t.buf.Text().ToString());
    }
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoBytes() <= 4096u);
    CHECK(t.buf.DroppedUndoEntries() > 0u);
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() + t.buf.DroppedUndoEntries() == 10u);
    SelectionSet s = t.sels;
    while (t.buf.Undo(s)) {}
    CHECK(t.buf.Text().ToString() == states[t.buf.DroppedUndoEntries()]);

    Typist big;
    big.buf.SetUndoPolicy({ 300, 100 });
    big.Type(std::string(1000, 'z'), TransactionKind::Other);
    CHECK(big.buf.UndoDepth() == 0u);
    CHECK(big.buf.DroppedUndoEntries() == 1u);
    CHECK(big.buf.Text().Size() == 1000u);
    CHECK(big.buf.Dirty());
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.cpp`. Add `#include <chrono>`, then replace `Edit`, `Commit`, `Undo` and `Redo` with the versions below and add the new functions:
```cpp
    std::uint64_t TextBuffer::SteadyNowMs()
    {
        return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(
            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
    }

    void TextBuffer::SetUndoPolicy(const UndoPolicy& policy)
    {
        m_policy = policy;
        EnforceMemoryCap();
    }

    void TextBuffer::SetClock(Clock clock) { m_clock = clock ? std::move(clock) : Clock(&TextBuffer::SteadyNowMs); }

    void TextBuffer::Edit(std::span<const EditOp> ops)
    {
        assert(m_depth > 0 && "TextBuffer::Edit outside a transaction");
        if (m_depth == 0) return;
        EditBatch batch = ApplyOps(ops);
        if (batch.records.empty()) return;
        const std::uint64_t now = m_clock();
        if (m_open->batches.empty()) m_open->firstEditMs = now;
        m_open->lastEditMs = now;
        m_open->batches.push_back(std::move(batch));
    }

    std::uint64_t TextBuffer::Weigh(const UndoEntry& entry)
    {
        std::uint64_t bytes = sizeof(UndoEntry) + (entry.before.Size() + entry.after.Size()) * sizeof(Selection);
        for (const EditBatch& b : entry.batches)
        {
            bytes += sizeof(EditBatch) + b.eolRemoved.size() * sizeof(EolException);
            for (const EditRecord& r : b.records) bytes += sizeof(EditRecord) + r.oldText.size() + r.newText.size();
        }
        if (entry.eolBefore) bytes += entry.eolBefore->MemoryBytes();
        if (entry.eolAfter) bytes += entry.eolAfter->MemoryBytes();
        return bytes;
    }

    bool TextBuffer::CanMerge(const UndoEntry& entry) const
    {
        if (entry.kind == TransactionKind::Other || m_policy.groupMs == 0 || m_undo.empty()) return false;
        const UndoEntry& top = m_undo.back();
        if (top.sealed || top.kind != entry.kind || top.eolAfter || entry.eolAfter) return false;
        if (entry.firstEditMs < top.lastEditMs || entry.firstEditMs - top.lastEditMs > m_policy.groupMs) return false;
        return top.after == entry.before;   // the cursor did not move between them
    }

    void TextBuffer::Commit(UndoEntry&& entry)
    {
        m_redo.clear();
        m_redoBytes = 0;
        entry.idAfter = ++m_lastIssuedId;
        m_changeId = entry.idAfter;
        const std::uint64_t bytes = Weigh(entry);
        entry.bytes = bytes;
        if (CanMerge(entry))
        {
            UndoEntry& top = m_undo.back();
            for (EditBatch& b : entry.batches) top.batches.push_back(std::move(b));
            top.after = std::move(entry.after);
            top.idAfter = entry.idAfter;
            top.lastEditMs = entry.lastEditMs;
            top.bytes += bytes;
        }
        else
        {
            m_undo.push_back(std::move(entry));
        }
        m_undoBytes += bytes;
        EnforceMemoryCap();
    }

    void TextBuffer::EnforceMemoryCap()
    {
        while (m_undoBytes + m_redoBytes > m_policy.memoryBytes && !m_undo.empty())
        {
            m_undoBytes -= m_undo.front().bytes;
            m_undo.pop_front();
            ++m_dropped;
        }
    }

    bool TextBuffer::Undo(SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        if (m_depth > 0 || m_undo.empty()) return false;
        UndoEntry entry = std::move(m_undo.back());
        m_undo.pop_back();
        m_undoBytes -= entry.bytes;
        for (auto it = entry.batches.rbegin(); it != entry.batches.rend(); ++it) ApplyInverse(*it);
        if (entry.eolBefore) m_eols = *entry.eolBefore;
        m_changeId = entry.idBefore;
        sels = entry.before;
        entry.sealed = true;
        m_redoBytes += entry.bytes;
        m_redo.push_back(std::move(entry));
        return true;
    }

    bool TextBuffer::Redo(SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        if (m_depth > 0 || m_redo.empty()) return false;
        UndoEntry entry = std::move(m_redo.back());
        m_redo.pop_back();
        m_redoBytes -= entry.bytes;
        for (const EditBatch& b : entry.batches) ApplyForward(b);
        if (entry.eolAfter) m_eols = *entry.eolAfter;
        m_changeId = entry.idAfter;
        sels = entry.after;
        m_undoBytes += entry.bytes;
        m_undo.push_back(std::move(entry));
        return true;
    }
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// editor.text.* -- the text editor's reflected settings (text-editor spec s8;
// settings rule 2026-10-07). A plain struct: the reflection and ARC_SETTINGS
// live in TextSettings.cpp. The ArcaneText core never reads the registry; the
// mappers below turn the published block into the plain option structs the
// core takes, so Core tests build options directly and TextSettingsTest proves
// each mapping once.
//
// Why here (exe side) and not in the ArcaneText lib:
//   - ARC_SETTINGS registers from a static initializer, and an object file in
//     a .lib that nothing references is never linked -- a settings-only TU
//     inside ArcaneText.lib would silently not register in ArcaneEditor.exe;
//   - Editor-audience settings are declared in ArcaneEditor (settings spec s3.2);
//   - the core stays registry-free.

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"

#include <cstdint>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct TextSettings
    {
        std::uint32_t undoGroupMs = 300;   // typing within this window joins the previous undo step
        std::uint32_t undoMemoryMB = 64;   // undo history kept per document; oldest steps drop first
    };

    [[nodiscard]] inline Text::UndoPolicy ToUndoPolicy(const TextSettings& s) noexcept
    {
        Text::UndoPolicy p;
        p.groupMs = s.undoGroupMs;
        p.memoryBytes = std::uint64_t(s.undoMemoryMB) * 1024u * 1024u;
        return p;
    }
}
```
