### Task TE1-10: External append, reload as one undo step, and line-ending conversion (spec s3.5, s5.3)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp` (public: `AppendExternal` x2, `ReloadExternal` x2, `LastReloadClearedHistory`, `ConvertLineEndings`, `ClearHistory`; member `m_lastReloadClearedHistory`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextBufferExternalTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1-8/TE1-9 `TextBuffer`; `EolMap::AppendRows` (TE1-6); `SelectionSet::ApplyEdits`, `ClampTo` (TE1-7).
- Produces (the binding two plus overloads):
  - `void AppendExternal(std::string_view tail)`: every new break takes the dominant style.
  - `void AppendExternal(std::string_view tail, const EolMap& tailEols)`: the decoded tail's own styles. Row `i` of `tailEols` is the tail's i-th break.
  - `void ReloadExternal(std::string newText, const SelectionSet& before)`: the binding form. It keeps the dominant style and no exceptions.
  - `void ReloadExternal(std::string newText, EolMap newEols, const SelectionSet& before)`.
  - `bool LastReloadClearedHistory() const`.
  - `bool ConvertLineEndings(Eol style, const SelectionSet& sels)`: false when the map is already uniform `style`.
  - `void ClearHistory()` (CANON A2, NEW): drops every undo and redo entry and seals the group, leaving `changeId`, `savedChangeId` and `version` untouched. TE2-15's Reopen with Encoding is the only caller (`ReloadExternal(text, eols, sels); ClearHistory(); MarkSaved();`), because the old text was decoded under another encoding and undoing into it would put mis-decoded bytes back under the new label (spec s3.5 as amended by CANON D5).

Rules (spec s3.5, s5.3):
- **Append** happens outside a transaction. It is NOT an undo entry, `changeId` and `savedChangeId` are left alone (a clean document stays clean), and `version` bumps with one edit-log entry whose `firstRow` is the old last row. Registered anchors and observers see an insertion at the old end, so a Right anchor at the end follows the tail. Whether to append at all (clean or read-only only, the 4 KB window hash, the `\r`-at-old-end case) is TextDocument's decision in TE2/TE6. The buffer only executes it.
- **Reload** is one undoable `Other` transaction. It is sealed on both sides and trimmed to the changed middle (common prefix and suffix), so a one-byte external change costs bytes, not megabytes. Its entry also records the whole `EolMap` before and after. If the changed old text alone exceeds the undo cap, the history (undo and redo) is cleared instead, and `LastReloadClearedHistory()` reports it so TE2 can show the s5.4 note. The caller marks the buffer saved afterwards, since it now equals the file.
- **ConvertLineEndings** changes only the `EolMap`, never the rope, so `version` does not bump. It is one sealed undo step with a new `changeId`, so the document becomes dirty.
- **ClearHistory** touches only the history: the rope, the `EolMap`, `version`, `changeId` and `savedChangeId` stay as they are, so a dirty document stays dirty and a clean one stays clean. Afterwards `CanUndo()` and `CanRedo()` are false, `UndoBytes()` is 0, and the next typing step cannot merge into anything (the history is empty). It is refused inside a transaction.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("AppendExternal: no undo entry, the document stays clean, version and log advance", "[text-buffer]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("line1\n"), EolMap{});
    SelectionSet s = SelectionSet::Cursor(0);
    Commit(buf, s, { { { 0, 0 }, ">" } });
    buf.MarkSaved();
    const auto version = buf.Version();
    const auto changeId = buf.ChangeId();
    AnchorSet ends;
    const AnchorSet::Id tailAnchor = ends.Add({ buf.Text().Size(), Bias::Right });
    buf.RegisterAnchors(ends);
    buf.AppendExternal("line2\nline3\n");
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == ">line1\nline2\nline3\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Dirty());
    CHECK(buf.ChangeId() == changeId);
    CHECK(buf.Version() == version + 1);
    CHECK(buf.UndoDepth() == 1u);
    CHECK(ends.Get(tailAnchor).offset == buf.Text().Size());   // Follow: a Right anchor at the end stays at the end
    const auto log = buf.EditsSince(version);
    REQUIRE(log.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(log[0].firstRow == 1u);
    CHECK(log[0].rowDelta == 2);
    buf.UnregisterAnchors(ends);
    SelectionSet u = s;
    REQUIRE(buf.Undo(u));   // the history behind the append is still valid
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "line1\nline2\nline3\n");
    CHECK(buf.Dirty());
}

    CHECK(buf.ChangeId() == changeId);
    CHECK(buf.Dirty() == dirty);              // savedChangeId untouched: still dirty
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Undo(s));

    buf.MarkSaved();                          // the Reopen with Encoding sequence ends here
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Dirty());
    Commit(buf, s, { { { 0, 0 }, "4" } });    // a new history starts from the cleared state
    CHECK(buf.UndoDepth() == 1u);
    REQUIRE(buf.Undo(s));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == text);
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Dirty());
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.CanUndo());
```

```cpp
    void TextBuffer::AppendExternal(std::string_view tail) { AppendExternal(tail, EolMap(m_eols.Dominant())); }

    void TextBuffer::AppendExternal(std::string_view tail, const EolMap& tailEols)
    {
        assert(m_depth == 0 && "AppendExternal inside a transaction");
        if (tail.empty() || m_depth > 0) return;
        const ByteOffset size = m_rope.Size();
        const std::uint32_t lastRow = m_rope.LineCount() - 1;
        const std::uint32_t breaks = CountNewlines(tail);
        m_rope = m_rope.Append(tail);
        m_eols.AppendRows(lastRow, tailEols, breaks);   // the tail's first break ends the old last row
        const EditShift shift{ size, size, tail.size() };
        ++m_version;
        m_log.push_back({ m_version, lastRow, lastRow, static_cast<std::int32_t>(breaks) });
        if (m_log.size() > 2 * kEditLogKeep)
            m_log.erase(m_log.begin(), m_log.end() - static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(kEditLogKeep));
        for (AnchorSet* set : m_anchorSets) set->Shift(std::span(&shift, 1));
        for (EditObserver* o : m_observers) o->OnBufferEdited(std::span(&shift, 1), m_version);
    }

    void TextBuffer::ReloadExternal(std::string newText, const SelectionSet& before)
    {
        ReloadExternal(std::move(newText), EolMap(m_eols.Dominant()), before);
    }

    void TextBuffer::ReloadExternal(std::string newText, EolMap newEols, const SelectionSet& before)
    {
        assert(m_depth == 0 && "ReloadExternal inside a transaction");
        if (m_depth > 0) return;
        m_lastReloadClearedHistory = false;

        // Trim to the changed middle: the common prefix and suffix stay put.
        const std::string old = m_rope.ToString();
        const std::size_t common = std::min(old.size(), newText.size());
        std::size_t prefix = 0;
        while (prefix < common && old[prefix] == newText[prefix]) ++prefix;
        std::size_t suffix = 0;
        while (suffix < common - prefix && old[old.size() - 1 - suffix] == newText[newText.size() - 1 - suffix]) ++suffix;
        const ByteRange changed{ prefix, old.size() - suffix };
        std::string middle = newText.substr(prefix, newText.size() - suffix - prefix);
        const bool textChanges = !(changed.Empty() && middle.empty());
        if (!textChanges && newEols == m_eols) return;

        BreakUndoGroup();
        if (changed.Size() > m_policy.memoryBytes)
        {
            // spec s5.3: the old text does not fit the history -- clear it instead of recording.
            const EditOp op{ changed, std::move(middle) };
            ApplyOps(std::span(&op, 1));
            m_eols = std::move(newEols);
            m_undo.clear();
            m_redo.clear();
            m_undoBytes = m_redoBytes = 0;
            m_changeId = ++m_lastIssuedId;
            m_lastReloadClearedHistory = true;
            return;
        }

        UndoEntry entry;
        entry.before = before;
        entry.kind = TransactionKind::Other;
        entry.idBefore = m_changeId;
        entry.eolBefore = m_eols;
        entry.firstEditMs = entry.lastEditMs = m_clock();
        SelectionSet after = before;
        if (textChanges)
        {
            const EditShift shift{ changed.begin, changed.end, middle.size() };
            const EditOp op{ changed, std::move(middle) };
            entry.batches.push_back(ApplyOps(std::span(&op, 1)));
            after.ApplyEdits(std::span(&shift, 1));
            after.ClampTo(m_rope.Size());
        }
        m_eols = std::move(newEols);
        entry.eolAfter = m_eols;
        entry.after = std::move(after);
        entry.sealed = true;
        Commit(std::move(entry));
    }

    bool TextBuffer::ConvertLineEndings(Eol style, const SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        assert(m_depth == 0 && "ConvertLineEndings inside a transaction");
        if (m_depth > 0) return false;
        EolMap uniform(style);
        if (m_eols == uniform) return false;
        BreakUndoGroup();
        UndoEntry entry;
        entry.before = sels;
        entry.after = sels;
        entry.idBefore = m_changeId;
        entry.eolBefore = m_eols;
        entry.eolAfter = uniform;
        entry.sealed = true;
        m_eols = std::move(uniform);
        Commit(std::move(entry));
        return true;
    }

    void TextBuffer::ClearHistory()
    {
        assert(m_depth == 0 && "ClearHistory inside a transaction");
        if (m_depth > 0) return;
        // Nothing is left to merge into, so the group is sealed by construction:
        // CanMerge() refuses an empty undo stack.
        m_undo.clear();
        m_redo.clear();
        m_undoBytes = m_redoBytes = 0;
        // m_changeId, m_savedChangeId, m_lastIssuedId and m_version stay: ids are
        // never reissued, and Dirty() keeps its meaning across the clear.
    }
```
(`Commit` never merges these: they are kind `Other` and carry `eolAfter`.)

### Task TE1-11: `FileCodec`, file bytes to buffer text and back, byte-identical (spec s3.5, s11.1)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.cpp` (new field `defaultLineEnding`)
- Modify: `docs/superpowers/audits/2026-10-03-settings-inventory.md` (one row in `### Text editor`, one amendment row), `scripts/settings-frozen-names.txt` (regenerated)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/FileCodecTest.cpp`, `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextSettingsTest.cpp` (one new case)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Utf8::*` (TE1-1), `Rope` (TE1-2), `EolMap` (TE1-6), `TextBuffer` (TE1-8, in the one-edit property).
- Produces:
  - `enum class TextEncoding { Utf8, Utf8Bom, Utf16LE, Utf16BE, Windows1252 }` (UTF-16 always carries its BOM).
  - `enum class ReadOnlyReason { None, InvalidUtf8, InvalidUtf16, Binary }`.
  - `struct DecodeOptions { std::optional<TextEncoding> forced; Eol defaultEol = Eol::LF; }`. `forced` is `Utf8` or `Windows1252`, which is what Reopen with Encoding offers (spec s3.5). Any other value is ignored and detection runs.
  - `struct DecodedText { std::string text; EolMap eols; TextEncoding encoding; ReadOnlyReason readOnly; }`.
  - `struct EncodeError { std::uint32_t row; std::uint32_t byteCol; std::uint32_t value; std::string message; }`.
  - `bool LooksBinary(std::string_view)` (NUL in the first 8 KB), `DecodedText DecodeFile(std::string_view bytes, const DecodeOptions& = {})`, `std::expected<std::string, EncodeError> EncodeFile(const Rope&, const EolMap&, TextEncoding)`, `std::pair<std::string, EolMap> SplitLineEndings(std::string_view, Eol defaultEol)`.
  - `DecodedText DecodeFragment(std::string_view bytes, TextEncoding encoding, Eol defaultEol)` (CANON A4, NEW): decodes BOM-less bytes in a KNOWN encoding -- UTF-8 rules for `Utf8`/`Utf8Bom` (raw bytes kept; `InvalidUtf8`, else `Binary` on a NUL; a leading `EF BB BF` is text, not a BOM), BOM-less UTF-16 LE/BE with the lone-surrogate rule (`InvalidUtf16`), Windows-1252 byte for byte. CR/CRLF/LF fold exactly as in `DecodeFile`; a fragment with no break takes `defaultEol` as its dominant style. `encoding` is echoed into the result. The caller passes complete units only (TE2-4 `CompleteTailLength`); this is TE2-17's appended-tail decoder (CANON B2).
  - `constexpr bool EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding)` (CANON A4, NEW): true for `Utf8Bom`, `Utf16LE`, `Utf16BE`.
  - `std::string_view EncodingId(TextEncoding)` (CANON A4, NEW): the stable identity string, exactly `"utf-8"`, `"utf-8-bom"`, `"utf-16le"`, `"utf-16be"`, `"windows-1252"` (recovery markers, view state and the automation report store it). `std::optional<TextEncoding> EncodingFromId(std::string_view)` is the inverse, ASCII case-insensitive; an unknown id gives `std::nullopt`. The UI label is TE2-15's `Editor::EncodingLabel`; the file-local message helper in `FileCodec.cpp` is `EncodingDisplayName` (CANON B12).
  - `Editor::TextLineEnding { LF, CRLF }`, `TextSettings::defaultLineEnding` (`editor.text.defaultLineEnding`, PreferencesProject: a project may set its line-ending default, spec s8), `Text::Eol Editor::ToEol(TextLineEnding)`, `Text::DecodeOptions Editor::ToDecodeOptions(const TextSettings&)`.

Rules (spec s3.5):
- BOM detection order: `EF BB BF` gives Utf8Bom (the BOM is stripped, then written back), `FF FE` gives Utf16LE, `FE FF` gives Utf16BE, and anything else is UTF-8.
- Invalid UTF-8 keeps its **raw bytes** in the text. It is read-only (`InvalidUtf8`), and `EncodeFile(Utf8)` writes the same bytes back. NUL in the first 8 KB of a UTF-8 file means `Binary`, also raw and read-only. TE2 decides whether to refuse a binary file outright.
- A UTF-16 lone surrogate becomes its 3-byte WTF-8 form (an invalid sequence the view draws as hex boxes). The file is read-only (`InvalidUtf16`), and encoding back writes the same unit. A UTF-16 BOM with an odd body length falls back to raw bytes (`Utf8`, `InvalidUtf16`).
- Windows-1252 is decoded only when forced. The five undefined bytes (81 8D 8F 90 9D) map to the C1 control of the same value, as `MultiByteToWideChar` does, so every byte round-trips. Forcing 1252 clears the read-only reason (Reopen with Encoding makes a legacy file editable).
- Line endings: CRLF, lone CR and LF all become `'\n'`. The dominant style is the most frequent; ties go LF over CRLF over CR. A file with no break takes `defaultEol`. The rest are exceptions.
- Encoding refuses what the target cannot hold: invalid UTF-8 for UTF-16 or 1252, and code points 1252 lacks. It reports the row, byte column and value, so TE2's save banner can name the place.
- A fragment (an appended tail) carries no BOM, so it is never detected: `DecodeFragment` is told the encoding the document already has. Decoding a UTF-16 tail through `DecodeFile` would read it as UTF-8 with NULs and call it binary (Review Focus F2).

`ArcaneTests/src/Text/FileCodecTest.cpp`:
```cpp
// FileCodec (text-editor spec s3.5, s11.1): every encoding, BOM and line-ending
// style -- mixed files and lone CR included -- loads and saves byte-identical;
// invalid and binary content stays raw and read-only; a one-character edit to a
// mixed file changes exactly that line's bytes.

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>

#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"

#include <initializer_list>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    std::string S(std::initializer_list<char32_t> cps)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const char32_t cp : cps) Utf8::Append(out, cp);
        return out;
    }

    std::string Utf16Bytes(const std::u16string& s, bool le)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const char16_t u : s)
        {
            const char lo = static_cast<char>(u & 0xFF), hi = static_cast<char>(u >> 8);
            out.push_back(le ? lo : hi);
            out.push_back(le ? hi : lo);
        }
        return out;
    }

    struct Piece { std::string utf8; std::u16string utf16; std::string cp1252; bool in1252; };

    const std::vector<Piece>& Pieces()
    {
        static const std::vector<Piece> p = {
            { "a", u"a", "a", true },
            { " ", u" ", " ", true },
            { "\t", u"\t", "\t", true },
            { S({ 0xE9 }), u"é", std::string(1, static_cast<char>(0xE9)), true },
            { S({ 0x20AC }), u"€", std::string(1, static_cast<char>(0x80)), true },
            { S({ 0x65E5 }), u"日", "", false },
            { S({ 0x1F600 }), u"\U0001F600", "", false },
            { "\n", u"\n", "\n", true },
            { "\r\n", u"\r\n", "\r\n", true },
            { "\r", u"\r", "\r", true },
        };
        return p;
    }

    std::string Normalized(std::string s)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (s[i] == '\r')
            {
                out.push_back('\n');
                if (i + 1 < s.size() && s[i + 1] == '\n') ++i;
            }
            else out.push_back(s[i]);
        }
        return out;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: mixed line endings and a lone CR round-trip byte-identical", "[text-codec]")
{
    const std::string file = "one\r\ntwo\nthree\rfour\r\n";
    const DecodedText d = DecodeFile(file);
    CHECK(d.text == "one\ntwo\nthree\nfour\n");
    CHECK(d.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8);
    CHECK(d.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);
    CHECK(d.eols.Dominant() == Eol::CRLF);   // 2 CRLF, 1 LF, 1 CR
    CHECK(d.eols.StyleOf(1) == Eol::LF);
    CHECK(d.eols.StyleOf(2) == Eol::CR);
    CHECK(d.eols.IsMixed());
    const auto out = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text, 8), d.eols, d.encoding);
    REQUIRE(out.has_value());
    CHECK(*out == file);
    CHECK(DecodeFile("a\r").eols.StyleOf(0) == Eol::CR);
    CHECK(DecodeFile("a\nb\r\n").eols.Dominant() == Eol::LF);   // tie: LF wins
    CHECK(DecodeFile("abc", { std::nullopt, Eol::CRLF }).eols.Dominant() == Eol::CRLF);   // no break: the default
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: every encoding round-trips byte-identical", "[text-codec]")
{
    rc::prop("decode -> encode == the file", [] {
        const auto enc = static_cast<TextEncoding>(*rc::gen::inRange(0, 5));
        std::string utf8, cp1252;
        std::u16string utf16;
        const auto n = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, 40);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        {
            const Piece& p = Pieces()[*rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, Pieces().size())];
            if (enc == TextEncoding::Windows1252 && !p.in1252) continue;
            utf8 += p.utf8;
            utf16 += p.utf16;
            cp1252 += p.cp1252;
        }
        std::string file;
        switch (enc)
        {
        case TextEncoding::Utf8: file = utf8; break;
        case TextEncoding::Utf8Bom: file = "\xEF\xBB\xBF" + utf8; break;
        case TextEncoding::Utf16LE: file = "\xFF\xFE" + Utf16Bytes(utf16, true); break;
        case TextEncoding::Utf16BE: file = "\xFE\xFF" + Utf16Bytes(utf16, false); break;
        case TextEncoding::Windows1252: file = cp1252; break;
        }
        DecodeOptions o;
        if (enc == TextEncoding::Windows1252) o.forced = TextEncoding::Windows1252;
        const DecodedText d = DecodeFile(file, o);
        RC_ASSERT(d.encoding == enc);
        RC_ASSERT(d.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);
        RC_ASSERT(d.text == Normalized(utf8));
        const auto out = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text, 8), d.eols, d.encoding);
        RC_ASSERT(out.has_value());
        RC_ASSERT(*out == file);
    });
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: invalid UTF-8 and binary files stay raw, read-only and byte-identical", "[text-codec]")
{
    rc::prop("raw bytes survive", [](const std::vector<unsigned char>& raw) {
        const std::string file(raw.begin(), raw.end());
        if (file.starts_with("\xEF\xBB\xBF") || file.starts_with("\xFF\xFE") || file.starts_with("\xFE\xFF")) return;
        const DecodedText d = DecodeFile(file);
        RC_ASSERT(d.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8);
        const bool expectReadOnly = !Utf8::IsValid(file) || file.substr(0, 8192).find('\0') != std::string::npos;
        RC_ASSERT((d.readOnly != ReadOnlyReason::None) == expectReadOnly);
        const auto out = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text, 8), d.eols, d.encoding);
        RC_ASSERT(out.has_value());
        RC_ASSERT(*out == file);
    });
    CHECK(DecodeFile(std::string("ab\0cd", 5)).readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::Binary);
    CHECK(DecodeFile(std::string(9000, 'a') + std::string(1, '\0')).readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);   // NUL past 8 KB
    CHECK(DecodeFile(std::string("caf\xE9", 4)).readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8);
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: UTF-16 lone surrogates and odd lengths are kept, read-only", "[text-codec]")
{
    const std::string file = std::string("\xFF\xFE", 2) + Utf16Bytes(u"a", true) + std::string("\x00\xD8", 2) + Utf16Bytes(u"b", true);
    const DecodedText d = DecodeFile(file);
    CHECK(d.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK(d.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16);
    CHECK(d.text == "a" + S({ 0xD800 }) + "b");
    const auto out = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text, 8), d.eols, d.encoding);
    REQUIRE(out.has_value());
    CHECK(*out == file);
    const std::string odd = std::string("\xFF\xFE", 2) + "a";
    const DecodedText o = DecodeFile(odd);
    CHECK(o.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8);
    CHECK(o.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16);
    CHECK(*EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(o.text), o.eols, o.encoding) == odd);
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: Windows-1252 maps every byte, undefined ones to C1, and unlocks binary-looking files", "[text-codec]")
{
    const std::string undefinedBytes = std::string("\x81\x8D\x8F\x90\x9D", 5);
    const DecodedText d = DecodeFile(undefinedBytes, { TextEncoding::Windows1252, Eol::LF });
    CHECK(d.text == S({ 0x81, 0x8D, 0x8F, 0x90, 0x9D }));
    CHECK(*EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text), d.eols, TextEncoding::Windows1252) == undefinedBytes);
    const DecodedText nul = DecodeFile(std::string("a\0b", 3), { TextEncoding::Windows1252, Eol::LF });
    CHECK(nul.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);
    CHECK(nul.encoding == TextEncoding::Windows1252);
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: encoding refuses what the target cannot hold, naming the place", "[text-codec]")
{
    const auto out = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8("ok\n" + S({ 0x65E5 })), EolMap{}, TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(out.has_value());
    CHECK(out.error().row == 1u);
    CHECK(out.error().byteCol == 0u);
    CHECK(out.error().value == 0x65E5u);
    CHECK_FALSE(out.error().message.empty());
    const auto bad = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(std::string("a\xFF", 2)), EolMap{}, TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(bad.has_value());
    CHECK(bad.error().value == 0xFFu);
    CHECK(bad.error().byteCol == 1u);
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: a one-character edit to a mixed file changes exactly that line's bytes", "[text-codec]")
{
    rc::prop("replace one byte / insert one break -> the file differs only there", [] {
        static const char* const styles[] = { "\n", "\r\n", "\r" };
        std::string file;
        std::vector<std::size_t> rowStart;   // file offset of each row
        std::vector<std::size_t> rowLength;
        const auto rows = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 20);
        bool prevCr = false;
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; ++r)
        {
            rowStart.push_back(file.size());
            const auto len = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, 6);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) file.push_back(static_cast<char>('a' + *rc::gen::inRange(0, 3)));
            rowLength.push_back(len);
            if (r + 1 < rows || *rc::gen::inRange(0, 2) == 0)
            {
                int style = *rc::gen::inRange(0, 3);
                if (style == 0 && len == 0 && prevCr) style = 1;   // a CR then an LF would read back as one CRLF break
                file += styles[style];
                prevCr = style == 2;
            }
        }
        std::vector<int> candidates;
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; ++r) if (rowLength[r] > 0) candidates.push_back(r);
        if (candidates.empty()) return;
        const int row = candidates[*rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, candidates.size())];
        const auto col = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, rowLength[row]);

        const DecodedText d = DecodeFile(file);
        TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text, 8), d.eols);
        const ByteOffset at = buf.Text().LineStart(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(row)) + col;
        SelectionSet s;
        buf.BeginTransaction(s);
        buf.Edit(std::vector<EditOp>{ { { at, at + 1 }, "Z" } });
        buf.EndTransaction(s);
        std::string expected = file;
        expected[rowStart[row] + col] = 'Z';
        const auto out = EncodeFile(buf.Text(), buf.Eols(), d.encoding);
        RC_ASSERT(out.has_value());
        RC_ASSERT(*out == expected);

        TextBuffer buf2(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text, 8), d.eols);
        buf2.BeginTransaction(s);
        buf2.Edit(std::vector<EditOp>{ { { at, at }, "\n" } });
        buf2.EndTransaction(s);
        std::string expected2 = file;
        expected2.insert(rowStart[row] + col, EolMap::Bytes(d.eols.Dominant()));
        const auto out2 = EncodeFile(buf2.Text(), buf2.Eols(), d.encoding);
        RC_ASSERT(out2.has_value());
        RC_ASSERT(*out2 == expected2);
    });
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: encoding ids are stable, round-trip, and parse case-insensitively", "[text-codec]")
{
    static_assert(!EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding::Utf8));
    static_assert(EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding::Utf8Bom));
    static_assert(EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding::Utf16LE));
    static_assert(EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding::Utf16BE));
    static_assert(!EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding::Windows1252));

    struct Row { TextEncoding encoding; std::string_view id; };
    const Row rows[] = {
        { TextEncoding::Utf8, "utf-8" },
        { TextEncoding::Utf8Bom, "utf-8-bom" },
        { TextEncoding::Utf16LE, "utf-16le" },
        { TextEncoding::Utf16BE, "utf-16be" },
        { TextEncoding::Windows1252, "windows-1252" },
    };
    for (const Row& r : rows)
    {
        INFO("id " << std::string(r.id));
        CHECK(EncodingId(r.encoding) == r.id);
        const std::optional<TextEncoding> back = EncodingFromId(EncodingId(r.encoding));
        REQUIRE(back.has_value());
        CHECK(*back == r.encoding);
    }
    CHECK(EncodingFromId("UTF-8") == TextEncoding::Utf8);
    CHECK(EncodingFromId("Windows-1252") == TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    CHECK(EncodingFromId("UTF-16LE") == TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK_FALSE(EncodingFromId("latin-1").has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(EncodingFromId("utf8").has_value());   // ids are exact apart from case
    CHECK_FALSE(EncodingFromId("").has_value());
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: DecodeFragment decodes BOM-less bytes in a known encoding", "[text-codec]")
{
    // A BOM-less UTF-16LE tail with CRLF breaks: '\n' text, CRLF dominant, the LF row an exception.
    const DecodedText le = DecodeFragment(Utf16Bytes(u"a\r\nb\r\nc\n", true), TextEncoding::Utf16LE, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(le.text == "a\nb\nc\n");
    CHECK(le.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK(le.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);
    CHECK(le.eols.Dominant() == Eol::CRLF);
    CHECK(le.eols.StyleOf(2) == Eol::LF);
    const DecodedText be = DecodeFragment(Utf16Bytes(u"x\r\n", false), TextEncoding::Utf16BE, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(be.text == "x\n");
    CHECK(be.eols.Dominant() == Eol::CRLF);
    // A fragment is never sniffed for a BOM: FF FE here is the character U+FEFF, not a marker.
    const DecodedText zw = DecodeFragment(Utf16Bytes(u"﻿z", true), TextEncoding::Utf16LE, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(zw.text == S({ 0xFEFF }) + "z");

    // A lone surrogate becomes WTF-8 and makes the content read-only.
    const std::string lone = Utf16Bytes(u"a", true) + std::string("\x00\xD8", 2) + Utf16Bytes(u"b", true);
    const DecodedText ls = DecodeFragment(lone, TextEncoding::Utf16LE, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(ls.text == "a" + S({ 0xD800 }) + "b");
    CHECK(ls.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16);

    // Windows-1252 maps every one of the 256 bytes, and the result encodes back byte-identical.
    std::string all;
    for (int b = 0; b < 256; ++b) all.push_back(static_cast<char>(b));
    const DecodedText w = DecodeFragment(all, TextEncoding::Windows1252, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(w.encoding == TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    CHECK(w.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);   // the NUL byte is a character in 1252
    CHECK(w.text.find(S({ 0x20AC })) != std::string::npos);   // 0x80
    CHECK(w.text.find(S({ 0x0081 })) != std::string::npos);   // undefined -> C1
    CHECK(w.text.find(S({ 0x00E9 })) != std::string::npos);   // 0xE9
    const auto wOut = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(w.text), w.eols, TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    REQUIRE(wOut.has_value());
    CHECK(*wOut == all);

    // UTF-8 keeps an invalid byte raw and reports it; a leading EF BB BF is text, not a BOM.
    const std::string bad = std::string("ok", 2) + std::string(1, static_cast<char>(0xFF)) + "\n";
    const DecodedText u = DecodeFragment(bad, TextEncoding::Utf8, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(u.text == bad);
    CHECK(u.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8);
    CHECK(u.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8);
    const std::string bomLike = std::string("\xEF\xBB\xBF", 3) + "x";
    const DecodedText kept = DecodeFragment(bomLike, TextEncoding::Utf8Bom, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(kept.text == bomLike);
    CHECK(kept.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8Bom);
    CHECK(kept.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);

    // No break: the caller's default style (TE2-17 passes the buffer's dominant style).
    CHECK(DecodeFragment("abc", TextEncoding::Utf8, Eol::CRLF).eols.Dominant() == Eol::CRLF);
    // Same folding as DecodeFile, lone CR included.
    const DecodedText mixed = DecodeFragment("p\rq\r\nr\n", TextEncoding::Utf8, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(mixed.text == DecodeFile("p\rq\r\nr\n").text);
    CHECK(mixed.eols == DecodeFile("p\rq\r\nr\n").eols);
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// File bytes <-> buffer text (spec s3.5). Pure: no file I/O (TE2's TextFileIO
// reads and writes; this converts). Every supported encoding, BOM and line
// ending round-trips byte-identical when unedited:
//   - UTF-8 (BOM kept if present), UTF-16 LE/BE with BOM, Windows-1252 (only
//     when forced -- Reopen with Encoding);
//   - invalid UTF-8 and binary (NUL in the first 8 KB) keep their RAW bytes and
//     are read-only; a UTF-16 lone surrogate is kept as WTF-8, read-only;
//   - line breaks become '\n'; the EolMap records each one's original style.

#include "TextEditor/Core/EolMap.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <expected>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class TextEncoding : std::uint8_t { Utf8, Utf8Bom, Utf16LE, Utf16BE, Windows1252 };
    enum class ReadOnlyReason : std::uint8_t { None, InvalidUtf8, InvalidUtf16, Binary };

    struct DecodeOptions
    {
        std::optional<TextEncoding> forced;   // Utf8 or Windows1252 (Reopen with Encoding); others are ignored
        Eol defaultEol = Eol::LF;              // for a file with no line break (editor.text.defaultLineEnding)
    };

    struct DecodedText
    {
        std::string text;   // '\n' breaks only
        EolMap eols;
        TextEncoding encoding = TextEncoding::Utf8;
        ReadOnlyReason readOnly = ReadOnlyReason::None;
    };

    struct EncodeError
    {
        std::uint32_t row = 0;
        std::uint32_t byteCol = 0;
        std::uint32_t value = 0;   // the code point the target lacks, or the invalid byte
        std::string message;
    };

    // True when the encoding writes a byte-order mark (UTF-16 always does).
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding e) noexcept
    {
        return e == TextEncoding::Utf8Bom || e == TextEncoding::Utf16LE || e == TextEncoding::Utf16BE;
    }

    // The stable identity string stored by recovery markers, view state and the
    // automation report: "utf-8", "utf-8-bom", "utf-16le", "utf-16be",
    // "windows-1252". EncodingFromId is the inverse (ASCII case-insensitive);
    // an unknown id gives nullopt. The UI label is Editor::EncodingLabel (TE2-15).
    [[nodiscard]] std::string_view EncodingId(TextEncoding e) noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<TextEncoding> EncodingFromId(std::string_view id) noexcept;

    [[nodiscard]] bool LooksBinary(std::string_view bytes) noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] DecodedText DecodeFile(std::string_view bytes, const DecodeOptions& options = {});

    // BOM-less bytes in a KNOWN encoding -- an appended tail (TE2-17). Nothing is
    // detected: Utf8/Utf8Bom follow the UTF-8 rules (raw bytes kept, InvalidUtf8,
    // else Binary on a NUL; a leading EF BB BF is text), Utf16LE/BE decode without
    // a BOM (a lone surrogate -> WTF-8, InvalidUtf16), Windows1252 maps every
    // byte. Line breaks fold exactly as DecodeFile's; no break -> defaultEol.
    // The caller passes complete units only (TE2-4 CompleteTailLength); an odd
    // UTF-16 byte count is a caller bug (asserted; the last byte is dropped and
    // the result is InvalidUtf16, so the document goes read-only, never wrong).
    [[nodiscard]] DecodedText DecodeFragment(std::string_view bytes, TextEncoding encoding, Eol defaultEol);

    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::string, EncodeError> EncodeFile(const Rope& text, const EolMap& eols, TextEncoding encoding);

    // CRLF / CR / LF -> '\n'; dominant = most frequent (ties LF > CRLF > CR),
    // none -> defaultEol; the rest are exceptions.
    [[nodiscard]] std::pair<std::string, EolMap> SplitLineEndings(std::string_view text, Eol defaultEol);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>
#include <format>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("the spec's binary sniff window: NUL bytes in the first 8 KB mean binary (text-editor spec s3.5)")
        constexpr std::size_t kBinarySniffBytes = 8192;

        // Windows-1252 bytes 0x80..0x9F. The five the code page leaves undefined
        // (81 8D 8F 90 9D) map to the C1 control of the same value, as
        // MultiByteToWideChar does, so every byte round-trips.
        ARC_CONSTANT("character-set table: Windows-1252 0x80..0x9F, a published code page -- not a tunable")
        constexpr char16_t kCp1252High[32] = {
            0x20AC, 0x0081, 0x201A, 0x0192, 0x201E, 0x2026, 0x2020, 0x2021, 0x02C6, 0x2030, 0x0160, 0x2039, 0x0152, 0x008D, 0x017D, 0x008F,
            0x0090, 0x2018, 0x2019, 0x201C, 0x201D, 0x2022, 0x2013, 0x2014, 0x02DC, 0x2122, 0x0161, 0x203A, 0x0153, 0x009D, 0x017E, 0x0178,
        };

        unsigned char U8(char c) noexcept { return static_cast<unsigned char>(c); }

        std::optional<unsigned char> ToCp1252(char32_t cp) noexcept
        {
            if (cp < 0x80 || (cp >= 0xA0 && cp <= 0xFF)) return static_cast<unsigned char>(cp);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 32; ++i)
                if (kCp1252High[i] == cp) return static_cast<unsigned char>(0x80 + i);
            return std::nullopt;
        }

        // File-local: the encoding's name inside EncodeError messages. The
        // identity string is EncodingId; the UI label is Editor::EncodingLabel.
        const char* EncodingDisplayName(TextEncoding e) noexcept
        {
            switch (e)
            {
            case TextEncoding::Utf16LE: return "UTF-16 LE";
            case TextEncoding::Utf16BE: return "UTF-16 BE";
            case TextEncoding::Windows1252: return "Windows-1252";
            case TextEncoding::Utf8Bom: return "UTF-8 with BOM";
            default: return "UTF-8";
            }
        }

        char AsciiLower(char c) noexcept { return (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') ? static_cast<char>(c - 'A' + 'a') : c; }

        // Every byte -> its Windows-1252 code point, appended as UTF-8.
        void AppendCp1252(std::string_view bytes, std::string& out)
        {
            out.reserve(out.size() + bytes.size() + bytes.size() / 8);
            for (const char c : bytes)
            {
                const unsigned char b = U8(c);
                Utf8::Append(out, (b < 0x80 || b >= 0xA0) ? char32_t(b) : char32_t(kCp1252High[b - 0x80]));
            }
        }

        // The UTF-8 rules: raw bytes kept; invalid -> InvalidUtf8, else a NUL in the sniff window -> Binary.
        ReadOnlyReason Utf8Reason(std::string_view utf8) noexcept
        {
            if (!Utf8::IsValid(utf8)) return ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8;
            if (LooksBinary(utf8)) return ReadOnlyReason::Binary;
            return ReadOnlyReason::None;
        }

        // UTF-16 code units -> UTF-8; a lone surrogate becomes WTF-8. Returns false when one was seen.
        bool DecodeUtf16(std::string_view body, bool le, std::string& out)
        {
            const auto unit = [&](std::size_t k) -> char16_t {
                const unsigned a = U8(body[k]), b = U8(body[k + 1]);
                return static_cast<char16_t>(le ? (a | (b << 8)) : ((a << 8) | b));
            };
            bool clean = true;
            out.reserve(body.size());
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < body.size(); i += 2)
            {
                const char16_t u = unit(i);
                if (u >= 0xD800 && u <= 0xDBFF && i + 3 < body.size())
                {
                    const char16_t v = unit(i + 2);
                    if (v >= 0xDC00 && v <= 0xDFFF)
                    {
                        Utf8::Append(out, 0x10000 + ((char32_t(u) - 0xD800) << 10) + (char32_t(v) - 0xDC00));
                        i += 2;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                if (u >= 0xD800 && u <= 0xDFFF) clean = false;
                Utf8::Append(out, u);
            }
            return clean;
        }
    }

    bool LooksBinary(std::string_view bytes) noexcept
    {
        return bytes.substr(0, kBinarySniffBytes).find('\0') != std::string_view::npos;
    }

    std::pair<std::string, EolMap> SplitLineEndings(std::string_view s, Eol defaultEol)
    {
        if (s.find('\r') == std::string_view::npos)   // the common case: LF only (or no break)
        {
            const bool anyBreak = s.find('\n') != std::string_view::npos;
            return { std::string(s), EolMap(anyBreak ? Eol::LF : defaultEol) };
        }
        std::string text;
        text.reserve(s.size());
        std::vector<Eol> styles;
        std::size_t counts[3] = {};
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i)
        {
            const char c = s[i];
            if (c == '\r')
            {
                const bool crlf = i + 1 < s.size() && s[i + 1] == '\n';
                styles.push_back(crlf ? Eol::CRLF : Eol::CR);
                if (crlf) ++i;
                text.push_back('\n');
            }
            else if (c == '\n')
            {
                styles.push_back(Eol::LF);
                text.push_back('\n');
            }
            else
            {
                text.push_back(c);
            }
        }
        for (const Eol e : styles) ++counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(e)];
        Eol dominant = defaultEol;
        if (!styles.empty())
        {
            dominant = Eol::LF;
            if (counts[1] > counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(dominant)]) dominant = Eol::CRLF;
            if (counts[2] > counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(dominant)]) dominant = Eol::CR;
        }
        EolMap map(dominant);
        for (std::size_t row = 0; row < styles.size(); ++row) map.SetStyle(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(row), styles[row]);
        return { std::move(text), std::move(map) };
    }

    DecodedText DecodeFile(std::string_view bytes, const DecodeOptions& options)
    {
        DecodedText out;
        std::string utf8;
        const bool forced1252 = options.forced == TextEncoding::Windows1252;
        const bool detect = !options.forced || options.forced == TextEncoding::Utf8;
        if (forced1252)
        {
            out.encoding = TextEncoding::Windows1252;
            AppendCp1252(bytes, utf8);
        }
        else if (!options.forced && bytes.size() >= 2 && (bytes.starts_with("\xFF\xFE") || bytes.starts_with("\xFE\xFF")))
        {
            const bool le = U8(bytes[0]) == 0xFF;
            const std::string_view body = bytes.substr(2);
            if (body.size() % 2 != 0)
            {
                out.encoding = TextEncoding::Utf8;   // not decodable as UTF-16: keep the raw bytes
                utf8.assign(bytes);
                out.readOnly = ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16;
            }
            else
            {
                out.encoding = le ? TextEncoding::Utf16LE : TextEncoding::Utf16BE;
                if (!DecodeUtf16(body, le, utf8)) out.readOnly = ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            std::string_view body = bytes;
            if (detect && body.starts_with("\xEF\xBB\xBF"))
            {
                out.encoding = TextEncoding::Utf8Bom;
                body.remove_prefix(3);
            }
            utf8.assign(body);
            out.readOnly = Utf8Reason(utf8);
        }
        auto [text, eols] = SplitLineEndings(utf8, options.defaultEol);
        out.text = std::move(text);
        out.eols = std::move(eols);
        return out;
    }

    DecodedText DecodeFragment(std::string_view bytes, TextEncoding encoding, Eol defaultEol)
    {
        DecodedText out;
        out.encoding = encoding;
        std::string utf8;
        switch (encoding)
        {
        case TextEncoding::Utf8:
        case TextEncoding::Utf8Bom:
            utf8.assign(bytes);   // BOM-less by contract: a leading EF BB BF is the character U+FEFF
            out.readOnly = Utf8Reason(utf8);
            break;
        case TextEncoding::Utf16LE:
        case TextEncoding::Utf16BE:
        {
            std::string_view body = bytes;
            bool clean = true;
            if (body.size() % 2 != 0)
            {
                assert(false && "DecodeFragment: pass complete UTF-16 units only (CompleteTailLength)");
                body.remove_suffix(1);
                clean = false;
            }
            if (!DecodeUtf16(body, encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16LE, utf8)) clean = false;
            if (!clean) out.readOnly = ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16;
            break;
        }
        case TextEncoding::Windows1252:
            AppendCp1252(bytes, utf8);
            break;
        }
        auto [text, eols] = SplitLineEndings(utf8, defaultEol);
        out.text = std::move(text);
        out.eols = std::move(eols);
        return out;
    }

    std::string_view EncodingId(TextEncoding e) noexcept
    {
        switch (e)
        {
        case TextEncoding::Utf8Bom: return "utf-8-bom";
        case TextEncoding::Utf16LE: return "utf-16le";
        case TextEncoding::Utf16BE: return "utf-16be";
        case TextEncoding::Windows1252: return "windows-1252";
        case TextEncoding::Utf8: break;
        }
        return "utf-8";
    }

    std::optional<TextEncoding> EncodingFromId(std::string_view id) noexcept
    {
        const TextEncoding all[] = { TextEncoding::Utf8, TextEncoding::Utf8Bom, TextEncoding::Utf16LE,
                                     TextEncoding::Utf16BE, TextEncoding::Windows1252 };
        for (const TextEncoding e : all)
        {
            const std::string_view known = EncodingId(e);
            if (known.size() == id.size() &&
                std::equal(known.begin(), known.end(), id.begin(), [](char a, char b) { return a == AsciiLower(b); }))
                return e;
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    std::expected<std::string, EncodeError> EncodeFile(const Rope& text, const EolMap& eols, TextEncoding encoding)
    {
        const bool utf16 = encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16LE || encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16BE;
        const bool raw = encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8 || encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8Bom;
        std::string out;
        out.reserve(static_cast<std::size_t>(text.Size()) + 16);
        if (encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8Bom) out += "\xEF\xBB\xBF";
        if (encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16LE) out += "\xFF\xFE";
        if (encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16BE) out += "\xFE\xFF";

        std::uint32_t row = 0, col = 0;
        std::optional<EncodeError> error;
        const auto unit16 = [&](char16_t u) {
            const char lo = static_cast<char>(u & 0xFF), hi = static_cast<char>(u >> 8);
            out.push_back(encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16LE ? lo : hi);
            out.push_back(encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16LE ? hi : lo);
        };
        const auto lineBreak = [&] {
            for (const char c : EolMap::Bytes(eols.StyleOf(row)))
            {
                if (utf16) unit16(static_cast<char16_t>(c));
                else out.push_back(c);
            }
            ++row;
            col = 0;
        };
        const auto fail = [&](std::uint32_t value, std::string what) {
            error = EncodeError{ row, col, value, std::format("{} at line {}, byte {} cannot be saved as {}", what, row + 1, col + 1,
                                                              EncodingDisplayName(encoding)) };
        };
        // Consumes whole units of s; leaves an incomplete trailing sequence for the next chunk unless `last`.
        const auto consume = [&](std::string_view s, bool last) -> std::size_t {
            std::size_t i = 0;
            while (i < s.size() && !error)
            {
                if (s[i] == '\n')
                {
                    lineBreak();
                    ++i;
                    continue;
                }
                if (raw)
                {
                    const std::size_t nl = s.find('\n', i);
                    const std::size_t end = nl == std::string_view::npos ? s.size() : nl;
                    out.append(s.substr(i, end - i));
                    col += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(end - i);
                    i = end;
                    continue;
                }
                const std::string_view rest = s.substr(i);
                if (!last && Utf8::IsIncompletePrefix(rest)) break;
                if (utf16 && U8(rest[0]) == 0xED && rest.size() >= 2 && U8(rest[1]) >= 0xA0 && U8(rest[1]) <= 0xBF)
                {
                    // WTF-8 surrogate (DecodeFile's lone-surrogate form) -> the same UTF-16 unit.
                    if (rest.size() < 3 && !last) break;
                    if (rest.size() >= 3 && Utf8::IsContinuation(U8(rest[2])))
                    {
                        unit16(static_cast<char16_t>(0xD000 | ((U8(rest[1]) & 0x3F) << 6) | (U8(rest[2]) & 0x3F)));
                        i += 3;
                        col += 3;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                const Utf8::Unit u = Utf8::DecodeAt(s, i);
                if (!u.valid)
                {
                    fail(U8(s[i]), std::format("Byte 0x{:02X}", U8(s[i])));
                    break;
                }
                if (encoding == TextEncoding::Windows1252)
                {
                    const std::optional<unsigned char> b = ToCp1252(u.cp);
                    if (!b)
                    {
                        fail(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(u.cp), std::format("U+{:04X}", static_cast<std::uint32_t>(u.cp)));
                        break;
                    }
                    out.push_back(static_cast<char>(*b));
                }
                else if (u.cp >= 0x10000)
                {
                    const char32_t v = u.cp - 0x10000;
                    unit16(static_cast<char16_t>(0xD800 + (v >> 10)));
                    unit16(static_cast<char16_t>(0xDC00 + (v & 0x3FF)));
                }
                else
                {
                    unit16(static_cast<char16_t>(u.cp));
                }
                i += u.length;
                col += u.length;
            }
            return i;
        };

        std::string carry;
        text.ForEachChunkWhile({ 0, text.Size() }, [&](std::string_view chunk) {
            if (carry.empty())
            {
                const std::size_t used = consume(chunk, false);
                carry.assign(chunk.substr(used));
            }
            else
            {
                carry.append(chunk);
                const std::size_t used = consume(carry, false);
                carry.erase(0, used);
            }
            return !error;
        });
        if (!error && !carry.empty()) consume(carry, true);
        if (error) return std::unexpected(std::move(*error));
        return out;
    }
}
```

### Task TE1-12: `FoldModel`, indentation folds plus manual folds on anchors (spec s4.6, s3.2)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/FoldModelTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Rope` (TE1-2), `Anchor`, `EditShift`, `EditShiftMap` (TE1-5).
- Produces:
  - `struct FoldRange { std::uint32_t headerRow; std::uint32_t lastRow; }`: hides `headerRow+1 .. lastRow`, and `==` is defaulted.
  - `enum class FoldSource { Indent, Marker, Manual }`. `Marker` is filled by TE3 from the grammar's `foldMarkers`.
  - `class FoldModel` with: `static IndentColumns(std::string_view, tabSize)`, `static IsBlank(std::string_view)`, `static IndentRegionAt(const Rope&, row, tabSize) -> std::optional<FoldRange>`, `static IndentRegions(const Rope&, tabSize) -> std::vector<FoldRange>` (one pass, sorted by header), `Fold(const Rope&, FoldRange, FoldSource) -> bool`, `Unfold(const Rope&, row) -> bool`, `UnfoldInnermost(const Rope&, row) -> bool` (CANON A5, NEW: removes only the innermost fold that heads or hides `row`; vim `zo`/`zd`, TE5), `UnfoldAll()`, `IsFoldedAt(const Rope&, headerRow)`, `Folded(const Rope&) -> std::vector<FoldRange>`, `OnEdits(std::span<const EditShift>)`, `Prune(const Rope&)`, `Count()`.

Indentation rule (spec s4.6, as Zed does it): a row is foldable if the next non-blank row is indented more. The region runs to the last non-blank row indented more than the header, before the next non-blank row indented no more than it. Trailing blank rows are not hidden, and the closing-bracket row stays visible. Indent width counts a tab to the next multiple of `tabSize`. A folded region is stored as two anchors (Left) at the ends of its header row and last row, so edits shift it like any anchor. It resolves back to rows on demand, and a fold whose last row no longer lies below its header is invalid: it is skipped, and `Prune` drops it.

```cpp
    REQUIRE(folds.Fold(r, { 1, 2 }, FoldSource::Indent));
    CHECK(folds.Unfold(r, 2));
    CHECK(folds.Count() == 0u);
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// Folds (spec s4.6). Indentation-based by default -- a row is foldable if the
// next non-blank row is indented more, and the closing-bracket row stays
// visible -- plus manual folds (vim zf, a gutter action) and, from TE3, the
// grammar's foldMarkers. Folded regions are anchors (spec s3.2): Left anchors
// at the ends of the header row and the last hidden row, resolved back to rows
// on demand. Per view: each TextEditorView owns one (spec s5.1, split view).

#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct FoldRange
    {
        std::uint32_t headerRow = 0;   // stays visible
        std::uint32_t lastRow = 0;     // headerRow+1 .. lastRow are hidden

        friend constexpr bool operator==(const FoldRange&, const FoldRange&) = default;
    };

    enum class FoldSource : std::uint8_t { Indent, Marker, Manual };

    class FoldModel
    {
    public:
        [[nodiscard]] static std::uint32_t IndentColumns(std::string_view line, std::uint32_t tabSize) noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] static bool IsBlank(std::string_view line) noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] static std::optional<FoldRange> IndentRegionAt(const Rope& text, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t tabSize);
        [[nodiscard]] static std::vector<FoldRange> IndentRegions(const Rope& text, std::uint32_t tabSize);   // sorted by header

        bool Fold(const Rope& text, FoldRange range, FoldSource source);   // false when nothing would hide; replaces a fold with the same header
        bool Unfold(const Rope& text, std::uint32_t row);                  // every fold whose header is row or that hides row
        bool UnfoldInnermost(const Rope& text, std::uint32_t row);         // only the innermost such fold (largest header; vim zo/zd)
        void UnfoldAll() noexcept { m_folds.clear(); }
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsFoldedAt(const Rope& text, std::uint32_t headerRow) const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<FoldRange> Folded(const Rope& text) const;   // valid folds, sorted by header, one per header
        void OnEdits(std::span<const EditShift> edits);
        void Prune(const Rope& text);
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t Count() const noexcept { return m_folds.size(); }

    private:
        struct Entry
        {
            Anchor header;
            Anchor last;
            FoldSource source = FoldSource::Manual;
        };

        [[nodiscard]] static std::optional<FoldRange> Resolve(const Rope& text, const Entry& e);

        std::vector<Entry> m_folds;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        void LineText(const Rope& text, std::uint32_t row, std::string& out)
        {
            text.CopyTo({ text.LineStart(row), text.LineEnd(row) }, out);
        }
    }

    std::uint32_t FoldModel::IndentColumns(std::string_view line, std::uint32_t tabSize) noexcept
    {
        const std::uint32_t tab = std::max(tabSize, 1u);
        std::uint32_t col = 0;
        for (const char c : line)
        {
            if (c == ' ') ++col;
            else if (c == '\t') col = (col / tab + 1) * tab;
            else break;
        }
        return col;
    }

    bool FoldModel::IsBlank(std::string_view line) noexcept
    {
        return line.find_first_not_of(" \t") == std::string_view::npos;
    }

    std::optional<FoldRange> FoldModel::IndentRegionAt(const Rope& text, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t tabSize)
    {
        const std::uint32_t rows = text.LineCount();
        if (row + 1 >= rows) return std::nullopt;
        std::string line;
        LineText(text, row, line);
        if (IsBlank(line)) return std::nullopt;
        const std::uint32_t base = IndentColumns(line, tabSize);
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> last;
        for (std::uint32_t r = row + 1; r < rows; ++r)
        {
            LineText(text, r, line);
            if (IsBlank(line)) continue;
            if (IndentColumns(line, tabSize) <= base) break;
            last = r;
        }
        if (!last) return std::nullopt;
        return FoldRange{ row, *last };
    }

    std::vector<FoldRange> FoldModel::IndentRegions(const Rope& text, std::uint32_t tabSize)
    {
        // One pass with a stack of open headers. A header closes at the first
        // later non-blank row indented no more than it; its region ends at the
        // last non-blank row before that, and exists only past the header itself.
        struct Open { std::uint32_t row; std::uint32_t indent; };
        std::vector<Open> open;
        std::vector<FoldRange> out;
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> prevNonBlank;
        std::string line;
        const auto close = [&](const Open& h) {
            if (prevNonBlank && *prevNonBlank > h.row) out.push_back({ h.row, *prevNonBlank });
        };
        for (std::uint32_t r = 0; r < text.LineCount(); ++r)
        {
            LineText(text, r, line);
            if (IsBlank(line)) continue;
            const std::uint32_t indent = IndentColumns(line, tabSize);
            while (!open.empty() && open.back().indent >= indent)
            {
                close(open.back());
                open.pop_back();
            }
            open.push_back({ r, indent });
            prevNonBlank = r;
        }
        while (!open.empty())
        {
            close(open.back());
            open.pop_back();
        }
        std::sort(out.begin(), out.end(), [](const FoldRange& a, const FoldRange& b) { return a.headerRow < b.headerRow; });
        return out;
    }

    std::optional<FoldRange> FoldModel::Resolve(const Rope& text, const Entry& e)
    {
        const std::uint32_t header = text.OffsetToPoint(e.header.offset).row;
        const std::uint32_t last = text.OffsetToPoint(e.last.offset).row;
        if (last <= header) return std::nullopt;
        return FoldRange{ header, last };
    }

    bool FoldModel::Fold(const Rope& text, FoldRange range, FoldSource source)
    {
        if (range.lastRow <= range.headerRow || range.lastRow >= text.LineCount()) return false;
        std::erase_if(m_folds, [&](const Entry& e) {
            const auto r = Resolve(text, e);
            return r && r->headerRow == range.headerRow;
        });
        m_folds.push_back({ { text.LineEnd(range.headerRow), Bias::Left }, { text.LineEnd(range.lastRow), Bias::Left }, source });
        return true;
    }

    bool FoldModel::Unfold(const Rope& text, std::uint32_t row)
    {
        const std::size_t before = m_folds.size();
        std::erase_if(m_folds, [&](const Entry& e) {
            const auto r = Resolve(text, e);
            return r && (r->headerRow == row || (row > r->headerRow && row <= r->lastRow));
        });
        return m_folds.size() != before;
    }

    bool FoldModel::UnfoldInnermost(const Rope& text, std::uint32_t row)
    {
        // Folds nest by header: the innermost fold at a row is the one with the
        // largest header that still heads or hides it (ties: the smaller region).
        std::optional<std::size_t> best;
        FoldRange bestRange;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_folds.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto r = Resolve(text, m_folds[i]);
            if (!r || row < r->headerRow || row > r->lastRow) continue;
            if (!best || r->headerRow > bestRange.headerRow ||
                (r->headerRow == bestRange.headerRow && r->lastRow < bestRange.lastRow))
            {
                best = i;
                bestRange = *r;
            }
        }
        if (!best) return false;
        m_folds.erase(m_folds.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(*best));
        return true;
    }

    bool FoldModel::IsFoldedAt(const Rope& text, std::uint32_t headerRow) const
    {
        return std::any_of(m_folds.begin(), m_folds.end(), [&](const Entry& e) {
            const auto r = Resolve(text, e);
            return r && r->headerRow == headerRow;
        });
    }

    std::vector<FoldRange> FoldModel::Folded(const Rope& text) const
    {
        std::vector<FoldRange> out;
        out.reserve(m_folds.size());
        for (const Entry& e : m_folds)
            if (const auto r = Resolve(text, e)) out.push_back(*r);
        std::sort(out.begin(), out.end(), [](const FoldRange& a, const FoldRange& b) {
            return a.headerRow != b.headerRow ? a.headerRow < b.headerRow : a.lastRow > b.lastRow;
        });
        out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end(), [](const FoldRange& a, const FoldRange& b) { return a.headerRow == b.headerRow; }),
                  out.end());   // edits can resolve two folds onto one header: keep the larger
        return out;
    }

    void FoldModel::OnEdits(std::span<const EditShift> edits)
    {
        if (edits.empty() || m_folds.empty()) return;
        const EditShiftMap map(edits);
        for (Entry& e : m_folds)
        {
            e.header.offset = map.Map(e.header.offset, e.header.bias);
            e.last.offset = map.Map(e.last.offset, e.last.bias);
        }
    }

    void FoldModel::Prune(const Rope& text)
    {
        std::erase_if(m_folds, [&](const Entry& e) { return !Resolve(text, e).has_value(); });
    }
}
```

### Task TE1-13: `DisplayMap`, the fold layer between buffer rows and display rows (spec s3.6, s11.1)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/DisplayMap.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/DisplayMap.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/DisplayMapTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `FoldRange`, `FoldModel` (TE1-12, in the property test); `Rope` (TE1-2).
- Produces: `class DisplayMap` (binding) with `SetFolds(std::span<const FoldRange>, std::uint32_t bufferRowCount)`, `BufferRowCount()`, `DisplayRowCount()`, `IsHidden(bufferRow)`, `BufferRowToDisplay(bufferRow)` (a hidden row maps to its fold header's display row), `DisplayRowToBuffer(displayRow)` (clamped to the last display row), `VisibleAtOrBefore(bufferRow)`, `FoldAt(headerRow) -> std::optional<FoldRange>`, `struct HiddenRun { first, last; }`, `HiddenRuns()`.

One layer in v1, folds: the union of every fold's hidden rows, kept as merged runs with prefix sums. A row is O(log folds) either way (spec s3.6). Drawing, scrolling, `TextCommands` up/down (TE1-16), vim `j`/`k`/`gj`/`gk`, `H M L` and `scrolloff` all go through it. Soft wrap becomes a second layer behind the same interface (spec s12.3). The owner rebuilds it with `SetFolds(foldModel.Folded(text), text.LineCount())` whenever the buffer version or the fold set changes, which costs O(folds).

```cpp
// DisplayMap (text-editor spec s3.6, s11.1): buffer row <-> display row under
// random folds -- and random fold/unfold/edit sequences through FoldModel --
// equals a brute-force model.

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>

#include "TextEditor/Core/DisplayMap.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    // The model: a hidden flag per row, the visible rows in order.
    void CheckAgainstBruteForce(const DisplayMap& map, std::span<const FoldRange> folds, std::uint32_t rows)
    {
        std::vector<bool> hidden(rows, false);
        for (const FoldRange& f : folds)
            if (f.lastRow > f.headerRow)
                for (std::uint32_t r = f.headerRow + 1; r <= std::min(f.lastRow, rows - 1); ++r) hidden[r] = true;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> visible;
        for (std::uint32_t r = 0; r < rows; ++r)
            if (!hidden[r]) visible.push_back(r);
        RC_ASSERT(map.BufferRowCount() == rows);
        RC_ASSERT(map.DisplayRowCount() == visible.size());
        for (std::uint32_t d = 0; d < visible.size(); ++d) RC_ASSERT(map.DisplayRowToBuffer(d) == visible[d]);
        RC_ASSERT(map.DisplayRowToBuffer(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(visible.size()) + 5) == visible.back());
        for (std::uint32_t r = 0; r < rows; ++r)
        {
            RC_ASSERT(map.IsHidden(r) == hidden[r]);
            const auto at = std::upper_bound(visible.begin(), visible.end(), r) - visible.begin() - 1;
            RC_ASSERT(map.BufferRowToDisplay(r) == static_cast<std::uint32_t>(at));
            RC_ASSERT(map.VisibleAtOrBefore(r) == visible[static_cast<std::size_t>(at)]);
        }
    }
}

TEST_CASE("DisplayMap: hidden rows map to their header; display rows skip them", "[text-display]")
{
    DisplayMap map;
    const std::vector<FoldRange> folds{ { 1, 3 }, { 6, 7 } };   // rows 0..9: hide 2,3 and 7
    map.SetFolds(folds, 10);
    CHECK(map.DisplayRowCount() == 7u);
    CHECK(map.BufferRowToDisplay(2) == 1u);
    CHECK(map.BufferRowToDisplay(4) == 2u);
    CHECK(map.BufferRowToDisplay(8) == 5u);    // visible: 0 1 4 5 6 8 9
    CHECK(map.DisplayRowToBuffer(2) == 4u);
    CHECK(map.DisplayRowToBuffer(5) == 8u);
    CHECK(map.DisplayRowToBuffer(6) == 9u);
    CHECK(map.IsHidden(7));
    CHECK(map.FoldAt(1) == FoldRange{ 1, 3 });
    CHECK_FALSE(map.FoldAt(2).has_value());
    REQUIRE(map.HiddenRuns().size() == 2u);
    DisplayMap none;
    none.SetFolds({}, 0);
    CHECK(none.DisplayRowCount() == 1u);   // an empty buffer still has one row
}

TEST_CASE("DisplayMap: fold/unfold/edit sequences through FoldModel equal the brute-force model", "[text-display]")
{
    rc::prop("FoldModel::Folded after edits -> DisplayMap == brute force", [] {
        std::string text;
        const auto lines = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 30);
        for (int i = 0; i < lines; ++i) text += std::string(static_cast<std::size_t>(*rc::gen::inRange(0, 4)), 'a') + "\n";
        Rope rope = Rope::FromUtf8(text, 8);
        FoldModel folds;
        const int steps = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 25);
        for (int s = 0; s < steps; ++s)
        {
            const int what = *rc::gen::inRange(0, 4);
            const std::uint32_t rows = rope.LineCount();
            if (what == 0)
            {
                const auto h = *rc::gen::inRange<std::uint32_t>(0, rows);
                folds.Fold(rope, { h, *rc::gen::inRange<std::uint32_t>(h, rows) }, FoldSource::Manual);
            }
            else if (what == 1)
            {
                folds.Unfold(rope, *rc::gen::inRange<std::uint32_t>(0, rows));
            }
            else
            {
                const auto b = *rc::gen::inRange<ByteOffset>(0, rope.Size() + 1);
                const auto e = *rc::gen::inRange<ByteOffset>(b, rope.Size() + 1);
                static const char* const inserts[] = { "", "x", "\n", "y\nz\n", "\n\n" };
                const std::string ins = inserts[*rc::gen::inRange(0, 5)];
                const EditShift shift{ b, e, ins.size() };
                rope = rope.Replace({ b, e }, ins);
                folds.OnEdits(std::span(&shift, 1));
            }
            const std::vector<FoldRange> resolved = folds.Folded(rope);
            for (const FoldRange& f : resolved)
            {
                RC_ASSERT(f.headerRow < f.lastRow);
                RC_ASSERT(f.lastRow < rope.LineCount());
            }
            DisplayMap map;
            map.SetFolds(resolved, rope.LineCount());
            CheckAgainstBruteForce(map, resolved, rope.LineCount());
        }
    });
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The display map (spec s3.6): buffer row <-> display row. v1 has one layer,
// folds: the union of the folds' hidden rows as merged runs with prefix sums,
// so either direction is O(log folds). Everything row-visual goes through it
// (drawing, scrolling, up/down, vim j/k/gj/gk, H M L, scrolloff, zj/zk); soft
// wrap becomes a second layer behind this interface (s12.3). Tab expansion
// stays a draw-time computation. Per view (spec s5.1).

#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    class DisplayMap
    {
    public:
        struct HiddenRun
        {
            std::uint32_t first = 0, last = 0;   // inclusive buffer rows
        };

        // Folds may overlap, nest, or run past the end; empty ones are ignored.
        void SetFolds(std::span<const FoldRange> folds, std::uint32_t bufferRowCount);

        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t BufferRowCount() const noexcept { return m_rows; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t DisplayRowCount() const noexcept { return m_rows - m_hiddenTotal; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsHidden(std::uint32_t bufferRow) const noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t BufferRowToDisplay(std::uint32_t bufferRow) const noexcept;   // hidden -> its header's display row
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t DisplayRowToBuffer(std::uint32_t displayRow) const noexcept;  // clamped to the last display row
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t VisibleAtOrBefore(std::uint32_t bufferRow) const noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<FoldRange> FoldAt(std::uint32_t headerRow) const noexcept;    // the run hidden right below headerRow
        [[nodiscard]] std::span<const HiddenRun> HiddenRuns() const noexcept { return m_runs; }

    private:
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t RunsStartingAtOrBefore(std::uint32_t row) const noexcept;

        std::vector<HiddenRun> m_runs;               // sorted, disjoint, non-adjacent
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> m_hiddenBefore;   // [i] = hidden rows in runs [0, i); runs + 1 entries
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> m_displayAfter;   // [i] = display row of the first visible row after run i
        std::uint32_t m_rows = 1;
        std::uint32_t m_hiddenTotal = 0;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/DisplayMap.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/DisplayMap.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    void DisplayMap::SetFolds(std::span<const FoldRange> folds, std::uint32_t bufferRowCount)
    {
        m_rows = std::max(bufferRowCount, 1u);
        m_runs.clear();
        for (const FoldRange& f : folds)
        {
            if (f.lastRow <= f.headerRow || f.headerRow + 1 >= m_rows) continue;
            m_runs.push_back({ f.headerRow + 1, std::min(f.lastRow, m_rows - 1) });
        }
        std::sort(m_runs.begin(), m_runs.end(), [](const HiddenRun& a, const HiddenRun& b) { return a.first < b.first; });
        std::vector<HiddenRun> merged;
        for (const HiddenRun& r : m_runs)
        {
            if (!merged.empty() && r.first <= merged.back().last + 1) merged.back().last = std::max(merged.back().last, r.last);
            else merged.push_back(r);
        }
        m_runs = std::move(merged);
        m_hiddenBefore.assign(m_runs.size() + 1, 0);
        m_displayAfter.assign(m_runs.size(), 0);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_runs.size(); ++i)
        {
            m_hiddenBefore[i + 1] = m_hiddenBefore[i] + (m_runs[i].last - m_runs[i].first + 1);
            m_displayAfter[i] = m_runs[i].first - m_hiddenBefore[i];
        }
        m_hiddenTotal = m_hiddenBefore.back();
    }

    std::size_t DisplayMap::RunsStartingAtOrBefore(std::uint32_t row) const noexcept
    {
        return static_cast<std::size_t>(std::upper_bound(m_runs.begin(), m_runs.end(), row,
                                                         [](std::uint32_t r, const HiddenRun& run) { return r < run.first; })
                                        - m_runs.begin());
    }

    bool DisplayMap::IsHidden(std::uint32_t row) const noexcept
    {
        const std::size_t k = RunsStartingAtOrBefore(row);
        return k > 0 && row <= m_runs[k - 1].last;
    }

    std::uint32_t DisplayMap::VisibleAtOrBefore(std::uint32_t row) const noexcept
    {
        row = std::min(row, m_rows - 1);
        const std::size_t k = RunsStartingAtOrBefore(row);
        if (k > 0 && row <= m_runs[k - 1].last) return m_runs[k - 1].first - 1;   // a run never starts at row 0
        return row;
    }

    std::uint32_t DisplayMap::BufferRowToDisplay(std::uint32_t row) const noexcept
    {
        const std::uint32_t visible = VisibleAtOrBefore(row);
        return visible - m_hiddenBefore[RunsStartingAtOrBefore(visible)];   // runs before a visible row end before it
    }

    std::uint32_t DisplayMap::DisplayRowToBuffer(std::uint32_t displayRow) const noexcept
    {
        displayRow = std::min(displayRow, DisplayRowCount() - 1);
        const auto k = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::upper_bound(m_displayAfter.begin(), m_displayAfter.end(), displayRow)
                                                - m_displayAfter.begin());
        return displayRow + m_hiddenBefore[k];
    }

    std::optional<FoldRange> DisplayMap::FoldAt(std::uint32_t headerRow) const noexcept
    {
        const std::size_t k = RunsStartingAtOrBefore(headerRow + 1);
        if (k > 0 && m_runs[k - 1].first == headerRow + 1) return FoldRange{ headerRow, m_runs[k - 1].last };
        return std::nullopt;
    }
}
```

**Files:**

- Create: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextCase.hpp` (the cursor-marker harness every TextCommands test uses)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextCommandsEditTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `TextBuffer`, `EditOp`, `TransactionKind` (TE1-8/9), `SelectionSet`, `Selection` (TE1-7), `EditShift`, `EditShiftMap` (TE1-5), `PrevGraphemeBoundary`, `NextGraphemeBoundary` (TE1-4).
- Produces:
  - `struct EditContext {}`: the options the commands read. TE1-15/16/17/19 add fields, and `Editor::ApplyEditSettings` fills them.
  - `class TextCommands` with:
    - `TextCommands(TextBuffer&, SelectionSet&, EditContext = {})`, `Buffer()`, `Selections()`, `Context()`, `SetContext(EditContext)`.
    - `struct SelectionEdit { EditOp op; ByteOffset anchor; ByteOffset head; }`: the new ends are RELATIVE to `op.range.begin` in the text after the op. `using PerSelectionEdit = std::function<std::optional<SelectionEdit>(const Selection&)>`.
    - `EditEach(TransactionKind, const PerSelectionEdit&)`: the s2.1 engine. One transaction, `f` called once per selection in order, one batched `Edit`, every selection placed from its own result. A selection whose op would overlap the previous op keeps its place.
    - `EditAndMap(TransactionKind, std::vector<EditOp>, Bias cursorBias, Bias startBias, Bias endBias)`: row-built ops (indent, comment, join); the selections map through the edit with the given biases.
    - `void SetSelections(std::vector<Selection> next, std::size_t primaryIndex)` and `void SetSelections(std::vector<Selection> next)` (CANON A3, NEW; the one-argument form makes the LAST element primary): no text change. A selection with `id == 0` gets `AllocateId()`; the one at `primaryIndex` (clamped to the last) is given the newest id unless its id already exceeds every other, so `Primary()` returns it; then `Selections().Replace(...)` normalizes and merges, and the result is clamped to the text. An empty `next` is ignored. Mouse release (TE2-14), vim's `VimText::Select` (TE5a-2) and `TextDocument::GoTo` (TE2-19) use it.
    - `void ApplyEdits(TransactionKind kind, std::vector<EditOp> ops, std::vector<Selection> after, std::size_t primaryIndex)` (CANON A3, NEW): one transaction -- `BeginTransaction(current, kind)`, `Edit(ops)` when non-empty, selections := `after` (POST-edit offsets, the `SetSelections` id rule), `EndTransaction(after)`. Empty `ops` still assigns `after` and records no undo entry; empty `after` with ops maps the current selections like `EditAndMap(kind, ops, Bias::Left, Bias::Left, Bias::Right)`. Callers that compute their own selections (vim's `VimText::Apply`, TE4-22's `AutoCloser`) use it instead of raw `BeginTransaction/Edit/EndTransaction`, so s2.1 holds.
    - `InsertText(std::string_view)` (kind Typing), `Paste(std::string_view)` (Other), `InsertPerSelection(std::span<const std::string>)` (one text per selection when the counts match, otherwise all of them joined by `'\n'` everywhere), `DeleteSelections()`, `Backspace()` and `DeleteForward()` (by grapheme, kind Deleting), `CopySelections() -> std::vector<std::string>` (an empty selection copies its whole line plus `'\n'`), `Undo()`, `Redo()`, `static NormalizeNewlines(std::string_view)`.
  - Test harness `Arcane::Text::Test::{ParseMarked, FormatMarked, Doc, Case, CheckCases, S}` in `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextCase.hpp`. These names stay TE1's; TE5's vim tables use their own markers through `ParseVimMarked/FormatVimMarked` (CANON B17).
