```cpp
TEST_CASE("save plan: the step a save takes", "[text-io]")
{
    SaveFacts f;
    f.targetExists = false;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::CreateNew);                        // a new file: temp + MoveFileExW

    f.targetExists = true;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::ReplaceAtomic);                    // the ordinary save

    f.readOnlyAttribute = true;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::RefuseReadOnly);                   // D14: refused with the banner
    f.mode = SaveMode::OverwriteInPlace;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::RefuseReadOnly);                   // no mode writes through the attribute...
    f.mode = SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::ClearReadOnlyThenReplace);         // ...except the confirmed removal
    f.readOnlyAttribute = false;
    f.mode = SaveMode::Atomic;

    f.holders.push_back({ 4242, "game.exe", false });
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::AskAboutHolders);                  // a writer would be orphaned
    f.mode = SaveMode::AtomicSkipHolderCheck;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::ReplaceAtomic);                    // "Save anyway"
    f.mode = SaveMode::OverwriteInPlace;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::OverwriteInPlace);                 // "Overwrite in place"
    f.mode = SaveMode::Atomic;
    f.holders.clear();

    f.underFollow = true;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::AskAboutHolders);                  // always for a followed file
    f.underFollow = false;
    f.recentExternalWrite = true;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::AskAboutHolders);                  // ...and one written in the last recentWriteSeconds
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text save's PURE half (text editor spec s5.3): which step a save takes,
// how a ReplaceFileW failure classifies, the `.arctmp~` temp/backup names and
// the self-save fingerprint. No <windows.h>: the Win32 error codes the save
// classifies are spelled here, and TextFileIO.cpp does the I/O.

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace Win32Error
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("Win32 vocabulary: winerror.h codes the text save path classifies")
        inline constexpr std::uint32_t kSuccess = 0, kInvalidFunction = 1, kFileNotFound = 2, kPathNotFound = 3,
                                       kAccessDenied = 5, kSharingViolation = 32, kLockViolation = 33,
                                       kNotSupported = 50, kDiskFull = 112, kUnableToRemoveReplaced = 1175,
                                       kUnableToMoveReplacement = 1176, kUnableToMoveReplacement2 = 1177;
    }

    // One stat of a file. mtime is the raw FILETIME (100 ns ticks) as an integer.
    struct FileStamp
    {
        bool          exists = false;
        std::uint64_t size = 0;
        std::int64_t  mtime = 0;
        std::uint32_t attributes = 0;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] bool SameStamp(const FileStamp& a, const FileStamp& b);

    // A process the Restart Manager says holds the file open.
    struct FileHolder
    {
        std::uint32_t pid = 0;
        std::string   appName;            // UTF-8, as the Restart Manager names it
        bool          thisProcess = false;
    };

    enum class SaveMode : std::uint8_t
    {
        Atomic,                    // the ordinary save: holders checked first
        AtomicSkipHolderCheck,     // "Save anyway": replace, detaching any writer
        OverwriteInPlace,          // truncate + rewrite through a write-shared handle (not atomic)
        RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic,  // the confirmed "Remove read-only and save"
    };

    struct SaveFacts
    {
        bool targetExists = false;
        bool readOnlyAttribute = false;
        bool underFollow = false;            // the document follows the file (TE6 sets it)
        bool recentExternalWrite = false;    // written by someone else within editor.text.recentWriteSeconds
        std::vector<FileHolder> holders;     // the Restart Manager's answer (empty when not asked)
        SaveMode mode = SaveMode::Atomic;
    };

    enum class SaveStep : std::uint8_t
    {
        CreateNew,                 // temp + MoveFileExW(MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)
        ReplaceAtomic,             // temp + ReplaceFileW (MoveFileExW fallback where unsupported)
        OverwriteInPlace,
        ClearReadOnlyThenReplace,
        RefuseReadOnly,            // banner: Save As..., Remove read-only and save (confirmed)
        AskAboutHolders,           // banner: Overwrite in place / Save anyway / Cancel
    };
    [[nodiscard]] SaveStep PlanSave(const SaveFacts& facts);
    // The Restart Manager is asked only when its answer can change the step.
    [[nodiscard]] bool NeedsHolderCheck(bool targetExists, bool readOnlyAttribute, SaveMode mode);

    enum class ReplaceFailure : std::uint8_t
    {
        Unsupported,          // ERROR_INVALID_FUNCTION / ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED: fall back to MoveFileExW
        OriginalIntact,       // _REPLACEMENT (1176) / REMOVE_REPLACED (1175, backup named): delete the temp
        OriginalUnderBackup,  // _REPLACEMENT_2 (1177): move the backup back first
        SharingViolation,
        AccessDenied,
        Other,
    };
    [[nodiscard]] ReplaceFailure ClassifyReplaceFailure(std::uint32_t win32Error);

    // `<target>.arctmp~<pid>-<serial>`, beside the target (same volume, so
    // ReplaceFileW and MoveFileExW never copy across volumes).
    [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path TransientSavePath(const std::filesystem::path& target,
                                                          std::uint32_t pid, std::uint32_t serial);
    [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path TransientBackupPath(const std::filesystem::path& temp);   // temp + ".bak"
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t NextTransientSerial();   // process-wide, thread-safe, starts at 1

    // What a save wrote (spec s5.3 self-save suppression).
    struct FileFingerprint
    {
        std::uint64_t size = 0;
        std::int64_t  mtime = 0;
        std::uint64_t hash = 0;
        bool          valid = false;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t HashBytes(std::string_view bytes);   // FNV-1a 64
    [[nodiscard]] FileFingerprint FingerprintOf(std::string_view bytes, std::int64_t mtime);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Project/TransientFiles.hpp>

#include <atomic>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    bool SameStamp(const FileStamp& a, const FileStamp& b)
    {
        if (a.exists != b.exists) return false;
        if (!a.exists) return true;
        return a.size == b.size && a.mtime == b.mtime;
    }

    SaveStep PlanSave(const SaveFacts& f)
    {
        if (!f.targetExists)
            return SaveStep::CreateNew;
        if (f.readOnlyAttribute)
            return f.mode == SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic ? SaveStep::ClearReadOnlyThenReplace
                                                                : SaveStep::RefuseReadOnly;
        if (f.mode == SaveMode::OverwriteInPlace)
            return SaveStep::OverwriteInPlace;
        if (f.mode == SaveMode::Atomic && (!f.holders.empty() || f.underFollow || f.recentExternalWrite))
            return SaveStep::AskAboutHolders;
        return SaveStep::ReplaceAtomic;
    }

    bool NeedsHolderCheck(bool targetExists, bool readOnlyAttribute, SaveMode mode)
    {
        return targetExists && !readOnlyAttribute && mode == SaveMode::Atomic;
    }

    ReplaceFailure ClassifyReplaceFailure(std::uint32_t e)
    {
        using namespace Win32Error;
        if (e == kInvalidFunction || e == kNotSupported)               return ReplaceFailure::Unsupported;
        if (e == kUnableToMoveReplacement || e == kUnableToRemoveReplaced) return ReplaceFailure::OriginalIntact;
        if (e == kUnableToMoveReplacement2)                            return ReplaceFailure::OriginalUnderBackup;
        if (e == kSharingViolation || e == kLockViolation)            return ReplaceFailure::SharingViolation;
        if (e == kAccessDenied)                                        return ReplaceFailure::AccessDenied;
        return ReplaceFailure::Other;
    }

    std::filesystem::path TransientSavePath(const std::filesystem::path& target, std::uint32_t pid, std::uint32_t serial)
    {
        std::filesystem::path p = target;
        p += std::string(Arcane::kTransientSaveMarker) + std::to_string(pid) + "-" + std::to_string(serial);
        return p;
    }

    std::filesystem::path TransientBackupPath(const std::filesystem::path& temp)
    {
        std::filesystem::path p = temp;
        p += ".bak";
        return p;
    }

    std::uint32_t NextTransientSerial()
    {
        static std::atomic<std::uint32_t> serial{ 0 };
        return serial.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) + 1;
    }

    std::uint64_t HashBytes(std::string_view bytes)
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("algorithm: FNV-1a 64-bit offset basis and prime")
        constexpr std::uint64_t kBasis = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull, kPrime = 0x100000001b3ull;
        std::uint64_t h = kBasis;
        for (const char c : bytes)
        {
            h ^= static_cast<std::uint8_t>(c);
            h *= kPrime;
        }
        return h;
    }

    FileFingerprint FingerprintOf(std::string_view bytes, std::int64_t mtime)
    {
        return FileFingerprint{ bytes.size(), mtime, HashBytes(bytes), true };
    }
}
```

```cpp
TEST_CASE("disk change: the append window is the 4 KB before the old end", "[text-io]")

TEST_CASE("disk change: classification", "[text-io]")

    const SyncedFileState s = Synced(10, 100, "0123456789");
    CHECK(ClassifyDiskChange(s, FileStamp{ true, 10, 100, 0 }, std::nullopt) == DiskChange::None);
    CHECK(ClassifyDiskChange(s, FileStamp{ false, 0, 0, 0 }, std::nullopt) == DiskChange::Deleted);
    CHECK(ClassifyDiskChange(s, FileStamp{ true, 4, 101, 0 }, std::nullopt) == DiskChange::Truncated);
    CHECK(ClassifyDiskChange(s, FileStamp{ true, 20, 101, 0 }, HashBytes("0123456789")) == DiskChange::Appended);
    CHECK(ClassifyDiskChange(s, FileStamp{ true, 20, 101, 0 }, HashBytes("XXXXXXXXXX")) == DiskChange::Rewritten);  // rotation
    CHECK(ClassifyDiskChange(s, FileStamp{ true, 20, 101, 0 }, std::nullopt) == DiskChange::Rewritten);             // window unreadable
    CHECK(ClassifyDiskChange(s, FileStamp{ true, 10, 105, 0 }, std::nullopt) == DiskChange::Rewritten);             // same size, new bytes

    SyncedFileState gone = s;
    gone.stamp = FileStamp{};
    CHECK(ClassifyDiskChange(gone, FileStamp{ false, 0, 0, 0 }, std::nullopt) == DiskChange::None);
    CHECK(ClassifyDiskChange(gone, FileStamp{ true, 3, 9, 0 }, std::nullopt) == DiskChange::Recreated);

    SyncedFileState saved = s;
    saved.selfSave = FileFingerprint{ 12, 200, 77, true };
    CHECK(ClassifyDiskChange(saved, FileStamp{ true, 12, 200, 0 }, std::nullopt) == DiskChange::SelfSave);

    SyncedFileState empty = Synced(0, 1, "");
    CHECK(ClassifyDiskChange(empty, FileStamp{ true, 5, 2, 0 }, HashBytes("")) == DiskChange::Appended);       // an empty log grows
}

TEST_CASE("disk change: append only when clean or read-only; everything else by the dirty rule", "[text-io]")
{
    CHECK(DecideDiskAction(DiskChange::None, false, false, false) == DiskAction::Ignore);
    CHECK(DecideDiskAction(DiskChange::SelfSave, true, false, false) == DiskAction::AcceptSelfSave);
    CHECK(DecideDiskAction(DiskChange::Appended, false, false, false) == DiskAction::AppendTail);
    CHECK(DecideDiskAction(DiskChange::Appended, false, true, false) == DiskAction::AppendTail);
    CHECK(DecideDiskAction(DiskChange::Appended, true, false, false) == DiskAction::DirtyBanner);   // dirty + growing = banner
    CHECK(DecideDiskAction(DiskChange::Appended, false, false, true) == DiskAction::SilentReload);  // tail completes a CRLF
    CHECK(DecideDiskAction(DiskChange::Appended, true, false, true) == DiskAction::DirtyBanner);
    CHECK(DecideDiskAction(DiskChange::Truncated, false, false, false) == DiskAction::SilentReload);
    CHECK(DecideDiskAction(DiskChange::Rewritten, true, false, false) == DiskAction::DirtyBanner);
    CHECK(DecideDiskAction(DiskChange::Recreated, false, false, false) == DiskAction::SilentReload);
    CHECK(DecideDiskAction(DiskChange::Deleted, false, false, false) == DiskAction::DeletedBanner);
    CHECK(DecideDiskAction(DiskChange::Deleted, true, false, false) == DiskAction::DeletedBanner);
}

TEST_CASE("disk change: a writer mid-character leaves the incomplete tail for the next poll", "[text-io]")
{
    CHECK(CompleteTailLength("abc", TextEncoding::Utf8) == 3u);
    CHECK(CompleteTailLength("ab\xC3", TextEncoding::Utf8) == 2u);              // lead of a 2-byte sequence, cut
    CHECK(CompleteTailLength("ab\xE2\x82", TextEncoding::Utf8) == 2u);          // 3-byte sequence, cut after 2
    CHECK(CompleteTailLength("ab\xE2\x82\xAC", TextEncoding::Utf8) == 5u);      // complete euro sign
    CHECK(CompleteTailLength("ab\x80", TextEncoding::Utf8) == 3u);              // a stray continuation is an invalid byte: complete
    CHECK(CompleteTailLength(std::string("a\0b", 3), TextEncoding::Utf16LE) == 2u);                   // odd byte held back
    CHECK(CompleteTailLength(std::string("\x3D\xD8", 2), TextEncoding::Utf16LE) == 0u);               // a lone high surrogate
    CHECK(CompleteTailLength(std::string("\xD8\x3D", 2), TextEncoding::Utf16BE) == 0u);
    CHECK(CompleteTailLength("\xE9\xE9", TextEncoding::Windows1252) == 2u);
    CHECK(CompleteTailLength("ab\xC3", TextEncoding::Utf8Bom) == 2u);           // Utf8Bom behaves as Utf8
    CHECK(CompleteTailLength("ab\xE2\x82\xAC", TextEncoding::Utf8Bom) == 5u);
}

TEST_CASE("disk change: a tail that turns a lone CR into CRLF reloads instead of appending", "[text-io]")
{
    CHECK(LastUnitOf("ab\r", TextEncoding::Utf8) == u'\r');
    CHECK(LastUnitOf(std::string("a\0\r\0", 4), TextEncoding::Utf16LE) == u'\r');
    CHECK(LastUnitOf(std::string("\0a\0\r", 4), TextEncoding::Utf16BE) == u'\r');
    CHECK(LastUnitOf("", TextEncoding::Utf8) == 0u);
    CHECK(TailSplitsCrLf(u'\r', "\nmore", TextEncoding::Utf8));
    CHECK_FALSE(TailSplitsCrLf(u'\n', "\nmore", TextEncoding::Utf8));
    CHECK_FALSE(TailSplitsCrLf(u'\r', "more", TextEncoding::Utf8));
    CHECK(TailSplitsCrLf(u'\r', std::string("\n\0", 2), TextEncoding::Utf16LE));
    CHECK(TailSplitsCrLf(u'\r', std::string("\0\n", 2), TextEncoding::Utf16BE));
    CHECK(TailSplitsCrLf(u'\r', "\n", TextEncoding::Windows1252));
    CHECK(LastUnitOf("ab\r", TextEncoding::Utf8Bom) == u'\r');                  // Utf8Bom behaves as Utf8
    CHECK(TailSplitsCrLf(u'\r', "\nmore", TextEncoding::Utf8Bom));
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// External-change classification (text editor spec s3.5, s5.3): what a fresh
// stat of an open text file means against what the document last synced, and
// what the document does about it. Pure; TextDocument::PollDisk feeds it.

#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    ARC_CONSTANT("spec s3.5: append detection hashes the 4 KB window just before the old end of the file")
    inline constexpr std::uint64_t kAppendWindowBytes = 4096;

    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t AppendWindowStart(std::uint64_t oldSize);

    // What the document knows about the bytes it holds.
    struct SyncedFileState
    {
        FileStamp       stamp;              // the stat the buffer equals
        std::uint64_t   windowHash = 0;     // HashBytes of [AppendWindowStart(size), size)
        std::uint16_t   lastUnit = 0;       // the file's last code unit (byte, or UTF-16 unit); 0 = empty
        FileFingerprint selfSave;           // what our last save wrote (spec s5.3 self-save suppression)
    };

    enum class DiskChange : std::uint8_t { None, SelfSave, Appended, Truncated, Rewritten, Deleted, Recreated };

    // `windowHashNow`: HashBytes of the file's bytes at [AppendWindowStart(synced
    // size), synced size) read NOW -- only meaningful when the file grew; nullopt
    // when it was not (or could not be) read, which classifies as Rewritten.
    [[nodiscard]] DiskChange ClassifyDiskChange(const SyncedFileState& synced, const FileStamp& now,
                                                std::optional<std::uint64_t> windowHashNow);

    enum class DiskAction : std::uint8_t { Ignore, AcceptSelfSave, AppendTail, SilentReload, DirtyBanner, DeletedBanner };
    // Append only when the document is clean or read-only (spec s3.5); a tail
    // that would turn the last lone CR into CRLF reloads instead.
    [[nodiscard]] DiskAction DecideDiskAction(DiskChange change, bool dirty, bool readOnly, bool tailSplitsCrLf);

    // The longest prefix of an appended tail that holds only whole characters.
    // Utf8Bom behaves as Utf8 in all three (the BOM sits at offset 0, never in a tail).
    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t CompleteTailLength(std::string_view tail, Text::TextEncoding encoding);
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint16_t LastUnitOf(std::string_view bytes, Text::TextEncoding encoding);
    [[nodiscard]] bool TailSplitsCrLf(std::uint16_t lastUnit, std::string_view tail, Text::TextEncoding encoding);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextChangeClassifier.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextChangeClassifier.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        bool IsUtf16(Text::TextEncoding e) { return e == Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE || e == Text::TextEncoding::Utf16BE; }

        std::uint16_t Unit16(std::string_view bytes, std::size_t at, Text::TextEncoding e)
        {
            const auto b0 = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(bytes[at]);
            const auto b1 = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(bytes[at + 1]);
            return e == Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE ? static_cast<std::uint16_t>(b0 | (b1 << 8))
                                                : static_cast<std::uint16_t>((b0 << 8) | b1);
        }

        // Expected length of a UTF-8 sequence from its lead byte; 0 = not a lead.
        std::size_t Utf8SequenceLength(std::uint8_t lead)
        {
            if (lead < 0x80) return 1;
            if ((lead & 0xE0) == 0xC0) return 2;
            if ((lead & 0xF0) == 0xE0) return 3;
            if ((lead & 0xF8) == 0xF0) return 4;
            return 0;
        }
    }

    std::uint64_t AppendWindowStart(std::uint64_t oldSize)
    {
        return oldSize > kAppendWindowBytes ? oldSize - kAppendWindowBytes : 0;
    }

    DiskChange ClassifyDiskChange(const SyncedFileState& synced, const FileStamp& now,
                                  std::optional<std::uint64_t> windowHashNow)
    {
        if (!now.exists)
            return synced.stamp.exists ? DiskChange::Deleted : DiskChange::None;
        if (!synced.stamp.exists)
            return DiskChange::Recreated;
        if (now.size == synced.stamp.size && now.mtime == synced.stamp.mtime)
            return DiskChange::None;
        if (synced.selfSave.valid && now.size == synced.selfSave.size && now.mtime == synced.selfSave.mtime)
            return DiskChange::SelfSave;
        if (now.size < synced.stamp.size)
            return DiskChange::Truncated;
        if (now.size > synced.stamp.size && windowHashNow && *windowHashNow == synced.windowHash)
            return DiskChange::Appended;
        return DiskChange::Rewritten;
    }

    DiskAction DecideDiskAction(DiskChange change, bool dirty, bool readOnly, bool tailSplitsCrLf)
    {
        const bool mayReplaceText = !dirty || readOnly;
        switch (change)
        {
        case DiskChange::None:      return DiskAction::Ignore;
        case DiskChange::SelfSave:  return DiskAction::AcceptSelfSave;
        case DiskChange::Deleted:   return DiskAction::DeletedBanner;
        case DiskChange::Appended:
            if (!mayReplaceText) return DiskAction::DirtyBanner;
            return tailSplitsCrLf ? DiskAction::SilentReload : DiskAction::AppendTail;
        case DiskChange::Truncated:
        case DiskChange::Rewritten:
        case DiskChange::Recreated:
            return mayReplaceText ? DiskAction::SilentReload : DiskAction::DirtyBanner;
        }
        return DiskAction::Ignore;
    }

    std::size_t CompleteTailLength(std::string_view tail, Text::TextEncoding encoding)
    {
        if (encoding == Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252)
            return tail.size();
        if (IsUtf16(encoding))
        {
            std::size_t n = tail.size() & ~std::size_t{ 1 };
            if (n >= 2)
            {
                const std::uint16_t last = Unit16(tail, n - 2, encoding);
                if (last >= 0xD800 && last <= 0xDBFF)
                    n -= 2;   // a high surrogate waits for its low half
            }
            return n;
        }
        // UTF-8: find the last lead byte within 3 bytes of the end; if its
        // sequence runs past the end, the tail stops before it.
        const std::size_t size = tail.size();
        for (std::size_t back = 1; back <= 4 && back <= size; ++back)
        {
            const auto b = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(tail[size - back]);
            if ((b & 0xC0) == 0x80)
                continue;   // a continuation byte: keep looking for its lead
            const std::size_t len = Utf8SequenceLength(b);
            if (len == 0 || len <= back)
                return size;          // ASCII, an invalid lead, or a complete sequence
            return size - back;       // the sequence is cut: hold it back
        }
        return size;                  // only continuation bytes: invalid bytes, each its own cluster
    }

    std::uint16_t LastUnitOf(std::string_view bytes, Text::TextEncoding encoding)
    {
        if (IsUtf16(encoding))
            return bytes.size() >= 2 ? Unit16(bytes, (bytes.size() & ~std::size_t{ 1 }) - 2, encoding) : 0;
        return bytes.empty() ? 0 : static_cast<std::uint8_t>(bytes.back());
    }

    bool TailSplitsCrLf(std::uint16_t lastUnit, std::string_view tail, Text::TextEncoding encoding)
    {
        if (lastUnit != u'\r')
            return false;
        if (IsUtf16(encoding))
            return tail.size() >= 2 && Unit16(tail, 0, encoding) == u'\n';
        return !tail.empty() && tail.front() == '\n';
    }
}
```

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-5 (spec s5.3): reads share READ|WRITE|DELETE so a running
// writer keeps writing; the canonical path collapses case, 8.3 names and
// junctions into one document key.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cwctype>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }
}

TEST_CASE("text file io: a file another handle holds open for writing still reads", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-read-shared");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "game.log";
    WriteAll(p, "line 1\nline 2\n");
    HANDLE writer = ::CreateFileW(p.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, nullptr,
                                  OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(writer != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE);

    // A reader that does not share WRITE is refused while the writer holds the file...
    HANDLE plain = ::CreateFileW(p.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    const DWORD plainError = ::GetLastError();
    CHECK(plain == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE);
    CHECK(plainError == ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION);
    if (plain != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) ::CloseHandle(plain);

    // ...the text editor's read shares READ|WRITE|DELETE and gets the bytes.
    const ReadOutcome r = ReadFileShared(p, 1024);
    CHECK(r.ok);
    CHECK(r.bytes == "line 1\nline 2\n");
    CHECK(r.stamp.exists);
    CHECK(r.stamp.size == 14u);

    // The writer keeps writing; a range read sees the new tail.
    DWORD wrote = 0;
    ::SetFilePointer(writer, 0, nullptr, FILE_END);
    REQUIRE(::WriteFile(writer, "line 3\n", 7, &wrote, nullptr));
    const auto tail = ReadRangeShared(p, 14, 7);
    REQUIRE(tail.has_value());
    CHECK(*tail == "line 3\n");
    CHECK(StatFile(p).size == 21u);
    ::CloseHandle(writer);
}

TEST_CASE("text file io: the size limit, a missing file and the stat", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-read-limits");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "notes.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "0123456789");
    const ReadOutcome big = ReadFileShared(p, 4);
    CHECK_FALSE(big.ok);
    CHECK(big.tooLarge);
    CHECK(big.bytes.empty());
    CHECK(big.stamp.size == 10u);                      // the stat is still reported

    const ReadOutcome missing = ReadFileShared(s.dir / "gone.txt", 1024);
    CHECK_FALSE(missing.ok);
    CHECK(missing.win32Error == ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND);
    CHECK_FALSE(StatFile(s.dir / "gone.txt").exists);

    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY));
    const FileStamp st = StatFile(p);
    CHECK(st.exists);
    CHECK(st.size == 10u);
    CHECK((st.attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0);
    CHECK(st.mtime != 0);
    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL));
    CHECK(FileIndexOf(p) != 0u);
}

TEST_CASE("text file io: the canonical path resolves case, 8.3 names and junctions to one key", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-canonical");
    const std::filesystem::path dir = s.dir / "Some Folder With Spaces";
    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
    const std::filesystem::path p = dir / "ReadMe.Notes.md";
    WriteAll(p, "x");

    const auto canon = CanonicalFilePath(p);
    REQUIRE(canon.has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(canon->wstring().starts_with(L"\\\\?\\"));   // the \\?\ prefix is stripped

    std::wstring upper = p.wstring();
    std::transform(upper.begin(), upper.end(), upper.begin(), [](wchar_t c) { return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towupper(c)); });
    CHECK(CanonicalFilePath(upper) == canon);                 // case

    std::wstring shortName(32768, L'\0');
    const DWORD n = ::GetShortPathNameW(p.c_str(), shortName.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(shortName.size()));
    shortName.resize(n);
    if (n == 0 || std::filesystem::path(shortName) == p)
        WARN("8.3 names are disabled on this volume -- the short-name leg did not run");
    else
        CHECK(CanonicalFilePath(shortName) == canon);         // 8.3

    const std::filesystem::path link = s.dir / "jn";
    const std::wstring cmd = L"cmd /c mklink /J \"" + link.wstring() + L"\" \"" + dir.wstring() + L"\" >nul 2>&1";
    if (_wsystem(cmd.c_str()) == 0)
    {
        CHECK(CanonicalFilePath(link / "ReadMe.Notes.md") == canon);   // junction
        ::RemoveDirectoryW(link.c_str());                             // the junction only, never its target
    }
    else
        WARN("mklink /J failed -- the junction leg did not run");

    CHECK_FALSE(CanonicalFilePath(dir / "missing.md").has_value());
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// TextFileIO (text editor spec s5.3): the Windows file layer under
// TextDocument. Reads open with FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE |
// FILE_SHARE_DELETE, so a running game (or the editor's own logger) keeps
// writing, rotating or deleting the file being viewed. Identity is the
// canonical path from GetFinalPathNameByHandleW (case, 8.3 names, junctions
// and symlinks resolved). Saves (TE2-6) and holder checks (TE2-7) live here too.

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <optional>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct ReadOutcome
    {
        bool          ok = false;
        bool          tooLarge = false;   // above maxBytes: nothing read (the stamp is still filled)
        std::uint32_t win32Error = 0;
        std::string   bytes;
        FileStamp     stamp;              // on success stamp.size == bytes.size()
    };

    [[nodiscard]] ReadOutcome ReadFileShared(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::uint64_t maxBytes);
    // [offset, offset + length), shorter when the file is shorter; nullopt when it cannot be opened.
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::string> ReadRangeShared(const std::filesystem::path& path,
                                                             std::uint64_t offset, std::uint64_t length);
    [[nodiscard]] FileStamp StatFile(const std::filesystem::path& path);
    // GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(FILE_NAME_NORMALIZED | VOLUME_NAME_DOS) with the
    // \\?\ (and \\?\UNC\) prefix stripped; nullopt when the file cannot be opened.
    // Known limit (spec s5.3): two hard links to one file stay two keys.
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::filesystem::path> CanonicalFilePath(const std::filesystem::path& path);
    // nFileIndexHigh:Low, 0 when unreadable (ReplaceFileW changes it; overwrite in place does not).
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t FileIndexOf(const std::filesystem::path& path);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        // Every text-editor open shares all three ways (spec s5.3).
        constexpr DWORD kShareAll = FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE;

        struct Handle
        {
            HANDLE h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
            explicit Handle(HANDLE v) : h(v) {}
            ~Handle() { if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) ::CloseHandle(h); }
            Handle(const Handle&) = delete;
            Handle& operator=(const Handle&) = delete;
            [[nodiscard]] bool Valid() const { return h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE; }
        };

        std::int64_t ToInt64(const FILETIME& ft)
        {
            return static_cast<std::int64_t>((static_cast<std::uint64_t>(ft.dwHighDateTime) << 32) | ft.dwLowDateTime);
        }

        std::uint64_t ToUInt64(DWORD high, DWORD low)
        {
            return (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(high) << 32) | low;
        }

        // Reads up to `length` bytes from the handle's position; a file that
        // shrank mid-read returns what was there.
        bool ReadUpTo(HANDLE h, std::uint64_t length, std::string& out)
        {
            out.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(length));
            std::uint64_t done = 0;
            while (done < length)
            {
                const DWORD chunk = static_cast<DWORD>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(length - done, std::uint64_t{ 1 } << 30));
                DWORD got = 0;
                if (!::ReadFile(h, out.data() + done, chunk, &got, nullptr))
                    return false;
                if (got == 0)
                    break;
                done += got;
            }
            out.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(done));
            return true;
        }
    }

    ReadOutcome ReadFileShared(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::uint64_t maxBytes)
    {
        ReadOutcome r;
        const Handle h(::CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
                                     FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL | FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN, nullptr));
        if (!h.Valid())
        {
            r.win32Error = ::GetLastError();
            return r;
        }
        BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION info{};
        if (!::GetFileInformationByHandle(h.h, &info))
        {
            r.win32Error = ::GetLastError();
            return r;
        }
        const std::uint64_t size = ToUInt64(info.nFileSizeHigh, info.nFileSizeLow);
        r.stamp = FileStamp{ true, size, ToInt64(info.ftLastWriteTime), info.dwFileAttributes };
        if (size > maxBytes)
        {
            r.tooLarge = true;
            return r;
        }
        if (!ReadUpTo(h.h, size, r.bytes))
        {
            r.win32Error = ::GetLastError();
            r.bytes.clear();
            return r;
        }
        r.stamp.size = r.bytes.size();
        r.ok = true;
        return r;
    }

    std::optional<std::string> ReadRangeShared(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::uint64_t offset, std::uint64_t length)
    {
        const Handle h(::CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
        if (!h.Valid())
            return std::nullopt;
        LARGE_INTEGER at{};
        at.QuadPart = static_cast<LONGLONG>(offset);
        if (!::SetFilePointerEx(h.h, at, nullptr, FILE_BEGIN))
            return std::nullopt;
        std::string out;
        if (!ReadUpTo(h.h, length, out))
            return std::nullopt;
        return out;
    }

    FileStamp StatFile(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA data{};
        if (!::GetFileAttributesExW(path.c_str(), GetFileExInfoStandard, &data))
            return FileStamp{};
        return FileStamp{ true, ToUInt64(data.nFileSizeHigh, data.nFileSizeLow), ToInt64(data.ftLastWriteTime),
                          data.dwFileAttributes };
    }

    std::optional<std::filesystem::path> CanonicalFilePath(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        const Handle h(::CreateFileW(path.c_str(), FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
                                     FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, nullptr));
        if (!h.Valid())
            return std::nullopt;
        std::wstring buf(MAX_PATH, L'\0');
        DWORD n = ::GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(h.h, buf.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(buf.size()),
                                              FILE_NAME_NORMALIZED | VOLUME_NAME_DOS);
        if (n == 0)
            return std::nullopt;
        if (n >= buf.size())   // too small: n is the size needed, terminator included
        {
            buf.assign(n, L'\0');
            n = ::GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(h.h, buf.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(buf.size()),
                                            FILE_NAME_NORMALIZED | VOLUME_NAME_DOS);
            if (n == 0 || n >= buf.size())
                return std::nullopt;
        }
        buf.resize(n);
        constexpr std::wstring_view kUncPrefix = L"\\\\?\\UNC\\";
        constexpr std::wstring_view kLocalPrefix = L"\\\\?\\";
        if (std::wstring_view(buf).starts_with(kUncPrefix))
            return std::filesystem::path(L"\\\\" + buf.substr(kUncPrefix.size()));
        if (std::wstring_view(buf).starts_with(kLocalPrefix))
            return std::filesystem::path(buf.substr(kLocalPrefix.size()));
        return std::filesystem::path(buf);
    }

    std::uint64_t FileIndexOf(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        const Handle h(::CreateFileW(path.c_str(), FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
                                     FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, nullptr));
        BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION info{};
        if (!h.Valid() || !::GetFileInformationByHandle(h.h, &info))
            return 0;
        return ToUInt64(info.nFileIndexHigh, info.nFileIndexLow);
    }
}
```

**Files:**

- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextFileSaveTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `PlanSave`, `NeedsHolderCheck`, `ClassifyReplaceFailure`, `TransientSavePath`, `TransientBackupPath`, `NextTransientSerial`, `FingerprintOf`, `Win32Error` (TE2-3); `StatFile`, `FileIndexOf` (TE2-5).
- Produces: `struct SaveFileOps { std::uint32_t (*replaceFile)(const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*); std::uint32_t (*moveFile)(const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*, std::uint32_t); std::vector<FileHolder> (*listHolders)(const std::filesystem::path&); }`; `const SaveFileOps& RealSaveFileOps()`; `namespace MoveFlags { kReplaceExisting, kWriteThrough }`; `enum class SaveStatus : std::uint8_t { Saved, SavedWithoutAclPreservation, ReadOnlyAttribute, AccessDenied, SharingViolation, HoldersPresent, RecoveredOriginalIntact, RecoveredFromBackup, RecoveryFailed, WriteFailed }`; `constexpr bool SavedOk(SaveStatus)`; `struct SaveRequest { std::filesystem::path target; std::string_view bytes; SaveMode mode; bool underFollow; bool recentExternalWrite; std::uint32_t pid; }`; `struct SaveOutcome { SaveStatus status; std::uint32_t win32Error; std::vector<FileHolder> holders; bool overwriteInPlaceAvailable; std::filesystem::path tempPath, backupPath; FileFingerprint written; }`; `SaveOutcome SaveFileBytes(const SaveRequest&, const SaveFileOps& = RealSaveFileOps())`; `bool ProbeWriteShared(const std::filesystem::path&)`.

`ReplaceFileW` gets an explicit backup name (`<temp>.bak`) so `ERROR_UNABLE_TO_MOVE_REPLACEMENT_2` leaves the original at a known name the save moves back. `ReplaceFileW` may report a target held without delete sharing as `ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION`, `ERROR_UNABLE_TO_REMOVE_REPLACED` or `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED`; on the last two the save probes the target with a `DELETE` open and reports a sharing violation when that open fails with one, so the in-use banner appears whichever code the volume returns (TE2-7 records the code a real holder produces).

```cpp
// replaces through ReplaceFileW; creates through MoveFileExW; falls back where

    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            Clear();
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir() { Clear(); }
        void Clear()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            if (std::filesystem::exists(dir, ec))
                for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator(dir, ec))
                    ::SetFileAttributesW(e.path().c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL);
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }

    std::string ReadAll(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::ifstream in(p, std::ios::binary);
        return std::string(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    }

    int TransientFilesIn(const std::filesystem::path& dir)
    {
        int n = 0;
        for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(dir))
            if (Arcane::IsTransientSaveFile(e.path())) ++n;
        return n;
    }

    bool OnNtfs(const std::filesystem::path& dir)
    {
        wchar_t root[MAX_PATH] = {};
        wchar_t fs[MAX_PATH] = {};
        return ::GetVolumePathNameW(dir.c_str(), root, MAX_PATH)
            && ::GetVolumeInformationW(root, nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, fs, MAX_PATH)
            && std::wstring_view(fs) == L"NTFS";
    }

    // ---- injected partial failures ---------------------------------------
    std::uint32_t g_replaceError = 0;
    bool g_renameToBackup = false;      // simulate _2: the original now sits under the backup name
    bool g_failBackupRestore = false;   // the move back fails too

    std::uint32_t FakeReplace(const wchar_t* replaced, const wchar_t* /*replacement*/, const wchar_t* backup)
    {
        if (g_renameToBackup)
            ::MoveFileExW(replaced, backup, 0);
        return g_replaceError;
    }

    std::uint32_t FakeMove(const wchar_t* from, const wchar_t* to, std::uint32_t flags)
    {
        if (g_failBackupRestore && std::wstring_view(from).ends_with(L".bak"))
            return ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED;
        return ::MoveFileExW(from, to, flags) ? 0u : ::GetLastError();
    }

    SaveFileOps FakeOps(std::uint32_t replaceError, bool renameToBackup = false, bool failBackupRestore = false)
    {
        g_replaceError = replaceError;
        g_renameToBackup = renameToBackup;
        g_failBackupRestore = failBackupRestore;
        SaveFileOps o;
        o.replaceFile = &FakeReplace;
        o.moveFile = &FakeMove;
        return o;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("text save: a new file is created through the temp; an existing one is replaced", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-save-basic");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "notes.md";

    const SaveOutcome created = SaveFileBytes({ p, "first\n" });
    CHECK(created.status == SaveStatus::Saved);
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "first\n");
    CHECK(TransientFilesIn(s.dir) == 0);
    CHECK(created.written.valid);
    CHECK(created.written.size == 6u);
    CHECK(created.written.hash == HashBytes("first\n"));
    CHECK(created.written.mtime == StatFile(p).mtime);

    const std::uint64_t indexBefore = FileIndexOf(p);
    const SaveOutcome replaced = SaveFileBytes({ p, "second\n" });
    CHECK(replaced.status == SaveStatus::Saved);
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "second\n");
    CHECK(TransientFilesIn(s.dir) == 0);                  // temp moved in, backup deleted
    CHECK(FileIndexOf(p) != indexBefore);                 // ReplaceFileW: a new file object (spec s5.3)
}
```

```cpp
    // ---- saving (spec s5.3) --------------------------------------------------

    // The Win32 calls a test must be able to fail on purpose. Each returns 0 on
    // success, else the GetLastError() value.
    struct SaveFileOps
    {
        std::uint32_t (*replaceFile)(const wchar_t* replaced, const wchar_t* replacement, const wchar_t* backup) = nullptr;
        std::uint32_t (*moveFile)(const wchar_t* from, const wchar_t* to, std::uint32_t flags) = nullptr;
        std::vector<FileHolder> (*listHolders)(const std::filesystem::path& file) = nullptr;   // null = never asked
    };
    [[nodiscard]] const SaveFileOps& RealSaveFileOps();

    namespace MoveFlags
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("Win32 vocabulary: MoveFileExW flags (winbase.h), spelled for the SaveFileOps seam")
        inline constexpr std::uint32_t kReplaceExisting = 0x1, kWriteThrough = 0x8;
    }

    enum class SaveStatus : std::uint8_t
    {
        Saved,
        SavedWithoutAclPreservation,  // ReplaceFileW unsupported here: MoveFileExW replaced it (noted once)
        ReadOnlyAttribute,            // refused (D14 banner)
        AccessDenied,                 // ACL: the same banner without the remove option
        SharingViolation,             // held without delete sharing: Retry / Save As / Overwrite in place
        HoldersPresent,               // writers would be orphaned: Overwrite in place / Save anyway / Cancel
        RecoveredOriginalIntact,      // _REPLACEMENT (or REMOVE_REPLACED): temp deleted, original untouched
        RecoveredFromBackup,          // _2: the backup was moved back to the original name
        RecoveryFailed,               // _2 and the move back failed: tempPath + backupPath both survive
        WriteFailed,                  // the temp could not be written (disk full, ...) or another failure
    };
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool SavedOk(SaveStatus s) noexcept
    {
        return s == SaveStatus::Saved || s == SaveStatus::SavedWithoutAclPreservation;
    }

    struct SaveRequest
    {
        std::filesystem::path target;
        std::string_view      bytes;
        SaveMode              mode = SaveMode::Atomic;
        bool                  underFollow = false;
        bool                  recentExternalWrite = false;
        std::uint32_t         pid = 0;   // the temp name's pid; 0 = this process
    };

    struct SaveOutcome
    {
        SaveStatus              status = SaveStatus::WriteFailed;
        std::uint32_t           win32Error = 0;
        std::vector<FileHolder> holders;                     // HoldersPresent
        bool                    overwriteInPlaceAvailable = false;
        std::filesystem::path   tempPath, backupPath;        // named for RecoveryFailed
        FileFingerprint         written;                     // valid when SavedOk
    };

    [[nodiscard]] SaveOutcome SaveFileBytes(const SaveRequest& request, const SaveFileOps& ops = RealSaveFileOps());
    // True when a GENERIC_WRITE open sharing all three ways succeeds: every current
    // holder allows write sharing, so "Overwrite in place" can be offered.
    [[nodiscard]] bool ProbeWriteShared(const std::filesystem::path& file);
```

Append to `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.cpp` -- first add to the anonymous namespace (after `ReadUpTo`):
```cpp
        // Writes everything; does not flush (callers flush once at the end).
        bool WriteAllHandle(HANDLE h, std::string_view bytes, DWORD& error)
        {
            std::size_t done = 0;
            while (done < bytes.size())
            {
                const DWORD chunk = static_cast<DWORD>(std::min<std::size_t>(bytes.size() - done, std::size_t{ 1 } << 30));
                DWORD wrote = 0;
                if (!::WriteFile(h, bytes.data() + done, chunk, &wrote, nullptr))
                {
                    error = ::GetLastError();
                    return false;
                }
                done += wrote;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // The temp beside the target. CREATE_NEW: a stale temp is never reused.
        std::uint32_t WriteTemp(const std::filesystem::path& temp, std::string_view bytes)
        {
            DWORD error = 0;
            bool ok = false;
            {
                const Handle h(::CreateFileW(temp.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_NEW, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
                if (!h.Valid())
                    return ::GetLastError();
                ok = WriteAllHandle(h.h, bytes, error) && ::FlushFileBuffers(h.h);
                if (!ok && error == 0)
                    error = ::GetLastError();
            }
            if (!ok)
            {
                ::DeleteFileW(temp.c_str());
                return error != 0 ? error : Win32Error::kDiskFull;
            }
            return Win32Error::kSuccess;
        }

        SaveStatus StatusForError(std::uint32_t e)
        {
            if (e == Win32Error::kSharingViolation || e == Win32Error::kLockViolation) return SaveStatus::SharingViolation;
            if (e == Win32Error::kAccessDenied) return SaveStatus::AccessDenied;
            return SaveStatus::WriteFailed;
        }

        // A DELETE open that fails with a sharing violation: someone holds the
        // target without FILE_SHARE_DELETE, whatever code ReplaceFileW reported.
        bool HeldWithoutDeleteShare(const std::filesystem::path& target)
        {
            HANDLE h = ::CreateFileW(target.c_str(), DELETE, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
            if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
                return ::GetLastError() == ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION;
            ::CloseHandle(h);
            return false;
        }

        std::uint32_t RealReplace(const wchar_t* replaced, const wchar_t* replacement, const wchar_t* backup)
        {
            return ::ReplaceFileW(replaced, replacement, backup, 0, nullptr, nullptr) ? 0u : ::GetLastError();
        }

        std::uint32_t RealMove(const wchar_t* from, const wchar_t* to, std::uint32_t flags)
        {
            return ::MoveFileExW(from, to, flags) ? 0u : ::GetLastError();
        }

        SaveOutcome WriteInPlace(const std::filesystem::path& target, std::string_view bytes)
        {
            SaveOutcome out;
            const Handle h(::CreateFileW(target.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
            if (!h.Valid())
            {
                out.win32Error = ::GetLastError();
                out.status = StatusForError(out.win32Error);
                return out;
            }
            LARGE_INTEGER zero{};
            DWORD error = 0;
            if (!::SetFilePointerEx(h.h, zero, nullptr, FILE_BEGIN) || !WriteAllHandle(h.h, bytes, error)
                || !::SetEndOfFile(h.h) || !::FlushFileBuffers(h.h))
            {
                out.win32Error = error != 0 ? error : ::GetLastError();
                out.status = SaveStatus::WriteFailed;
                return out;
            }
            out.status = SaveStatus::Saved;
            return out;
        }
```

```cpp
    const SaveFileOps& RealSaveFileOps()
    {
        static const SaveFileOps ops{ &RealReplace, &RealMove, nullptr };
        return ops;
    }

    bool ProbeWriteShared(const std::filesystem::path& file)
    {
        const Handle h(::CreateFileW(file.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
        return h.Valid();
    }

    SaveOutcome SaveFileBytes(const SaveRequest& req, const SaveFileOps& ops)
    {
        SaveOutcome out;
        const auto finish = [&](SaveStatus status) -> SaveOutcome
        {
            out.status = status;
            if (SavedOk(status))
                out.written = FingerprintOf(req.bytes, StatFile(req.target).mtime);
            return out;
        };

        const FileStamp before = StatFile(req.target);
        SaveFacts facts;
        facts.targetExists = before.exists;
        facts.readOnlyAttribute = before.exists && (before.attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0;
        facts.underFollow = req.underFollow;
        facts.recentExternalWrite = req.recentExternalWrite;
        facts.mode = req.mode;
        if (ops.listHolders && NeedsHolderCheck(facts.targetExists, facts.readOnlyAttribute, req.mode))
            facts.holders = ops.listHolders(req.target);

        switch (PlanSave(facts))
        {
        case SaveStep::RefuseReadOnly:
            return finish(SaveStatus::ReadOnlyAttribute);
        case SaveStep::AskAboutHolders:
            out.holders = std::move(facts.holders);
            out.overwriteInPlaceAvailable = ProbeWriteShared(req.target);
            return finish(SaveStatus::HoldersPresent);
        case SaveStep::OverwriteInPlace:
        {
            const SaveOutcome inPlace = WriteInPlace(req.target, req.bytes);
            out.win32Error = inPlace.win32Error;
            return finish(inPlace.status);
        }
        case SaveStep::ClearReadOnlyThenReplace:
            if (!::SetFileAttributesW(req.target.c_str(), before.attributes & ~static_cast<DWORD>(FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY)))
            {
                out.win32Error = ::GetLastError();
                return finish(SaveStatus::AccessDenied);
            }
            break;   // then the atomic replace below
        case SaveStep::CreateNew:
        case SaveStep::ReplaceAtomic:
            break;
        }

        const std::uint32_t pid = req.pid != 0 ? req.pid : static_cast<std::uint32_t>(::GetCurrentProcessId());
        out.tempPath = TransientSavePath(req.target, pid, NextTransientSerial());
        if (const std::uint32_t e = WriteTemp(out.tempPath, req.bytes); e != Win32Error::kSuccess)
        {
            out.win32Error = e;
            return finish(e == Win32Error::kAccessDenied ? SaveStatus::AccessDenied : SaveStatus::WriteFailed);
        }

        if (!facts.targetExists)
        {
            if (const std::uint32_t e = ops.moveFile(out.tempPath.c_str(), req.target.c_str(), MoveFlags::kWriteThrough); e != 0)
            {
                ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
                out.win32Error = e;
                return finish(e == Win32Error::kAccessDenied ? SaveStatus::AccessDenied : SaveStatus::WriteFailed);
            }
            return finish(SaveStatus::Saved);
        }

        out.backupPath = TransientBackupPath(out.tempPath);
        const std::uint32_t e = ops.replaceFile(req.target.c_str(), out.tempPath.c_str(), out.backupPath.c_str());
        if (e == Win32Error::kSuccess)
        {
            ::DeleteFileW(out.backupPath.c_str());   // a failed delete leaves an ignored .arctmp~ file
            return finish(SaveStatus::Saved);
        }
        out.win32Error = e;
        switch (ClassifyReplaceFailure(e))
        {
        case ReplaceFailure::Unsupported:
            if (const std::uint32_t m = ops.moveFile(out.tempPath.c_str(), req.target.c_str(),
                                                     MoveFlags::kReplaceExisting | MoveFlags::kWriteThrough); m == 0)
                return finish(SaveStatus::SavedWithoutAclPreservation);
            else
            {
                ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
                out.win32Error = m;
                return finish(SaveStatus::WriteFailed);
            }
        case ReplaceFailure::OriginalUnderBackup:
            if (ops.moveFile(out.backupPath.c_str(), req.target.c_str(), MoveFlags::kWriteThrough) == 0)
            {
                ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
                return finish(SaveStatus::RecoveredFromBackup);
            }
            return finish(SaveStatus::RecoveryFailed);
        case ReplaceFailure::SharingViolation:
            ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
            out.overwriteInPlaceAvailable = ProbeWriteShared(req.target);
            return finish(SaveStatus::SharingViolation);
        case ReplaceFailure::OriginalIntact:
        case ReplaceFailure::AccessDenied:
            ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
            if (HeldWithoutDeleteShare(req.target))
            {
                out.overwriteInPlaceAvailable = ProbeWriteShared(req.target);
                return finish(SaveStatus::SharingViolation);
            }
            return finish(ClassifyReplaceFailure(e) == ReplaceFailure::AccessDenied ? SaveStatus::AccessDenied
                                                                                   : SaveStatus::RecoveredOriginalIntact);
        case ReplaceFailure::Other:
            ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
            return finish(SaveStatus::WriteFailed);
        }
        ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
        return finish(SaveStatus::WriteFailed);
    }
```

```cpp
// text-file-holder-fixture: holds ONE file open with a chosen access and share
// mode until its stdin reaches EOF, so ArcaneTests can prove the text save's
// sharing-violation, overwrite-in-place and Restart Manager paths against a
// REAL second process (TextFileHoldersTest.cpp). Its own premake project (a
// second wmain cannot live in ArcaneTests); plain Win32, no engine code.
//
//   text-file-holder-fixture <path> <access: r|w|rw> <share: none|r|rw|rwd>
//
// Prints "HELD <pid>\n" once the handle is open (or "ERROR <code>\n" and exits
// 1), then blocks until stdin closes, closes the handle and exits 0.

#include <cstdio>
#include <string_view>

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

int wmain(int argc, wchar_t** argv)
{
    if (argc != 4)
    {
        std::fputs("usage: text-file-holder-fixture <path> <r|w|rw> <none|r|rw|rwd>\n", stderr);
        return 2;
    }
    const std::wstring_view access(argv[2]);
    const std::wstring_view share(argv[3]);
    DWORD a = 0;
    if (access.find(L'r') != std::wstring_view::npos) a |= GENERIC_READ;
    if (access.find(L'w') != std::wstring_view::npos) a |= GENERIC_WRITE;
    DWORD s = 0;
    if (share != L"none")
    {
        if (share.find(L'r') != std::wstring_view::npos) s |= FILE_SHARE_READ;
        if (share.find(L'w') != std::wstring_view::npos) s |= FILE_SHARE_WRITE;
        if (share.find(L'd') != std::wstring_view::npos) s |= FILE_SHARE_DELETE;
    }
    HANDLE h = ::CreateFileW(argv[1], a, s, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
    {
        std::printf("ERROR %lu\n", ::GetLastError());
        std::fflush(stdout);
        return 1;
    }
    std::printf("HELD %lu\n", ::GetCurrentProcessId());
    std::fflush(stdout);
    HANDLE in = ::GetStdHandle(STD_INPUT_HANDLE);
    char buf[64];
    DWORD got = 0;
    while (::ReadFile(in, buf, sizeof(buf), &got, nullptr) && got > 0) {}
    ::CloseHandle(h);
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-7 (spec s5.3): a second process holds the file with a chosen
// sharing mode; the save reports holders (Restart Manager), a sharing
// violation, whether overwrite in place is possible, and succeeds by the right
// route once the user picks one.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Project/TransientFiles.hpp>

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }

    std::string Read(const std::filesystem::path& p) { return ReadFileShared(p, 1u << 20).bytes; }

    int TransientFilesIn(const std::filesystem::path& dir)
    {
        int n = 0;
        for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(dir))
            if (Arcane::IsTransientSaveFile(e.path())) ++n;
        return n;
    }

    std::filesystem::path FixtureExe()
    {
        wchar_t buf[MAX_PATH] = {};
        ::GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, buf, MAX_PATH);
        return (std::filesystem::path(buf).parent_path() / ".." / "text-file-holder-fixture" /
                "text-file-holder-fixture.exe").lexically_normal();
    }

    // A real second process holding `file` until Release() / destruction.
    class HeldFile
    {
    public:
        HeldFile(const std::filesystem::path& file, const wchar_t* access, const wchar_t* share)
        {
            REQUIRE(std::filesystem::exists(FixtureExe()));
            SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES sa{ sizeof(sa), nullptr, TRUE };
            HANDLE outRead = nullptr, outWrite = nullptr, inRead = nullptr;
            REQUIRE(::CreatePipe(&outRead, &outWrite, &sa, 0));
            REQUIRE(::CreatePipe(&inRead, &m_stdinWrite, &sa, 0));
            ::SetHandleInformation(outRead, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0);
            ::SetHandleInformation(m_stdinWrite, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0);
            STARTUPINFOW si{};
            si.cb = sizeof(si);
            si.dwFlags = STARTF_USESTDHANDLES;
            si.hStdInput = inRead;
            si.hStdOutput = outWrite;
            si.hStdError = outWrite;
            std::wstring cmd = L"\"" + FixtureExe().wstring() + L"\" \"" + file.wstring() + L"\" " + access + L" " + share;
            PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
            const BOOL ok = ::CreateProcessW(nullptr, cmd.data(), nullptr, nullptr, TRUE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, nullptr, nullptr, &si, &pi);
            ::CloseHandle(inRead);
            ::CloseHandle(outWrite);
            REQUIRE(ok);
            m_process = pi.hProcess;
            ::CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
            std::string line;
            char c = 0;
            DWORD got = 0;
            while (::ReadFile(outRead, &c, 1, &got, nullptr) && got == 1 && c != '\n')
                line.push_back(c);
            ::CloseHandle(outRead);
            INFO("fixture said: " << line);
            REQUIRE(line.starts_with("HELD "));
            m_pid = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::stoul(line.substr(5)));
        }
        ~HeldFile() { Release(); }
        HeldFile(const HeldFile&) = delete;
        HeldFile& operator=(const HeldFile&) = delete;
        void Release()
        {
            if (m_stdinWrite) { ::CloseHandle(m_stdinWrite); m_stdinWrite = nullptr; }
            if (m_process) { ::WaitForSingleObject(m_process, 10000); ::CloseHandle(m_process); m_process = nullptr; }
        }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t Pid() const { return m_pid; }

    private:
        HANDLE m_stdinWrite = nullptr;
        HANDLE m_process = nullptr;
        std::uint32_t m_pid = 0;
    };

    bool Names(const std::vector<FileHolder>& holders, std::uint32_t pid)
    {
        return std::any_of(holders.begin(), holders.end(), [&](const FileHolder& h) { return h.pid == pid; });
    }
}

TEST_CASE("text holders: the Restart Manager names this process while it holds the file", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-holders-self");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "self.log";
    WriteAll(p, "x");
    HANDLE h = ::CreateFileW(p.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
                             nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE);
    const std::vector<FileHolder> held = ListFileHolders(p);
    ::CloseHandle(h);
    CHECK(std::any_of(held.begin(), held.end(), [](const FileHolder& f)
                      { return f.thisProcess && f.pid == ::GetCurrentProcessId() && !f.appName.empty(); }));
    CHECK(ListFileHolders(p).empty());
    CHECK(RealSaveFileOps().listHolders == &ListFileHolders);
}

TEST_CASE("text holders: a writer without delete sharing -> holders, then in use, then overwrite in place", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-holders-writer");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "game.log";
    WriteAll(p, "old\n");
    HeldFile held(p, L"w", L"rw");

    const SaveOutcome a = SaveFileBytes({ p, "new\n" });
    CHECK(a.status == SaveStatus::HoldersPresent);
    CHECK(Names(a.holders, held.Pid()));
    CHECK(a.overwriteInPlaceAvailable);

    const SaveOutcome b = SaveFileBytes({ p, "new\n", SaveMode::AtomicSkipHolderCheck });   // "Save anyway"
    INFO("ReplaceFileW reported " << b.win32Error);
    CHECK(b.status == SaveStatus::SharingViolation);
    CHECK(b.overwriteInPlaceAvailable);
    CHECK(Read(p) == "old\n");
    CHECK(TransientFilesIn(s.dir) == 0);

    const SaveOutcome c = SaveFileBytes({ p, "new\n", SaveMode::OverwriteInPlace });
    CHECK(c.status == SaveStatus::Saved);
    CHECK(Read(p) == "new\n");
}

TEST_CASE("text holders: a reader that shares only read -> in use, no overwrite in place, Retry after release", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-holders-reader");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "data.csv";
    WriteAll(p, "old\n");
    HeldFile held(p, L"r", L"r");

    const SaveOutcome b = SaveFileBytes({ p, "new\n", SaveMode::AtomicSkipHolderCheck });
    CHECK(b.status == SaveStatus::SharingViolation);
    CHECK_FALSE(b.overwriteInPlaceAvailable);
    CHECK(SaveFileBytes({ p, "new\n", SaveMode::OverwriteInPlace }).status == SaveStatus::SharingViolation);
    CHECK(Read(p) == "old\n");

    held.Release();
    const SaveOutcome retry = SaveFileBytes({ p, "new\n" });
    CHECK(retry.status == SaveStatus::Saved);
    CHECK(Read(p) == "new\n");
}

{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-holders-logger");

    WriteAll(p, "old\n");

    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-holders-follow");

    recent.recentExternalWrite = true;
```

```cpp
    {
```

```cpp
            std::vector<RM_PROCESS_INFO> infos;
            DWORD rc = ::RmGetList(session, &needed, &count, nullptr, &reasons);
            while (rc == ERROR_MORE_DATA)   // the list can grow between calls: ask again with the new size
            {
                infos.resize(needed);
                count = needed;
                rc = ::RmGetList(session, &needed, &count, infos.data(), &reasons);
            }
            if (rc == ERROR_SUCCESS)
                for (UINT i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                {
                    const DWORD pid = infos[i].Process.dwProcessId;
                    out.push_back(FileHolder{ static_cast<std::uint32_t>(pid), WideToUtf8(infos[i].strAppName),
                                              pid == ::GetCurrentProcessId() });
                }
        }
        ::RmEndSession(session);
        return out;
    }
```

### Task TE2-8: Chain SDL's single Windows message hook (spec s5.5)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Platform/WindowsMessageHooks.hpp`, `ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Platform/WindowsMessageHooks.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Platform/Window.cpp:1-4` (include), `:65-73` (`SessionEndHook` runs the chain)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/WindowsMessageHookTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the existing process-wide `SDL_SetWindowsMessageHook(&SessionEndHook, nullptr)` registration (Window.cpp:113-119).
- Produces (ARC_API, `namespace Arcane`): `using WindowsMessageHook = bool (*)(void* user, void* msg);` `void AddWindowsMessageHook(WindowsMessageHook, void* user)`, `void RemoveWindowsMessageHook(WindowsMessageHook, void* user)`, `bool RunWindowsMessageHooks(void* msg)`. TE2-10's `TextInputHook` registers through it.

SDL3 has one hook slot per process (last writer wins); `Window.cpp` already owns it for the session-end route. Chaining keeps that route and gives every later consumer the same pre-`TranslateMessage` view without replacing it.

```cpp
    Arcane::AddWindowsMessageHook(&CountingHook, &b);

    MSG m{};
    m.message = WM_NULL;

    CHECK(a.seen == 1);
    CHECK(b.seen == 1);

    b.keep = false;
    CHECK_FALSE(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&m));   // swallowed...
    CHECK(a.seen == 2);                                 // ...after every hook saw it

    CHECK(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&m));
    CHECK(a.seen == 3);

    Arcane::RemoveWindowsMessageHook(&CountingHook, &a);
    CHECK(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&m));
    CHECK(a.seen == 3);
    Arcane::AddWindowsMessageHook(nullptr, &a);         // a null hook is ignored
```

`ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Platform/WindowsMessageHooks.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// The chain behind SDL's ONE Windows message hook (text editor spec s5.5).
// SDL_SetWindowsMessageHook has a single process-wide slot (last writer wins);
// Window.cpp owns it for the session-end route and runs this chain from it, so
// every other consumer (the text editor's dead-key and layout hook) sees each
// message before TranslateMessage without replacing anyone.
//
// `msg` is a MSG* on Windows (opaque here so <windows.h> stays out of public
// headers). Return false to swallow the message. Hooks run on the thread that
// pumps SDL events, in registration order, and every hook sees every message
// (one swallowing does not hide it from the others). A hook must not add or
// remove hooks from inside itself.

#include <Arcane/Base/Api.hpp>

namespace Arcane
{
    using WindowsMessageHook = bool (*)(void* user, void* msg);

    ARC_API void AddWindowsMessageHook(WindowsMessageHook hook, void* user);      // a duplicate (hook, user) is ignored
    ARC_API void RemoveWindowsMessageHook(WindowsMessageHook hook, void* user);
    // Runs the chain; false when any hook swallowed. Window.cpp's SDL hook calls it.
    ARC_API bool RunWindowsMessageHooks(void* msg);
}
```

`ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Platform/WindowsMessageHooks.cpp`:
```cpp
#include <Arcane/Platform/WindowsMessageHooks.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane
{
    namespace
    {
        struct Entry
        {
            WindowsMessageHook hook;
            void*              user;
        };

        std::mutex& HooksMutex()
        {
            static std::mutex m;
            return m;
        }

        std::vector<Entry>& Hooks()
        {
            static std::vector<Entry> v;
            return v;
        }
    }

    void AddWindowsMessageHook(WindowsMessageHook hook, void* user)
    {
        if (!hook)
            return;
        const std::lock_guard lock(HooksMutex());
        std::vector<Entry>& v = Hooks();
        if (std::none_of(v.begin(), v.end(), [&](const Entry& e) { return e.hook == hook && e.user == user; }))
            v.push_back(Entry{ hook, user });
    }

    void RemoveWindowsMessageHook(WindowsMessageHook hook, void* user)
    {
        const std::lock_guard lock(HooksMutex());
        std::erase_if(Hooks(), [&](const Entry& e) { return e.hook == hook && e.user == user; });
    }

    bool RunWindowsMessageHooks(void* msg)
    {
        const std::lock_guard lock(HooksMutex());
        bool keep = true;
        for (const Entry& e : Hooks())
            keep = e.hook(e.user, msg) && keep;   // every hook sees every message
        return keep;
    }
}
```

`ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Platform/Window.cpp` -- add after `#include <Arcane/Platform/Window.hpp>` (line 1):
```cpp

```
and replace `SessionEndHook` (lines 65-73) with:
```cpp
        bool SDLCALL SessionEndHook(void* /*userdata*/, MSG* msg)
        {
            if (msg)
            {
                if (msg->message == WM_ENDSESSION && msg->wParam == TRUE)
                    Arcane::Diagnostics::RequestCleanExit();
            }
            // THE CHAIN (text editor spec s5.5): SDL's hook slot is single and
            // process-wide, so every other consumer registers through
            // AddWindowsMessageHook and runs here, after the session-end check.
            // Its answer is ours: a hook that swallows (false) stops the message.
            return msg ? Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(msg) : true;
        }
```
