### Task TE2-9: Keyboard layout facts -- AltGr, Latin letters, dead keys, asked of the layout (spec s5.5)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.cpp`
- Modify: `premake5.lua` (TE2 block: add `TextKeyboardLayout.cpp`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextKeyboardLayoutTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Arcane::Editor::EditorActions` (`Register`, `BeginFrame`, `Pressed`, `PressedInWindow`, `SetActiveKeyLayout`), `Arcane::KeyLayout`, `Arcane::Keys` (EditorActions.hpp:27-138, KeyLayout.hpp:18-56).
- Produces: `struct KeyboardLayoutFacts { std::uintptr_t layout; bool hasAltGr; bool lettersLatin; }`; `std::uintptr_t ActiveKeyboardLayout()`; `KeyboardLayoutFacts QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(std::uintptr_t layout)`; `char LatinLetterForScancode(std::uint32_t pcScancode, std::uintptr_t layout)`; `std::uint32_t ScancodeForVirtualKey(std::uint32_t vk, std::uintptr_t layout)`; `bool IsDeadKey(std::uint32_t vk, std::uintptr_t layout)`; `struct KeyForChar { std::uint32_t vk; bool shift, ctrl, alt; }`; `std::optional<KeyForChar> KeyForCharacter(char16_t, std::uintptr_t layout)`. TE5 reads `lettersLatin` for `vim.latinLettersInNormal` (auto) and `LatinLetterForScancode` for Normal-mode letters.

**The Labelled-letter verification (spec s5.5 "The plan verifies Arcane's KeyLayout honours this").** Read from the settings tree: the ImGui route matches a Labelled letter through `ImGui::IsKeyChordPressed(ImGuiKey_<letter>)` (EditorActions.cpp:376-389), and `imgui_impl_sdl3` maps the SDL *key event's* keycode to that `ImGuiKey` (`ImGui_ImplSDL3_KeyEventToImGuiKey`, imgui_impl_sdl3.cpp:237-313). SDL3's default `SDL_HINT_KEYCODE_OPTIONS` (`french_numbers,latin_letters`; Arcane never overrides it -- the only `SDL_SetHint` call is Window.cpp:221's activation hint) gives a non-Latin layout's letter keys their US-position Latin keycode in key events, so `Ctrl+V` arrives as `ImGuiKey_V`. The SDL-snapshot route (Global/Viewport actions) uses `SystemKeyLayout::KeycodeFor` -> `SDL_GetKeyFromScancode(sc, NONE, key_event=false)`, which does *not* apply `latin_letters`; EditorActions covers that with `FallbackApplies` (EditorActions.cpp:322-332), which matches the letter's QWERTY scancode position when the layout's key produces no Latin letter. The test below proves (a) on Russian and Greek the Windows VK of every letter sits at exactly its US scancode position -- so "QWERTY position" *is* "the VK letter" there -- and (b) both routes fire `Ctrl+V` on a non-Latin layout.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

`ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextKeyboardLayoutTest.cpp`:
```cpp
// Text editor TE2-9 (spec s5.5): AltGr, Latin-letter and dead-key facts come
// from the layout itself (ToUnicodeEx / VkKeyScanExW / MapVirtualKeyExW), and a
// Labelled letter chord means the key's Latin VK letter on every layout.
// Layouts are loaded with KLF_NOTELLSHELL and unloaded only if this test loaded them.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.hpp"
#include "Input/EditorActions.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/CVarRegistry.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Input/InputSnapshot.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Input/KeyLayout.hpp>

#include <imgui.h>

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    class ScopedLayout
    {
    public:
        ScopedLayout(const wchar_t* klid, WORD expectedLanguage)
        {
            const int count = ::GetKeyboardLayoutList(0, nullptr);
            std::vector<HKL> before(static_cast<std::size_t>(count));
            ::GetKeyboardLayoutList(count, before.data());
            m_hkl = ::LoadKeyboardLayoutW(klid, KLF_NOTELLSHELL);
            m_loadedHere = m_hkl && std::find(before.begin(), before.end(), m_hkl) == before.end();
            // LoadKeyboardLayoutW answers with the system default when it cannot load the request.
            m_ok = m_hkl && LOWORD(reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(m_hkl)) == expectedLanguage;
        }
        ~ScopedLayout()
        {
            if (m_loadedHere)
                ::UnloadKeyboardLayout(m_hkl);
        }
        ScopedLayout(const ScopedLayout&) = delete;
        ScopedLayout& operator=(const ScopedLayout&) = delete;
        [[nodiscard]] bool Ok() const { return m_ok; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uintptr_t Id() const { return reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(m_hkl); }

    private:
        HKL  m_hkl = nullptr;
        bool m_loadedHere = false;
        bool m_ok = false;
    };
}

TEST_CASE("keyboard layout: US has no AltGr, Latin letters, '{' is Shift+[, no dead quote", "[text-input]")
{
    const ScopedLayout us(L"00000409", 0x0409);
    if (!us.Ok()) SKIP("the US layout could not be loaded");
    const KeyboardLayoutFacts f = QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(us.Id());
    CHECK(f.layout == us.Id());
    CHECK_FALSE(f.hasAltGr);
    CHECK(f.lettersLatin);
    const auto k = KeyForCharacter(u'{', us.Id());
    REQUIRE(k.has_value());
    CHECK(k->vk == VK_OEM_4);
    CHECK(k->shift);
    CHECK_FALSE(k->ctrl);
    CHECK_FALSE(IsDeadKey(VK_OEM_7, us.Id()));
    CHECK(LatinLetterForScancode(ScancodeForVirtualKey('V', us.Id()), us.Id()) == 'v');
}

TEST_CASE("keyboard layout: German has AltGr ('{' = AltGr+7) and QWERTZ letters", "[text-input]")
{
    const ScopedLayout de(L"00000407", 0x0407);
    if (!de.Ok()) SKIP("the German layout could not be loaded");
    const KeyboardLayoutFacts f = QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(de.Id());
    CHECK(f.hasAltGr);
    CHECK(f.lettersLatin);
    const auto k = KeyForCharacter(u'{', de.Id());
    REQUIRE(k.has_value());
    CHECK(k->vk == '7');
    CHECK(k->ctrl);
    CHECK(k->alt);
    CHECK(LatinLetterForScancode(0x2C, de.Id()) == 'y');   // the key in US-Z's place is labelled Y on QWERTZ
    CHECK(LatinLetterForScancode(0x15, de.Id()) == 'z');   // and US-Y's place is Z
}

TEST_CASE("keyboard layout: Polish (programmers) types letters with AltGr", "[text-input]")
{
    const ScopedLayout pl(L"00000415", 0x0415);
    if (!pl.Ok()) SKIP("the Polish layout could not be loaded");
    CHECK(QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(pl.Id()).hasAltGr);
    const auto k = KeyForCharacter(u'\u0105', pl.Id());   // a-ogonek
    REQUIRE(k.has_value());
    CHECK(k->vk == 'A');
    CHECK(k->ctrl);
    CHECK(k->alt);
}

TEST_CASE("keyboard layout: US-International has AltGr and dead quote and grave keys", "[text-input]")
{
    const ScopedLayout intl(L"00020409", 0x0409);
    if (!intl.Ok()) SKIP("the US-International layout could not be loaded");
    CHECK(QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(intl.Id()).hasAltGr);
    CHECK(IsDeadKey(VK_OEM_7, intl.Id()));   // ' and "
    CHECK(IsDeadKey(VK_OEM_3, intl.Id()));   // ` and ~
    CHECK_FALSE(IsDeadKey('A', intl.Id()));
}

TEST_CASE("keyboard layout: Russian and Greek letters are non-Latin and every letter VK sits at its US position", "[text-input]")
{
    const ScopedLayout us(L"00000409", 0x0409);
    if (!us.Ok()) SKIP("the US layout could not be loaded");
    const ScopedLayout ru(L"00000419", 0x0419);
    const ScopedLayout el(L"00000408", 0x0408);
    for (const ScopedLayout* l : { &ru, &el })
    {
        if (!l->Ok()) { WARN("a non-Latin layout could not be loaded"); continue; }
        CHECK_FALSE(QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(l->Id()).lettersLatin);
        for (std::uint32_t vk = 'A'; vk <= 'Z'; ++vk)
        {
            INFO("VK " << static_cast<char>(vk));
            const std::uint32_t scan = ScancodeForVirtualKey(vk, l->Id());
            CHECK(scan == ScancodeForVirtualKey(vk, us.Id()));                       // the VK letter == the QWERTY position...
            CHECK(LatinLetterForScancode(scan, l->Id()) == static_cast<char>('a' + (vk - 'A')));   // ...and reads back as that letter
        }
    }
}

TEST_CASE("keyboard layout: on a non-Latin layout Ctrl+V reaches a Labelled chord on both routes", "[text-input]")
{
    struct Cyrillic final : Arcane::KeyLayout   // the letter scancodes produce U+0430.. (no Latin letter anywhere)
    {
        std::int32_t KeycodeFor(std::uint32_t sc) const override
        { return (sc >= 4 && sc <= 29) ? 0x430 + static_cast<std::int32_t>(sc - 4) : Arcane::QwertyKeyLayout().KeycodeFor(sc); }
        std::uint32_t ScancodeFor(std::int32_t kc) const override
        { for (std::uint32_t sc = 1; sc < 512; ++sc) if (KeycodeFor(sc) == kc) return sc; return 0; }
        std::string KeyName(std::int32_t kc) const override { return Arcane::QwertyKeyLayout().KeyName(kc); }
    } cyrillic;

    Arcane::CVarRegistry reg;
    EditorActions actions(reg);
    actions.Register({ "t.paste", "Paste", ActionContext::Global, "Ctrl+V" });
    SetActiveKeyLayout(&cyrillic);

    // The SDL-snapshot route: the V key's scancode, a Cyrillic keycode -> FallbackApplies.
    Arcane::InputSnapshot snap;
    snap.SetScancode(Arcane::Keys::kScanLCtrl);
    snap.SetScancode(Arcane::Keys::ScanLetter('V'));
    snap.AddKeycode(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(cyrillic.KeycodeFor(Arcane::Keys::ScanLetter('V'))));
    Arcane::InputSnapshot none;
    ActionFrameInput in;
    in.snap = &none;
    in.dt = 1.0 / 60.0;
    actions.BeginFrame(in);
    in.snap = &snap;
    actions.BeginFrame(in);
    CHECK(actions.Pressed("t.paste"));

    // The ImGui route: SDL3's latin_letters keycode option makes the key EVENT carry SDLK_V,
    // which imgui_impl_sdl3 maps to ImGuiKey_V -- simulated here as that key event.
    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(800, 600);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr;
    int w = 0, h = 0;
    io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
    bool fired = false;
    const auto frame = [&] { io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f; ImGui::NewFrame(); fired = actions.PressedInWindow("t.paste"); ImGui::Render(); };
    frame();
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Ctrl, true);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_V, true);
    frame();
    frame();   // the trickled queue may need a second frame for the second event
    CHECK(fired);
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
    SetActiveKeyLayout(nullptr);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// The keyboard layout's own answers (text editor spec s5.5): whether it HAS
// AltGr, whether its letter keys are Latin, which keys are dead -- asked of
// the layout with ToUnicodeEx / VkKeyScanExW / MapVirtualKeyExW, never inferred
// from event timing. Layouts are HKLs passed as integers so no <windows.h>
// leaks out. ToUnicodeEx is always called with flag 0x4 (keyboard state
// unchanged, Windows 10 1607+), so asking never disturbs a pending dead key.

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct KeyboardLayoutFacts
    {
        std::uintptr_t layout = 0;    // the HKL these describe
        bool hasAltGr = false;        // a key's Ctrl+Alt (AltGr) layer produces a character or a dead key
        bool lettersLatin = true;     // VK 'A'..'Z' all produce Latin letters unshifted
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::uintptr_t ActiveKeyboardLayout();                        // GetKeyboardLayout(0)
    [[nodiscard]] KeyboardLayoutFacts QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(std::uintptr_t layout);
    // 'a'..'z' when the key at PC scancode `pcScancode` has a letter VK on `layout`
    // (the Windows convention for Ctrl+letter chords), else 0.
    [[nodiscard]] char LatinLetterForScancode(std::uint32_t pcScancode, std::uintptr_t layout);
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t ScancodeForVirtualKey(std::uint32_t vk, std::uintptr_t layout);
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsDeadKey(std::uint32_t vk, std::uintptr_t layout);

    struct KeyForChar
    {
        std::uint32_t vk = 0;
        bool shift = false, ctrl = false, alt = false;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<KeyForChar> KeyForCharacter(char16_t ch, std::uintptr_t layout);   // VkKeyScanExW
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")   // ToUnicodeEx / VkKeyScanExW / MapVirtualKeyExW / GetKeyboardLayout

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("Win32 vocabulary: ToUnicodeEx flag bit 2 -- do not change the keyboard state (Windows 10 1607+)")
        constexpr UINT kToUnicodeKeepState = 0x4;
        ARC_CONSTANT("Win32 vocabulary: the 'down' bit of a GetKeyboardState byte")
        constexpr BYTE kKeyDown = 0x80;

        HKL AsHkl(std::uintptr_t v) { return reinterpret_cast<HKL>(v); }

        // Keys whose AltGr layer can carry characters: digits, letters, the OEM
        // punctuation keys and the ISO 102nd key.
        bool CandidateKey(UINT vk)
        {
            return (vk >= '0' && vk <= '9') || (vk >= 'A' && vk <= 'Z') || (vk >= VK_OEM_1 && vk <= VK_OEM_3)
                || (vk >= VK_OEM_4 && vk <= VK_OEM_8) || vk == VK_OEM_102;
        }

        int Translate(UINT vk, const BYTE* state, HKL hkl, wchar_t* buf, int cap)
        {
            const UINT scan = ::MapVirtualKeyExW(vk, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC, hkl);
            return ::ToUnicodeEx(vk, scan, state, buf, cap, kToUnicodeKeepState, hkl);
        }
    }

    std::uintptr_t ActiveKeyboardLayout()
    {
        return reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(::GetKeyboardLayout(0));
    }

    KeyboardLayoutFacts QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(std::uintptr_t layout)
    {
        KeyboardLayoutFacts f;
        f.layout = layout;
        const HKL hkl = AsHkl(layout);
        BYTE altGr[256] = {};
        altGr[VK_CONTROL] = altGr[VK_LCONTROL] = altGr[VK_MENU] = altGr[VK_RMENU] = kKeyDown;
        const BYTE none[256] = {};
        wchar_t buf[8] = {};
        for (UINT vk = 0; vk < 256 && !f.hasAltGr; ++vk)
        {
            if (!CandidateKey(vk))
                continue;
            const int n = Translate(vk, altGr, hkl, buf, 8);
            if (n < 0 || (n > 0 && buf[0] >= 0x20))   // a dead key or a printable character on the AltGr layer
                f.hasAltGr = true;
        }
        int latin = 0;
        for (UINT vk = 'A'; vk <= 'Z'; ++vk)
        {
            const int n = Translate(vk, none, hkl, buf, 8);
            if (n == 1 && ((buf[0] >= L'a' && buf[0] <= L'z') || (buf[0] >= L'A' && buf[0] <= L'Z')))
                ++latin;
        }
        f.lettersLatin = latin == 26;
        return f;
    }

    char LatinLetterForScancode(std::uint32_t pcScancode, std::uintptr_t layout)
    {
        const UINT vk = ::MapVirtualKeyExW(pcScancode, MAPVK_VSC_TO_VK_EX, AsHkl(layout));
        return (vk >= 'A' && vk <= 'Z') ? static_cast<char>('a' + (vk - 'A')) : '\0';
    }

    std::uint32_t ScancodeForVirtualKey(std::uint32_t vk, std::uintptr_t layout)
    {
        return ::MapVirtualKeyExW(vk, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC, AsHkl(layout));
    }

    bool IsDeadKey(std::uint32_t vk, std::uintptr_t layout)
    {
        const BYTE none[256] = {};
        wchar_t buf[8] = {};
        return Translate(vk, none, AsHkl(layout), buf, 8) < 0;
    }

    std::optional<KeyForChar> KeyForCharacter(char16_t ch, std::uintptr_t layout)
    {
        const SHORT r = ::VkKeyScanExW(static_cast<WCHAR>(ch), AsHkl(layout));
        if (r == -1)
            return std::nullopt;
        const BYTE mods = HIBYTE(r);
        KeyForChar k;
        k.vk = LOBYTE(r);
        k.shift = (mods & 1) != 0;
        k.ctrl = (mods & 2) != 0;
        k.alt = (mods & 4) != 0;
        return k;
    }
}
```

### Task TE2-10: The text input stream and the dead-key command-mode hook (spec s5.5)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextInput.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextInput.cpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextInputHook.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextInputHook.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorApp.cpp:468-477` (`StageEditorFonts` installs the hook)
- Modify: `premake5.lua` (TE2 block: add `TextInput.cpp`, `TextInputHook.cpp`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextInputStreamTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `AddWindowsMessageHook`, `RemoveWindowsMessageHook`, `RunWindowsMessageHooks` (TE2-8); `ActiveKeyboardLayout`, `QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts`, `KeyboardLayoutFacts` (TE2-9); `Text::Utf8::Append` (TE1-1, the single UTF-8 encoder, CANON B13 -- this task therefore needs TE1-1 merged, even on lane L1).
- Produces: `enum class TextNamedKey : std::uint8_t { Left, Right, Up, Down, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Backspace, Delete, Enter, Tab, Escape, Insert }` (`Insert` is read from `ImGuiKey_Insert`; TE2's view ignores it, **TE5**'s vim layer maps it to `<Insert>`); `struct TextKeyPress { TextNamedKey key; bool ctrl, shift, alt; }`; `struct RawTextInput { std::vector<TextKeyPress> keys; std::u32string chars; std::u32string commandModeChars; bool rightAltDown; bool layoutHasAltGr; }`; `struct TextInputFrame { std::vector<TextKeyPress> keys; std::string text; bool altGrHeld; bool droppedUnsupported; }`; `TextInputFrame BuildTextInputFrame(const RawTextInput&)`; `RawTextInput ReadImGuiTextInput(bool layoutHasAltGr, std::u32string commandModeChars)`. `class TextInputHook { static TextInputHook& Get(); void Install(); void Uninstall(); bool Installed() const; void SetCommandMode(bool); bool CommandMode() const; void SetImeAllowed(bool); bool ImeAllowed() const; const KeyboardLayoutFacts& Layout() const; std::u32string TakeCommandModeChars(); bool OnMessage(void* msg); void RefreshLayout(std::uintptr_t); }`. **TE5 drives** `SetCommandMode` (Normal/Visual/operator-pending = true) and `SetImeAllowed`; TE2's view reads `Layout()`, `ImeAllowed()` and `TakeCommandModeChars()`. No `AppendUtf8` of this chunk's own: characters are encoded with TE1's `Text::Utf8::Append` (CANON B13).

`SetImeAllowed(false)` TRULY disables the IME (CANON B24, Review Focus F5), not just the candidate window: the hook remembers the HWND of the last `WM_SETFOCUS` / `WM_KEYDOWN` it saw and, on a state change only, calls `ImmAssociateContextEx(hwnd, nullptr, 0)` (disassociate: keystrokes reach the window raw, so vim Normal mode's `j` is never a composition on a Japanese/Chinese IME) or `ImmAssociateContextEx(hwnd, nullptr, IACE_DEFAULT)` (restore). While disabled, a focus move to another window restores the old one and disassociates the new one, and a `WM_SETFOCUS` / `WM_KEYDOWN` that finds the context re-associated (SDL3's `SDL_StartTextInput` re-associates its own context) disassociates it again. The view still maps the flag to `ImGuiPlatformImeData::WantVisible` as well. TE5a-22 calls `SetImeAllowed` unchanged.

Notes the code relies on, read from the tree: SDL3 never delivers Tab/Enter/control characters as text (its `SDL_SendKeyboardText` drops unprintable characters), so Tab and Enter reach a text widget as named keys; the character filter still implements the spec's rule (drop 0x00-0x1F except Tab and Enter, and DEL 0x7F) for any other source, and drops a Tab/Enter character when the named key fired the same frame so nothing inserts twice. ImGui is built with 16-bit `ImWchar` (no `IMGUI_USE_WCHAR32` in imconfig.h or premake), so `ImGuiIO::AddInputCharacterUTF16` turns a typed non-BMP character into U+FFFD (imgui.cpp:1792-1793); the stream drops it rather than inserting a replacement character, and reports it (see the self-review gap).

```cpp
    // A hidden top-level window on this thread: it shares the thread's default

    class ScopedHiddenWindow
    {
    public:
        ScopedHiddenWindow()
            : m_hwnd(::CreateWindowExW(0, L"STATIC", L"text-input-ime-test", WS_OVERLAPPED, 0, 0, 64, 64,
                                       nullptr, nullptr, ::GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), nullptr)) {}
        ~ScopedHiddenWindow() { if (m_hwnd) ::DestroyWindow(m_hwnd); }

    {

        bool m_loadedHere = false;

TEST_CASE("text input: control characters drop except Tab and Enter, never twice with the named key", "[text-input]")
{
    RawTextInput raw;
    raw.chars = std::u32string{ U'a', 0x01, 0x16, U'b', 0x7F, U'\t', U'c', U'\r', 0x00, U'\n' };
    TextInputFrame f = BuildTextInputFrame(raw);
    CHECK(f.text == "ab\tc\n\n");                 // Ctrl+A / Ctrl+V's 0x01 / 0x16, DEL and NUL gone; CR -> LF

    raw.keys.push_back({ TextNamedKey::Tab });
    raw.keys.push_back({ TextNamedKey::Enter });
    f = BuildTextInputFrame(raw);
    CHECK(f.text == "abc");                       // the named keys own Tab and Enter this frame
    REQUIRE(f.keys.size() == 2u);
    CHECK(f.keys[0].key == TextNamedKey::Tab);
}

TEST_CASE("text input: AltGr is text, never a chord -- only on a layout that has AltGr", "[text-input]")
{
    RawTextInput raw;
    raw.layoutHasAltGr = true;
    raw.rightAltDown = true;
    raw.keys.push_back({ TextNamedKey::Up, true, false, true });    // Ctrl+Alt+Up while AltGr is held
    raw.keys.push_back({ TextNamedKey::Left });                      // a plain arrow still moves
    raw.chars = U"{";
    TextInputFrame f = BuildTextInputFrame(raw);
    CHECK(f.altGrHeld);
    CHECK(f.text == "{");
    REQUIRE(f.keys.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(f.keys[0].key == TextNamedKey::Left);

    raw.rightAltDown = false;                                        // Left Alt + Ctrl: a real chord
    f = BuildTextInputFrame(raw);
    CHECK_FALSE(f.altGrHeld);
    CHECK(f.keys.size() == 2u);

    raw.rightAltDown = true;
    raw.layoutHasAltGr = false;                                      // US: Right Alt is just Alt
    f = BuildTextInputFrame(raw);
    CHECK_FALSE(f.altGrHeld);
    CHECK(f.keys.size() == 2u);
}

TEST_CASE("text input: ReadImGuiTextInput reads named keys with their modifiers and drains the queue", "[text-input]")
{
    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(800, 600);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr;
    int w = 0, h = 0;
    io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
    io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
    ImGui::NewFrame();
    ImGui::Render();
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Shift, true);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_LeftArrow, true);
    io.AddInputCharacter('x');
    RawTextInput raw;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3 && raw.keys.empty(); ++i)   // the trickled queue delivers one event kind per frame
    {
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        RawTextInput r = ReadImGuiTextInput(false, U"");
        raw.chars += r.chars;
        raw.keys.insert(raw.keys.end(), r.keys.begin(), r.keys.end());
        ImGui::Render();
    }
    ImGui::NewFrame();
    raw.chars += ReadImGuiTextInput(false, U"").chars;
    CHECK(io.InputQueueCharacters.Size == 0);
    ImGui::Render();
    REQUIRE(raw.keys.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(raw.keys[0].key == TextNamedKey::Left);
    CHECK(raw.keys[0].shift);
    CHECK(raw.chars == U"x");

    // Insert is a named key too (TE5's vim layer maps it to <Insert>).
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Shift, false);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_LeftArrow, false);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_Insert, true);
    RawTextInput ins;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4 && ins.keys.empty(); ++i)   // the trickled queue: the releases first, then the press
    {
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        RawTextInput r = ReadImGuiTextInput(false, U"");
        ins.keys.insert(ins.keys.end(), r.keys.begin(), r.keys.end());
        ImGui::Render();
    }
    REQUIRE(ins.keys.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(ins.keys[0].key == TextNamedKey::Insert);
    CHECK_FALSE(ins.keys[0].shift);
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
}

TEST_CASE("text input hook: in command mode WM_DEADCHAR becomes the bare symbol and is swallowed", "[text-input]")
{
    TextInputHook hook;
    MSG m{};
    m.message = WM_DEADCHAR;
    m.wParam = L'^';
    CHECK(hook.OnMessage(&m));                    // text-entry mode: composition is left alone
    CHECK(hook.TakeCommandModeChars().empty());

    hook.SetCommandMode(true);
    CHECK(hook.CommandMode());
    CHECK_FALSE(hook.OnMessage(&m));              // swallowed; the dead state is consumed
    m.wParam = L'"';
    CHECK_FALSE(hook.OnMessage(&m));
    CHECK(hook.TakeCommandModeChars() == U"^\"");
    CHECK(hook.TakeCommandModeChars().empty());

    m.message = WM_CHAR;
    m.wParam = L'a';
    CHECK(hook.OnMessage(&m));                    // ordinary characters pass in every mode

    CHECK(hook.ImeAllowed());
    hook.SetImeAllowed(false);                    // no window seen yet: only the flag changes
    CHECK_FALSE(hook.ImeAllowed());
}

TEST_CASE("text input hook: SetImeAllowed(false) disassociates the IME context; true restores it", "[text-input]")
{
    const ScopedHiddenWindow window;
    REQUIRE(window.Get() != nullptr);
    if (!HasInputContext(window.Get())) SKIP("this system gives the thread no default input context (IMM disabled)");

    TextInputHook hook;
    MSG focus{};
    focus.hwnd = window.Get();
    focus.message = WM_SETFOCUS;
    CHECK(hook.OnMessage(&focus));                // remembered, passed on

    hook.SetImeAllowed(false);
    CHECK_FALSE(HasInputContext(window.Get()));   // keystrokes reach the window raw: no composition
    hook.SetImeAllowed(false);                    // no state change: nothing re-applied
    CHECK_FALSE(HasInputContext(window.Get()));

    // SDL3's SDL_StartTextInput re-associates its context behind our back; the
    // next key down while disabled takes it away again.
    ::ImmAssociateContextEx(window.Get(), nullptr, IACE_DEFAULT);
    REQUIRE(HasInputContext(window.Get()));
    MSG key{};
    key.hwnd = window.Get();
    key.message = WM_KEYDOWN;
    key.wParam = 'J';
    CHECK(hook.OnMessage(&key));
    CHECK_FALSE(HasInputContext(window.Get()));

    hook.SetImeAllowed(true);
    CHECK(hook.ImeAllowed());
    CHECK(HasInputContext(window.Get()));         // the thread's default context is back
}

TEST_CASE("text input hook: WM_INPUTLANGCHANGE re-queries the layout", "[text-input]")
{
    const ScopedLayout de(L"00000407", 0x0407);
    const ScopedLayout us(L"00000409", 0x0409);
    if (!de.Ok() || !us.Ok()) SKIP("the German or US layout could not be loaded");
    TextInputHook hook;
    MSG m{};
    m.message = WM_INPUTLANGCHANGE;
    m.lParam = static_cast<LPARAM>(de.Id());
    CHECK(hook.OnMessage(&m));
    CHECK(hook.Layout().layout == de.Id());
    CHECK(hook.Layout().hasAltGr);
    m.lParam = static_cast<LPARAM>(us.Id());
    CHECK(hook.OnMessage(&m));
    CHECK_FALSE(hook.Layout().hasAltGr);
}

{
    TextInputHook hook;
    hook.Install();
    CHECK(hook.Installed());
    hook.SetCommandMode(true);
    MSG m{};
    m.message = WM_DEADCHAR;
    m.wParam = L'`';
    CHECK_FALSE(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&m));
    CHECK(hook.TakeCommandModeChars() == U"`");
    hook.Uninstall();
    CHECK_FALSE(hook.Installed());
    CHECK(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&m));
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text editor's two input streams (spec s5.5). CHORDS -- keys plus
// modifiers bound to actions -- go through EditorActions (PressedInWindow) and
// are never read here. This file turns one frame of ImGui input into NAMED
// KEYS (the navigation and editing keys a text widget handles itself) and
// CHARACTERS (what the OS layout produced). The two never mix: the character
// stream drops 0x00-0x1F except Tab and Enter (and DEL), so a Ctrl+letter's
// control character never doubles its chord.

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    enum class TextNamedKey : std::uint8_t
    {
        Left, Right, Up, Down, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Backspace, Delete, Enter, Tab, Escape,
        Insert,   // ImGuiKey_Insert: TE2's view ignores it; TE5's vim layer maps it to <Insert>
    };

    struct TextKeyPress
    {
        TextNamedKey key = TextNamedKey::Left;
        bool ctrl = false, shift = false, alt = false;
    };

    struct RawTextInput
    {
        std::vector<TextKeyPress> keys;      // this frame's presses (typematic repeats included)
        std::u32string chars;                // ImGui's input character queue
        std::u32string commandModeChars;     // dead-key symbols TextInputHook produced in command mode
        bool rightAltDown = false;
        bool layoutHasAltGr = false;
    };

    struct TextInputFrame
    {
        std::vector<TextKeyPress> keys;
        std::string text;                    // UTF-8
        bool altGrHeld = false;              // this frame's key events are text, never chords
        bool droppedUnsupported = false;     // a U+FFFD from ImGui's 16-bit queue was dropped
    };

    [[nodiscard]] TextInputFrame BuildTextInputFrame(const RawTextInput& raw);
    // Reads this frame's named keys and DRAINS io.InputQueueCharacters (a widget
    // that owns the keyboard consumes the queue, as InputText does). Needs a frame.
    [[nodiscard]] RawTextInput ReadImGuiTextInput(bool layoutHasAltGr, std::u32string commandModeChars);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextInput.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextInput.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"   // Text::Utf8::Append: the one UTF-8 encoder (CANON B13)

#include <imgui.h>

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        bool HasKey(const std::vector<TextKeyPress>& keys, TextNamedKey k)
        {
            return std::any_of(keys.begin(), keys.end(), [&](const TextKeyPress& p) { return p.key == k; });
        }

        struct KeyMap
        {
            ImGuiKey     imgui;
            TextNamedKey named;
        };
        constexpr KeyMap kKeyMap[] = {
            { ImGuiKey_LeftArrow, TextNamedKey::Left },    { ImGuiKey_RightArrow, TextNamedKey::Right },
            { ImGuiKey_UpArrow, TextNamedKey::Up },        { ImGuiKey_DownArrow, TextNamedKey::Down },
            { ImGuiKey_Home, TextNamedKey::Home },         { ImGuiKey_End, TextNamedKey::End },
            { ImGuiKey_PageUp, TextNamedKey::PageUp },     { ImGuiKey_PageDown, TextNamedKey::PageDown },
            { ImGuiKey_Backspace, TextNamedKey::Backspace }, { ImGuiKey_Delete, TextNamedKey::Delete },
            { ImGuiKey_Enter, TextNamedKey::Enter },       { ImGuiKey_KeypadEnter, TextNamedKey::Enter },
            { ImGuiKey_Tab, TextNamedKey::Tab },           { ImGuiKey_Escape, TextNamedKey::Escape },
            { ImGuiKey_Insert, TextNamedKey::Insert },
        };
    }

    TextInputFrame BuildTextInputFrame(const RawTextInput& raw)
    {
        TextInputFrame f;
        f.altGrHeld = raw.layoutHasAltGr && raw.rightAltDown;
        for (const TextKeyPress& k : raw.keys)
        {
            if (f.altGrHeld && (k.ctrl || k.alt))
                continue;   // AltGr (Left Ctrl + Right Alt) is text: never a chord
            f.keys.push_back(k);
        }
        const bool tabKey = HasKey(f.keys, TextNamedKey::Tab);
        const bool enterKey = HasKey(f.keys, TextNamedKey::Enter);
        const auto add = [&](char32_t c)
        {
            if (c == 0xFFFD) { f.droppedUnsupported = true; return; }
            if (c == U'\t') { if (!tabKey) f.text.push_back('\t'); return; }
            if (c == U'\r' || c == U'\n') { if (!enterKey) f.text.push_back('\n'); return; }
            if (c < 0x20 || c == 0x7F) return;
            Text::Utf8::Append(f.text, c);
        };
        for (const char32_t c : raw.commandModeChars) add(c);
        for (const char32_t c : raw.chars) add(c);
        return f;
    }

    RawTextInput ReadImGuiTextInput(bool layoutHasAltGr, std::u32string commandModeChars)
    {
        RawTextInput raw;
        ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
        for (const KeyMap& m : kKeyMap)
            if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(m.imgui, true))
                raw.keys.push_back(TextKeyPress{ m.named, io.KeyCtrl, io.KeyShift, io.KeyAlt });
        for (const ImWchar c : io.InputQueueCharacters)
            raw.chars.push_back(static_cast<char32_t>(c));
        io.InputQueueCharacters.resize(0);
        raw.commandModeChars = std::move(commandModeChars);
        raw.rightAltDown = ImGui::IsKeyDown(ImGuiKey_RightAlt);
        raw.layoutHasAltGr = layoutHasAltGr;
        return raw;
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text editor's hook on SDL's Windows message hook (spec s5.5), chained
// through Arcane::AddWindowsMessageHook (TE2-8). Two jobs:
//  - WM_INPUTLANGCHANGE re-queries the layout's facts (AltGr, Latin letters),
//    so "is Right Alt AltGr here?" is always the active layout's answer;
//  - in COMMAND MODE (vim Normal / Visual / operator-pending -- TE5 sets it),
//    WM_DEADCHAR becomes the bare symbol (queued for the view) and the
//    layout's dead-key state is consumed, so `"a` on US-International selects
//    register a instead of composing a-umlaut. In the text-entry modes the hook
//    stays out of the way and composition works normally.
// It also owns the IME-allowed flag TE5 sets (spec s5.1, s5.5). Disallowing
// TRULY disables the IME: the hook remembers the window of the last
// WM_SETFOCUS / WM_KEYDOWN and disassociates its input context
// (ImmAssociateContextEx(hwnd, nullptr, 0)), so a Japanese/Chinese IME never
// turns vim Normal mode's `j` into a composition; allowing restores the default
// context (IACE_DEFAULT). The view additionally maps the flag to
// ImGuiPlatformImeData::WantVisible.

#include "TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class TextInputHook
    {
    public:
        static TextInputHook& Get();   // the editor's instance (EditorApp installs it at boot)

        void Install();                // registers the chained hook + queries the active layout; idempotent
        void Uninstall();
        [[nodiscard]] bool Installed() const noexcept { return m_installed; }

        void SetCommandMode(bool on) noexcept { m_commandMode = on; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool CommandMode() const noexcept { return m_commandMode; }
        // On a state change only: disassociates (false) or restores (true) the
        // IME context of the last focused window the hook saw.
        void SetImeAllowed(bool allowed);
        [[nodiscard]] bool ImeAllowed() const noexcept { return m_imeAllowed; }

        [[nodiscard]] const KeyboardLayoutFacts& Layout() const noexcept { return m_layout; }
        void RefreshLayout(std::uintptr_t layout);
        [[nodiscard]] std::u32string TakeCommandModeChars();

        // The hook body. `msg` is a MSG*; false swallows it. Public for tests.
        bool OnMessage(void* msg);

    private:
        static bool Thunk(void* user, void* msg);
        void NoteImeWindow(void* hwnd);   // WM_SETFOCUS / WM_KEYDOWN: track the window, keep it disassociated

        KeyboardLayoutFacts m_layout;
        std::u32string      m_commandChars;
        void*               m_imeWindow = nullptr;   // HWND of the last WM_SETFOCUS / WM_KEYDOWN
        bool                m_installed = false;
        bool                m_commandMode = false;
        bool                m_imeAllowed = true;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextInputHook.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextInputHook.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Platform/WindowsMessageHooks.hpp>

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#include <imm.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "imm32.lib")   // ImmGetContext / ImmReleaseContext / ImmAssociateContextEx

#include <utility>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        bool WindowHasInputContext(HWND hwnd)
        {
            const HIMC himc = ::ImmGetContext(hwnd);
            if (!himc)
                return false;
            ::ImmReleaseContext(hwnd, himc);
            return true;
        }

        // ImmAssociateContextEx(hwnd, nullptr, 0) leaves the window with NO
        // input context: the IME cannot compose there at all.
        void AssociateIme(void* window, bool allowed)
        {
            const HWND hwnd = static_cast<HWND>(window);
            if (!hwnd || !::IsWindow(hwnd))
                return;
            ::ImmAssociateContextEx(hwnd, nullptr, allowed ? IACE_DEFAULT : 0);
        }

        // ToUnicodeEx WITHOUT the keep-state flag on Space consumes a pending
        // dead key (it returns the spacing accent), so the next keystroke is
        // translated on its own.
        void ConsumeDeadKeyState(std::uintptr_t layout)
        {
            const HKL hkl = reinterpret_cast<HKL>(layout);
            const BYTE state[256] = {};
            wchar_t buf[8] = {};
            const UINT scan = ::MapVirtualKeyExW(VK_SPACE, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC, hkl);
            (void)::ToUnicodeEx(VK_SPACE, scan, state, buf, 8, 0, hkl);
        }
    }

    TextInputHook& TextInputHook::Get()
    {
        static TextInputHook hook;
        return hook;
    }

    void TextInputHook::Install()
    {
        if (m_installed)
            return;
        RefreshLayout(ActiveKeyboardLayout());
        Arcane::AddWindowsMessageHook(&TextInputHook::Thunk, this);
        m_installed = true;
    }

    void TextInputHook::Uninstall()
    {
        if (!m_installed)
            return;
        Arcane::RemoveWindowsMessageHook(&TextInputHook::Thunk, this);
        m_installed = false;
    }

    void TextInputHook::RefreshLayout(std::uintptr_t layout)
    {
        m_layout = QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(layout);
    }

    std::u32string TextInputHook::TakeCommandModeChars()
    {
        return std::exchange(m_commandChars, std::u32string{});
    }

    void TextInputHook::SetImeAllowed(bool allowed)
    {
        if (allowed == m_imeAllowed)
            return;   // only a state change touches the input context
        m_imeAllowed = allowed;
        AssociateIme(m_imeWindow, allowed);
    }

    void TextInputHook::NoteImeWindow(void* window)
    {
        if (window != m_imeWindow)
        {
            if (!m_imeAllowed)
            {
                AssociateIme(m_imeWindow, true);    // the window we left gets its IME back
                AssociateIme(window, false);        // the focused one goes without
            }
            m_imeWindow = window;
            return;
        }
        // Same window: while disabled, a context that came back (SDL3's
        // SDL_StartTextInput re-associates its own) is taken away again.
        if (!m_imeAllowed && window && WindowHasInputContext(static_cast<HWND>(window)))
            AssociateIme(window, false);
    }

    bool TextInputHook::Thunk(void* user, void* msg)
    {
        return static_cast<TextInputHook*>(user)->OnMessage(msg);
    }

    bool TextInputHook::OnMessage(void* msgPtr)
    {
        const MSG& msg = *static_cast<const MSG*>(msgPtr);
        if (msg.message == WM_SETFOCUS || msg.message == WM_KEYDOWN)
            NoteImeWindow(msg.hwnd);   // passed on either way
        if (msg.message == WM_INPUTLANGCHANGE)
        {
            RefreshLayout(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(msg.lParam));   // lParam: the new HKL
            return true;
        }
        if (m_commandMode && msg.message == WM_DEADCHAR)
        {
            m_commandChars.push_back(static_cast<char32_t>(msg.wParam));
            ConsumeDeadKeyState(m_layout.layout != 0 ? m_layout.layout : ActiveKeyboardLayout());
            return false;   // swallowed: nothing composes with the next key
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextLayoutTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (TE1, CANON A1-A5): `Rope` (`FromUtf8`, `LineStart`, `LineEnd`, `LineCount`, `CopyTo`, `ToString`), `explicit TextBuffer(Rope, EolMap = {})`, `TextBuffer::{Version, EditsSince, EditLogCovers, Eols, Dirty}`, `EditLogEntry`, `EolMap`, `Eol`, `SelectionSet()`, `DisplayMap()` + `DisplayMap::SetFolds(std::span<const FoldRange>, std::uint32_t)`, `Text::TextCommands` (the class: `SetSelections`, `InsertText`, `MoveDocumentEnd`), `Text::EditContext`, `Editor::ApplyEditSettings(const TextSettings&, Text::EditContext&)` (TE1-15), `NextGraphemeBoundary(std::string_view, std::size_t)`, `Utf8::DecodeAt` / `Utf8::Unit`; `TextLineNumbers` (TE2-2).
- Produces: `struct TextModel { explicit TextModel(Text::Rope text, Text::EolMap eols = {}); explicit TextModel(Text::TextBuffer& shared); std::unique_ptr<Text::TextBuffer> owned; /* declared BEFORE buffer; null when shared */ Text::TextBuffer& buffer; Text::SelectionSet selections; Text::DisplayMap display; void SyncDisplay(); }` (CANON A7: the shared-buffer form is TE2's, TE4-17's split builds its second model with it; TE4-12 adds `folds`, `editing`, `followForeignEdits`, `markerGeneration` and replaces `SyncDisplay`'s body with `Text::SyncDisplay(folds, display, buffer.Text())`; TE4-18 adds `indent`); `Text::EditContext DefaultEditContext(TextModel&)` (calls `model.SyncDisplay()`, fills the context from `Settings<TextSettings>()` through `ApplyEditSettings`, points `display` at `model.display`; TE4-18 adds `model.indent`); `class GlyphAdvances { virtual float Advance(char32_t) const; virtual float HexBoxAdvance() const; virtual float SpaceAdvance() const; }`; `enum class ClusterKind { Text, Tab, HexBox }`; `struct LayoutCluster { std::uint32_t byte, length; float x, width; ClusterKind kind; }`; `struct LineLayout { std::vector<Checkpoint> checkpoints; std::uint32_t bytes; float width; }`; `kLayoutCheckpointStride` (64); `void WalkClusters(...)`; `LineLayout BuildLineLayout(std::string_view, const GlyphAdvances&, std::uint32_t tabSize)`; `class LineCursor { float XForColumn(std::uint32_t); std::uint32_t ColumnForX(float); void ForEachVisible(float x0, float x1, fn); }`; `class LineLayoutCache { void Sync(const Text::TextBuffer&, std::uint64_t glyphGeneration, std::uint32_t tabSize); const LineLayout& Get(const Text::Rope&, std::uint32_t row, const GlyphAdvances&); void Clear(); }`; `float GutterWidth(std::uint32_t lineCount, float digitAdvance, TextLineNumbers)`; `std::optional<std::uint32_t> GutterNumber(std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t cursorRow, TextLineNumbers)`; `struct RowRange { std::uint32_t first, last; }`; `RowRange VisibleDisplayRows(float scrollY, float viewHeight, float lineHeight, std::uint32_t displayRowCount)`. TE4's split view and soft-wrap layer reuse `LineCursor`.

Every command runs through TE1's `Text::TextCommands` class constructed over the model: `Text::TextCommands cmds(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model));` (CANON A3: there is no `TextCommandContext` and no free-function `TextCommands` namespace).

Design: a line's layout stores only a checkpoint `{byte, x}` every `kLayoutCheckpointStride` clusters. `XForColumn` / `ColumnForX` binary-search the checkpoints and walk at most one stride of clusters, copying just that window out of the rope; drawing walks only the windows that intersect the visible x range. A line's layout is built once (one walk) and survives edits to other rows: `Sync` replays the buffer's edit log, dropping touched rows and shifting the rest by `rowDelta`.

`ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextLayoutTest.cpp`:
```cpp
// Text editor TE2-11 (spec s5.1, s3.5): cluster widths (tabs to the next stop,
// invalid bytes and control characters as hex boxes, combining marks inside
// their cluster), the x-prefix checkpoints, column <-> x through them, and the
// cache surviving edits to other rows.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>

#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextLayout.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;
using Arcane::Text::Rope;

namespace
{
    // 10 px per code point, CJK 20, combining marks 0; hex box 24; space 10.
    struct FixedGlyphs final : GlyphAdvances
    {
        float Advance(char32_t cp) const override
        {
            if (cp >= 0x0300 && cp <= 0x036F) return 0.0f;
            if (cp >= 0x4E00 && cp <= 0x9FFF) return 20.0f;
            return 10.0f;
        }
        float HexBoxAdvance() const override { return 24.0f; }
        float SpaceAdvance() const override { return 10.0f; }
    };

    std::vector<LayoutCluster> Clusters(std::string_view line, std::uint32_t tab = 4)
    {
        std::vector<LayoutCluster> out;
        WalkClusters(line, 0, 0.0f, FixedGlyphs{}, tab, [&](const LayoutCluster& c) { out.push_back(c); return true; });
        return out;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("text layout: tabs stop on the grid, invalid bytes and controls are hex boxes, marks join their base", "[text-view]")
{
    const auto a = Clusters("ab\tc");
    REQUIRE(a.size() == 4u);
    CHECK(a[2].kind == ClusterKind::Tab);
    CHECK(a[2].x == 20.0f);
    CHECK(a[2].width == 20.0f);                 // 20 -> the next 40 px stop
    CHECK(a[3].x == 40.0f);
    CHECK(BuildLineLayout("ab\tc", FixedGlyphs{}, 4).width == 50.0f);
    CHECK(Clusters("\t")[0].width == 40.0f);    // a tab at a stop advances a full stop

    const auto b = Clusters("a\xE9" "b");       // an invalid byte: its own cluster, a hex box
    REQUIRE(b.size() == 3u);
    CHECK(b[1].kind == ClusterKind::HexBox);
    CHECK(b[1].length == 1u);
    CHECK(b[1].width == 24.0f);
    CHECK(b[2].x == 34.0f);

    CHECK(Clusters("\x01")[0].kind == ClusterKind::HexBox);   // a control character
    const auto c = Clusters("e\xCC\x81x");      // e + U+0301 combining acute: one cluster
    REQUIRE(c.size() == 2u);
    CHECK(c[0].length == 3u);
    CHECK(c[0].width == 10.0f);
    CHECK(Clusters("\xE4\xB8\xAD")[0].width == 20.0f);       // a wide CJK glyph
}

TEST_CASE("text layout: checkpoints every stride; column <-> x through them", "[text-view]")
{
    const std::string longLine(1000, 'x');
    const LineLayout L = BuildLineLayout(longLine, FixedGlyphs{}, 4);
    CHECK(L.bytes == 1000u);
    CHECK(L.width == 10000.0f);
    CHECK(L.checkpoints.size() == 16u);         // clusters 0, 64, ..., 960
    CHECK(L.checkpoints[3].byte == 3u * kLayoutCheckpointStride);
    CHECK(L.checkpoints[3].x == 10.0f * 3u * kLayoutCheckpointStride);

    const Rope rope = Rope::FromUtf8("first\n" + longLine + "\nlast");
    const FixedGlyphs g;
    LineCursor cur(rope, 1, L, g, 4);
    CHECK(cur.XForColumn(130) == 1300.0f);
    CHECK(cur.XForColumn(5000) == 10000.0f);     // past the end: the line's width
    CHECK(cur.ColumnForX(1304.0f) == 130u);      // nearer the left edge of cluster 130
    CHECK(cur.ColumnForX(1306.0f) == 131u);      // nearer its right edge
    CHECK(cur.ColumnForX(-5.0f) == 0u);
    CHECK(cur.ColumnForX(99999.0f) == 1000u);
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> seen;
    cur.ForEachVisible(2000.0f, 2100.0f, [&](const LayoutCluster& c, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        seen.push_back(c.byte);
        CHECK(bytes == "x");
    });
    REQUIRE(seen.size() == 10u);
    CHECK(seen.front() == 200u);
    CHECK(seen.back() == 209u);
}

TEST_CASE("text layout: ColumnForX inverts XForColumn at every cluster boundary (property)", "[text-view]")
{
    rc::prop("round trip", [] {
        const std::vector<int> picks = *rc::gen::container<std::vector<int>>(rc::gen::inRange(0, 6));
        std::string line;
        for (const int p : picks)
            line += p == 0 ? "a" : p == 1 ? "\t" : p == 2 ? "\xC3\xA9" : p == 3 ? "\xE9" : p == 4 ? "\xE4\xB8\xAD" : "e\xCC\x81";
        const FixedGlyphs g;
        const LineLayout L = BuildLineLayout(line, g, 4);
        const Rope rope = Rope::FromUtf8(line);
        LineCursor cur(rope, 0, L, g, 4);
        float lastX = -1.0f;
        WalkClusters(line, 0, 0.0f, g, 4, [&](const LayoutCluster& c)
        {
            RC_ASSERT(cur.XForColumn(c.byte) == c.x);
            RC_ASSERT(cur.ColumnForX(c.x + 0.25f) == c.byte);
            RC_ASSERT(c.x > lastX);
            lastX = c.x;
            return true;
        });
        RC_ASSERT(cur.XForColumn(L.bytes) == L.width);
    });
}

TEST_CASE("text layout: the cache keeps rows an edit did not touch and shifts the rows below it", "[text-view]")
{
    TextModel model(Rope::FromUtf8("aaaa\nbbbb\ncccc\ndddd"));
    const FixedGlyphs g;
    LineLayoutCache cache;
    cache.Sync(model.buffer, 1, 4);
    const Rope& before = model.buffer.Text();
    for (std::uint32_t row = 0; row < 4; ++row) (void)cache.Get(before, row, g);
    CHECK(cache.Size() == 4u);

    // Insert a new line inside row 1: row 1 is touched, rows 2..3 move down by one.
    {
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands cmds(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model));
        cmds.SetSelections({ Arcane::Text::Selection{ 0, 7, 7, std::nullopt } });
        cmds.InsertText("X\nY");
    }
    cache.Sync(model.buffer, 1, 4);
    CHECK(cache.Size() == 3u);                   // rows 0, 3, 4 (old 0, 2, 3)
    const Rope& after = model.buffer.Text();
    CHECK(cache.Get(after, 4, g).width == 40.0f);   // old row 3, kept and shifted
    cache.Sync(model.buffer, 2, 4);              // a font change
    CHECK(cache.Size() == 0u);
}

TEST_CASE("text model: owns a buffer built from text and line endings; the display map is synced at once", "[text-view]")
{
    TextModel model(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\nc"), Arcane::Text::EolMap(Arcane::Text::Eol::CRLF));
    REQUIRE(model.owned != nullptr);
    CHECK(&model.buffer == model.owned.get());
    CHECK(model.buffer.Eols().Dominant() == Arcane::Text::Eol::CRLF);
    CHECK_FALSE(model.buffer.Dirty());
    CHECK(model.display.DisplayRowCount() == 3u);    // the constructor ran SyncDisplay

    const Arcane::Text::EditContext ctx = DefaultEditContext(model);
    CHECK(ctx.display == &model.display);
    CHECK(ctx.tabSize == Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().tabSize);
    CHECK(ctx.insertSpaces == Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().insertSpaces);

    TextModel lf(Rope::FromUtf8("x"));                 // the default EolMap: LF
    CHECK(lf.buffer.Eols().Dominant() == Arcane::Text::Eol::LF);
}

TEST_CASE("text model: two models over one buffer see each other's edits and keep their own selections", "[text-view]")
{
    TextModel first(Rope::FromUtf8("one\ntwo"));
    TextModel second(first.buffer);
    CHECK(second.owned == nullptr);
    CHECK(&second.buffer == &first.buffer);

    {
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands cmds(first.buffer, first.selections, DefaultEditContext(first));
        cmds.SetSelections({ Arcane::Text::Selection{ 0, 3, 3, std::nullopt } });
        cmds.InsertText("!");
    }
    CHECK(second.buffer.Text().ToString() == "one!\ntwo");
    CHECK(second.selections.Primary().head == 0u);    // its own cursor, untouched

    {
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands cmds(second.buffer, second.selections, DefaultEditContext(second));
        cmds.MoveDocumentEnd(false);
        cmds.InsertText("\nthree");
    }
    CHECK(first.buffer.Text().ToString() == "one!\ntwo\nthree");
    CHECK(first.selections.Primary().head == 4u);
    first.SyncDisplay();                               // the version moved: the row count follows
    CHECK(first.display.DisplayRowCount() == 3u);
}

TEST_CASE("text layout: gutter width, gutter numbers and the visible row window", "[text-view]")
{
    CHECK(GutterWidth(10, 8.0f, TextLineNumbers::Absolute) == 40.0f);      // 3 digits minimum + 2 padding
    CHECK(GutterWidth(123456, 8.0f, TextLineNumbers::Relative) == 64.0f);  // 6 digits + 2
    CHECK(GutterWidth(10, 8.0f, TextLineNumbers::Off) == 8.0f);
    CHECK(GutterNumber(4, 9, TextLineNumbers::Absolute) == 5u);
    CHECK(GutterNumber(4, 9, TextLineNumbers::Relative) == 5u);
    CHECK(GutterNumber(9, 9, TextLineNumbers::Relative) == 0u);
    CHECK(GutterNumber(9, 9, TextLineNumbers::Hybrid) == 10u);
    CHECK(GutterNumber(12, 9, TextLineNumbers::Hybrid) == 3u);
    CHECK_FALSE(GutterNumber(4, 9, TextLineNumbers::Off).has_value());
    const RowRange r = VisibleDisplayRows(45.0f, 100.0f, 20.0f, 1000);
    CHECK(r.first == 2u);
    CHECK(r.last == 9u);                         // rows 2..7 visible, one row of margin
    CHECK(VisibleDisplayRows(0.0f, 100.0f, 20.0f, 3).last == 3u);
    CHECK(VisibleDisplayRows(0.0f, 100.0f, 0.0f, 3).last == 0u);
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text a view shows and edits (text editor spec s2, s3): a buffer, this
// view's selections and the buffer-row <-> display-row map. TextDocument's
// primary model owns its buffer; a split view (TE4-17) builds a second model
// over the SAME buffer with the shared-buffer constructor, with its own
// SelectionSet + DisplayMap (CANON A7).

#include "TextEditor/Core/DisplayMap.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/EolMap.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct TextModel
    {
        // A model that owns a new buffer over `text` (history empty, clean).
        explicit TextModel(Text::Rope text, Text::EolMap eols = {});
        // A model over a buffer someone else owns (a split view's second model).
        explicit TextModel(Text::TextBuffer& shared);
        TextModel(const TextModel&) = delete;
        TextModel& operator=(const TextModel&) = delete;

        std::unique_ptr<Text::TextBuffer> owned;   // declared BEFORE `buffer`; null when shared
        Text::TextBuffer&  buffer;
        Text::SelectionSet selections;
        Text::DisplayMap   display;

        // Rebuilds `display` when the buffer's version (TE4-12: or the fold
        // set) changed since the last call. Called at the start of
        // TextEditorView::Draw and by DefaultEditContext before every command.
        void SyncDisplay();

        // SyncDisplay's bookkeeping.
        std::uint64_t displaySyncedVersion = 0;
        bool          displaySynced = false;
    };

    // The EditContext every command over `model` takes: model.SyncDisplay(),
    // then today's editor.text.* editing settings (ApplyEditSettings) and the
    // model's display map. TE4-24's TextDocument::MakeEditContext builds on it.
    [[nodiscard]] Text::EditContext DefaultEditContext(TextModel& model);
}
```

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <utility>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    TextModel::TextModel(Text::Rope text, Text::EolMap eols)
        : owned(std::make_unique<Text::TextBuffer>(std::move(text), std::move(eols))), buffer(*owned)
    {
        SyncDisplay();
    }

    TextModel::TextModel(Text::TextBuffer& shared) : owned(), buffer(shared)
    {
        SyncDisplay();
    }

    void TextModel::SyncDisplay()
    {
        if (displaySynced && displaySyncedVersion == buffer.Version())
            return;
        display.SetFolds({}, buffer.Text().LineCount());   // no folds before TE4-12
        displaySyncedVersion = buffer.Version();
        displaySynced = true;
    }

    Text::EditContext DefaultEditContext(TextModel& model)
    {
        model.SyncDisplay();
        Text::EditContext ctx;
        ApplyEditSettings(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>(), ctx);
        ctx.display = &model.display;
        return ctx;
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// Per-line horizontal layout (text editor spec s5.1). A line is a sequence of
// clusters -- a grapheme cluster, a tab, or a hex box (an invalid UTF-8 byte or
// a control character, spec s3.5) -- each with its x. A line's layout keeps
// only a checkpoint {byte, x} every kLayoutCheckpointStride clusters, so column
// <-> x is a binary search plus a walk of at most one stride, and drawing a
// long line copies only the windows the view can see.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    ARC_CONSTANT("layout: clusters between two x-prefix checkpoints; bounds every column <-> x walk (spec s5.1)")
    inline constexpr std::uint32_t kLayoutCheckpointStride = 64;

    // The advances a layout asks for: the view answers from the pushed ImGui
    // font, tests from a fixed-width fake.
    class GlyphAdvances
    {
    public:
        virtual ~GlyphAdvances() = default;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual float Advance(char32_t cp) const = 0;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual float HexBoxAdvance() const = 0;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual float SpaceAdvance() const = 0;
    };

    enum class ClusterKind : std::uint8_t { Text, Tab, HexBox };

    struct LayoutCluster
    {
        std::uint32_t byte = 0;      // byte column in the line
        std::uint32_t length = 0;
        float         x = 0.0f;      // from the line start
        float         width = 0.0f;
        ClusterKind   kind = ClusterKind::Text;
    };

    struct LineLayout
    {
        struct Checkpoint
        {
            std::uint32_t byte = 0;
            float         x = 0.0f;
        };
        std::vector<Checkpoint> checkpoints;   // [0] = {0, 0}
        std::uint32_t bytes = 0;
        float width = 0.0f;
    };

    // Visits the clusters of `text` -- bytes [base, base + size) of a line,
    // starting on a cluster boundary whose x is `startX`. Stops when fn returns false.
    void WalkClusters(std::string_view text, std::uint32_t base, float startX, const GlyphAdvances& glyphs,
                      std::uint32_t tabSize, const std::function<bool(const LayoutCluster&)>& fn);
    [[nodiscard]] LineLayout BuildLineLayout(std::string_view line, const GlyphAdvances& glyphs, std::uint32_t tabSize);

    // Column <-> x and the visible clusters of one buffer row, reading the rope
    // one checkpoint window at a time. The string_view handed to
    // ForEachVisible's callback is valid only during that call.
    class LineCursor
    {
    public:
        LineCursor(const Text::Rope& rope, std::uint32_t row, const LineLayout& layout, const GlyphAdvances& glyphs,
                   std::uint32_t tabSize);
        [[nodiscard]] float XForColumn(std::uint32_t byteCol);   // inside a cluster: its start
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t ColumnForX(float x);          // the nearest cluster boundary
        void ForEachVisible(float x0, float x1, const std::function<void(const LayoutCluster&, std::string_view)>& fn);

    private:
        [[nodiscard]] std::string_view Window(std::size_t checkpoint);

        const Text::Rope&    m_rope;
        const LineLayout&    m_layout;
        const GlyphAdvances& m_glyphs;
        std::uint32_t        m_tab;
        Text::ByteOffset     m_lineStart;
        std::string          m_scratch;
    };

    // One layout per buffer row, kept across edits to other rows.
    class LineLayoutCache
    {
    public:
        // Replays the buffer's edits since the last Sync (drops touched rows,
        // shifts the rows below by rowDelta); clears on a glyph or tab change.
        void Sync(const Text::TextBuffer& buffer, std::uint64_t glyphGeneration, std::uint32_t tabSize);
        [[nodiscard]] const LineLayout& Get(const Text::Rope& rope, std::uint32_t row, const GlyphAdvances& glyphs);
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t Size() const noexcept { return m_rows.size(); }
        void Clear() { m_rows.clear(); m_synced = false; }

    private:
        std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t, LineLayout> m_rows;
        std::uint64_t m_version = 0;
        std::uint64_t m_glyphs = 0;
        std::uint32_t m_tab = 1;
        bool          m_synced = false;
        std::string   m_scratch;
    };

    // ---- gutter and rows --------------------------------------------------------
    [[nodiscard]] float GutterWidth(std::uint32_t lineCount, float digitAdvance, TextLineNumbers mode);
    // The number the gutter shows for `row` (0-based) with the cursor on `cursorRow`; nullopt = none.
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::uint32_t> GutterNumber(std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t cursorRow, TextLineNumbers mode);
    struct RowRange
    {
        std::uint32_t first = 0, last = 0;   // display rows [first, last)
    };
    [[nodiscard]] RowRange VisibleDisplayRows(float scrollY, float viewHeight, float lineHeight, std::uint32_t displayRowCount);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextLayout.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextLayout.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/Graphemes.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    void WalkClusters(std::string_view text, std::uint32_t base, float startX, const GlyphAdvances& g,
                      std::uint32_t tabSize, const std::function<bool(const LayoutCluster&)>& fn)
    {
        const float tabStop = g.SpaceAdvance() * static_cast<float>(std::max<std::uint32_t>(tabSize, 1));
        std::size_t i = 0;
        float x = startX;
        while (i < text.size())
        {
            const std::size_t next = std::min(text.size(), std::max(i + 1, Text::NextGraphemeBoundary(text, i)));
            LayoutCluster c;
            c.byte = base + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i);
            c.length = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(next - i);
            c.x = x;
            const Text::Utf8::Unit d = Text::Utf8::DecodeAt(text, i);
            if (!d.valid || d.cp < 0x20 || d.cp == 0x7F)
            {
                if (d.valid && d.cp == U'\t')
                {
                    c.kind = ClusterKind::Tab;
                    c.width = tabStop - std::fmod(x, tabStop);
                    if (c.width < g.SpaceAdvance() * 0.5f)   // float drift just short of a stop
                        c.width += tabStop;
                }
                else
                {
                    c.kind = ClusterKind::HexBox;
                    c.width = g.HexBoxAdvance();
                }
            }
            else
            {
                c.kind = ClusterKind::Text;
                float w = 0.0f;
                for (std::size_t j = i; j < next;)
                {
                    const Text::Utf8::Unit dj = Text::Utf8::DecodeAt(text, j);
                    w += dj.valid ? g.Advance(dj.cp) : g.HexBoxAdvance();
                    j += std::max<std::size_t>(1, dj.length);
                }
                c.width = w;
            }
            if (!fn(c))
                return;
            x += c.width;
            i = next;
        }
    }

    LineLayout BuildLineLayout(std::string_view line, const GlyphAdvances& g, std::uint32_t tabSize)
    {
        LineLayout L;
        L.bytes = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(line.size());
        L.checkpoints.push_back({ 0, 0.0f });
        std::uint32_t n = 0;
        WalkClusters(line, 0, 0.0f, g, tabSize, [&](const LayoutCluster& c)
        {
            if (n > 0 && n % kLayoutCheckpointStride == 0)
                L.checkpoints.push_back({ c.byte, c.x });
            ++n;
            L.width = c.x + c.width;
            return true;
        });
        return L;
    }

    LineCursor::LineCursor(const Text::Rope& rope, std::uint32_t row, const LineLayout& layout,
                           const GlyphAdvances& glyphs, std::uint32_t tabSize)
        : m_rope(rope), m_layout(layout), m_glyphs(glyphs), m_tab(tabSize), m_lineStart(rope.LineStart(row))
    {
    }

    std::string_view LineCursor::Window(std::size_t k)
    {
        const std::uint32_t from = m_layout.checkpoints[k].byte;
        const std::uint32_t to = k + 1 < m_layout.checkpoints.size() ? m_layout.checkpoints[k + 1].byte : m_layout.bytes;
        m_scratch.clear();
        m_rope.CopyTo(Text::ByteRange{ m_lineStart + from, m_lineStart + to }, m_scratch);
        return m_scratch;
    }

    float LineCursor::XForColumn(std::uint32_t col)
    {
        if (col >= m_layout.bytes)
            return m_layout.width;
        const auto& cps = m_layout.checkpoints;
        const auto it = std::upper_bound(cps.begin(), cps.end(), col,
                                         [](std::uint32_t c, const LineLayout::Checkpoint& p) { return c < p.byte; });
        const std::size_t k = static_cast<std::size_t>(it - cps.begin()) - 1;
        float result = cps[k].x;
        WalkClusters(Window(k), cps[k].byte, cps[k].x, m_glyphs, m_tab, [&](const LayoutCluster& c)
        {
            if (c.byte + c.length > col) { result = c.x; return false; }
            result = c.x + c.width;
            return true;
        });
        return result;
    }

    std::uint32_t LineCursor::ColumnForX(float x)
    {
        if (x <= 0.0f)
            return 0;
        if (x >= m_layout.width)
            return m_layout.bytes;
        const auto& cps = m_layout.checkpoints;
        const auto it = std::upper_bound(cps.begin(), cps.end(), x,
                                         [](float v, const LineLayout::Checkpoint& p) { return v < p.x; });
        const std::size_t k = static_cast<std::size_t>(it - cps.begin()) - 1;
        std::uint32_t result = k + 1 < cps.size() ? cps[k + 1].byte : m_layout.bytes;
        WalkClusters(Window(k), cps[k].byte, cps[k].x, m_glyphs, m_tab, [&](const LayoutCluster& c)
        {
            if (x < c.x + c.width)
            {
                result = x < c.x + c.width * 0.5f ? c.byte : c.byte + c.length;
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        });
        return result;
    }

    void LineCursor::ForEachVisible(float x0, float x1, const std::function<void(const LayoutCluster&, std::string_view)>& fn)
    {
        if (m_layout.bytes == 0)
            return;
        const auto& cps = m_layout.checkpoints;
        const auto it = std::upper_bound(cps.begin(), cps.end(), x0,
                                         [](float v, const LineLayout::Checkpoint& p) { return v < p.x; });
        std::size_t k = it == cps.begin() ? 0 : static_cast<std::size_t>(it - cps.begin()) - 1;
        for (; k < cps.size(); ++k)
        {
            if (cps[k].x >= x1)
                break;
            const std::string_view w = Window(k);
            const std::uint32_t windowStart = cps[k].byte;
            bool past = false;
            WalkClusters(w, windowStart, cps[k].x, m_glyphs, m_tab, [&](const LayoutCluster& c)
            {
                if (c.x >= x1) { past = true; return false; }
                if (c.x + c.width > x0)
                    fn(c, w.substr(c.byte - windowStart, c.length));
                return true;
            });
            if (past)
                break;
        }
    }

    void LineLayoutCache::Sync(const Text::TextBuffer& buffer, std::uint64_t glyphGeneration, std::uint32_t tabSize)
    {
        if (!m_synced || glyphGeneration != m_glyphs || tabSize != m_tab)
        {
            m_rows.clear();
            m_glyphs = glyphGeneration;
            m_tab = tabSize;
            m_version = buffer.Version();
            m_synced = true;
            return;
        }
        if (buffer.Version() == m_version)
            return;
        if (!buffer.EditLogCovers(m_version))
        {
            m_rows.clear();   // the log no longer reaches back this far: rebuild what is drawn
            m_version = buffer.Version();
            return;
        }
        for (const Text::EditLogEntry& e : buffer.EditsSince(m_version))
        {
            std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t, LineLayout> next;
            next.reserve(m_rows.size());
            for (auto& [row, layout] : m_rows)
            {
                if (row < e.firstRow)
                    next.emplace(row, std::move(layout));
                else if (row > e.lastRowBefore)
                    next.emplace(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(row) + e.rowDelta), std::move(layout));
            }
            m_rows = std::move(next);
        }
        m_version = buffer.Version();
    }

    const LineLayout& LineLayoutCache::Get(const Text::Rope& rope, std::uint32_t row, const GlyphAdvances& glyphs)
    {
        if (const auto it = m_rows.find(row); it != m_rows.end())
            return it->second;
        m_scratch.clear();
        rope.CopyTo(Text::ByteRange{ rope.LineStart(row), rope.LineEnd(row) }, m_scratch);
        return m_rows.emplace(row, BuildLineLayout(m_scratch, glyphs, m_tab)).first->second;
    }

    float GutterWidth(std::uint32_t lineCount, float digitAdvance, TextLineNumbers mode)
    {
        if (mode == TextLineNumbers::Off)
            return digitAdvance;
        std::uint32_t digits = 1;
        for (std::uint32_t n = lineCount; n >= 10; n /= 10)
            ++digits;
        return static_cast<float>(std::max<std::uint32_t>(digits, 3) + 2) * digitAdvance;
    }

    std::optional<std::uint32_t> GutterNumber(std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t cursorRow, TextLineNumbers mode)
    {
        const std::uint32_t distance = row > cursorRow ? row - cursorRow : cursorRow - row;
        switch (mode)
        {
        case TextLineNumbers::Off:      return std::nullopt;
        case TextLineNumbers::Absolute: return row + 1;
        case TextLineNumbers::Relative: return distance;
        case TextLineNumbers::Hybrid:   return row == cursorRow ? row + 1 : distance;
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    RowRange VisibleDisplayRows(float scrollY, float viewHeight, float lineHeight, std::uint32_t count)
    {
        if (lineHeight <= 0.0f || count == 0)
            return {};
        const auto clampRow = [&](double v) { return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::clamp(v, 0.0, static_cast<double>(count))); };
        RowRange r;
        r.first = clampRow(std::floor(scrollY / lineHeight));
        r.last = clampRow(std::ceil((scrollY + viewHeight) / lineHeight) + 1.0);
        return r;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-12 (spec s5.1): text documents draw with editor.text.font --
// the mono face itself unless a different family is asked for.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Widgets/EditorFonts.hpp"

#include <imgui.h>
#include <imgui_internal.h>

#include <filesystem>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    struct ScopedFontContext
    {
        ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
        ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
        ScopedFontContext()
        {
            ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
            ctx->DebugLogFlags &= ~ImGuiDebugLogFlags_OutputToTTY;
        }
        ~ScopedFontContext()
        {
            ForgetEditorFonts();
            ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
            ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
        }
    };
}

TEST_CASE("text font: WithTextFace resolves the family and clears it when it is the mono face", "[text-view]")

    CHECK(WithTextFace(base, families, "No Such Family").textFace.empty());   // falls back to JetBrains Mono == mono

    }
}
```

```cpp
        g_fonts.text = (r.textFace.empty() || r.textFace == r.monoFace)
                     ? g_fonts.mono
                     : AddFaceOrBundled(io, r.textFace, bundled.monoFace, lucide, r.sizePx);
```

### Task TE2-13: `TextEditorView` v1 -- visible rows, gutter, selections, carets, hex boxes, typing, IME position, Ctrl+wheel zoom (spec s5.1, s5.5)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.cpp`
- Modify: `premake5.lua` (TE2 block: add `TextEditorView.cpp`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextEditorViewTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `TextModel` (+ `SyncDisplay()`), `DefaultEditContext`, `LineLayoutCache`, `LineCursor`, `GlyphAdvances`, `GutterWidth`, `GutterNumber`, `VisibleDisplayRows` (TE2-11); `GetEditorFonts().text` (TE2-12); `ReadImGuiTextInput`, `BuildTextInputFrame`, `TextNamedKey`, `TextInputHook::Get()` (`Layout()`, `ImeAllowed()`, `TakeCommandModeChars()`) (TE2-10); `TextSettings` (TE2-2: `fontSize`, `lineNumbers`, `caretBlink`, `highlightCurrentLine`; TE1: `std::uint32_t tabSize`, `insertSpaces`); TE1's `Text::TextCommands` class (CANON A3: `TextCommands(TextBuffer&, SelectionSet&, EditContext)`, `InsertText`, `Newline`, `Tab`, `Backspace`, `DeleteForward`, `MoveLeft/Right/Up/Down(bool)`, `MoveLineStart/End(bool)`, `MoveDocumentStart/End(bool)`, `MovePageUp/Down(std::uint32_t, bool)`, `SingleSelection`, `SetSelections(std::vector<Selection>)`), `Text::EditContext`, `SelectionSet::{All, Primary, Size}`, `Rope::{OffsetToPoint, LineStart, LineEnd, LineCount, Summary}`, `DisplayMap::{DisplayRowCount, DisplayRowToBuffer, BufferRowToDisplay}`.
- Produces: `struct ViewColorRun { std::uint32_t byteStart; ImU32 color; }`; `using RowColorRunsFn = std::function<bool(std::uint32_t bufferRow, std::vector<ViewColorRun>& out)>;` (**TE3**: `view.SetRowColorRuns([&](row, out){ if (const LineTokens* t = cache.Line(row)) { for (r : t->runs) out.push_back({ r.byteStart, scopeMap.Color(r.scope) }); return true; } return false; })` -- rows return false draw plain); `struct TextViewFacts { std::uint32_t firstVisibleRow, visibleRows; float lineHeight, gutterWidth; ImVec2 textOrigin, clipMin, clipMax, caretScreen; bool keyboardActive; }`; `class TextEditorView { explicit TextEditorView(TextModel&); void Rebind(TextModel&); void Draw(const char* strId, const ImVec2& size, bool readOnly); void SetRowColorRuns(RowColorRunsFn); void Focus(); void RevealOffset(Text::ByteOffset, bool center); bool KeyboardActive() const; float Zoom() const; void SetZoom(float); const TextViewFacts& Facts() const; TextModel& Model(); void SetEditContextProvider(std::function<Text::EditContext(TextModel&)>); }`. Every command the view runs goes through `Text::TextCommands(m_model->buffer, m_model->selections, MakeContext())`, where `MakeContext()` calls the provider (default: `DefaultEditContext`, TE2-11; **TE4-24** installs `[this](TextModel& m){ return MakeEditContext(m); }` on every view, so typing gets the document's indentation, word characters, comment tokens and cursor-confirm hook). `Draw` calls `m_model->SyncDisplay()` first. The baseline keys (`ApplyBaselineKey`: unmodified/Shift arrows, Home/End, Ctrl+Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Backspace, Delete, Enter, Tab, Escape) are what **TE4** moves into rebindable `text.*` rows (TE4 deletes `ApplyBaselineKey`'s cases as it registers each row).

The widget owns the keyboard by holding ImGui's `ActiveId` while its window is focused (as `InputText` does), so `io.WantCaptureKeyboard` is true and the Global SDL-route shortcuts stand down (`EditorShortcutsLive`, ViewportInput.hpp:22-24); it claims Tab so ImGui's tabbing does not steal it, consumes `io.InputQueueCharacters`, and writes `ImGuiPlatformImeData` (`WantTextInput` always while active -- SDL3 needs it to emit text -- and `WantVisible` per `TextInputHook::ImeAllowed()`) at the primary caret. Mouse here is the click that places the caret; TE2-14 replaces `HandleMouse` with the full gesture model.

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-13 (spec s5.1, s5.5): the view on a bare ImGui context --
// geometry, keyboard ownership, typing, baseline keys, read-only, click to
// place the caret, IME position, Ctrl+wheel zoom, the TE3 colour-run seam.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <imgui.h>
#include <imgui_internal.h>

#include <functional>
#include <set>
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;
using Arcane::Text::Rope;

namespace
{
    struct ImGuiHarness
    {
        ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
        ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
        ImGuiHarness()
        {
            ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
            ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
            io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(1024, 768);
            io.IniFilename = nullptr;
            unsigned char* px = nullptr;
            int w = 0, h = 0;
            io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
        }
        ~ImGuiHarness()
        {
            ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
            ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
        }
        void Frame(const std::function<void()>& body)
        {
            ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
            ImGui::NewFrame();
            ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(0, 0));
            ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(600, 400));
            ImGui::Begin("doc", nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings);
            body();
            ImGui::End();
            ImGui::Render();
        }
    };

    std::string Text(const TextModel& m) { return m.buffer.Text().ToString(); }
}

TEST_CASE("text view: geometry, keyboard ownership and the IME position at the primary caret", "[text-view]")
{
    ImGuiHarness h;
    TextModel model(Rope::FromUtf8("first line\nsecond\nthird\n"));
    TextEditorView view(model);
    view.Focus();
    ImGuiPlatformImeData ime;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
        h.Frame([&] { view.Draw("##tv", ImVec2(0, 0), false); ime = ImGui::GetCurrentContext()->PlatformImeData; });
    const TextViewFacts& f = view.Facts();
    CHECK(f.keyboardActive);
    CHECK(view.KeyboardActive());
    CHECK(f.lineHeight > 0.0f);
    CHECK(f.gutterWidth > 0.0f);
    CHECK(f.visibleRows == 4u);                            // three lines and the empty last one
    CHECK(f.firstVisibleRow == 0u);
    CHECK(ime.WantTextInput);
    CHECK(ime.WantVisible);
    CHECK(ime.InputLineHeight == f.lineHeight);
    CHECK(ime.InputPos.y == f.caretScreen.y);
    CHECK(ImGui::GetIO().WantCaptureKeyboard);
}

TEST_CASE("text view: typed characters insert, baseline keys move and edit, read-only blocks edits only", "[text-view]")
{
    ImGuiHarness h;
    TextModel model(Rope::FromUtf8("abc\ndef"));
    TextEditorView view(model);
    view.Focus();
    const auto draw = [&](bool ro) { h.Frame([&] { view.Draw("##tv", ImVec2(0, 0), ro); }); };
    const auto key = [&](ImGuiKey k, bool ro = false) { ImGui::GetIO().AddKeyEvent(k, true); draw(ro); ImGui::GetIO().AddKeyEvent(k, false); draw(ro); };
    draw(false);

    ImGui::GetIO().AddInputCharacter('X');
    draw(false);
    CHECK(Text(model) == "Xabc\ndef");

    key(ImGuiKey_RightArrow);
    key(ImGuiKey_Backspace);
    CHECK(Text(model) == "Xbc\ndef");
    key(ImGuiKey_Enter);
    CHECK(Text(model) == "X\nbc\ndef");
    key(ImGuiKey_End);
    ImGui::GetIO().AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Shift, true);
    key(ImGuiKey_LeftArrow);
    ImGui::GetIO().AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Shift, false);
    draw(false);
    const auto& sel = model.selections.Primary();
    CHECK((sel.anchor > sel.head ? sel.anchor - sel.head : sel.head - sel.anchor) == 1u);   // Shift+Left selected one character

    const std::string before = Text(model);
    ImGui::GetIO().AddInputCharacter('Q');
    draw(true);
    key(ImGuiKey_Delete, true);
    CHECK(Text(model) == before);                          // read-only: nothing typed or deleted...
    key(ImGuiKey_Home, true);
    CHECK(model.selections.Primary().head == model.buffer.Text().LineStart(1));   // ...but the caret still moves

    key(ImGuiKey_Tab);
    const auto& s = Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>();
    CHECK(Text(model).substr(2, s.insertSpaces ? static_cast<std::size_t>(s.tabSize) : 1u)
          == (s.insertSpaces ? std::string(static_cast<std::size_t>(s.tabSize), ' ') : std::string("\t")));
}

TEST_CASE("text view: commands take the EditContext from the installed provider", "[text-view]")
{
    ImGuiHarness h;
    TextModel model(Rope::FromUtf8("abc"));

    CHECK(calls > 0);
}
```
