`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// TextEditorView v1 (text editor spec s5.1): a custom ImGui widget over a
// TextModel. It draws the VISIBLE rows only (through the DisplayMap), a
// line-number gutter, the current-line tint, per-row selection rectangles,
// every caret, invalid bytes and control characters as hex boxes, and token
// colours when a source supplies them (TE3, SetRowColorRuns). It owns the
// keyboard while active (ImGui ActiveId, as InputText does), reads named keys
// and characters through TextInput (spec s5.5), reports the IME position at
// the primary caret, and zooms per document with Ctrl+mouse wheel.

#include "TextEditor/View/TextInput.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextLayout.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"

#include <imgui.h>

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    // A colour run starting at byteStart, until the next run (TE3's token runs, coloured).
    struct ViewColorRun
    {
        std::uint32_t byteStart = 0;
        ImU32         color = 0;
    };
    // Fill `out` (sorted by byteStart) for a buffer row and return true; false = draw the row plain.
    using RowColorRunsFn = std::function<bool(std::uint32_t bufferRow, std::vector<ViewColorRun>& out)>;

    struct TextViewFacts
    {
        std::uint32_t firstVisibleRow = 0;   // buffer row
        std::uint32_t visibleRows = 0;
        float  lineHeight = 0.0f;
        float  gutterWidth = 0.0f;
        ImVec2 textOrigin{};                 // screen position of row 0, column 0 (scroll applied)
        ImVec2 clipMin{}, clipMax{};         // the widget's visible rect
        ImVec2 caretScreen{};                // top-left of the primary caret
        bool   keyboardActive = false;
    };

    // The EditContext every command of the view takes (CANON A7). Default:
    // DefaultEditContext (TE2-11); TE4-24 installs TextDocument::MakeEditContext.
    using EditContextProvider = std::function<Text::EditContext(TextModel&)>;

    class TextEditorView
    {
    public:
        explicit TextEditorView(TextModel& model);
        // The view now shows another model (layout cache and pending reveal reset).
        // Reopen with Encoding does NOT rebind: it reloads the same buffer (TE2-15).
        void Rebind(TextModel& model);

        // Draws the widget into `size` (0 = the remaining region). `readOnly` blocks edits, never selection.
        // Starts with m_model->SyncDisplay().
        void Draw(const char* strId, const ImVec2& size, bool readOnly);

        void SetRowColorRuns(RowColorRunsFn fn) { m_rowRuns = std::move(fn); }
        // Null restores the default (DefaultEditContext).
        void SetEditContextProvider(EditContextProvider provider) { m_contextProvider = std::move(provider); }
        void Focus() { m_wantFocus = true; }
        void RevealOffset(Text::ByteOffset offset, bool center) { m_pendingReveal = { offset, center }; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool KeyboardActive() const noexcept { return m_facts.keyboardActive; }
        [[nodiscard]] float Zoom() const noexcept { return m_zoom; }
        void SetZoom(float zoom);
        [[nodiscard]] const TextViewFacts& Facts() const noexcept { return m_facts; }
        [[nodiscard]] TextModel& Model() noexcept { return *m_model; }

    private:
        struct Geometry
        {
            ImVec2 textOrigin{};
            ImVec2 clipMin{}, clipMax{};
            float  gutterW = 0.0f;
            float  lineH = 0.0f;
            RowRange rows;
            const GlyphAdvances* glyphs = nullptr;
            std::uint32_t tab = 1;
        };

        void HandleMouse(const Geometry& g, bool hovered, bool readOnly);
        void HandleKeyboard(const Geometry& g, bool readOnly);
        void ApplyBaselineKey(Text::TextCommands& cmds, const TextKeyPress& k, bool readOnly, std::uint32_t pageRows);
        [[nodiscard]] Text::EditContext MakeContext();   // the provider's context, or DefaultEditContext
        void ApplyPendingReveal(const Geometry& g);
        void DrawRows(const Geometry& g, bool active);
        void Activate();
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Text::Selection> DisplayedSelections() const;
        [[nodiscard]] Text::ByteOffset OffsetAt(const Geometry& g, const ImVec2& screen);
        [[nodiscard]] ImVec2 ScreenPosOf(const Geometry& g, Text::ByteOffset offset);

        TextModel*      m_model;
        LineLayoutCache m_layouts;
        RowColorRunsFn  m_rowRuns;
        EditContextProvider m_contextProvider;
        TextViewFacts   m_facts;
        std::optional<std::pair<Text::ByteOffset, bool>> m_pendingReveal;
        std::vector<ViewColorRun> m_runs;
        ImFont*       m_lastFont = nullptr;
        float         m_lastSize = 0.0f;
        std::uint64_t m_glyphGeneration = 0;
        float         m_maxLineWidth = 0.0f;
        float         m_zoom = 1.0f;
        double        m_lastInputTime = 0.0;
        ImGuiID       m_id = 0;
        bool          m_wantFocus = false;
        bool          m_warnedUnsupported = false;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextInput.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextInputHook.hpp"
#include "Widgets/EditorFonts.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Base/Log.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <imgui_internal.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cfloat>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("UI: a hex box's width in digit advances -- two hex digits plus side padding (spec s3.5)")
        constexpr float kHexBoxDigits = 2.6f;
        ARC_CONSTANT("UI: Ctrl+wheel zoom -- per-notch factor and the clamp of the per-document multiplier (spec s5.1)")
        constexpr float kZoomStep = 1.1f, kZoomMin = 0.5f, kZoomMax = 4.0f;
        ARC_CONSTANT("UI timing: Dear ImGui InputText's caret blink -- period and visible part, seconds (imgui_widgets.cpp)")
        constexpr double kBlinkPeriod = 1.2, kBlinkOn = 0.8;

        class BakedAdvances final : public GlyphAdvances
        {
        public:
            explicit BakedAdvances(ImFontBaked* baked)
                : m_baked(baked), m_space(baked->GetCharAdvance(' ')), m_digit(baked->GetCharAdvance('0')) {}
            float Advance(char32_t cp) const override
            {
                // ImGui is built with 16-bit ImWchar: a code point past the BMP draws as the replacement glyph.
                return m_baked->GetCharAdvance(cp <= 0xFFFF ? static_cast<ImWchar>(cp)
                                                            : static_cast<ImWchar>(IM_UNICODE_CODEPOINT_INVALID));
            }
            float HexBoxAdvance() const override { return m_digit * kHexBoxDigits; }
            float SpaceAdvance() const override { return m_space; }
            [[nodiscard]] float DigitAdvance() const { return m_digit; }
        private:
            ImFontBaked* m_baked;
            float m_space;
            float m_digit;
        };

        Text::ByteOffset SelMin(const Text::Selection& s) { return std::min(s.anchor, s.head); }
        Text::ByteOffset SelMax(const Text::Selection& s) { return std::max(s.anchor, s.head); }
    }

    TextEditorView::TextEditorView(TextModel& model) : m_model(&model) {}

    void TextEditorView::Rebind(TextModel& model)
    {
        m_model = &model;
        m_layouts.Clear();
        m_pendingReveal.reset();
        m_maxLineWidth = 0.0f;
    }

    void TextEditorView::SetZoom(float zoom)
    {
        m_zoom = std::clamp(zoom, kZoomMin, kZoomMax);
    }

    Text::EditContext TextEditorView::MakeContext()
    {
        return m_contextProvider ? m_contextProvider(*m_model) : DefaultEditContext(*m_model);
    }

    std::vector<Text::Selection> TextEditorView::DisplayedSelections() const
    {
        const auto all = m_model->selections.All();
        return std::vector<Text::Selection>(all.begin(), all.end());
    }

    void TextEditorView::Activate()
    {
        ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow();
        ImGui::SetActiveID(m_id, window);
        ImGui::SetFocusID(m_id, window);
        ImGui::FocusWindow(window);
        m_lastInputTime = ImGui::GetTime();
    }

    void TextEditorView::Draw(const char* strId, const ImVec2& size, bool readOnly)
    {
        m_model->SyncDisplay();   // the display map follows the buffer (TE4-12: and the folds) before any row math
        const TextSettings& settings = Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>();
        ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
        ImGui::PushFont(GetEditorFonts().text, settings.fontSize * m_zoom);   // null font = keep the current face (headless)
        const ImGuiWindowFlags flags = ImGuiWindowFlags_HorizontalScrollbar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove
                                     | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs | (io.KeyCtrl ? ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollWithMouse : 0);
        ImGui::BeginChild(strId, size, ImGuiChildFlags_None, flags);
        ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow();
        ImGuiContext& gctx = *ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
        m_id = window->GetID("##text");

        if (ImGui::GetFont() != m_lastFont || ImGui::GetFontSize() != m_lastSize)
        {
            m_lastFont = ImGui::GetFont();
            m_lastSize = ImGui::GetFontSize();
            ++m_glyphGeneration;
            m_maxLineWidth = 0.0f;
        }
        const BakedAdvances glyphs(ImGui::GetFontBaked());
        Geometry g;
        g.glyphs = &glyphs;
        g.tab = std::max<std::uint32_t>(1u, settings.tabSize);
        m_layouts.Sync(m_model->buffer, m_glyphGeneration, g.tab);

        const Text::Rope& rope = m_model->buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t displayRows = m_model->display.DisplayRowCount();
        g.lineH = ImGui::GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing();
        g.gutterW = GutterWidth(rope.LineCount(), glyphs.DigitAdvance(), settings.lineNumbers);
        const float widthGuess = static_cast<float>(rope.Summary().longestLineBytes) * glyphs.SpaceAdvance();
        ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(g.gutterW + std::max(m_maxLineWidth, widthGuess) + glyphs.SpaceAdvance() * 4.0f,
                            static_cast<float>(displayRows) * g.lineH));

        const ImRect inner = window->InnerRect;
        g.clipMin = inner.Min;
        g.clipMax = inner.Max;
        g.textOrigin = ImVec2(inner.Min.x + g.gutterW - ImGui::GetScrollX(), inner.Min.y - ImGui::GetScrollY());
        g.rows = VisibleDisplayRows(ImGui::GetScrollY(), inner.GetHeight(), g.lineH, displayRows);

        ImGui::ItemAdd(inner, m_id);
        const bool hovered = ImGui::ItemHoverable(inner, m_id, ImGuiItemFlags_None);

        const bool windowFocused = ImGui::IsWindowFocused(ImGuiFocusedFlags_RootAndChildWindows);
        if (m_wantFocus || (windowFocused && gctx.ActiveId == 0))
        {
            Activate();
            m_wantFocus = false;
        }
        if (gctx.ActiveId == m_id)
        {
            ImGui::KeepAliveID(m_id);
            gctx.ActiveIdUsingNavDirMask = ~static_cast<ImU32>(0);
            ImGui::SetKeyOwner(ImGuiKey_Tab, m_id);   // ImGui's tabbing must not steal Tab
        }

        HandleMouse(g, hovered, readOnly);
        const bool active = gctx.ActiveId == m_id;
        if (active)
            HandleKeyboard(g, readOnly);
        if (hovered && io.KeyCtrl && io.MouseWheel != 0.0f)
            SetZoom(m_zoom * (io.MouseWheel > 0.0f ? kZoomStep : 1.0f / kZoomStep));
        ApplyPendingReveal(g);
        DrawRows(g, active);

        m_facts.keyboardActive = active;
        m_facts.lineHeight = g.lineH;
        m_facts.gutterWidth = g.gutterW;
        m_facts.textOrigin = g.textOrigin;
        m_facts.clipMin = g.clipMin;
        m_facts.clipMax = g.clipMax;
        m_facts.visibleRows = g.rows.last - g.rows.first;
        m_facts.firstVisibleRow = g.rows.last > g.rows.first ? m_model->display.DisplayRowToBuffer(g.rows.first) : 0;
        m_facts.caretScreen = ScreenPosOf(g, m_model->selections.Primary().head);

        if (active)
        {
            // SDL3 emits text only while some widget wants text input; the
            // composition window follows the primary caret (spec s5.1 IME).
            ImGuiPlatformImeData& ime = gctx.PlatformImeData;
            ime.WantVisible = !readOnly && TextInputHook::Get().ImeAllowed();
            ime.WantTextInput = true;
            ime.InputPos = ImVec2(m_facts.caretScreen.x - 1.0f, m_facts.caretScreen.y);
            ime.InputLineHeight = g.lineH;
            ime.ViewportId = window->Viewport->ID;
        }

        ImGui::EndChild();
        ImGui::PopFont();
    }

    Text::ByteOffset TextEditorView::OffsetAt(const Geometry& g, const ImVec2& screen)
    {
        const std::uint32_t count = m_model->display.DisplayRowCount();
        if (count == 0)
            return 0;
        const float rel = (screen.y - g.textOrigin.y) / g.lineH;
        const std::uint32_t displayRow = rel <= 0.0f ? 0u : std::min<std::uint32_t>(count - 1, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rel));
        const std::uint32_t row = m_model->display.DisplayRowToBuffer(displayRow);
        const Text::Rope& rope = m_model->buffer.Text();
        LineCursor cur(rope, row, m_layouts.Get(rope, row, *g.glyphs), *g.glyphs, g.tab);
        return rope.LineStart(row) + cur.ColumnForX(screen.x - g.textOrigin.x);
    }

    ImVec2 TextEditorView::ScreenPosOf(const Geometry& g, Text::ByteOffset offset)
    {
        const Text::Rope& rope = m_model->buffer.Text();
        const Text::Point p = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::min<Text::ByteOffset>(offset, rope.Size()));
        LineCursor cur(rope, p.row, m_layouts.Get(rope, p.row, *g.glyphs), *g.glyphs, g.tab);
        const std::uint32_t displayRow = m_model->display.BufferRowToDisplay(p.row);
        return ImVec2(g.textOrigin.x + cur.XForColumn(p.col), g.textOrigin.y + static_cast<float>(displayRow) * g.lineH);
    }

    void TextEditorView::HandleMouse(const Geometry& g, bool hovered, bool /*readOnly*/)
    {
        if (!hovered || !ImGui::IsMouseClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Left))
            return;
        Activate();
        const Text::ByteOffset at = OffsetAt(g, ImGui::GetIO().MousePos);
        Text::TextCommands(m_model->buffer, m_model->selections, MakeContext())
            .SetSelections({ Text::Selection{ 0, at, at, std::nullopt } });
    }

    void TextEditorView::ApplyBaselineKey(Text::TextCommands& cmds, const TextKeyPress& k, bool readOnly, std::uint32_t pageRows)
    {
        const bool plain = !k.ctrl && !k.alt;
        const bool ctrlOnly = k.ctrl && !k.alt;
        const bool extend = k.shift;
        switch (k.key)
        {
        case TextNamedKey::Left:     if (plain) cmds.MoveLeft(extend); break;
        case TextNamedKey::Right:    if (plain) cmds.MoveRight(extend); break;
        case TextNamedKey::Up:       if (plain) cmds.MoveUp(extend); break;
        case TextNamedKey::Down:     if (plain) cmds.MoveDown(extend); break;
        case TextNamedKey::Home:     if (plain) cmds.MoveLineStart(extend); else if (ctrlOnly) cmds.MoveDocumentStart(extend); break;
        case TextNamedKey::End:      if (plain) cmds.MoveLineEnd(extend); else if (ctrlOnly) cmds.MoveDocumentEnd(extend); break;
        case TextNamedKey::PageUp:   if (plain) cmds.MovePageUp(pageRows, extend); break;
        case TextNamedKey::PageDown: if (plain) cmds.MovePageDown(pageRows, extend); break;
        case TextNamedKey::Backspace: if (plain && !k.shift && !readOnly) cmds.Backspace(); break;
        case TextNamedKey::Delete:    if (plain && !k.shift && !readOnly) cmds.DeleteForward(); break;
        case TextNamedKey::Enter:     if (plain && !readOnly) cmds.Newline(); break;      // autoIndent per the context
        case TextNamedKey::Tab:       if (plain && !k.shift && !readOnly) cmds.Tab(); break;   // to the next tab stop, or a tab
        case TextNamedKey::Escape:
            if (plain && m_model->selections.Size() > 1)   // Esc collapses multiple cursors to the primary (Sublime)
                cmds.SingleSelection();
            break;
        case TextNamedKey::Insert:
            break;   // no overwrite mode in the text editor; TE5's vim layer maps Insert to <Insert>
        }
    }

    void TextEditorView::HandleKeyboard(const Geometry& g, bool readOnly)
    {
        TextInputHook& hook = TextInputHook::Get();
        const TextInputFrame in = BuildTextInputFrame(ReadImGuiTextInput(hook.Layout().hasAltGr, hook.TakeCommandModeChars()));
        if (in.droppedUnsupported && !m_warnedUnsupported)
        {
            ARC_WARN("Text editor: a typed character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane was dropped "
                     "(ImGui is built with 16-bit ImWchar)");
            m_warnedUnsupported = true;
        }
        if (in.keys.empty() && in.text.empty())
            return;
        m_lastInputTime = ImGui::GetTime();
        Text::TextCommands cmds(m_model->buffer, m_model->selections, MakeContext());
        const std::uint32_t pageRows = std::max<std::uint32_t>(1, g.rows.last - g.rows.first) - 1;
        for (const TextKeyPress& k : in.keys)
            ApplyBaselineKey(cmds, k, readOnly, std::max<std::uint32_t>(1, pageRows));
        if (!readOnly && !in.text.empty())
            cmds.InsertText(in.text);
        m_pendingReveal = { m_model->selections.Primary().head, false };
    }

    void TextEditorView::ApplyPendingReveal(const Geometry& g)
    {
        if (!m_pendingReveal)
            return;
        const auto [offset, center] = *m_pendingReveal;
        m_pendingReveal.reset();
        const ImVec2 p = ScreenPosOf(g, offset);
        const float y = p.y - g.textOrigin.y;
        const float x = p.x - g.textOrigin.x;
        const float viewH = g.clipMax.y - g.clipMin.y;
        const float viewW = g.clipMax.x - g.clipMin.x - g.gutterW;
        const float margin = g.glyphs->SpaceAdvance() * 4.0f;
        const float scrollY = ImGui::GetScrollY();
        const float scrollX = ImGui::GetScrollX();
        if (center)
            ImGui::SetScrollY(std::max(0.0f, y - (viewH - g.lineH) * 0.5f));
        else if (y < scrollY)
            ImGui::SetScrollY(y);
        else if (y + g.lineH > scrollY + viewH)
            ImGui::SetScrollY(y + g.lineH - viewH);
        if (x < scrollX)
            ImGui::SetScrollX(std::max(0.0f, x - margin));
        else if (x + margin > scrollX + viewW)
            ImGui::SetScrollX(x + margin - viewW);
    }

    void TextEditorView::DrawRows(const Geometry& g, bool active)
    {
        const TextSettings& s = Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>();
        ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
        const ImU32 textCol = ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text);
        const ImU32 dimCol = ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TextDisabled);
        const ImU32 selCol = ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TextSelectedBg);
        const ImU32 lineCol = ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_FrameBg);
        const ImU32 caretCol = ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_InputTextCursor);
        const ImU32 gutterBg = ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_WindowBg);
        ImFont* font = ImGui::GetFont();
        const float fontSize = ImGui::GetFontSize();

        const Text::Rope& rope = m_model->buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Text::Selection> sels = DisplayedSelections();
        const Text::Selection primary = m_model->selections.Primary();
        const std::uint32_t caretRow = rope.OffsetToPoint(primary.head).row;
        const bool oneCaret = sels.size() == 1 && sels[0].anchor == sels[0].head;
        const bool caretVisible = active && (!s.caretBlink || std::fmod(ImGui::GetTime() - m_lastInputTime, kBlinkPeriod) < kBlinkOn);
        const float caretW = std::max(1.0f, std::floor(g.lineH / 16.0f));
        const float textLeft = g.clipMin.x + g.gutterW;
        const float x0 = textLeft - g.textOrigin.x;
        const float x1 = g.clipMax.x - g.textOrigin.x;

        dl->PushClipRect(ImVec2(textLeft, g.clipMin.y), g.clipMax, true);
        for (std::uint32_t dr = g.rows.first; dr < g.rows.last; ++dr)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = m_model->display.DisplayRowToBuffer(dr);
            const float y = g.textOrigin.y + static_cast<float>(dr) * g.lineH;
            const Text::ByteOffset lineStart = rope.LineStart(row);
            const Text::ByteOffset lineEnd = rope.LineEnd(row);
            const LineLayout& layout = m_layouts.Get(rope, row, *g.glyphs);
            m_maxLineWidth = std::max(m_maxLineWidth, layout.width);
            LineCursor cur(rope, row, layout, *g.glyphs, g.tab);

            if (s.highlightCurrentLine && oneCaret && row == caretRow)
                dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(textLeft, y), ImVec2(g.clipMax.x, y + g.lineH), lineCol);

            // Selections touching this row: sorted and disjoint, so binary-search the first.
            auto it = std::partition_point(sels.begin(), sels.end(), [&](const Text::Selection& sel) { return SelMax(sel) < lineStart; });
            for (; it != sels.end() && SelMin(*it) <= lineEnd + 1; ++it)
            {
                if (it->anchor == it->head)
                    continue;
                const Text::ByteOffset lo = SelMin(*it), hi = SelMax(*it);
                if (lo > lineEnd) break;
                const float xa = lo <= lineStart ? 0.0f : cur.XForColumn(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(lo - lineStart));
                const float xb = hi > lineEnd ? layout.width + g.glyphs->SpaceAdvance()
                                              : cur.XForColumn(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(hi - lineStart));
                dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(g.textOrigin.x + xa, y), ImVec2(g.textOrigin.x + xb, y + g.lineH), selCol);
            }

            // Text: same-colour Text clusters batch into one AddText; tabs and hex boxes break a batch.
            m_runs.clear();
            const bool colored = m_rowRuns && m_rowRuns(row, m_runs);
            std::size_t runIndex = 0;
            const auto colorAt = [&](std::uint32_t byte) -> ImU32
            {
                if (!colored || m_runs.empty()) return textCol;
                while (runIndex + 1 < m_runs.size() && m_runs[runIndex + 1].byteStart <= byte) ++runIndex;
                return m_runs[runIndex].byteStart <= byte ? m_runs[runIndex].color : textCol;
            };
            std::string batch;
            float batchX = 0.0f;
            ImU32 batchCol = textCol;
            const auto flush = [&]
            {
                if (!batch.empty())
                    dl->AddText(font, fontSize, ImVec2(g.textOrigin.x + batchX, y), batchCol, batch.data(), batch.data() + batch.size());
                batch.clear();
            };
            cur.ForEachVisible(x0, x1, [&](const LayoutCluster& c, std::string_view bytes)
            {
                if (c.kind == ClusterKind::Text)
                {
                    const ImU32 col = colorAt(c.byte);
                    if (batch.empty() || col != batchCol) { flush(); batchX = c.x; batchCol = col; }
                    batch.append(bytes);
                    return;
                }
                flush();
                if (c.kind == ClusterKind::HexBox)
                {
                    const ImVec2 a(g.textOrigin.x + c.x + 1.0f, y + 1.0f);
                    const ImVec2 b(g.textOrigin.x + c.x + c.width - 1.0f, y + g.lineH - 1.0f);
                    dl->AddRect(a, b, dimCol);
                    char hex[3] = {};
                    std::snprintf(hex, sizeof(hex), "%02X", static_cast<unsigned>(static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[0])));
                    const float small = fontSize * 0.75f;
                    const ImVec2 ts = font->CalcTextSizeA(small, FLT_MAX, 0.0f, hex);
                    dl->AddText(font, small, ImVec2((a.x + b.x - ts.x) * 0.5f, (a.y + b.y - ts.y) * 0.5f), dimCol, hex);
                }
            });
            flush();

            // Carets on this row (every selection's head).
            if (caretVisible)
                for (const Text::Selection& sel : sels)
                    if (sel.head >= lineStart && sel.head <= lineEnd)
                    {
                        const float cx = g.textOrigin.x + cur.XForColumn(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(sel.head - lineStart));
                        dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(cx, y), ImVec2(cx + caretW, y + g.lineH), caretCol);
                    }
        }
        dl->PopClipRect();

        // The gutter stays put horizontally.
        dl->PushClipRect(g.clipMin, ImVec2(textLeft, g.clipMax.y), true);
        dl->AddRectFilled(g.clipMin, ImVec2(textLeft, g.clipMax.y), gutterBg);
        const float digit = static_cast<const BakedAdvances*>(g.glyphs)->DigitAdvance();
        for (std::uint32_t dr = g.rows.first; dr < g.rows.last; ++dr)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = m_model->display.DisplayRowToBuffer(dr);
            const std::optional<std::uint32_t> n = GutterNumber(row, caretRow, s.lineNumbers);
            if (!n)
                continue;
            const std::string label = std::to_string(*n);
            const float w = font->CalcTextSizeA(fontSize, FLT_MAX, 0.0f, label.c_str()).x;
            dl->AddText(font, fontSize, ImVec2(textLeft - digit - w, g.textOrigin.y + static_cast<float>(dr) * g.lineH),
                        row == caretRow ? textCol : dimCol, label.c_str());
        }
        dl->PopClipRect();
    }
}

### Task TE2-14: The mouse model -- drag, double/triple click, Ctrl+click add/remove, Alt+drag column, auto-scroll (spec s3.4, s5.1)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextMouse.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextMouse.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp` (gesture member, `HitAt`, `AutoScroll`), `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.cpp` (replace `HandleMouse` and `DisplayedSelections`)
- Modify: `premake5.lua` (TE2 block: add `TextMouse.cpp`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextMouseTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1 `Selection`, `ByteRange`, `Rope`, and the `Text::TextCommands` members `std::optional<ByteRange> WordRangeAt(ByteOffset) const` (TE1-17, CANON B14: the single word-range implementation) and `SetSelections(std::vector<Selection>)` (TE1-14, last element primary); `DefaultEditContext` (TE2-11); TE2-13's `TextEditorView` internals (`MakeContext()`).
- Produces: `struct MouseHit { Text::ByteOffset offset; std::uint32_t row; float x; }`; `struct MouseModel { std::function<Text::ByteRange(Text::ByteOffset)> wordAt; std::function<Text::ByteRange(std::uint32_t)> lineWithBreak; std::function<Text::ByteOffset(std::uint32_t row, float x)> offsetAtRowX; }`; `enum class DragMode : std::uint8_t { None, Char, Word, Line, Column }`; `class TextMouseGesture { void Press(const MouseHit&, int clickCount, bool ctrl, bool shift, bool alt, std::span<const Text::Selection> current, const MouseModel&); void Drag(const MouseHit&, const MouseModel&); std::vector<Text::Selection> Release(); bool Active() const; DragMode Mode() const; std::vector<Text::Selection> Preview() const; }`. TE5's vim mouse handling (Visual on drag) reuses `TextMouseGesture`.

The drag in progress is a separate *pending* selection merged on release (spec s3.4): during the drag the `SelectionSet` keeps the base selections and the view draws base + pending (`Preview()`); `Release()` hands the full list to `Text::TextCommands(...).SetSelections(sels)` (the last element becomes primary; overlaps merge). There is no word-range function of TE2's own (CANON B14): the view's `MouseModel::wordAt` is `Text::TextCommands(buffer, selections, MakeContext()).WordRangeAt(o).value_or(Text::ByteRange{ o, o })`, so a double-click reads the view's EditContext word characters (TE1-16's default `[A-Za-z0-9_]` plus non-ASCII letters; TE4-24's `MakeEditContext` supplies the grammar's `wordChars`), and a double-click off a word (space, punctuation, an invalid byte) places a caret.

`ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextMouseTest.cpp`:
```cpp
// Text editor TE2-14 (spec s3.4, s5.1): the pure gesture machine over a fake
// geometry (10 px per byte), then the view on a bare ImGui context.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextMouse.hpp"

#include <imgui.h>
#include <imgui_internal.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <functional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;
using Arcane::Text::ByteRange;
using Arcane::Text::Rope;
using Arcane::Text::Selection;

namespace
{
    const Rope kRope = Rope::FromUtf8("alpha beta\ngamma delta\n\nlast");

    // The mouse's wordAt exactly as the view builds it: TE1's
    // TextCommands::WordRangeAt over the model, a caret when not on a word.
    std::function<ByteRange(Arcane::Text::ByteOffset)> WordAtOf(TextModel& model)
    {
        return [&model](Arcane::Text::ByteOffset o)
        {
            return Arcane::Text::TextCommands(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model))
                .WordRangeAt(o)
                .value_or(ByteRange{ o, o });
        };
    }

    TextModel& WordModel()
    {
        static TextModel model(kRope);   // the same text the fake geometry walks
        return model;
    }

    MouseModel FakeModel()
    {
        MouseModel m;
        m.wordAt = WordAtOf(WordModel());
        m.lineWithBreak = [](std::uint32_t row)
        {
            const auto end = row + 1 < kRope.LineCount() ? kRope.LineStart(row + 1) : kRope.Size();
            return ByteRange{ kRope.LineStart(row), end };
        };
        m.offsetAtRowX = [](std::uint32_t row, float x)
        {
            const auto len = kRope.LineEnd(row) - kRope.LineStart(row);
            const auto col = std::min<std::uint64_t>(len, static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::max(0.0f, x) / 10.0f + 0.5f));
            return kRope.LineStart(row) + col;
        };
        return m;
    }

    MouseHit Hit(std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t col)
    {
        return MouseHit{ kRope.LineStart(row) + col, row, static_cast<float>(col) * 10.0f };
    }

    std::vector<std::pair<std::uint64_t, std::uint64_t>> Pairs(const std::vector<Selection>& sels)
    {
        std::vector<std::pair<std::uint64_t, std::uint64_t>> out;
        for (const Selection& s : sels) out.emplace_back(s.anchor, s.head);
        return out;
    }

    using P = std::vector<std::pair<std::uint64_t, std::uint64_t>>;
}

TEST_CASE("text mouse: double-click word ranges come from TextCommands::WordRangeAt; off a word, a caret", "[text-view]")
{
    const auto beta = WordAtOf(WordModel());
    CHECK(beta(7) == ByteRange{ 6, 10 });                  // inside "beta"
    CHECK(beta(10) == ByteRange{ 6, 10 });                 // at the line end: the word that ends there

    TextModel model(Rope::FromUtf8("caf\xC3\xA9  x.y a\xE9z"));
    const auto wordAt = WordAtOf(model);
    CHECK(wordAt(1) == ByteRange{ 0, 5 });                 // "cafe-acute": a non-ASCII letter is a word character
    CHECK(wordAt(6) == ByteRange{ 6, 6 });                 // between two spaces: no word, a caret
    CHECK(wordAt(13) == ByteRange{ 13, 14 });              // an invalid byte is never a word character (spec s3.5)

    TextModel empty(Rope::FromUtf8(""));
    CHECK(WordAtOf(empty)(0) == ByteRange{ 0, 0 });
}

TEST_CASE("text mouse: click, drag, shift+click", "[text-view]")
{
    const MouseModel m = FakeModel();
    TextMouseGesture g;
    const std::vector<Selection> none{ Selection{ 0, 0, 0, std::nullopt } };
    g.Press(Hit(0, 2), 1, false, false, false, none, m);
    CHECK(g.Active());
    CHECK(g.Mode() == DragMode::Char);
    g.Drag(Hit(1, 3), m);
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Preview()) == P{ { 2, 14 } });
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Release()) == P{ { 2, 14 } });
    CHECK_FALSE(g.Active());

    const std::vector<Selection> current{ Selection{ 0, 2, 4, std::nullopt } };
    g.Press(Hit(1, 0), 1, false, true, false, current, m);   // Shift+click extends the primary from its anchor
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Release()) == P{ { 2, 11 } });
}

TEST_CASE("text mouse: double-click words and triple-click lines, extended by dragging", "[text-view]")
{
    const MouseModel m = FakeModel();
    TextMouseGesture g;
    const std::vector<Selection> none{ Selection{ 0, 0, 0, std::nullopt } };
    g.Press(Hit(0, 7), 2, false, false, false, none, m);
    CHECK(g.Mode() == DragMode::Word);
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Preview()) == P{ { 6, 10 } });
    g.Drag(Hit(1, 2), m);                                   // into "gamma": beta..gamma
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Release()) == P{ { 6, 16 } });

    g.Press(Hit(1, 2), 2, false, false, false, none, m);
    g.Drag(Hit(0, 1), m);                                   // backwards into "alpha": reversed
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Release()) == P{ { 16, 0 } });

    g.Press(Hit(1, 4), 3, false, false, false, none, m);
    CHECK(g.Mode() == DragMode::Line);
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Preview()) == P{ { 11, 23 } });           // the line with its break
    g.Drag(Hit(2, 0), m);
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Release()) == P{ { 11, 24 } });
}

TEST_CASE("text mouse: Ctrl+click adds a cursor, removes one it lands on, never leaves none", "[text-view]")
{
    const MouseModel m = FakeModel();
    TextMouseGesture g;
    std::vector<Selection> current{ Selection{ 0, 1, 1, std::nullopt } };
    g.Press(Hit(1, 2), 1, true, false, false, current, m);
    current = g.Release();
    CHECK(Pairs(current) == P{ { 1, 1 }, { 13, 13 } });   // the new cursor last: it becomes primary

    g.Press(Hit(0, 1), 1, true, false, false, current, m);  // on the existing caret: remove it
    current = g.Release();
    CHECK(Pairs(current) == P{ { 13, 13 } });

    current = { Selection{ 0, 6, 10, std::nullopt }, Selection{ 0, 13, 13, std::nullopt } };
    g.Press(Hit(0, 8), 1, true, false, false, current, m);  // inside a selection: remove that selection
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Release()) == P{ { 13, 13 } });

    current = { Selection{ 0, 13, 13, std::nullopt } };
    g.Press(Hit(1, 2), 1, true, false, false, current, m);  // removing the only cursor keeps it
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Release()) == P{ { 13, 13 } });

    g.Press(Hit(0, 7), 2, true, false, false, current, m);  // Ctrl+double-click adds a word
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Release()) == P{ { 13, 13 }, { 6, 10 } });
}

TEST_CASE("text mouse: Alt+drag selects a column, one selection per row, carets on short rows", "[text-view]")
{
    const MouseModel m = FakeModel();
    TextMouseGesture g;
    const std::vector<Selection> none{ Selection{ 0, 0, 0, std::nullopt } };
    g.Press(Hit(0, 1), 1, false, false, true, none, m);
    CHECK(g.Mode() == DragMode::Column);
    g.Drag(MouseHit{ kRope.LineStart(2), 2, 30.0f }, m);   // rows 0..2, x 10..30
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Release()) == P{ { 1, 3 }, { 12, 14 }, { 23, 23 } });

    g.Press(MouseHit{ kRope.LineStart(1) + 3, 1, 30.0f }, 1, false, false, true, none, m);
    g.Drag(Hit(0, 1), m);                                   // up and to the left: reversed, bottom-up order kept sorted
    CHECK(Pairs(g.Release()) == P{ { 3, 1 }, { 14, 12 } });
}

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text editor's mouse model (spec s3.4, s5.1), pure: click, drag,
// double-click word, triple-click line, Shift+click extend, Ctrl+click add or
// remove a cursor, Alt+drag column selection. The drag in progress is a
// PENDING selection beside the base set; Release() returns the full list for
// Text::TextCommands::SetSelections, which merges it and makes the last one
// primary. Geometry and word ranges come in through MouseModel (the view's
// wordAt is TE1's TextCommands::WordRangeAt), so the machine is tested
// without ImGui.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct MouseHit
    {
        Text::ByteOffset offset = 0;
        std::uint32_t    row = 0;    // buffer row
        float            x = 0.0f;   // x in line coordinates (0 = column 0)
    };

    struct MouseModel
    {
        std::function<Text::ByteRange(Text::ByteOffset)>        wordAt;   // empty range = not on a word
        std::function<Text::ByteRange(std::uint32_t row)>       lineWithBreak;
        std::function<Text::ByteOffset(std::uint32_t row, float x)> offsetAtRowX;
    };

    enum class DragMode : std::uint8_t { None, Char, Word, Line, Column };

    class TextMouseGesture
    {
    public:
        // clickCount: ImGui's MouseClickedCount (1, 2, 3; 4 wraps to 1).
        void Press(const MouseHit& hit, int clickCount, bool ctrl, bool shift, bool alt,
                   std::span<const Text::Selection> current, const MouseModel& model);
        void Drag(const MouseHit& hit, const MouseModel& model);
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Text::Selection> Release();
        [[nodiscard]] bool Active() const noexcept { return m_mode != DragMode::None; }
        [[nodiscard]] DragMode Mode() const noexcept { return m_mode; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Text::Selection> Preview() const;   // base + pending, for drawing

    private:
        [[nodiscard]] static Text::Selection Sel(Text::ByteOffset anchor, Text::ByteOffset head)
        {
            return Text::Selection{ 0, anchor, head, std::nullopt };
        }

        DragMode                       m_mode = DragMode::None;
        std::vector<Text::Selection>   m_base;      // kept as they were at the press
        std::vector<Text::Selection>   m_pending;   // the drag's selection(s)
        Text::ByteRange                m_origin;    // the word / line the drag started on
        Text::ByteOffset               m_anchor = 0;
        std::uint32_t                  m_anchorRow = 0;
        float                          m_anchorX = 0.0f;
        bool                           m_removedOnly = false;   // Ctrl+click removed a cursor: no pending
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextMouse.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextMouse.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        Text::ByteOffset Lo(const Text::Selection& s) { return std::min(s.anchor, s.head); }
        Text::ByteOffset Hi(const Text::Selection& s) { return std::max(s.anchor, s.head); }
    }

    void TextMouseGesture::Press(const MouseHit& hit, int clickCount, bool ctrl, bool shift, bool alt,
                                 std::span<const Text::Selection> current, const MouseModel& model)
    {
        const int clicks = ((std::max(1, clickCount) - 1) % 3) + 1;
        m_base.clear();
        m_pending.clear();
        m_removedOnly = false;
        m_anchorRow = hit.row;
        m_anchorX = hit.x;

        if (alt)
        {
            if (ctrl) m_base.assign(current.begin(), current.end());
            m_mode = DragMode::Column;
            Drag(hit, model);
            return;
        }
        if (shift && !current.empty() && clicks == 1)
        {
            const Text::Selection primary = current.back();   // the caller passes the set with its primary last
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < current.size(); ++i) m_base.push_back(current[i]);
            m_anchor = primary.anchor;
            m_mode = DragMode::Char;
            m_pending = { Sel(m_anchor, hit.offset) };
            return;
        }
        if (ctrl)
        {
            m_base.assign(current.begin(), current.end());
            if (clicks == 1)
            {
                // On a caret, or inside a selection: remove it (never the last one).
                const auto hitIt = std::find_if(m_base.begin(), m_base.end(), [&](const Text::Selection& s)
                {
                    return s.anchor == s.head ? s.head == hit.offset : (hit.offset >= Lo(s) && hit.offset <= Hi(s));
                });
                if (hitIt != m_base.end() && m_base.size() > 1)
                {
                    m_base.erase(hitIt);
                    m_mode = DragMode::Char;
                    m_removedOnly = true;
                    return;
                }
                if (hitIt != m_base.end())
                {
                    m_mode = DragMode::Char;
                    m_removedOnly = true;   // the only cursor: keep it as it is
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        m_anchor = hit.offset;
        switch (clicks)
        {
        case 2:
            m_mode = DragMode::Word;
            m_origin = model.wordAt(hit.offset);
            m_pending = { Sel(m_origin.begin, m_origin.end) };
            break;
        case 3:
            m_mode = DragMode::Line;
            m_origin = model.lineWithBreak(hit.row);
            m_pending = { Sel(m_origin.begin, m_origin.end) };
            break;
        default:
            m_mode = DragMode::Char;
            m_pending = { Sel(hit.offset, hit.offset) };
            break;
        }
    }

    void TextMouseGesture::Drag(const MouseHit& hit, const MouseModel& model)
    {
        if (m_removedOnly)
            return;
        switch (m_mode)
        {
        case DragMode::None:
            return;
        case DragMode::Char:
            m_pending = { Sel(m_anchor, hit.offset) };
            return;
        case DragMode::Word:
        case DragMode::Line:
        {
            const Text::ByteRange r = m_mode == DragMode::Word ? model.wordAt(hit.offset) : model.lineWithBreak(hit.row);
            if (r.begin >= m_origin.begin)
                m_pending = { Sel(m_origin.begin, std::max(r.end, m_origin.end)) };
            else
                m_pending = { Sel(m_origin.end, r.begin) };   // dragging backwards: head before the anchor word
            return;
        }
        case DragMode::Column:
        {
            m_pending.clear();
            const std::uint32_t r0 = std::min(m_anchorRow, hit.row), r1 = std::max(m_anchorRow, hit.row);
            for (std::uint32_t row = r0; row <= r1; ++row)
                m_pending.push_back(Sel(model.offsetAtRowX(row, m_anchorX), model.offsetAtRowX(row, hit.x)));
            return;
        }
        }
    }

    std::vector<Text::Selection> TextMouseGesture::Preview() const
    {
        std::vector<Text::Selection> out = m_base;
        out.insert(out.end(), m_pending.begin(), m_pending.end());
        return out;
    }

    std::vector<Text::Selection> TextMouseGesture::Release()
    {
        std::vector<Text::Selection> out = Preview();
        m_mode = DragMode::None;
        m_base.clear();
        m_pending.clear();
        m_removedOnly = false;
        return out;
    }
}

```cpp
    std::vector<Text::Selection> TextEditorView::DisplayedSelections() const
    {
        if (m_mouse.Active())
        {
            std::vector<Text::Selection> shown = m_mouse.Preview();
            std::sort(shown.begin(), shown.end(), [](const Text::Selection& a, const Text::Selection& b) { return SelMin(a) < SelMin(b); });
            return shown;   // drawn only: overlaps resolve when SetSelections merges on release
        }
        const auto all = m_model->selections.All();
        return std::vector<Text::Selection>(all.begin(), all.end());
    }

    MouseHit TextEditorView::HitAt(const Geometry& g, const ImVec2& screen)
    {
        const std::uint32_t count = m_model->display.DisplayRowCount();
        const float rel = (screen.y - g.textOrigin.y) / g.lineH;
        const std::uint32_t displayRow = count == 0 || rel <= 0.0f ? 0u : std::min<std::uint32_t>(count - 1, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rel));
        const std::uint32_t row = count == 0 ? 0u : m_model->display.DisplayRowToBuffer(displayRow);
        const float x = screen.x - g.textOrigin.x;
        const Text::Rope& rope = m_model->buffer.Text();
        LineCursor cur(rope, row, m_layouts.Get(rope, row, *g.glyphs), *g.glyphs, g.tab);
        return MouseHit{ rope.LineStart(row) + cur.ColumnForX(x), row, x };
    }

    MouseModel TextEditorView::MakeMouseModel(const Geometry& g)
    {
        MouseModel m;
        // TE1's word range under this view's EditContext (CANON B14); off a word: a caret.
        m.wordAt = [this](Text::ByteOffset o)
        {
            return Text::TextCommands(m_model->buffer, m_model->selections, MakeContext())
                .WordRangeAt(o)
                .value_or(Text::ByteRange{ o, o });
        };
        m.lineWithBreak = [this](std::uint32_t row)
        {
            const Text::Rope& rope = m_model->buffer.Text();
            return Text::ByteRange{ rope.LineStart(row), row + 1 < rope.LineCount() ? rope.LineStart(row + 1) : rope.Size() };
        };
        m.offsetAtRowX = [this, g](std::uint32_t row, float x)
        {
            const Text::Rope& rope = m_model->buffer.Text();
            LineCursor cur(rope, row, m_layouts.Get(rope, row, *g.glyphs), *g.glyphs, g.tab);
            return rope.LineStart(row) + cur.ColumnForX(x);
        };
        return m;
    }

    void TextEditorView::AutoScroll(const Geometry& g, const ImVec2& mouse)
    {
        // Drag-select auto-scroll: the further outside, the faster (one pixel per pixel per frame).
        if (mouse.y < g.clipMin.y) ImGui::SetScrollY(std::max(0.0f, ImGui::GetScrollY() - (g.clipMin.y - mouse.y)));
        else if (mouse.y > g.clipMax.y) ImGui::SetScrollY(ImGui::GetScrollY() + (mouse.y - g.clipMax.y));
        const float textLeft = g.clipMin.x + g.gutterW;
        if (mouse.x < textLeft) ImGui::SetScrollX(std::max(0.0f, ImGui::GetScrollX() - (textLeft - mouse.x)));
        else if (mouse.x > g.clipMax.x) ImGui::SetScrollX(ImGui::GetScrollX() + (mouse.x - g.clipMax.x));
    }

    void TextEditorView::HandleMouse(const Geometry& g, bool hovered, bool /*readOnly*/)
    {
        const ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
        if (hovered && ImGui::IsMouseClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Left))
        {
            Activate();
            // The gesture wants the primary LAST (Shift+click extends it).
            std::vector<Text::Selection> current;
            for (const Text::Selection& s : m_model->selections.All())
                if (s.id != m_model->selections.Primary().id) current.push_back(s);
            current.push_back(m_model->selections.Primary());
            m_mouse.Press(HitAt(g, io.MousePos), ImGui::GetMouseClickedCount(ImGuiMouseButton_Left),
                          io.KeyCtrl, io.KeyShift, io.KeyAlt, current, MakeMouseModel(g));
        }
        if (!m_mouse.Active())
            return;
        if (ImGui::IsMouseDown(ImGuiMouseButton_Left))
        {
            AutoScroll(g, io.MousePos);
            m_mouse.Drag(HitAt(g, io.MousePos), MakeMouseModel(g));
            return;
        }
        Text::TextCommands(m_model->buffer, m_model->selections, MakeContext()).SetSelections(m_mouse.Release());
        m_lastInputTime = ImGui::GetTime();
        m_pendingReveal = { m_model->selections.Primary().head, false };
    }

There is no `HasBom()`: callers use `Text::EncodingHasBom(doc.Encoding())`. **TE6** uses `SetReadOnlyLock` (Open as Text on an asset with a dedicated editor, spec s5.4) and the remembered encoding for session restore; **TE4**'s Inspector page / status strip call `ReopenWithEncoding` and read `Encoding()`.

`Save()` here is the plain atomic save (a failure -- including an `EncodeError` -- shows a generic banner); TE2-16 replaces it with the full outcome-to-banner flow. A file with the read-only *attribute* is still editable -- the save is what is refused (spec s5.3, D14); only invalid-UTF-8, invalid-UTF-16 or binary *content* (and TE6's lock) makes the document read-only. Reopen with Encoding decodes the file again into the SAME buffer (`ReloadExternal`, then `ClearHistory`, then `MarkSaved`; no new model, no `Rebind`) and says through `ShowNote` that undo history was cleared: undoing across the reopen would put text decoded under the old encoding back under the new label (CANON D5, Review Focus F3). `Open` is the ONE place the model, its buffer and the view are created: `AdoptDecoded` only records the encoding, the read-only reason, the synced stamp and the banner, so Reopen with Encoding (and TE2-17's reload) re-run it over the same buffer, and TE3-30's highlight cache, created once right after `Open`'s `AdoptDecoded` call (TE3-30 calls it "Adopt"), follows every later reload through the edit log. `Open` also applies the undo policy (`editor.text.undoGroupMs` / `undoMemoryMB` through `ToUndoPolicy`) to the new buffer, so typing groups and the memory cap hold from the first keystroke, not only after the first reload.

    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            Clear();
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir() { Clear(); }
        void Clear()
        {

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {

    }

    std::string ReadAll(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::ifstream in(p, std::ios::binary);
        return std::string(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    }

        cmds.SetSelections({ Arcane::Text::Selection{ 0, at, at, std::nullopt } });
        cmds.InsertText(text);

    CHECK(SniffText(std::string("\xFF\xFEh\0", 4)) == TextSniffResult::Text);
    CHECK(SniffText(std::string("\xFE\xFF\0h", 4)) == TextSniffResult::Text);
    CHECK(SniffText(std::string(9000, 'a') + std::string(1, '\0')) == TextSniffResult::Text);   // past the window
    for (const char* cpp : { "a.cpp", "a.CXX", "a.cc", "a.c", "a.hpp", "a.hxx", "a.hh", "a.h", "a.inl" })

TEST_CASE("text document: a UTF-8 file opens editable under its canonical path; any spelling finds the same key", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-open");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "Notes.md";
    WriteAll(p, "# Title\nbody\n");
    TextDocumentServices services;
    const Arcane::Guid id = Arcane::Guid::Generate();
    services.peekGuid = [&](const std::filesystem::path&) { return id; };
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);
    CHECK(doc->Title() == "Notes.md");
    CHECK(doc->CanonicalPath() == *CanonicalFilePath(p));
    CHECK(doc->AssetGuid() == id);
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == TextEncoding::Utf8);
    CHECK_FALSE(Arcane::Text::EncodingHasBom(doc->Encoding()));
    CHECK(std::string(EncodingLabel(doc->Encoding())) == "UTF-8");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "# Title\nbody\n");
    CHECK(&doc->Buffer() == &doc->Model().buffer);                // Buffer() is the primary model's buffer
    CHECK(doc->WindowLabel().starts_with("Notes.md###textdoc_"));
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    doc->ShowNote("hello");
    CHECK(doc->Note() == "hello");
    doc->ShowNote("");
    CHECK(doc->Note().empty());

    std::wstring upper = p.wstring();
    std::transform(upper.begin(), upper.end(), upper.begin(), [](wchar_t c) { return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towupper(c)); });
    CHECK(OpenOrFail(upper)->CanonicalPath() == doc->CanonicalPath());

    Type(*doc, 0, "X");
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Save());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "X# Title\nbody\n");
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 14u);
}

TEST_CASE("text document: invalid UTF-8 opens read-only with its bytes; Reopen as Windows-1252 edits and saves 1252", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-1252");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "legacy.bat";
    const std::string original = "echo caf\xE9\r\n";
    WriteAll(p, original);
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    CHECK(doc->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(doc->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8);
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "echo caf\xE9\n");                // raw bytes, never lossy-decoded
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::ReadOnlyContent);
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<TextBannerAction>{ TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252 });
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Save());                                                   // read-only content never saves
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == original);

    const TextModel* modelBefore = &doc->Model();
    const Arcane::Text::TextBuffer* bufferBefore = &doc->Buffer();
    doc->ApplyBannerAction(TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252);
    CHECK(&doc->Model() == modelBefore);                                        // decoded into the SAME model and buffer
    CHECK(&doc->Buffer() == bufferBefore);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "echo caf\xC3\xA9\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());

    // Review Focus F3: the reopen is not undoable. Undo would put the raw
    // invalid-UTF-8 bytes back under the Windows-1252 label.
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().CanUndo());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().CanRedo());
    CHECK(doc->Note().find("Undo history was cleared") != std::string::npos);
    {
        TextModel& model = doc->Model();
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands cmds(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model));
        CHECK_FALSE(cmds.Undo());                                               // Ctrl+Z is a no-op
    }
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "echo caf\xC3\xA9\n");
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    CHECK(doc->Save());
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == original);                                              // unedited: byte-identical

    Type(*doc, 10, "!");                                                        // after the UTF-8 e-acute (bytes 8..9)
    CHECK(doc->Save());
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "echo caf\xE9!\r\n");
}

    CHECK_FALSE(locked->Save());
}

#pragma once

// The path and content rules every text route shares (text editor spec s1,
// s3.5, s5.3): C++ never opens in the text editor (it stays in the IDE), a
// known binary format is refused, a file with NUL bytes in its first 8 KB
// sniffs as binary (a UTF-16 BOM excepted), and the explicit text extensions
// register the text document directly.

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <span>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    ARC_CONSTANT("spec s3.5: binary detection looks for NUL bytes in the first 8 KB")
    inline constexpr std::size_t kSniffBytes = 8192;

    enum class TextSniffResult : std::uint8_t { Text, Binary };
    [[nodiscard]] TextSniffResult SniffText(std::string_view head);

    [[nodiscard]] bool IsCppSourcePath(const std::filesystem::path& p);         // .cpp .cxx .cc .c .hpp .hxx .hh .h .inl
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsKnownBinaryExtension(const std::filesystem::path& p);
    [[nodiscard]] std::span<const std::string_view> ExplicitTextExtensions();   // lowercase, with the dot

    // A real file's verdict: not a known binary extension AND its first
    // kSniffBytes sniff as text. False when the file cannot be read (TE7-9's
    // opener asks this before routing an unknown extension to the text editor).
    [[nodiscard]] bool SniffsAsText(const std::filesystem::path& p);
}

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextSniff.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSniff.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <optional>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        std::string LowerExt(const std::filesystem::path& p)
        {
            const std::u8string u = p.extension().u8string();
            std::string ext(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(u.data()), u.size());
            std::transform(ext.begin(), ext.end(), ext.begin(),
                           [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' ? c + ('a' - 'A') : c); });
            return ext;
        }

        bool In(std::span<const std::string_view> set, std::string_view ext)
        {
            return std::find(set.begin(), set.end(), ext) != set.end();
        }

        constexpr std::string_view kCpp[] = { ".cpp", ".cxx", ".cc", ".c", ".hpp", ".hxx", ".hh", ".h", ".inl" };
        constexpr std::string_view kBinary[] = {
            ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".tga", ".bmp", ".hdr", ".dds", ".ktx", ".ktx2", ".psd", ".exr",
            ".wav", ".ogg", ".mp3", ".flac", ".ttf", ".otf", ".glb", ".fbx",
            ".exe", ".dll", ".pdb", ".lib", ".obj", ".exp", ".ilk", ".dmp", ".bin",
            ".zip", ".7z", ".rar", ".gz", ".pak", ".arcart",
        };
        constexpr std::string_view kText[] = {
            ".md", ".markdown", ".txt", ".log", ".ini", ".cfg", ".conf", ".toml", ".yaml", ".yml", ".xml",
            ".json", ".jsonc", ".csv", ".tsv", ".hlsl", ".hlsli", ".fx", ".lua", ".bat", ".cmd", ".ps1", ".psm1",
            ".sh", ".bash", ".gitignore", ".gitattributes", ".editorconfig",
            ".arcsyntax", ".arctheme", ".arcproj", ".meta",
        };
    }

    TextSniffResult SniffText(std::string_view head)
    {
        if (head.starts_with("\xFF\xFE") || head.starts_with("\xFE\xFF"))
            return TextSniffResult::Text;   // UTF-16 with a BOM: NULs are expected
        const std::string_view window = head.substr(0, std::min(head.size(), kSniffBytes));
        return window.find('\0') == std::string_view::npos ? TextSniffResult::Text : TextSniffResult::Binary;
    }

    bool IsCppSourcePath(const std::filesystem::path& p) { return In(kCpp, LowerExt(p)); }
    bool IsKnownBinaryExtension(const std::filesystem::path& p) { return In(kBinary, LowerExt(p)); }
    std::span<const std::string_view> ExplicitTextExtensions() { return kText; }

    bool SniffsAsText(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        if (IsKnownBinaryExtension(p))
            return false;
        const std::optional<std::string> head = ReadRangeShared(p, 0, kSniffBytes);   // shorter when the file is
        return head && SniffText(*head) == TextSniffResult::Text;
    }
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// TextDocument (text editor spec s5.3): the EditorDocument for every text file
// without a dedicated Arcane editor. Identity is the CANONICAL PATH
// (GetFinalPathNameByHandleW): an asset's Guid is only a lookup into it. Bytes
// decode through Text::DecodeFile -- UTF-8 (+/- BOM), UTF-16 LE/BE with a BOM,
// and Windows-1252 on request (Reopen with Encoding). Invalid UTF-8, invalid
// UTF-16 or binary content opens READ-ONLY with its raw bytes, so saving can
// never corrupt it. The document draws a banner strip over one TextEditorView.
//
// Model() / View() are the canonical accessors of the PRIMARY model and view
// (TE4-17's split adds a secondary view); Buffer() is the primary model's
// buffer. ShowNote() is the document's one note channel.

#include "Documents/EditorDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextChangeClassifier.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Guid.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class TextDocument;

    enum class TextReadOnlyReason : std::uint8_t { None, InvalidUtf8, InvalidUtf16, Binary, Locked };

    enum class TextBannerKind : std::uint8_t
    {
        None,
        ReadOnlyContent,   // invalid UTF-8 / invalid UTF-16 / binary
        SaveFailed,
    };

    enum class TextBannerAction : std::uint8_t { ReopenAs1252, Retry, Dismiss };

    struct TextBanner
    {
        TextBannerKind kind = TextBannerKind::None;
        std::string    message;
    };
    // The buttons a banner offers, in order. Pure.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<TextBannerAction> BannerActions(const TextBanner& banner);
    [[nodiscard]] const char* BannerActionLabel(TextBannerAction action);
    // The UI label of an encoding ("UTF-8", "UTF-8 with BOM", "UTF-16 LE",
    // "UTF-16 BE", "Windows-1252"). The stable id is Text::EncodingId.
    [[nodiscard]] const char* EncodingLabel(Text::TextEncoding encoding);

    struct TextDocumentServices
    {
        std::function<Arcane::Guid(const std::filesystem::path&)> peekGuid;   // the asset id when the file is one
    };

    class TextDocument final : public EditorDocument
    {
    public:
        // Null with `error` set: missing or unreadable, or above editor.text.openMaxMB.
        static std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, TextDocumentServices services,
                                                  std::string& error);

        const std::string& Title() const override { return m_title; }
        Arcane::Guid AssetGuid() const override { return m_guid; }
        bool Dirty() const override;
        bool Save() override;
        bool WindowFocused() const override { return m_windowFocused; }
        void Draw(bool& requestClose) override;
        void NoteMoved(const std::filesystem::path& newPath) override;
        void NoteReopened() override;

        [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path CanonicalPath() const { return m_canonical; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::filesystem::path& Path() const noexcept { return m_path; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& WindowLabel() const noexcept { return m_windowLabel; }
        // The PRIMARY model and view (canonical accessors).
        [[nodiscard]] TextModel& Model() noexcept { return *m_model; }
        [[nodiscard]] const TextModel& Model() const noexcept { return *m_model; }
        [[nodiscard]] TextEditorView& View() noexcept { return *m_view; }
        // The primary model's buffer.
        [[nodiscard]] Text::TextBuffer& Buffer() noexcept { return m_model->buffer; }
        [[nodiscard]] const Text::TextBuffer& Buffer() const noexcept { return m_model->buffer; }
        [[nodiscard]] Text::TextEncoding Encoding() const noexcept { return m_encoding; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool ReadOnly() const noexcept { return m_readOnlyReason != TextReadOnlyReason::None; }
        [[nodiscard]] TextReadOnlyReason ReadOnlyReason() const noexcept { return m_readOnlyReason; }
        [[nodiscard]] const TextBanner& Banner() const noexcept { return m_banner; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& Note() const noexcept { return m_note; }
        // The one note channel: a quiet line over the view with a Dismiss button. "" clears.
        void ShowNote(std::string note) { m_note = std::move(note); }
        [[nodiscard]] const SyncedFileState& Synced() const noexcept { return m_synced; }

        // Re-decode the file as `encoding` (spec s3.5) into the SAME buffer;
        // refused while dirty. Undo history is cleared (and a note says so): the
        // old text was decoded under another encoding. The choice is kept for
        // reloads (and TE6 remembers it per file).
        bool ReopenWithEncoding(Text::TextEncoding encoding);
        void ApplyBannerAction(TextBannerAction action);
        // TE6 (spec s5.4): Open as Text on an asset with a dedicated editor opens locked.
        void SetReadOnlyLock(bool locked);

    private:
        TextDocument(std::filesystem::path path, std::filesystem::path canonical, TextDocumentServices services);
        // Encoding, content read-only state, the banner and the synced fingerprint
        // from one decode of `read` (the text itself is already in the buffer).
        void AdoptDecoded(const ReadOutcome& read, Text::TextEncoding encoding, Text::ReadOnlyReason readOnly);
        // editor.text.defaultLineEnding (ToDecodeOptions) + the Reopen with Encoding choice.
        [[nodiscard]] Text::DecodeOptions CurrentDecodeOptions() const;
        void SyncFrom(std::string_view bytes, const FileStamp& stamp);
        void Retitle();
        void RecomputeReadOnly();
        void DrawBanner();
        [[nodiscard]] std::string Name() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t MaxOpenBytes() const;

        std::filesystem::path             m_path;
        std::filesystem::path             m_canonical;
        TextDocumentServices              m_services;
        Arcane::Guid                      m_guid;
        std::string                       m_title;
        std::string                       m_windowLabel;
        std::string                       m_labelId;          // "###textdoc_<hash of the opening canonical path>": the dock slot holds across moves
        std::string                       m_canonicalUtf8;
        std::unique_ptr<TextModel>        m_model;            // created once by Open; never replaced
        std::unique_ptr<TextEditorView>   m_view;
        Text::TextEncoding                m_encoding = Text::TextEncoding::Utf8;
        std::optional<Text::TextEncoding> m_forcedEncoding;   // the Reopen with Encoding choice
        TextReadOnlyReason                m_contentReadOnly = TextReadOnlyReason::None;
        TextReadOnlyReason                m_readOnlyReason = TextReadOnlyReason::None;
        bool                              m_locked = false;
        SyncedFileState                   m_synced;
        TextBanner                        m_banner;
        std::string                       m_note;
        bool                              m_windowFocused = false;
    };
}

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"

#include "Input/EditorActions.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <imgui.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <expected>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("units: bytes per MiB (editor.text.*MB settings)")
        constexpr std::uint64_t kBytesPerMiB = 1024ull * 1024ull;

        std::string Utf8(const std::filesystem::path& p)
        {
            const std::u8string u = p.u8string();
            return std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(u.data()), u.size());
        }

        // The codec's content verdict -> the document's read-only reason.
        TextReadOnlyReason FromContentReason(Text::ReadOnlyReason reason)
        {
            switch (reason)
            {
            case Text::ReadOnlyReason::None:         return TextReadOnlyReason::None;
            case Text::ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8:  return TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8;
            case Text::ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16: return TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16;
            case Text::ReadOnlyReason::Binary:       return TextReadOnlyReason::Binary;
            }
            return TextReadOnlyReason::Binary;   // unknown: the safe side
        }
    }

    std::vector<TextBannerAction> BannerActions(const TextBanner& b)
    {
        switch (b.kind)
        {
        case TextBannerKind::None:            return {};
        case TextBannerKind::ReadOnlyContent: return { TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252 };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveFailed:      return { TextBannerAction::Retry, TextBannerAction::Dismiss };
        }
        return {};
    }

    const char* BannerActionLabel(TextBannerAction a)
    {
        switch (a)
        {
        case TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252: return "Reopen as Windows-1252";
        case TextBannerAction::Retry:        return "Retry";
        case TextBannerAction::Dismiss:      return "Dismiss";
        }
        return "?";
    }

    const char* EncodingLabel(Text::TextEncoding e)
    {
        switch (e)
        {
        case Text::TextEncoding::Utf8:        return "UTF-8";
        case Text::TextEncoding::Utf8Bom:     return "UTF-8 with BOM";
        case Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE:     return "UTF-16 LE";
        case Text::TextEncoding::Utf16BE:     return "UTF-16 BE";
        case Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252: return "Windows-1252";
        }
        return "?";
    }

    TextDocument::TextDocument(std::filesystem::path path, std::filesystem::path canonical, TextDocumentServices services)
        : m_path(std::move(path)), m_canonical(std::move(canonical)), m_services(std::move(services))
    {
        m_guid = m_services.peekGuid ? m_services.peekGuid(m_canonical) : Arcane::Guid::Nil();
        char id[24] = {};
        std::snprintf(id, sizeof(id), "%016llx", static_cast<unsigned long long>(HashBytes(Utf8(m_canonical))));
        m_labelId = std::string("###textdoc_") + id;
        Retitle();
    }

    std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> TextDocument::Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, TextDocumentServices services,
                                                     std::string& error)
    {
        const std::optional<std::filesystem::path> canonical = CanonicalFilePath(path);
        if (!canonical)
        {
            error = "'" + Utf8(path) + "' could not be opened: it is missing or not accessible";
            return nullptr;
        }
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc(new TextDocument(path, *canonical, std::move(services)));
        const ReadOutcome r = ReadFileShared(*canonical, doc->MaxOpenBytes());
        if (r.tooLarge)
        {
            error = "'" + doc->Name() + "' is " + std::to_string(r.stamp.size / kBytesPerMiB) + " MB, above editor.text.openMaxMB ("
                  + std::to_string(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().openMaxMB) + " MB) -- open it externally";
            return nullptr;
        }
        if (!r.ok)
        {
            error = "'" + doc->Name() + "' could not be read (Windows error " + std::to_string(r.win32Error) + ")";
            return nullptr;
        }
        const Text::DecodedText decoded = Text::DecodeFile(r.bytes, doc->CurrentDecodeOptions());
        doc->m_model = std::make_unique<TextModel>(Text::Rope::FromUtf8(decoded.text), decoded.eols);
        doc->m_model->buffer.MarkSaved();   // a freshly read document equals its file
        // editor.text.undoGroupMs / undoMemoryMB from the first keystroke (TE2-17 re-applies the
        // live values before every reload).
        doc->m_model->buffer.SetUndoPolicy(ToUndoPolicy(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()));
        doc->m_view = std::make_unique<TextEditorView>(*doc->m_model);
        doc->AdoptDecoded(r, decoded.encoding, decoded.readOnly);
        // The model, buffer and view above are created HERE only. AdoptDecoded is metadata
        // (encoding, read-only reason, synced stamp, banner): ReopenWithEncoding and TE2-17's
        // reload re-run it over the SAME buffer, so TE3-30's InitHighlight() goes right here,
        // once per document.
        return doc;
    }

    Text::DecodeOptions TextDocument::CurrentDecodeOptions() const
    {
        Text::DecodeOptions options = ToDecodeOptions(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>());
        options.forced = m_forcedEncoding;
        return options;
    }

    std::uint64_t TextDocument::MaxOpenBytes() const
    {
        return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::max<std::uint32_t>(1u, Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().openMaxMB)) * kBytesPerMiB;
    }

    std::string TextDocument::Name() const { return Utf8(m_path.filename()); }

    void TextDocument::Retitle()
    {
        m_title = Name();
        m_windowLabel = m_title + m_labelId;
        m_canonicalUtf8 = Utf8(m_canonical);
    }

    void TextDocument::RecomputeReadOnly()
    {
        m_readOnlyReason = m_locked ? TextReadOnlyReason::Locked : m_contentReadOnly;
    }

    void TextDocument::SetReadOnlyLock(bool locked)
    {
        m_locked = locked;
        RecomputeReadOnly();
    }

    void TextDocument::SyncFrom(std::string_view bytes, const FileStamp& stamp)
    {
        m_synced.stamp = stamp;
        m_synced.windowHash = HashBytes(bytes.substr(static_cast<std::size_t>(AppendWindowStart(bytes.size()))));
        m_synced.lastUnit = LastUnitOf(bytes, m_encoding);
    }

    void TextDocument::AdoptDecoded(const ReadOutcome& read, Text::TextEncoding encoding, Text::ReadOnlyReason readOnly)
    {
        m_encoding = encoding;
        m_contentReadOnly = FromContentReason(readOnly);
        RecomputeReadOnly();
        SyncFrom(read.bytes, read.stamp);
        const char* what = nullptr;
        switch (m_contentReadOnly)
        {
        case TextReadOnlyReason::Binary:       what = "contains NUL bytes"; break;
        case TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8:  what = "is not valid UTF-8"; break;
        case TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16: what = "is not valid UTF-16"; break;
        case TextReadOnlyReason::None:
        case TextReadOnlyReason::Locked:       break;
        }
        if (what == nullptr)
            m_banner = {};
        else
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::ReadOnlyContent,
                "'" + Name() + "' " + what + ", so it opened read-only and keeps its bytes exactly. "
                "If it is a legacy text file, reopen it as Windows-1252." };
    }

    bool TextDocument::Dirty() const { return m_model->buffer.Dirty(); }

    bool TextDocument::ReopenWithEncoding(Text::TextEncoding encoding)
    {
        if (Dirty())
            return false;
        const ReadOutcome r = ReadFileShared(m_canonical, MaxOpenBytes());
        if (!r.ok)
        {
            ShowNote("Could not reread '" + Name() + "' (Windows error " + std::to_string(r.win32Error) + ")");
            return false;
        }
        m_forcedEncoding = encoding;
        Text::DecodedText decoded = Text::DecodeFile(r.bytes, CurrentDecodeOptions());
        const Text::TextEncoding decodedAs = decoded.encoding;
        const Text::ReadOnlyReason contentReadOnly = decoded.readOnly;

        // The SAME buffer (the view, a split view and every observer stay bound):
        // no new model, no Rebind.
        Text::TextBuffer& buffer = m_model->buffer;
        buffer.ReloadExternal(std::move(decoded.text), std::move(decoded.eols), m_model->selections);
        buffer.ClearHistory();   // spec s3.5 / CANON D5: undo must not reach text decoded under the old encoding
        buffer.MarkSaved();      // the buffer equals the file again
        m_model->selections.ClampTo(buffer.Text().Size());

        AdoptDecoded(r, decodedAs, contentReadOnly);
        ShowNote(std::string("Reopened '") + Name() + "' as " + EncodingLabel(m_encoding)
                 + ". Undo history was cleared: the earlier text was decoded as a different encoding.");
        return true;
    }

    bool TextDocument::Save()
    {
        if (ReadOnly())
            return false;
        Text::TextBuffer& buffer = m_model->buffer;
        const std::expected<std::string, Text::EncodeError> encoded = Text::EncodeFile(buffer.Text(), buffer.Eols(), m_encoding);
        if (!encoded)
        {
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveFailed, "Could not save '" + Name() + "': " + encoded.error().message
                                   + ". Your changes are still here." };
            return false;
        }
        const std::string& bytes = *encoded;
        SaveRequest req;
        req.target = m_canonical;
        req.bytes = bytes;
        const SaveOutcome out = SaveFileBytes(req);
        if (!SavedOk(out.status))
        {
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveFailed, "Could not save '" + Name() + "' (Windows error "
                                   + std::to_string(out.win32Error) + "). Your changes are still here." };
            return false;
        }
        buffer.MarkSaved();
        m_synced.selfSave = out.written;
        SyncFrom(bytes, StatFile(m_canonical));
        m_banner = {};
        return true;
    }

    void TextDocument::ApplyBannerAction(TextBannerAction a)
    {
        switch (a)
        {
        case TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252: (void)ReopenWithEncoding(Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252); break;
        case TextBannerAction::Retry:        (void)Save(); break;
        case TextBannerAction::Dismiss:      m_banner = {}; break;
        }
    }

    void TextDocument::NoteMoved(const std::filesystem::path& newPath)
    {
        m_path = newPath;
        m_canonical = CanonicalFilePath(newPath).value_or(newPath);
        Retitle();
    }

    void TextDocument::NoteReopened()
    {
        m_view->Focus();
    }

    void TextDocument::DrawBanner()
    {
        if (m_banner.kind != TextBannerKind::None)
        {
            ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0.0f);
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(m_banner.message.c_str());
            ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
            std::optional<TextBannerAction> clicked;
            for (const TextBannerAction a : BannerActions(m_banner))
            {
                ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(a));
                if (ImGui::SmallButton(BannerActionLabel(a)))
                    clicked = a;
                ImGui::PopID();
                ImGui::SameLine();
            }
            ImGui::NewLine();
            ImGui::Separator();
            if (clicked)
                ApplyBannerAction(*clicked);
        }
        if (!m_note.empty())
        {
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", m_note.c_str());
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Dismiss##textnote"))
                ShowNote("");
        }
    }

    void TextDocument::Draw(bool& requestClose)
    {
        bool open = true;
        const bool visible = ImGui::Begin(m_windowLabel.c_str(), &open, Dirty() ? ImGuiWindowFlags_UnsavedDocument : 0);
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s", m_canonicalUtf8.c_str());   // the tab (or title bar) is LastItemData after Begin
        if (!visible)
        {
            m_windowFocused = false;
            ImGui::End();
            requestClose = !open;
            return;
        }
        m_windowFocused = ImGui::IsWindowFocused(ImGuiFocusedFlags_RootAndChildWindows);
        EditorActions& keys = EditorActions::Get();
        if (m_windowFocused)
        {
            keys.MarkContextActive(ActionContext::Document);
            if (keys.Pressed("document.save"))
                (void)RequestSave();
        }
        DrawBanner();
        m_view->Draw("##text", ImVec2(0.0f, 0.0f), ReadOnly());
        ImGui::End();
        requestClose = !open;
    }
}

using namespace Arcane::Editor;
