```cpp
namespace
{
    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            Clear();
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir() { Clear(); }
        void Clear()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            if (std::filesystem::exists(dir, ec))
                for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator(dir, ec))
                    ::SetFileAttributesW(e.path().c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL);
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }

    std::string Read(const std::filesystem::path& p) { return ReadFileShared(p, 1u << 20).bytes; }

    std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> OpenOrFail(const std::filesystem::path& p, TextDocumentServices s = {})
    {
        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(p, std::move(s), error);
        INFO(error);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        return doc;
    }

    // Types `text` at `at` through TE1's command class, as the view would.
    void Type(TextDocument& doc, Arcane::Text::ByteOffset at, std::string_view text)
    {
        TextModel& model = doc.Model();
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands cmds(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model));
        cmds.SetSelections({ Arcane::Text::Selection{ 0, at, at, std::nullopt } });
        cmds.InsertText(text);
    }

    std::uint32_t g_replaceError = 0;
    bool g_renameToBackup = false;
    std::uint32_t FakeReplace(const wchar_t* replaced, const wchar_t*, const wchar_t* backup)
    {
        if (g_renameToBackup) ::MoveFileExW(replaced, backup, 0);
        return g_replaceError;
    }
    std::uint32_t FakeMove(const wchar_t* from, const wchar_t* to, std::uint32_t flags)
    {
        return ::MoveFileExW(from, to, flags) ? 0u : ::GetLastError();
    }
    const SaveFileOps kFakeOps{ &FakeReplace, &FakeMove, nullptr };
}

TEST_CASE("text save flow: a read-only file -- the VCS-worded banner, removal only behind a confirmation", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-flow-readonly");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "locked.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "checked in\n");
    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY));
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.readOnlyReason = [](const std::filesystem::path&) { return std::string("locked by Git LFS -- run `git lfs lock`"); };
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());                          // the attribute refuses the SAVE, not the edit
    Type(*doc, 0, "x");

    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Refused);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveReadOnly);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("locked by Git LFS") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::SaveAs, A::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave, A::Cancel });
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());

    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave);      // asks first, repeating the warning
    CHECK(doc->Banner().confirmingRemoveReadOnly);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("locked by Git LFS") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly, A::Cancel });
    CHECK(Read(p) == "checked in\n");

    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(Read(p) == "xchecked in\n");
    CHECK((StatFile(p).attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) == 0);

    TextDocumentServices plain;
    const std::filesystem::path q = s.dir / "other.txt";
    WriteAll(q, "a\n");
    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(q.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY));
    auto other = OpenOrFail(q, plain);
    Type(*other, 0, "b");
    CHECK_FALSE(other->Save());
    CHECK(other->Banner().message.find("may be under version control") != std::string::npos);   // no probe: the default wording
}

TEST_CASE("text save flow: a holder -> the holders banner; Save anyway replaces", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-flow-holders");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "game.log";
    WriteAll(p, "old\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    Type(*doc, 0, "new ");
    HANDLE h = ::CreateFileW(p.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nullptr,
                             OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE);
    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Deferred);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveHolders);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find(std::to_string(::GetCurrentProcessId())) != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::OverwriteInPlace, A::SaveAnyway, A::Cancel });
    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::SaveAnyway);
    ::CloseHandle(h);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(Read(p) == "new old\n");
}

TEST_CASE("text save flow: in use without delete sharing -> Retry / Save As / Overwrite in place", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-flow-inuse");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "data.csv";
    WriteAll(p, "old\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    Type(*doc, 0, "new ");
    HANDLE h = ::CreateFileW(p.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, nullptr,
                             OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE);
    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Deferred);   // the Restart Manager names this process first
    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::SaveAnyway);                      // ...ReplaceFileW then meets no delete sharing
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveInUse);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("in use by another program") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::Retry, A::SaveAs, A::OverwriteInPlace, A::Cancel });
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());
    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::OverwriteInPlace);
    ::CloseHandle(h);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(Read(p) == "new old\n");
}

TEST_CASE("text save flow: partial ReplaceFileW failures keep the buffer dirty and say what happened", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-flow-recovery");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "a.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "original\n");
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.saveOps = &kFakeOps;
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);
    Type(*doc, 0, "edited ");

    g_replaceError = ERROR_UNABLE_TO_MOVE_REPLACEMENT;
    g_renameToBackup = false;
    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Refused);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveRecovery);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("unchanged") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(Read(p) == "original\n");

    g_replaceError = ERROR_UNABLE_TO_MOVE_REPLACEMENT_2;
    g_renameToBackup = true;
    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Refused);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("put back") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(Read(p) == "original\n");

    g_replaceError = ERROR_INVALID_FUNCTION;
    g_renameToBackup = false;
    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Saved);
    CHECK(Read(p) == "edited original\n");
    CHECK(doc->Note().find("permissions") != std::string::npos);   // the ACL loss, said once
}

TEST_CASE("text save flow: Save As moves the identity; the original file is untouched", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-flow-saveas");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "a.md";
    WriteAll(p, "body\n");
    int identityChanges = 0;
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.identityChanged = [&](TextDocument&) { ++identityChanges; };
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);
    Type(*doc, 0, "new ");
    const std::filesystem::path target = s.dir / "b.md";
    CHECK(doc->SaveAs(target));
    CHECK(identityChanges == 1);
    CHECK(doc->Title() == "b.md");
    CHECK(doc->CanonicalPath() == *CanonicalFilePath(target));
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(Read(target) == "new body\n");
    CHECK(Read(p) == "body\n");
}

TEST_CASE("text save flow: trim and final newline are one undo step each; the fingerprint is recorded", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-flow-transforms");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "t.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "a  \nb\t");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeLayer layer;
    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung trim("editor.text.trimTrailingWhitespace", Arcane::CVarValue::Bool(true));
    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung eol("editor.text.ensureFinalNewline", Arcane::CVarValue::Bool(true));
    CHECK(doc->Save());
    CHECK(Read(p) == "a\nb\n");
    CHECK(doc->Synced().selfSave.valid);
    CHECK(doc->Synced().selfSave.size == 4u);
    CHECK(doc->Synced().selfSave.mtime == StatFile(p).mtime);
    CHECK(doc->Synced().selfSave.hash == HashBytes("a\nb\n"));
    auto& sels = doc->Model().selections;
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Undo(sels));
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "a\nb");
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Undo(sels));
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "a  \nb\t");

    // Nothing to change: no transaction, so no empty undo step.
    TextModel& model = doc->Model();
    Arcane::Text::TextCommands cmds(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model));
    CHECK(cmds.TrimTrailingWhitespace());
    CHECK(cmds.EnsureFinalNewline());
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "a\nb\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(cmds.TrimTrailingWhitespace());
    CHECK_FALSE(cmds.EnsureFinalNewline());
    CHECK(cmds.Undo());
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "a\nb");                 // the last step was EnsureFinalNewline's
}

TEST_CASE("text save flow: a recent external write asks first; after recentWriteSeconds it saves", "[text-doc]")

TEST_CASE("text save flow: a character the encoding cannot hold refuses the save and names where it is", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-flow-encode");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "legacy.txt";
    const std::string original = "caf\xE9\r\n";              // a euro-free Windows-1252 file
    WriteAll(p, original);
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::ReopenAs1252);
    REQUIRE(doc->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    Type(*doc, 0, "\xE4\xB8\xAD");                            // U+4E2D: no Windows-1252 byte holds it

    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Refused);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveEncodeError);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("Cannot save as Windows-1252") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("line 1, byte 1") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("U+4E2D") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::SaveAs, A::Dismiss });
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(Read(p) == original);                              // nothing was written
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Save());
    CHECK(Read(p) == original);
    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::Dismiss);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());
}

TEST_CASE("text save flow: afterSave runs after every successful Save and Save As, never after a refused one", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-flow-aftersave");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "a.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "one\n");
    int calls = 0;
    std::filesystem::path seen;
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.afterSave = [&](TextDocument& d) { ++calls; seen = d.CanonicalPath(); };
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);
    Type(*doc, 0, "x");
    CHECK(doc->Save());
    CHECK(calls == 1);
    CHECK(seen == *CanonicalFilePath(p));

    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY));
    Type(*doc, 0, "y");
    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Refused);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveReadOnly);
    CHECK(calls == 1);                                       // a refused save is not a save

    const std::filesystem::path target = s.dir / "b.txt";
    CHECK(doc->SaveAs(target));
    CHECK(calls == 2);
    CHECK(seen == *CanonicalFilePath(target));              // called with the new identity in place
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.cpp` -- add after `TextCommands::Redo` (inside `namespace Arcane::Text`):

```cpp
    bool TextCommands::TrimTrailingWhitespace()
    {
        const Rope& text = m_buffer.Text();
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::string line;
        for (std::uint32_t row = 0; row < text.LineCount(); ++row)
        {
            const ByteOffset b = text.LineStart(row);
            const ByteOffset e = text.LineEnd(row);
            text.CopyTo(ByteRange{ b, e }, line);
            std::size_t keep = line.size();
            while (keep > 0 && (line[keep - 1] == ' ' || line[keep - 1] == '\t'))
                --keep;
            if (keep < line.size())
                ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ b + keep, e }, std::string{} });
        }
        if (ops.empty())
            return false;
        EditAndMap(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), Bias::Left, Bias::Left, Bias::Right);
        return true;
    }

    bool TextCommands::EnsureFinalNewline()
    {
        const Rope& text = m_buffer.Text();
        const ByteOffset size = text.Size();
        if (size == 0)
            return false;
        std::string last;
        text.CopyTo(ByteRange{ size - 1, size }, last);
        if (last == "\n")
            return false;
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ size, size }, "\n" });   // the new break takes the file's dominant ending (EolMap)
        EditAndMap(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), Bias::Left, Bias::Left, Bias::Right);
        return true;
    }
```

```cpp
    std::vector<TextBannerAction> BannerActions(const TextBanner& b)
    {
        using A = TextBannerAction;
        switch (b.kind)
        {
        case TextBannerKind::None:             return {};
        case TextBannerKind::ReadOnlyContent:  return { A::ReopenAs1252 };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveFailed:       return { A::Retry, A::SaveAs, A::Dismiss };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveReadOnly:
            return b.confirmingRemoveReadOnly ? std::vector<A>{ A::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly, A::Cancel }
                                              : std::vector<A>{ A::SaveAs, A::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave, A::Cancel };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveAccessDenied: return { A::SaveAs, A::Cancel };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveInUse:
            return b.overwriteInPlaceAvailable ? std::vector<A>{ A::Retry, A::SaveAs, A::OverwriteInPlace, A::Cancel }
                                               : std::vector<A>{ A::Retry, A::SaveAs, A::Cancel };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveHolders:
            return b.overwriteInPlaceAvailable ? std::vector<A>{ A::OverwriteInPlace, A::SaveAnyway, A::Cancel }
                                               : std::vector<A>{ A::SaveAnyway, A::Cancel };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveRecovery:     return { A::Retry, A::SaveAs, A::Dismiss };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveEncodeError:  return { A::SaveAs, A::Dismiss };
        }
        return {};
    }

    const char* BannerActionLabel(TextBannerAction a)
    {
        switch (a)
        {
        case TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252:          return "Reopen as Windows-1252";
        case TextBannerAction::Retry:                 return "Retry";
        case TextBannerAction::Dismiss:               return "Dismiss";
        case TextBannerAction::SaveAs:                return "Save As...";
        case TextBannerAction::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave: return "Remove read-only and save";
        case TextBannerAction::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly: return "Yes, remove read-only and save";
        case TextBannerAction::OverwriteInPlace:      return "Overwrite in place (not atomic)";
        case TextBannerAction::SaveAnyway:            return "Save anyway";
        case TextBannerAction::Cancel:                return "Cancel";
        }
        return "?";
    }

    double TextDocument::Now() const
    {
        if (m_services.now)
            return m_services.now();
        return std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
    }

    void TextDocument::NoteExternalWrite() { m_lastExternalWrite = Now(); }

    bool TextDocument::RecentExternalWrite() const
    {
        return m_lastExternalWrite
            && Now() - *m_lastExternalWrite < static_cast<double>(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().recentWriteSeconds);
    }

    std::string TextDocument::ReadOnlyReasonText() const
    {
        return m_services.readOnlyReason ? m_services.readOnlyReason(m_canonical) : std::string("it may be under version control");
    }

    std::string TextDocument::HoldersMessage(const std::string& name, const std::vector<FileHolder>& holders) const
    {
        if (!holders.empty())
        {
            std::string who;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < holders.size(); ++i)
            {
                if (i > 0) who += i + 1 == holders.size() ? " and " : ", ";
                who += (holders[i].thisProcess ? std::string("this editor") : holders[i].appName)
                     + " (pid " + std::to_string(holders[i].pid) + ")";
            }
            return "'" + name + "' is open in " + who + ". Replacing it would detach a program that is still writing it.";
        }
        if (m_follow)
            return "'" + name + "' is being followed. Replacing it would detach the program writing it.";
        return "'" + name + "' was written by another program in the last "
             + std::to_string(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().recentWriteSeconds)
             + " seconds. Replacing it could detach a program that is still writing it.";
    }

    std::expected<std::string, Text::EncodeError> TextDocument::EncodeForSave()
    {
        const TextSettings& s = Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>();
        Text::TextCommands cmds(m_model->buffer, m_model->selections, DefaultEditContext(*m_model));
        if (s.trimTrailingWhitespace)
            (void)cmds.TrimTrailingWhitespace();
        if (s.ensureFinalNewline)
            (void)cmds.EnsureFinalNewline();
        return Text::EncodeFile(m_model->buffer.Text(), m_model->buffer.Eols(), m_encoding);
    }

    std::string TextDocument::EncodeErrorMessage(const Text::EncodeError& e) const
    {
        char codePoint[16] = {};
        std::snprintf(codePoint, sizeof(codePoint), "U+%04X", static_cast<unsigned>(e.value));
        return std::string("Cannot save as ") + EncodingLabel(m_encoding) + ": line " + std::to_string(e.row + 1u)
             + ", byte " + std::to_string(e.byteCol + 1u) + " holds " + codePoint
             + " it cannot represent. Nothing was written; Save As keeps your changes elsewhere.";
    }

    bool TextDocument::Save() { return SaveWith(SaveMode::Atomic); }

    SaveGestureResult TextDocument::RequestSave()
    {
        if (SaveWith(SaveMode::Atomic))
            return SaveGestureResult::Saved;
        return m_banner.kind == TextBannerKind::SaveHolders ? SaveGestureResult::Deferred : SaveGestureResult::Refused;
    }

    bool TextDocument::SaveWith(SaveMode mode)
    {
        if (ReadOnly())
            return false;   // read-only content never saves (spec s3.5)
        const std::expected<std::string, Text::EncodeError> encoded = EncodeForSave();
        if (!encoded)
        {
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveEncodeError, EncodeErrorMessage(encoded.error()) };
            return false;   // nothing written; the buffer stays dirty
        }
        const std::string& bytes = *encoded;
        SaveRequest req;
        req.target = m_canonical;
        req.bytes = bytes;
        req.mode = mode;
        req.underFollow = m_follow;
        req.recentExternalWrite = RecentExternalWrite();
        const SaveOutcome out = SaveFileBytes(req, m_services.saveOps ? *m_services.saveOps : RealSaveFileOps());
        const bool ok = HandleSaveOutcome(out, bytes, m_canonical);
        if (ok && m_services.afterSave)
            m_services.afterSave(*this);
        return ok;
    }

    bool TextDocument::SaveAs(const std::filesystem::path& target)
    {
        if (ReadOnly())
            return false;
        const std::expected<std::string, Text::EncodeError> encoded = EncodeForSave();
        if (!encoded)
        {
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveEncodeError, EncodeErrorMessage(encoded.error()) };
            return false;
        }
        const std::string& bytes = *encoded;
        SaveRequest req;
        req.target = target;
        req.bytes = bytes;
        const SaveOutcome out = SaveFileBytes(req, m_services.saveOps ? *m_services.saveOps : RealSaveFileOps());
        if (!SavedOk(out.status))
            return HandleSaveOutcome(out, bytes, target);
        m_path = target;
        m_canonical = CanonicalFilePath(target).value_or(target);
        m_guid = m_services.peekGuid ? m_services.peekGuid(m_canonical) : Arcane::Guid::Nil();
        Retitle();
        const bool ok = HandleSaveOutcome(out, bytes, target);
        if (m_services.identityChanged)
            m_services.identityChanged(*this);
        if (ok && m_services.afterSave)
            m_services.afterSave(*this);   // after the re-key: it sees the new identity
        return ok;
    }

    bool TextDocument::HandleSaveOutcome(const SaveOutcome& out, const std::string& bytes, const std::filesystem::path& target)
    {
        const std::string name = Utf8(target.filename());
        const std::string err = std::to_string(out.win32Error);
        switch (out.status)
        {
        case SaveStatus::Saved:
        case SaveStatus::SavedWithoutAclPreservation:
            m_model->buffer.MarkSaved();
            m_model->buffer.BreakUndoGroup();   // a save ends the typing group (spec s3.3)
            m_synced.selfSave = out.written;
            SyncFrom(bytes, StatFile(m_canonical));
            m_banner = {};
            if (out.status == SaveStatus::SavedWithoutAclPreservation && !m_aclNoteShown)
            {
                ShowNote("Saved '" + name + "' without keeping its permissions: this volume does not support ReplaceFileW.");
                m_aclNoteShown = true;
            }
            return true;
        case SaveStatus::ReadOnlyAttribute:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveReadOnly, "'" + name + "' is read-only -- " + ReadOnlyReasonText()
                + ". Removing the flag behind a version control system's back is how work gets lost; Save As keeps your changes elsewhere." };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::AccessDenied:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveAccessDenied, "Windows denied writing '" + name + "' -- "
                + ReadOnlyReasonText() + ". Save As keeps your changes elsewhere." };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::SharingViolation:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveInUse, "'" + name + "' is in use by another program. Nothing was written.",
                                   out.overwriteInPlaceAvailable };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::HoldersPresent:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveHolders, HoldersMessage(name, out.holders), out.overwriteInPlaceAvailable };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::RecoveredOriginalIntact:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveRecovery, "Saving '" + name + "' failed (Windows error " + err
                + "); the file on disk is unchanged. Your changes are still here." };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::RecoveredFromBackup:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveRecovery, "Saving '" + name + "' failed part-way (Windows error " + err
                + "); the original was put back. Your changes are still here." };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::RecoveryFailed:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveRecovery, "Saving '" + name + "' failed part-way and the original could not "
                "be put back. Nothing is lost: the original is '" + Utf8(out.backupPath) + "' and your version is '"
                + Utf8(out.tempPath) + "'." };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::WriteFailed:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveFailed, "Could not save '" + name + "' (Windows error " + err
                + "). Your changes are still here." };
            break;
        }
        return false;
    }

    void TextDocument::ApplyBannerAction(TextBannerAction a)
    {
        switch (a)
        {
        case TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252:
            (void)ReopenWithEncoding(Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252);
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::Retry:
            (void)SaveWith(SaveMode::Atomic);
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::SaveAs:
            if (m_services.requestSaveAsPath)
                m_services.requestSaveAsPath(*this);
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave:
            // The confirmation repeats the readOnlyReason phrase verbatim (TE6-22's tests rely on it).
            m_banner.confirmingRemoveReadOnly = true;
            m_banner.message = "Remove the read-only flag from '" + Name() + "' and save? " + ReadOnlyReasonText()
                             + " -- if a version control system locked it, your change may be lost or conflict.";
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly:
            (void)SaveWith(SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic);
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::OverwriteInPlace:
            (void)SaveWith(SaveMode::OverwriteInPlace);
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::SaveAnyway:
            (void)SaveWith(SaveMode::AtomicSkipHolderCheck);
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::Cancel:
        case TextBannerAction::Dismiss:
            m_banner = {};
            break;
        }
    }
```

### Task TE2-17: External changes -- appends on the poll that sees them, replacements after two equal polls, clean reload as one undoable transaction, dirty banner, clean-only append, truncation, rotation, deletion (spec s3.5, s5.3)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp` (enums grow; `Tick`, `PollDisk`, `ReloadFromDisk`, `KeepMine`, `AppendCount`), `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.cpp` (replace `BannerActions`, `BannerActionLabel`, `ApplyBannerAction`; add the poll)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextDocumentExternalTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ClassifyDiskChange`, `DecideDiskAction`, `CompleteTailLength`, `TailSplitsCrLf`, `LastUnitOf`, `AppendWindowStart`, `kAppendWindowBytes` (TE2-4, all over `Text::TextEncoding`); `StatFile`, `ReadRangeShared`, `ReadFileShared`, `SameStamp`, `HashBytes` (TE2-3/5); TE1 `TextBuffer::{AppendExternal(tail, tailEols), ReloadExternal(text, eols, before), LastReloadClearedHistory(), SetUndoPolicy, MarkSaved, Eols}`, `Text::DecodeFile(bytes, const DecodeOptions&) -> DecodedText`, `Text::DecodeFragment(bytes, TextEncoding, Eol defaultEol) -> DecodedText` (CANON B2: the appended tail carries no BOM), `Text::TextCommands::SetSelections(next, primaryIndex)`; `Editor::ToDecodeOptions`, `Editor::ToUndoPolicy`, `DefaultEditContext` (TE2-11); TE2-15's `Buffer()`, `Model()`, `Encoding()`, `ShowNote`; `TextSettings::{watchPollSeconds, undoMemoryMB}`.
- Produces: `TextBannerKind` += `ChangedOnDisk, DeletedOnDisk`; `TextBannerAction` += `Reload, KeepMine`; `TextDocument::{Tick(double) override, PollDisk(), ReloadFromDisk(), KeepMine()}` (`ReloadFromDisk` stays a NON-virtual `void`: TE6-7's `EditorDocument` virtual is named `ReloadFromExternalChange()`, so nothing is hidden); `std::uint64_t TextDocument::AppendCount() const` (appends taken from disk since open; CANON A11). An appended tail that `DecodeFragment` reports as not valid text in the document's encoding (`readOnly` = `InvalidUtf8`, `InvalidUtf16`, or `Binary` for a NUL in UTF-8) is appended byte-faithfully but turns the document read-only with that reason and the `ReadOnlyContent` banner, never editable text. **TE6-3**'s Follow (cadence and per-poll chunk cap inside `PollDisk`) and the log witnesses drive `PollDisk` through `Tick` and read `AppendCount`.

The poll (CANON B1, C TE2 #12) classifies every stamp change at once. Growth whose bytes before the old end are unchanged (`DiskChange::Appended`) is acted on by the poll that sees it: a clean or read-only document appends the tail's complete characters immediately (`CompleteTailLength`; an incomplete trailing unit stays on disk for the next poll, and the synced stamp and size advance only by the bytes consumed), so a log that is written continuously -- its stamp different at every poll -- shows each poll's lines at once (Review Focus F1). Only a replacement -- `Truncated`, `Rewritten` (rotation included), `Deleted`, `Recreated` -- waits until two consecutive polls see the same stamp, so a program mid-way through replacing a file is never read half-way (the "debounced" of spec s5.3 applies to these alone, at `editor.text.watchPollSeconds`). The appended tail is decoded with `Text::DecodeFragment` in the document's encoding, never `DecodeFile`: a UTF-16 tail has no BOM and would read as UTF-8 with NULs (Review Focus F2). When the fragment's `readOnly` is not `None` (an invalid UTF-8 byte, a lone UTF-16 surrogate, a NUL in UTF-8 -> `Binary`, TE1-11), the tail is still appended exactly (the buffer must equal the file), but an editable document turns read-only with that reason and the `ReadOnlyContent` banner, exactly as if it had been opened with that content; a document that is already content-read-only keeps its first reason. A reload keeps cursors by line/column, is one undoable transaction, and marks the document clean (the buffer equals the file); when TE1's reload finds the changed old text larger than the live `editor.text.undoMemoryMB`, it clears the history itself and `LastReloadClearedHistory()` makes the document say so through `ShowNote` (spec s5.4). The self-save fingerprint makes the document's own save invisible to the poll.

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-17 (spec s3.5, s5.3): external changes. Growth appends on the
// poll that sees it; a replacement counts only after two equal polls.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;
using A = TextBannerAction;

namespace
{
    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }

    void AppendAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::app).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }

    std::string Read(const std::filesystem::path& p) { return ReadFileShared(p, 1u << 24).bytes; }

    std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> OpenOrFail(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(p, {}, error);
        INFO(error);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        return doc;
    }

    std::string TextOf(TextDocument& d) { return d.Buffer().Text().ToString(); }

    void Type(TextDocument& doc, Arcane::Text::ByteOffset at, std::string_view text)
    {
        TextModel& model = doc.Model();
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands cmds(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model));
        cmds.SetSelections({ Arcane::Text::Selection{ 0, at, at, std::nullopt } });
        cmds.InsertText(text);
    }

    void Settle(TextDocument& d) { d.PollDisk(); d.PollDisk(); }   // a replacement acts on the second of two equal polls
}

TEST_CASE("external change: a rewrite waits one poll; a clean document reloads silently as one undoable step", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-clean");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "a.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "one\ntwo\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    Type(*doc, 4, "X");
    REQUIRE(doc->Save());
    WriteAll(p, "one\nTWO\nthree\n");                      // grew, but the bytes before the old end changed: a rewrite
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "one\nXtwo\n");                  // a writer may be mid-way through replacing it: wait for a second equal poll
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "one\nTWO\nthree\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 0u);
    auto& sels = doc->Model().selections;
    REQUIRE(doc->Buffer().Undo(sels));                     // Ctrl+Z after a reload restores the previous version...
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "one\nXtwo\n");
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());                                   // ...which no longer equals the file on disk
    REQUIRE(doc->Buffer().Undo(sels));                     // and the history behind it stays valid
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "one\ntwo\n");
}

{

TEST_CASE("external change: a file that grows between every poll shows each poll's lines at once (Review Focus F1)", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-steady");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "game.log";
    WriteAll(p, "start\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    Type(*doc, 0, "# ");
    REQUIRE(doc->Save());
    const bool couldUndo = doc->Buffer().CanUndo();
    REQUIRE(couldUndo);
    std::string expected = "# start\n";
    for (int i = 1; i <= 10; ++i)
    {
        const std::string line = "tick " + std::to_string(i) + "\n";
        AppendAll(p, line);                                // the writer never pauses: the stamp differs at every poll
        expected += line;
        doc->PollDisk();
        INFO("poll " << i);
        CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == expected);                   // this poll's complete lines are already in the buffer
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
        CHECK(doc->Buffer().CanUndo() == couldUndo);       // an append is no undo entry
        CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i));
    }
    REQUIRE(doc->Buffer().Undo(doc->Model().selections));  // the pre-growth edit is still the top of the history
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == expected.substr(2));
}

TEST_CASE("external change: a UTF-16LE file growing by odd byte counts appends exactly its complete lines (Review Focus F2)", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-utf16");

    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    REQUIRE(doc->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());

    AppendAll(p, std::string("b\0\n\0c", 5));              // 5 bytes: "b\n" and the first half of 'c'
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "a\nb\n");                       // decoded as BOM-less UTF-16LE, no NULs; the half unit waits
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 10u);                // the synced size advanced by the 4 consumed bytes only
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 1u);

    AppendAll(p, std::string("\0\n\0", 3));                // 3 more bytes complete 'c' and its break
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "a\nb\nc\n");
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 14u);
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 2u);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
}

    AppendAll(wide, std::string("\x00\xDC" "b\0\n\0", 6));  // a lone LOW surrogate, then "b\n"
    c->PollDisk();
    CHECK(c->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(c->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16);
    CHECK(c->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK(c->AppendCount() == 1u);
    CHECK_FALSE(c->Dirty());
```

```cpp
    void TextDocument::Tick(double dt)
    {
        m_pollElapsed += dt;
        if (m_pollElapsed < Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().watchPollSeconds)
            return;
        m_pollElapsed = 0.0;
        PollDisk();
    }

    void TextDocument::PollDisk()
    {
        const FileStamp now = StatFile(m_canonical);
        if (SameStamp(now, m_synced.stamp))
        {
            m_pendingStamp.reset();
            return;
        }
        const DiskObservation seen = ObserveDisk(now);
        // Appended (and the document's own save) act on the poll that sees them, so a
        // log written without pause still shows each poll's lines (CANON C TE2 #12).
        // A replacement waits for a second poll with the same stamp.
        const bool replacement = seen.change == DiskChange::Truncated || seen.change == DiskChange::Rewritten
                              || seen.change == DiskChange::Deleted   || seen.change == DiskChange::Recreated;
        if (replacement && (!m_pendingStamp || !SameStamp(*m_pendingStamp, now)))
        {
            m_pendingStamp = now;   // seen once: act when the next poll agrees
            return;
        }
        m_pendingStamp.reset();
        ActOnDisk(seen, now);
    }

    TextDocument::DiskObservation TextDocument::ObserveDisk(const FileStamp& now) const
    {
        DiskObservation seen;
        const std::uint64_t oldSize = m_synced.stamp.size;
        std::optional<std::uint64_t> windowHash;
        if (now.exists && m_synced.stamp.exists && now.size > oldSize)
            if (std::optional<std::string> w = ReadRangeShared(m_canonical, AppendWindowStart(oldSize), oldSize - AppendWindowStart(oldSize)))
            {
                seen.window = std::move(*w);
                windowHash = HashBytes(seen.window);
            }
        seen.change = ClassifyDiskChange(m_synced, now, windowHash);
        if (seen.change == DiskChange::Appended)
        {
            if (std::optional<std::string> t = ReadRangeShared(m_canonical, oldSize, now.size - oldSize))
            {
                seen.tail = std::move(*t);
                const std::string_view tail = seen.tail;
                seen.splitsCrLf = TailSplitsCrLf(m_synced.lastUnit, tail.substr(0, CompleteTailLength(tail, Encoding())), Encoding());
            }
            else
                seen.change = DiskChange::Rewritten;   // the tail could not be read: treat it as a replacement
        }
        return seen;
    }

    void TextDocument::ActOnDisk(const DiskObservation& seen, const FileStamp& now)
    {
        if (seen.change != DiskChange::None && seen.change != DiskChange::SelfSave)
            NoteExternalWrite();
        switch (DecideDiskAction(seen.change, Dirty(), ReadOnly(), seen.splitsCrLf))
        {
        case DiskAction::Ignore:
            break;
        case DiskAction::AcceptSelfSave:
            m_synced.stamp = now;
            break;
        case DiskAction::AppendTail:
            AppendTail(seen.window, seen.tail, now);
            break;
        case DiskAction::SilentReload:
            ReloadFromDisk();
            break;
        case DiskAction::DirtyBanner:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::ChangedOnDisk, "'" + Name() + "' changed on disk. Reload it (your version "
                "stays one Ctrl+Z away) or keep yours (Save then overwrites the disk)." };
            m_synced.stamp = now;
            break;
        case DiskAction::DeletedBanner:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::DeletedOnDisk, "'" + Name() + "' was deleted on disk. Save recreates it." };
            m_synced.stamp = now;
            break;
        }
    }

    void TextDocument::AppendTail(std::string_view window, std::string_view tail, const FileStamp& now)
    {
        // Complete characters only (a UTF-16 unit, a surrogate pair, a UTF-8 sequence);
        // the rest stays on disk and the next poll rereads it from the synced end.
        const std::string_view consumed = tail.substr(0, CompleteTailLength(tail, Encoding()));
        if (consumed.empty())
            return;   // only a partial character so far: the synced stamp stays put
        // The tail has no BOM: decode it in the document's known encoding (CANON B2), its
        // breaks folded as DecodeFile folds them, a break-less tail taking the dominant style.
        const Text::DecodedText d = Text::DecodeFragment(tail.substr(0, CompleteTailLength(tail, Encoding())), Encoding(), Buffer().Eols().Dominant());
        Buffer().AppendExternal(d.text, d.eols);   // no undo entry, ids unchanged (spec s3.5)
        ++m_appendCount;
        // A tail that is not valid text in this encoding (invalid UTF-8, a lone UTF-16
        // surrogate, a NUL in UTF-8 -> Binary; TE1-11) is kept byte-faithfully above, but the
        // document no longer edits: the same read-only state an open of that content gives.
        if (d.readOnly != Text::ReadOnlyReason::None && m_contentReadOnly == TextReadOnlyReason::None)
        {
            m_contentReadOnly = FromContentReason(d.readOnly);
            RecomputeReadOnly();
            const char* what = m_contentReadOnly == TextReadOnlyReason::Binary      ? "gained NUL bytes"
                             : m_contentReadOnly == TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8 ? "gained bytes that are not valid UTF-8"
                                                                                     : "gained bytes that are not valid UTF-16";
            if (m_banner.kind == TextBannerKind::None)
                m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::ReadOnlyContent,
                    "'" + Name() + "' " + what + " on disk, so it is read-only now and keeps its bytes exactly. "
                    "If it is a legacy text file, reopen it as Windows-1252." };
        }
        // The synced state advances by the CONSUMED bytes only, so a held-back partial
        // character keeps the synced size behind the file and is read whole next time.
        const std::uint64_t newSize = m_synced.stamp.size + consumed.size();
        std::string joined(window);
        joined.append(consumed);
        const std::size_t keep = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(joined.size(), kAppendWindowBytes));
        m_synced.stamp = FileStamp{ true, newSize, now.mtime, now.attributes };
        m_synced.windowHash = HashBytes(std::string_view(joined).substr(joined.size() - keep));
        m_synced.lastUnit = LastUnitOf(consumed, Encoding());
    }

    void TextDocument::ReloadFromDisk()
    {
        const ReadOutcome r = ReadFileShared(m_canonical, MaxOpenBytes());
        if (!r.ok)
        {
            ShowNote(r.tooLarge ? "'" + Name() + "' grew past editor.text.openMaxMB; it was not reloaded."
                                : "Could not reload '" + Name() + "' (Windows error " + std::to_string(r.win32Error) + ").");
            return;
        }
        Text::DecodeOptions options = ToDecodeOptions(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>());
        options.forced = m_forcedEncoding;   // a Reopen with Encoding choice survives reloads
        Text::DecodedText d = Text::DecodeFile(r.bytes, options);
        TextModel& model = Model();
        Text::TextBuffer& buffer = Buffer();
        // Cursors are kept by line/column (spec s5.3); the primary stays primary.
        const std::size_t primaryIndex = model.selections.PrimaryIndex();
        std::vector<std::pair<Text::Point, Text::Point>> points;
        {
            const Text::Rope& before = buffer.Text();
            for (const Text::Selection& sel : model.selections.All())
                points.emplace_back(before.OffsetToPoint(sel.anchor), before.OffsetToPoint(sel.head));
        }
        buffer.SetUndoPolicy(ToUndoPolicy(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()));   // the live editor.text.undoMemoryMB cap
        // One undoable Other transaction (TE1-10). If the changed old text alone exceeds
        // the cap, TE1 clears the history instead and reports it; the document never clears it itself.
        buffer.ReloadExternal(std::move(d.text), std::move(d.eols), model.selections);
        buffer.MarkSaved();   // the buffer equals the file again; undo returns to the previous text
        if (buffer.LastReloadClearedHistory())   // the s5.4 note, through the one note channel
            ShowNote("History cleared: '" + Name() + "' was reloaded from disk and its previous text is larger than editor.text.undoMemoryMB.");
        const Text::Rope& after = buffer.Text();
        const auto clampPoint = [&](const Text::Point& pt)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = std::min(pt.row, after.LineCount() - 1);
            const Text::ByteOffset start = after.LineStart(row);
            return std::min<Text::ByteOffset>(start + pt.col, after.LineEnd(row));
        };
        std::vector<Text::Selection> mapped;
        for (const auto& [a, h] : points)
            mapped.push_back(Text::Selection{ 0, clampPoint(a), clampPoint(h), std::nullopt });
        Text::TextCommands(buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model)).SetSelections(std::move(mapped), primaryIndex);
        m_encoding = d.encoding;
        m_contentReadOnly = d.readOnly == Text::ReadOnlyReason::Binary       ? TextReadOnlyReason::Binary
                          : d.readOnly == Text::ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8  ? TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8
                          : d.readOnly == Text::ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16 ? TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16
                                                                             : TextReadOnlyReason::None;
        RecomputeReadOnly();
        SyncFrom(r.bytes, r.stamp);
        if (m_banner.kind == TextBannerKind::ChangedOnDisk || m_banner.kind == TextBannerKind::DeletedOnDisk)
            m_banner = {};
    }

    void TextDocument::KeepMine()
    {
        m_banner = {};   // the synced stamp already moved on: the next Save overwrites the disk
    }
```

```cpp
    struct ImGuiScope

    TextSharedVerbs PressAndRead(EditorActions& actions, ImGuiKeyChord mods, ImGuiKey key)
    {
        ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
        TextSharedVerbs got;
        const auto frame = [&] { io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f; ImGui::NewFrame(); const TextSharedVerbs v = ReadTextSharedVerbs(actions);

        if (mods & ImGuiMod_Ctrl) io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Ctrl, true);
        if (mods & ImGuiMod_Shift) io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Shift, true);
        io.AddKeyEvent(key, true);
        frame();
        frame();
        io.AddKeyEvent(key, false);
        if (mods & ImGuiMod_Ctrl) io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Ctrl, false);
        if (mods & ImGuiMod_Shift) io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Shift, false);
        frame();
        return got;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("text clipboard: line endings normalise; one entry per cursor distributes on an equal count", "[text-actions]")
{
    CHECK(NormalizeClipboardText("a\r\nb\rc\n") == "a\nb\nc\n");
    std::string os;
    const TextClipboard fake{ [&](const std::string& s) { os = s; }, [&] { return os; } };
    CopyToClipboard(fake, { "alpha", "beta" });
    CHECK(os == "alpha\nbeta");
    CHECK(PasteForCursors(os, 2) == std::vector<std::string>{ "alpha", "beta" });     // remembered parts
    CHECK(PasteForCursors(os, 3) == std::vector<std::string>(3, "alpha\nbeta"));      // a different count: the whole text each
    CHECK(PasteForCursors("x\ny\nz\n", 3) == std::vector<std::string>{ "x", "y", "z" }); // copied elsewhere: one line per cursor
    CHECK(PasteForCursors("solo", 1) == std::vector<std::string>{ "solo" });
}

TEST_CASE("text verbs: the editor's own action ids, rebinding included; Ctrl+F4 closes", "[text-actions]")
{
    const ImGuiScope scope;
    Arcane::CVarRegistry reg;
    EditorActions actions(reg);
    RegisterEditorActions(actions);
    CHECK(PressAndRead(actions, ImGuiMod_Ctrl, ImGuiKey_Z).undo);
    CHECK(PressAndRead(actions, ImGuiMod_Ctrl, ImGuiKey_Y).redo);
    CHECK(PressAndRead(actions, ImGuiMod_Ctrl | ImGuiMod_Shift, ImGuiKey_Z).redo);
    CHECK(PressAndRead(actions, ImGuiMod_Ctrl, ImGuiKey_X).cut);
    CHECK(PressAndRead(actions, ImGuiMod_Ctrl, ImGuiKey_C).copy);
    CHECK(PressAndRead(actions, ImGuiMod_Ctrl, ImGuiKey_V).paste);
    CHECK(PressAndRead(actions, ImGuiMod_Ctrl, ImGuiKey_W).close);
    CHECK(PressAndRead(actions, ImGuiMod_Ctrl, ImGuiKey_F4).close);
    reg.Set(actions.HandleOf("edit.undo"), Arcane::CVarValue::String("Ctrl+U"), Arcane::SetBy::EditorUser, "editor", Arcane::CVarContext::Editor);
    reg.Publish();
    actions.RefreshBindings();
    CHECK_FALSE(PressAndRead(actions, ImGuiMod_Ctrl, ImGuiKey_Z).undo);
    CHECK(PressAndRead(actions, ImGuiMod_Ctrl, ImGuiKey_U).undo);   // rebinding Undo rebinds it here too
}

TEST_CASE("text verbs: document.closeAlt is a Global Ctrl+F4 row the Global close route reads", "[text-actions]")
{
    const auto it = std::find_if(kEditorActionTable.begin(), kEditorActionTable.end(),
                                 [](const EditorActionDesc& d) { return d.id == "document.closeAlt"; });
    REQUIRE(it != kEditorActionTable.end());
    CHECK(it->context == ActionContext::Global);
    CHECK(it->defaultChord == "Ctrl+F4");

    Arcane::CVarRegistry reg;

    in.dt = 1.0 / 60.0;
    in.snap = &none;
    actions.BeginFrame(in);
    in.snap = &f4;
    actions.BeginFrame(in);
    CHECK(ReadGlobalShortcuts(actions).closeDocument);
}

TEST_CASE("text verbs: per-document history, multi-cursor cut/copy/paste, read-only, close", "[text-actions]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path p = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-te2-verbs.txt";
    std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary) << "aa bb\n";
    std::string os;
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.clipboard = TextClipboard{ [&](const std::string& s) { os = s; }, [&] { return os; } };
    std::string error;
    auto doc = TextDocument::Open(p, services, error);
    REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
    TextModel& model = doc->Model();
    const auto selectTwo = [&]
    {
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model))
            .SetSelections({ Selection{ 0, 0, 2, std::nullopt }, Selection{ 0, 3, 5, std::nullopt } });
    };
    selectTwo();
    bool close = false;

    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .copy = true }, close);
    CHECK(os == "aa\nbb");
    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .cut = true }, close);
    CHECK(doc->Model().buffer.Text().ToString() == " \n");
    CHECK(doc->Model().selections.Size() == 2u);
    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .paste = true }, close);       // two cursors, two parts: each gets its own
    CHECK(doc->Model().buffer.Text().ToString() == "aa bb\n");
    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .undo = true }, close);
    CHECK(doc->Model().buffer.Text().ToString() == " \n");
    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .redo = true }, close);
    CHECK(doc->Model().buffer.Text().ToString() == "aa bb\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(close);

    selectTwo();
    doc->SetReadOnlyLock(true);
    os = "zz";
    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .cut = true, .paste = true }, close);
    CHECK(doc->Model().buffer.Text().ToString() == "aa bb\n");          // read-only: nothing changes...
    CHECK(os == "aa\nbb");                                               // ...but copying (cut's copy half) still works
    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .close = true }, close);
    CHECK(close);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->OwnsSharedVerbs());                                 // its view is not drawn, so it owns no keys
    std::filesystem::remove(p);
}

TEST_CASE("text verbs: DocumentHost reports a focused document that owns the shared verbs", "[text-actions]")
{
    struct OwningDoc final : EditorDocument
    {
        std::string title = "t";
        bool focused = true, owns = true;
        const std::string& Title() const override { return title; }
        Arcane::Guid AssetGuid() const override { return Arcane::Guid::Nil(); }
        bool Dirty() const override { return false; }
        bool Save() override { return true; }
        bool WindowFocused() const override { return focused; }
        bool OwnsSharedVerbs() const override { return owns; }
        void Draw(bool&) override {}
        void NoteMoved(const std::filesystem::path&) override {}
    };
    DocumentHost host;
    auto* d = static_cast<OwningDoc*>(host.Add(std::make_unique<OwningDoc>()));
    CHECK(host.DocumentOwnsSharedVerbs());
    d->owns = false;
    CHECK_FALSE(host.DocumentOwnsSharedVerbs());
    d->owns = true;
    d->focused = false;
    CHECK_FALSE(host.DocumentOwnsSharedVerbs());
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text editor's clipboard (spec s5.1, s7). A copy with several selections
// stores ONE ENTRY PER CURSOR: the OS clipboard gets them joined by LF, and the
// parts are remembered process-wide, so a paste into any text document with
// the same cursor count distributes them (Sublime). A clipboard copied
// elsewhere with exactly one line per cursor distributes too.

#include <cstddef>
#include <functional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct TextClipboard
    {
        std::function<void(const std::string&)> set;
        std::function<std::string()>            get;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] TextClipboard ImGuiTextClipboard();   // ImGui::SetClipboardText / GetClipboardText

    [[nodiscard]] std::string NormalizeClipboardText(std::string text);   // CRLF and lone CR -> LF (the rope stores LF)
    void CopyToClipboard(const TextClipboard& clipboard, const std::vector<std::string>& parts);
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> PasteForCursors(const std::string& normalizedClip, std::size_t cursorCount);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextClipboard.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextClipboard.hpp"

#include <imgui.h>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        struct Remembered
        {
            std::string              joined;
            std::vector<std::string> parts;
        };
        Remembered& Memory()
        {
            static Remembered m;
            return m;
        }
    }

    TextClipboard ImGuiTextClipboard()
    {
        return TextClipboard{
            [](const std::string& s) { ImGui::SetClipboardText(s.c_str()); },
            [] { const char* t = ImGui::GetClipboardText(); return std::string(t ? t : ""); },
        };
    }

    std::string NormalizeClipboardText(std::string text)
    {
        std::string out;
        out.reserve(text.size());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < text.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (text[i] == '\r')
            {
                out.push_back('\n');
                if (i + 1 < text.size() && text[i + 1] == '\n')
                    ++i;
            }
            else
                out.push_back(text[i]);
        }
        return out;
    }

    void CopyToClipboard(const TextClipboard& clipboard, const std::vector<std::string>& parts)
    {
        std::string joined;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < parts.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (i > 0)
                joined.push_back('\n');
            joined += parts[i];
        }
        Memory() = Remembered{ joined, parts };
        if (clipboard.set)
            clipboard.set(joined);
    }

    std::vector<std::string> PasteForCursors(const std::string& clip, std::size_t cursorCount)
    {
        if (cursorCount <= 1)
            return { clip };
        const Remembered& m = Memory();
        if (m.parts.size() == cursorCount && m.joined == clip)
            return m.parts;
        std::vector<std::string> lines;
        std::size_t start = 0;
        for (;;)
        {
            const std::size_t nl = clip.find('\n', start);
            if (nl == std::string::npos)
            {
                lines.push_back(clip.substr(start));
                break;
            }
            lines.push_back(clip.substr(start, nl - start));
            start = nl + 1;
        }
        if (!lines.empty() && lines.back().empty())
            lines.pop_back();
        if (lines.size() == cursorCount)
            return lines;
        return std::vector<std::string>(cursorCount, clip);
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text document's keyboard verbs (text editor spec s7). The SHARED verbs
// reuse the editor's existing action ids -- edit.undo, edit.redo,
// edit.redoAlt, edit.cut, edit.copy, edit.paste, document.close and the new
// Global document.closeAlt (Ctrl+F4) -- answered by the focused text document
// through PressedInWindow (the Settings window's local-undo precedent), so
// rebinding Undo rebinds it everywhere. document.save stays the Document
// context's (Pressed, like every other document). TE4 adds the text.* rows
// (ActionContext::TextDocument) here.

#include "Input/EditorActions.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct TextSharedVerbs
    {
        bool undo = false, redo = false, cut = false, copy = false, paste = false, close = false;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] TextSharedVerbs ReadTextSharedVerbs(const EditorActions& actions);
}
```

```cpp
        v.redo  = a.PressedInWindow("edit.redo") || a.PressedInWindow("edit.redoAlt");
        v.cut   = a.PressedInWindow("edit.cut");

        v.paste = a.PressedInWindow("edit.paste");
        v.close = a.PressedInWindow("document.close") || a.PressedInWindow("document.closeAlt");
```

```cpp
    void TextDocument::ApplySharedVerbs(const TextSharedVerbs& v, bool& requestClose)
    {
        TextModel& model = Model();
        Text::TextCommands cmds(Buffer(), model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model));
        bool moved = false;
        if (v.undo && !ReadOnly())
            moved |= cmds.Undo();
        if (v.redo && !ReadOnly())
            moved |= cmds.Redo();
        if (v.copy || v.cut)
        {
            const std::vector<std::string> parts = cmds.CopySelections();
            if (std::any_of(parts.begin(), parts.end(), [](const std::string& s) { return !s.empty(); }))
            {
                CopyToClipboard(m_services.clipboard, parts);
                if (v.cut && !ReadOnly())
                {
                    cmds.DeleteSelections();
                    moved = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if (v.paste && !ReadOnly() && m_services.clipboard.get)
        {
            const std::string clip = NormalizeClipboardText(m_services.clipboard.get());
            if (!clip.empty())
            {
                // One part per cursor (equal counts distribute, else the whole text at each); one undo step.
                const std::vector<std::string> perCursor = PasteForCursors(clip, model.selections.Size());
                cmds.InsertPerSelection(perCursor);
                moved = true;
            }
        }
        if (moved)
            View().RevealOffset(model.selections.Primary().head, false);
        if (v.close)
            requestClose = true;
    }
```

### Task TE2-19: `DocumentHost` -- canonical-path index, fallback factory, `OpenAt`, re-keying; `TextDocument::GoTo` (spec s5.3, s9)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/EditorDocument.hpp` (`CanonicalPath`, `RevealPoint`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/DocumentHost.hpp:23-148`, `ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/DocumentHost.cpp:30-189` (also `RegisterTextFactory`, `HasDedicatedFactory` and the private `Route::text` flag)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp`, `.cpp` (`CanonicalPath` becomes an override; `GoTo`; `RevealPoint` forwards to `GoTo`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextDocumentHostTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1 `Text::Point`, `Rope::{LineCount, LineStart, LineEnd}`; `Text::TextCommands::SetSelections(std::vector<Selection>)` (TE1-14: no text change, the last element becomes primary, id-0 selections get fresh ids); `DefaultEditContext(TextModel&)` (TE2-11); `TextDocument::{Open, Model, View}` (TE2-15); `TextEditorView::{RevealOffset, Focus}` (TE2-13).
- Produces: `virtual std::filesystem::path EditorDocument::CanonicalPath() const` (default empty), `virtual void EditorDocument::RevealPoint(std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t col)` (default nothing); `void TextDocument::GoTo(Text::Point at)` (CANON B8: THE "go to a point" in an open text document -- row clamped to the last row, column clamped to that row's byte length, one cursor there, centred in the primary view; the `RevealPoint` override forwards to it; **TE4-13** extends its body to unfold a fold hiding the target; **TE7-9**'s FileOpener calls it); `DocumentHost::{SetPathCanonicalizer(PathCanonicalizer), SetFallbackFactory(OpenFactory, std::function<bool(const std::filesystem::path&)> claims), SetGuidResolver(GuidResolver), OpenAt(const std::filesystem::path&, const Arcane::Text::Point&), OpenAt(const Arcane::Guid&, const Arcane::Text::Point&), FindByCanonicalPath(const std::filesystem::path&), RefreshCanonicalKey(EditorDocument&)}`; `void DocumentHost::RegisterTextFactory(std::string extension, OpenFactory factory)` (registers the extension factory exactly like `RegisterFactory` and marks it a TEXT route: it counts for `HasFactory`, never for `HasDedicatedFactory`; **TE2-20**'s explicit-extension loop registers through it) and `[[nodiscard]] bool DocumentHost::HasDedicatedFactory(const std::filesystem::path& path) const` (true only when an extension factory registered through `RegisterFactory` takes `path` -- never a text route, never the fallback; the extension match is case-insensitive like `HasFactory`'s). After TE2-20, `HasFactory` is true for every text file, so the "has a dedicated editor" facts read `HasDedicatedFactory`: **TE6-12**'s Open as Text lock and **TE7-9**'s FileOpener `hasDedicatedEditor` (and the tab menu / asset panels / Open With page) consume it. Also `using PathCanonicalizer = std::function<std::filesystem::path(const std::filesystem::path&)>; using GuidResolver = std::function<std::optional<std::filesystem::path>(const Arcane::Guid&)>;`. `DocumentHost` has NO C++ route (CANON B5): a C/C++ source is simply not claimed by TE2-20's fallback predicate until **TE7-9** removes that exclusion and its FileOpener owns C++ opens. Callers outside TE2 (**Spec 2**'s Goto Anything / Find in Files, **TE5**'s global marks) reach `OpenAt` through TE7's FileOpener (CANON A10); **TE6**'s Open as Text uses the canonical index to focus an already-open text tab.

Identity rules (spec s5.3): a document that reports a canonical path is keyed by it; `OpenPath` resolves any spelling (case, 8.3, junction) to that key *before* constructing anything, so the Asset Browser, a Problems `file:line` row and `--open-path` all focus one tab. A Guid-keyed document (the existing asset editors) is untouched: it reports no canonical path. An asset move re-keys (`NoteAssetMoved` -> `NoteMoved` -> `RefreshCanonicalKey`).

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-19 (spec s5.3, s9): DocumentHost's canonical-path index, the
// fallback factory and OpenAt -- with fake documents -- and TextDocument::GoTo
// (CANON B8) on a real document.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    // The fake canonicalizer: lowercase, forward slashes.
    std::filesystem::path Lower(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::string s = p.generic_string();
        std::transform(s.begin(), s.end(), s.begin(), [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
        return s;
    }

    struct FakeTextDoc final : EditorDocument
    {
        std::string title;
        std::filesystem::path canonical;
        Arcane::Guid guid;
        int reopened = 0;
        std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t>> revealed;
        FakeTextDoc(const std::filesystem::path& p, Arcane::Guid g = Arcane::Guid::Nil())
            : title(p.filename().string()), canonical(Lower(p)), guid(g) {}
        const std::string& Title() const override { return title; }
        Arcane::Guid AssetGuid() const override { return guid; }
        bool Dirty() const override { return false; }
        bool Save() override { return true; }
        void Draw(bool&) override {}
        void NoteReopened() override { ++reopened; }
        void NoteMoved(const std::filesystem::path& p) override { title = p.filename().string(); canonical = Lower(p); }
        std::filesystem::path CanonicalPath() const override { return canonical; }
        void RevealPoint(std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t col) override { revealed.emplace_back(row, col); }
    };

    struct Rig
    {
        DocumentHost host;
        int fallbackBuilds = 0;
        Rig()
        {
            host.SetPathCanonicalizer(&Lower);
            host.RegisterFactory(".arcmat", [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return std::make_unique<FakeTextDoc>(p); });
            host.SetFallbackFactory(
                [this](const std::filesystem::path& p) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument>
                {
                    ++fallbackBuilds;
                    return std::make_unique<FakeTextDoc>(p);
                },
                // The fake claims predicate: everything but a PNG and a C++ source
                // (the real one, TE2-20, refuses C/C++ until TE7-9 -- D15).
                [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return p.extension() != ".png" && p.extension() != ".cpp"; });
        }
    };
}

TEST_CASE("document host: any spelling of an open file focuses its one tab", "[text-doc][editor]")
{
    Rig r;
    EditorDocument* a = r.host.OpenPath("C:/Proj/Config/Notes.MD");
    REQUIRE(a != nullptr);
    EditorDocument* b = r.host.OpenPath("c:/proj/config/notes.md");
    CHECK(b == a);
    CHECK(r.host.Count() == 1u);
    CHECK(r.fallbackBuilds == 1);                          // resolved by key BEFORE constructing a second document
    CHECK(static_cast<FakeTextDoc*>(a)->reopened == 1);
    CHECK(r.host.FindByCanonicalPath(Lower("C:/PROJ/config/NOTES.md")) == a);
}

TEST_CASE("document host: extension routes first, then the fallback when it claims the path", "[text-doc][editor]")
{
    Rig r;
    CHECK(r.host.OpenPath("C:/p/m.arcmat") != nullptr);
    CHECK(r.fallbackBuilds == 0);
    CHECK(r.host.OpenPath("C:/p/readme") != nullptr);       // no extension: the fallback
    CHECK(r.fallbackBuilds == 1);
    CHECK(r.host.OpenPath("C:/p/hero.png") == nullptr);     // not claimed
    CHECK(r.host.HasFactory("C:/p/a.txt"));
    CHECK(r.host.HasFactory("C:/p/m.arcmat"));
    CHECK_FALSE(r.host.HasFactory("C:/p/hero.png"));
    CHECK_FALSE(r.host.HasFactory("C:/p/a.cpp"));
}

    r.host.SetGuidResolver([&](const Arcane::Guid& g) -> std::optional<std::filesystem::path>

    CHECK(r.host.OpenAt(id, Arcane::Text::Point{ 1, 1 }) == d);

TEST_CASE("document host: a move or a Save As re-keys; closing drops the key", "[text-doc][editor]")
{
    Rig r;
    const Arcane::Guid id = Arcane::Guid::Generate();
    auto* doc = static_cast<FakeTextDoc*>(r.host.Add(std::make_unique<FakeTextDoc>("C:/p/old.json", id)));
    CHECK(r.host.FindByCanonicalPath(Lower("C:/p/old.json")) == doc);
    r.host.NoteAssetMoved(id, "C:/p/sub/new.json");
    CHECK(r.host.FindByCanonicalPath(Lower("C:/p/old.json")) == nullptr);
    CHECK(r.host.FindByCanonicalPath(Lower("C:/p/sub/new.json")) == doc);

    doc->canonical = Lower("C:/p/saved-as.json");           // the document changed its own identity (Save As)
    r.host.RefreshCanonicalKey(*doc);
    CHECK(r.host.FindByCanonicalPath(Lower("C:/p/sub/new.json")) == nullptr);
    CHECK(r.host.OpenPath("C:/P/SAVED-AS.json") == doc);

    r.host.RequestClose(doc);
    CHECK(r.host.Count() == 0u);
    CHECK(r.host.FindByCanonicalPath(Lower("C:/p/saved-as.json")) == nullptr);
}

// After TE2-20 HasFactory is true for every text file; HasDedicatedFactory is the
// "a dedicated editor takes it" fact (TE6-12's Open as Text lock, TE7-9's FileOpener).
TEST_CASE("document host: dedicated factories are told apart from text routes and the fallback", "[text-doc][editor]")
{
    DocumentHost host;
    const auto none = [](const std::filesystem::path&) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> { return nullptr; };
    host.RegisterFactory(".arcsprite", none);
    host.RegisterTextFactory(".md", none);
    host.SetFallbackFactory(none, [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return p.extension() == ".cfgx"; });
    CHECK(host.HasDedicatedFactory("C:/p/s.ARCSPRITE"));                // case-insensitive, like HasFactory
    CHECK(host.HasFactory("C:/p/notes.md"));
    CHECK_FALSE(host.HasDedicatedFactory("C:/p/notes.md"));             // a text route is not a dedicated editor
    CHECK_FALSE(host.HasDedicatedFactory("C:/p/NOTES.MD"));
    CHECK(host.HasFactory("C:/p/a.cfgx"));
    CHECK_FALSE(host.HasDedicatedFactory("C:/p/a.cfgx"));               // nor is the fallback
    CHECK_FALSE(host.HasDedicatedFactory("C:/p/a.png"));                // nor nothing

    // A text route opens like any extension route.
    int textBuilds = 0;
    host.RegisterTextFactory(".TXT", [&](const std::filesystem::path& p) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument>
    { ++textBuilds; return std::make_unique<FakeTextDoc>(p); });

TEST_CASE("text document: GoTo clamps to the buffer and leaves one cursor there; RevealPoint forwards to it", "[text-doc][editor]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path p = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-te2-goto.txt";
    std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary) << "alpha\nbe\ngamma\n";   // rows start at 0, 6, 9, 15 (the empty last row)
    {
        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(p, {}, error);
        INFO(error);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        TextModel& model = doc->Model();

        // Two cursors first: GoTo collapses them into one.
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model))
            .SetSelections({ Arcane::Text::Selection{ 0, 1, 1, std::nullopt }, Arcane::Text::Selection{ 0, 7, 7, std::nullopt } });
        REQUIRE(model.selections.Size() == 2u);

        doc->GoTo(Arcane::Text::Point{ 1, 1 });
        CHECK(model.selections.Size() == 1u);
        CHECK(model.selections.Primary().anchor == 7u);
        CHECK(model.selections.Primary().head == 7u);

        doc->GoTo(Arcane::Text::Point{ 1, 40 });               // the column clamps to the row's byte length ("be")
        CHECK(model.selections.Primary().head == 8u);

        doc->GoTo(Arcane::Text::Point{ 99, 3 });               // the row clamps to the last row (empty: column 0)
        CHECK(model.selections.Size() == 1u);
        CHECK(model.selections.Primary().head == 15u);
        CHECK(model.selections.Primary().anchor == 15u);

        doc->RevealPoint(2, 2);                                // the EditorDocument hook lands where GoTo does
        CHECK(model.selections.Primary().head == 11u);
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());                             // moving the cursor is not an edit
    }
    std::filesystem::remove(p);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/DocumentHost.cpp` -- (no text-editor include: the host knows nothing about C++ or text; the fallback's `claims` predicate decides) replace `OpenPath`, `HasFactory`, `Add`, `NoteAssetMoved`, `CloseAll` and `Close` with, and add the new members:
```cpp
    std::filesystem::path DocumentHost::Canonical(const std::filesystem::path& p) const
    {
        if (m_canonicalizer)
            return m_canonicalizer(p);
        std::error_code ec;
        const std::filesystem::path abs = std::filesystem::absolute(p, ec);
        return (ec ? p : abs).lexically_normal();
    }

    void DocumentHost::IndexCanonical(EditorDocument* doc)
    {
        const std::filesystem::path c = doc->CanonicalPath();
        if (!c.empty())
            m_byCanonical[c.native()] = doc;
    }

    void DocumentHost::UnindexCanonical(const EditorDocument* doc)
    {
        std::erase_if(m_byCanonical, [doc](const auto& kv) { return kv.second == doc; });
    }

    EditorDocument* DocumentHost::FindByCanonicalPath(const std::filesystem::path& canonical)
    {
        const auto it = m_byCanonical.find(canonical.native());
        return it == m_byCanonical.end() ? nullptr : it->second;
    }

    void DocumentHost::RefreshCanonicalKey(EditorDocument& doc)
    {
        UnindexCanonical(&doc);
        IndexCanonical(&doc);
    }

    EditorDocument* DocumentHost::OpenPath(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        // Identity first (spec s5.3): any spelling of an open file focuses its
        // one tab, before anything is constructed.
        if (!m_byCanonical.empty())
            if (EditorDocument* open = FindByCanonicalPath(Canonical(path)))
            {
                open->NoteReopened();
                return m_focusRequest = open;
            }
        const std::string ext = LowerExt(path);
        for (const Route& route : m_factories)
        {
            if (route.ext != ext)
                continue;
            // Focus-not-reopen, cheap form first (review m4): resolve the asset
            // identity WITHOUT constructing a document -- a discarded construct
            // is not free (compile submits on the live doc's coalesce keys).
            if (route.peek)
                if (const Arcane::Guid peeked = route.peek(path); peeked.IsValid())
                    if (EditorDocument* open = FindByGuid(peeked))
                    {
                        open->NoteReopened();   // re-select its page like a fresh open (final fix R)
                        return m_focusRequest = open;
                    }
            std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> doc = route.factory(path);
            if (!doc)
                return nullptr;   // factory already logged the cause
            if (doc->AssetGuid().IsValid())
                if (EditorDocument* open = FindByGuid(doc->AssetGuid()))
                {
                    open->NoteReopened();
                    return m_focusRequest = open;
                }
            return m_focusRequest = Add(std::move(doc));
        }
        // The fallback (spec s5.3): any text file no extension factory claims.
        if (m_fallback && m_fallbackClaims && m_fallbackClaims(path))
        {
            std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> doc = m_fallback(path);
            if (!doc)
                return nullptr;   // the fallback logged why (binary, unreadable, above openMaxMB)
            if (doc->AssetGuid().IsValid())
                if (EditorDocument* open = FindByGuid(doc->AssetGuid()))
                {
                    open->NoteReopened();
                    return m_focusRequest = open;
                }
            return m_focusRequest = Add(std::move(doc));
        }
        ARC_WARN("DocumentHost: no editor registered for '{}'", ext);
        return nullptr;
    }

    EditorDocument* DocumentHost::OpenAt(const std::filesystem::path& path, const Arcane::Text::Point& at)
    {
        EditorDocument* doc = OpenPath(path);
        if (doc)
            doc->RevealPoint(at.row, at.col);
        return doc;
    }

    EditorDocument* DocumentHost::OpenAt(const Arcane::Guid& guid, const Arcane::Text::Point& at)
    {
        if (!m_guidResolver)
            return nullptr;
        const std::optional<std::filesystem::path> path = m_guidResolver(guid);
        return path ? OpenAt(*path, at) : nullptr;
    }

    bool DocumentHost::HasFactory(const std::filesystem::path& path) const
    {
        const std::string ext = LowerExt(path);
        if (std::any_of(m_factories.begin(), m_factories.end(), [&](const Route& r) { return r.ext == ext; }))
            return true;
        return m_fallback && m_fallbackClaims && m_fallbackClaims(path);
    }

    void DocumentHost::RegisterTextFactory(std::string extension, OpenFactory factory)
    {
        // Lowered like LowerExt's side of the match, so ".TXT" and ".txt" are one route.
        std::transform(extension.begin(), extension.end(), extension.begin(),
                       [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
        m_factories.push_back(Route{ std::move(extension), std::move(factory), nullptr, /*text*/ true });
    }

    bool DocumentHost::HasDedicatedFactory(const std::filesystem::path& path) const
    {
        const std::string ext = LowerExt(path);
        return std::any_of(m_factories.begin(), m_factories.end(),
                           [&](const Route& r) { return !r.text && r.ext == ext; });
    }

    EditorDocument* DocumentHost::Add(std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> doc)
    {
        m_docs.push_back(std::move(doc));
        IndexCanonical(m_docs.back().get());
        if (m_observer.opened) m_observer.opened(*m_docs.back());
        return m_docs.back().get();
    }

    void DocumentHost::NoteAssetMoved(const Arcane::Guid& g, const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        if (EditorDocument* d = FindByGuid(g))
        {
            d->NoteMoved(p);
            RefreshCanonicalKey(*d);   // a text document's identity follows the file (spec s5.3)
        }
    }

    void DocumentHost::CloseAll()
    {
        m_pendingClose = nullptr;
        m_lastActive = nullptr;
        if (m_observer.closing) for (const auto& d : m_docs) m_observer.closing(*d);
        m_docs.clear();
        m_dockPlaced.clear();
        m_byCanonical.clear();
    }

    void DocumentHost::Close(EditorDocument* doc)
    {
        if (m_lastActive == doc) m_lastActive = nullptr;
        m_dockPlaced.erase(doc);   // a reopen docks fresh again
        UnindexCanonical(doc);
        if (m_observer.closing) m_observer.closing(*doc);
        m_docs.erase(std::remove_if(m_docs.begin(), m_docs.end(),
                                    [doc](const auto& d) { return d.get() == doc; }),
                     m_docs.end());
    }
```

`TextDocument.cpp` (add `#include <algorithm>` beside its standard includes):
```cpp
    void TextDocument::GoTo(Text::Point at)
    {
        const Text::Rope& text = Model().buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t row = std::min(at.row, text.LineCount() - 1);
        const Text::ByteOffset o = std::min<Text::ByteOffset>(text.LineStart(row) + at.col, text.LineEnd(row));
        Text::TextCommands(Model().buffer, Model().selections, DefaultEditContext(Model()))
            .SetSelections({ Text::Selection{ 0, o, o, std::nullopt } });
        View().RevealOffset(o, true);   // centred (spec s9)
    }

    void TextDocument::RevealPoint(std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t col)
    {
        GoTo(Text::Point{ row, col });
        View().Focus();
    }
```
