replace `TokenizeLine` and add the new functions:

```cpp
    LineTokens Tokenizer::TokenizeLine(std::string_view line, StateId start, const TokenizeOptions& options)
    {
        LineTokens out;
        const bool capped = options.longLineMaxBytes != 0 && line.size() > options.longLineMaxBytes;
        const std::string_view subject = capped ? line.substr(0, options.longLineMaxBytes) : line;
        out.foldMarker = FoldMarkerOf(subject);
        std::vector<StateFrame> stack = m_root.LineLocal() ? std::vector<StateFrame>{} : m_states.Frames(start);
        m_disabled.clear();
        Finish(subject, line.size(), 0, stack, out, options);
        return out;
    }

    void Tokenizer::ResumeLine(std::string_view line, LineTokens& tokens, const TokenizeOptions& options)
    {
        if (!tokens.partial) return;
        const bool capped = options.longLineMaxBytes != 0 && line.size() > options.longLineMaxBytes;
        const std::string_view subject = capped ? line.substr(0, options.longLineMaxBytes) : line;
        std::vector<StateFrame> stack = m_states.Frames(tokens.endState);
        m_disabled.clear();
        Finish(subject, line.size(), tokens.resumeAt, stack, tokens, options);
    }

    void Tokenizer::Finish(std::string_view subject, std::size_t lineSize, std::size_t pos, std::vector<StateFrame>& stack,
                           LineTokens& out, const TokenizeOptions& options)
    {
        const std::size_t stopped = Run(subject, pos, stack, out, options);
        if (stopped < subject.size())
        {
            out.partial = true;
            out.resumeAt = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(stopped);
            out.endState = m_states.Intern(stack);
            return;
        }
        out.partial = false;
        out.resumeAt = 0;
        if (lineSize > subject.size())
        {
            // The long-line cap (spec s3.5): the rest draws plain and the next
            // line restarts from the root -- identically in every mode.
            Emit(out, subject.size(), lineSize, 0, kRunNone);
            out.capped = true;
            out.endState = StateTable::kRoot;
            return;
        }
        // Line-local (spec s4.1): whatever is still open is force-closed here.
        out.endState = m_root.LineLocal() ? StateTable::kRoot : m_states.Intern(stack);
    }

    FoldMarker Tokenizer::FoldMarkerOf(std::string_view subject)
    {
        const GrammarRules& g = m_root.Rules();
        if (g.FoldBegin() && m_scratch.Match(*g.FoldBegin(), subject, 0) == MatchStatus::Match) return FoldMarker::Begin;
        if (g.FoldEnd() && m_scratch.Match(*g.FoldEnd(), subject, 0) == MatchStatus::Match) return FoldMarker::End;
        return FoldMarker::None;
    }

    bool Tokenizer::Disabled(const Candidate& c) const noexcept
    {
        for (const DisabledCandidate& d : m_disabled)
            if (d.grammar == c.grammar && d.rule == c.rule && d.kind == c.kind) return true;
        return false;
    }

    void Tokenizer::OnLimitHit(const Candidate& c, const TokenizeOptions& options)
    {
        m_disabled.push_back({ c.grammar, c.rule, c.kind });
        if (!options.problems) return;
        const CompiledRule& r = RuleOf(c);
        std::string_view which = "match";
        switch (c.kind)
        {
            case Candidate::Kind::End:
            case Candidate::Kind::BoundaryEnd: which = "end"; break;
            case Candidate::Kind::Escape:      which = "escape"; break;
            case Candidate::Kind::Rule:        which = r.kind == RuleDesc::Kind::Match ? "match" : "begin"; break;
        }
        options.problems->RegexLimitHit(*c.grammar, c.rule, which);
    }

    void CopyRowForTokenize(const Rope& rope, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t longLineMaxBytes, std::string& out)
    {
        out.clear();
        const ByteOffset begin = rope.LineStart(row);
        ByteOffset end = rope.LineEnd(row);
        if (longLineMaxBytes != 0 && end - begin > longLineMaxBytes) end = begin + longLineMaxBytes + 1;
        rope.CopyTo(ByteRange{ begin, end }, out);
    }
```

and replace `Run` (the TE3-10 body plus the budget check, the disabled list and limit reporting):

```cpp
    std::size_t Tokenizer::Run(std::string_view subject, std::size_t pos, std::vector<StateFrame>& stack, LineTokens& out,
                               const TokenizeOptions& options)
    {
        const auto now = [&options] { return options.clock ? (*options.clock)() : SteadyNowUs(); };
        const std::uint64_t t0 = options.lineBudgetUs ? now() : 0;
        std::uint32_t steps = 0;
        BuildCandidates(stack);
        std::uint32_t noProgress = 0;
        for (;;)
        {
            if (options.lineBudgetUs && steps > 0 && steps % kBudgetCheckStride == 0 && now() - t0 >= options.lineBudgetUs)
                return pos;   // partial: the caller records resumeAt = pos and the state here

            std::size_t best = m_candidates.size();
            std::size_t bestStart = std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_candidates.size(); ++i)
            {
                Slot& s = m_slots[i];
                const Regex& re = RegexOf(m_candidates[i]);
                if (!s.known && Disabled(m_candidates[i]))
                {
                    s.known = true;
                    s.none = true;
                }
                if (!s.known || (re.UsesStartAnchor() && !Disabled(m_candidates[i])) || (!s.none && s.start < pos))
                {
                    s.known = true;
                    const MatchStatus status = m_scratch.Match(re, subject, pos, FlagsOf(m_candidates[i], RuleOf(m_candidates[i])));
                    if (status == MatchStatus::Match)
                    {
                        s.none = false;
                        m_scratch.Group(0, s.start, s.end);
                        const std::uint32_t slots = m_scratch.GroupSlots();
                        s.groups.assign(2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(slots), kUnsetGroup);
                        for (std::uint32_t g = 0; g < slots; ++g) m_scratch.Group(g, s.groups[2 * g], s.groups[2 * g + 1]);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        s.none = true;
                        if (status == MatchStatus::LimitHit) OnLimitHit(m_candidates[i], options);
                    }
                }
                if (!s.none && s.start < bestStart)
                {
                    best = i;
                    bestStart = s.start;
                }
            }

            if (best == m_candidates.size())
            {
                const ScopeRef c = ContentScope(stack);
                Emit(out, pos, subject.size(), c.id, StackFlags(stack));
                return subject.size();
            }

            const Candidate c = m_candidates[best];
            m_winner = m_slots[best];
            const ScopeRef content = ContentScope(stack);
            Emit(out, pos, m_winner.start, content.id, StackFlags(stack));
            const std::size_t before = pos;
            const CompiledRule& r = RuleOf(c);
            switch (c.kind)
            {
                case Candidate::Kind::Rule:
                    if (r.kind == RuleDesc::Kind::Match)
                    {
                        EmitMatch(out, subject, m_winner, r, stack);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        const ScopeRef delim = r.scope.id ? r.scope : content;
                        Emit(out, m_winner.start, m_winner.end, delim.id, StackFlags(stack) | delim.flags);
                        stack.push_back({ c.grammar, c.rule });
                        BuildCandidates(stack);
                    }
                    break;
                case Candidate::Kind::Escape:
                    Emit(out, m_winner.start, m_winner.end, content.id, StackFlags(stack));
                    break;
                case Candidate::Kind::End:
                case Candidate::Kind::BoundaryEnd:
                {
                    const std::size_t keep = c.kind == Candidate::Kind::End ? stack.size() - 1 : c.frame;
                    const std::span<const StateFrame> parent(stack.data(), keep);
                    const ScopeRef delim = r.scope.id ? r.scope : ContentScope(parent);
                    Emit(out, m_winner.start, m_winner.end, delim.id, StackFlags(parent) | delim.flags);
                    stack.resize(keep);
                    BuildCandidates(stack);
                    break;
                }
            }
            pos = m_winner.end;
            ++steps;

            if (pos == before)
            {
                if (++noProgress > kNoProgressLimit)
                {
                    if (pos >= subject.size()) return subject.size();
                    const std::size_t step = Utf8Step(subject, pos);
                    const ScopeRef here = ContentScope(stack);
                    Emit(out, pos, pos + step, here.id, StackFlags(stack));
                    pos += step;
                    noProgress = 0;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                noProgress = 0;
            }
        }
    }
```

A disabled candidate is marked `none` the first time its slot is (re)built after a stack change, so a catastrophic rule costs one limit hit per line, not one per region push. The budget clock is read only every `kBudgetCheckStride` steps and never before the first step, so a resume always makes progress.

### Task TE3-12: GrammarRegistry -- search path, overrides, Problems, detection, plugin grammars, snapshots, live reload (spec s4.1, s4.2)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/GrammarRegistry.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/GrammarRegistry.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/GrammarRegistryTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ParseGrammar`, `CompileGrammarRules`, `LinkGrammar`, `MakePlainTextGrammar` (TE3-7/8); `ScopeTable` (TE3-4); `ISyntaxProblemSink` (TE3-10); `LanguageOverride`, `NormaliseExtension` (TE3-3); `MatchScratch` (TE3-2)
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Text`):
  - `enum class GrammarOrigin : std::uint8_t { Engine, Project, Plugin }`; `struct GrammarSearchDir { std::filesystem::path dir; GrammarOrigin origin; }`
  - `struct GrammarProblem { enum class Kind { Invalid, EmbedMissing, RegexLimit }; Kind kind; std::string source, grammar, rulePath, message; }`
  - `using GrammarProblemSink = std::function<void(std::string_view key, std::span<const GrammarProblem>)>`
  - `class GrammarRegistry final : public ISyntaxProblemSink` -- `Scopes()`, `SetSearchDirs`, `SetProblemSink`, `RegisterPluginGrammar(owner, label, jsonText)`, `UnregisterPluginGrammars(owner)`, `Reload()`, `NotifySaved(path) -> bool`, `PollChanges() -> bool`, `Find(name)`, `PlainText()`, `Detect(path, firstLine, overrides)`, `Names()`, `Generation()`, `RegexLimitHit(...)` (any thread), `PumpProblems()` (UI thread)
  - Problems keys: `"text.grammar:" + source` (one per grammar source), `"text.grammar.limit:" + grammar name`

Behaviour (spec s4.1):
- **Search path**, later entries overriding earlier ones by `name`: the engine `data/Syntaxes/`, the project's `Config/Syntaxes/`, then plugins -- each active plugin root's `Syntaxes/` directory (Arcane plugins are data directories, `Project::ActivePluginRoots()`), then texts registered in-process with `RegisterPluginGrammar` (the seam a future editor-plugin API calls). Each directory is read non-recursively, `*.arcsyntax` only (so `data/Syntaxes/tests/` samples are never loaded), in file-name order.
- **Bad grammar**: unparsable JSON -> a Problems row naming the file; its name is unknown, so an earlier grammar of that name (if any) stays. Parsed but invalid (a bad rule, a bad regex) -> a Problems row naming the file and the rule path, and **that language resolves to Plain Text** (`Find(name) == PlainText()`), so the breakage is visible. A missing embed target -> a Warning row; the region's content draws in its content scope. An embed cycle -> a Warning row and the cyclic embed unresolved (no `shared_ptr` cycle).
- **Snapshots**: `Find` returns a refcounted `GrammarSnapshot`; `Reload` keeps a grammar's previous snapshot (same pointer, same `grammarVersion()`) when its source text and its embedded snapshots are unchanged, so editing one grammar invalidates only it and the grammars that embed it. `Generation()` bumps whenever any published snapshot changes; documents re-resolve then.
- **Detection** (s4.1): (1) the user's remembered choice for the extension (`editor.text.languageByExtension`), (2) `files` -- a whole-file-name entry beats an extension entry, and a later search entry beats an earlier one, (3) `firstLine`, (4) Plain Text. The spec lists the remembered choice last; it is consulted first here because the picker's memory exists to correct a wrong detection, which it could never do for an extension some grammar's `files` claims (reported in the self-review).
- **Live reload**: `NotifySaved(path)` reloads when a `.arcsyntax` inside a search directory was saved (the text editor's save calls it, TE3-30); `PollChanges()` compares each directory's `(name, size, mtime)` listing and reloads on a difference (external edits; TE3-30 calls it on the asset-watch cadence).
- **Regex limits** (s4.2): `RegexLimitHit` may be called from the worker; each `(grammarVersion, rule, which)` is reported once; `PumpProblems` publishes them on the UI thread.

```cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Helpers/TestEnvironment.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/GrammarRegistry.hpp"

#include <chrono>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>
#include <thread>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

namespace
{
    std::string Grammar(std::string_view name, std::string_view files, std::string_view extra = {},
                        std::string_view patterns = "[]")
    {
        return R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":")" + std::string(name) + R"(","scope":"source.x",)" +
               R"("files":)" + std::string(files) + "," + std::string(extra) + R"("patterns":)" + std::string(patterns) + "}";
    }

    void Write(const fs::path& p, std::string_view text)
    {
        fs::create_directories(p.parent_path());
        std::ofstream out(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        out << text;
    }

    struct Problems
    {
        std::map<std::string, std::vector<GrammarProblem>> byKey;
        GrammarProblemSink Sink()
        {
            return [this](std::string_view key, std::span<const GrammarProblem> rows) {
                if (rows.empty()) byKey.erase(std::string(key));
                else byKey[std::string(key)] = std::vector<GrammarProblem>(rows.begin(), rows.end());
            };
        }
    };

    struct Dirs
    {
        Arcane::Test::TempDir root{ "grammar_registry" };
        fs::path engine = root.path / "engine";
        fs::path project = root.path / "project";
        fs::path plugin = root.path / "plugin" / "Syntaxes";
        std::vector<GrammarSearchDir> All() const
        {
            return { { engine, GrammarOrigin::Engine }, { project, GrammarOrigin::Project }, { plugin, GrammarOrigin::Plugin } };
        }
    };
}

TEST_CASE("GrammarRegistry: loads each search dir, later entries override by name", "[text-registry]")
{
    Dirs d;
    Write(d.engine / "Json.arcsyntax", Grammar("JSON", R"([".json"])"));
    Write(d.engine / "Ini.arcsyntax", Grammar("INI", R"([".ini"])"));
    Write(d.engine / "tests" / "sample.arcsyntax", Grammar("Hidden", "[]"));   // not loaded: non-recursive
    Write(d.project / "Ini.arcsyntax", Grammar("INI", R"([".ini", ".cfg"])"));
    GrammarRegistry reg;
    reg.SetSearchDirs(d.All());
    reg.Reload();
    CHECK(reg.Names() == std::vector<std::string>{ "INI", "JSON", "Plain Text" });
    REQUIRE(reg.Find("INI") != nullptr);
    CHECK(reg.Find("INI")->Rules().Desc().files.size() == 2u);   // the project's
    CHECK(reg.Find("Hidden") == nullptr);
    CHECK(reg.PlainText()->Name() == "Plain Text");
}

TEST_CASE("GrammarRegistry: unparsable files and invalid grammars become Problems rows", "[text-registry]")
{
    Dirs d;
    Write(d.engine / "Json.arcsyntax", Grammar("JSON", R"([".json"])"));
    Write(d.project / "Broken.arcsyntax", "{ this is not json");
    Write(d.project / "Json.arcsyntax", Grammar("JSON", R"([".json"])", "", R"([{"match":"(oops"}])"));
    Problems p;
    GrammarRegistry reg;
    reg.SetProblemSink(p.Sink());
    reg.SetSearchDirs(d.All());
    reg.Reload();
    const std::string brokenKey = "text.grammar:" + (d.project / "Broken.arcsyntax").generic_string();
    const std::string jsonKey = "text.grammar:" + (d.project / "Json.arcsyntax").generic_string();
    REQUIRE(p.byKey.contains(brokenKey));
    CHECK(p.byKey[brokenKey][0].kind == GrammarProblem::Kind::Invalid);
    CHECK(p.byKey[brokenKey][0].message.find("not valid JSON") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(p.byKey.contains(jsonKey));
    CHECK(p.byKey[jsonKey][0].grammar == "JSON");
    CHECK(p.byKey[jsonKey][0].rulePath == "patterns[0].match");
    CHECK(reg.Find("JSON") == reg.PlainText());   // a named-but-broken override shows as Plain Text (spec s4.1)

    // Fixing the file retracts its row (an empty publish for that key).
    Write(d.project / "Json.arcsyntax", Grammar("JSON", R"([".json"])"));
    reg.Reload();
    CHECK_FALSE(p.byKey.contains(jsonKey));
    CHECK(reg.Find("JSON") != reg.PlainText());
}

TEST_CASE("GrammarRegistry: detection -- remembered choice, file name, extension, firstLine, Plain Text", "[text-registry]")

    Write(d.engine / "Shell.arcsyntax", Grammar("Shell", R"([".sh", ".bashrc"])", R"("firstLine":"^#!.*\\bbash\\b",)"));
    Write(d.engine / "Ini.arcsyntax", Grammar("INI", R"([".ini", ".cfg"])"));
    Write(d.project / "Cfg.arcsyntax", Grammar("ProjectCfg", R"([".cfg"])"));
    GrammarRegistry reg;
    reg.SetSearchDirs(d.All());
    reg.Reload();
    CHECK(reg.Detect("a/b.JSON", "", {})->Name() == "JSON");
    CHECK(reg.Detect("a/b.meta", "", {})->Name() == "JSON");
    CHECK(reg.Detect("home/.bashrc", "", {})->Name() == "Shell");            // whole file name
    CHECK(reg.Detect("x.cfg", "", {})->Name() == "ProjectCfg");              // later search entry wins the extension
    CHECK(reg.Detect("script", "#!/usr/bin/env bash", {})->Name() == "Shell");   // firstLine
    CHECK(reg.Detect("data.txt", "{ \"a\": 1 }", {})->Name() == "JSON");
    CHECK(reg.Detect("notes.unknown", "hello", {}) == reg.PlainText());
    const std::vector<LanguageOverride> remembered{ { ".cfg", "INI" }, { ".txt", "Missing" } };
    CHECK(reg.Detect("x.cfg", "", remembered)->Name() == "INI");             // the picker's memory first
    CHECK(reg.Detect("x.txt", "", remembered) == reg.PlainText());           // a remembered name that is gone is ignored
}

TEST_CASE("GrammarRegistry: plugin grammars -- directories and registered texts, later wins", "[text-registry]")
{
    Dirs d;
    Write(d.engine / "Ini.arcsyntax", Grammar("INI", R"([".ini"])"));
    Write(d.plugin / "Ini.arcsyntax", Grammar("INI", R"([".ini", ".plug"])"));
    GrammarRegistry reg;
    reg.SetSearchDirs(d.All());
    reg.RegisterPluginGrammar("my.plugin", "Lang", Grammar("PluginLang", R"([".pl1"])"));
    reg.Reload();
    CHECK(reg.Find("INI")->Rules().Desc().files.size() == 2u);
    REQUIRE(reg.Find("PluginLang") != nullptr);
    CHECK(reg.Detect("a.pl1", "", {})->Name() == "PluginLang");
    reg.UnregisterPluginGrammars("my.plugin");
    reg.Reload();
    CHECK(reg.Find("PluginLang") == nullptr);
}

TEST_CASE("GrammarRegistry: unchanged grammars keep their snapshot; a change relinks its embedders only", "[text-registry]")
{
    Dirs d;
    Write(d.engine / "Inner.arcsyntax", Grammar("Inner", R"([".in"])"));
    Write(d.engine / "Outer.arcsyntax", Grammar("Outer", R"([".out"])", "", R"([{"begin":"<<","end":">>","embed":"Inner"}])"));
    Write(d.engine / "Other.arcsyntax", Grammar("Other", R"([".oth"])"));
    GrammarRegistry reg;
    reg.SetSearchDirs(d.All());
    reg.Reload();
    const GrammarSnapshot inner = reg.Find("Inner"), outer = reg.Find("Outer"), other = reg.Find("Other");
    const std::uint64_t gen = reg.Generation();
    CHECK(outer->Embed(0) == inner);

    reg.Reload();   // nothing changed
    CHECK(reg.Find("Inner") == inner);
    CHECK(reg.Find("Outer") == outer);
    CHECK(reg.Generation() == gen);

    Write(d.engine / "Inner.arcsyntax", Grammar("Inner", R"([".in", ".inner"])"));
    reg.Reload();
    CHECK(reg.Find("Inner") != inner);
    CHECK(reg.Find("Inner")->grammarVersion() > inner->grammarVersion());
    CHECK(reg.Find("Outer") != outer);                        // relinked to the new Inner
    CHECK(reg.Find("Outer")->RulesPtr() == outer->RulesPtr()); // without recompiling its regexes
    CHECK(reg.Find("Other") == other);                        // untouched
    CHECK(reg.Generation() > gen);
    CHECK(outer->Embed(0) == inner);                          // the old snapshot is intact for whoever holds it
}

TEST_CASE("GrammarRegistry: a missing embed target and an embed cycle are Warnings, not crashes", "[text-registry]")
{
    Dirs d;
    Write(d.engine / "A.arcsyntax", Grammar("A", R"([".a"])", "", R"([{"begin":"<","end":">","embed":"B"},{"begin":"\\{","end":"\\}","embed":"Nope"}])"));
    Write(d.engine / "B.arcsyntax", Grammar("B", R"([".b"])", "", R"([{"begin":"<","end":">","embed":"A"}])"));
    Problems p;
    GrammarRegistry reg;
    reg.SetProblemSink(p.Sink());
    reg.SetSearchDirs(d.All());
    reg.Reload();
    const std::string aKey = "text.grammar:" + (d.engine / "A.arcsyntax").generic_string();
    REQUIRE(p.byKey.contains(aKey));
    bool sawMissing = false, sawCycle = false;
    for (const auto& [key, rows] : p.byKey)
        for (const GrammarProblem& g : rows)
        {
            sawMissing |= g.kind == GrammarProblem::Kind::EmbedMissing && g.message.find("Nope") != std::string::npos;
            sawCycle |= g.kind == GrammarProblem::Kind::EmbedMissing && g.message.find("cycle") != std::string::npos;
        }
    CHECK(sawMissing);
    CHECK(sawCycle);
    const GrammarSnapshot a = reg.Find("A");
    REQUIRE(a != nullptr);
    CHECK(a->Embed(1) == nullptr);   // "Nope"
}

TEST_CASE("GrammarRegistry: NotifySaved and PollChanges reload; unrelated paths do not", "[text-registry]")
{
    Dirs d;
    Write(d.engine / "Ini.arcsyntax", Grammar("INI", R"([".ini"])"));
    GrammarRegistry reg;
    reg.SetSearchDirs(d.All());
    reg.Reload();
    CHECK_FALSE(reg.PollChanges());
    Write(d.project / "Toml.arcsyntax", Grammar("TOML", R"([".toml"])"));
    CHECK(reg.PollChanges());
    CHECK(reg.Find("TOML") != nullptr);
    CHECK_FALSE(reg.NotifySaved(d.root.path / "elsewhere" / "Toml.arcsyntax"));
    CHECK_FALSE(reg.NotifySaved(d.project / "notes.txt"));
    Write(d.project / "Toml.arcsyntax", Grammar("TOML", R"([".toml", ".tml"])"));
    CHECK(reg.NotifySaved(d.project / "Toml.arcsyntax"));
    CHECK(reg.Find("TOML")->Rules().Desc().files.size() == 2u);
}

TEST_CASE("GrammarRegistry: regex-limit hits from any thread are reported once and published on the UI thread", "[text-registry]")
{
    Dirs d;
    Write(d.engine / "Bad.arcsyntax", Grammar("Bad", R"([".bad"])", "", R"([{"match":"(a+)+$"}])"));
    Problems p;
    GrammarRegistry reg;
    reg.SetProblemSink(p.Sink());
    reg.SetSearchDirs(d.All());
    reg.Reload();
    const GrammarSnapshot bad = reg.Find("Bad");
    std::thread worker([&] { for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) reg.RegexLimitHit(*bad, 0, "match"); });
    worker.join();
    reg.RegexLimitHit(*bad, 0, "match");
    CHECK(p.byKey.empty());   // nothing published off the UI thread
    reg.PumpProblems();
    REQUIRE(p.byKey.contains("text.grammar.limit:Bad"));
    REQUIRE(p.byKey["text.grammar.limit:Bad"].size() == 1u);
    CHECK(p.byKey["text.grammar.limit:Bad"][0].rulePath == "patterns[0].match");
    CHECK(p.byKey["text.grammar.limit:Bad"][0].kind == GrammarProblem::Kind::RegexLimit);
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The grammar registry (spec s4.1): search path, name overrides, validation
// with Problems rows, refcounted versioned snapshots, detection, live reload.
// UI-thread object except RegexLimitHit, which the highlight worker calls.

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/LanguageOverrides.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Scope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Tokenizer.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <set>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <tuple>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class GrammarOrigin : std::uint8_t { Engine, Project, Plugin };

    struct GrammarSearchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        GrammarOrigin origin = GrammarOrigin::Engine;
    };

    struct GrammarProblem
    {
        enum class Kind : std::uint8_t { Invalid, EmbedMissing, RegexLimit };
        Kind kind = Kind::Invalid;
        std::string source;     // the file (generic path) or "plugin:<owner>/<label>"
        std::string grammar;    // the grammar's name when known
        std::string rulePath;   // "patterns[2].end"; "" = the file's top level
        std::string message;
    };

    // Publication-group semantics (Arcane::Diagnostics): each call REPLACES the
    // key's rows; an empty span retracts them.
    using GrammarProblemSink = std::function<void(std::string_view key, std::span<const GrammarProblem> problems)>;

    class GrammarRegistry final : public ISyntaxProblemSink
    {
    public:
        GrammarRegistry();
        ~GrammarRegistry() override;
        GrammarRegistry(const GrammarRegistry&)            = delete;
        GrammarRegistry& operator=(const GrammarRegistry&) = delete;

        [[nodiscard]] ScopeTable& Scopes() noexcept { return m_scopes; }
        [[nodiscard]] const ScopeTable& Scopes() const noexcept { return m_scopes; }

        void SetSearchDirs(std::vector<GrammarSearchDir> dirs);   // priority order; call Reload() after
        void SetProblemSink(GrammarProblemSink sink);
        void RegisterPluginGrammar(std::string owner, std::string label, std::string jsonText);
        void UnregisterPluginGrammars(std::string_view owner);

        void Reload();
        bool NotifySaved(const std::filesystem::path& file);
        bool PollChanges();

        [[nodiscard]] GrammarSnapshot Find(std::string_view name) const;
        [[nodiscard]] GrammarSnapshot PlainText() const { return m_plain; }
        [[nodiscard]] GrammarSnapshot Detect(const std::filesystem::path& file, std::string_view firstLine,
                                             std::span<const LanguageOverride> overrides) const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> Names() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t Generation() const noexcept { return m_generation; }

        void RegexLimitHit(const CompiledGrammar& grammar, std::uint32_t ruleIndex, std::string_view which) override;
        void PumpProblems();

    private:
        struct Source
        {
            std::string label;   // problem source / key suffix
            std::filesystem::path path;
            std::string text;
        };
        struct Entry
        {
            std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules> rules;   // nullptr = named but invalid -> Plain Text
            std::size_t sourceIndex = 0;
        };
        struct PluginText
        {
            std::string owner, label, text;
        };
        using Signature = std::vector<std::tuple<std::string, std::uintmax_t, std::int64_t>>;

        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Source> GatherSources() const;
        [[nodiscard]] Signature ScanSignature() const;
        void Publish(std::map<std::string, std::vector<GrammarProblem>> problems);

        ScopeTable m_scopes;
        std::vector<GrammarSearchDir> m_dirs;
        std::vector<PluginText> m_pluginTexts;
        GrammarProblemSink m_sink;
        GrammarSnapshot m_builtinPlain;   // MakePlainTextGrammar, used when no valid "Plain Text" file exists
        GrammarSnapshot m_plain;
        std::map<std::string, GrammarSnapshot, std::less<>> m_grammars;   // by name (Plain Text included)
        std::vector<std::string> m_priority;   // names, lowest priority first (source order of the winning entry)
        std::unordered_map<std::string, std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules>> m_rulesByText;   // compile cache, keyed by source text
        std::set<std::string> m_publishedKeys;
        Signature m_signature;
        std::uint64_t m_nextVersion = 1;
        std::uint64_t m_generation = 0;
        mutable MatchScratch m_scratch{ RegexLimits{} };   // firstLine detection (UI thread)

        std::mutex m_limitMutex;
        std::set<std::tuple<std::uint64_t, std::uint32_t, std::string>> m_limitSeen;
        std::vector<GrammarProblem> m_limitQueue;
        std::map<std::string, std::vector<GrammarProblem>> m_limitRows;   // by grammar name, UI thread
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/GrammarRegistry.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/GrammarRegistry.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;

    namespace
    {
        std::string Lower(std::string s)
        {
            std::transform(s.begin(), s.end(), s.begin(), [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
            return s;
        }

        std::string ReadAll(const fs::path& p)
        {
            std::ifstream in(p, std::ios::binary);
            return std::string((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
        }

        std::vector<fs::path> GrammarFiles(const fs::path& dir)
        {
            std::vector<fs::path> out;
            std::error_code ec;
            if (!fs::is_directory(dir, ec)) return out;
            for (fs::directory_iterator it(dir, ec), end; !ec && it != end; it.increment(ec))
                if (it->is_regular_file(ec) && Lower(it->path().extension().string()) == ".arcsyntax") out.push_back(it->path());
            std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
            return out;
        }

        bool SameFile(const fs::path& a, const fs::path& b)
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            return fs::weakly_canonical(a, ec) == fs::weakly_canonical(b, ec);
        }
    }

    GrammarRegistry::GrammarRegistry()
    {
        m_builtinPlain = MakePlainTextGrammar(m_scopes, m_nextVersion++);
        m_plain = m_builtinPlain;
        m_grammars.emplace("Plain Text", m_plain);
        m_priority.push_back("Plain Text");
    }

    GrammarRegistry::~GrammarRegistry() = default;

    void GrammarRegistry::SetSearchDirs(std::vector<GrammarSearchDir> dirs) { m_dirs = std::move(dirs); }
    void GrammarRegistry::SetProblemSink(GrammarProblemSink sink) { m_sink = std::move(sink); }

    void GrammarRegistry::RegisterPluginGrammar(std::string owner, std::string label, std::string jsonText)
    {
        m_pluginTexts.push_back({ std::move(owner), std::move(label), std::move(jsonText) });
    }

    void GrammarRegistry::UnregisterPluginGrammars(std::string_view owner)
    {
        std::erase_if(m_pluginTexts, [owner](const PluginText& p) { return p.owner == owner; });
    }

    std::vector<GrammarRegistry::Source> GrammarRegistry::GatherSources() const
    {
        std::vector<Source> out;
        for (const GrammarSearchDir& d : m_dirs)
            for (const fs::path& f : GrammarFiles(d.dir))
                out.push_back({ f.generic_string(), f, ReadAll(f) });
        for (const PluginText& p : m_pluginTexts) out.push_back({ "plugin:" + p.owner + "/" + p.label, {}, p.text });
        return out;
    }

    GrammarRegistry::Signature GrammarRegistry::ScanSignature() const
    {
        Signature sig;
        for (const GrammarSearchDir& d : m_dirs)
            for (const fs::path& f : GrammarFiles(d.dir))
            {
                std::error_code ec;
                const std::uintmax_t size = fs::file_size(f, ec);
                const auto mtime = fs::last_write_time(f, ec);
                sig.emplace_back(f.generic_string(), size, static_cast<std::int64_t>(mtime.time_since_epoch().count()));
            }
        return sig;
    }

    void GrammarRegistry::Reload()
    {
        const std::vector<Source> sources = GatherSources();
        std::map<std::string, std::vector<GrammarProblem>> problems;
        std::map<std::string, Entry, std::less<>> entries;
        std::unordered_map<std::string, std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules>> usedRules;

        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sources.size(); ++i)
        {
            const Source& src = sources[i];
            const std::string key = "text.grammar:" + src.label;
            std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules> rules;
            if (const auto cached = m_rulesByText.find(src.text); cached != m_rulesByText.end())
                rules = cached->second;
            else
            {
                auto desc = ParseGrammar(src.text);
                if (!desc)
                {
                    problems[key].push_back({ GrammarProblem::Kind::Invalid, src.label, {}, desc.error().rulePath, desc.error().message });
                    continue;   // name unknown: an earlier grammar of that name stays
                }
                const std::string name = desc->name;
                auto compiled = CompileGrammarRules(std::move(*desc), m_scopes);
                if (!compiled)
                {
                    problems[key].push_back({ GrammarProblem::Kind::Invalid, src.label, name, compiled.error().rulePath,
                                              compiled.error().message });
                    entries.insert_or_assign(name, Entry{ nullptr, i });   // named but broken -> Plain Text (spec s4.1)
                    continue;
                }
                rules = std::move(*compiled);
            }
            usedRules.emplace(src.text, rules);
            entries.insert_or_assign(rules->Name(), Entry{ rules, i });
        }
        m_rulesByText = std::move(usedRules);

        // Link in dependency order; a grammar is linked after everything it embeds.
        std::map<std::string, GrammarSnapshot, std::less<>> linked;
        std::vector<std::string> visiting;
        std::function<GrammarSnapshot(const std::string&)> link = [&](const std::string& name) -> GrammarSnapshot {
            if (const auto it = linked.find(name); it != linked.end()) return it->second;
            const auto e = entries.find(name);
            if (e == entries.end()) return nullptr;
            if (!e->second.rules) return linked.emplace(name, m_plain).first->second;
            const std::string key = "text.grammar:" + sources[e->second.sourceIndex].label;
            if (std::find(visiting.begin(), visiting.end(), name) != visiting.end()) return nullptr;   // caller reports the cycle
            visiting.push_back(name);
            const GrammarRules& rules = *e->second.rules;
            std::vector<GrammarSnapshot> embeds;
            for (const std::string& target : rules.EmbedNames())
            {
                const bool cyclic = std::find(visiting.begin(), visiting.end(), target) != visiting.end();
                GrammarSnapshot s = cyclic ? nullptr : link(target);
                if (!s)
                    problems[key].push_back({ GrammarProblem::Kind::EmbedMissing, sources[e->second.sourceIndex].label, name, {},
                                              cyclic ? "embed \"" + target + "\" forms an embed cycle; its content draws unhighlighted"
                                                     : "embed target \"" + target + "\" is not a loaded grammar" });
                embeds.push_back(std::move(s));
            }
            visiting.pop_back();
            GrammarSnapshot snap;
            if (const auto prev = m_grammars.find(name); prev != m_grammars.end() && prev->second &&
                prev->second->RulesPtr() == e->second.rules && prev->second->Embeds() == embeds)
                snap = prev->second;   // unchanged: keep the snapshot and its version
            else
                snap = LinkGrammar(e->second.rules, std::move(embeds), m_nextVersion++);
            return linked.emplace(name, std::move(snap)).first->second;
        };
        // Plain Text first: a broken grammar resolves to it (spec s4.1). A
        // valid "Plain Text" file overrides the built-in one.
        m_plain = m_builtinPlain;
        if (const auto pt = entries.find("Plain Text"); pt != entries.end() && pt->second.rules) m_plain = link("Plain Text");
        linked.insert_or_assign("Plain Text", m_plain);
        for (const auto& [name, entry] : entries) link(name);

        // Priority: the winning entry's source order (later = higher).
        std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t, std::string>> order;
        for (const auto& [name, entry] : entries) order.emplace_back(entry.sourceIndex, name);
        std::sort(order.begin(), order.end());
        std::vector<std::string> priority{ "Plain Text" };
        for (const auto& [index, name] : order)
            if (name != "Plain Text") priority.push_back(name);

        const bool changed = linked != m_grammars;
        m_grammars = std::move(linked);
        m_priority = std::move(priority);
        m_signature = ScanSignature();
        if (changed) ++m_generation;
        Publish(std::move(problems));
    }

    void GrammarRegistry::Publish(std::map<std::string, std::vector<GrammarProblem>> problems)
    {
        std::set<std::string> keys;
        for (const auto& [key, rows] : problems) keys.insert(key);
        if (m_sink)
        {
            for (const std::string& old : m_publishedKeys)
                if (!keys.contains(old)) m_sink(old, {});
            for (const auto& [key, rows] : problems) m_sink(key, rows);
        }
        m_publishedKeys = std::move(keys);
    }

    bool GrammarRegistry::NotifySaved(const fs::path& file)
    {
        if (Lower(file.extension().string()) != ".arcsyntax") return false;
        for (const GrammarSearchDir& d : m_dirs)
            if (SameFile(file.parent_path(), d.dir))
            {
                Reload();
                return true;
            }
        return false;
    }

    bool GrammarRegistry::PollChanges()
    {
        if (ScanSignature() == m_signature) return false;
        Reload();
        return true;
    }

    GrammarSnapshot GrammarRegistry::Find(std::string_view name) const
    {
        const auto it = m_grammars.find(name);
        return it == m_grammars.end() ? nullptr : it->second;
    }

    std::vector<std::string> GrammarRegistry::Names() const
    {
        std::vector<std::string> out;
        for (const auto& [name, snap] : m_grammars) out.push_back(name);
        return out;   // std::map order: sorted
    }

    GrammarSnapshot GrammarRegistry::Detect(const fs::path& file, std::string_view firstLine,
                                            std::span<const LanguageOverride> overrides) const
    {
        const std::string ext = NormaliseExtension(file.extension().string());
        const std::string base = Lower(file.filename().string());
        // 1. The language picker's memory for this extension (see the task text for why it is first).
        if (!ext.empty())
            for (const LanguageOverride& o : overrides)
                if (o.extension == ext)
                    if (GrammarSnapshot g = Find(o.grammar)) return g;
        // 2. `files`: the whole file name, then the extension; later search entries first.
        for (const bool wholeName : { true, false })
            for (auto it = m_priority.rbegin(); it != m_priority.rend(); ++it)
            {
                const GrammarSnapshot g = Find(*it);
                if (!g) continue;
                for (const std::string& f : g->Rules().Desc().files)
                    if (wholeName ? f == base : (!ext.empty() && f == ext)) return g;
            }
        // 3. firstLine.
        if (!firstLine.empty())
            for (auto it = m_priority.rbegin(); it != m_priority.rend(); ++it)
            {
                const GrammarSnapshot g = Find(*it);
                if (g && g->Rules().FirstLine() && m_scratch.Match(*g->Rules().FirstLine(), firstLine, 0) == MatchStatus::Match)
                    return g;
            }
        return m_plain;
    }

    void GrammarRegistry::RegexLimitHit(const CompiledGrammar& grammar, std::uint32_t ruleIndex, std::string_view which)
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_limitMutex);
        if (!m_limitSeen.emplace(grammar.grammarVersion(), ruleIndex, std::string(which)).second) return;
        const CompiledRule& r = grammar.Rules().Rule(ruleIndex);
        m_limitQueue.push_back({ GrammarProblem::Kind::RegexLimit, grammar.Name(), grammar.Name(), r.path + "." + std::string(which),
                                 "the regex match limit was hit; the rule is skipped for that line "
                                 "(raise editor.text.regexMatchLimit or simplify the pattern)" });
    }

    void GrammarRegistry::PumpProblems()
    {
        std::vector<GrammarProblem> fresh;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(m_limitMutex);
            fresh.swap(m_limitQueue);
        }
        if (fresh.empty()) return;
        std::set<std::string> touched;
        for (GrammarProblem& p : fresh)
        {
            touched.insert(p.grammar);
            m_limitRows[p.grammar].push_back(std::move(p));
        }
        if (m_sink)
            for (const std::string& g : touched) m_sink("text.grammar.limit:" + g, m_limitRows[g]);
    }
}
```

Two details worth naming for the reviewer: `Reload` compares the new name -> snapshot map with the old one (`linked != m_grammars` compares `shared_ptr`s), so `Generation()` moves only when a snapshot was replaced, added or removed; and the previous-snapshot reuse requires both the same compiled rules (same source text, via the text-keyed compile cache) and pointer-equal embedded snapshots, which is what makes a change to `Inner` relink `Outer` while `Other` keeps its snapshot.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nothing
- Produces: `template <class T> class Arcane::Text::GapVector` -- `size()`, `operator[]`, `Assign(count)`, `Replace(at, eraseCount, insertCount)` (inserted slots are `T{}`)

Why a gap buffer: the highlight cache keeps one entry per row and an edit replaces a run of rows in the middle (Enter inserts one). A plain `std::vector` memmoves every row below each time -- tens of MB per keystroke on a 1 M-row file. Edits cluster at the caret, and Follow appends at the end, so a gap that sits where the last edit was makes the common cases O(edit size).

```cpp
#pragma once

// A gap buffer of T (the highlight cache's per-row entries, spec s4.4). Every
// slot of the backing vector holds a live T; the gap's slots are kept at T{}
// so erased entries release their memory.

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    template <class T>
    class GapVector
    {
    public:
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t size() const noexcept { return m_buf.size() - (m_gapEnd - m_gapBegin); }

        [[nodiscard]] T& operator[](std::size_t i) noexcept { return m_buf[i < m_gapBegin ? i : i + (m_gapEnd - m_gapBegin)]; }
        [[nodiscard]] const T& operator[](std::size_t i) const noexcept
        {
            return m_buf[i < m_gapBegin ? i : i + (m_gapEnd - m_gapBegin)];
        }

        void Assign(std::size_t count)
        {
            m_buf.clear();
            m_buf.resize(count);
            m_gapBegin = m_gapEnd = count;
        }

        // Erases [at, at + eraseCount) and inserts insertCount T{} at `at`.
        void Replace(std::size_t at, std::size_t eraseCount, std::size_t insertCount)
        {
            MoveGap(at);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < eraseCount; ++i) m_buf[m_gapEnd + i] = T{};
            m_gapEnd += eraseCount;
            if (m_gapEnd - m_gapBegin < insertCount) Grow(insertCount);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < insertCount; ++i) m_buf[m_gapBegin + i] = T{};
            m_gapBegin += insertCount;
        }

    private:
        void MoveGap(std::size_t at)
        {
            if (at < m_gapBegin)
            {
                const std::size_t n = m_gapBegin - at;
                std::move_backward(m_buf.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(at), m_buf.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(m_gapBegin),
                                   m_buf.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(m_gapEnd));
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < std::min(n, m_gapEnd - m_gapBegin); ++i) m_buf[at + i] = T{};
                m_gapBegin -= n;
                m_gapEnd -= n;
            }
            else if (at > m_gapBegin)
            {
                const std::size_t n = at - m_gapBegin;
                std::move(m_buf.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(m_gapEnd), m_buf.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(m_gapEnd + n),
                          m_buf.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(m_gapBegin));
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < std::min(n, m_gapEnd - m_gapBegin); ++i) m_buf[m_gapEnd + n - 1 - i] = T{};
                m_gapBegin += n;
                m_gapEnd += n;
            }
        }

        void Grow(std::size_t need)
        {
            const std::size_t gap = m_gapEnd - m_gapBegin;
            const std::size_t extra = std::max(need - gap, m_buf.size() / 2 + 64);   // geometric growth
            m_buf.insert(m_buf.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(m_gapEnd), extra, T{});
            m_gapEnd += extra;
        }

        std::vector<T> m_buf;
        std::size_t m_gapBegin = 0;
        std::size_t m_gapEnd = 0;
    };
}
```

(`64` sits in an expression, not a constant declaration.) `MoveGap` resets only the vacated slots that end up inside the new gap; a moved-from slot outside it is overwritten by the move itself.

### Task TE3-14: HighlightCache -- edit sync, checkpoints with convergence stop, bounded UI catch-up, plain-until-ready, syntaxMaxMB, line-local path (spec s3.5, s4.4)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightCache.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightCache.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneTests/src/Helpers/TextHighlightFixtures.hpp` (`FakeHighlightText`, `FullTokenize`, `RunsEqual`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/HighlightCacheTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Rope`, `RopeSnapshot`, `EditLogEntry`, `TextBuffer::{Version, Snapshot, EditsSince, EditLogCovers}` (skeleton + TE1-8; `RopeSnapshot` in `TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp`, `EditLogEntry`/`TextBuffer` in `TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp`); `Tokenizer`, `CopyRowForTokenize`, `TokenizeOptions` (TE3-10/11); `StateTable` (TE3-9); `GapVector` (TE3-13); `SyntaxLimits` (TE3-3)
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Text`):
  - `class IHighlightText { Version(); Snapshot(); EditsSince(v); bool EditLogCovers(std::uint64_t v) const; }` and `class BufferHighlightText final : public IHighlightText` (adapts a `TextBuffer`; `EditLogCovers` forwards to `TextBuffer::EditLogCovers`)
  - `std::optional<std::uint32_t> MapRowForward(std::uint32_t row, std::span<const EditLogEntry> edits) noexcept`
  - `struct HighlightStats { syncLinesThisFrame, syncUsThisFrame, resultsApplied, resultsDiscarded, rowsFromWorker, jobsSubmitted, resets }`
  - `class HighlightCache` -- `struct Services { MatchScratch* uiScratch; IHighlightExecutor* executor; ISyntaxProblemSink* problems; std::function<std::uint64_t()> clock; }`; `HighlightCache(const IHighlightText&, GrammarSnapshot, Services, SyntaxLimits)`; `SetGrammar`, `SetLimits`, `Grammar()`, `BeginFrame(firstVisibleRow, lastVisibleRow)`, **`const LineTokens* Line(std::uint32_t row)`** (binding), `Peek(row) const`, `Enabled()`, `Frontier()`, `RowCount()`, `ContentGeneration()`, `Stats()`, `SyncedVersion()`

How the cache stays correct (spec s4.4), in one paragraph for the reviewer: the cache is always at one buffer version (`SyncedVersion`), one grammar version and one session epoch (a `StateTable`). Each row holds `{hasTokens, startState, tokens}`. A sorted list of **checkpoints** marks rows whose start state is not yet verified; the first checkpoint is the **frontier**, and exactly the rows above it are ready (`Line` returns them; everything else draws plain). An edit replaces its rows with empty ones and puts checkpoints at the first edited row and the first row after the edit; rows below keep their tokens, shifted by `rowDelta`. Work at the frontier is either free -- a row whose stored start state equals the previous row's end state is verified by one integer compare and the checkpoint is dropped (the **convergence stop**: typing in a string re-tokenizes one line and the compare restores everything below) -- or one tokenize, after which the checkpoint moves to the next row. The UI thread does that work only for a visible row within `syncCatchUpLines` of the frontier, and only within `syncCatchUpLines` lines and `syncCatchUpBudgetUs` per frame; anything else returns `nullptr` and marks the frame urgent for the worker (TE3-16). Line-local grammars bypass all of it: any requested row is tokenized from the root on demand, at any file size. A stateful grammar on a buffer above `syntaxMaxMB` is `Disabled` (`Line` always `nullptr`).

The spec's per-entry `{bufferVersion, grammarVersion}` are held once per cache (every ready row is valid at `SyncedVersion` under `Grammar()`), and once per worker result (TE3-15/16), where they are checked on arrival; a row never carries a version of its own because no row is ever valid at a version other than the cache's.

```cpp
#pragma once

// A deterministic IHighlightText (edits are logged exactly like TE1's
// TextBuffer log contract), a full re-tokenize reference, and run equality.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightCache.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/StateTable.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Tokenizer.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Test
{
    class FakeHighlightText final : public Arcane::Text::IHighlightText
    {
    public:
        explicit FakeHighlightText(std::string_view text) : m_rope(Arcane::Text::Rope::FromUtf8(text)) {}

        std::uint64_t Version() const override { return m_version; }
        Arcane::Text::RopeSnapshot Snapshot() const override { return Arcane::Text::RopeSnapshot{ m_rope, m_version }; }
        std::span<const Arcane::Text::EditLogEntry> EditsSince(std::uint64_t v) const override
        {
            const auto it = std::find_if(m_log.begin(), m_log.end(), [v](const Arcane::Text::EditLogEntry& e) { return e.version > v; });
            return { m_log.data() + (it - m_log.begin()), static_cast<std::size_t>(m_log.end() - it) };
        }
        // TE1's rule (TextBuffer::EditLogCovers): complete when v is current, or the oldest kept entry is v + 1 or older.
        bool EditLogCovers(std::uint64_t v) const override
        {
            if (v >= m_version) return true;
            return !m_log.empty() && m_log.front().version <= v + 1;
        }

        void Replace(Arcane::Text::ByteRange range, std::string_view text)
        {
            const std::uint32_t firstRow = m_rope.OffsetToPoint(range.begin).row;
            const std::uint32_t lastRowBefore = m_rope.OffsetToPoint(range.end).row;
            const auto newlines = static_cast<std::int64_t>(std::count(text.begin(), text.end(), '\n'));
            m_rope = m_rope.Replace(range, text);
            ++m_version;
            m_log.push_back({ m_version, firstRow, lastRowBefore,
                              static_cast<std::int32_t>(newlines - static_cast<std::int64_t>(lastRowBefore - firstRow)) });
        }
        void Insert(Arcane::Text::ByteOffset at, std::string_view text) { Replace({ at, at }, text); }
        void Append(std::string_view text) { Insert(m_rope.Size(), text); }
        Arcane::Text::ByteOffset RowStart(std::uint32_t row) const { return m_rope.LineStart(row); }
        Arcane::Text::ByteOffset RowEnd(std::uint32_t row) const { return m_rope.LineEnd(row); }
        std::uint32_t Rows() const { return m_rope.LineCount(); }
        std::string Text() const { return m_rope.ToString(); }
        void ForgetLog() { m_log.clear(); ++m_version; }   // a trimmed log: EditLogCovers(older) is false, the next sync sees a gap

    private:
        Arcane::Text::Rope m_rope;
        std::uint64_t m_version = 0;
        std::vector<Arcane::Text::EditLogEntry> m_log;
    };

    inline std::vector<Arcane::Text::LineTokens> FullTokenize(const Arcane::Text::Rope& rope, const Arcane::Text::CompiledGrammar& g,
                                                              std::uint32_t longLineMaxBytes)
    {
        Arcane::Text::StateTable states;
        Arcane::Text::MatchScratch scratch{ Arcane::Text::RegexLimits{} };
        Arcane::Text::Tokenizer t(g, states, scratch);
        Arcane::Text::TokenizeOptions opt;
        opt.longLineMaxBytes = longLineMaxBytes;
        std::vector<Arcane::Text::LineTokens> out;
        Arcane::Text::StateId state = Arcane::Text::StateTable::kRoot;
        std::string line;
        for (std::uint32_t r = 0; r < rope.LineCount(); ++r)
        {
            line.clear();   // the WHOLE line: an independent reference for CopyRowForTokenize's cap+1 copy
            rope.CopyTo(Arcane::Text::ByteRange{ rope.LineStart(r), rope.LineEnd(r) }, line);
            out.push_back(t.TokenizeLine(line, state, opt));
            state = out.back().endState;
        }
        return out;
    }

    inline bool RunsEqual(const Arcane::Text::LineTokens& a, const Arcane::Text::LineTokens& b)
    {
        if (a.runs.size() != b.runs.size() || a.capped != b.capped || a.partial != b.partial || a.foldMarker != b.foldMarker) return false;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < a.runs.size(); ++i)
            if (a.runs[i].byteStart != b.runs[i].byteStart || a.runs[i].scope != b.runs[i].scope || a.runs[i].flags != b.runs[i].flags)
                return false;
        return true;
    }

    // Every READY row of `cache` equals the full re-tokenize of the current text ("nothing stale is ever applied").
    // Call it after BeginFrame, when the cache has synced to text.Version().
    inline bool ReadyRowsMatchFull(Arcane::Text::HighlightCache& cache, const FakeHighlightText& text, const Arcane::Text::CompiledGrammar& g,
                                   std::uint32_t longLineMaxBytes)
    {
        const auto full = FullTokenize(text.Snapshot().rope, g, longLineMaxBytes);
        for (std::uint32_t r = 0; r < cache.RowCount(); ++r)
            if (const Arcane::Text::LineTokens* t = cache.Peek(r); t && !t->partial && !RunsEqual(*t, full[r])) return false;
        return true;
    }
}
```

```cpp
    std::string Lines(std::uint32_t n, std::string_view line)
    {
        std::string s;
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        {
            s += line;
            if (i + 1 < n) s += '\n';
        }
        return s;
    }

    SyntaxLimits Generous()
    {
        SyntaxLimits l;
        l.syncCatchUpLines = 1000000;   // no distance or per-frame line bound
        return l;                       // everything else 0 = unbounded
    }

    struct Env
    {
        ScopeTable scopes;
        GrammarSnapshot grammar = CompileTestGrammar(kBlockyGrammar, scopes);

        HighlightCache::Services Services(std::function<std::uint64_t()> clock = {})
        {

            s.uiScratch = &ui;
            s.clock = std::move(clock);
            return s;
        }
    };

    const LineTokens* row = local.Line(399);   // deep in a file above the limit (spec s11.2)
    REQUIRE(row != nullptr);
    CHECK(DescribeRuns(*row, e.scopes) == "0:constant.other.timestamp.log 25: 51:string.quoted.log");
    CHECK(row->endState == StateTable::kRoot);   // the open quote is force-closed at the end of the line
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The per-buffer highlight cache (spec s4.4). UI-thread owned; the worker
// never touches it -- its results arrive through a queue (TE3-16). See the
// TE3-14 task text for the checkpoint model.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/GapVector.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/StateTable.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/SyntaxLimits.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/SyntaxTypes.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Tokenizer.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    // What the cache reads from a buffer. TextBuffer is adapted by
    // BufferHighlightText; tests use a deterministic fake.
    class IHighlightText
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IHighlightText() = default;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::uint64_t Version() const = 0;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual RopeSnapshot Snapshot() const = 0;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::span<const EditLogEntry> EditsSince(std::uint64_t version) const = 0;
        // False when the log no longer reaches back to `version` (TE1 keeps the newest 4096 batches): invalidate everything.
        [[nodiscard]] virtual bool EditLogCovers(std::uint64_t version) const = 0;
    };

    class BufferHighlightText final : public IHighlightText
    {
    public:
        explicit BufferHighlightText(const TextBuffer& buffer) : m_buffer(buffer) {}
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t Version() const override { return m_buffer.Version(); }
        [[nodiscard]] RopeSnapshot Snapshot() const override { return m_buffer.Snapshot(); }
        [[nodiscard]] std::span<const EditLogEntry> EditsSince(std::uint64_t version) const override { return m_buffer.EditsSince(version); }
        [[nodiscard]] bool EditLogCovers(std::uint64_t version) const override { return m_buffer.EditLogCovers(version); }

    private:
        const TextBuffer& m_buffer;
    };

    // A row in version-v coordinates -> the same row now, or nullopt when an
    // edit in `edits` (all newer than v, oldest first) replaced it.
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::uint32_t> MapRowForward(std::uint32_t row, std::span<const EditLogEntry> edits) noexcept;

    struct HighlightStats
    {
        std::uint32_t syncLinesThisFrame = 0;   // lines the UI thread tokenized this frame
        std::uint64_t syncUsThisFrame = 0;      // wall time the UI thread spent catching up this frame
        std::uint64_t resultsApplied = 0;
        std::uint64_t resultsDiscarded = 0;
        std::uint64_t rowsFromWorker = 0;
        std::uint64_t jobsSubmitted = 0;
        std::uint64_t resets = 0;
    };

    class IHighlightExecutor;   // HighlightWorker.hpp (TE3-15)

    class HighlightCache
    {
    public:
        struct Services
        {
            MatchScratch* uiScratch = nullptr;              // the UI thread's PCRE2 state (required, spec s4.2)
            IHighlightExecutor* executor = nullptr;         // the worker (TE3-16); nullptr = UI catch-up only
            ISyntaxProblemSink* problems = nullptr;         // regex-limit reports
            std::function<std::uint64_t()> clock;           // microseconds; empty = SteadyNowUs
        };

        HighlightCache(const IHighlightText& text, GrammarSnapshot grammar, Services services, SyntaxLimits limits);
        ~HighlightCache();
        HighlightCache(const HighlightCache&)            = delete;
        HighlightCache& operator=(const HighlightCache&) = delete;

        void SetGrammar(GrammarSnapshot grammar);
        void SetLimits(const SyntaxLimits& limits);
        [[nodiscard]] const GrammarSnapshot& Grammar() const noexcept { return m_grammar; }

        // Once per frame, before any Line(): syncs the buffer's edits, drops
        // settled checkpoints, resets the frame's catch-up allowance.
        void BeginFrame(std::uint32_t firstVisibleRow, std::uint32_t lastVisibleRow);

        // Binding (plan skeleton): the row's tokens, or nullptr when not ready
        // (draw plain). Never tokenizes beyond the catch-up bounds.
        const LineTokens* Line(std::uint32_t row);
        // The row's tokens if they are ready now; never does any work.
        [[nodiscard]] const LineTokens* Peek(std::uint32_t row) const;

        [[nodiscard]] bool Enabled() const noexcept { return m_mode != Mode::Disabled; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t Frontier() const noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t RowCount() const noexcept { return m_snapshot.rope.LineCount(); }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t ContentGeneration() const noexcept { return m_contentGeneration; }
        [[nodiscard]] HighlightStats Stats() const noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t SyncedVersion() const noexcept { return m_syncedVersion; }

    private:
        enum class Mode : std::uint8_t { Stateful, LineLocal, Disabled };
        enum class StepResult : std::uint8_t { Nothing, Resolved, Tokenized };

        struct HighlightRow
        {
            bool hasTokens = false;
            StateId startState = StateTable::kRoot;
            LineTokens tokens;
        };
        struct LocalRow
        {
            LineTokens tokens;
            std::uint64_t frame = 0;
        };

        [[nodiscard]] Mode ModeFor() const;
        void Reset();
        void Sync();
        void ApplyEdit(const EditLogEntry& e);
        void ApplyEditLocal(const EditLogEntry& e);
        void ResolveFree();
        StepResult Step(std::uint32_t budgetUs);
        const LineTokens* LocalLine(std::uint32_t row);
        void EvictLocal();
        void AddCheckpoint(std::uint32_t row);
        void EraseCheckpoint(std::uint32_t row);
        [[nodiscard]] TokenizeOptions Options(std::uint32_t budgetUs) const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t Now() const;

        const IHighlightText& m_text;
        GrammarSnapshot m_grammar;
        Services m_services;
        SyntaxLimits m_limits;
        Mode m_mode = Mode::Disabled;
        std::shared_ptr<StateTable> m_states;
        std::optional<Tokenizer> m_tokenizer;
        RopeSnapshot m_snapshot;
        std::uint64_t m_syncedVersion = 0;
        std::uint64_t m_epoch = 0;   // bumped by every Reset(): StateIds of another epoch mean nothing here
        GapVector<HighlightRow> m_rows;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> m_checkpoints;   // sorted, unique
        std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t, LocalRow> m_local;
        std::uint64_t m_frame = 0;
        std::uint32_t m_firstVisible = 0;
        std::uint32_t m_lastVisible = 0;
        std::uint32_t m_frameLines = 0;
        std::uint64_t m_frameUs = 0;
        bool m_wantUrgent = false;        // this frame: a visible row was refused (TE3-16 raises the worker's priority)
        bool m_urgentLastFrame = false;
        std::uint64_t m_contentGeneration = 0;
        HighlightStats m_stats;
        std::string m_line;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightCache.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightCache.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("capacity hint, not a tunable: line-local rows kept across frames; an evicted row costs one re-tokenize when it is drawn again")
        constexpr std::size_t kLocalCacheRows = 4096;
    }

    std::optional<std::uint32_t> MapRowForward(std::uint32_t row, std::span<const EditLogEntry> edits) noexcept
    {
        for (const EditLogEntry& e : edits)
        {
            if (row < e.firstRow) continue;
            if (row <= e.lastRowBefore) return std::nullopt;
            row = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(row) + e.rowDelta);
        }
        return row;
    }

    HighlightCache::HighlightCache(const IHighlightText& text, GrammarSnapshot grammar, Services services, SyntaxLimits limits)
        : m_text(text), m_grammar(std::move(grammar)), m_services(std::move(services)), m_limits(limits)
    {
        assert(m_services.uiScratch && "HighlightCache needs the UI thread's MatchScratch");
        m_snapshot = m_text.Snapshot();
        m_syncedVersion = m_snapshot.version;
        m_mode = ModeFor();
        Reset();
    }

    HighlightCache::~HighlightCache() = default;

    HighlightCache::Mode HighlightCache::ModeFor() const
    {
        if (!m_grammar) return Mode::Disabled;
        if (m_grammar->LineLocal()) return Mode::LineLocal;   // any size, any scroll position (s4.4)
        if (m_limits.syntaxMaxBytes != 0 && m_snapshot.rope.Size() > m_limits.syntaxMaxBytes) return Mode::Disabled;
        return Mode::Stateful;
    }

    void HighlightCache::Reset()
    {
        ++m_epoch;
        m_states = std::make_shared<StateTable>();
        if (m_grammar) m_tokenizer.emplace(*m_grammar, *m_states, *m_services.uiScratch);
        else m_tokenizer.reset();
        m_local.clear();
        m_checkpoints.clear();
        if (m_mode == Mode::Stateful)
        {
            m_rows.Assign(m_snapshot.rope.LineCount());
            m_checkpoints.push_back(0);
        }
        else
        {
            m_rows.Assign(0);
        }
        ++m_contentGeneration;
        ++m_stats.resets;
    }

    void HighlightCache::SetGrammar(GrammarSnapshot grammar)
    {
        if (grammar == m_grammar) return;
        m_grammar = std::move(grammar);
        m_mode = ModeFor();
        Reset();
    }

    void HighlightCache::SetLimits(const SyntaxLimits& limits)
    {
        const bool capChanged = limits.longLineMaxBytes != m_limits.longLineMaxBytes;
        m_limits = limits;
        if (capChanged) Reset();   // the cap is part of every row's tokens (s3.5)
    }

    std::uint32_t HighlightCache::Frontier() const noexcept
    {
        if (m_mode != Mode::Stateful) return 0;
        return m_checkpoints.empty() ? static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m_rows.size()) : m_checkpoints.front();
    }

    HighlightStats HighlightCache::Stats() const noexcept
    {
        HighlightStats s = m_stats;
        s.syncLinesThisFrame = m_frameLines;
        s.syncUsThisFrame = m_frameUs;
        return s;
    }

    std::uint64_t HighlightCache::Now() const { return m_services.clock ? m_services.clock() : SteadyNowUs(); }

    TokenizeOptions HighlightCache::Options(std::uint32_t budgetUs) const
    {
        TokenizeOptions o;
        o.longLineMaxBytes = m_limits.longLineMaxBytes;
        o.lineBudgetUs = budgetUs;
        o.clock = m_services.clock ? &m_services.clock : nullptr;
        o.problems = m_services.problems;
        return o;
    }

    void HighlightCache::AddCheckpoint(std::uint32_t row)
    {
        const auto it = std::lower_bound(m_checkpoints.begin(), m_checkpoints.end(), row);
        if (it == m_checkpoints.end() || *it != row) m_checkpoints.insert(it, row);
    }

    void HighlightCache::EraseCheckpoint(std::uint32_t row)
    {
        const auto it = std::lower_bound(m_checkpoints.begin(), m_checkpoints.end(), row);
        if (it != m_checkpoints.end() && *it == row) m_checkpoints.erase(it);
    }

    void HighlightCache::BeginFrame(std::uint32_t firstVisibleRow, std::uint32_t lastVisibleRow)
    {
        ++m_frame;
        m_firstVisible = firstVisibleRow;
        m_lastVisible = std::max(firstVisibleRow, lastVisibleRow);
        m_urgentLastFrame = m_wantUrgent;
        m_wantUrgent = false;
        m_frameLines = 0;
        m_frameUs = 0;
        Sync();
        if (const Mode mode = ModeFor(); mode != m_mode)
        {
            m_mode = mode;
            Reset();
        }
        if (m_mode == Mode::Stateful) ResolveFree();
        else if (m_mode == Mode::LineLocal) EvictLocal();
    }

    void HighlightCache::Sync()
    {
        if (m_text.Version() == m_syncedVersion) return;
        RopeSnapshot snap = m_text.Snapshot();
        const std::span<const EditLogEntry> edits = m_text.EditsSince(m_syncedVersion);
        const bool gap = !m_text.EditLogCovers(m_syncedVersion) || edits.empty() || edits.front().version != m_syncedVersion + 1;
        m_snapshot = std::move(snap);
        m_syncedVersion = m_snapshot.version;
        if (gap)
        {
            Reset();   // the log no longer covers our version: start over rather than guess (s4.4)
            return;
        }
        for (const EditLogEntry& e : edits)
        {
            if (m_mode == Mode::Stateful) ApplyEdit(e);
            else if (m_mode == Mode::LineLocal) ApplyEditLocal(e);
        }
        ++m_contentGeneration;
        assert(m_mode != Mode::Stateful || m_rows.size() == m_snapshot.rope.LineCount());
    }

    void HighlightCache::ApplyEdit(const EditLogEntry& e)
    {
        const std::uint32_t removed = e.lastRowBefore - e.firstRow + 1;
        const auto inserted = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(removed) + e.rowDelta);
        m_rows.Replace(e.firstRow, removed, inserted);
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> next;
        next.reserve(m_checkpoints.size() + 2);
        for (const std::uint32_t cp : m_checkpoints)
        {
            if (cp < e.firstRow) next.push_back(cp);
            else if (cp > e.lastRowBefore) next.push_back(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(cp) + e.rowDelta));
        }
        m_checkpoints = std::move(next);
        AddCheckpoint(e.firstRow);                                                // the edited rows: tokenize
        if (e.firstRow + inserted < m_rows.size()) AddCheckpoint(e.firstRow + inserted);   // the first row after them: verify
    }

    void HighlightCache::ApplyEditLocal(const EditLogEntry& e)
    {
        std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t, LocalRow> next;
        next.reserve(m_local.size());
        for (auto& [row, entry] : m_local)
        {
            if (row < e.firstRow) next.emplace(row, std::move(entry));
            else if (row > e.lastRowBefore)
                next.emplace(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(row) + e.rowDelta), std::move(entry));
        }
        m_local = std::move(next);
    }

    void HighlightCache::ResolveFree()
    {
        while (!m_checkpoints.empty())
        {
            const std::uint32_t f = m_checkpoints.front();
            if (f >= m_rows.size())
            {
                m_checkpoints.erase(m_checkpoints.begin());
                continue;
            }
            StateId prevEnd = StateTable::kRoot;
            if (f > 0)
            {
                const HighlightRow& p = m_rows[f - 1];
                if (p.tokens.partial) return;
                prevEnd = p.tokens.endState;
            }
            const HighlightRow& r = m_rows[f];
            if (!r.hasTokens || r.startState != prevEnd) return;
            m_checkpoints.erase(m_checkpoints.begin());   // converged: everything to the next checkpoint is ready
            ++m_contentGeneration;
        }
    }

    HighlightCache::StepResult HighlightCache::Step(std::uint32_t budgetUs)
    {
        if (m_checkpoints.empty()) return StepResult::Nothing;
        const std::uint32_t f = m_checkpoints.front();
        if (f >= m_rows.size())
        {
            m_checkpoints.erase(m_checkpoints.begin());
            return StepResult::Resolved;
        }
        if (f > 0 && m_rows[f - 1].tokens.partial)
        {
            HighlightRow& p = m_rows[f - 1];
            CopyRowForTokenize(m_snapshot.rope, f - 1, m_limits.longLineMaxBytes, m_line);
            m_tokenizer->ResumeLine(m_line, p.tokens, Options(budgetUs));
            ++m_contentGeneration;
            return StepResult::Tokenized;
        }
        const StateId prevEnd = f == 0 ? StateTable::kRoot : m_rows[f - 1].tokens.endState;
        HighlightRow& r = m_rows[f];
        if (r.hasTokens && r.startState == prevEnd)
        {
            EraseCheckpoint(f);
            ++m_contentGeneration;
            return StepResult::Resolved;
        }
        CopyRowForTokenize(m_snapshot.rope, f, m_limits.longLineMaxBytes, m_line);
        r.tokens = m_tokenizer->TokenizeLine(m_line, prevEnd, Options(budgetUs));
        r.hasTokens = true;
        r.startState = prevEnd;
        EraseCheckpoint(f);
        if (f + 1 < m_rows.size()) AddCheckpoint(f + 1);
        ++m_contentGeneration;
        return StepResult::Tokenized;
    }

    const LineTokens* HighlightCache::Line(std::uint32_t row)
    {
        switch (m_mode)
        {
            case Mode::Disabled:  return nullptr;
            case Mode::LineLocal: return LocalLine(row);
            case Mode::Stateful:  break;
        }
        if (row >= m_rows.size()) return nullptr;
        if (row < Frontier()) return &m_rows[row].tokens;
        ResolveFree();
        if (row < Frontier()) return &m_rows[row].tokens;
        // Bounded UI catch-up (s4.4): only within syncCatchUpLines of the last
        // ready row, and only within the frame's line and time allowance.
        if (row - Frontier() >= m_limits.syncCatchUpLines)
        {
            m_wantUrgent = true;
            return nullptr;
        }
        while (row >= Frontier())
        {
            if (m_frameLines >= m_limits.syncCatchUpLines)
            {
                m_wantUrgent = true;
                break;
            }
            std::uint32_t budget = m_limits.tokenizeLineBudgetUs;
            if (m_limits.syncCatchUpBudgetUs != 0)
            {
                if (m_frameUs >= m_limits.syncCatchUpBudgetUs)
                {
                    m_wantUrgent = true;
                    break;
                }
                const auto left = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m_limits.syncCatchUpBudgetUs - m_frameUs);
                budget = budget == 0 ? left : std::min(budget, left);
            }
            const std::uint64_t t0 = Now();
            const StepResult step = Step(budget);
            m_frameUs += Now() - t0;
            if (step == StepResult::Nothing) break;
            if (step == StepResult::Tokenized) ++m_frameLines;
            ResolveFree();
        }
        return row < Frontier() ? &m_rows[row].tokens : nullptr;
    }

    const LineTokens* HighlightCache::Peek(std::uint32_t row) const
    {
        switch (m_mode)
        {
            case Mode::Disabled:  return nullptr;
            case Mode::LineLocal:
            {
                const auto it = m_local.find(row);
                return it == m_local.end() ? nullptr : &it->second.tokens;
            }
            case Mode::Stateful:  break;
        }
        return row < Frontier() && row < m_rows.size() ? &m_rows[row].tokens : nullptr;
    }

    const LineTokens* HighlightCache::LocalLine(std::uint32_t row)
    {
        if (row >= m_snapshot.rope.LineCount()) return nullptr;
        auto it = m_local.find(row);
        if (it == m_local.end())
        {
            CopyRowForTokenize(m_snapshot.rope, row, m_limits.longLineMaxBytes, m_line);
            LocalRow fresh{ m_tokenizer->TokenizeLine(m_line, StateTable::kRoot, Options(m_limits.tokenizeLineBudgetUs)), m_frame };
            it = m_local.emplace(row, std::move(fresh)).first;
            ++m_contentGeneration;
        }
        else
        {
            it->second.frame = m_frame;
            if (it->second.tokens.partial)
            {
                CopyRowForTokenize(m_snapshot.rope, row, m_limits.longLineMaxBytes, m_line);
                m_tokenizer->ResumeLine(m_line, it->second.tokens, Options(m_limits.tokenizeLineBudgetUs));
                ++m_contentGeneration;
            }
        }
        return &it->second.tokens;
    }

    void HighlightCache::EvictLocal()
    {
        if (m_local.size() <= kLocalCacheRows) return;
        std::erase_if(m_local, [this](const auto& kv) { return kv.second.frame + 1 < m_frame; });
    }
}
```

### Task TE3-15: HighlightWorker -- jobs over RopeSnapshot, result queue, executors, per-thread PCRE2 state (spec s4.2, s4.4)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightWorker.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightWorker.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/HighlightWorkerTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `RopeSnapshot` (skeleton), `Tokenizer`, `CopyRowForTokenize` (TE3-10/11), `StateTable`, `kNoState` (TE3-9), `SyntaxLimits` (TE3-3)
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Text`):
  - `struct HighlightRowResult { StateId startState; LineTokens tokens; }`
  - `struct HighlightResult { std::uint64_t ticket, epoch, version, grammarVersion; std::uint32_t firstRow; std::vector<HighlightRowResult> rows; bool converged; }`
  - `class HighlightResultQueue { void Push(HighlightResult); std::vector<HighlightResult> TakeAll(); bool Empty() const; }`
  - `struct HighlightJob { ticket, epoch, snapshot, grammar, states, startRow, startState, resume, endRow, knownStarts, limits, problems, urgent, results }`
  - `HighlightResult RunHighlightJob(const HighlightJob&, MatchScratch&, const std::function<std::uint64_t()>& clock)`
  - `class IHighlightExecutor { virtual void Submit(HighlightJob) = 0; }`; `class ThreadedHighlightExecutor` (`Submit`, `WaitIdle()`, `Pending()`); `class ManualHighlightExecutor` (`Submit`, `Pending()`, `Job(i)`, `RunNext()`, `RunAll()`)

A job is one worker slice (spec s4.4): it tokenizes rows `[startRow, endRow)` of an immutable `RopeSnapshot` -- the buffer's version at submission -- with the session's shared `StateTable` and its own `MatchScratch`, and stops at the first of: `endRow`; `highlightFrameBudgetUs` of wall time (checked between rows); a partial row (the per-line budget, resumed by the next job); or **convergence** -- the start state it computed for a row equals the start state the cache already holds for it (`knownStarts`), so the rest is known (the convergence stop, s4.4). The job holds the grammar snapshot and the state table by `shared_ptr`, so a grammar reload or a cache reset never frees anything under it (s4.1). Results go into the submitting cache's own queue; only the UI thread writes the cache. `ThreadedHighlightExecutor` runs jobs on one `std::jthread` with that thread's `MatchScratch` (s4.2), urgent jobs first. `ManualHighlightExecutor` holds jobs until the test runs them -- the "held worker" of s11.2.
