- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/StyleLineTest.cpp`, `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextSyntaxServiceTest.cpp`, `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextDocumentSyntaxTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: everything above; `Arcane::Diagnostics::Publish`, `Arcane::Diagnostic`, `DiagLocator::File` (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Base/Diagnostics.hpp:702-776`); `Arcane::Project::Root()`, `ActivePluginRoots()` (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Project/Project.hpp:79,88`); `ModuleBuild::ExeDir()` (`Project/ModuleBuild.hpp`, as `ThemePresetDir` uses it); `AssetBrowserSettings::watchPollSeconds` (the asset-watch cadence, `EditorAppProject.cpp:436`); `EditorSyntaxThemeSettings`, `ActiveSyntaxRules` (TE3-5/6); `Theme::Live()` (`Widgets/EditorTheme.hpp:150`); `TextSettings`, `ToSyntaxLimits` (TE3-3); TE2-15 `TextDocument::{Open, Buffer, CanonicalPath (by value), Model, View, Draw}`, TE2-16 `TextDocumentServices::afterSave`, TE2-13 `TextEditorView::{SetRowColorRuns, Facts}` + `ViewColorRun`/`RowColorRunsFn`, TE2-11 `TextModel::{display, SyncDisplay}`, TE2-20's text-route wiring in `EditorApp.cpp` (the `afterSave` lambda it sets once)
- Produces:
  - `struct Arcane::Text::StyledSpan { std::uint32_t begin, end; ScopeStyle style; }`; `void StyleLine(std::uint32_t lineBytes, const LineTokens* tokens, ScopeMap& styles, std::vector<StyledSpan>& out)`
  - `Arcane::Editor::TextSyntaxService` -- `SetProject`, `Tick(double)`, `NotifySaved(path)`, `Registry()`, `Styles()`, `Limits()`, `DetectFor(path, firstLine)`, `CreateCache(text, grammar)`, `StylesGeneration()`; `Arcane::Diagnostic ToDiagnostic(const GrammarProblem&)`; `std::filesystem::path EngineSyntaxDir()`
  - `TextSyntaxService* TextDocumentServices::syntax = nullptr` (**NEW member**, CANON A6: null = no highlighting -- `Highlight()` returns nullptr, the picker lists Plain Text only)
  - `Arcane::Text::HighlightCache* TextDocument::Highlight()` (the document's cache, for TE4's brackets/folds/status strip; canonical, there is no `Highlights()`), `void TextDocument::SetLanguage(std::string_view grammarName)` (TE4's language picker), `void TextDocument::UpdateHighlight(std::uint32_t firstVisibleRow, std::uint32_t lastVisibleRow)` (called once per frame by the document with the union of its views' visible rows; TE4-17 supplies the union when split)

One `TextSyntaxService` per editor: the `GrammarRegistry` (engine `data/Syntaxes` staged beside the exe, the project's `Config/Syntaxes`, each active plugin root's `Syntaxes`), one `ThreadedHighlightExecutor` shared by every document, the UI thread's `MatchScratch` (limits refreshed each tick from `editor.text.regexMatchLimit/regexDepthLimit`), the `ScopeMap` rebuilt whenever `editor.theme.syntax.rules` or the live palette changes, Problems rows through `Arcane::Diagnostics::Publish` (code `text.grammar.invalid` Error / `text.grammar.embed` Warning / `text.grammar.regexLimit` Warning, locator = the grammar file), and grammar files polled on the asset-watch cadence. The service reaches documents as `TextDocumentServices::syntax` (set by the app's text routes; null = no highlighting). Each `TextDocument` with a service owns a `HighlightCache` over its `TextBuffer`, colours its view through `View().SetRowColorRuns` (each token run resolved through the `ScopeMap`; bold/italic are carried but not drawn), calls `UpdateHighlight` once per frame before its views draw, and re-resolves its grammar by name when the registry's `Generation()` moves (a reload re-highlights open documents, s4.1). Saving reaches `NotifySaved` through `TextDocumentServices::afterSave` -- the app's ONE `afterSave` lambda, which TE6-12 extends with the asset reload (CANON B21) -- so saving a grammar in the text editor reloads it live.

```cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/StyleLine.hpp"

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    LineTokens Runs(std::vector<TokenRun> runs)
    {
        LineTokens t;
        t.runs = std::move(runs);
        return t;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("StyleLine: plain, styled, merged, partial and capped lines", "[text-view]")
{
    ScopeTable scopes;
    const ScopeId str = scopes.Intern("string.quoted.x"), num = scopes.Intern("constant.numeric.x"), kw = scopes.Intern("keyword.x");
    const ScopeStyle red{ PackRgba(255, 0, 0, 255), true, false, false };
    ScopeMap map(scopes, { { "string", red }, { "constant", red }, { "keyword", { PackRgba(0, 0, 255, 255), true, false, true } } });
    std::vector<StyledSpan> out;

    StyleLine(10, nullptr, map, out);   // not ready: one plain span
    REQUIRE(out.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(out[0].begin == 0u); CHECK(out[0].end == 10u); CHECK_FALSE(out[0].style.hasColor);

    StyleLine(0, nullptr, map, out);
    CHECK(out.empty());

    const LineTokens t = Runs({ { 0, kw }, { 2, 0 }, { 3, str }, { 6, num } });
    StyleLine(8, &t, map, out);         // string and number share red: merged
    REQUIRE(out.size() == 3u);
    CHECK(out[0].begin == 0u); CHECK(out[0].end == 2u); CHECK(out[0].style.bold);
    CHECK(out[1].begin == 2u); CHECK(out[1].end == 3u); CHECK_FALSE(out[1].style.hasColor);
    CHECK(out[2].begin == 3u); CHECK(out[2].end == 8u); CHECK(out[2].style == red);

    LineTokens partial = t;
    partial.partial = true;
    partial.resumeAt = 4;
    StyleLine(8, &partial, map, out);   // tokenized up to 4; the rest plain
    REQUIRE(out.size() == 4u);
    CHECK(out[2].end == 4u);
    CHECK(out[3].begin == 4u); CHECK(out[3].end == 8u); CHECK_FALSE(out[3].style.hasColor);

    const LineTokens capped = Runs({ { 0, str }, { 5, 0 } });
    StyleLine(100, &capped, map, out);  // a capped line's last run is plain to the end
    REQUIRE(out.size() == 2u);
    CHECK(out[1].begin == 5u); CHECK(out[1].end == 100u); CHECK_FALSE(out[1].style.hasColor);
}
```

```cpp
TEST_CASE("ToDiagnostic: grammar problems become Problems rows", "[text-view]")
{
    Text::GrammarProblem p{ Text::GrammarProblem::Kind::Invalid, "D:/p/Config/Syntaxes/Json.arcsyntax", "JSON", "patterns[2].end", "missing )" };
    Diagnostic d = Editor::ToDiagnostic(p);
    CHECK(d.severity == DiagSeverity::Error);
    CHECK(d.code == "text.grammar.invalid");
    CHECK(d.message == "JSON (patterns[2].end): missing )");
    CHECK(d.locator.kind == DiagLocator::Kind::File);
    CHECK(d.locator.file == "D:/p/Config/Syntaxes/Json.arcsyntax");
    p.kind = Text::GrammarProblem::Kind::EmbedMissing;
    CHECK(Editor::ToDiagnostic(p).severity == DiagSeverity::Warning);
    CHECK(Editor::ToDiagnostic(p).code == "text.grammar.embed");
    p.kind = Text::GrammarProblem::Kind::RegexLimit;
    CHECK(Editor::ToDiagnostic(p).code == "text.grammar.regexLimit");

    CHECK(svc.DetectFor("x.foo", "")->Name() == "Plain Text");
    Test::ScopedCodeRung rung("editor.text.languageByExtension", CVarValue::String(".foo=Test"));
    CHECK(svc.DetectFor("x.foo", "")->Name() == "Test");
}

TEST_CASE("TextSyntaxService: saving a grammar reloads it; a broken one raises a Problems row", "[text-view]")
{
    Test::TempDir dir("syntax_service_reload");
    const fs::path file = dir.path / "engine" / "Test.arcsyntax";
    Write(file, kGood);
    Editor::DiagnosticStore store;
    store.InstallAsEngineSink();
    Editor::TextSyntaxService svc(std::make_unique<Text::ManualHighlightExecutor>(), dir.path / "engine");
    const std::uint64_t gen = svc.Registry().Generation();
    Write(file, R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":"Test","scope":"source.t","files":[".tst"],"patterns":[{"match":"(bad"}]})");
    svc.NotifySaved(file);
    CHECK(svc.Registry().Generation() > gen);
    CHECK(svc.Registry().Find("Test") == svc.Registry().PlainText());
    bool found = false;
    for (const Diagnostic& d : store.Snapshot()) found |= d.code == "text.grammar.invalid";
    CHECK(found);
    Write(file, kGood);
    svc.NotifySaved(file);
    found = false;
    for (const Diagnostic& d : store.Snapshot()) found |= d.code == "text.grammar.invalid";
    CHECK_FALSE(found);   // fixed: retracted
    store.UninstallEngineSink();
}
```

```cpp
using namespace Arcane;
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

    void Write(const fs::path& p, std::string_view text)
    {
        fs::create_directories(p.parent_path());
        std::ofstream out(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        out << text;
    }

    constexpr std::string_view kGood = R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":"Test","scope":"source.t","files":[".tst"],
        "patterns":[{"match":"//.*$","scope":"comment.line.t"},{"match":"[0-9]+","scope":"constant.numeric.t"}]})";

    // Draws `doc` for `frames` frames on a bare ImGui context (TE2-15's headless pattern).
    void DrawFrames(Editor::TextDocument& doc, int frames)
    {
        ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
        ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
        ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
        ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
        io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(1024, 768);
        io.IniFilename = nullptr;
        unsigned char* px = nullptr;
        int w = 0, h = 0;
        io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; ++i)
        {
            io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
            ImGui::NewFrame();
            bool close = false;
            doc.Draw(close);
            ImGui::Render();
        }
        ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
        ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
    }

    std::unique_ptr<Editor::TextDocument> OpenWith(const fs::path& p, Editor::TextDocumentServices services)
    {
        std::string error;
        auto doc = Editor::TextDocument::Open(p, std::move(services), error);
        INFO(error);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        return doc;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("TextDocument: afterSave composed with NotifySaved reloads a grammar saved in the editor", "[text-view]")
{
    Test::TempDir dir("syntax_doc_save");

    Write(grammar, kGood);
    Editor::TextSyntaxService svc(std::make_unique<Text::ManualHighlightExecutor>(), dir.path / "engine");
    int afterSaveCalls = 0;
    Editor::TextDocumentServices services;
    services.syntax = &svc;
    services.afterSave = [&](Editor::TextDocument& d)   // the app's one lambda, shape of EditorApp's wiring
    {
        ++afterSaveCalls;
        svc.NotifySaved(d.CanonicalPath());
    };
    auto doc = OpenWith(grammar, services);
    const std::uint64_t gen = svc.Registry().Generation();
    Text::TextCommands(doc->Buffer(), doc->Model().selections).InsertText(" ");   // leading whitespace: still valid JSON
    REQUIRE(doc->Dirty());
    REQUIRE(doc->Save());
    CHECK(afterSaveCalls == 1);
    CHECK(svc.Registry().Generation() > gen);   // the saved grammar was re-read
    CHECK(svc.Registry().Find("Test") != svc.Registry().PlainText());
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// A row's tokens -> spans to draw (spec s4.3, s4.5): runs resolved through
// the theme's ScopeMap, adjacent equal styles merged, and everything not
// (yet) tokenized -- a not-ready row, the tail of a partial row, the part of a
// capped row past the cap -- in the default style.

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Scope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/SyntaxTypes.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct StyledSpan
    {
        std::uint32_t begin = 0;
        std::uint32_t end = 0;
        ScopeStyle style;   // hasColor false = the default text colour
    };

    void StyleLine(std::uint32_t lineBytes, const LineTokens* tokens, ScopeMap& styles, std::vector<StyledSpan>& out);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/StyleLine.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/StyleLine.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        void Push(std::vector<StyledSpan>& out, std::uint32_t begin, std::uint32_t end, const ScopeStyle& style)
        {
            if (begin >= end) return;
            if (!out.empty() && out.back().end == begin && out.back().style == style)
            {
                out.back().end = end;
                return;
            }
            out.push_back({ begin, end, style });
        }
    }

    void StyleLine(std::uint32_t lineBytes, const LineTokens* tokens, ScopeMap& styles, std::vector<StyledSpan>& out)
    {
        out.clear();
        if (lineBytes == 0) return;
        if (!tokens || tokens->runs.empty())
        {
            Push(out, 0, lineBytes, ScopeStyle{});
            return;
        }
        const std::uint32_t covered = tokens->partial ? std::min(tokens->resumeAt, lineBytes) : lineBytes;
        Push(out, 0, std::min(tokens->runs.front().byteStart, covered), ScopeStyle{});
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < tokens->runs.size(); ++i)
        {
            const std::uint32_t b = std::min(tokens->runs[i].byteStart, covered);
            const std::uint32_t e = i + 1 < tokens->runs.size() ? std::min(tokens->runs[i + 1].byteStart, covered) : covered;
            Push(out, b, e, styles.Style(tokens->runs[i].scope));
        }
        Push(out, covered, lineBytes, ScopeStyle{});
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The editor's one syntax service (text editor spec s4): the grammar
// registry over the engine/project/plugin search path, the shared highlight
// worker, the UI thread's PCRE2 state, the theme's ScopeMap, Problems rows,
// and live reload of grammar files.

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/GrammarRegistry.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightCache.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightWorker.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Scope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/SyntaxLimits.hpp"
#include "Widgets/EditorTheme.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Base/Diagnostics.hpp>

#include <filesystem>
#include <memory>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane { class Project; }

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Diagnostic ToDiagnostic(const Arcane::Text::GrammarProblem& problem);
    [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path EngineSyntaxDir();   // <exe dir>/data/Syntaxes

    class TextSyntaxService
    {
    public:
        TextSyntaxService();   // EngineSyntaxDir(), a ThreadedHighlightExecutor
        TextSyntaxService(std::unique_ptr<Arcane::Text::IHighlightExecutor> executor, std::filesystem::path engineDir);
        ~TextSyntaxService();
        TextSyntaxService(const TextSyntaxService&)            = delete;
        TextSyntaxService& operator=(const TextSyntaxService&) = delete;

        // Engine dir, then <root>/Config/Syntaxes, then each active plugin root's Syntaxes/ (spec s4.1); reloads.
        void SetProject(const Arcane::Project* project);
        // Once per frame: regex limits, regex-limit Problems rows, ScopeMap rebuild, grammar-file poll.
        void Tick(double editorClockSeconds);
        void NotifySaved(const std::filesystem::path& file);

        [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::GrammarRegistry& Registry() noexcept { return m_registry; }
        [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::ScopeMap& Styles() noexcept { return m_styles; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t StylesGeneration() const noexcept { return m_stylesGeneration; }

                                                                                Arcane::Text::GrammarSnapshot grammar);

    private:

        Arcane::Text::GrammarRegistry m_registry;
        std::unique_ptr<Arcane::Text::IHighlightExecutor> m_executor;

        std::string m_appliedRules;
        Theme::Palette m_appliedPalette{};
        bool m_stylesBuilt = false;
        std::uint64_t m_stylesGeneration = 0;
        std::filesystem::path m_engineDir;
        double m_nextPoll = 0.0;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextSyntaxService.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextSyntaxService.hpp"

#include "Project/ModuleBuild.hpp"
#include "Settings/AssetBrowserSettings.hpp"
#include "Settings/SyntaxThemeSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/LanguageOverrides.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Project/Project.hpp>

#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    Arcane::Diagnostic ToDiagnostic(const Arcane::Text::GrammarProblem& p)
    {
        using Kind = Arcane::Text::GrammarProblem::Kind;
        Arcane::Diagnostic d;
        d.scope = Arcane::DiagScope::Project;
        switch (p.kind)
        {
            case Kind::Invalid:
                d.severity = Arcane::DiagSeverity::Error;
                d.code = "text.grammar.invalid";
                d.detail = p.grammar.empty() ? "The file is ignored." : "Files in this language open as Plain Text until it is fixed.";
                break;
            case Kind::EmbedMissing:
                d.severity = Arcane::DiagSeverity::Warning;
                d.code = "text.grammar.embed";
                d.detail = "That embedded region draws without highlighting.";
                break;
            case Kind::RegexLimit:
                d.severity = Arcane::DiagSeverity::Warning;
                d.code = "text.grammar.regexLimit";
                d.detail = "Lines where it happens draw partly unhighlighted.";
                break;
        }
        const std::string who = p.grammar.empty() ? std::filesystem::path(p.source).filename().string() : p.grammar;
        d.message = who + (p.rulePath.empty() ? std::string() : " (" + p.rulePath + ")") + ": " + p.message;
        if (p.kind != Kind::RegexLimit && !p.source.starts_with("plugin:")) d.locator = Arcane::DiagLocator::File(p.source);
        return d;
    }

    std::filesystem::path EngineSyntaxDir() { return ModuleBuild::ExeDir() / "data" / "Syntaxes"; }

    TextSyntaxService::TextSyntaxService()
        : TextSyntaxService(std::make_unique<Arcane::Text::ThreadedHighlightExecutor>(), EngineSyntaxDir())
    {
    }

    TextSyntaxService::TextSyntaxService(std::unique_ptr<Arcane::Text::IHighlightExecutor> executor, std::filesystem::path engineDir)
        : m_executor(std::move(executor)), m_engineDir(std::move(engineDir))
    {
        m_registry.SetProblemSink([](std::string_view key, std::span<const Arcane::Text::GrammarProblem> rows) {
            std::vector<Arcane::Diagnostic> diags;
            diags.reserve(rows.size());
            for (const Arcane::Text::GrammarProblem& p : rows) diags.push_back(ToDiagnostic(p));
            Arcane::Diagnostics::Publish(key, diags);
        });
        SetProject(nullptr);
        RebuildStylesIfChanged();
    }

    TextSyntaxService::~TextSyntaxService() = default;

    void TextSyntaxService::SetProject(const Arcane::Project* project)
    {
        std::vector<Arcane::Text::GrammarSearchDir> dirs{ { m_engineDir, Arcane::Text::GrammarOrigin::Engine } };
        if (project)
        {
            dirs.push_back({ project->Root() / "Config" / "Syntaxes", Arcane::Text::GrammarOrigin::Project });
            for (const std::filesystem::path& plugin : project->ActivePluginRoots())
                dirs.push_back({ plugin / "Syntaxes", Arcane::Text::GrammarOrigin::Plugin });
        }
        m_registry.SetSearchDirs(std::move(dirs));
        m_registry.Reload();
    }

    Arcane::Text::SyntaxLimits TextSyntaxService::Limits() const { return ToSyntaxLimits(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()); }

    void TextSyntaxService::Tick(double editorClockSeconds)
    {
        m_uiScratch.SetLimits(Limits().regex);
        m_registry.PumpProblems();
        RebuildStylesIfChanged();
        if (editorClockSeconds >= m_nextPoll)
        {
            m_nextPoll = editorClockSeconds + Arcane::Settings<AssetBrowserSettings>().watchPollSeconds;   // the asset-watch cadence
            m_registry.PollChanges();
        }
    }

    void TextSyntaxService::NotifySaved(const std::filesystem::path& file) { m_registry.NotifySaved(file); }

    Arcane::Text::GrammarSnapshot TextSyntaxService::DetectFor(const std::filesystem::path& file, std::string_view firstLine) const
    {
        const std::vector<Arcane::Text::LanguageOverride> overrides =
            Arcane::Text::ParseLanguageOverrides(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().languageByExtension);
        return m_registry.Detect(file, firstLine, overrides);
    }

    std::unique_ptr<Arcane::Text::HighlightCache> TextSyntaxService::CreateCache(const Arcane::Text::IHighlightText& text,
                                                                                 Arcane::Text::GrammarSnapshot grammar)
    {
        Arcane::Text::HighlightCache::Services services;
        services.uiScratch = &m_uiScratch;
        services.executor = m_executor.get();
        services.problems = &m_registry;
        return std::make_unique<Arcane::Text::HighlightCache>(text, std::move(grammar), std::move(services), Limits());
    }

    void TextSyntaxService::RebuildStylesIfChanged()
    {
        const std::string& rules = Arcane::Settings<EditorSyntaxThemeSettings>().rules;
        const Theme::Palette& palette = Theme::Live();
        if (m_stylesBuilt && rules == m_appliedRules && std::memcmp(&palette, &m_appliedPalette, sizeof palette) == 0) return;
        m_styles = Arcane::Text::ScopeMap(m_registry.Scopes(), ActiveSyntaxRules(rules, palette));
        m_appliedRules = rules;
        m_appliedPalette = palette;
        m_stylesBuilt = true;
        ++m_stylesGeneration;
    }
}
```

In `TextDocument::Open`, after `doc->AdoptDecoded(r, decoded.encoding, decoded.readOnly);` and before `return doc;`: `doc->InitHighlight();`. That call in `Open` is the single place `InitHighlight` runs: `AdoptDecoded` itself only updates metadata and Reopen with Encoding calls it again, but the buffer, model and view are created once in `Open`, and Reopen with Encoding and Reload decode into the same `TextBuffer` (CANON TE2 #9c, TE2-17), and the cache follows them through the edit log, so the cache and the view's colour function made here live as long as the document. Definitions (`TextDocument.cpp`):

```cpp
    void TextDocument::InitHighlight()
    {
        if (!m_services.syntax)
            return;   // no highlighting (CANON A6)
        TextSyntaxService& syntax = *m_services.syntax;
        m_highlightText = std::make_unique<Arcane::Text::BufferHighlightText>(Buffer());
        m_highlight = syntax.CreateCache(*m_highlightText, syntax.DetectFor(CanonicalPath(), FirstLineForDetection()));
        m_grammarGeneration = syntax.Registry().Generation();
        View().SetRowColorRuns([this](std::uint32_t row, std::vector<ViewColorRun>& out) { return SyntaxRowColors(row, out); });
    }

    bool TextDocument::SyntaxRowColors(std::uint32_t row, std::vector<ViewColorRun>& out)
    {
        if (!m_highlight || !m_services.syntax)
            return false;
        const Arcane::Text::LineTokens* tokens = m_highlight->Line(row);   // nullptr: not ready, the row draws plain (s4.4)
        if (!tokens)
            return false;
        const Arcane::Text::Rope& text = Buffer().Text();
        const auto lineBytes = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(text.LineEnd(row) - text.LineStart(row));
        Arcane::Text::StyleLine(lineBytes, tokens, m_services.syntax->Styles(), m_spans);
        // A ViewColorRun lasts until the next run, so a default-styled span carries the text colour explicitly.
        const ImU32 plain = ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text);
        for (const Arcane::Text::StyledSpan& s : m_spans)
            out.push_back({ s.begin, s.style.hasColor ? s.style.color : plain });
        return true;   // bold/italic are carried in ScopeStyle but draw in the regular face (only JetBrains Mono Regular ships)
    }

    std::string TextDocument::FirstLineForDetection()
    {
        std::string line;
        Arcane::Text::CopyRowForTokenize(Buffer().Text(), 0, m_services.syntax->Limits().longLineMaxBytes, line);
        return line;
    }

    void TextDocument::SetLanguage(std::string_view grammarName)
    {
        if (!m_highlight || !m_services.syntax)
            return;
        if (Arcane::Text::GrammarSnapshot g = m_services.syntax->Registry().Find(grammarName))
            m_highlight->SetGrammar(std::move(g));
    }

    void TextDocument::UpdateHighlight(std::uint32_t firstVisibleRow, std::uint32_t lastVisibleRow)
    {
        if (!m_highlight || !m_services.syntax)
            return;
        TextSyntaxService& syntax = *m_services.syntax;
        if (syntax.Registry().Generation() != m_grammarGeneration)   // a grammar was reloaded (spec s4.1)
        {
            m_grammarGeneration = syntax.Registry().Generation();
            const Arcane::Text::GrammarSnapshot& current = m_highlight->Grammar();
            Arcane::Text::GrammarSnapshot next = current ? syntax.Registry().Find(current->Name()) : nullptr;
            if (!next)
                next = syntax.DetectFor(CanonicalPath(), FirstLineForDetection());
            m_highlight->SetGrammar(std::move(next));   // a no-op when the snapshot is unchanged
        }
        m_highlight->SetLimits(syntax.Limits());
        m_highlight->BeginFrame(firstVisibleRow, std::max(firstVisibleRow, lastVisibleRow));
    }

    void TextDocument::UpdateHighlightForViews()
    {
        // The primary view's visible buffer rows, from its last frame's facts (the scroll a frame
        // behind costs nothing: Line() still serves any visible row within syncCatchUpLines).
        // TE4-17 extends this to min(first) / max(last) over both views when split.
        const TextViewFacts& f = View().Facts();
        Model().SyncDisplay();
        const Arcane::Text::DisplayMap& d = Model().display;
        const std::uint32_t firstDisplay = d.BufferRowToDisplay(f.firstVisibleRow);
        const std::uint32_t lastDisplay =
            std::min(firstDisplay + std::max<std::uint32_t>(f.visibleRows, 1u) - 1u, std::max<std::uint32_t>(d.DisplayRowCount(), 1u) - 1u);
        UpdateHighlight(f.firstVisibleRow, d.DisplayRowToBuffer(lastDisplay));
    }
```

and in TE2's `TextDocument::Draw`, immediately before `m_view->Draw("##text", ...)`: `UpdateHighlightForViews();   // one BeginFrame per frame, before any view asks for rows (TE3-30)`. No `NotifySaved` call is added to `TextDocument::Save`: saving reaches the service through `TextDocumentServices::afterSave` (TE2-16 calls it after every successful `Save`/`SaveAs`; the app's lambda above calls `NotifySaved`). `TextEditorView` is not modified: colours arrive through TE2-13's `SetRowColorRuns` seam.

**Interfaces:**

The s11.2 regex-limit test needs no new product code -- TE3-2 (limits), TE3-11 (skip and report) and TE3-12 (dedupe and publish) already carry it -- so this task is its own reviewable test unit, validated by mutation in Step 2. The "find query" half is tested here at the engine level (a line-by-line `MatchScratch` scan, the shape s4.2 prescribes for find, returns `LimitHit` promptly and the scan goes on); the find bar's "stopped: pattern too complex" message belongs to TE4's `TextSearch`, which must surface `MatchStatus::LimitHit` (handed over in Produces of TE3-2).

```cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Helpers/TextHighlightFixtures.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/GrammarRegistry.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightCache.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightWorker.hpp"

#include <chrono>
#include <map>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using namespace Arcane::Test;

namespace
{
    constexpr std::string_view kCatastrophic = R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":"Evil","scope":"source.evil","files":[".evil"],
        "patterns":[{"match":"(a+)+$","scope":"invalid.evil"},{"match":"[0-9]+","scope":"constant.numeric.evil"}]})";

    std::string EvilLines(int n)
    {
        std::string s;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) s += "7 " + std::string(48, 'a') + "b 9\n";
        return s;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Regex limits: a catastrophic grammar rule is skipped and reported once; UI and worker keep running", "[text-regex][text-highlight]")
{
    std::map<std::string, std::vector<GrammarProblem>> problems;
    GrammarRegistry reg;
    reg.SetProblemSink([&](std::string_view key, std::span<const GrammarProblem> rows) {
        problems[std::string(key)].assign(rows.begin(), rows.end());
    });
    reg.RegisterPluginGrammar("tests", "Evil", std::string(kCatastrophic));
    reg.Reload();
    const GrammarSnapshot g = reg.Find("Evil");
    REQUIRE(g != nullptr);

    FakeHighlightText text(EvilLines(60));
    MatchScratch ui{ RegexLimits{ 20000, 0 } };
    ManualHighlightExecutor exec;
    HighlightCache::Services s;
    s.uiScratch = &ui;
    s.executor = &exec;
    s.problems = &reg;
    SyntaxLimits l;
    l.syncCatchUpLines = 30;   // rows 0..29 on the UI thread, the rest on the worker
    l.regex = RegexLimits{ 20000, 0 };
    HighlightCache cache(text, g, s, l);

    const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    cache.BeginFrame(0, 59);
    REQUIRE(cache.Line(20) != nullptr);
    for (int i = 0; i < 10 && cache.Frontier() < cache.RowCount(); ++i)
    {
        exec.RunAll();
        cache.BeginFrame(0, 59);
    }
    const auto elapsed = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0;
    CHECK(cache.Frontier() == cache.RowCount());
    CHECK(elapsed < std::chrono::seconds(5));   // bounded: no hang (the unbounded match takes minutes)
    CHECK(ui.LimitHits() > 0u);

    // Every line still coloured its numbers.
    REQUIRE(cache.Peek(40) != nullptr);
    CHECK(cache.Peek(40)->runs.front().scope == *reg.Scopes().Find("constant.numeric.evil"));

    reg.PumpProblems();
    REQUIRE(problems.contains("text.grammar.limit:Evil"));
    REQUIRE(problems["text.grammar.limit:Evil"].size() == 1u);   // once, though 60 lines on two threads hit it
    CHECK(problems["text.grammar.limit:Evil"][0].rulePath == "patterns[0].match");
}

TEST_CASE("Regex limits: a threaded worker survives the same rule", "[text-regex][text-worker]")
{
    GrammarRegistry reg;
    reg.RegisterPluginGrammar("tests", "Evil", std::string(kCatastrophic));
    reg.Reload();
    FakeHighlightText text(EvilLines(200));
    MatchScratch ui{ RegexLimits{ 20000, 0 } };
    ThreadedHighlightExecutor exec;
    HighlightCache::Services s;
    s.uiScratch = &ui;
    s.executor = &exec;
    s.problems = &reg;
    SyntaxLimits l;
    l.regex = RegexLimits{ 20000, 0 };
    HighlightCache cache(text, reg.Find("Evil"), s, l);
    const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(10);
    while (cache.Frontier() < cache.RowCount() && std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline)
    {
        cache.BeginFrame(0, 199);
        exec.WaitIdle();
    }
    CHECK(cache.Frontier() == cache.RowCount());
}

TEST_CASE("Regex limits: a find-style line scan with a catastrophic pattern stops each line promptly and goes on", "[text-regex]")
{
    MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{ 20000, 0 } };
    const auto re = Regex::Compile("(x+x+)+y");
    REQUIRE(re.has_value());
    const std::string line(64, 'x');
    int limitHits = 0;
    const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    for (int row = 0; row < 100; ++row)
        if (scratch.Match(**re, line, 0) == MatchStatus::LimitHit) ++limitHits;
    CHECK(limitHits == 100);
    CHECK(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0 < std::chrono::seconds(2));
    CHECK(scratch.Match(**re, "xxy", 0) == MatchStatus::Match);   // the scratch is still usable
}
```

### Task TE3-32: Measure and set the syntax budget and limit defaults (spec s4.2-s4.4, s8, s11.5; settings rule)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/SyntaxMeasureTest.cpp` (hidden tag `[.text-measure]`: never runs in the suite)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp` (six initializers), `ArcaneTests/src/SweepTextSyntaxTest.cpp` (the matching `CHECK` and `RequireDefault` lines), the inventory's six `editor.text.*` rows ("(TE3-32 measures)" -> the measured value and its rule)
- Test: the existing `[sweep][text]` cases (re-pinned to the measured values)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: everything in TE3-2..TE3-29 (the shipped grammars as the corpus)
- Produces: the measured defaults of `editor.text.tokenizeLineBudgetUs`, `syncCatchUpBudgetUs`, `highlightFrameBudgetMs`, `regexMatchLimit`, `regexDepthLimit`, `bracketScanMaxLines`; the task report records every printed number and the machine (CPU model, Release build)

Each default is computed by a fixed rule from a measurement, so the step that sets it is mechanical and the reasoning is reviewable:

| Setting | Measured | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `tokenizeLineBudgetUs` | `T64`: median of 7 runs, tokenizing one 64 KiB minified-JSON line (the densest legitimate line at the cap) with the shipped JSON grammar | `clamp(roundUp100(2 x T64), 250, 8000)` -- a legitimate capped line never goes partial |
| `syncCatchUpBudgetUs` | `T200`: for each sample corpus (JSON, HLSL, Lua, Markdown samples repeated to 2,000 lines) the median of 7 runs tokenizing 200 consecutive lines; the max over corpora | `clamp(roundUp100(1.25 x T200), 500, 4000)` -- `syncCatchUpLines` of typical lines fit in one frame's allowance |
| `highlightFrameBudgetMs` | `R`: single-thread throughput (MB/s) tokenizing a generated 30 MB JSON document end to end | `clamp(ceil(1000 x (30 / R) / 600), 2, 8)` -- the slice that colours a 30 MB file within 10 s at 60 fps (the s11.5 "Ctrl+End in 30 MB" budget) |
| `regexMatchLimit` | `M0`: the smallest value in {100k, 250k, 500k, 1M, 2.5M, 5M, 10M} at which every shipped grammar tokenizes the whole corpus (all samples + the 30 MB JSON's first 10,000 lines) with zero limit hits; `H(V)`: JIT time to fail `^(a+)+$` on 40 `a` + `b` at limit V | the smallest ladder value >= `10 x M0`; then check `H(default) <= tokenizeLineBudgetUs / 2` -- if it fails, report both numbers (do not lower the headroom silently) |
| `regexDepthLimit` | `D0`: the smallest value in {1k, 2k, 5k, 10k, 20k, 50k, 100k} at which the corpus tokenizes with zero limit hits when every grammar is compiled `RegexOptions::NoJit` (the interpreter, the only place the depth limit applies) | the smallest ladder value >= `10 x D0` |
| `bracketScanMaxLines` | `S`: lines per millisecond `FindEnclosingBrackets` scans over the 10,000-line JSON corpus from a cursor with no enclosing pair (a full scan) | `clamp(floorTo1000(S x 1 ms), 1000, 100000)` -- a cursor move never spends more than about 1 ms looking for brackets |

`roundUp100(x)` rounds up to a multiple of 100; `floorTo1000` rounds down to a multiple of 1,000.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the measurement** -- `ArcaneTests/src/Text/SyntaxMeasureTest.cpp`:

```cpp
// TE3-32: measures the syntax budgets and limits and prints the derived
// defaults (hidden tag: run by hand, in Release, from the exe dir).

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Helpers/TextShippedGrammars.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Brackets.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/StateTable.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Tokenizer.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using namespace Arcane::Test;
using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;

namespace
{
    double Us(Clock::duration d) { return std::chrono::duration<double, std::micro>(d).count(); }

    template <class F>
    double MedianUs(int runs, F&& f)
    {
        std::vector<double> t;
        for (int i = 0; i < runs; ++i)
        {
            const auto a = Clock::now();
            f();
            t.push_back(Us(Clock::now() - a));
        }
        std::sort(t.begin(), t.end());
        return t[t.size() / 2];
    }

    std::string JsonDocument(std::size_t targetBytes)
    {
        std::string s = "[\n";
        for (int i = 0; s.size() < targetBytes; ++i)
            s += "  {\"id\": " + std::to_string(i) + ", \"name\": \"item " + std::to_string(i) +
                 "\", \"tags\": [\"a\", \"b\\n\"], \"value\": -12.5e3, \"ok\": true, \"next\": null},\n";
        s += "  {}\n]";
        return s;
    }

    std::string MinifiedLine(std::size_t bytes)
    {
        std::string s = "[";
        while (s.size() < bytes) s += "{\"k\":\"v\\u0041\",\"n\":[1,2.5,-3e4,true,null]},";
        s.resize(bytes);
        return s;
    }

    // The sample's lines after its header line, repeated to `lines` lines.
    std::string Sample(std::string_view file, std::size_t lines)
    {
        std::ifstream in(RepoRoot() / "data" / "Syntaxes" / "tests" / std::string(file), std::ios::binary);
        const std::string text((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
        std::vector<std::string> body;
        std::size_t p = text.find('\n');
        while (p != std::string::npos && p + 1 < text.size())
        {
            const std::size_t q = text.find('\n', p + 1);
            body.push_back(text.substr(p + 1, (q == std::string::npos ? text.size() : q) - p - 1));
            p = q;
        }
        std::string out;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < lines && !body.empty(); ++i)
        {
            out += body[i % body.size()];
            out += '\n';
        }
        return out;
    }

    // Tokenizes every line of `text`; returns the scratch's limit hits.
    std::uint64_t TokenizeAll(const CompiledGrammar& g, std::string_view text, MatchScratch& scratch)
    {
        StateTable states;
        Tokenizer t(g, states, scratch);
        const std::uint64_t before = scratch.LimitHits();
        StateId state = StateTable::kRoot;
        std::size_t p = 0;
        while (p <= text.size())
        {
            const std::size_t q = std::min(text.find('\n', p), text.size());
            state = t.TokenizeLine(text.substr(p, q - p), state).endState;
            p = q + 1;
        }
        return scratch.LimitHits() - before;
    }

    void Print(const char* name, double measured, const char* unit, std::uint64_t derived)
    {
        std::printf("MEASURE %s measured=%.3f %s derived_default=%llu\n", name, measured, unit, static_cast<unsigned long long>(derived));
    }
}

TEST_CASE("TE3-32: measure the syntax budgets and limits", "[.text-measure]")
{
    auto& reg = ShippedGrammars().registry;
    const GrammarSnapshot json = reg.Find("JSON");
    REQUIRE(json != nullptr);
    MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{} };

    // tokenizeLineBudgetUs
    const std::string line64 = MinifiedLine(64 * 1024);
    StateTable states;
    Tokenizer jt(*json, states, scratch);
    const double t64 = MedianUs(7, [&] { (void)jt.TokenizeLine(line64, StateTable::kRoot); });
    const auto lineBudget = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::clamp(std::ceil(2.0 * t64 / 100.0) * 100.0, 250.0, 8000.0));
    Print("tokenizeLineBudgetUs", t64, "us(T64)", lineBudget);

    // syncCatchUpBudgetUs
    double t200 = 0.0;
    for (const auto& [name, file] : { std::pair{ "JSON", "syntax_test_json.json" }, std::pair{ "HLSL", "syntax_test_hlsl.hlsl" },
                                      std::pair{ "Lua", "syntax_test_lua.lua" }, std::pair{ "Markdown", "syntax_test_markdown.md" } })
    {
        const GrammarSnapshot g = reg.Find(name);
        REQUIRE(g != nullptr);
        std::string corpus = Sample(file, 200);
        t200 = std::max(t200, MedianUs(7, [&] { (void)TokenizeAll(*g, corpus, scratch); }));
    }
    const auto catchUp = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::clamp(std::ceil(1.25 * t200 / 100.0) * 100.0, 500.0, 4000.0));
    Print("syncCatchUpBudgetUs", t200, "us(T200)", catchUp);

    // highlightFrameBudgetMs
    const std::string big = JsonDocument(30u << 20);
    const auto a = Clock::now();
    (void)TokenizeAll(*json, big, scratch);
    const double seconds = Us(Clock::now() - a) / 1e6;
    const double mbps = 30.0 / seconds;
    const auto frameMs = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::clamp(std::ceil(1000.0 * (30.0 / mbps) / 600.0), 2.0, 8.0));
    Print("highlightFrameBudgetMs", mbps, "MB/s", frameMs);

    // regexMatchLimit
    std::string corpus;
    for (const char* f : { "syntax_test_json.json", "syntax_test_hlsl.hlsl", "syntax_test_lua.lua", "syntax_test_markdown.md",
                           "syntax_test_ini.ini", "syntax_test_toml.toml", "syntax_test_yaml.yaml", "syntax_test_xml.xml",
                           "syntax_test_batch.bat", "syntax_test_powershell.ps1", "syntax_test_shell.sh", "syntax_test_arcanelog.log" })
        corpus += Sample(f, 2000);
    corpus += big.substr(0, big.find('\n', 1u << 20));
    const std::uint32_t ladder[] = { 100000, 250000, 500000, 1000000, 2500000, 5000000, 10000000 };
    std::uint32_t m0 = 0;
    for (const std::uint32_t v : ladder)
    {
        MatchScratch s{ RegexLimits{ v, 0 } };
        std::uint64_t hits = 0;
        for (const std::string& name : reg.Names()) hits += TokenizeAll(*reg.Find(name), corpus, s);
        if (hits == 0) { m0 = v; break; }
    }
    REQUIRE(m0 != 0u);
    std::uint32_t matchDefault = ladder[std::size(ladder) - 1];
    for (const std::uint32_t v : ladder)
        if (v >= 10ull * m0) { matchDefault = v; break; }
    const auto evil = Regex::Compile("^(a+)+$");
    REQUIRE(evil.has_value());
    MatchScratch es{ RegexLimits{ matchDefault, 0 } };
    const std::string evilSubject = std::string(40, 'a') + 'b';
    const double hitUs = MedianUs(7, [&] { (void)es.Match(**evil, evilSubject, 0); });
    Print("regexMatchLimit", static_cast<double>(m0), "M0", matchDefault);
    std::printf("MEASURE regexMatchLimit H(default)=%.1f us, tokenizeLineBudgetUs/2=%.1f us -> %s\n", hitUs, lineBudget / 2.0,
                hitUs <= lineBudget / 2.0 ? "ok" : "CONFLICT (report both numbers)");

    // regexDepthLimit (interpreter only)
    const std::uint32_t depthLadder[] = { 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, 20000, 50000, 100000 };
    std::uint32_t d0 = 0;
    {
        // Recompile the shipped grammars without JIT through a second registry reading the same files.
        // (CompileGrammarRules always JITs, so the interpreter path is measured on the grammar regexes
        // individually: every rule regex of every grammar, matched across the corpus lines.)
        std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const Regex>> interp;
        for (const std::string& name : reg.Names())
        {
            const GrammarRules& r = reg.Find(name)->Rules();
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < r.RuleCount(); ++i)
                for (const auto& re : { r.Rule(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i)).match, r.Rule(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i)).end,
                                        r.Rule(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i)).escape })
                    if (re)
                        if (auto x = Regex::Compile(re->Pattern(), RegexOptions::Ucp | RegexOptions::NoJit)) interp.push_back(*x);
        }
        std::vector<std::string_view> lines;
        for (std::size_t p = 0; p < corpus.size();)
        {
            const std::size_t q = std::min(corpus.find('\n', p), corpus.size());
            lines.push_back(std::string_view(corpus).substr(p, q - p));
            p = q + 1;
        }
        for (const std::uint32_t v : depthLadder)
        {
            MatchScratch s{ RegexLimits{ 100000000, v } };
            std::uint64_t hits = 0;
            for (const auto& re : interp)
                for (const std::string_view l : lines)
                    if (s.Match(*re, l, 0) == MatchStatus::LimitHit) ++hits;
            if (hits == 0) { d0 = v; break; }
        }
    }
    REQUIRE(d0 != 0u);
    std::uint64_t depthDefault = 10000000;
    for (const std::uint32_t v : depthLadder)
        if (v >= 10ull * d0) { depthDefault = v; break; }
    if (depthDefault == 10000000) depthDefault = std::min<std::uint64_t>(10ull * d0, 10000000);
    Print("regexDepthLimit", static_cast<double>(d0), "D0", depthDefault);

    // bracketScanMaxLines
    const std::string jsonLines = big.substr(0, [&] { std::size_t p = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) p = big.find('\n', p) + 1; return p; }());
    const Rope rope = Rope::FromUtf8("x\n" + jsonLines);   // the cursor on row 0 sees no enclosing pair: a full scan
    const TokenLookup none = [](std::uint32_t) -> const LineTokens* { return nullptr; };
    const std::uint64_t lastRow = rope.LineCount() - 1;
    const double scanUs = MedianUs(7, [&] { (void)FindEnclosingBrackets(rope, rope.LineStart(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(lastRow)), json->Rules(), none, 0, 0); });
    const double linesPerMs = static_cast<double>(lastRow) / (scanUs / 1000.0);
    const auto scanDefault = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::clamp(std::floor(linesPerMs / 1000.0) * 1000.0, 1000.0, 100000.0));
    Print("bracketScanMaxLines", linesPerMs, "lines/ms", scanDefault);
}
```

(The bracket scan starts at the last row and walks up to the document's outer `[` in the first JSON row -- every other bracket is balanced -- then `FindMatchingBracket` walks forward from it to the end without finding the truncated document's `]`: the whole range twice, the worst case the bound exists for. `S` counts each line once for two passes, so the derived bound is conservative.)

**Spec gaps, conflicts and things I could not place:**
1. **Detection order (s4.1) -- resolved, a spec amendment (CANON D8; controller ruling).** The spec lists ext -> firstLine -> the remembered per-extension choice. Taken literally, the picker's memory could never correct an extension that a grammar's `files` claims (e.g. `.cfg` -> INI), which is the reason it exists. TE3-12 consults the remembered choice **first** (order: remembered choice -> `files` -> `firstLine` -> Plain Text), as the controller ruled; s4.1 is amended accordingly.
2. **Plugin-registered grammars (s4.1).** Arcane has no editor-plugin API for in-process registration today; TE3-12 implements both a data seam (each active plugin root's `Syntaxes/` directory) and an in-process `RegisterPluginGrammar`, but nothing outside the tests calls the latter yet.
3. **Italic/bold syntax styles (s4.5).** Carried through `ScopeStyle`, but only JetBrains Mono Regular ships (`premake5.lua:1129`), so TE3-30 draws them in the regular face; shipping italic/bold faces is a font task for TE2/TE6.
4. **`symbols` (s4.1/s9).** Validated and compiled (`GrammarRules::Symbols()`); the `ISymbolProvider` that consumes them is s9 and not in TE3's brief -- TE4 owns it (CANON A7).
5. **Find-query limit message (s4.2/s11.2).** TE3-31 proves the engine half; the find bar / vim message line wording belongs to TE4's `TextSearch` and TE5c.
6. **Per-entry `bufferVersion`/`grammarVersion` (s4.4).** Realized at cache level (every ready row is valid at the cache's synced version and grammar) and per worker result (checked on arrival) rather than stored in every row -- equivalent, because no row is ever valid at a version other than the cache's; stated in TE3-14 for the reviewer.
7. **Grammar expressiveness limits found while writing the v1 grammars:** no back-references from `end` into `begin` captures (Lua long brackets are listed per level 0-2; shell heredoc bodies and YAML block-scalar bodies are not recognised), no `include`/repository (rules are repeated where needed). TE4 code declares no numeric constants: tunables are `TextSettings` fields, UI metrics are derived from `ImGui::GetFontSize()` / `LineHeight()` inline, and tables use `std::to_array` (no count literal).

```cpp
enum class Bias : std::uint8_t { Left, Right };   struct Anchor { ByteOffset offset; Bias bias; };
class AnchorSet { using Id = std::uint32_t; Id Add(Anchor); void Remove(Id); bool Contains(Id) const; Anchor Get(Id) const;
                  void Set(Id, Anchor); std::size_t Size() const; void Clear(); template<class F> void ForEach(F&&) const; /* f(Id, Anchor) */ };
struct EditShift { ByteOffset begin, end, newLength; };           // pre-edit coordinates

enum class TransactionKind { Other, Typing, Deleting };

                   Edit(std::span<const EditOp>); EndTransaction(const SelectionSet&); bool Undo(SelectionSet&); bool Redo(SelectionSet&);
                   CanUndo(); CanRedo(); BreakUndoGroup(); EditsSince(version); EditLogCovers(version);
                   RegisterAnchors(AnchorSet&); UnregisterAnchors(AnchorSet&); AddObserver(EditObserver&); RemoveObserver(EditObserver&);
                   bool ConvertLineEndings(Eol, const SelectionSet&); void ReloadExternal(std::string, EolMap, const SelectionSet&);

struct Selection { std::uint32_t id; ByteOffset anchor, head; std::optional<std::uint32_t> goalColumn; bool Empty() const; };
class SelectionSet { All(); Size(); Primary() /* newest id */; PrimaryIndex(); AllocateId(); Add(anchor, head, goal) -> id;
                     SetSingle(ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head); Replace(std::vector<Selection>); ApplyEdits(std::span<const EditShift>); operator==; };
struct FoldRange { std::uint32_t headerRow, lastRow; };   enum class FoldSource { Indent, Marker, Manual };
class FoldModel { FoldModel(); static IndentColumns; static IsBlank; static IndentRegionAt(const Rope&, row, tabSize) -> std::optional<FoldRange>;
                  static IndentRegions(const Rope&, tabSize); bool Fold(const Rope&, FoldRange, FoldSource); bool Unfold(const Rope&, row);
                  bool UnfoldInnermost(const Rope&, row); void UnfoldAll(); bool IsFoldedAt(const Rope&, header) const;
                  std::vector<FoldRange> Folded(const Rope&) const; void OnEdits(std::span<const EditShift>); void Prune(const Rope&); Count(); };
```

Resolved by CANON (no open reconciliation notes remain for this chunk):
- **One command layer.** TE2's view runs every command through `Text::TextCommands(m_model->buffer, m_model->selections, MakeContext())`, where `MakeContext()` calls the provider installed with `SetEditContextProvider` (default `DefaultEditContext`, TE2-13). TE4-18 adds the model's indentation to `DefaultEditContext`; TE4-24 installs `TextDocument::MakeEditContext` as every view's provider; TE4-22 puts a filter before the view's `InsertText` / `Backspace` calls.
- **`TextModel` over a shared buffer** is TE2-11's shape and `ReopenWithEncoding` into the same buffer is TE2-15's (CANON B7); TE4-17 only adds the split.
- **The syntax service** reaches the document as `TextDocumentServices::syntax` (a pointer, null = no highlighting); TE4 code reads `m_services.syntax` and null-checks it.
- **The display map** is TE1's (default constructor + `SetFolds`); `TextModel::SyncDisplay()` keeps it current (TE2-11 body; TE4-12 replaces the body with `Text::SyncDisplay(folds, display, buffer.Text())`).

```cpp
using namespace Arcane::Editor;

TEST_CASE("TextDocument context: name, specificity, overlap", "[text-actions]")
{
    CHECK(std::string_view(ActionContextName(ActionContext::TextDocument)) == "Text document");
    CHECK(ContextSpecificity(ActionContext::TextDocument) == 2);
    CHECK(ContextSpecificity(ActionContext::TextDocument) > ContextSpecificity(ActionContext::Document));
    CHECK(ContextSpecificity(ActionContext::TextDocument) < ContextSpecificity(ActionContext::Text));
    CHECK(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::Global));
    CHECK(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::Global, ActionContext::TextDocument));
    CHECK(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::Document));
    CHECK(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::Document, ActionContext::TextDocument));
    CHECK(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::TextDocument));
    CHECK_FALSE(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::Text));       // a field's Enter/Escape never meets a text row
    CHECK_FALSE(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::Outliner));   // F2 rename vs F2 next bookmark
    CHECK_FALSE(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::Graph));
    CHECK_FALSE(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::AssetBrowser));
    CHECK(UsesImGuiRoute(ActionContext::TextDocument));
}

TEST_CASE("Key chords: a bare [ is a labelled key; Ctrl+[ and Ctrl+Shift+[ parse and round-trip", "[text-actions]")
{
    const auto outdent = ParseKeyChord("Ctrl+[");
    REQUIRE(outdent.has_value());
    CHECK(outdent->ctrl);
    CHECK(outdent->type == KeyType::Labelled);
    CHECK(outdent->key == '[');
    CHECK(FormatKeyChord(*outdent) == "Ctrl+[");
    const auto fold = ParseKeyChord("Ctrl+Shift+[");
    REQUIRE(fold.has_value());
    CHECK(fold->shift);
    CHECK(fold->key == '[');
    CHECK(FormatKeyChord(*fold) == "Ctrl+Shift+[");
    REQUIRE(ParseKeyChord("[").has_value());
    CHECK(ParseKeyChord("[")->key == '[');
    CHECK(ParseKeyChord("[KeyW]")->type == KeyType::Physical);   // a physical name is still one
    CHECK_FALSE(ParseKeyChord("[KeyQQ]").has_value());
    CHECK(FormatKeyChord(*ParseKeyChord("Ctrl+]")) == "Ctrl+]");
    // The Shortcuts page's capture of Ctrl + the BracketLeft scancode (47) formats to text that parses back.
    const KeyChord physical{ true, false, false, false, KeyType::Physical, 47 };
    const KeyChord labelled = ToKeyType(physical, KeyType::Labelled);
    const auto reparsed = ParseKeyChord(FormatKeyChord(labelled));
    REQUIRE(reparsed.has_value());
    CHECK(*reparsed == labelled);
}

TEST_CASE("TextDocument rows fire while the text view takes text input; a panel row does not", "[text-actions]")
{
    Arcane::CVarRegistry reg;
    EditorActions actions(reg);
    actions.Register({ "t.lineStart", "Line Start", ActionContext::TextDocument, "Home" });
    actions.Register({ "t.next", "Next Asset", ActionContext::AssetBrowser, "Down" });
    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(800, 600);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr; int w = 0, h = 0;
    io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
    bool home = false, down = false;
    const auto frame = [&](bool typing, bool capture)
    {
        Arcane::InputSnapshot s;
        ActionFrameInput in; in.snap = &s; in.captureLive = capture; in.dt = 1.0 / 60.0;
        actions.BeginFrame(in);
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        io.WantTextInput = typing;   // what the text view's PlatformImeData.WantTextInput makes it
        home = actions.Pressed("t.lineStart");
        down = actions.Pressed("t.next");
        ImGui::Render();
    };
    frame(true, false);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_Home, true);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_DownArrow, true);
    frame(true, false);
    CHECK(home);          // the text document is the typist: Home is navigation, never text
    CHECK_FALSE(down);    // an Asset Browser row keeps the typing gate
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_Home, false);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_DownArrow, false);
    frame(false, false);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_DownArrow, true);
    frame(false, false);
    CHECK(down);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_DownArrow, false);
    frame(false, true);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_Home, true);
    frame(true, true);
    CHECK_FALSE(home);    // an Input Actions rebind capture owns the keyboard
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
}
```

```cpp
    const char* ActionContextName(ActionContext c) noexcept
    {
        switch (c)
        {
        case ActionContext::Global:        return "Global";
        case ActionContext::Viewport:      return "Viewport";
        case ActionContext::Graph:         return "Graph";
        case ActionContext::AssetBrowser:  return "Asset Browser";
        case ActionContext::Outliner:      return "Outliner";
        case ActionContext::Inspector:     return "Inspector";
        case ActionContext::Text:          return "Text field";
        case ActionContext::Console:       return "Console";
        case ActionContext::InputDocument: return "Input Actions";
        case ActionContext::Document:      return "Document";
        case ActionContext::TextDocument:  return "Text document";
        }
        return "?";
    }

    int ContextSpecificity(ActionContext c) noexcept
    {
        switch (c)
        {
        case ActionContext::Global:       return 0;
        case ActionContext::Document:     return 1;
        case ActionContext::TextDocument: return 2;   // alongside the panels (text editor spec s7.2)
        case ActionContext::Text:         return 3;
        default:                          return 2;
        }
    }

    bool ContextsOverlap(ActionContext a, ActionContext b) noexcept
    {
        if (a == ActionContext::Text || b == ActionContext::Text) return a == b;   // fires only while typing; Global never does
        if (a == b || a == ActionContext::Global || b == ActionContext::Global) return true;
        const auto docHosted = [](ActionContext c)
        {
            return c == ActionContext::Graph || c == ActionContext::Inspector || c == ActionContext::InputDocument
                || c == ActionContext::TextDocument;
        };
        return (a == ActionContext::Document && docHosted(b)) || (b == ActionContext::Document && docHosted(a));
    }
```

`EditorActions.cpp:532-543` -- `Live` exempts TextDocument rows from the typing gate:

```cpp
    bool EditorActions::Live(const State& s, bool imguiRoute) const
    {
        if (m_listening) return false;
        const ActionContext c = s.desc.context;
        if (c == ActionContext::Text) return true;
        if (c == ActionContext::Global || c == ActionContext::Viewport)
            return EditorShortcutsLive(m_frame.playMode, m_frame.wantCaptureKeyboard, m_frame.captureLive,
                                       c == ActionContext::Viewport, m_frame.viewportActive);
        if (m_frame.captureLive) return false;
        // The text document IS the typist (TE4-1, text editor spec s7.2): its
        // view sets WantTextInput to receive characters, and its rows are
        // navigation/editing chords; the unmodified ones use non-printing keys
        // only (Home, Tab, F3), so they never steal a typed character. The
        // caller (DispatchTextActions) runs them only while the view has focus.
        if (c == ActionContext::TextDocument) return true;
        const bool typing = imguiRoute && ImGui::GetCurrentContext() ? ImGui::GetIO().WantTextInput : m_frame.wantTextInput;
        return s.chord.ctrl || s.chord.alt || s.chord.super || !typing;
    }
```

```cpp
            unsigned char* px = nullptr; int w = 0, h = 0;
            io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
        }
        ~GuiRig() { ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx); ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev); }
    };
}

{
    const std::map<std::string_view, std::string_view> spec = {
        { "text.wordLeft", "Ctrl+Left" }, { "text.wordRight", "Ctrl+Right" },
        { "text.selectWordLeft", "Ctrl+Shift+Left" }, { "text.selectWordRight", "Ctrl+Shift+Right" },
        { "text.lineStart", "Home" }, { "text.lineEnd", "End" },
        { "text.documentStart", "Ctrl+Home" }, { "text.documentEnd", "Ctrl+End" },
        { "text.pageUp", "PageUp" }, { "text.pageDown", "PageDown" },
        { "text.addNextMatch", "Ctrl+D" }, { "text.selectAllMatches", "Alt+F3" },
        { "text.splitSelectionIntoLines", "Ctrl+Shift+L" },
        { "text.addCursorAbove", "Ctrl+Alt+Up" }, { "text.addCursorBelow", "Ctrl+Alt+Down" },
        { "text.selectLine", "Ctrl+L" }, { "text.duplicateLine", "Ctrl+Shift+D" }, { "text.deleteLine", "Ctrl+Shift+K" },
        { "text.moveLineUp", "Alt+Up" }, { "text.moveLineDown", "Alt+Down" },
        { "text.indent", "Tab" }, { "text.outdent", "Shift+Tab" }, { "text.indentAlt", "Ctrl+]" }, { "text.outdentAlt", "Ctrl+[" },
        { "text.toggleLineComment", "Ctrl+/" }, { "text.toggleBlockComment", "Ctrl+Shift+/" }, { "text.joinLines", "Ctrl+J" },
        { "text.find", "Ctrl+F" }, { "text.replace", "Ctrl+H" }, { "text.findNext", "F3" }, { "text.findPrevious", "Shift+F3" },
        { "text.goToLine", "Ctrl+G" }, { "text.fold", "Ctrl+Shift+[" }, { "text.unfold", "Ctrl+Shift+]" },
        { "text.goToMatchingBracket", "Ctrl+M" },
        { "text.toggleBookmark", "Ctrl+F2" }, { "text.nextBookmark", "F2" }, { "text.previousBookmark", "Shift+F2" },
    };
    std::set<std::string_view> ids;
    std::size_t index = 0;
    for (const TextActionRow& row : kTextActionTable)
    {
        INFO(row.desc.id);
        CHECK(row.desc.id.starts_with("text."));
        CHECK(row.desc.context == ActionContext::TextDocument);
        CHECK_FALSE(row.desc.displayName.empty());
        CHECK(ids.insert(row.desc.id).second);
        CHECK(static_cast<std::size_t>(row.action) == index);            // the enum IS the table order
        CHECK(FindTextAction(row.action) == &row);
        const auto chord = ParseKeyChord(row.desc.defaultChord);
        REQUIRE(chord.has_value());
        CHECK_FALSE(ReservedChordReason(*chord).has_value());
        const bool unboundByDesign = row.desc.id == "text.convertLineEndings";
        CHECK(chord->Bound() == !unboundByDesign);
        if (const auto it = spec.find(row.desc.id); it != spec.end())
            CHECK(FormatKeyChord(*chord) == FormatKeyChord(*ParseKeyChord(it->second)));
        ++index;
    }
    CHECK(kTextActionTable.size() == static_cast<std::size_t>(TextAction::Count));
    for (const auto& [id, chord] : spec) { INFO(id); CHECK(ids.contains(id)); }
    for (const EditorActionDesc& d : kEditorActionTable) { INFO(d.id); CHECK_FALSE(ids.contains(d.id)); }
}

TEST_CASE("Text action table: registered with the editor's table, nothing in conflict, no undesigned same-context overlap", "[text-actions]")
{
    Arcane::CVarRegistry reg;
    EditorActions actions(reg);
    RegisterEditorActions(actions);
    for (const TextActionRow& row : kTextActionTable)
    {
        INFO(row.desc.id);
        CHECK_FALSE(reg.Find("editor.keys." + std::string(row.desc.id)).IsStale());
        CHECK(actions.ConflictsOf(row.desc.id).empty());
    }
    for (const TextActionRow& a : kTextActionTable)
        for (const TextActionRow& b : kTextActionTable)
        {
            if (a.desc.id >= b.desc.id) continue;
            const auto ca = ParseKeyChord(a.desc.defaultChord), cb = ParseKeyChord(b.desc.defaultChord);
            INFO(a.desc.id << " vs " << b.desc.id);
            CHECK_FALSE(SameKey(*ca, *cb));
        }
}

TEST_CASE("Text action table: Ctrl+D is Add Next Match in a focused text document and edit.duplicate elsewhere (spec s7 item 3)", "[text-actions]")
{
    Arcane::CVarRegistry reg;
    EditorActions actions(reg);
    RegisterEditorActions(actions);
    GuiRig gui;
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    bool addNext = false, duplicate = false, lineStart = false, frameAll = false;
    const auto frame = [&](std::initializer_list<std::uint32_t> sc, bool textFocused)
    {
        const Arcane::InputSnapshot s = Snap(sc);
        ActionFrameInput in; in.snap = &s; in.dt = 1.0 / 60.0;
        actions.BeginFrame(in);
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        if (textFocused) actions.MarkContextActive(ActionContext::TextDocument);   // what DispatchTextActions does (TE4-24)
        addNext = actions.Pressed("text.addNextMatch");
        duplicate = actions.Pressed("edit.duplicate");
        lineStart = actions.Pressed("text.lineStart");
        frameAll = actions.Pressed("editor.view.frameAll");
        ImGui::Render();
    };
    const auto ctrlD = [&](bool down)
    {
        io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Ctrl, down);
        io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_LeftCtrl, down);
        io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_D, down);
    };
    frame({}, true);
    ctrlD(true);
    frame({ Keys::kScanLCtrl, Keys::ScanLetter('D') }, true);
    CHECK(addNext);
    CHECK_FALSE(duplicate);        // shadowed by specificity, as graph.duplicate shadows it in the graph
    ctrlD(false);
    frame({}, false);
    frame({}, false);              // two frames: the context bit ages out (now | prev)
    ctrlD(true);
    frame({ Keys::kScanLCtrl, Keys::ScanLetter('D') }, false);
    CHECK(duplicate);              // no text document focused: Duplicate fires
    ctrlD(false);
    frame({}, true);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_Home, true);
    frame({ Keys::kScanHome }, true);
    CHECK(lineStart);
    CHECK_FALSE(frameAll);         // Home in a text document never frames the scene
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_Home, false);
    CHECK(actions.ConflictsOf("text.addNextMatch").empty());   // both default: a designed shadow, not a conflict
    CHECK(actions.ConflictsOf("text.lineStart").empty());
}
```

```cpp
// TE4-3 (spec s8): the s8 list is the contract -- every editor.text.* name it
// lists is a registered Editor preference; the budgets and limits are Dev rows;
// the spec-fixed defaults hold; TE4's own six rows have their defaults.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include <Arcane/Config/CVarRegistry.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <type_traits>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane;

namespace
{
    std::int64_t AsInteger(const CVarValue& v)
    {
        switch (v.type)
        {
        case CVarType::Int32:  return v.AsInt32();
        case CVarType::UInt32: return static_cast<std::int64_t>(v.AsUInt32());
        case CVarType::Int64:  return v.AsInt64();
        case CVarType::UInt64: return static_cast<std::int64_t>(v.AsUInt64());
        default: FAIL("not an integer cvar"); return 0;
        }
    }

    std::string MissingOf(std::span<const std::string_view> fields, std::string_view prefix)
    {
        std::string missing;
        for (std::string_view field : fields)
        {
            const std::string name = std::string(prefix) + std::string(field);
            if (!CVarRegistry::Get().Describe(name)) missing += "  " + name + "\n";
        }
        return missing;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// TE4-4 (spec s4.2, s5.2): find queries compile once on the PCRE2 wrapper --
// plain text is escaped, case and whole word are flags, a pattern that can
// match a line break is routed to the multi-line path.

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    RegexLimits Limits() { RegexLimits l; l.matchLimit = 1000000; l.depthLimit = 100000; return l; }
    SearchQuery Q(std::string text, bool regex = false, bool caseSensitive = false, bool wholeWord = false)
    {
        SearchQuery q; q.text = std::move(text); q.regex = regex; q.caseSensitive = caseSensitive; q.wholeWord = wholeWord;
        return q;
    }
    bool Matches(const CompiledQuery& q, std::string_view subject, std::size_t* at = nullptr)
    {
        MatchScratch m(Limits());
        if (m.Match(*q.regex, subject, 0) != MatchStatus::Match) return false;
        std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
        if (at && m.Group(0, b, e)) *at = b;
        return true;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch: a plain query is escaped, so metacharacters match themselves", "[text-search]")
{
    CHECK(TextSearch::EscapeLiteral("a.b*c(d)[e]{f}|g?h+i^j$k\\l") == "a\\.b\\*c\\(d\\)\\[e\\]\\{f\\}\\|g\\?h\\+i\\^j\\$k\\\\l");
    const CompiledQuery q = TextSearch::Compile(Q("a.b"), "");
    REQUIRE(q.Valid());
    CHECK(q.error.empty());
    CHECK(Matches(q, "xa.b"));
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(q, "axb"));
    CHECK_FALSE(q.multiline);
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch: case sensitivity is a compile flag for plain and regex queries", "[text-search]")
{
    CHECK(Matches(TextSearch::Compile(Q("Foo"), ""), "foo"));
    const CompiledQuery cs = TextSearch::Compile(Q("Foo", false, true), "");
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(cs, "foo"));
    CHECK(Matches(cs, "Foo"));
    CHECK(Matches(TextSearch::Compile(Q("F.O", true), ""), "fxo"));
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(TextSearch::Compile(Q("F.O", true, true), ""), "fxo"));
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch: whole word uses the grammar's word class plus non-ASCII letters and digits", "[text-search]")
{
    const CompiledQuery q = TextSearch::Compile(Q("foo", false, true, true), "A-Za-z0-9_");
    REQUIRE(q.Valid());
    std::size_t at = 0;
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(q, "foobar"));
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(q, "_foo"));
    CHECK(Matches(q, "(foo)", &at));
    CHECK(at == 1);
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(q, "\xC3\xA9" "foo"));                  // an e-acute before it is a word character
    CHECK(Matches(q, "foo-bar"));                                // '-' is not a word character here...
    const CompiledQuery dash = TextSearch::Compile(Q("foo", false, true, true), "A-Za-z0-9_\\-");
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(dash, "foo-bar"));                       // ...but is in a grammar that says so
    const CompiledQuery alt = TextSearch::Compile(Q("a|b", true, true, true), "");
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(alt, "ab"));                             // the boundary wraps the whole alternation
    CHECK(Matches(alt, "a b"));
    CHECK(TextSearch::WordClass("") == "[A-Za-z0-9_\\p{L}\\p{N}]");
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch: a pattern that can match a line break takes the multi-line path", "[text-search]")
{
    for (std::string_view p : { "a\\nb", "\\r", "\\R", "x\\x0Ay", "\\x{a}", "\\x{000D}", "\\cJ", "\\012", "(?s)a.b", "(?is:a.b)", "a\nb" })
    {
        INFO(p);
        CHECK(TextSearch::PatternNeedsMultiline(p));
    }
    for (std::string_view p : { "a\\\\nb", "\\s+", "[^a]+", "(?i)a.b", "(?-s)a.b", "\\x41", "\\N", "abc" })
    {
        INFO(p);
        CHECK_FALSE(TextSearch::PatternNeedsMultiline(p));
    }
    CHECK(TextSearch::Compile(Q("a\\nb", true), "").multiline);
    CHECK_FALSE(TextSearch::Compile(Q("a\\nb"), "").multiline);   // plain text: a backslash and an n
    CHECK(TextSearch::Compile(Q("a\nb"), "").multiline);          // plain text with a real line break (a pasted selection)
    SearchQuery forced = Q("abc");
    forced.forceMultiline = true;                                 // vim \_s / \%^ (TE5c)
    CHECK(TextSearch::Compile(forced, "").multiline);
}

    CHECK_FALSE(empty.Valid());

{
    SearchQuery q = Q("x");
    q.scope = { { 10, 20 }, { 0, 5 }, { 4, 8 }, { 30, 30 }, { 20, 22 } };
    const CompiledQuery c = TextSearch::Compile(q, "");
    REQUIRE(c.scope.size() == 2);
    CHECK((c.scope[0].begin == 0 && c.scope[0].end == 8));
    CHECK((c.scope[1].begin == 10 && c.scope[1].end == 22));
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// TextSearch (text editor spec s4.2, s3.2, s9; TE4-4..6): find queries
// compiled once on TE3's PCRE2 wrapper, run against an immutable RopeSnapshot.
// Two paths (spec s4.2 "Contiguous input"):
//  - line by line, for every pattern that cannot match a line break: each line
//    is copied into a reused scratch string; a line longer than the window is
//    matched in overlapping windows with lookbehind context;
//  - multi-line, when the pattern can match a line break (or vim forced it): a
//    materialized copy of the snapshot, refused above multilineMaxBytes.
// Matches are byte ranges of ONE snapshot and are never anchors (spec s3.2):
// callers recompute them for the next version.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp"

#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct SearchQuery
    {
        std::string text;
        bool regex = false;
        bool caseSensitive = false;
        bool wholeWord = false;
        bool forceMultiline = false;      // vim's \_x, \%^, \%$ (TE5c): always the multi-line path
        std::vector<ByteRange> scope;     // in-selection: a match must lie inside one range; empty = whole document
    };

    struct CompiledQuery
    {
        std::shared_ptr<const Regex> regex;   // null = an empty or an invalid query
        bool multiline = false;
        std::vector<ByteRange> scope;         // sorted, disjoint, non-empty
        std::string pattern;                  // the PCRE2 source that was compiled
        std::string error;                    // the compile error; "" for a valid or an empty query
        [[nodiscard]] bool Valid() const noexcept { return regex != nullptr; }
    };

    namespace TextSearch
    {
        // Every PCRE2 metacharacter backslash-escaped: plain text matches itself.
        [[nodiscard]] std::string EscapeLiteral(std::string_view text);
        // True when the pattern names a line break (\n \r \R \v, \x0a / \x{d}, \cJ, \012, a literal LF/CR)
        // or turns on dot-all ((?s)). \s and negated classes do NOT count: on the line path they simply
        // never see a line break, which is what a find-bar user expects.
        [[nodiscard]] bool PatternNeedsMultiline(std::string_view pcrePattern);
        // "[<wordChars>\p{L}\p{N}]": the grammar's word characters (vim's iskeyword, spec s6.5/s11.3)
        // plus every non-ASCII letter and digit. Empty wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_".
        [[nodiscard]] std::string WordClass(std::string_view wordChars);
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<ByteRange> NormalizeScope(std::vector<ByteRange> scope);
        [[nodiscard]] CompiledQuery Compile(const SearchQuery& query, std::string_view wordChars);
    }
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

namespace Arcane::Text::TextSearch
{
    namespace
    {
        bool HexIsLineBreak(std::string_view digits)
        {
            if (digits.empty()) return false;
            unsigned value = 0;
            for (const char c : digits)
            {
                const int d = (c >= '0' && c <= '9') ? c - '0'
                            : (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') ? c - 'a' + 10
                            : (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') ? c - 'A' + 10 : -1;
                if (d < 0) return false;
                value = value * 16 + static_cast<unsigned>(d);
                if (value > 0x10FFFF) return false;
            }
            return value == 0x0A || value == 0x0D;
        }
    }

    std::string EscapeLiteral(std::string_view text)
    {
        std::string out;
        out.reserve(text.size() * 2);
        for (const char c : text)
        {
            switch (c)
            {
            case '\\': case '^': case '$': case '.': case '|': case '?': case '*': case '+':
            case '(': case ')': case '[': case ']': case '{': case '}':
                out.push_back('\\');
                break;
            default:
                break;
            }
            out.push_back(c);
        }
        return out;
    }

    bool PatternNeedsMultiline(std::string_view p)
    {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); ++i)
        {
            const char c = p[i];
            if (c == '\n' || c == '\r') return true;                 // a literal line break in the pattern
            if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < p.size())
            {
                const char e = p[i + 1];
                if (e == 'n' || e == 'r' || e == 'R' || e == 'v') return true;   // \v: PCRE2 vertical space includes LF
                if (e == 'x')
                {
                    if (i + 2 < p.size() && p[i + 2] == '{')
                    {
                        const std::size_t close = p.find('}', i + 3);
                        if (close != std::string_view::npos && HexIsLineBreak(p.substr(i + 3, close - (i + 3)))) return true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        std::size_t n = 0;
                        while (n < 2 && i + 2 + n < p.size() && std::isxdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(p[i + 2 + n]))) ++n;
                        if (HexIsLineBreak(p.substr(i + 2, n))) return true;
                    }
                }
                if (e == 'c' && i + 2 < p.size())
                {
                    const char k = p[i + 2];
                    if (k == 'J' || k == 'j' || k == 'M' || k == 'm') return true;
                }
                if (e == '0' && (p.substr(i + 1, 3) == "012" || p.substr(i + 1, 3) == "015")) return true;
                ++i;   // the escaped character is consumed
                continue;
            }
            if (c == '(' && i + 1 < p.size() && p[i + 1] == '?')
            {
                for (std::size_t j = i + 2; j < p.size(); ++j)
                {
                    const char f = p[j];
                    if (f == 's') return true;                       // (?s) / (?is: -- dot matches a line break
                    if (f == '-' || f == ')' || f == ':') break;     // (?-s) turns it off; the flag list ended
                    if (!std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(f)) && f != '^') break;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    std::string WordClass(std::string_view wordChars)
    {
        const std::string_view chars = wordChars.empty() ? std::string_view("A-Za-z0-9_") : wordChars;
        return "[" + std::string(chars) + "\\p{L}\\p{N}]";
    }

    std::vector<ByteRange> NormalizeScope(std::vector<ByteRange> scope)
    {
        std::erase_if(scope, [](const ByteRange& r) { return r.end <= r.begin; });
        std::sort(scope.begin(), scope.end(), [](const ByteRange& a, const ByteRange& b) { return a.begin < b.begin; });
        std::vector<ByteRange> out;
        for (const ByteRange& r : scope)
        {
            if (!out.empty() && r.begin <= out.back().end) out.back().end = std::max(out.back().end, r.end);
            else out.push_back(r);
        }
        return out;
    }

    CompiledQuery Compile(const SearchQuery& q, std::string_view wordChars)
    {
        CompiledQuery out;
        out.scope = NormalizeScope(q.scope);
        if (q.text.empty()) return out;                              // empty: invalid, no error to show
        std::string body = q.regex ? q.text : EscapeLiteral(q.text);
        out.multiline = q.forceMultiline || PatternNeedsMultiline(body);
        if (q.wholeWord)
        {
            const std::string k = WordClass(wordChars);
            body = "(?<!" + k + ")(?:" + body + ")(?!" + k + ")";
        }
        RegexOptions options = RegexOptions::None;
        if (!q.caseSensitive) options = options | RegexOptions::Caseless;
        if (out.multiline) options = options | RegexOptions::Multiline;   // PCRE2_MULTILINE on the materialized copy
        auto compiled = Regex::Compile(body, options);
        out.pattern = std::move(body);
        if (compiled) out.regex = std::move(*compiled);
        else out.error = compiled.error().message.empty() ? std::string("invalid pattern") : compiled.error().message;
        return out;
    }
}
```

```cpp
}

    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(Snap("ab\ncab\nab"), Q("ab$", true), Lim())) == Pairs{ { 0, 2 }, { 4, 6 }, { 7, 9 } });
}

}

    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(Snap("ab ab\nxab\n\nab"), TextSearch::Compile(q, ""), Lim())) == Pairs{ { 3, 5 }, { 7, 9 } });
    q.scope = { { 3, 8 } };                                     // 7..9 straddles the scope's end

TEST_CASE("TextSearch: SearchRows covers only the visible rows; FindNext wraps both ways", "[text-search]")
{
    const RopeSnapshot s = Snap("ab ab\nxab\n\nab");
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::SearchRows(s, Q("ab"), 1, 2, Lim())) == Pairs{ { 7, 9 } });
    SearchStatus st{};
    auto f = TextSearch::FindNext(s, Q("ab"), 4, true, true, Lim(), &st);
    REQUIRE(f.has_value());
    CHECK((f->begin == 7 && f->end == 9));
    f = TextSearch::FindNext(s, Q("ab"), 12, true, true, Lim(), &st);
    REQUIRE(f.has_value());
    CHECK(f->begin == 0);                                        // wrapped to the top
    CHECK_FALSE(TextSearch::FindNext(s, Q("ab"), 12, true, false, Lim(), &st).has_value());
    f = TextSearch::FindNext(s, Q("ab"), 7, false, true, Lim(), &st);
    REQUIRE(f.has_value());
    CHECK(f->begin == 3);                                        // the last match beginning before 7
    f = TextSearch::FindNext(s, Q("ab"), 0, false, true, Lim(), &st);
    REQUIRE(f.has_value());
    CHECK(f->begin == 11);                                       // wrapped to the bottom
    CHECK(st == SearchStatus::Complete);
}

    CHECK(r.status == SearchStatus::MatchLimitHit);

    CHECK(r.message.find("line 2") != std::string::npos);

    CHECK(TextSearch::Search(Snap("a\na"), Q("a"), Lim(), &cancel).status == SearchStatus::Cancelled);
    CHECK(TextSearch::Search(Snap("a"), Q(""), Lim()).status == SearchStatus::EmptyQuery);
```
