```cpp
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch line path: windowed long lines report exactly the unwindowed matches (property)", "[text-search]")
{
    rc::prop("windows of 8..32 bytes == one subject per line", [] {
        const std::string text = *rc::gen::container<std::string>(rc::gen::element('a', 'b', 'a', 'b', '\n'));
        const int patternLength = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 4);
        const std::string pattern = *rc::gen::container<std::string>(static_cast<std::size_t>(patternLength), rc::gen::element('a', 'b'));
        const std::uint64_t window = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(*rc::gen::inRange(8, 33));
        // The model: leftmost non-overlapping occurrences, per line.
        Pairs model;
        std::size_t lineStart = 0;
        for (;;)
        {
            const std::size_t nl = text.find('\n', lineStart);
            const std::size_t lineEnd = nl == std::string::npos ? text.size() : nl;
            const std::string_view line(text.data() + lineStart, lineEnd - lineStart);
            for (std::size_t p = line.find(pattern); p != std::string_view::npos; p = line.find(pattern, p + pattern.size()))
                model.emplace_back(lineStart + p, lineStart + p + pattern.size());
            if (nl == std::string::npos) break;
            lineStart = nl + 1;
        }
        const RopeSnapshot s = Snap(text);
        RC_ASSERT(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(s, Q(pattern), Lim())) == model);
        RC_ASSERT(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(s, Q(pattern), Lim(window))) == model);
    });
}
```

```cpp
    // Regex.hpp -- enum class MatchFlags gains, on the next two free bits:
        NotBol = 1u << 2,   // PCRE2_NOTBOL: the subject's start is not a line start (a long line's later window)
        NotEol = 1u << 3,   // PCRE2_NOTEOL: the subject's end is not a line end (a long line's earlier window)
    // class Regex gains:
        // The longest lookbehind in CHARACTERS (PCRE2_INFO_MAXLOOKBEHIND); a UTF-8 window needs 4x that in bytes.
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t MaxLookbehind() const noexcept;

    // Regex.cpp -- in MatchScratch::Match, where the MatchFlags become PCRE2 options:
        if (HasFlag(flags, MatchFlags::NotBol)) options |= PCRE2_NOTBOL;
        if (HasFlag(flags, MatchFlags::NotEol)) options |= PCRE2_NOTEOL;
    // and:
    std::uint32_t Regex::MaxLookbehind() const noexcept
    {
        std::uint32_t n = 0;
        pcre2_pattern_info(m_code, PCRE2_INFO_MAXLOOKBEHIND, &n);
        return n;
    }
```

```cpp
    enum class SearchStatus : std::uint8_t
    {
        Complete,               // every match in the window was reported (or the callback stopped early)
        EmptyQuery,
        InvalidPattern,
        MatchLimitHit,          // a regex limit stopped the scan (spec s4.2): reported, never a hang
        MaxMatchesHit,          // the caller's cap (SearchLimits::maxMatches)
        TooLargeForMultiline,   // the multi-line path refused the file (editor.text.multilineSearchMaxMB)
        Deferred,               // a per-frame row query met a multi-line pattern: the worker owns it
        Cancelled,
    };

    struct SearchLimits
    {
        RegexLimits   regex{};                // editor.text.regexMatchLimit / regexDepthLimit
        std::uint64_t lineWindowBytes = 0;    // editor.text.longLineMaxBytes; 0 = never window
        std::uint64_t multilineMaxBytes = 0;  // editor.text.multilineSearchMaxMB, in bytes
        std::uint64_t maxMatches = 0;         // a caller's cap for Search(); 0 = none
    };

    struct SearchHit
    {
        ByteRange          range;             // absolute, in the snapshot
        std::uint32_t      row = 0;           // the row the match begins on
        std::string_view   subject;           // the scratch the regex ran on; valid during the callback only
        ByteOffset         subjectBase = 0;   // absolute offset of subject[0]
        const MatchScratch* match = nullptr;  // capture groups (Group(i, b, e)), subject-relative
    };

    struct SearchResult
    {
        std::vector<ByteRange> matches;
        SearchStatus status = SearchStatus::Complete;
        std::string message;                  // for the find bar / vim message line when not Complete
        std::uint64_t version = 0;            // the snapshot's buffer version
    };

    using SearchHitFn = std::function<bool(const SearchHit&)>;   // return false to stop

    namespace TextSearch
    {
        // Every match whose begin lies in [window.begin, window.end), in document order.
        SearchStatus ForEachMatch(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, ByteRange window,
                                  const SearchLimits& limits, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel, const SearchHitFn& onHit,
                                  std::string* message);
        // Spec s9: the pure whole-document search (the find bar's worker; spec 2's Find in Files).
        [[nodiscard]] SearchResult Search(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, const SearchLimits& limits,
                                          const std::atomic<bool>* cancel = nullptr);
        // The matches beginning on rows [firstRow, lastRow] (the visible range). Line path only:
        // a multi-line query returns Deferred.
        [[nodiscard]] SearchResult SearchRows(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query,
                                              std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow, const SearchLimits& limits);
        // Forward: the first match beginning at or after `from`; backward: the last one beginning
        // before `from`; `wrap` continues from the other end.
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<ByteRange> FindNext(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, ByteOffset from,
                                                        bool forward, bool wrap, const SearchLimits& limits, SearchStatus* status,
                                                        const std::atomic<bool>* cancel = nullptr, std::string* message = nullptr);
    }
```

```cpp
namespace Arcane::Text::TextSearch
{
    namespace
    {
        std::size_t NextCodePoint(std::string_view s, std::size_t i)
        {
            if (i >= s.size()) return i + 1;
            const auto b = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]);
            const std::size_t len = b < 0x80 ? 1 : (b >> 5) == 0x6 ? 2 : (b >> 4) == 0xE ? 3 : (b >> 3) == 0x1E ? 4 : 1;
            if (i + len > s.size()) return i + 1;
            for (std::size_t k = 1; k < len; ++k)
                if ((static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i + k]) & 0xC0) != 0x80) return i + 1;   // an invalid byte is its own step (spec s3.5)
            return i + len;
        }

        bool IsCancelled(const std::atomic<bool>* cancel) { return cancel && cancel->load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }

        std::string LimitMessage(std::uint32_t row)
        {
            return std::format("Search stopped: the pattern hit editor.text.regexMatchLimit / regexDepthLimit on line {}.", row + 1);
        }

        enum class Flow : std::uint8_t { Continue, PastEnd, Stopped };
        using FlowFn = std::function<Flow(const SearchHit&)>;

        struct LineScanner
        {
            LineScanner(const Rope& r, const CompiledQuery& q, const SearchLimits& l) : rope(r), query(q), limits(l), m(l.regex) {}
            const Rope& rope;
            const CompiledQuery& query;
            const SearchLimits& limits;
            std::string scratch;
            MatchScratch m;                                  // this thread's match data, context and JIT stack

            // Matches in `scratch` from `start`; reports those whose line-relative begin is
            // below reportEnd. `subjectLineOffset` = scratch[0]'s offset inside the line.
            SearchStatus ScanSubject(std::uint32_t row, ByteOffset lineBase, std::uint64_t subjectLineOffset, std::size_t start,
                                     std::uint64_t reportEnd, MatchFlags flags, std::uint64_t& lastEnd, const FlowFn& fn,
                                     Flow& flow, std::string* message)
            {
                std::size_t pos = start;
                while (pos <= scratch.size())
                {
                    const MatchStatus r = m.Match(*query.regex, scratch, pos, flags);
                    if (r == MatchStatus::NoMatch) break;
                    if (r == MatchStatus::LimitHit)
                    {
                        if (message) *message = LimitMessage(row);
                        return SearchStatus::MatchLimitHit;
                    }
                    if (r == MatchStatus::Error)
                    {
                        if (message) *message = "Search stopped: the regex engine reported an error.";
                        return SearchStatus::InvalidPattern;
                    }
                    std::size_t mb = 0, me = 0;
                    m.Group(0, mb, me);
                    const std::uint64_t lineBegin = subjectLineOffset + mb;
                    if (lineBegin >= reportEnd) break;
                    SearchHit hit;
                    hit.range = { lineBase + lineBegin, lineBase + subjectLineOffset + me };
                    hit.row = row;
                    hit.subject = scratch;
                    hit.subjectBase = lineBase + subjectLineOffset;
                    hit.match = &m;
                    lastEnd = subjectLineOffset + me;
                    flow = fn(hit);
                    if (flow != Flow::Continue) return SearchStatus::Complete;
                    pos = me > mb ? me : NextCodePoint(scratch, me);
                }
                return SearchStatus::Complete;
            }

            // Every match beginning on `row` (spec s4.2: the line is the subject; long lines in windows).
            SearchStatus ScanRow(std::uint32_t row, const FlowFn& fn, Flow& flow, std::string* message)
            {
                const ByteOffset ls = rope.LineStart(row), le = rope.LineEnd(row);
                const std::uint64_t len = le - ls;
                const std::uint64_t window = limits.lineWindowBytes;
                std::uint64_t lastEnd = 0;
                if (window == 0 || len <= window)
                {
                    scratch.clear();
                    rope.CopyTo({ ls, le }, scratch);
                    return ScanSubject(row, ls, 0, 0, len + 1, MatchFlags::None, lastEnd, fn, flow, message);
                }
                // Overlapping windows: a match is reported by the window it begins in (before
                // that window's overlap); scanning resumes after the last reported match, so no
                // two windows report overlapping matches; 4 x MaxLookbehind() bytes of context
                // precede each window so lookbehinds (whole word) see the real neighbours.
                // A match longer than the overlap that crosses a window end is cut there.
                const std::uint64_t overlap = std::max<std::uint64_t>(1, window / 4);
                const std::uint64_t step = window - overlap;
                const std::uint64_t lookbehind = std::uint64_t{ query.regex->MaxLookbehind() } * 4;   // characters -> UTF-8 bytes
                for (std::uint64_t ws = 0; ws < len; ws += step)
                {
                    const std::uint64_t we = std::min(len, ws + window);
                    const std::uint64_t context = std::min(ws, lookbehind);
                    const std::uint64_t subjectStart = ws - context;
                    const std::uint64_t reportEnd = we < len ? ws + step : len + 1;
                    const std::uint64_t from = std::max(ws, lastEnd);
                    if (from < reportEnd)
                    {
                        scratch.clear();
                        rope.CopyTo({ ls + subjectStart, ls + we }, scratch);
                        MatchFlags flags = MatchFlags::None;
                        if (we < len) flags = flags | MatchFlags::NotEol;
                        if (ws > 0 && context == 0) flags = flags | MatchFlags::NotBol;
                        const SearchStatus s = ScanSubject(row, ls, subjectStart, static_cast<std::size_t>(from - subjectStart),
                                                           reportEnd, flags, lastEnd, fn, flow, message);
                        if (s != SearchStatus::Complete || flow != Flow::Continue) return s;
                    }
                    if (we == len) break;
                }
                return SearchStatus::Complete;
            }
        };

        SearchStatus ForEachLine(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& q, ByteRange window, const SearchLimits& limits,
                                 const std::atomic<bool>* cancel, const SearchHitFn& onHit, std::string* message)
        {
            const Rope& rope = snapshot.rope;
            const ByteOffset size = rope.Size();
            LineScanner scanner(rope, q, limits);
            bool stopped = false;
            const auto scanArea = [&](ByteRange area, const ByteRange* scope) -> SearchStatus
            {
                const std::uint32_t first = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(area.begin, size)).row;
                const std::uint32_t last = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(area.end, size)).row;
                for (std::uint32_t row = first;; ++row)
                {
                    if (IsCancelled(cancel)) return SearchStatus::Cancelled;
                    Flow flow = Flow::Continue;
                    const SearchStatus s = scanner.ScanRow(row, [&](const SearchHit& h) -> Flow
                    {
                        if (h.range.begin < area.begin) return Flow::Continue;
                        if (h.range.begin >= area.end) return Flow::PastEnd;
                        if (scope && (h.range.begin < scope->begin || h.range.end > scope->end)) return Flow::Continue;
                        return onHit(h) ? Flow::Continue : Flow::Stopped;
                    }, flow, message);
                    if (s != SearchStatus::Complete) return s;
                    if (flow == Flow::Stopped) { stopped = true; return SearchStatus::Complete; }
                    if (flow == Flow::PastEnd || row == last) break;
                }
                return SearchStatus::Complete;
            };
            if (q.scope.empty()) return scanArea(window, nullptr);
            for (const ByteRange& s : q.scope)
            {
                const ByteRange area{ std::max(window.begin, s.begin), std::min(window.end, s.end + 1) };
                if (area.begin >= area.end) continue;
                const SearchStatus status = scanArea(area, &s);
                if (status != SearchStatus::Complete || stopped) return status;
            }
            return SearchStatus::Complete;
        }
    }

    SearchStatus ForEachMatch(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, ByteRange window,
                              const SearchLimits& limits, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel, const SearchHitFn& onHit, std::string* message)
    {
        if (!query.Valid())
        {
            if (message) *message = query.error;
            return query.error.empty() ? SearchStatus::EmptyQuery : SearchStatus::InvalidPattern;
        }
        if (window.begin >= window.end || window.begin > snapshot.rope.Size()) return SearchStatus::Complete;
        if (query.multiline)
        {
            if (message) *message = "Multi-line search runs on the worker.";
            return SearchStatus::Deferred;                       // TE4-6 replaces this branch with the materialized path
        }
        return ForEachLine(snapshot, query, window, limits, cancel, onHit, message);
    }

    SearchResult Search(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, const SearchLimits& limits, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel)
    {
        SearchResult out;
        out.version = snapshot.version;
        bool capped = false;
        out.status = ForEachMatch(snapshot, query, { 0, snapshot.rope.Size() + 1 }, limits, cancel, [&](const SearchHit& h)
        {
            out.matches.push_back(h.range);
            if (limits.maxMatches != 0 && out.matches.size() >= limits.maxMatches) { capped = true; return false; }
            return true;
        }, &out.message);
        if (capped && out.status == SearchStatus::Complete)
        {
            out.status = SearchStatus::MaxMatchesHit;
            out.message = std::format("Stopped after {} matches.", limits.maxMatches);
        }
        return out;
    }

    SearchResult SearchRows(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow,
                            const SearchLimits& limits)
    {
        SearchResult out;
        out.version = snapshot.version;
        if (query.Valid() && query.multiline) { out.status = SearchStatus::Deferred; return out; }
        const Rope& rope = snapshot.rope;
        const std::uint32_t last = std::min(lastRow, rope.LineCount() - 1);
        if (firstRow > last) return out;
        const ByteRange window{ rope.LineStart(firstRow), rope.LineEnd(last) + 1 };
        out.status = ForEachMatch(snapshot, query, window, limits, nullptr, [&](const SearchHit& h)
        {
            out.matches.push_back(h.range);
            return true;
        }, &out.message);
        return out;
    }

    std::optional<ByteRange> FindNext(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, ByteOffset from, bool forward, bool wrap,
                                      const SearchLimits& limits, SearchStatus* status, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel, std::string* message)
    {
        SearchStatus local = SearchStatus::Complete;
        SearchStatus& st = status ? *status : local;
        const ByteOffset end = snapshot.rope.Size() + 1;
        from = std::min<ByteOffset>(from, end - 1);
        std::optional<ByteRange> found;
        const auto first = [&](ByteRange window)
        {
            st = ForEachMatch(snapshot, query, window, limits, cancel, [&](const SearchHit& h) { found = h.range; return false; }, message);
        };
        const auto last = [&](ByteRange window)
        {
            st = ForEachMatch(snapshot, query, window, limits, cancel, [&](const SearchHit& h) { found = h.range; return true; }, message);
        };
        if (forward)
        {
            first({ from, end });
            if (!found && wrap && st == SearchStatus::Complete && from > 0) first({ 0, from });
        }
        else
        {
            last({ 0, from });
            if (!found && wrap && st == SearchStatus::Complete) last({ from, end });
        }
        return found;
    }
}
```

```cpp
        // Spec s4.2: a pattern that can span lines gets the whole snapshot as one
        // contiguous subject. It runs on the worker (the find bar never calls it per
        // frame) and is refused above multilineMaxBytes, so a 400 MB log never
        // doubles its memory for a regex.
        SearchStatus ForEachMaterialized(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& q, ByteRange window,
                                         const SearchLimits& limits, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel, const SearchHitFn& onHit,
                                         std::string* message)
        {
            const Rope& rope = snapshot.rope;
            const std::uint64_t size = rope.Size();
            if (size > limits.multilineMaxBytes)
            {
                if (message)
                    *message = std::format("Multi-line search is limited to {} MB (editor.text.multilineSearchMaxMB); this file is {} MB.",
                                           limits.multilineMaxBytes >> 20, (size + (std::uint64_t{ 1 } << 20) - 1) >> 20);
                return SearchStatus::TooLargeForMultiline;
            }
            const std::string text = rope.ToString();
            MatchScratch m(limits.regex);
            std::size_t pos = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<ByteOffset>(window.begin, size));
            std::uint32_t row = rope.OffsetToPoint(pos).row;
            std::size_t counted = pos;                               // newlines counted up to here
            const auto rowAt = [&](std::size_t offset)
            {
                if (offset > counted)
                {
                    row += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::count(text.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(counted),
                                                                 text.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(offset), '\n'));
                    counted = offset;
                }
                return row;
            };
            while (pos <= text.size())
            {
                if (IsCancelled(cancel)) return SearchStatus::Cancelled;
                const MatchStatus r = m.Match(*q.regex, text, pos);
                if (r == MatchStatus::NoMatch) break;
                if (r == MatchStatus::LimitHit)
                {
                    if (message) *message = LimitMessage(rowAt(pos));
                    return SearchStatus::MatchLimitHit;
                }
                if (r == MatchStatus::Error)
                {
                    if (message) *message = "Search stopped: the regex engine reported an error.";
                    return SearchStatus::InvalidPattern;
                }
                std::size_t mb = 0, me = 0;
                m.Group(0, mb, me);
                if (mb >= window.end) break;
                const ByteRange range{ mb, me };
                bool inScope = q.scope.empty();
                for (const ByteRange& s : q.scope)
                    if (range.begin >= s.begin && range.end <= s.end) { inScope = true; break; }
                if (inScope)
                {
                    SearchHit hit;
                    hit.range = range;
                    hit.row = rowAt(mb);
                    hit.subject = text;
                    hit.subjectBase = 0;
                    hit.match = &m;
                    if (!onHit(hit)) return SearchStatus::Complete;
                }
                pos = me > mb ? me : NextCodePoint(text, me);
            }
            return SearchStatus::Complete;
        }
```

- Consumes: TE4-4/5 `SearchQuery`, `CompiledQuery`, `SearchHit`, `SearchLimits`, `TextSearch::{Compile, ForEachMatch}`; TE3-2 `MatchScratch::{Group, GroupSlots}`; TE1 `TextBuffer(Rope, EolMap)`, `TextBuffer::{Text, Snapshot, BreakUndoGroup, Undo, Redo}`, `class TextCommands` (`TextCommands(TextBuffer&, SelectionSet&, EditContext = {})`, `EditAndMap(TransactionKind, std::vector<EditOp>, Bias cursorBias, Bias startBias, Bias endBias)`), `TransactionKind::Other`, `SelectionSet::{AllocateId, Replace, SetSingle, All, Primary, Size}`, `Selection{id, anchor, head, goalColumn}`, `EditOp`, `Bias`.
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Text`): `std::string ExpandReplacement(std::string_view, const SearchHit&, bool regex)`; `void AssignSelections(SelectionSet&, std::span<const ByteRange> ranges, std::size_t primary)` (range.begin = anchor, range.end = head; ranges[primary] gets the newest id); `enum class CursorGate { Empty, Proceed, NeedsConfirmation }`; `CursorGate CheckCursorCount(std::uint64_t count, std::uint32_t maxCursors)`; `SearchCommands::ReplaceAll(TextBuffer&, SelectionSet&, std::vector<EditOp>)`; `SearchCommands::ReplaceOne(TextBuffer&, SelectionSet&, ByteRange, std::string_view) -> bool`; `SearchCommands::SelectRanges(SelectionSet&, std::span<const ByteRange>, ByteOffset focus)`. TE5c's `:s` does NOT reuse them: vim's replacement syntax differs, so TE5c-8 has its own `Text::VimExpandReplacement` (CANON A6, B16).

Add Next Match (Ctrl+D) and Select All Matches (Alt+F3) are TE1-17's plain-text commands with TE1's `ConfirmCursorCount`; TE4 does not duplicate them. `CheckCursorCount` is the same rule as a pure function, for the find bar, whose matches arrive asynchronously from its worker (TE4-10) and cannot block inside a command. The functions here live in namespace `SearchCommands`, not `TextCommands` (TE1's `TextCommands` is a class), and every edit goes through `TextCommands::EditAndMap`, so the s2.1 single mutation path holds.

```cpp
#pragma once

// Search edits (text editor spec s2.1, s3.2, s5.2; TE4-7): replacement
// expansion, Replace / Replace All as ONE undo step, matches -> selections and
// the cursor gate. Every edit runs through TextCommands::EditAndMap (the single
// mutation layer); TE1-17 owns Ctrl+D / Alt+F3.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    // One match's replacement. Plain mode: the text as typed. Regex mode: $0-$99 and ${n}
    // are capture groups ($$ is '$'); \n \t \\ are a line break, a tab, a backslash. An
    // unset or missing group expands to "".
    [[nodiscard]] std::string ExpandReplacement(std::string_view replacement, const SearchHit& hit, bool regex);

    // Rebuild `sels` from ranges (begin = anchor, end = head). ranges[primary] gets the newest
    // id, so it is the primary (spec s3.4).
    void AssignSelections(SelectionSet& sels, std::span<const ByteRange> ranges, std::size_t primary);

    enum class CursorGate : std::uint8_t { Empty, Proceed, NeedsConfirmation };
    // Spec s3.2: making cursors from matches asks first above editor.text.maxCursors.
    [[nodiscard]] CursorGate CheckCursorCount(std::uint64_t count, std::uint32_t maxCursors) noexcept;

    namespace SearchCommands
    {
        // Spec s5.2: every op in ONE transaction (TransactionKind::Other), so one Ctrl+Z.
        void ReplaceAll(TextBuffer& buffer, SelectionSet& sels, std::vector<EditOp> ops);
        // One match replaced as its own undo step; a selection equal to it now covers the replacement.
        bool ReplaceOne(TextBuffer& buffer, SelectionSet& sels, ByteRange match, std::string_view text);
        // Matches -> selections; the first range at or after `focus` (else the last) is primary.
        void SelectRanges(SelectionSet& sels, std::span<const ByteRange> ranges, ByteOffset focus);
    }
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/SearchCommands.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchCommands.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <optional>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::string ExpandReplacement(std::string_view rep, const SearchHit& hit, bool regex)
    {
        if (!regex) return std::string(rep);
        std::string out;
        const std::size_t groupCount = hit.match ? hit.match->GroupSlots() : 0;
        const auto group = [&](std::size_t n)
        {
            std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
            if (!hit.match || n >= groupCount || !hit.match->Group(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(n), b, e)) return;
            if (e < b || e > hit.subject.size()) return;
            out.append(hit.subject.substr(b, e - b));
        };
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < rep.size(); ++i)
        {
            const char c = rep[i];
            if (c == '$' && i + 1 < rep.size())
            {
                const char d = rep[i + 1];
                if (d == '$') { out.push_back('$'); ++i; continue; }
                if (d == '{')
                {
                    const std::size_t close = rep.find('}', i + 2);
                    const std::string_view digits = close == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view{} : rep.substr(i + 2, close - (i + 2));
                    if (!digits.empty() && std::all_of(digits.begin(), digits.end(), [](char x) { return std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(x)) != 0; }))
                    {
                        std::size_t n = 0;
                        for (const char x : digits) n = n * 10 + static_cast<std::size_t>(x - '0');
                        group(n);
                        i = close;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                if (std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(d)))
                {
                    std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(d - '0');
                    std::size_t used = 1;
                    if (i + 2 < rep.size() && std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(rep[i + 2])))
                    {
                        const std::size_t two = n * 10 + static_cast<std::size_t>(rep[i + 2] - '0');
                        if (two < groupCount) { n = two; used = 2; }
                    }
                    group(n);
                    i += used;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < rep.size())
            {
                const char d = rep[i + 1];
                if (d == 'n') { out.push_back('\n'); ++i; continue; }
                if (d == 't') { out.push_back('\t'); ++i; continue; }
                if (d == '\\') { out.push_back('\\'); ++i; continue; }
            }
            out.push_back(c);
        }
        return out;
    }

    void AssignSelections(SelectionSet& sels, std::span<const ByteRange> ranges, std::size_t primary)
    {
        if (ranges.empty()) return;
        primary = std::min(primary, ranges.size() - 1);
        std::vector<Selection> out(ranges.size());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < ranges.size(); ++i)
            if (i != primary) out[i] = Selection{ sels.AllocateId(), ranges[i].begin, ranges[i].end, std::nullopt };
        out[primary] = Selection{ sels.AllocateId(), ranges[primary].begin, ranges[primary].end, std::nullopt };   // the newest id
        sels.Replace(std::move(out));
    }

    CursorGate CheckCursorCount(std::uint64_t count, std::uint32_t maxCursors) noexcept
    {
        if (count == 0) return CursorGate::Empty;
        return count > maxCursors ? CursorGate::NeedsConfirmation : CursorGate::Proceed;
    }

    namespace SearchCommands
    {
        void ReplaceAll(TextBuffer& buffer, SelectionSet& sels, std::vector<EditOp> ops)
        {
            if (ops.empty()) return;
            buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
            TextCommands(buffer, sels).EditAndMap(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), Bias::Left, Bias::Left, Bias::Right);
            buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
        }

        bool ReplaceOne(TextBuffer& buffer, SelectionSet& sels, ByteRange match, std::string_view text)
        {
            if (match.begin > match.end || match.end > buffer.Text().Size()) return false;
            std::vector<EditOp> ops;
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ match, std::string(text) });
            buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
            TextCommands(buffer, sels).EditAndMap(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), Bias::Right, Bias::Left, Bias::Right);
            buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
            return true;
        }

        void SelectRanges(SelectionSet& sels, std::span<const ByteRange> ranges, ByteOffset focus)
        {
            if (ranges.empty()) return;
            std::size_t primary = ranges.size() - 1;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < ranges.size(); ++i)
                if (ranges[i].begin >= focus) { primary = i; break; }
            AssignSelections(sels, ranges, primary);
        }
    }
}
```

```cpp
// against snapshots; a newer job of a kind supersedes the older one; results

{
    SearchLimits Lim()
    {
        SearchLimits l;
        l.regex.matchLimit = 10000000;
        l.regex.depthLimit = 100000;
        l.multilineMaxBytes = 1u << 20;
        return l;
    }
    std::string Needles(int n)
    {

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) s += "line " + std::to_string(i) + " needle\n";
        return s;
    }
    CompiledQuery Q(std::string text, bool regex = false)

        return j;
    }

TEST_CASE("SearchWorker: Count reports the total, the active match's 1-based index and a row histogram", "[text-search]")

    const RopeSnapshot s{ Rope::FromUtf8(Needles(17)), 42 };
    SearchJob j = Job(SearchJobKind::Count, s, Q("needle"));
    const std::uint64_t third = s.rope.LineStart(2) + 7;         // "line 2 " is 7 bytes
    j.hasCurrent = true;
    j.current = third;
    j.buckets = 4;
    const std::uint64_t ticket = worker.Submit(j);
    const auto r = Settle(worker);
    REQUIRE(r.has_value());
    CHECK(r->ticket == ticket);
    CHECK(r->version == 42);
    CHECK(r->status == SearchStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(r->total == 17);
    CHECK(r->currentIndex == 3);
    REQUIRE(r->bucketCounts.size() == 4);
    CHECK(std::accumulate(r->bucketCounts.begin(), r->bucketCounts.end(), std::uint64_t{ 0 }) == 17);
    CHECK_FALSE(worker.Poll().has_value());
}

{
    VisibleMatchCache cache;
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("ab ab\nab"), EolMap());
    const CompiledQuery q = Q("ab");
    auto m = cache.Get(buf.Snapshot(), q, 1, 0, 1, Lim());
    CHECK(m.size() == 3);
    CHECK(cache.Recomputes() == 1);
    m = cache.Get(buf.Snapshot(), q, 1, 0, 1, Lim());
    CHECK(cache.Recomputes() == 1);                              // same version, generation, rows: reused
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    buf.BeginTransaction(sels);
    const EditOp op{ { 0, 0 }, "x" };
    buf.Edit(std::span<const EditOp>(&op, 1));
    buf.EndTransaction(sels);
    m = cache.Get(buf.Snapshot(), q, 1, 0, 1, Lim());
    CHECK(cache.Recomputes() == 2);                              // a new version: recomputed from the text
    REQUIRE(m.size() == 3);
    CHECK(m[0].begin == 1);
    cache.Get(buf.Snapshot(), q, 2, 0, 1, Lim());
    CHECK(cache.Recomputes() == 3);                              // a new query generation
    cache.Get(buf.Snapshot(), q, 2, 1, 1, Lim());
    CHECK(cache.Recomputes() == 4);                              // scrolled
    cache.Get(buf.Snapshot(), Q("a\\nb", true), 3, 0, 1, Lim());
    CHECK(cache.Status() == SearchStatus::Deferred);             // multi-line: the worker's job
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The find bar's background half (text editor spec s5.2, s3.2; TE4-8): one
// thread per owner that counts matches (the "3 of 17" total and the scrollbar
// histogram), finds the next match, and collects every match for Replace All
// or matches -> cursors -- always on a RopeSnapshot, never the live buffer, so
// a 400 MB log is searched while the user types. A newer job of a kind cancels
// the older one. Every result carries its snapshot version: the UI applies it
// only while the buffer is still at that version (spec s3.2: matches are not
// anchors, they are recomputed). VisibleMatchCache is the per-frame half: the
// visible rows' matches, recomputed for every new snapshot.

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class SearchJobKind : std::uint8_t { Find = 0, ReplaceAll = 1, Cursors = 2, Count = 3 };   // also the run priority

    struct SearchJob
    {
        SearchJobKind kind = SearchJobKind::Count;
        RopeSnapshot snapshot;
        CompiledQuery query;
        SearchLimits limits;
        // Count
        ByteOffset current = 0;            // the active match's begin; its 1-based index is reported
        bool hasCurrent = false;
        std::uint32_t buckets = 0;         // scrollbar histogram buckets over buffer rows; 0 = none
        std::uint32_t visibleFirstRow = 0, visibleLastRow = 0;
        bool wantVisible = false;          // multi-line queries: the matches touching those rows
        // Find
        ByteOffset from = 0;
        bool forward = true;
        bool wrap = true;
        // ReplaceAll
        std::string replacement;
        bool regexReplacement = false;
    };

    struct SearchJobResult
    {
        SearchJobKind kind = SearchJobKind::Count;
        std::uint64_t ticket = 0;
        std::uint64_t version = 0;                 // the snapshot's buffer version
        SearchStatus status = SearchStatus::Complete;
        std::string message;
        std::uint64_t total = 0;                   // Count
        std::uint64_t currentIndex = 0;            // Count: 1-based; 0 = the current offset is not a match
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> bucketCounts;   // Count
        std::vector<ByteRange> visible;            // Count with wantVisible
        std::optional<ByteRange> found;            // Find
        std::vector<EditOp> edits;                 // ReplaceAll (expanded text) / Cursors (empty text)
    };

    class SearchWorker
    {
    public:
        SearchWorker();
        ~SearchWorker();
        SearchWorker(const SearchWorker&) = delete;
        SearchWorker& operator=(const SearchWorker&) = delete;

        std::uint64_t Submit(SearchJob job);            // supersedes a pending or running job of the same kind
        std::optional<SearchJobResult> Poll();          // UI thread; only the latest ticket of a kind surfaces
        void Cancel(SearchJobKind kind);
        void CancelAll();
        bool WaitIdle(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout);   // tests and shutdown paths

    private:
        struct Impl;
        std::unique_ptr<Impl> m_impl;
    };

    class VisibleMatchCache
    {
    public:
        std::span<const ByteRange> Get(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, std::uint64_t queryGeneration,
                                       std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow, const SearchLimits& limits);
        [[nodiscard]] SearchStatus Status() const noexcept { return m_status; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& Message() const noexcept { return m_message; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t Recomputes() const noexcept { return m_recomputes; }
        void Invalidate() noexcept { m_valid = false; }

    private:
        std::vector<ByteRange> m_matches;
        SearchStatus m_status = SearchStatus::Complete;
        std::string m_message;
        std::uint64_t m_version = 0, m_generation = 0, m_recomputes = 0;
        std::uint32_t m_firstRow = 0, m_lastRow = 0;
        bool m_valid = false;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/SearchWorker.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchWorker.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchCommands.hpp"   // ExpandReplacement

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        SearchJobResult RunSearchJob(const SearchJob& job, std::uint64_t ticket, const std::atomic<bool>& cancel)
        {
            SearchJobResult out;
            out.kind = job.kind;
            out.ticket = ticket;
            out.version = job.snapshot.version;
            if (!job.query.Valid())
            {
                out.status = job.query.error.empty() ? SearchStatus::EmptyQuery : SearchStatus::InvalidPattern;
                out.message = job.query.error;
                return out;
            }
            const Rope& rope = job.snapshot.rope;
            const ByteRange all{ 0, rope.Size() + 1 };
            switch (job.kind)
            {
            case SearchJobKind::Count:
            {
                const std::uint32_t lines = rope.LineCount();
                if (job.buckets > 0) out.bucketCounts.assign(job.buckets, 0);
                ByteRange visible{};
                if (job.wantVisible)
                {
                    const std::uint32_t last = std::min(job.visibleLastRow, lines - 1);
                    visible = { rope.LineStart(std::min(job.visibleFirstRow, last)), rope.LineEnd(last) + 1 };
                }
                out.status = TextSearch::ForEachMatch(job.snapshot, job.query, all, job.limits, &cancel, [&](const SearchHit& h)
                {
                    ++out.total;
                    if (job.hasCurrent && h.range.begin == job.current) out.currentIndex = out.total;
                    if (job.buckets > 0)
                        ++out.bucketCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(h.row) * job.buckets / lines)];
                    if (job.wantVisible && h.range.end >= visible.begin && h.range.begin < visible.end) out.visible.push_back(h.range);
                    return true;
                }, &out.message);
                break;
            }
            case SearchJobKind::Find:
                out.found = TextSearch::FindNext(job.snapshot, job.query, job.from, job.forward, job.wrap, job.limits, &out.status,
                                                 &cancel, &out.message);
                break;
            case SearchJobKind::ReplaceAll:
            case SearchJobKind::Cursors:
                out.status = TextSearch::ForEachMatch(job.snapshot, job.query, all, job.limits, &cancel, [&](const SearchHit& h)
                {
                    out.edits.push_back(EditOp{ h.range, job.kind == SearchJobKind::ReplaceAll
                                                         ? ExpandReplacement(job.replacement, h, job.regexReplacement)
                                                         : std::string{} });
                    return true;
                }, &out.message);
                break;
            }
            return out;
        }
    }

    struct SearchWorker::Impl
    {
        struct Pending { std::uint64_t ticket = 0; SearchJob job; };
        std::mutex mutex;
        std::condition_variable wake, idle;
        std::array<std::optional<Pending>, 4> pending;
        std::array<std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>>, 4> running;
        std::array<std::uint64_t, 4> latest{};
        std::deque<SearchJobResult> results;
        std::uint64_t nextTicket = 1;
        bool busy = false;
        bool stop = false;
        std::thread thread;

        bool AnyPending() const { return std::any_of(pending.begin(), pending.end(), [](const auto& p) { return p.has_value(); }); }

        void Run()
        {
            std::unique_lock lock(mutex);
            for (;;)
            {
                wake.wait(lock, [&] { return stop || AnyPending(); });
                if (stop) return;
                std::size_t kind = 0;
                while (!pending[kind]) ++kind;                       // Find, ReplaceAll, Cursors, Count
                Pending job = std::move(*pending[kind]);
                pending[kind].reset();
                auto cancel = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>>(false);
                running[kind] = cancel;
                busy = true;
                lock.unlock();
                SearchJobResult result = RunSearchJob(job.job, job.ticket, *cancel);
                lock.lock();
                running[kind].reset();
                busy = false;
                if (!cancel->load() && job.ticket == latest[kind]) results.push_back(std::move(result));
                idle.notify_all();
            }
        }
    };

    SearchWorker::SearchWorker() : m_impl(std::make_unique<Impl>())
    {
        m_impl->thread = std::thread([impl = m_impl.get()] { impl->Run(); });
    }

    SearchWorker::~SearchWorker()
    {
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(m_impl->mutex);
            m_impl->stop = true;
            for (auto& r : m_impl->running)
                if (r) r->store(true);
        }
        m_impl->wake.notify_all();
        m_impl->thread.join();
    }

    std::uint64_t SearchWorker::Submit(SearchJob job)
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_impl->mutex);
        const auto k = static_cast<std::size_t>(job.kind);
        const std::uint64_t ticket = m_impl->nextTicket++;
        m_impl->latest[k] = ticket;
        m_impl->pending[k] = Impl::Pending{ ticket, std::move(job) };
        if (m_impl->running[k]) m_impl->running[k]->store(true);
        m_impl->wake.notify_one();
        return ticket;
    }

    std::optional<SearchJobResult> SearchWorker::Poll()
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_impl->mutex);
        while (!m_impl->results.empty())
        {
            SearchJobResult r = std::move(m_impl->results.front());
            m_impl->results.pop_front();
            if (r.ticket == m_impl->latest[static_cast<std::size_t>(r.kind)]) return r;
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    void SearchWorker::Cancel(SearchJobKind kind)
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_impl->mutex);
        const auto k = static_cast<std::size_t>(kind);
        m_impl->latest[k] = m_impl->nextTicket++;                    // anything in flight is now stale
        m_impl->pending[k].reset();
        if (m_impl->running[k]) m_impl->running[k]->store(true);
    }

    void SearchWorker::CancelAll()
    {
        for (const SearchJobKind k : { SearchJobKind::Find, SearchJobKind::ReplaceAll, SearchJobKind::Cursors, SearchJobKind::Count })
            Cancel(k);
    }

    bool SearchWorker::WaitIdle(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
    {
        std::unique_lock lock(m_impl->mutex);
        return m_impl->idle.wait_for(lock, timeout, [&] { return !m_impl->busy && !m_impl->AnyPending(); });
    }

    std::span<const ByteRange> VisibleMatchCache::Get(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, std::uint64_t generation,
                                                      std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow, const SearchLimits& limits)
    {
        if (m_valid && m_version == snapshot.version && m_generation == generation && m_firstRow == firstRow && m_lastRow == lastRow)
            return m_matches;
        SearchResult r = TextSearch::SearchRows(snapshot, query, firstRow, lastRow, limits);
        m_matches = std::move(r.matches);
        m_status = r.status;
        m_message = std::move(r.message);
        m_version = snapshot.version;
        m_generation = generation;
        m_firstRow = firstRow;
        m_lastRow = lastRow;
        m_valid = true;
        ++m_recomputes;
        return m_matches;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// TE4-9 (spec s5.1): the text area's extras as pure layout functions, and the
// overlay seam the view calls once per visible row.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextLayoutExtras.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextViewOverlay.hpp"
#include <imgui.h>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, WhitespaceKind>> Marks(std::string_view line, WhitespaceMode mode,
                                                                std::vector<ByteRange> selected = {})
    {
        std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, WhitespaceKind>> out;
        for (const WhitespaceMark& m : WhitespaceMarks(line, mode, selected)) out.emplace_back(m.byteCol, m.kind);
        return out;
    }
    using Marked = std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, WhitespaceKind>>;
    constexpr WhitespaceKind S = WhitespaceKind::Space, T = WhitespaceKind::Tab;
}

TEST_CASE("Text extras: whitespace marks per mode", "[text-view]")
{
    CHECK(Marks("a b\tc ", WhitespaceMode::None).empty());
    CHECK(Marks("a b\tc ", WhitespaceMode::All) == Marked{ { 1, S }, { 3, T }, { 5, S } });
    CHECK(Marks("a b  c\t", WhitespaceMode::Boundary) == Marked{ { 3, S }, { 4, S }, { 6, T } });   // a single space between words is skipped
    CHECK(Marks("  x", WhitespaceMode::Boundary) == Marked{ { 0, S }, { 1, S } });
    CHECK(Marks("x ", WhitespaceMode::Boundary) == Marked{ { 1, S } });
    CHECK(Marks("a b c", WhitespaceMode::Selection, { { 1, 4 } }) == Marked{ { 1, S }, { 3, S } });
    CHECK(Marks("a b c", WhitespaceMode::Selection).empty());
}

TEST_CASE("Text extras: indentation width and indent-guide columns (blank rows take the smaller neighbour)", "[text-view]")
{
    CHECK(MeasureIndent("    x", 4) == 4u);
    CHECK(MeasureIndent("\t  x", 4) == 6u);
    CHECK(MeasureIndent(" \tx", 4) == 4u);
    CHECK_FALSE(MeasureIndent("   ", 4).has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(MeasureIndent("", 4).has_value());
    const std::vector<std::optional<std::uint32_t>> indents = { 0u, 4u, std::nullopt, 8u, 4u, std::nullopt };
    const auto g = IndentGuideColumns(indents, std::nullopt, std::nullopt, 4);
    REQUIRE(g.size() == 6);
    CHECK(g[0].empty());
    CHECK(g[1] == std::vector<std::uint32_t>{ 0 });
    CHECK(g[2] == std::vector<std::uint32_t>{ 0 });              // between 4 and 8: min 4
    CHECK(g[3] == std::vector<std::uint32_t>{ 0, 4 });
    CHECK(g[4] == std::vector<std::uint32_t>{ 0 });
    CHECK(g[5].empty());                                          // nothing below: 0
    const auto edge = IndentGuideColumns(std::vector<std::optional<std::uint32_t>>{ std::nullopt }, 8u, 4u, 4);
    CHECK(edge[0] == std::vector<std::uint32_t>{ 0 });           // the rows just outside the view decide
}

namespace
{
    struct Recorder final : Editor::ITextViewOverlay
    {
        int frames = 0;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> background, foreground, gutter;
        std::vector<std::string> texts;
        bool rowsAgree = true;
        void BeginFrame(const Editor::TextEditorView&) override
        {
            ++frames;
            background.clear(); foreground.clear(); gutter.clear(); texts.clear();
        }
        void RowBackground(const Editor::TextRowPaint& p) override
        {
            background.push_back(p.bufferRow);
            texts.emplace_back(p.text);
            if (p.view->Display().DisplayRowToBuffer(p.displayRow) != p.bufferRow) rowsAgree = false;
        }
        void RowForeground(const Editor::TextRowPaint& p) override { foreground.push_back(p.bufferRow); }
        void Gutter(const Editor::TextGutterPaint& p) override { gutter.push_back(p.bufferRow); }
    };
}

TEST_CASE("Text view: overlays are called once per visible row, in display order, with the row's text", "[text-view]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path path = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "te4-overlay-seam.txt";
    { std::ofstream(path, std::ios::binary) << "alpha\nbeta\ngamma\n"; }
    std::string error;
    auto doc = Editor::TextDocument::Open(path, Editor::TextDocumentServices{}, error);
    REQUIRE(doc);
    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(1280, 800);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr; int w = 0, h = 0;
    io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
    Recorder rec;
    doc->View().AddOverlay(&rec);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
    {
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(900, 600), ImGuiCond_Always);
        bool close = false;
        doc->Draw(close);
        ImGui::Render();
    }
    CHECK(rec.frames == 2);
    CHECK(rec.background == std::vector<std::uint32_t>{ 0, 1, 2, 3 });
    CHECK(rec.foreground == rec.background);
    CHECK(rec.gutter == rec.background);
    CHECK(rec.texts == std::vector<std::string>{ "alpha", "beta", "gamma", "" });
    CHECK(rec.rowsAgree);
    doc->View().RemoveOverlay(&rec);
    doc.reset();
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
    std::filesystem::remove(path);
}

TEST_CASE("Text view: SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow reads back while pending, applies at the next Draw, clamps to the last display row", "[text-view]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path path = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "te4-top-row.txt";
    {
        std::ofstream out(path, std::ios::binary);
        for (int i = 0; i < 200; ++i) out << "line " << i << "\n";   // 201 display rows (the empty last one)
    }
    std::string error;
    auto doc = Editor::TextDocument::Open(path, Editor::TextDocumentServices{}, error);
    REQUIRE(doc);
    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(1280, 800);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr; int w = 0, h = 0;
    io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
    const auto frame = [&] {
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(900, 600), ImGuiCond_Always);
        bool close = false;
        doc->Draw(close);
        ImGui::Render();
    };
    Editor::TextEditorView& view = doc->View();
    frame();
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() == 0u);
    CHECK(view.VisibleRowCount() == view.Facts().visibleRows);
    CHECK(view.VisibleRowCount() > 0u);

    view.SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow(40);
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() == 40u);                      // pending: read back before any Draw
    frame();
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() == 40u);                      // applied in that frame's geometry
    CHECK(view.Facts().firstVisibleRow == 40u);                       // no folds: buffer row == display row
    CHECK(view.LastVisibleDisplayRow() == 40u + view.VisibleRowCount() - 1u);

    view.SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow(100000);
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() == 100000u);                  // pending values are not clamped
    frame();
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() == view.Display().DisplayRowCount() - 1u);   // clamped at Draw: 200

    doc.reset();
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
    std::filesystem::remove(path);
}
// The folded-file clamp (a request past the end lands on DisplayRowCount() - 1
// of the FOLDED map) is in TE4-12's tests: folds on the model arrive there.
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextLayoutExtras.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Pure layout for the text area's extras (text editor spec s5.1; TE4-9, TE4-16):
// whitespace marks, indent guides, rulers, the gutter's columns, scrollbar
// ticks. No ImGui: the overlays (View/TextAreaOverlays, GutterOverlays,
// ScrollbarOverlay) turn these into draw calls.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    // = Editor::RenderWhitespace by ordinal (editor.text.renderWhitespace).
    enum class WhitespaceMode : std::uint8_t { None = 0, Boundary = 1, Selection = 2, All = 3 };
    enum class WhitespaceKind : std::uint8_t { Space, Tab };
    struct WhitespaceMark { std::uint32_t byteCol = 0; WhitespaceKind kind = WhitespaceKind::Space; };

    // Boundary: every tab, and every space except a single one between two non-whitespace
    // characters. Selection: whitespace inside `selectedCols` (line-relative byte ranges).
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<WhitespaceMark> WhitespaceMarks(std::string_view line, WhitespaceMode mode,
                                                              std::span<const ByteRange> selectedCols);

    // The leading whitespace's width in columns (tabs to the next stop); nullopt = a blank line.
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::uint32_t> MeasureIndent(std::string_view line, std::uint32_t tabSize);

    // Guide columns per row of a visible block: one at every multiple of indentSize below the
    // row's indent. A blank row takes min(previous non-blank, next non-blank); `above`/`below`
    // are the nearest non-blank rows outside the block (nullopt = none, counts as 0).
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::vector<std::uint32_t>> IndentGuideColumns(std::span<const std::optional<std::uint32_t>> indents,
                                                                             std::optional<std::uint32_t> above,
                                                                             std::optional<std::uint32_t> below,
                                                                             std::uint32_t indentSize);

    // editor.text.rulers: "80, 120" -> {80, 120}; junk, zero and duplicates are dropped; sorted.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::uint32_t> ParseRulers(std::string_view text);

    // The gutter, left to right: bookmark/Problems markers, line numbers, fold arrows.
    struct GutterColumns
    {
        float markerX = 0.0f, markerW = 0.0f;
        float numbersX = 0.0f, numbersW = 0.0f;
        float foldX = 0.0f, foldW = 0.0f;
        float total = 0.0f;
    };
    // Markers and folds are one line-height square each, around the numbers column TE2 sizes
    // (GutterWidth: 0 when line numbers are off).
    [[nodiscard]] GutterColumns ComputeGutterColumns(float numbersWidth, float lineHeight);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextLayoutExtras.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextLayoutExtras.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <charconv>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::vector<WhitespaceMark> WhitespaceMarks(std::string_view line, WhitespaceMode mode, std::span<const ByteRange> selected)
    {
        std::vector<WhitespaceMark> out;
        if (mode == WhitespaceMode::None) return out;
        const auto isWs = [&](std::size_t i) { return i < line.size() && (line[i] == ' ' || line[i] == '\t'); };
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < line.size(); ++i)
        {
            const char c = line[i];
            if (c != ' ' && c != '\t') continue;
            if (mode == WhitespaceMode::Boundary && c == ' ' && i > 0 && !isWs(i - 1) && i + 1 < line.size() && !isWs(i + 1)) continue;
            if (mode == WhitespaceMode::Selection
                && std::none_of(selected.begin(), selected.end(), [&](const ByteRange& r) { return i >= r.begin && i < r.end; }))
                continue;
            out.push_back({ static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i), c == '\t' ? WhitespaceKind::Tab : WhitespaceKind::Space });
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::optional<std::uint32_t> MeasureIndent(std::string_view line, std::uint32_t tabSize)
    {
        tabSize = std::max<std::uint32_t>(1, tabSize);
        std::uint32_t col = 0;
        for (const char c : line)
        {
            if (c == ' ') ++col;
            else if (c == '\t') col += tabSize - col % tabSize;
            else return col;
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    std::vector<std::vector<std::uint32_t>> IndentGuideColumns(std::span<const std::optional<std::uint32_t>> indents,
                                                               std::optional<std::uint32_t> above, std::optional<std::uint32_t> below,
                                                               std::uint32_t indentSize)
    {
        indentSize = std::max<std::uint32_t>(1, indentSize);
        const std::size_t n = indents.size();
        std::vector<std::optional<std::uint32_t>> prev(n), next(n);
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> run = above;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { if (indents[i]) run = indents[i]; prev[i] = run; }
        run = below;
        for (std::size_t i = n; i-- > 0;) { if (indents[i]) run = indents[i]; next[i] = run; }
        std::vector<std::vector<std::uint32_t>> out(n);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        {
            const std::uint32_t width = indents[i] ? *indents[i] : std::min(prev[i].value_or(0), next[i].value_or(0));
            for (std::uint32_t c = 0; c < width; c += indentSize) out[i].push_back(c);
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::vector<std::uint32_t> ParseRulers(std::string_view text)
    {
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> out;
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < text.size())
        {
            const std::size_t comma = std::min(text.find(',', i), text.size());
            std::string_view tok = text.substr(i, comma - i);
            while (!tok.empty() && (tok.front() == ' ' || tok.front() == '\t')) tok.remove_prefix(1);
            while (!tok.empty() && (tok.back() == ' ' || tok.back() == '\t')) tok.remove_suffix(1);
            std::uint32_t v = 0;
            const auto [p, ec] = std::from_chars(tok.data(), tok.data() + tok.size(), v);
            if (!tok.empty() && ec == std::errc{} && p == tok.data() + tok.size() && v > 0) out.push_back(v);
            i = comma + 1;
        }
        std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
        out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end()), out.end());
        return out;
    }

    GutterColumns ComputeGutterColumns(float numbersWidth, float lineHeight)
    {
        GutterColumns g;
        g.markerX = 0.0f;
        g.markerW = lineHeight;
        g.numbersX = g.markerW;
        g.numbersW = std::max(0.0f, numbersWidth);
        g.foldX = g.numbersX + g.numbersW;
        g.foldW = lineHeight;
        g.total = g.foldX + g.foldW;
        return g;
    }
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextViewOverlay.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text view's paint/click seam (text editor spec s5.1; TE4-9). Row
// decorations -- current line, rulers, indent guides, whitespace, search
// matches, bracket boxes, fold arrows, bookmark and Problems markers,
// scrollbar annotations -- are overlays the view calls at fixed points of its
// Draw, in registration order, so TextEditorView stays the one place that lays
// rows out and every decoration is drawn from the same row geometry.

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextLayoutExtras.hpp"

#include <imgui.h>
#include <imgui_internal.h>   // ImRect

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class TextEditorView;

    struct TextRowPaint
    {
        ImDrawList* drawList = nullptr;
        const TextEditorView* view = nullptr;
        std::uint32_t bufferRow = 0, displayRow = 0;
        ImVec2 rowMin{}, rowMax{};      // the row's band across the text area, screen space
        float textX = 0.0f;             // screen x of byte column 0 (after horizontal scroll)
        std::string_view text;          // the row's bytes, no line break; valid during the call
        float spaceWidth = 0.0f;        // the advance of ' ' in the text font (rulers, guides)
        std::function<float(std::uint32_t byteCol)> xAt;   // screen x of a byte column on this row (the row's LineCursor)
    };

    struct TextGutterPaint
    {
        ImDrawList* drawList = nullptr;
        const TextEditorView* view = nullptr;
        std::uint32_t bufferRow = 0, displayRow = 0;
        ImVec2 rowMin{}, rowMax{};      // the row's band across the gutter
        Text::GutterColumns columns{};
        bool gutterHovered = false;     // the mouse is anywhere over the gutter this frame
    };

    struct TextGutterClick
    {
        std::uint32_t bufferRow = 0;
        float xInGutter = 0.0f;
        ImGuiMouseButton button = ImGuiMouseButton_Left;
        Text::GutterColumns columns{};
    };

    struct TextScrollbarPaint
    {
        ImDrawList* drawList = nullptr;
        const TextEditorView* view = nullptr;
        ImRect track{};
        std::uint32_t displayRowCount = 0;
    };

    class ITextViewOverlay
    {
    public:
        virtual ~ITextViewOverlay() = default;
        virtual void BeginFrame(const TextEditorView&) {}
        virtual void RowBackground(const TextRowPaint&) {}       // under selections and text
        virtual void RowForeground(const TextRowPaint&) {}       // over text and carets
        virtual void Gutter(const TextGutterPaint&) {}
        virtual bool GutterClicked(const TextGutterClick&) { return false; }   // true = consumed (the view does nothing else)
        virtual void Scrollbar(const TextScrollbarPaint&) {}
    };
}
```

`TextEditorView` (TE2-13) changes -- the seam, the gutter columns, and thin forwarding accessors over TE2's `TextModel` / `TextViewFacts` that every TE4 overlay and command uses (one place maps TE4's vocabulary onto TE2's view):

1. `TextEditorView.hpp`: `#include "TextEditor/View/TextViewOverlay.hpp"`, `<algorithm>`, `<cmath>`, `<optional>`; public:
   ```cpp
        void AddOverlay(ITextViewOverlay* overlay);       // not owned; called in registration order
        void RemoveOverlay(ITextViewOverlay* overlay);
        [[nodiscard]] const Text::GutterColumns& Gutter() const noexcept { return m_gutter; }

        // TE4 forwarding accessors (TE2's TextModel and TextViewFacts underneath).
        [[nodiscard]] Text::TextBuffer& Buffer() noexcept { return Model().buffer; }
        [[nodiscard]] const Text::TextBuffer& Buffer() const noexcept { return Model().buffer; }
        [[nodiscard]] Text::SelectionSet& Selections() noexcept { return Model().selections; }
        [[nodiscard]] const Text::SelectionSet& Selections() const noexcept { return Model().selections; }
        [[nodiscard]] Text::DisplayMap& Display() noexcept { return Model().display; }
        [[nodiscard]] const Text::DisplayMap& Display() const noexcept { return Model().display; }
        // Display rows (TE2's Facts().firstVisibleRow is a BUFFER row). A pending
        // SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow reads back until the next Draw applies it.
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t FirstVisibleDisplayRow() const noexcept { return m_pendingTopRow ? *m_pendingTopRow : m_firstDisplayRow; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t LastVisibleDisplayRow() const noexcept
        {
            return FirstVisibleDisplayRow() + std::max<std::uint32_t>(Facts().visibleRows, 1) - 1;
        }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t VisibleRowCount() const noexcept { return Facts().visibleRows; }
        // Scrolls so `displayRow` is the top row; applied at the next Draw, clamped to [0, DisplayRowCount()-1].
        void SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow(std::uint32_t displayRow) noexcept { m_pendingTopRow = displayRow; }
        [[nodiscard]] float LineHeight() const noexcept { return Facts().lineHeight; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::int32_t PageRows() const noexcept { return static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::max<std::uint32_t>(Facts().visibleRows, 2) - 1); }
        [[nodiscard]] bool Focused() const noexcept { return KeyboardActive(); }
        void ScrollToRow(std::uint32_t bufferRow, bool center) { RevealOffset(Model().buffer.Text().LineStart(bufferRow), center); }
        void EnsureCursorVisible() { RevealOffset(Model().selections.Primary().head, false); }
        void ZoomBy(int steps) { SetZoom(Zoom() * std::pow(1.1f, static_cast<float>(steps))); }   // one Ctrl+wheel notch per step
        void ResetZoom() { SetZoom(1.0f); }
   ```

   ```cpp
                                      [&](std::uint32_t byteCol) { return textX + cursor.XForColumn(byteCol); } };
            for (ITextViewOverlay* o : m_overlays) o->RowBackground(paint);   // BEFORE selection rects and text runs
            // ... TE2's selection rectangles, token runs, carets ...
            for (ITextViewOverlay* o : m_overlays) o->RowForeground(paint);   // AFTER text and carets
            // ... TE2's line number ...
            const TextGutterPaint gutterPaint{ dl, this, row, d, gutterMin, gutterMax, m_gutter, gutterHovered };
            for (ITextViewOverlay* o : m_overlays) o->Gutter(gutterPaint);
   ```
   with `const bool gutterHovered = ImGui::IsMouseHoveringRect(gutterRectMin, gutterRectMax);` computed once before the loop over the whole gutter rect, and `m_glyphs` = TE2's `GlyphAdvances` for the pushed text font. If TE2's view already paints a current-line band, delete that block: `TextAreaOverlay` is now its single painter.
5. Where TE2 handles a mouse press whose x is left of the text area (the gutter), before its own handling:
   ```cpp
            const TextGutterClick click{ clickedRow, io.MousePos.x - gutterLeft, button, m_gutter };
            bool consumed = false;
            for (ITextViewOverlay* o : m_overlays) if (o->GutterClicked(click)) { consumed = true; break; }
            // consumed: skip TE2's own gutter handling (line selection) for this press
   ```
6. After the row loop, before `EndChild` of the text area:
   ```cpp
        if (ImGuiWindow* w = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow(); w->ScrollbarY)
        {
            const TextScrollbarPaint sp{ w->DrawList, this, ImGui::GetWindowScrollbarRect(w, ImGuiAxis_Y), Display().DisplayRowCount() };
            for (ITextViewOverlay* o : m_overlays) o->Scrollbar(sp);
        }
   ```
7. The text area child window gets `ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs` (if TE2 did not already set it), so Tab reaches `text.indent` instead of ImGui's nav tabbing (`NavUpdateCreateTabbingRequest`, `ThirdParty/imgui/imgui.cpp:14862`).
8. `SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow` (CANON A7). In `Draw`, after TE2 computes `displayRows` and `g.lineH` and before `g.rows = VisibleDisplayRows(ImGui::GetScrollY(), ...)`, apply a pending top row to THIS frame's scroll (ImGui's `SetScrollY` would only land next frame), and record the display row the frame actually starts at right after `g.rows` is computed:
   ```cpp
        if (m_pendingTopRow)
        {
            const std::uint32_t top = std::min<std::uint32_t>(*m_pendingTopRow, displayRows > 0 ? displayRows - 1 : 0u);
            // +0.5 px keeps floor(scrollY / lineH) == top against float rounding; ImFont::RenderText truncates positions.
            window->Scroll.y = static_cast<float>(top) * g.lineH + 0.5f;
            m_pendingTopRow.reset();
        }
        // ... TE2: g.rows = VisibleDisplayRows(ImGui::GetScrollY(), inner.GetHeight(), g.lineH, displayRows); ...
        m_firstDisplayRow = g.rows.last > g.rows.first ? g.rows.first : 0u;
   ```
   ImGui clamps `Scroll.y` to the child's scroll range at the next `Begin`, so a row near the end settles where the last row sits at the bottom; within the frame that applied it, the request is exact (the test below). `TextModel::SyncDisplay()` runs at the start of `Draw` (TE2-13), so `displayRows` already reflects the current folds.

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextAreaOverlays.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Text-area overlays (text editor spec s5.1; TE4-9): the current-line band,
// column rulers, indent guides and whitespace marks (TextAreaOverlay), and
// search-match backgrounds with a distinct active match (SearchHighlightOverlay,
// fed by the find bar and, in TE5, by vim's hlsearch).

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextLayoutExtras.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextViewOverlay.hpp"

#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class TextAreaOverlay final : public ITextViewOverlay
    {
    public:
        // The document's indent width (TE4-18: detected or set), the guides' step.
        explicit TextAreaOverlay(std::function<std::uint32_t()> indentWidth);
        void BeginFrame(const TextEditorView& view) override;
        void RowBackground(const TextRowPaint& p) override;
        void RowForeground(const TextRowPaint& p) override;

    private:
        std::function<std::uint32_t()> m_indentWidth;
        bool m_currentLine = true;
        bool m_guides = true;
        Text::WhitespaceMode m_whitespace = Text::WhitespaceMode::Selection;
        std::uint32_t m_tabSize = 4;
        std::string m_rulerText;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> m_rulers;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> m_caretRows;                 // sorted
        std::vector<Text::ByteRange> m_selected;                // non-empty selections
        std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t, std::vector<std::uint32_t>> m_guideColumns;   // this frame's visible rows
    };

    struct MatchHighlights
    {
        std::span<const Text::ByteRange> matches;   // sorted, disjoint; valid for this frame
        std::optional<Text::ByteRange> active;
    };

    class SearchHighlightOverlay final : public ITextViewOverlay
    {
    public:
        explicit SearchHighlightOverlay(std::function<MatchHighlights()> source) : m_source(std::move(source)) {}
        void BeginFrame(const TextEditorView&) override { m_now = m_source ? m_source() : MatchHighlights{}; }
        void RowBackground(const TextRowPaint& p) override;

    private:
        std::function<MatchHighlights()> m_source;
        MatchHighlights m_now;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextAreaOverlays.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextAreaOverlays.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"
#include "Widgets/EditorTheme.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    TextAreaOverlay::TextAreaOverlay(std::function<std::uint32_t()> indentWidth) : m_indentWidth(std::move(indentWidth)) {}

    void TextAreaOverlay::BeginFrame(const TextEditorView& view)
    {
        const TextSettings& s = Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>();
        m_currentLine = s.highlightCurrentLine;
        m_guides = s.indentGuides;
        m_whitespace = static_cast<Text::WhitespaceMode>(s.renderWhitespace);
        m_tabSize = std::max<std::uint32_t>(1, m_indentWidth ? m_indentWidth() : static_cast<std::uint32_t>(s.tabSize));
        if (s.rulers != m_rulerText) { m_rulerText = s.rulers; m_rulers = Text::ParseRulers(m_rulerText); }

        const Text::Rope& rope = view.Buffer().Text();
        m_caretRows.clear();
        m_selected.clear();
        for (const Text::Selection& sel : view.Selections().All())
        {
            m_caretRows.push_back(rope.OffsetToPoint(sel.head).row);
            if (sel.anchor != sel.head) m_selected.push_back({ std::min(sel.anchor, sel.head), std::max(sel.anchor, sel.head) });
        }
        std::sort(m_caretRows.begin(), m_caretRows.end());

        m_guideColumns.clear();
        if (!m_guides) return;
        const std::uint32_t firstD = view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow(), lastD = view.LastVisibleDisplayRow();
        if (lastD < firstD) return;
        std::string line;
        const auto indentOf = [&](std::uint32_t row)
        {
            line.clear();
            rope.CopyTo({ rope.LineStart(row), rope.LineEnd(row) }, line);
            return Text::MeasureIndent(line, m_tabSize);
        };
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> rows;
        std::vector<std::optional<std::uint32_t>> indents;
        for (std::uint32_t d = firstD; d <= lastD; ++d)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = view.Display().DisplayRowToBuffer(d);
            rows.push_back(row);
            indents.push_back(indentOf(row));
        }
        // The nearest non-blank rows outside the view, looked for at most one view-height away.
        const std::uint32_t span = lastD - firstD + 1;
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> above, below;
        for (std::uint32_t k = 1; k <= span && rows.front() >= k && !above; ++k) above = indentOf(rows.front() - k);
        for (std::uint32_t k = 1; k <= span && rows.back() + k < rope.LineCount() && !below; ++k) below = indentOf(rows.back() + k);
        const auto columns = Text::IndentGuideColumns(indents, above, below, m_tabSize);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < rows.size(); ++i) m_guideColumns[rows[i]] = columns[i];
    }

    void TextAreaOverlay::RowBackground(const TextRowPaint& p)
    {
        if (m_currentLine && std::binary_search(m_caretRows.begin(), m_caretRows.end(), p.bufferRow))
            p.drawList->AddRectFilled(p.rowMin, p.rowMax, ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::kPanelRaised));
        const float space = p.spaceWidth;
        for (const std::uint32_t col : m_rulers)
        {
            const float x = std::floor(p.textX + static_cast<float>(col) * space) + 0.5f;
            p.drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(x, p.rowMin.y), ImVec2(x, p.rowMax.y), ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::kBorder));
        }
    }

    void TextAreaOverlay::RowForeground(const TextRowPaint& p)
    {
        const float space = p.spaceWidth;
        if (const auto it = m_guideColumns.find(p.bufferRow); it != m_guideColumns.end())
        {
            const ImU32 guide = ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::WithAlpha(Theme::kTextDim, 0.25f));
            for (const std::uint32_t col : it->second)
            {
                const float x = std::floor(p.textX + static_cast<float>(col) * space) + 0.5f;
                p.drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(x, p.rowMin.y), ImVec2(x, p.rowMax.y), guide);
            }
        }
        if (m_whitespace == Text::WhitespaceMode::None) return;
        std::vector<Text::ByteRange> selectedCols;
        if (m_whitespace == Text::WhitespaceMode::Selection)
        {
            const Text::ByteOffset ls = p.view->Buffer().Text().LineStart(p.bufferRow);
            const Text::ByteOffset le = ls + p.text.size();
            for (const Text::ByteRange& s : m_selected)
                if (s.end > ls && s.begin <= le) selectedCols.push_back({ std::max(s.begin, ls) - ls, std::min(s.end, le) - ls });
            if (selectedCols.empty()) return;
        }
        const ImU32 dim = ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::WithAlpha(Theme::kTextDim, 0.6f));
        const float cy = (p.rowMin.y + p.rowMax.y) * 0.5f;
        const float dot = std::max(1.0f, (p.rowMax.y - p.rowMin.y) * 0.06f);
        for (const Text::WhitespaceMark& m : Text::WhitespaceMarks(p.text, m_whitespace, selectedCols))
        {
            const float x0 = p.xAt(m.byteCol);
            const float x1 = p.xAt(m.byteCol + 1);
            if (m.kind == Text::WhitespaceKind::Space)
            {
                p.drawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2((x0 + x1) * 0.5f, cy), dot, dim);
                continue;
            }
            const float pad = dot * 2.0f;                               // a tab: a line with an arrow head
            p.drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(x0 + pad, cy), ImVec2(x1 - pad, cy), dim);
            p.drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(x1 - pad - pad, cy - pad), ImVec2(x1 - pad, cy), dim);
            p.drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(x1 - pad - pad, cy + pad), ImVec2(x1 - pad, cy), dim);
        }
    }

    void SearchHighlightOverlay::RowBackground(const TextRowPaint& p)
    {
        if (m_now.matches.empty() && !m_now.active) return;
        const Text::ByteOffset ls = p.view->Buffer().Text().LineStart(p.bufferRow);
        const Text::ByteOffset le = ls + p.text.size();
        const float thin = std::max(1.0f, ImGui::GetFontSize() * 0.12f);
        const auto paint = [&](Text::ByteRange r, ImU32 color)
        {
            if (r.end < ls || r.begin > le) return;
            const auto c0 = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::max(r.begin, ls) - ls);
            const auto c1 = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min(r.end, le) - ls);
            const float x0 = p.xAt(c0);
            float x1 = p.xAt(c1);
            if (r.end > le) x1 += p.spaceWidth;                           // the match continues past the line break
            if (x1 - x0 < thin) x1 = x0 + thin;                           // an empty match is a thin bar
            p.drawList->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(x0, p.rowMin.y), ImVec2(x1, p.rowMax.y), color);
        };
        const ImU32 other = ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::WithAlpha(Theme::kAmber, 0.30f));
        const auto first = std::lower_bound(m_now.matches.begin(), m_now.matches.end(), ls,
                                            [](const Text::ByteRange& m, Text::ByteOffset v) { return m.end < v; });
        for (auto it = first; it != m_now.matches.end() && it->begin <= le; ++it) paint(*it, other);
        if (m_now.active) paint(*m_now.active, ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::WithAlpha(Theme::kAccent, 0.55f)));
    }
}
```
