```cpp
#pragma once

// Problems rows as gutter / scrollbar markers (text editor spec s5.1; TE4-15):
// the diagnostics whose File locator names this document, one marker per row
// (the most severe wins, messages joined). A locator's path matches by
// canonical path, so a different spelling (case, slashes, 8.3) still lands.

#include <Arcane/Base/Diagnostics.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct ProblemMarker
    {
        std::uint32_t row = 0;
        Arcane::DiagSeverity severity = Arcane::DiagSeverity::Info;
        std::string message;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<ProblemMarker> ProblemMarkersForFile(std::span<const Arcane::Diagnostic> diags,
                                                                   const std::function<bool(std::string_view)>& isThisFile);

    // Does a diagnostic's file string name this document? A case-insensitive lexical match
    // first; otherwise CanonicalFilePath of the string (once per distinct string, memoized).
    class ProblemFileMatcher
    {
    public:
        explicit ProblemFileMatcher(std::filesystem::path canonical) : m_canonical(std::move(canonical)) {}
        bool operator()(std::string_view file);
        void Reset(std::filesystem::path canonical) { m_canonical = std::move(canonical); m_memo.clear(); }

    private:
        std::filesystem::path m_canonical;
        std::unordered_map<std::string, bool> m_memo;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/ProblemMarkers.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/ProblemMarkers.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"   // CanonicalFilePath (TE2)

#include <algorithm>
#include <cwctype>
#include <map>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        int Rank(Arcane::DiagSeverity s)
        {
            switch (s)
            {
            case Arcane::DiagSeverity::Error:   return 3;
            case Arcane::DiagSeverity::Warning: return 2;
            case Arcane::DiagSeverity::Info:    return 1;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        bool SamePath(const std::filesystem::path& a, const std::filesystem::path& b)
        {
            const std::wstring x = a.lexically_normal().make_preferred().wstring();
            const std::wstring y = b.lexically_normal().make_preferred().wstring();
            return x.size() == y.size()
                && std::equal(x.begin(), x.end(), y.begin(), [](wchar_t p, wchar_t q) { return std::towlower(p) == std::towlower(q); });
        }
    }

    std::vector<ProblemMarker> ProblemMarkersForFile(std::span<const Arcane::Diagnostic> diags,
                                                     const std::function<bool(std::string_view)>& isThisFile)
    {
        std::map<std::uint32_t, ProblemMarker> byRow;
        for (const Arcane::Diagnostic& d : diags)
        {
            if (d.locator.kind != Arcane::DiagLocator::Kind::File || d.locator.line < 1) continue;
            if (!isThisFile || !isThisFile(d.locator.file)) continue;
            const auto row = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(d.locator.line - 1);
            auto [it, inserted] = byRow.try_emplace(row, ProblemMarker{ row, d.severity, d.message });
            if (inserted) continue;
            if (Rank(d.severity) > Rank(it->second.severity)) it->second.severity = d.severity;
            it->second.message += "\n" + d.message;
        }
        std::vector<ProblemMarker> out;
        out.reserve(byRow.size());
        for (auto& [row, marker] : byRow) out.push_back(std::move(marker));
        return out;
    }

    bool ProblemFileMatcher::operator()(std::string_view file)
    {
        const std::string key(file);
        if (const auto it = m_memo.find(key); it != m_memo.end()) return it->second;
        const std::filesystem::path p(std::u8string(file.begin(), file.end()));
        bool same = SamePath(p, m_canonical);
        if (!same)
            if (const std::optional<std::filesystem::path> c = CanonicalFilePath(p)) same = SamePath(*c, m_canonical);
        m_memo.emplace(key, same);
        return same;
    }
}
```

```cpp
    void MarkerGutterOverlay::BeginFrame(const TextEditorView&)
    {
        m_rows = m_bookmarks.Rows();
        m_problems = m_source ? m_source() : std::span<const ProblemMarker>{};
    }

    void MarkerGutterOverlay::Gutter(const TextGutterPaint& p)
    {
        const ImVec2 cellMin(p.rowMin.x + p.columns.markerX, p.rowMin.y);
        const ImVec2 cellMax(cellMin.x + p.columns.markerW, p.rowMax.y);
        const ImVec2 centre((cellMin.x + cellMax.x) * 0.5f, (cellMin.y + cellMax.y) * 0.5f);
        const auto it = std::lower_bound(m_problems.begin(), m_problems.end(), p.bufferRow,
                                         [](const ProblemMarker& m, std::uint32_t row) { return m.row < row; });
        const bool bookmarked = std::binary_search(m_rows.begin(), m_rows.end(), p.bufferRow);
        if (it != m_problems.end() && it->row == p.bufferRow)
        {
            const ImVec4 colour = it->severity == Arcane::DiagSeverity::Error   ? Theme::kError
                                : it->severity == Arcane::DiagSeverity::Warning ? Theme::kWarning
                                                                                 : Theme::kTextDim;
            p.drawList->AddCircleFilled(centre, p.columns.markerW * 0.22f, ImGui::GetColorU32(colour));
            if (ImGui::IsMouseHoveringRect(cellMin, cellMax))
                ImGui::SetTooltip("%s%s", it->message.c_str(), bookmarked ? "\n(bookmarked)" : "");
            return;
        }
        if (!bookmarked) return;
        const ImVec2 size = ImGui::CalcTextSize(ICON_LC_BOOKMARK);
        p.drawList->AddText(ImVec2(centre.x - size.x * 0.5f, centre.y - size.y * 0.5f), ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::kAccent), ICON_LC_BOOKMARK);
    }

    bool MarkerGutterOverlay::GutterClicked(const TextGutterClick& c)
    {
        if (c.button != ImGuiMouseButton_Left) return false;
        if (c.xInGutter < c.columns.markerX || c.xInGutter >= c.columns.markerX + c.columns.markerW) return false;
        m_bookmarks.Toggle(c.bufferRow);
        return true;
    }
```

```cpp
    // Scrollbar annotations (spec s5.1). The enum order is the draw order: errors end on top.
    enum class ScrollMarkKind : std::uint8_t { SearchMatch = 0, Cursor = 1, Warning = 2, Error = 3 };
    struct ScrollMark { std::uint32_t displayRow = 0; ScrollMarkKind kind = ScrollMarkKind::SearchMatch; };
    struct ScrollTick { float y0 = 0.0f, y1 = 0.0f; ScrollMarkKind kind = ScrollMarkKind::SearchMatch; };

    // Grouped by kind (draw order), each a [y0, y1) band at least minTickPx tall; touching bands of a kind merge.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<ScrollTick> BuildScrollTicks(std::span<const ScrollMark> marks, std::uint32_t displayRowCount,
                                                           float trackY, float trackHeight, float minTickPx);
    // The find bar's histogram: bucket b covers buffer rows [b*lines/n, (b+1)*lines/n); a non-empty one is a mark.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<ScrollMark> SearchMarksFromBuckets(std::span<const std::uint32_t> buckets, std::uint32_t lineCount,
                                                                 const std::function<std::uint32_t(std::uint32_t)>& bufferToDisplay);
```

Append to `TextLayoutExtras.cpp`:

```cpp
    std::vector<ScrollTick> BuildScrollTicks(std::span<const ScrollMark> marks, std::uint32_t displayRowCount, float trackY,
                                             float trackHeight, float minTickPx)
    {
        std::vector<ScrollTick> out;
        if (displayRowCount == 0 || trackHeight <= 0.0f) return out;
        const float rowPx = trackHeight / static_cast<float>(displayRowCount);
        const float h = std::max(minTickPx, rowPx);
        std::vector<ScrollMark> sorted(marks.begin(), marks.end());
        std::sort(sorted.begin(), sorted.end(), [](const ScrollMark& a, const ScrollMark& b)
        {
            return a.kind != b.kind ? a.kind < b.kind : a.displayRow < b.displayRow;
        });
        for (const ScrollMark& m : sorted)
        {
            const float y0 = std::min(trackY + rowPx * static_cast<float>(m.displayRow), trackY + trackHeight - h);
            if (!out.empty() && out.back().kind == m.kind && y0 <= out.back().y1)
            {
                out.back().y1 = std::max(out.back().y1, y0 + h);
                continue;
            }
            out.push_back({ y0, y0 + h, m.kind });
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::vector<ScrollMark> SearchMarksFromBuckets(std::span<const std::uint32_t> buckets, std::uint32_t lineCount,
                                                   const std::function<std::uint32_t(std::uint32_t)>& bufferToDisplay)
    {
        std::vector<ScrollMark> out;
        if (buckets.empty() || lineCount == 0) return out;
        for (std::size_t b = 0; b < buckets.size(); ++b)
        {
            if (buckets[b] == 0) continue;
            const auto row = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(b) * lineCount / buckets.size());
            out.push_back({ bufferToDisplay ? bufferToDisplay(row) : row, ScrollMarkKind::SearchMatch });
        }
        return out;
    }
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// Scrollbar annotations (text editor spec s5.1; TE4-16): search matches (the
// find bar worker's row histogram -- never a per-match list, so a log with a
// million hits costs one bucket per track pixel), every caret, and Problems
// warnings/errors, through the view's display map (folds respected).

#include "TextEditor/Document/ProblemMarkers.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextViewOverlay.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <span>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class ScrollbarOverlay final : public ITextViewOverlay
    {
    public:
        struct Sources
        {
            std::function<std::span<const std::uint32_t>()> matchBuckets;   // empty span = no search
            std::function<std::span<const ProblemMarker>()> problems;
        };
        explicit ScrollbarOverlay(Sources sources) : m_sources(std::move(sources)) {}
        void Scrollbar(const TextScrollbarPaint& p) override;
        // The track's height in pixels at the last draw: the histogram's bucket count (FindBarFrame).
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t TrackPixels() const noexcept { return m_trackPixels; }

    private:
        Sources m_sources;
        std::uint32_t m_trackPixels = 0;
    };
}
```

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/ScrollbarOverlay.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"
#include "Widgets/EditorTheme.hpp"

#include <imgui.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    void ScrollbarOverlay::Scrollbar(const TextScrollbarPaint& p)
    {
        const TextEditorView& view = *p.view;
        const Text::Rope& rope = view.Buffer().Text();
        const Text::DisplayMap& display = view.Display();
        m_trackPixels = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::max(0.0f, p.track.GetHeight()));
        const auto toDisplay = [&](std::uint32_t row) { return display.BufferRowToDisplay(row); };
        std::vector<Text::ScrollMark> marks;
        if (m_sources.matchBuckets)
        {
            const std::vector<Text::ScrollMark> s = Text::SearchMarksFromBuckets(m_sources.matchBuckets(), rope.LineCount(), toDisplay);
            marks.insert(marks.end(), s.begin(), s.end());
        }
        for (const Text::Selection& s : view.Selections().All())
            marks.push_back({ toDisplay(rope.OffsetToPoint(s.head).row), Text::ScrollMarkKind::Cursor });
        if (m_sources.problems)
            for (const ProblemMarker& m : m_sources.problems())
                if (m.severity != Arcane::DiagSeverity::Info)
                    marks.push_back({ toDisplay(m.row), m.severity == Arcane::DiagSeverity::Error ? Text::ScrollMarkKind::Error
                                                                                                  : Text::ScrollMarkKind::Warning });
        const std::vector<Text::ScrollTick> ticks = Text::BuildScrollTicks(marks, p.displayRowCount, p.track.Min.y, p.track.GetHeight(),
                                                                           std::max(1.0f, ImGui::GetFontSize() * 0.15f));
        const float w = p.track.GetWidth();
        p.drawList->PushClipRect(p.track.Min, p.track.Max, false);
        for (const Text::ScrollTick& t : ticks)
        {
            ImVec4 colour;
            float x0 = p.track.Min.x, x1 = p.track.Max.x;
            switch (t.kind)
            {
            case Text::ScrollMarkKind::SearchMatch: colour = Theme::WithAlpha(Theme::kAmber, 0.85f); x0 += w * 0.5f; break;   // right half
            case Text::ScrollMarkKind::Cursor:      colour = Theme::WithAlpha(Theme::kText, 0.7f); x0 += w * 0.25f; x1 -= w * 0.25f; break;
            case Text::ScrollMarkKind::Warning:     colour = Theme::kWarning; x1 -= w * 0.5f; break;                         // left half
            case Text::ScrollMarkKind::Error:       colour = Theme::kError; x1 -= w * 0.5f; break;
            }
            p.drawList->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(x0, t.y0), ImVec2(x1, t.y1), ImGui::GetColorU32(colour));
        }
        p.drawList->PopClipRect();
    }
}
```

### Task TE4-17: Split view -- a second view over the same buffer (spec s5.1, D8)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp` (TE2-11 + TE4-12: `ViewEditScope`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp` / `.cpp` (TE2-15: the second model and view, split / close / focus, per-view overlays, `DrawViews`; TE3-30's private helpers in the same files, as a later-task edit: `UpdateHighlightForViews()`'s body widens to the union of both views' visible rows, and the second view gets TE3-30's `SyntaxRowColors` row-colour function; TE2-19 + TE4-13's `GoTo` / `RevealPoint` act on the focused view)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp` (TE2-13, additive: the `RowColorRuns()` getter the colour test reads)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/SplitViewTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1-7 `SelectionSet::ApplyEdits(std::span<const EditShift>)` (a cursor maps Right, a selection's start Right and end Left: an outside insertion at an edge never grows it), TE1-8 `EditObserver`, `TextBuffer::{AddObserver, RemoveObserver, Undo, Version}`, TE1-12 `FoldModel::{Fold, UnfoldAll, Folded, MarkerFoldEnd}`, TE1-14 `TextCommands(buf, sels).InsertText`; TE2-11 `TextModel` (both constructors -- `TextModel(Text::TextBuffer& shared)` is TE2-11's, CANON A7/B7 -- and `SyncDisplay()`), TE2-13 `TextEditorView(TextModel&)`, `Draw(const char*, const ImVec2&, bool readOnly)`, `Focus()`, TE2-15 `TextDocument::{Open, Model, View, Buffer, ReadOnly}` (`View()` / `Model()` are the primary view / model, CANON B9; `Buffer()` is TE2-15's, CANON B10); TE3-30 `TextDocument::{Highlight, UpdateHighlight(std::uint32_t firstVisibleRow, std::uint32_t lastVisibleRow)}` and its private helpers `UpdateHighlightForViews()` (body widened here) and `SyntaxRowColors(std::uint32_t, std::vector<ViewColorRun>&)` (installed on the second view), TE2-13 `SetRowColorRuns` / `RowColorRunsFn` / `ViewColorRun`, TE2-19 + TE4-13 `TextDocument::{GoTo(Text::Point), RevealPoint}` (re-targeted to the focused view), TE3-14's UI catch-up settings `editor.text.{syncCatchUpLines, syncCatchUpBudgetUs, highlightFrameBudgetMs}` (test), `TextSyntaxService(std::unique_ptr<IHighlightExecutor>, std::filesystem::path)`, `ManualHighlightExecutor`, `HighlightCache::Peek` (test); TE3-19 `RefreshMarkerFolds`; TE4-9 `TextEditorView::{FirstVisibleDisplayRow, LastVisibleDisplayRow, SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow, Display}`; TE4-9..16 overlays (`m_areaOverlay`, `m_searchOverlay`, `m_bracketOverlay`, `m_markerOverlay`, `m_scrollOverlay`, `FoldGutterOverlay`); TE4-12 `TextModel::{folds, editing, followForeignEdits, editSync, markerGeneration}`, `FoldCommands::ToggleFoldAt` (test); `Test::TempDir` (`Helpers/TestEnvironment.hpp`), `Test::ScopedCodeRung` (`Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp`).
- Produces: `struct Editor::ViewEditScope` (RAII: marks a model as the one editing); `TextDocument::{SecondaryView() -> TextEditorView*, FocusedView() -> TextEditorView&, SplitOpen(), SplitVertical(), OpenSplit(bool vertical), CloseSplit(), CloseView(TextEditorView&), FocusOtherView(), ModelOf(TextEditorView&) -> TextModel&}` (CANON A7) -- the names TE6 consumes; TE5c's `:sp` (`OpenSplit(false)`), `:vs` (`OpenSplit(true)`), `Ctrl+W w` (`FocusOtherView()`), `Ctrl+W c` / `:q` on a split (`CloseView(FocusedView())`) use them. This task adds no `PrimaryView()` and no `Buffer()` (TE2-15's `View()` / `Buffer()` are canonical) and does not touch `TextModel`'s shape or `ReopenWithEncoding` (TE2-11 / TE2-15 own them, CANON B7). Additive on TE2-13's view: `[[nodiscard]] const RowColorRunsFn& TextEditorView::RowColorRuns() const` (the installed row-colour function; empty = rows draw plain). `TextDocument::GoTo(Text::Point)` keeps TE2-19's signature; from this task it (and `RevealPoint`) places the caret in, unfolds in and reveals in the FOCUSED view.

**How a split stays consistent.** Each view keeps its own `TextModel` -- selections, display map, folds -- over ONE `TextBuffer` (the second model uses TE2-11's shared-buffer constructor; the primary model owns the buffer and is declared first, so it outlives the second). TE1 already has the mechanism: `SelectionSet::ApplyEdits` maps selections through an edit made elsewhere, with the right biases. TE4-12's `EditSync` observer calls it for a model whose `followForeignEdits` is on (both models while split) unless that model is `editing` (its own view is running the command, which places those selections itself). `ViewEditScope` sets `editing` around a view's input, its dispatched actions and the find bar's update, so the editing view is never shifted twice. An undo through one view shifts the other the same way, and an external reload or append (no view editing) shifts both. Because TE2-15's Reopen with Encoding decodes into the same buffer (CANON A7), the second model, the find bar and the bookmarks stay valid across a reopen.

**Highlighting a split.** TE3-30's cache tokenizes the rows `UpdateHighlight(first, last)` names once per frame. A split must name the union of both views' visible buffer rows, or a far-scrolled second view stays uncoloured: the document calls `UpdateHighlight(min(first0, first1), max(last0, last1))` (the cache's frame budget still bounds the work per frame), then refreshes each model's marker folds (TE4-12's `RefreshMarkerFolds` call, now per model). This is TE3-30's private `UpdateHighlightForViews()` with a wider body -- it is not redeclared -- and it runs once per frame before either view draws. Asking the cache for the rows is half of it; the second view must also be ASKED for colours: TE3-30's `InitHighlight` installs `SyntaxRowColors` on the primary view only, so `OpenSplit` installs the same function on the second view (`SyntaxRowColors` reads the shared cache by buffer row and keeps no per-view state). The colouring test leans on TE3-14's UI-thread catch-up: with the `ManualHighlightExecutor` no worker job ever runs, so the far rows are coloured only because `HighlightCache::Line` tokenizes up to `editor.text.syncCatchUpLines` rows inside `syncCatchUpBudgetUs` -- the test raises both (and `highlightFrameBudgetMs`) with `ScopedCodeRung`; if TE3-14's catch-up rule or those setting names change, this test changes with them.

**Known limit (lossy close).** `CloseView` on the primary while split rebuilds the primary's folds from the second view's `Folded(rope)` as `FoldSource::Marker` (where a marker region starts) or `FoldSource::Indent` -- a vim `zf` fold (`FoldSource::Manual`, TE5) comes back as an Indent fold over the same rows. The rows stay folded; what changes is how a later edit or `zE` treats them. Carrying the source needs a `FoldModel` accessor for it (TE1-12 has none); deferred, recorded in the chunk self-review.

```cpp
    void DrawDocFrames(Editor::TextDocument& doc, int frames)

            ImGui::Render();
        }
        ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
        ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);

TEST_CASE("Split view: two models over one buffer -- an edit and an undo through one shift the other", "[text-split]")
{
    Editor::TextModel a(Rope::FromUtf8("abc\ndef"));
    Editor::TextModel b(a.buffer);                             // TE2-11's shared-buffer constructor
    a.followForeignEdits = b.followForeignEdits = true;
    a.selections.SetSingle(0, 0);
    b.selections.SetSingle(5, 5);
    {
        Editor::ViewEditScope edit(a);
        TextCommands(a.buffer, a.selections).InsertText("XX");  // view A types at the top
    }
    CHECK(a.selections.Primary().head == 2);                   // A placed its own caret, once
    CHECK(b.selections.Primary().head == 7);                   // B followed
    {
        Editor::ViewEditScope edit(a);
        CHECK(a.buffer.Undo(a.selections));                    // A undoes: B follows back
    }
    CHECK(b.selections.Primary().head == 5);
    b.selections.SetSingle(4, 7);                              // B selects "def"
    {
        Editor::ViewEditScope edit(a);
        a.selections.SetSingle(4, 4);
        TextCommands(a.buffer, a.selections).InsertText("__");  // exactly at B's selection start
    }
    CHECK(b.selections.Primary().anchor == 6);                 // the selection did not grow
    CHECK(b.selections.Primary().head == 9);
}

TEST_CASE("Split view: the document's second view has its own folds and selections; close keeps one", "[text-split]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path path = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "te4-split.txt";
    auto doc = OpenText(path, "one\ntwo\n  three\nfour\n");
    REQUIRE(doc);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->SplitOpen());
    CHECK(doc->SecondaryView() == nullptr);
    doc->OpenSplit(true);
    REQUIRE(doc->SplitOpen());
    CHECK(doc->SplitVertical());
    Editor::TextEditorView& v0 = doc->View();
    Editor::TextEditorView& v1 = *doc->SecondaryView();
    CHECK(&v0.Buffer() == &v1.Buffer());
    CHECK(&v1.Buffer() == &doc->Buffer());
    CHECK(&v0.Selections() != &v1.Selections());
    CHECK(FoldCommands::ToggleFoldAt(v1.Folds(), v1.Display(), v1.Buffer().Text(), 1, 4));   // "two" folds "  three" in view 1 only
    CHECK(v1.Display().DisplayRowCount() + 1 == v0.Display().DisplayRowCount());
    v1.Selections().SetSingle(8, 8);                           // view 1's caret at "  three"
    {
        Editor::ViewEditScope edit(doc->ModelOf(v0));
        v0.Selections().SetSingle(0, 0);
        TextCommands(v0.Buffer(), v0.Selections()).InsertText(">> ");
    }
    CHECK(v1.Selections().Primary().head == 11);
    CHECK(v1.Folds().IsFoldedAt(v1.Buffer().Text(), 1));       // view 1's fold followed the edit too
    doc->OpenSplit(false);                                     // already split: no third view
    CHECK(doc->SplitVertical());
    doc->CloseSplit();                                         // focus is on the primary: the second view closes
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->SplitOpen());
    CHECK(doc->SecondaryView() == nullptr);
    CHECK(doc->View().Selections().Primary().head == 3);       // the primary kept its own caret (after ">> ")
    doc.reset();
    std::filesystem::remove(path);
}

TEST_CASE("Split view: FocusOtherView alternates; CloseView on the primary moves the second view's state into it", "[text-split]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path path = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "te4-split-close.txt";
    auto doc = OpenText(path, "one\ntwo\n  three\nfour\n");
    REQUIRE(doc);
    doc->FocusOtherView();                                     // not split: nothing to focus
    CHECK(&doc->FocusedView() == &doc->View());
    doc->OpenSplit(false);
    CHECK(&doc->FocusedView() == &doc->View());
    doc->FocusOtherView();
    CHECK(&doc->FocusedView() == doc->SecondaryView());
    doc->FocusOtherView();
    CHECK(&doc->FocusedView() == &doc->View());

    doc->FocusOtherView();                                     // GoTo acts on the FOCUSED view
    doc->View().Selections().SetSingle(0, 0);
    doc->GoTo({ 3, 0 });
    CHECK(doc->SecondaryView()->Selections().Primary().head == 16u);
    CHECK(doc->View().Selections().Primary().head == 0u);      // the primary's caret did not move
    doc->FocusOtherView();
    REQUIRE(&doc->FocusedView() == &doc->View());

    Editor::TextEditorView& v1 = *doc->SecondaryView();
    REQUIRE(FoldCommands::ToggleFoldAt(v1.Folds(), v1.Display(), v1.Buffer().Text(), 1, 4));
    v1.Selections().SetSingle(16, 16);                         // view 1's caret at "four"
    doc->View().Selections().SetSingle(0, 0);
    doc->CloseView(doc->View());                               // close the PRIMARY while split
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->SplitOpen());
    CHECK(doc->View().Selections().Primary().head == 16);      // the second view's caret survived
    CHECK(doc->View().Folds().IsFoldedAt(doc->Buffer().Text(), 1));   // and its fold
    CHECK(doc->View().Display().DisplayRowCount() == 4u);      // the primary's display follows the moved fold
    CHECK(&doc->FocusedView() == &doc->View());

    doc->OpenSplit(true);
    doc->SecondaryView()->Selections().SetSingle(0, 0);
    doc->CloseView(*doc->SecondaryView());                     // closing the second view leaves the primary as it was
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->SplitOpen());
    CHECK(doc->View().Selections().Primary().head == 16u);
    doc->CloseView(doc->View());                               // the only view: the document closes it, not CloseView
    CHECK(doc->View().Selections().Primary().head == 16u);
    doc.reset();
    std::filesystem::remove(path);
}

TEST_CASE("Split view: a far-scrolled second view gets coloured rows (UpdateHighlight covers the union of both views)", "[text-split][text-view]")
{
    Test::TempDir dir("te4_split_highlight");
    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir.path / "engine");
    {
        std::ofstream(dir.path / "engine" / "Test.arcsyntax", std::ios::binary)
            << R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":"Test","scope":"source.t","files":[".tst"],)"
               R"("patterns":[{"match":"//.*$","scope":"comment.line.t"},{"match":"[0-9]+","scope":"constant.numeric.t"}]})";
    }
    std::string text;
    for (int i = 0; i < 600; ++i) text += "12 // c\n";
    // Let one frame tokenize far ahead: the union may span hundreds of rows.
    const Test::ScopedCodeRung lines("editor.text.syncCatchUpLines", CVarValue::UInt32(100000));
    const Test::ScopedCodeRung catchUp("editor.text.syncCatchUpBudgetUs", CVarValue::UInt32(10000000));
    const Test::ScopedCodeRung frameBudget("editor.text.highlightFrameBudgetMs", CVarValue::UInt32(10000));
    Editor::TextSyntaxService svc(std::make_unique<Text::ManualHighlightExecutor>(), dir.path / "engine");
    svc.Tick(0.0);
    Editor::TextDocumentServices services;
    services.syntax = &svc;
    auto doc = OpenText(dir.path / "a.tst", text, services);
    REQUIRE(doc);
    REQUIRE(doc->Highlight() != nullptr);
    doc->OpenSplit(false);
    doc->SecondaryView()->SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow(500);      // the primary stays at the top
    DrawDocFrames(*doc, 4);
    REQUIRE(doc->SecondaryView()->FirstVisibleDisplayRow() >= 450u);
    const std::uint32_t row = doc->SecondaryView()->FirstVisibleDisplayRow() + 1;
    const Text::LineTokens* tokens = doc->Highlight()->Peek(row);
    REQUIRE(tokens != nullptr);                                // coloured: the cache was asked for the second view's rows
    CHECK_FALSE(tokens->runs.empty());
    CHECK(doc->Highlight()->Peek(0) != nullptr);               // and the primary's
    // ... and the second view ASKS for them: OpenSplit installed SyntaxRowColors on it (a view
    // without a row-colour function draws every row plain, whatever the cache holds).
    const Editor::RowColorRunsFn& colours = doc->SecondaryView()->RowColorRuns();
    REQUIRE(colours);
    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();                // SyntaxRowColors reads ImGuiCol_Text
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    std::vector<Editor::ViewColorRun> runs;
    CHECK(colours(row, runs));
    CHECK(runs.size() >= 2u);                                  // "12" numeric, then the comment
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
}
```

`TextModel.hpp` (TE2-11 + TE4-12) -- append after `struct TextModel` (the model's shape is TE2-11's; nothing else changes):

```cpp
    // Marks `model` as the one whose view is editing for the scope: its EditSync does not
    // shift its selections (the command places them); every other model's does.
    struct ViewEditScope
    {
        explicit ViewEditScope(TextModel& m) : model(m), previous(m.editing) { model.editing = true; }
        ~ViewEditScope() { model.editing = previous; }
        ViewEditScope(const ViewEditScope&) = delete;
        ViewEditScope& operator=(const ViewEditScope&) = delete;
        TextModel& model;
        bool previous;
    };
```

`TextDocument.cpp` -- the constructor's per-overlay `View().AddOverlay(...)` lines added by TE4-9, TE4-11, TE4-12, TE4-14, TE4-15 and TE4-16 become one `AttachOverlays(View(), Model());`, and:

```cpp
    void TextDocument::AttachOverlays(TextEditorView& view, TextModel& model)
    {
        view.AddOverlay(&m_areaOverlay);
        view.AddOverlay(&m_searchOverlay);
        auto fold = std::make_unique<FoldGutterOverlay>(model, [] { return Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().tabSize; });
        view.AddOverlay(fold.get());
        m_foldOverlays.push_back(std::move(fold));
        view.AddOverlay(&m_bracketOverlay);
        view.AddOverlay(&m_markerOverlay);
        view.AddOverlay(&m_scrollOverlay);
    }

    void TextDocument::OpenSplit(bool vertical)
    {
        if (m_secondView) return;
        TextModel& primary = Model();
        m_secondModel = std::make_unique<TextModel>(primary.buffer);
        m_secondModel->selections = primary.selections;             // the new view starts where the old one is
        m_secondModel->followForeignEdits = true;
        primary.followForeignEdits = true;
        m_secondView = std::make_unique<TextEditorView>(*m_secondModel);
        AttachOverlays(*m_secondView, *m_secondModel);
        if (Highlight())   // TE3-30's InitHighlight coloured the primary only; the shared cache colours both
            m_secondView->SetRowColorRuns([this](std::uint32_t row, std::vector<ViewColorRun>& out) { return SyntaxRowColors(row, out); });
        // The second model has no folds yet, so its display row IS the primary's top buffer row.
        m_secondView->SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow(primary.display.DisplayRowToBuffer(View().FirstVisibleDisplayRow()));
        m_splitVertical = vertical;
        m_focused = 0;
    }

    void TextDocument::CloseView(TextEditorView& view)
    {
        if (!m_secondView) return;
        if (&view == &View())
        {
            // The primary owns the buffer, so it stays; it takes over the second view's place.
            TextModel& primary = Model();
            const Text::Rope& rope = primary.buffer.Text();
            primary.selections = m_secondModel->selections;
            primary.folds.UnfoldAll();
            for (const Text::FoldRange& f : m_secondModel->folds.Folded(rope))
                primary.folds.Fold(rope, f, m_secondModel->folds.MarkerFoldEnd(f.headerRow) ? Text::FoldSource::Marker
                                                                                             : Text::FoldSource::Indent);
            primary.markerGeneration = 0;                                // re-read marker folds next frame
            primary.SyncDisplay();                                       // same folds: the display rows now match
            View().SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow(m_secondView->FirstVisibleDisplayRow());
        }
        else if (&view != m_secondView.get())
        {
            return;
        }
        m_foldOverlays.resize(1);
        m_secondView.reset();
        m_secondModel.reset();
        Model().followForeignEdits = false;
        m_focused = 0;
    }

    void TextDocument::CloseSplit()
    {
        if (!m_secondView) return;
        CloseView(m_focused == 1 ? View() : *m_secondView);              // the focused view's place survives
    }

    void TextDocument::FocusOtherView()
    {
        if (!m_secondView) return;
        m_focused = m_focused == 1 ? 0 : 1;
        FocusedView().Focus();
    }

    // Replaces the body of TE3-30's UpdateHighlightForViews() (same private declaration).
    void TextDocument::UpdateHighlightForViews()
    {
        Model().SyncDisplay();                                           // as TE3-30's body did: folds current
        if (m_secondModel) m_secondModel->SyncDisplay();
        // Visible buffer rows of one view, from its last frame (CANON: union across a split).
        const auto rowsOf = [](TextEditorView& v) -> std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t>
        {
            const Text::DisplayMap& d = v.Display();
            const std::uint32_t count = d.DisplayRowCount();
            const std::uint32_t lastD = count > 0 ? std::min(v.LastVisibleDisplayRow(), count - 1) : 0u;
            const std::uint32_t firstD = std::min(v.FirstVisibleDisplayRow(), lastD);
            return { d.DisplayRowToBuffer(firstD), d.DisplayRowToBuffer(lastD) };
        };
        auto [first, last] = rowsOf(View());
        if (m_secondView)
        {
            const auto [first1, last1] = rowsOf(*m_secondView);
            first = std::min(first, first1);
            last = std::max(last, last1);
        }
        UpdateHighlight(first, last);                                    // TE3-30: no-op without a cache
        if (Text::HighlightCache* h = Highlight())
        {
            Text::RefreshMarkerFolds(Model().folds, *h, Model().markerGeneration);           // TE4-12, per model
            if (m_secondModel) Text::RefreshMarkerFolds(m_secondModel->folds, *h, m_secondModel->markerGeneration);
        }
    }

    void TextDocument::DrawViews(const ImVec2& size)
    {
        if (!m_secondView) { DrawOneView(View(), Model(), 0, "##text0", size); return; }
        const ImGuiStyle& style = ImGui::GetStyle();
        if (m_splitVertical)
        {
            const ImVec2 half((size.x - style.ItemSpacing.x) * 0.5f, size.y);
            DrawOneView(View(), Model(), 0, "##text0", half);
            ImGui::SameLine();
            DrawOneView(*m_secondView, *m_secondModel, 1, "##text1", half);
        }
        else
        {
            const ImVec2 half(size.x, (size.y - style.ItemSpacing.y) * 0.5f);
            DrawOneView(View(), Model(), 0, "##text0", half);
            DrawOneView(*m_secondView, *m_secondModel, 1, "##text1", half);
        }
    }

    void TextDocument::DrawOneView(TextEditorView& view, TextModel& model, std::size_t index, const char* id, const ImVec2& size)
    {
        ViewEditScope edit(model);                                 // this view's input edits through its own selections
        view.Draw(id, size, ReadOnly());
        if (view.Focused()) m_focused = index;
    }
```

(`TextDocument.cpp` includes `<algorithm>` and `<utility>`.) In `Draw`: TE3-30's `UpdateHighlightForViews();` call stays where it is (once per frame, before any view draws) and the `RefreshMarkerFolds` line TE4-12 added after it is deleted (the new body refreshes both models); TE2's single `View().Draw(...)` call becomes `DrawViews(ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail());` (TE4-19 subtracts the status strip's height); the find bar's update runs inside `ViewEditScope edit(ModelOf(FocusedView()));`.

`GoTo` (TE2-19's signature, TE4-13's body) and `RevealPoint` now act on the focused view (a split's Ctrl+G, bookmark jumps and an `OpenAt` land where the user is looking; unsplit, `FocusedView()` is `View()`); TE4-13's go-to-line popup in `Draw` reads its `rope` / `currentRow` through `FocusedView()` instead of `View()` to match:

```cpp
    void TextDocument::GoTo(Text::Point at)
    {
        TextEditorView& view = FocusedView();
        TextModel& model = ModelOf(view);
        const Text::Rope& text = model.buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t row = std::min(at.row, text.LineCount() - 1);
        const Text::ByteOffset o = std::min<Text::ByteOffset>(text.LineStart(row) + at.col, text.LineEnd(row));
        Text::TextCommands(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model))
            .SetSelections({ Text::Selection{ 0, o, o, std::nullopt } });
        Text::FoldCommands::RevealSelections(model.folds, model.display, model.selections, text);   // TE4-13
        view.RevealOffset(o, true);   // centred (spec s9)
    }

    void TextDocument::RevealPoint(std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t col)
    {
        GoTo(Text::Point{ row, col });
        FocusedView().Focus();
    }
```

`TextEditorView.hpp` (TE2-13), public, beside `SetRowColorRuns` -- additive:

### Task TE4-18: A document's own indentation -- detection on open, the per-document override (spec s8 `detectIndentation`, s5.2, s5.3)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/IndentDetect.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/IndentDetect.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp` / `.cpp` (one Dev row: `detectIndentationRows`)
- Modify: `docs/superpowers/audits/2026-10-03-settings-inventory.md` (one Part 3 `### Text editor` row, one amendment row), `scripts/settings-frozen-names.txt` (regenerated)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextSettingsContractTest.cpp` (TE4-3's `kS8Amended` array gains `"detectIndentationRows"`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp` / `.cpp` (TE2-11: the model carries the indentation its commands use; `DefaultEditContext` applies it -- CANON A3, there is no `CommandContext`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp` / `.cpp` (TE2-15: detect on open; `Indentation()` / `SetIndentation()`; the overlays read it)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/IndentDetectTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1 `Rope::{LineCount, LineStart, LineEnd, CopyTo}`; TE1-15 `TextSettings::{tabSize, insertSpaces}`, `EditContext::{tabSize, insertSpaces}`, `Editor::ApplyEditSettings(const TextSettings&, Text::EditContext&)`; TE4-3 `TextSettings::detectIndentation`; TE2-15 `TextDocument::Open`; TE2-11 `DefaultEditContext(TextModel&)` (its body gains the model's indentation here); TE4-9 / TE4-12 / TE4-17 overlays (`TextAreaOverlay`, `FoldGutterOverlay`); `Test::ScopedCodeRung` (`ArcaneTests/src/Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp:40-61`).
- Produces: `struct Text::IndentStyle { std::uint32_t width = 4; bool spaces = true; bool operator==(const IndentStyle&) const = default; }`; `Text::DetectIndentation(const Rope&, std::uint32_t maxRows, std::uint32_t tabWidth) -> std::optional<IndentStyle>`; `TextSettings::detectIndentationRows` (`editor.text.detectIndentationRows`, Dev, 10000); `TextModel::indent` (the style the model's commands use); `[[nodiscard]] Text::IndentStyle Arcane::Editor::SettingsIndentation()` (free function in `View/TextModel.hpp`: `{ max(1, tabSize), insertSpaces }` from `Settings<TextSettings>()`); `TextDocument::Indentation() -> Text::IndentStyle` (the user's choice, else the detected one, else the settings) and `TextDocument::SetIndentation(Text::IndentStyle)`. TE4-19 (status strip) and TE4-20 (Inspector) edit it; TE4-24 builds command contexts from it; TE5's `>` / `<` / `Ctrl+T` / `Ctrl+D` and `:set sw` read it.

Detection is VS Code's approach: a line indented with a tab votes for tabs; for space-indented lines the most frequent change in indentation between consecutive non-blank lines (2..8; a 1-space change is alignment, not indentation) is the width. It reads at most `editor.text.detectIndentationRows` rows, so opening a 400 MB log never scans it whole.

```cpp
// TE4-18 (spec s8 detectIndentation, s5.2, s5.3): a file's own indentation is
// detected on open and wins over tabSize / insertSpaces; the user's choice wins
// over both, per document.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/IndentDetect.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Text;

TEST_CASE("Indentation detection: tabs, 2 spaces, 4 spaces, none, and the row bound", "[text-indent]")
{
    const auto detect = [](std::string_view text, std::uint32_t maxRows = 10000) { return DetectIndentation(Rope::FromUtf8(text), maxRows, 4); };
    CHECK(detect("{\n\t\"a\": 1,\n\t\"b\": {\n\t\t\"c\": 2\n\t}\n}\n") == IndentStyle{ 4, false });
    CHECK(detect("{\n  \"a\": 1,\n  \"b\": {\n    \"c\": 2\n  }\n}\n") == IndentStyle{ 2, true });
    CHECK(detect("{\n    \"a\": 1,\n    \"b\": {\n        \"c\": 2\n    }\n}\n") == IndentStyle{ 4, true });
    CHECK(detect("f(a,\n  b,\n   c)\nx\n  y\n") == IndentStyle{ 2, true });        // the 1-space alignment step is ignored
    CHECK_FALSE(detect("a\nb\nc\n").has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(detect("a\nb\nc\n  d\n", 3).has_value());                          // the indented row is past the bound
    CHECK(detect("a\n\tb\n  c\n  d\n    e\n") == IndentStyle{ 2, true });           // more space lines than tab lines
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// A file's own indentation (text editor spec s8 detectIndentation; TE4-18).

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct IndentStyle
    {
        std::uint32_t width = 4;    // columns per indent level (a tab's width when !spaces)
        bool spaces = true;
        bool operator==(const IndentStyle&) const = default;
    };

    // Tabs when more indented lines start with a tab than with spaces (width = tabWidth);
    // otherwise the most frequent indentation step (2..8) between consecutive non-blank
    // lines. nullopt when the first maxRows rows show no indentation.
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<IndentStyle> DetectIndentation(const Rope& rope, std::uint32_t maxRows, std::uint32_t tabWidth);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/IndentDetect.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/IndentDetect.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::optional<IndentStyle> DetectIndentation(const Rope& rope, std::uint32_t maxRows, std::uint32_t tabWidth)
    {
        std::uint32_t tabLines = 0, spaceLines = 0;
        std::array<std::uint32_t, 9> steps{};                    // steps[d]: indentation changed by d spaces
        std::uint32_t previous = 0;
        bool previousValid = false;
        std::string line;
        const std::uint32_t rows = std::min(rope.LineCount(), maxRows);
        for (std::uint32_t r = 0; r < rows; ++r)
        {
            line.clear();
            rope.CopyTo({ rope.LineStart(r), rope.LineEnd(r) }, line);
            std::size_t lead = 0;
            while (lead < line.size() && (line[lead] == ' ' || line[lead] == '\t')) ++lead;
            if (lead == line.size()) continue;                   // blank: keeps the previous indentation
            if (line.find('\t', 0) < lead)
            {
                ++tabLines;
                previousValid = false;
                continue;
            }
            const auto spaces = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(lead);
            if (spaces > 0) ++spaceLines;
            if (previousValid && spaces != previous)
            {
                const std::uint32_t d = spaces > previous ? spaces - previous : previous - spaces;
                if (d < steps.size()) ++steps[d];
            }
            previous = spaces;
            previousValid = true;
        }
        if (tabLines == 0 && spaceLines == 0) return std::nullopt;
        if (tabLines > spaceLines) return IndentStyle{ std::max<std::uint32_t>(1, tabWidth), false };
        std::uint32_t best = 0;
        for (std::uint32_t d = 2; d < steps.size(); ++d)
            if (steps[d] > steps[best]) best = d;                // ties keep the smaller step
        if (best == 0) return std::nullopt;
        return IndentStyle{ best, true };
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text document's footer (text editor spec s5.2, s3.5; TE4-19): Ln/Col,
// selections, then -- each clickable to change -- indentation, encoding
// (Reopen with Encoding), line endings (convert; "Mixed" noted, never silently
// fixed), language (the picker); the read-only badge; a split toggle; a note
// line; and a slot the vim chunk fills (mode, pending keys, recording). TE6-4
// adds the Follow toggle to the state and actions. Draw REPORTS picks in
// TextStatusStripActions; the document applies them after Draw.

#include "TextEditor/Core/EolMap.hpp"         // Eol
#include "TextEditor/Core/IndentDetect.hpp"   // IndentStyle
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"           // Point
#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"      // Text::TextEncoding

#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    enum class TextReadOnlyReason : std::uint8_t;   // TE2-15, TextDocument.hpp (which includes this header)

    struct TextStatusStripState
    {
        Text::Point primary{};                  // the primary caret
        std::string_view primaryLineText;       // its line, for the display column
        std::uint32_t tabSize = 4;
        std::size_t selectionCount = 1;
        std::uint64_t selectedChars = 0;        // characters in the single selection
        std::string encodingLabel;              // TE2-15's EncodingLabel(TextEncoding)
        Text::Eol eol = Text::Eol::LF;
        bool mixedEol = false;
        Text::IndentStyle indent{};
        std::string_view language;              // "" = Plain Text
        std::function<std::vector<std::string>()> languages;   // the picker's list (only called while it is open)
        std::optional<std::string> readOnlyReason;
        bool split = false;
        std::string note;                       // TextDocument::Note() (TE2-15; "" = none). TE6-4 adds followAvailable, following.
    };

    struct TextStatusStripActions
    {
        std::optional<Text::TextEncoding> reopenWith;
        std::optional<Text::Eol> convertEol;
        std::optional<Text::IndentStyle> setIndentation;
        std::optional<std::string> setLanguage;
        bool toggleSplit = false;
    };

    struct StatusStripText
    {
        std::string position, selection, encoding, eol, eolTooltip, indentation, language, readOnly, readOnlyTooltip, note;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t DisplayColumn(std::string_view line, std::uint32_t byteCol, std::uint32_t tabSize);   // 0-based
    [[nodiscard]] std::string_view EolLabel(Text::Eol eol) noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] std::string ReadOnlyBadgeText(TextReadOnlyReason reason);
    [[nodiscard]] StatusStripText BuildStatusStripText(const TextStatusStripState& state);

    enum class StatusSlot : std::uint8_t { VimMode = 0 };

    class TextStatusStrip
    {
    public:
        void SetSlot(StatusSlot slot, std::function<void()> draw) { m_slots[static_cast<std::size_t>(slot)] = std::move(draw); }
        [[nodiscard]] bool HasSlot(StatusSlot slot) const noexcept { return static_cast<bool>(m_slots[static_cast<std::size_t>(slot)]); }
        void Draw(const TextStatusStripState& state, TextStatusStripActions& actions);

    private:
        std::array<std::function<void()>, 1> m_slots;
        std::string m_languageFilter;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextStatusStrip.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextStatusStrip.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"   // TextReadOnlyReason
#include "Widgets/EditorTheme.hpp"
#include "Widgets/EditorWidgets.hpp"
#include "Widgets/IconsLucide.h"

#include <imgui.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <format>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        std::size_t NextCodePoint(std::string_view s, std::size_t i)
        {
            if (i >= s.size()) return i + 1;
            const auto b = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]);
            const std::size_t len = b < 0x80 ? 1 : (b >> 5) == 0x6 ? 2 : (b >> 4) == 0xE ? 3 : (b >> 3) == 0x1E ? 4 : 1;
            if (i + len > s.size()) return i + 1;
            for (std::size_t k = 1; k < len; ++k)
                if ((static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i + k]) & 0xC0) != 0x80) return i + 1;
            return i + len;
        }

        bool Segment(const std::string& label, const char* id, const char* popup, const std::string& tooltip)
        {
            const bool clicked = ImGui::SmallButton((label + id).c_str());
            if (!tooltip.empty() && ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_ForTooltip)) ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", tooltip.c_str());
            if (clicked) ImGui::OpenPopup(popup);
            return clicked;
        }
    }

    std::uint32_t DisplayColumn(std::string_view line, std::uint32_t byteCol, std::uint32_t tabSize)
    {
        tabSize = std::max<std::uint32_t>(1, tabSize);
        std::uint32_t col = 0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < line.size() && i < byteCol;)
        {
            if (line[i] == '\t') { col += tabSize - col % tabSize; ++i; continue; }
            i = NextCodePoint(line, i);
            ++col;
        }
        return col;
    }

    std::string_view EolLabel(Text::Eol eol) noexcept
    {
        switch (eol)
        {
        case Text::Eol::LF:   return "LF";
        case Text::Eol::CRLF: return "CRLF";
        case Text::Eol::CR:   return "CR";
        }
        return "?";
    }

    std::string ReadOnlyBadgeText(TextReadOnlyReason reason)
    {
        switch (reason)
        {
        case TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8: return "Not valid UTF-8: opened read-only. Reopen with Encoding > Windows 1252 to edit it.";
        case TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16: return "Not valid UTF-16 (an unpaired surrogate): opened read-only.";
        case TextReadOnlyReason::Binary:      return "Binary content: opened read-only.";
        case TextReadOnlyReason::Locked:      return "Opened as text beside its dedicated editor: Enable editing to change it.";
        case TextReadOnlyReason::None:        break;
        }
        return {};
    }

    StatusStripText BuildStatusStripText(const TextStatusStripState& s)
    {
        StatusStripText t;
        t.position = std::format("Ln {}, Col {}", s.primary.row + 1, DisplayColumn(s.primaryLineText, s.primary.col, s.tabSize) + 1);
        if (s.selectionCount > 1) t.selection = std::format("{} selections", s.selectionCount);
        else if (s.selectedChars > 0) t.selection = std::format("{} selected", s.selectedChars);
        t.encoding = s.encodingLabel;
        t.note = s.note;
        t.eol = s.mixedEol ? std::format("Mixed ({})", EolLabel(s.eol)) : std::string(EolLabel(s.eol));
        if (s.mixedEol)
            t.eolTooltip = std::format("This file mixes line endings. Every line keeps its own; new lines use {}. "
                                       "Pick one to convert every line (one undo step).", EolLabel(s.eol));
        t.indentation = s.indent.spaces ? std::format("Spaces: {}", s.indent.width) : std::format("Tab Size: {}", s.indent.width);
        t.language = s.language.empty() ? std::string("Plain Text") : std::string(s.language);
        if (s.readOnlyReason)
        {
            t.readOnly = "Read-only";
            t.readOnlyTooltip = *s.readOnlyReason;
        }
        return t;
    }

    void TextStatusStrip::Draw(const TextStatusStripState& s, TextStatusStripActions& a)
    {
        const StatusStripText t = BuildStatusStripText(s);
        ImGui::PushID("statusstrip");
        ImGui::Separator();
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(t.position.c_str());
        if (!t.selection.empty()) { ImGui::SameLine(); ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", t.selection.c_str()); }
        if (m_slots[0]) { ImGui::SameLine(); m_slots[0](); }
        if (!t.note.empty()) { ImGui::SameLine(); ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", t.note.c_str()); }

        // The right-hand group, measured so it ends at the window's right edge.
        const ImGuiStyle& style = ImGui::GetStyle();
        const auto buttonWidth = [&](const std::string& text) { return ImGui::CalcTextSize(text.c_str()).x + style.FramePadding.x * 2.0f + style.ItemSpacing.x; };
        float right = buttonWidth(t.indentation) + buttonWidth(t.encoding) + buttonWidth(t.eol) + buttonWidth(t.language)
                    + ImGui::GetFrameHeight() + style.ItemSpacing.x;
        if (!t.readOnly.empty()) right += ImGui::CalcTextSize(t.readOnly.c_str()).x + style.ItemSpacing.x;
        ImGui::SameLine(std::max(0.0f, ImGui::GetWindowContentRegionMax().x - right));

        if (!t.readOnly.empty())
        {
            ImGui::TextColored(Theme::kAmber, "%s", t.readOnly.c_str());
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_ForTooltip)) ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", t.readOnlyTooltip.c_str());
            ImGui::SameLine();
        }
        if (IconToggle(ICON_LC_COLUMNS_2 "##split", s.split)) a.toggleSplit = true;
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_ForTooltip)) ImGui::SetTooltip("Split view");

        ImGui::SameLine();
        Segment(t.indentation, "##indent", "##indentmenu", "Indentation");
        if (ImGui::BeginPopup("##indentmenu"))
        {
            if (ImGui::MenuItem("Indent Using Spaces", nullptr, s.indent.spaces)) a.setIndentation = Text::IndentStyle{ s.indent.width, true };
            if (ImGui::MenuItem("Indent Using Tabs", nullptr, !s.indent.spaces)) a.setIndentation = Text::IndentStyle{ s.indent.width, false };
            ImGui::Separator();
            for (const std::uint32_t width : { 2u, 4u, 8u })
                if (ImGui::MenuItem(std::format("Width: {}", width).c_str(), nullptr, s.indent.width == width))
                    a.setIndentation = Text::IndentStyle{ width, s.indent.spaces };
            ImGui::EndPopup();
        }

        ImGui::SameLine();
        Segment(t.encoding, "##encoding", "##encodingmenu", "Encoding: click to reopen with another");
        if (ImGui::BeginPopup("##encodingmenu"))
        {
            ImGui::TextDisabled("Reopen with Encoding");                  // spec s3.5: UTF-8, or Windows-1252 for legacy files
            if (ImGui::MenuItem("UTF-8")) a.reopenWith = Text::TextEncoding::Utf8;
            if (ImGui::MenuItem("Windows 1252")) a.reopenWith = Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252;
            ImGui::EndPopup();
        }

        ImGui::SameLine();
        Segment(t.eol, "##eol", "##eolmenu", t.eolTooltip.empty() ? std::string("Line endings: click to convert") : t.eolTooltip);
        if (ImGui::BeginPopup("##eolmenu"))
        {
            ImGui::TextDisabled("Convert every line to");
            for (const Text::Eol e : { Text::Eol::LF, Text::Eol::CRLF })
                if (ImGui::MenuItem(std::string(EolLabel(e)).c_str(), nullptr, !s.mixedEol && s.eol == e)) a.convertEol = e;
            ImGui::EndPopup();
        }

        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (Segment(t.language, "##language", "##languagemenu", "Language: click to pick")) m_languageFilter.clear();
        if (ImGui::BeginPopup("##languagemenu"))
        {
            if (ImGui::IsWindowAppearing()) ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
            InputTextString("##filter", &m_languageFilter);
            const auto lower = [](std::string text)
            {
                for (char& c : text) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
                return text;
            };
            const std::string filter = lower(m_languageFilter);
            if (s.languages)
                for (const std::string& name : s.languages())
                {
                    if (!filter.empty() && lower(name).find(filter) == std::string::npos) continue;
                    if (ImGui::MenuItem(name.c_str(), nullptr, name == s.language)) a.setLanguage = name;
                }
            ImGui::EndPopup();
        }
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
}
```

`TextDocument` (TE2-15) changes: include `TextEditor/View/TextStatusStrip.hpp`; public `TextStatusStrip& StatusStrip() noexcept { return m_status; }`; private `TextStatusStrip m_status; std::uint64_t m_selCharsVersion = ~std::uint64_t{ 0 }; Text::ByteRange m_selCharsRange{}; std::uint64_t m_selChars = 0; std::uint64_t SelectedChars();`:

```cpp
    // Characters in the single selection; recounted only when the text or the selection changed
    // (a Ctrl+A over a large log counts once, not every frame).
    std::uint64_t TextDocument::SelectedChars()
    {
        const Text::Selection& p = FocusedView().Selections().Primary();
        const Text::ByteRange r{ std::min(p.anchor, p.head), std::max(p.anchor, p.head) };
        if (r.begin == r.end) return 0;
        if (m_selCharsVersion == Buffer().Version() && m_selCharsRange.begin == r.begin && m_selCharsRange.end == r.end) return m_selChars;
        std::uint64_t n = 0;
        Buffer().Text().ForEachChunk(r, [&](std::string_view chunk)
        {
            for (const char c : chunk) n += (static_cast<unsigned char>(c) & 0xC0) != 0x80 ? 1u : 0u;
        });
        m_selCharsVersion = Buffer().Version();
        m_selCharsRange = r;
        m_selChars = n;
        return n;
    }
```

In `Draw`: the views get the height left after the footer -- `const float footer = ImGui::GetFrameHeightWithSpacing() + ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.y;` and `DrawViews(ImVec2(avail.x, avail.y - footer))` (TE4-17's call) -- then after the views:

```cpp
        TextEditorView& focused = FocusedView();
        const Text::Rope& rope = Buffer().Text();
        TextStatusStripState state;
        state.primary = rope.OffsetToPoint(focused.Selections().Primary().head);
        std::string line;
        rope.CopyTo({ rope.LineStart(state.primary.row), rope.LineEnd(state.primary.row) }, line);
        state.primaryLineText = line;
        state.indent = Indentation();
        state.tabSize = state.indent.width;
        state.selectionCount = focused.Selections().Size();
        state.selectedChars = state.selectionCount == 1 ? SelectedChars() : 0;
        state.encodingLabel = EncodingLabel(Encoding());
        state.note = Note();                                                   // TE2-15: the one note channel
        state.eol = Buffer().Eols().Dominant();
        state.mixedEol = Buffer().Eols().IsMixed();
        const Text::GrammarSnapshot grammar = Grammar();
        state.language = grammar ? std::string_view(grammar->Name()) : std::string_view{};
        state.languages = [this]                                               // TE3-30's service; none = Plain Text only
        {
            return m_services.syntax ? m_services.syntax->Registry().Names() : std::vector<std::string>{ "Plain Text" };
        };
        if (ReadOnly()) state.readOnlyReason = ReadOnlyBadgeText(ReadOnlyReason());
        state.split = SplitOpen();
        TextStatusStripActions actions;
        m_status.Draw(state, actions);
        if (actions.reopenWith) ReopenWithEncoding(*actions.reopenWith);
        if (actions.convertEol) Buffer().ConvertLineEndings(*actions.convertEol, focused.Selections());   // spec s3.5: one undo step
        if (actions.setIndentation) SetIndentation(*actions.setIndentation);
        if (actions.setLanguage) PickLanguage(*actions.setLanguage);
        if (actions.toggleSplit) { if (SplitOpen()) CloseSplit(); else OpenSplit(true); }
```

The strip holds no note of its own: `state.note` is read from TE2-15's `Note()` every frame, so a note set by TE2 (save, reload) or TE6 (recovery) through `ShowNote` shows until `ShowNote("")` clears it.

```cpp
    void TextDocument::PickLanguage(std::string_view name)
    {
        if (!m_services.syntax) return;                                 // no syntax service: Plain Text is all there is
        SetLanguage(name);                                              // TE3-30
        const std::string ext = CanonicalPath().extension().string();   // spec s4.1: remembered per extension
        CVarRegistry& reg = CVarRegistry::Get();
        const CVarHandle h = reg.Find("editor.text.languageByExtension");
        if (h.IsStale()) return;
        const std::string next = Text::SetLanguageOverride(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().languageByExtension, ext, name);
        reg.Set(h, CVarValue::String(next), SetBy::EditorUser, "editor", CVarContext::Editor);
        reg.Publish();
        NoteSettingEdited(SetBy::EditorUser, "editor.text.languageByExtension");   // the debounced archive write keeps it
    }
```

(`PickLanguage` is declared public in `TextDocument.hpp`; `m_services.syntax` is the `TextSyntaxService*` TE3-30 adds to `TextDocumentServices` (null-checked); `Find` / `Set` / `Publish` / `NoteSettingEdited` is the EditorUser write `Settings/FontsPage.cpp:14-22` and `Settings/ThemePage.cpp:30-37` use; `TextDocument.cpp` includes `Settings/SettingsHost.hpp`.)

```cpp
    CHECK(epoch >= 1);                                           // selected at open

    CHECK(doc->SelectionEpoch() == epoch + 1);
    CHECK(Editor::InspectorFilter::Only("text").Admits(doc->Kind()));
    doc.reset();
    std::filesystem::remove(path);
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocumentInspectorPage.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text document's Inspector page (text editor spec s5.3; TE4-20): path,
// size, encoding, language, line endings, indentation and the read-only
// reason; editable where meaningful (Reopen with Encoding, language, line
// endings = convert every line, indentation). Arcane's one Inspector model:
// the document draws no properties block of its own. Edits are queued while
// the rows draw and run after the last one (a reopen replaces the text the
// rows read).

#include "Panels/InspectorSource.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/EolMap.hpp"          // Eol
#include "TextEditor/Core/IndentDetect.hpp"    // IndentStyle
#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"       // Text::TextEncoding

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class TextDocumentInspectorPage final : public InspectorPage
    {
    public:
        struct Model
        {
            std::function<std::string()> name, path;
            std::function<std::uintmax_t()> size;
            std::function<std::string()> encodingLabel;              // TE2-15's EncodingLabel(TextEncoding)
            std::function<void(Text::TextEncoding)> reopenWithEncoding;
            std::function<std::string()> language;
            std::function<std::vector<std::string>()> languages;
            std::function<void(std::string_view)> setLanguage;
            std::function<Text::Eol()> eol;
            std::function<bool()> mixedEol;
            std::function<void(Text::Eol)> convertEol;
            std::function<Text::IndentStyle()> indentation;
            std::function<void(const Text::IndentStyle&)> setIndentation;
            std::function<std::optional<std::string>()> readOnlyReason;
        };

        explicit TextDocumentInspectorPage(Model model) : m_model(std::move(model)) {}
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<InspectorCrumb> Breadcrumb() const override;
        void Draw(PropertyGrid& grid) override;

    private:
        Model m_model;
        std::vector<std::function<void()>> m_deferred;
    };

    // "999 bytes", "12.1 KB (12,345 bytes)".
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatFileSize(std::uintmax_t bytes);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocumentInspectorPage.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocumentInspectorPage.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/View/TextStatusStrip.hpp"   // EolLabel
#include "Widgets/PropertyGrid.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <format>
#include <iterator>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    std::string FormatFileSize(std::uintmax_t bytes)
    {
        std::string digits = std::to_string(bytes);
        for (int i = static_cast<int>(digits.size()) - 3; i > 0; i -= 3) digits.insert(static_cast<std::size_t>(i), ",");
        const std::string exact = digits + (bytes == 1 ? " byte" : " bytes");
        if (bytes < 1024) return exact;
        const char* units[] = { "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB" };
        double value = static_cast<double>(bytes) / 1024.0;
        std::size_t unit = 0;
        while (value >= 1024.0 && unit + 1 < std::size(units)) { value /= 1024.0; ++unit; }
        return std::format("{:.1f} {} ({})", value, units[unit], exact);
    }

    std::vector<InspectorCrumb> TextDocumentInspectorPage::Breadcrumb() const
    {
        return { InspectorCrumb{ m_model.name ? m_model.name() : std::string("Text"), {}, std::optional<std::string>{ std::string("text") } } };
    }

    void TextDocumentInspectorPage::Draw(PropertyGrid& grid)
    {
        const auto defer = [this](std::function<void()> fn) { m_deferred.push_back(std::move(fn)); };
        if (grid.Section("File"))
        {
            PropertyGrid::Rows rows(grid, "##textfile");
            if (rows)
            {
                grid.ReadOnlyRow("Path", m_model.path ? m_model.path() : std::string{});
                grid.ReadOnlyRow("Size", FormatFileSize(m_model.size ? m_model.size() : 0));
                const std::optional<std::string> reason = m_model.readOnlyReason ? m_model.readOnlyReason() : std::nullopt;
                grid.ReadOnlyRow("Read-only", reason ? *reason : std::string("No"));
            }
        }
        if (grid.Section("Text"))
        {
            PropertyGrid::Rows rows(grid, "##texttext");
            if (rows)
            {
                grid.ReadOnlyRow("Encoding", m_model.encodingLabel ? m_model.encodingLabel() : std::string{});
                // Spec s3.5: a file that is not UTF-8 is reopened as Windows-1252 (or back as UTF-8);
                // TE2 refuses the reopen while the document is dirty.
                const std::array<Text::TextEncoding, 2> reopen{ Text::TextEncoding::Utf8, Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252 };
                const char* reopenItems[] = { "UTF-8", "Windows 1252" };
                if (const int picked = grid.ComboRow("Reopen with encoding", reopenItems, 2, -1); picked >= 0 && m_model.reopenWithEncoding)
                    defer([this, e = reopen[static_cast<std::size_t>(picked)]] { m_model.reopenWithEncoding(e); });

                const std::vector<std::string> names = m_model.languages ? m_model.languages() : std::vector<std::string>{};
                const std::string language = m_model.language ? m_model.language() : std::string{};
                std::vector<const char*> languageItems;
                int currentLanguage = -1;
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < names.size(); ++i)
                {
                    languageItems.push_back(names[i].c_str());
                    if (names[i] == language) currentLanguage = static_cast<int>(i);
                }
                if (const int picked = grid.ComboRow("Language", languageItems.data(), static_cast<int>(languageItems.size()), currentLanguage);
                    picked >= 0 && m_model.setLanguage)
                    defer([this, name = names[static_cast<std::size_t>(picked)]] { m_model.setLanguage(name); });

                const std::array<Text::Eol, 3> eols{ Text::Eol::LF, Text::Eol::CRLF, Text::Eol::CR };
                const char* eolItems[] = { "LF", "CRLF", "CR" };
                const bool mixed = m_model.mixedEol && m_model.mixedEol();
                const Text::Eol eol = m_model.eol ? m_model.eol() : Text::Eol::LF;
                int currentEol = -1;
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < eols.size(); ++i)
                    if (!mixed && eols[i] == eol) currentEol = static_cast<int>(i);
                if (const int picked = grid.ComboRow("Line endings", eolItems, 3, currentEol); picked >= 0 && m_model.convertEol)
                    defer([this, e = eols[static_cast<std::size_t>(picked)]] { m_model.convertEol(e); });
                if (mixed)
                    grid.ReadOnlyRow("Mixed endings", std::format("Yes: each line keeps its own; new lines use {}. Pick one above to convert every line.",
                                                                  EolLabel(eol)));

                const Text::IndentStyle indent = m_model.indentation ? m_model.indentation() : Text::IndentStyle{};
                bool spaces = indent.spaces;
                if (grid.CheckboxRow("Indent with spaces", spaces) && m_model.setIndentation)
                    defer([this, indent, spaces] { Text::IndentStyle o = indent; o.spaces = spaces; m_model.setIndentation(o); });
                int width = static_cast<int>(indent.width);
                if (grid.IntRow("Indent size", width) && m_model.setIndentation)
                    defer([this, indent, width] { Text::IndentStyle o = indent; o.width = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::clamp(width, 1, 16)); m_model.setIndentation(o); });
            }
        }
        std::vector<std::function<void()>> run;
        run.swap(m_deferred);
        for (const std::function<void()>& fn : run) fn();
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// Documents that can list their symbols (text editor spec s9): spec 2's
// Goto Anything '@' queries the active document through this. TextDocument
// implements it from its grammar's `symbols` rules (TE4-21); the shader graph
// and input-actions documents may implement it later.

#include "Documents/EditorDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"   // ByteRange, Point

#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct DocumentSymbol
    {
        std::string name;
        std::string kind;          // the grammar's word: "heading", "key", "function"
        Text::ByteRange range;     // the name's bytes
        Text::Point start;         // range.begin as row / byte column
    };

    class ISymbolProvider
    {
    public:
        virtual ~ISymbolProvider() = default;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::vector<DocumentSymbol> Symbols() = 0;   // document order
    };

    [[nodiscard]] inline ISymbolProvider* SymbolProviderOf(EditorDocument* doc) noexcept { return dynamic_cast<ISymbolProvider*>(doc); }
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/SymbolExtractor.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Symbols from a grammar's `symbols` rules (text editor spec s4.1, s9): each
// rule is a single-line pattern; `nameGroup` names the symbol (the whole match
// when the group is absent). Line by line on a snapshot, under the search limits.

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp"   // CompiledSymbol (TE3-8)

#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct TextSymbol
    {
        std::string name;
        std::string kind;
        ByteRange range;
        Point start;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<TextSymbol> ExtractSymbols(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, std::span<const CompiledSymbol> rules,
                                                         const SearchLimits& limits);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/SymbolExtractor.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/SymbolExtractor.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::vector<TextSymbol> ExtractSymbols(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, std::span<const CompiledSymbol> rules, const SearchLimits& limits)
    {
        std::vector<TextSymbol> out;
        for (const CompiledSymbol& rule : rules)
        {
            if (!rule.regex) continue;
            CompiledQuery q;
            q.regex = rule.regex;
            q.multiline = false;
            TextSearch::ForEachMatch(snapshot, q, { 0, snapshot.rope.Size() + 1 }, limits, nullptr, [&](const SearchHit& h)
            {
                // The name group when it took part in the match, else the whole match (group 0).
                std::pair<std::size_t, std::size_t> g{ static_cast<std::size_t>(h.range.begin - h.subjectBase),
                                                       static_cast<std::size_t>(h.range.end - h.subjectBase) };
                std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
                if (h.match && h.match->Group(rule.nameGroup, b, e) && e >= b) g = { b, e };
                if (g.second <= g.first || g.second > h.subject.size()) return true;
                TextSymbol s;
                s.name = std::string(h.subject.substr(g.first, g.second - g.first));
                s.kind = rule.kind;
                s.range = { h.subjectBase + g.first, h.subjectBase + g.second };
                s.start = snapshot.rope.OffsetToPoint(s.range.begin);
                out.push_back(std::move(s));
                return true;
            }, nullptr);
        }
        std::stable_sort(out.begin(), out.end(), [](const TextSymbol& a, const TextSymbol& b) { return a.range.begin < b.range.begin; });
        out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end(), [](const TextSymbol& a, const TextSymbol& b)
        {
            return a.range.begin == b.range.begin && a.range.end == b.range.end && a.kind == b.kind;
        }), out.end());
        return out;
    }
}
```

`TextDocument` (TE2-15) changes: include `Documents/SymbolProvider.hpp`, `TextEditor/Syntax/SymbolExtractor.hpp`, `TextEditor/TextSearchLimits.hpp`; the class becomes `class TextDocument final : public EditorDocument, public ISymbolProvider`; public `std::vector<DocumentSymbol> Symbols() override;`; private:

```cpp
        std::vector<DocumentSymbol> m_symbols;
        std::uint64_t m_symbolsVersion = std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max();
        std::uint64_t m_symbolsGrammar = std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max();
```

```cpp
    std::vector<DocumentSymbol> TextDocument::Symbols()
    {
        const TextSettings& s = Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>();
        const Text::GrammarSnapshot grammar = Grammar();
        if (!grammar || grammar->Rules().Symbols().empty()) return {};
        // Above syntaxMaxMB the stateful highlighter stops too (spec s3.5): no whole-file symbol scan.
        if (Buffer().Text().Size() > (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(s.syntaxMaxMB) << 20)) return {};
        const std::uint64_t version = Buffer().Version();
        const std::uint64_t grammarVersion = grammar->grammarVersion();
        if (version != m_symbolsVersion || grammarVersion != m_symbolsGrammar)
        {
            m_symbols.clear();
            for (Text::TextSymbol& t : Text::ExtractSymbols(Buffer().Snapshot(), grammar->Rules().Symbols(), SearchLimitsFromSettings(s)))
                m_symbols.push_back(DocumentSymbol{ std::move(t.name), std::move(t.kind), t.range, t.start });
            m_symbolsVersion = version;
            m_symbolsGrammar = grammarVersion;
        }
        return m_symbols;
    }
```

(`SymbolExtractor.cpp` is in `TextEditor/Syntax/`, which the `ArcaneText` library globs: a premake regenerate picks it up.)

### Task TE4-22: Auto-close pairs -- close, wrap, type over, delete the pair (spec s8 `autoClosePairs`, s4.1 `autoClose`)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/AutoClose.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/AutoClose.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextTypingFilter.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/AutoCloseFilter.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/AutoCloseFilter.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp` / `.cpp` (TE2-13: a typing filter sees each typed code point and plain Backspace first)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp` / `.cpp` (TE2-15: own the filter, attach it to every view)
- Modify: `premake5.lua` ArcaneTests `files` (append `AutoCloseFilter.cpp`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/AutoCloseTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1 `TextBuffer::{Text, Undo(SelectionSet&), RegisterAnchors(AnchorSet&), UnregisterAnchors}`, TE1-14 `TextCommands::ApplyEdits(TransactionKind, std::vector<EditOp> ops, std::vector<Selection> after, std::size_t primaryIndex)` (CANON A3: one transaction -- the edit plus the post-edit selections -- and with empty `ops` only the selections, no undo entry; product code never calls `BeginTransaction` / `Edit` / `EndTransaction` itself, spec s2.1), `TransactionKind::{Typing, Deleting}`, `EditOp{range, text}` (sorted, disjoint, strictly increasing begins), `AnchorSet::{Add, Remove, ForEach, Size}`, `Anchor{offset, bias}`, `Bias::Right`, `SelectionSet::{All, PrimaryIndex}`, `Selection::Empty`, `Rope::{ByteAt, Substr, OffsetToPoint, Size}`; TE3-8 `GrammarDesc::autoClose` (`std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>`, read through `CompiledGrammar::Rules().Desc()`); TE4-3 `TextSettings::autoClosePairs`; TE2-11 `TextModel::{buffer, selections}` (TE2-11's shape, CANON A7); TE2-13 `TextEditorView::{ApplyBaselineKey(Text::TextCommands&, ...), HandleKeyboard}` (its `cmds`); TE4-11 `TextDocument::Grammar()`; TE4-17 `TextDocument::AttachOverlays`; `Test::ScopedCodeRung`.
- Produces: `class Text::AutoCloser(TextBuffer&) { SetPairs(span<const pair<string,string>>), Type(SelectionSet&, std::string_view) -> bool, Backspace(SelectionSet&) -> bool, TrackedClosers() }`; `class Editor::ITextTypingFilter { Typed(TextModel&, std::string_view codePoint) -> bool; Backspace(TextModel&) -> bool }`; `TextEditorView::SetTypingFilter(ITextTypingFilter*)` (TE5's Insert mode keeps it: auto-close is an Insert-mode behaviour); `class Editor::AutoCloseFilter(TextBuffer&, PairsSource)`.

The rules are VS Code's defaults (`autoClosingBrackets: languageDefined`, `autoClosingOvertype: auto`, `autoClosingDelete: auto`, `autoSurround: languageDefined`): typing an opener with an empty selection inserts the pair when the next character is whitespace, the end of the line, or a closing bracket, and a quote does not close after a word character (`don't`); with a selection it wraps the selection and keeps it selected; typing a closer that this feature inserted moves over it; Backspace between an opener and the closer this feature inserted deletes both. Only closers it inserted are typed over or deleted with their opener (an anchor tracks each one, and anchors on rows without a caret are dropped). Each keystroke is one transaction (`Typing` / `Deleting`), so typing coalesces into the usual undo group.
