```cpp
// TE4-22 (spec s8 autoClosePairs): the grammar's autoClose pairs close, wrap,
// are typed over and are deleted together -- only the closers this inserted.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/AutoClose.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/AutoCloseFilter.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> kPairs = { { "(", ")" }, { "[", "]" }, { "\"", "\"" }, { "'", "'" } };

    struct Rig
    {
        TextBuffer buf;
        SelectionSet sels;
        AutoCloser closer{ buf };
        explicit Rig(std::string_view text) : buf(Rope::FromUtf8(text), EolMap()) { closer.SetPairs(kPairs); }
        std::string Text() const { return buf.Text().ToString(); }
    };
}

TEST_CASE("Auto-close: an opener closes before whitespace or a closer; the closer it inserted is typed over", "[text-autoclose]")
{
    Rig r("");
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "("));
    CHECK(r.Text() == "()");
    CHECK(r.sels.Primary().head == 1);
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "["));                         // before ")": a closer, so it closes
    CHECK(r.Text() == "([])");
    CHECK(r.closer.TrackedClosers() == 2);
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "]"));                         // typed over, nothing inserted
    CHECK(r.Text() == "([])");
    CHECK(r.sels.Primary().head == 3);
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, ")"));
    CHECK(r.Text() == "([])");
    CHECK(r.sels.Primary().head == 4);
    CHECK(r.closer.TrackedClosers() == 0);
    CHECK_FALSE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, ")"));                     // nothing tracked: the caller inserts it

    Rig word("abc");
    word.sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    CHECK_FALSE(word.closer.Type(word.sels, "("));               // before a word character: plain typing
    Rig quote("don");
    quote.sels.SetSingle(3, 3);
    CHECK_FALSE(quote.closer.Type(quote.sels, "'"));             // after a word character
    Rig assign("x = ");
    assign.sels.SetSingle(4, 4);
    REQUIRE(assign.closer.Type(assign.sels, "\""));
    CHECK(assign.Text() == "x = \"\"");
    CHECK(assign.sels.Primary().head == 5);
    CHECK_FALSE(assign.closer.Type(assign.sels, "a"));           // not a pair character
}

TEST_CASE("Auto-close: an opener wraps a selection and keeps it selected, per selection, as one undo step", "[text-autoclose]")
{
    Rig r("abc def");
    r.sels.SetSingle(0, 3);
    r.sels.Add(7, 4, std::nullopt);                              // a backward selection of "def"
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "("));
    CHECK(r.Text() == "(abc) (def)");
    REQUIRE(r.sels.Size() == 2);
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[0].anchor == 1);
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[0].head == 4);
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[1].anchor == 10);                         // the direction survives
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[1].head == 7);
    r.buf.Undo(r.sels);
    CHECK(r.Text() == "abc def");
}

TEST_CASE("Auto-close: several carets close and type over together", "[text-autoclose]")
{
    Rig r("a\nb\n");
    r.sels.SetSingle(1, 1);
    r.sels.Add(3, 3, std::nullopt);
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "["));
    CHECK(r.Text() == "a[]\nb[]\n");
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[0].head == 2);
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[1].head == 6);
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "]"));
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[0].head == 3);
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[1].head == 7);
    r.buf.Undo(r.sels);
    CHECK(r.Text() == "a\nb\n");
}

TEST_CASE("Auto-close: Backspace deletes an inserted pair; never a pair the user typed; leaving the row forgets", "[text-autoclose]")
{
    Rig r("\n");
    r.sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "("));
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Backspace(r.sels));
    CHECK(r.Text() == "\n");
    CHECK(r.sels.Primary().head == 0);

    Rig typed("()");
    typed.sels.SetSingle(1, 1);
    CHECK_FALSE(typed.closer.Backspace(typed.sels));             // not inserted by auto-close

    Rig away("\n");
    away.sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    REQUIRE(away.closer.Type(away.sels, "("));
    away.sels.SetSingle(3, 3);                                   // the caret leaves the row
    CHECK_FALSE(away.closer.Backspace(away.sels));
    CHECK(away.closer.TrackedClosers() == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("Auto-close: the filter follows editor.text.autoClosePairs", "[text-autoclose]")
{
    Editor::TextModel model(Rope::FromUtf8(""));
    Editor::AutoCloseFilter filter(model.buffer, [] { return std::span<const std::pair<std::string, std::string>>(kPairs); });
    {
        const Test::ScopedCodeRung off("editor.text.autoClosePairs", CVarValue::Bool(false));
        CHECK_FALSE(filter.Typed(model, "("));
    }
    REQUIRE(filter.Typed(model, "("));
    CHECK(model.buffer.Text().ToString() == "()");
    CHECK(filter.Backspace(model));
    CHECK(model.buffer.Text().ToString().empty());
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/AutoClose.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Auto-close pairs (text editor spec s8 autoClosePairs; TE4-22). The pairs
// are the grammar's `autoClose` (s4.1). An anchor tracks every closer this
// inserted: only those are typed over or deleted with their opener.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"

#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    class AutoCloser
    {
    public:
        explicit AutoCloser(TextBuffer& buffer);
        ~AutoCloser();
        AutoCloser(const AutoCloser&) = delete;
        AutoCloser& operator=(const AutoCloser&) = delete;

        void SetPairs(std::span<const std::pair<std::string, std::string>> pairs);
        // One typed code point. true = handled here (closed, wrapped or typed over, as one
        // Typing transaction); false = the caller inserts it as plain typing.
        [[nodiscard]] bool Type(SelectionSet& sels, std::string_view typed);
        // Plain Backspace. true = every caret sat between an opener and the closer this
        // inserted, and both went (one Deleting transaction).
        [[nodiscard]] bool Backspace(SelectionSet& sels);
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t TrackedClosers() const noexcept { return m_closers.Size(); }

    private:
        struct Pair { std::string open, close; };
        void Prune(const SelectionSet& sels);
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<AnchorSet::Id> TrackedAt(ByteOffset at) const;
        [[nodiscard]] bool StartsWith(ByteOffset at, std::string_view text) const;
        [[nodiscard]] bool CanClose(ByteOffset at, const Pair& pair) const;

        TextBuffer& m_buffer;
        AnchorSet m_closers;
        std::vector<Pair> m_pairs;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/AutoClose.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/AutoClose.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"     // TextCommands::ApplyEdits (CANON A3)

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <optional>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        // Append an op; one that begins where the last empty op begins merges into it, so the
        // batch keeps strictly increasing begins (two adjacent selections share an offset).
        void Put(std::vector<EditOp>& ops, ByteRange range, std::string text)
        {
            if (!ops.empty() && ops.back().range.begin == range.begin && ops.back().range.end == ops.back().range.begin)
            {
                ops.back().range.end = range.end;
                ops.back().text += text;
                return;
            }
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ range, std::move(text) });
        }

        bool IsWordByte(char c) noexcept
        {
            const auto u = static_cast<unsigned char>(c);
            return std::isalnum(u) || u == '_' || u >= 0x80;
        }

        // Post-edit ranges (begin = anchor, end = head, so a direction survives) as
        // TextCommands::ApplyEdits' `after`; id 0 = ApplyEdits allocates one.
        std::vector<Selection> ToSelections(const std::vector<ByteRange>& ranges)
        {
            std::vector<Selection> out;
            out.reserve(ranges.size());
            for (const ByteRange& r : ranges) out.push_back(Selection{ 0, r.begin, r.end, std::nullopt });
            return out;
        }
    }

    AutoCloser::AutoCloser(TextBuffer& buffer) : m_buffer(buffer) { m_buffer.RegisterAnchors(m_closers); }
    AutoCloser::~AutoCloser() { m_buffer.UnregisterAnchors(m_closers); }

    void AutoCloser::SetPairs(std::span<const std::pair<std::string, std::string>> pairs)
    {
        m_pairs.clear();
        for (const auto& [open, close] : pairs)
            if (!open.empty() && !close.empty()) m_pairs.push_back(Pair{ open, close });
    }

    bool AutoCloser::StartsWith(ByteOffset at, std::string_view text) const
    {
        const Rope& rope = m_buffer.Text();
        if (at + text.size() > rope.Size()) return false;
        return rope.Substr({ at, at + text.size() }) == text;
    }

    std::optional<AnchorSet::Id> AutoCloser::TrackedAt(ByteOffset at) const
    {
        std::optional<AnchorSet::Id> found;
        m_closers.ForEach([&](AnchorSet::Id id, const Anchor& a) { if (!found && a.offset == at) found = id; });
        return found;
    }

    // VS Code's languageDefined + beforeWhitespace rule.
    bool AutoCloser::CanClose(ByteOffset at, const Pair& pair) const
    {
        const Rope& rope = m_buffer.Text();
        const char next = at < rope.Size() ? rope.ByteAt(at) : '\n';
        bool nextOk = next == ' ' || next == '\t' || next == '\n' || next == '\r';
        for (const Pair& p : m_pairs)
            if (p.open != p.close && p.close[0] == next) nextOk = true;      // before a closing bracket
        if (!nextOk) return false;
        if (pair.open == pair.close && at > 0 && IsWordByte(rope.ByteAt(at - 1))) return false;   // don't
        return true;
    }

    void AutoCloser::Prune(const SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        const Rope& rope = m_buffer.Text();
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> rows;
        for (const Selection& s : sels.All()) rows.push_back(rope.OffsetToPoint(s.head).row);
        std::vector<AnchorSet::Id> drop;
        m_closers.ForEach([&](AnchorSet::Id id, const Anchor& a)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(a.offset, rope.Size())).row;
            if (std::find(rows.begin(), rows.end(), row) == rows.end()) drop.push_back(id);
        });
        for (const AnchorSet::Id id : drop) m_closers.Remove(id);
    }

    bool AutoCloser::Type(SelectionSet& sels, std::string_view typed)
    {
        if (typed.empty() || m_pairs.empty()) return false;
        const Pair* opener = nullptr;
        bool closer = false;
        for (const Pair& p : m_pairs)
        {
            if (!opener && p.open == typed) opener = &p;
            if (p.close == typed) closer = true;
        }
        if (!opener && !closer) return false;
        Prune(sels);

        enum class Act : std::uint8_t { Plain, Wrap, Close, Over };
        std::vector<Act> acts;
        bool any = false;
        for (const Selection& s : sels.All())
        {
            Act act = Act::Plain;
            if (!s.Empty()) { if (opener) act = Act::Wrap; }
            else if (closer && TrackedAt(s.head) && StartsWith(s.head, typed)) act = Act::Over;
            else if (opener && CanClose(s.head, *opener)) act = Act::Close;
            any = any || act != Act::Plain;
            acts.push_back(act);
        }
        if (!any) return false;

        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<ByteRange> after;        // {anchor, head} in post-edit coordinates
        std::vector<ByteOffset> newClosers;  // post-edit offsets of the closers inserted now
        std::vector<AnchorSet::Id> consumed;
        std::int64_t shift = 0;
        const auto at = [&](ByteOffset pre, std::size_t extra) { return static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(pre) + shift) + extra; };
        const std::span<const Selection> all = sels.All();
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < all.size(); ++i)
        {
            const Selection& s = all[i];
            const ByteOffset b = std::min(s.anchor, s.head), e = std::max(s.anchor, s.head);
            switch (acts[i])
            {
            case Act::Plain:
                Put(ops, { b, e }, std::string(typed));
                after.push_back({ at(b, typed.size()), at(b, typed.size()) });
                shift += static_cast<std::int64_t>(typed.size()) - static_cast<std::int64_t>(e - b);
                break;
            case Act::Wrap:
            {
                Put(ops, { b, b }, opener->open);
                Put(ops, { e, e }, opener->close);
                const ByteOffset nb = at(b, opener->open.size()), ne = at(e, opener->open.size());
                after.push_back(s.anchor <= s.head ? ByteRange{ nb, ne } : ByteRange{ ne, nb });
                shift += static_cast<std::int64_t>(opener->open.size() + opener->close.size());
                break;
            }
            case Act::Close:
                Put(ops, { b, b }, opener->open + opener->close);
                after.push_back({ at(b, opener->open.size()), at(b, opener->open.size()) });
                newClosers.push_back(at(b, opener->open.size()));
                shift += static_cast<std::int64_t>(opener->open.size() + opener->close.size());
                break;
            case Act::Over:
                consumed.push_back(*TrackedAt(b));
                after.push_back({ at(b, typed.size()), at(b, typed.size()) });
                break;
            }
        }
        for (const AnchorSet::Id id : consumed) m_closers.Remove(id);
        // One Typing transaction through TE1's command layer (spec s2.1); only typed over
        // (no ops) just moves the carets, with no undo entry.
        TextCommands(m_buffer, sels, EditContext{}).ApplyEdits(TransactionKind::Typing, std::move(ops), ToSelections(after), sels.PrimaryIndex());
        for (const ByteOffset c : newClosers) m_closers.Add(Anchor{ c, Bias::Right });   // typing at the caret pushes it right
        return true;
    }

    bool AutoCloser::Backspace(SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        if (m_closers.Size() == 0) return false;
        Prune(sels);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<ByteRange> after;
        std::vector<AnchorSet::Id> used;
        ByteOffset removed = 0;
        for (const Selection& s : sels.All())
        {
            if (!s.Empty()) return false;
            const std::optional<AnchorSet::Id> id = TrackedAt(s.head);
            if (!id) return false;
            const Pair* pair = nullptr;
            for (const Pair& p : m_pairs)
                if (s.head >= p.open.size() && StartsWith(s.head, p.close) && StartsWith(s.head - p.open.size(), p.open)) { pair = &p; break; }
            if (!pair) return false;
            const ByteRange range{ s.head - pair->open.size(), s.head + pair->close.size() };
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ range, {} });
            after.push_back({ range.begin - removed, range.begin - removed });
            removed += range.end - range.begin;
            used.push_back(*id);
        }
        if (ops.empty()) return false;
        for (const AnchorSet::Id id : used) m_closers.Remove(id);
        TextCommands(m_buffer, sels, EditContext{}).ApplyEdits(TransactionKind::Deleting, std::move(ops), ToSelections(after), sels.PrimaryIndex());
        return true;
    }
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/AutoCloseFilter.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/AutoCloseFilter.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    bool AutoCloseFilter::Refresh()
    {
        if (!Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().autoClosePairs) return false;
        const std::span<const std::pair<std::string, std::string>> pairs = m_pairs ? m_pairs() : std::span<const std::pair<std::string, std::string>>{};
        if (pairs.data() != m_pairsData || pairs.size() != m_pairsSize)   // the grammar changed
        {
            m_closer.SetPairs(pairs);
            m_pairsData = pairs.data();
            m_pairsSize = pairs.size();
        }
        return !pairs.empty();
    }

    bool AutoCloseFilter::Typed(TextModel& model, std::string_view codePoint)
    {
        return Refresh() && m_closer.Type(model.selections, codePoint);
    }

    bool AutoCloseFilter::Backspace(TextModel& model)
    {
        return Refresh() && m_closer.Backspace(model.selections);
    }
}
```

### Task TE4-23: Keyboard column selection (spec s3.2, s7 `text.columnSelect*`)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/ColumnSelect.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/ColumnSelect.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/ColumnSelectTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1 `ColumnModel::{ColumnOf(const Rope&, ByteOffset), OffsetAtColumn(const Rope&, row, column)}` (display columns; `OffsetAtColumn` clamps to the line), `GraphemeColumnModel(tabSize)`, `TextCommands::Columns()` (the dispatcher passes the view's model), `TextBuffer::{Text, BreakUndoGroup}`, `SelectionSet::{All, Primary, operator==}`, `Rope::{OffsetToPoint, LineStart, LineEnd, LineCount}`; TE4-7 `AssignSelections`.
- Produces: `enum class Text::ColumnStep { Up, Down, Left, Right }`; `struct Text::ColumnBox { anchorRow, anchorCol, headRow, headCol }`; `class Text::ColumnSelector { bool Step(TextBuffer&, SelectionSet&, ColumnStep, const ColumnModel&, std::uint32_t maxCursors); const std::optional<ColumnBox>& Box() const; }`. TE4-24 binds `text.columnSelectUp/Down/Left/Right` (Ctrl+Shift+Alt+arrows) to it; TE5's Visual-block mode may reuse `ColumnBox` for its rectangle.

TE1-17 left the keyboard half of s3.2's column selection to this chunk (Alt+drag is TE2's mouse path). The rectangle is kept in display columns, not bytes, so a step over a short line or a tab does not lose the column the box started in: the box is the state, and the selections are rebuilt from it after every step. Rows inside the box that are shorter than its left edge get no selection (Sublime and VS Code both skip them), except the anchor and head rows, which keep a clamped caret so the box never loses its ends. A selection set this selector did not produce (a click, an edit that moved the carets) starts a new box at the primary selection. A box taller than `editor.text.maxCursors` is refused, as every other cursor-making command is above that count.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```cpp
// TE4-23 (spec s3.2): Ctrl+Shift+Alt+arrows grow a rectangle in display
// columns; short rows inside it are skipped; a foreign selection restarts it.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "TextEditor/Core/ColumnSelect.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"   // GraphemeColumnModel
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Sels = std::vector<std::pair<ByteOffset, ByteOffset>>;

namespace
{
    Sels Of(const SelectionSet& s)
    {
        Sels out;
        for (const Selection& x : s.All()) out.emplace_back(x.anchor, x.head);
        return out;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Column select: down and right grow the box; up shrinks it back", "[text-column]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("abcdef\nab\nabcdef\n"), EolMap());   // rows start at 0, 7, 10
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(2, 2);
    const GraphemeColumnModel cols(4);
    ColumnSelector box;
    REQUIRE(box.Step(buf, sels, ColumnStep::Down, cols, 100));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 2, 2 }, { 9, 9 } });
    REQUIRE(box.Step(buf, sels, ColumnStep::Right, cols, 100));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 2, 3 }, { 9, 9 } });                     // row 1 is two columns wide: a clamped caret
    REQUIRE(box.Step(buf, sels, ColumnStep::Down, cols, 100));
    REQUIRE(box.Step(buf, sels, ColumnStep::Right, cols, 100));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 2, 4 }, { 9, 9 }, { 12, 14 } });
    CHECK(sels.Primary().head == 14);                                   // the head row is primary
    REQUIRE(box.Box().has_value());
    CHECK(box.Box()->headRow == 2);
    CHECK(box.Box()->headCol == 4);
    REQUIRE(box.Step(buf, sels, ColumnStep::Up, cols, 100));
    REQUIRE(box.Step(buf, sels, ColumnStep::Up, cols, 100));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 2, 4 } });
    CHECK_FALSE(box.Step(buf, sels, ColumnStep::Up, cols, 100));         // row 0 is the top
}

TEST_CASE("Column select: rows shorter than the box's left edge are skipped; tabs count as display columns", "[text-column]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("abcdef\n\nabcdef"), EolMap());     // rows start at 0, 7, 8
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(4, 4);
    const GraphemeColumnModel cols(4);
    ColumnSelector box;
    REQUIRE(box.Step(buf, sels, ColumnStep::Down, cols, 100));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 4, 4 }, { 7, 7 } });                     // the head row keeps a clamped caret
    REQUIRE(box.Step(buf, sels, ColumnStep::Down, cols, 100));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 4, 4 }, { 12, 12 } });                   // the empty middle row is skipped

    TextBuffer tabs(Rope::FromUtf8("\tab\nabcdef"), EolMap());        // rows start at 0, 4
    SelectionSet t;
    t.SetSingle(8, 8);                                                  // row 1, column 4
    ColumnSelector tbox;
    REQUIRE(tbox.Step(tabs, t, ColumnStep::Up, cols, 100));
    CHECK(Of(t) == Sels{ { 1, 1 }, { 8, 8 } });                        // column 4 of "\tab" is after the tab
}

TEST_CASE("Column select: a foreign selection restarts the box; maxCursors refuses a taller one", "[text-column]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("abcdef\nabcdef\nabcdef\n"), EolMap());   // rows start at 0, 7, 14
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(1, 1);
    const GraphemeColumnModel cols(4);
    ColumnSelector box;
    REQUIRE(box.Step(buf, sels, ColumnStep::Down, cols, 100));
    sels.SetSingle(19, 19);                                              // a click: row 2, column 5
    REQUIRE(box.Step(buf, sels, ColumnStep::Left, cols, 100));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 19, 18 } });
    REQUIRE(box.Box().has_value());
    CHECK(box.Box()->anchorRow == 2);

    SelectionSet capped;
    capped.SetSingle(1, 1);
    ColumnSelector small;
    REQUIRE(small.Step(buf, capped, ColumnStep::Down, cols, 2));
    CHECK_FALSE(small.Step(buf, capped, ColumnStep::Down, cols, 2));    // a third cursor is over the limit
    CHECK(capped.Size() == 2);
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// Keyboard column selection (text editor spec s3.2; TE4-23): a rectangle in
// display columns, grown one row or column per step; the selections are
// rebuilt from it every step.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"   // ColumnModel

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class ColumnStep : std::uint8_t { Up, Down, Left, Right };

    struct ColumnBox
    {
        std::uint32_t anchorRow = 0, anchorCol = 0;
        std::uint32_t headRow = 0, headCol = 0;
    };

    class ColumnSelector
    {
    public:
        // false = the step left the box unchanged (an edge, or over maxCursors).
        bool Step(TextBuffer& buffer, SelectionSet& sels, ColumnStep step, const ColumnModel& columns, std::uint32_t maxCursors);
        [[nodiscard]] const std::optional<ColumnBox>& Box() const noexcept { return m_box; }

    private:
        std::optional<ColumnBox> m_box;
        std::optional<SelectionSet> m_produced;   // what the last step left; anything else restarts the box
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/ColumnSelect.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/ColumnSelect.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchCommands.hpp"   // AssignSelections

#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    bool ColumnSelector::Step(TextBuffer& buffer, SelectionSet& sels, ColumnStep step, const ColumnModel& columns, std::uint32_t maxCursors)
    {
        const Rope& rope = buffer.Text();
        if (!m_box || !m_produced || !(*m_produced == sels))
        {
            const Selection& p = sels.Primary();
            const Point a = rope.OffsetToPoint(p.anchor);
            const Point h = rope.OffsetToPoint(p.head);
            m_box = ColumnBox{ a.row, columns.ColumnOf(rope, p.anchor), h.row, columns.ColumnOf(rope, p.head) };
        }
        ColumnBox next = *m_box;
        const std::uint32_t lastRow = rope.LineCount() == 0 ? 0 : rope.LineCount() - 1;
        switch (step)
        {
        case ColumnStep::Up:    if (next.headRow == 0) return false; --next.headRow; break;
        case ColumnStep::Down:  if (next.headRow >= lastRow) return false; ++next.headRow; break;
        case ColumnStep::Left:  if (next.headCol == 0) return false; --next.headCol; break;
        case ColumnStep::Right:
        {
            std::uint32_t widest = 0;   // the box never grows past the longest row it spans
            for (std::uint32_t r = std::min(next.anchorRow, next.headRow); r <= std::max(next.anchorRow, next.headRow); ++r)
                widest = std::max(widest, columns.ColumnOf(rope, rope.LineEnd(r)));
            if (next.headCol >= widest) return false;
            ++next.headCol;
            break;
        }
        }

        const std::uint32_t top = std::min(next.anchorRow, next.headRow), bottom = std::max(next.anchorRow, next.headRow);
        const std::uint32_t left = std::min(next.anchorCol, next.headCol);
        std::vector<ByteRange> ranges;
        std::size_t primary = 0;
        for (std::uint32_t r = top; r <= bottom; ++r)
        {
            const bool end = r == next.anchorRow || r == next.headRow;
            if (!end && columns.ColumnOf(rope, rope.LineEnd(r)) < left) continue;   // too short to reach the box
            if (r == next.headRow) primary = ranges.size();
            ranges.push_back({ columns.OffsetAtColumn(rope, r, next.anchorCol), columns.OffsetAtColumn(rope, r, next.headCol) });
        }
        if (ranges.size() > maxCursors) return false;
        buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
        AssignSelections(sels, ranges, primary);
        m_box = next;
        m_produced = sels;
        return true;
    }
}
```

(`ColumnSelect.cpp` is in `TextEditor/Core/`, which `ArcaneText` globs: a premake regenerate picks it up.)

```cpp
TEST_CASE("Text actions: the views' context (no rerun) carries the document's indentation and reports a refused cursor count as a note", "[text-actions]")
{
    const Test::ScopedCodeRung limit("editor.text.maxCursors", CVarValue::UInt32(2));
    const std::filesystem::path path = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "te4-actions-context.txt";

    REQUIRE_FALSE(doc->Indentation().spaces);
    Text::EditContext ec = doc->MakeEditContext(doc->Model());    // what SetEditContextProvider hands the views
    CHECK_FALSE(ec.insertSpaces);                                  // the document's indentation, not the settings'
    CHECK(ec.display == &doc->Model().display);
    REQUIRE(ec.confirmCursors);
    CHECK_FALSE(ec.confirmCursors(5));                             // refused ...
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->PendingCursorQuestion().has_value());         // ... without a question (nothing to re-run)
    CHECK(doc->Note().find("editor.text.maxCursors") != std::string::npos);   // ... and said why
    doc->OpenSplit(false);                                         // the second view gets the same provider (AttachOverlays)
    Text::EditContext ec1 = doc->MakeEditContext(doc->ModelOf(*doc->SecondaryView()));
    CHECK(ec1.display == &doc->ModelOf(*doc->SecondaryView()).display);
    CHECK_FALSE(ec1.insertSpaces);
    // The VIEWS carry the provider (AttachOverlays installs it on both), and it is the document's
    // context: the document's indentation, the view's own display map, and the refusing hook.
    for (Editor::TextEditorView* v : { &doc->View(), doc->SecondaryView() })
    {
        const std::function<Text::EditContext(Editor::TextModel&)>& provider = v->EditContextProvider();
        REQUIRE(provider);                                         // empty = DefaultEditContext: no grammar, no hook
        Text::EditContext viaView = provider(doc->ModelOf(*v));
        CHECK(viaView.display == &doc->ModelOf(*v).display);
        CHECK_FALSE(viaView.insertSpaces);                         // tabs, detected for this document (TE4-18)
        REQUIRE(viaView.confirmCursors);
        doc->ShowNote("");
        CHECK_FALSE(viaView.confirmCursors(5));                    // refuses without asking ...
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->PendingCursorQuestion().has_value());
        CHECK(doc->Note().find("editor.text.maxCursors") != std::string::npos);   // ... and says why
    }
    doc.reset();
    std::filesystem::remove(path);
}
```

```cpp
    int DispatchTextActions(EditorActions& actions, TextActionTarget& target)
```
```cpp
    {
```

`TextDocument.cpp`:

```cpp
    Text::EditContext TextDocument::MakeEditContext(TextModel& model, std::optional<TextAction> rerun)
    {
        // TE2-11 (+TE4-18): SyncDisplay, the editor.text.* editing settings, the display map and
        // the document's own indentation (model.indent).
        Text::EditContext ec = DefaultEditContext(model);
        if (const Text::GrammarSnapshot g = Grammar())
        {
            const Text::GrammarDesc& d = g->Rules().Desc();
            ec.wordChars = Text::WordChars::FromSpec(d.wordChars);
            ec.comment = Text::CommentTokens{ d.lineComment, d.blockCommentBegin, d.blockCommentEnd };
        }
        ec.confirmCursors = [this, rerun](std::size_t requested)
        {
            if (m_cursorsGranted) return true;
            if (rerun)
                m_cursorQuestion = CursorQuestion{ *rerun, requested };   // asked by Draw's modal; a yes re-runs the action
            else                                                          // typing / vim: nothing to re-run, say why
                ShowNote(std::format("Not added: {} cursors is more than editor.text.maxCursors ({}).",
                                     requested, Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().maxCursors));
            return false;
        };
        return ec;
    }

    void TextDocument::AnswerCursorQuestion(bool yes)
    {
        const std::optional<CursorQuestion> q = std::exchange(m_cursorQuestion, std::nullopt);
        if (!q || !yes) return;
        m_cursorsGranted = true;
        RunTextAction(q->action);
        m_cursorsGranted = false;
    }

    void TextDocument::RunTextAction(TextAction action)
    {
        TextEditorView& view = FocusedView();
        TextModel& model = ModelOf(view);
        ViewEditScope edit(model);                     // this view places its own selections (TE4-17)
        Text::TextBuffer& buf = Buffer();
        Text::SelectionSet& sels = model.selections;
        Text::TextCommands cmd(buf, sels, MakeEditContext(model, action));   // a refused cursor count re-runs `action` on Yes
        const Text::Rope& rope = buf.Text();
        const auto page = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::max(1, view.PageRows()));
        const std::uint32_t caretRow = rope.OffsetToPoint(sels.Primary().head).row;
        const std::uint32_t maxCursors = Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().maxCursors;
        switch (action)
        {
        case TextAction::WordLeft:                  cmd.MoveWordLeft(false); break;
        case TextAction::WordRight:                 cmd.MoveWordRight(false); break;
        case TextAction::SelectWordLeft:            cmd.MoveWordLeft(true); break;
        case TextAction::SelectWordRight:           cmd.MoveWordRight(true); break;
        case TextAction::LineStart:                 cmd.MoveLineStart(false); break;
        case TextAction::LineEnd:                   cmd.MoveLineEnd(false); break;
        case TextAction::SelectLineStart:           cmd.MoveLineStart(true); break;
        case TextAction::SelectLineEnd:             cmd.MoveLineEnd(true); break;
        case TextAction::DocumentStart:             cmd.MoveDocumentStart(false); break;
        case TextAction::DocumentEnd:               cmd.MoveDocumentEnd(false); break;
        case TextAction::SelectDocumentStart:       cmd.MoveDocumentStart(true); break;
        case TextAction::SelectDocumentEnd:         cmd.MoveDocumentEnd(true); break;
        case TextAction::PageUp:                    cmd.MovePageUp(page, false); break;
        case TextAction::PageDown:                  cmd.MovePageDown(page, false); break;
        case TextAction::SelectPageUp:              cmd.MovePageUp(page, true); break;
        case TextAction::SelectPageDown:            cmd.MovePageDown(page, true); break;
        case TextAction::AddNextMatch:              cmd.AddNextMatch(); break;
        case TextAction::SelectAllMatches:          cmd.SelectAllMatches(); break;
        case TextAction::SplitSelectionIntoLines:   cmd.SplitSelectionIntoLines(); break;
        case TextAction::AddCursorAbove:            cmd.AddCursorAbove(); break;
        case TextAction::AddCursorBelow:            cmd.AddCursorBelow(); break;
        case TextAction::ColumnSelectUp:            m_columnSelect.Step(buf, sels, Text::ColumnStep::Up, cmd.Columns(), maxCursors); break;
        case TextAction::ColumnSelectDown:          m_columnSelect.Step(buf, sels, Text::ColumnStep::Down, cmd.Columns(), maxCursors); break;
        case TextAction::ColumnSelectLeft:          m_columnSelect.Step(buf, sels, Text::ColumnStep::Left, cmd.Columns(), maxCursors); break;
        case TextAction::ColumnSelectRight:         m_columnSelect.Step(buf, sels, Text::ColumnStep::Right, cmd.Columns(), maxCursors); break;
        case TextAction::SelectLine:                cmd.SelectLine(); break;
        case TextAction::ExpandSelectionToBrackets:
            if (const std::optional<Text::BracketContext> c = BracketContextNow()) Text::BracketCommands::ExpandSelectionToBrackets(buf, sels, *c);
            break;
        case TextAction::DuplicateLine:             if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.DuplicateLines(); break;
        case TextAction::DeleteLine:                if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.DeleteLines(); break;
        case TextAction::MoveLineUp:                if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.MoveLinesUp(); break;
        case TextAction::MoveLineDown:              if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.MoveLinesDown(); break;
        case TextAction::Indent:                    if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.Tab(); break;       // rows indent; else to the next tab stop
        case TextAction::IndentAlt:                 if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.Indent(); break;
        case TextAction::Outdent:
        case TextAction::OutdentAlt:                if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.Outdent(); break;
        case TextAction::ToggleLineComment:         if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.ToggleLineComment(); break;
        case TextAction::ToggleBlockComment:        if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.ToggleBlockComment(); break;
        case TextAction::JoinLines:                 if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.JoinLines(); break;
        case TextAction::Find:                      m_find.Open(false, sels); m_findUi.focusQuery = true; break;
        case TextAction::Replace:                   m_find.Open(!ReadOnly(), sels); m_findUi.focusQuery = true; break;
        case TextAction::FindNext:
            if (!m_find.IsOpen()) m_find.Open(false, sels);
            m_find.Next();
            break;
        case TextAction::FindPrevious:
            if (!m_find.IsOpen()) m_find.Open(false, sels);
            m_find.Previous();
            break;
        case TextAction::GoToLine:                  GotoLine().openRequested = true; break;
        case TextAction::Fold:                      Text::FoldCommands::FoldAtCursors(model.folds, model.display, sels, rope, model.indent.width); break;
        case TextAction::Unfold:                    Text::FoldCommands::UnfoldAtCursors(model.folds, model.display, sels, rope); break;
        case TextAction::GoToMatchingBracket:
            if (const std::optional<Text::BracketContext> c = BracketContextNow()) Text::BracketCommands::GoToMatchingBracket(buf, sels, *c);
            break;
        case TextAction::ToggleBookmark:            Bookmarks().Toggle(caretRow); break;
        case TextAction::NextBookmark:
            if (const std::optional<std::uint32_t> row = Bookmarks().Next(caretRow)) GoTo(Text::Point{ *row, 0 });
            break;
        case TextAction::PreviousBookmark:
            if (const std::optional<std::uint32_t> row = Bookmarks().Previous(caretRow)) GoTo(Text::Point{ *row, 0 });
            break;
        case TextAction::ZoomIn:                    view.ZoomBy(1); break;
        case TextAction::ZoomOut:                   view.ZoomBy(-1); break;
        case TextAction::ZoomReset:                 view.ResetZoom(); break;
        case TextAction::ConvertLineEndings:        // spec s3.5: explicit, one undo step, to the dominant style
            if (!ReadOnly()) buf.ConvertLineEndings(buf.Eols().Dominant(), sels);
            break;
        case TextAction::Count:                     break;
        }
        // A caret never stays inside a fold, and the primary stays on screen.
        Text::FoldCommands::RevealSelections(model.folds, model.display, sels, buf.Text());
        view.EnsureCursorVisible();
    }
```

(`GoTo` is TE2-19's -- body extended by TE4-13, re-targeted to the focused view by TE4-17; `ReadOnly()` gates every edit -- TE1's commands do not know about TE2's read-only document. `Find`/`Replace` seed the query from a single-line primary selection, TE4-10's `Open`.)

```cpp
        if (view.Focused())
        {
            m_focused = index;
            DispatchTextActions(EditorActions::Get(), *this);       // inside this view's ViewEditScope
        }
```

```cpp
        {

            TextModel& m = ModelOf(v);

            v.ScrollToRow(Buffer().Text().OffsetToPoint(r.begin).row, true);
```


Inside the class the unqualified name `EditContextProvider` now names this member, so TE2-13's two in-class uses of the namespace-scope alias are spelled out (an unqualified alias use followed by a same-named member is ill-formed, [basic.scope.class]; MSVC accepts it, GCC/Clang do not): `void SetEditContextProvider(std::function<Text::EditContext(TextModel&)> provider) { m_contextProvider = std::move(provider); }` and `std::function<Text::EditContext(TextModel&)> m_contextProvider;`. **Spec gaps, conflicts and decisions the controller should see** (notes 1-3 and 6-8 of the first draft -- the TE1/TE2 command layer, `TextModel` over a shared buffer, the syntax-service constructor, the encoding enums, TE6's view APIs, `SetVim` -- are resolved by CANON and removed; the remaining numbers are kept):
4. **TE3 Regex additions.** The windowed line path needs `PCRE2_NOTBOL` / `PCRE2_NOTEOL` and `PCRE2_INFO_MAXLOOKBEHIND`; TE4-5 adds `MatchFlags::{NotBol, NotEol}` and `Regex::MaxLookbehind()` to TE3's wrapper (and git-adds TE3's `Regex.hpp` / `.cpp`).
5. **Brackets are TE3's.** TE3-18 owns `FindMatchingBracket` / `FindEnclosingBrackets` (string and comment runs skipped, `bracketScanMaxLines` measured by TE3-32); TE4-14 is only the UI and commands over them. TE3's `brackets` are single ASCII characters; `autoClose` pairs (TE4-22) are strings.
9. **Chords the spec does not give.** Column select (Ctrl+Shift+Alt+arrows), expand selection to brackets (Ctrl+Shift+M), zoom (Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0) use VS Code / Sublime chords; `text.convertLineEndings` ships unbound (the status strip and the Inspector are its primary controls) and normalizes to the dominant style. `text.toggleFollow` is TE6-4's row (a `TextActionRow` with `TextAction::ToggleFollow`, unbound; CANON A8), not TE4's.
10. **Split view has no s7 row.** The s7 list names none; TE4 adds a status-strip toggle and the `OpenSplit` / `CloseSplit` API for vim's `:sp` / `:vs` / `Ctrl+W` (TE5c). A `text.splitView` row would be a one-line addition if wanted.
11. **Real defect in the settings tree:** `ParseKeyChord("Ctrl+[")` returned nullopt (a bare `[` started a physical key name), so the spec's Ctrl+[ outdent could not be a default and a captured Ctrl+[ on the Shortcuts page did not round-trip. TE4-1 fixes it.
12. **Typing gate.** `EditorActions::Live` silences unmodified panel chords while `WantTextInput` is set, which a text view sets to receive characters; TE4-1 exempts `ActionContext::TextDocument` (its unmodified rows use non-printing keys only: Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Tab, F2, F3). A design decision in shared input code.
13. **ImGui nav tabbing** would take Tab from `text.indent`; TE4-9 sets `ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs` on the text-area child.
14. **New settings beyond the s8 list:** `editor.text.detectIndentationRows` (TE4-18; the detection bound) and TE3's `bracketScanMaxLines`. Both follow the every-tunable-is-a-setting rule; CANON D29 amends s8 with them, and TE4-3's s8-amendment contract case checks them.
15. **Auto-close rules** follow VS Code's defaults (`languageDefined`, close only before whitespace / end of line / a closer, no quote after a word character, type over and Backspace-delete only closers it inserted). The spec names the setting, not the rules.
16a. **Known limit (lossy split close, TE4-17):** `CloseView` on the primary while split rebuilds the primary's folds from the second view as `FoldSource::Marker` / `FoldSource::Indent`, so a vim Manual (`zf`) fold comes back as an Indent fold over the same rows (still folded; a later `zE` / edit treats it as Indent). Carrying the source needs a `FoldModel` accessor TE1-12 does not have; deferred.
16. **Documented limits, not bugs:** a match longer than a quarter of `longLineMaxBytes` that crosses a window boundary on an over-long line is cut there; backward Find scans from the document start (on the worker); Find Next lands one frame later (it runs on the worker); symbols are not extracted above `syntaxMaxMB`; Problems markers show only `File` locators; keyboard column select skips rows shorter than the box's left edge (Sublime, VS Code); auto-close forgets a tracked closer once no caret is on its row.
17. **TE2 integration edits are described by insertion point**, not line numbers: the overlay call sites in `TextEditorView::Draw` (TE4-9), the find bar / go-to / status strip / modal positions in `TextDocument::Draw`, the second model and view (TE4-17), the indentation in `DefaultEditContext` (TE4-18), the typing filter (TE4-22), the removal of `ApplyBaselineKey`'s Home / End / PageUp / PageDown / Tab cases (TE4-24), and the `SetProblemsSource` call in TE2's text factory in `EditorApp.cpp` (TE4-15).

**Folded-scroll and split-highlight correctness (found while reconciling):** TE2-13's `Facts().firstVisibleRow` is a BUFFER row, while TE4-9's `FirstVisibleDisplayRow()` first returned it unchanged; with folds the two differ, so the view now records the frame's first display row (`m_firstDisplayRow`) and every TE4 caller that converts with `DisplayRowToBuffer` is correct.

### Findings that shaped this chunk (read before executing)

Each finding was verified against the settings tree `D:\dev\starworks\Arcane-settings` at `19716cf2`, and `main` at `e1db2d9e`.

1. **There is no autosave or recovery path to join.** Crash-window plan 3, "Autosave and recovery" (`docs/specs/2026-09-22-crash-window-design.md` s8), was never built: no `SaveTo` seam, no `RestoreData.json`, no restore prompt, no settings.
   - `EditorApp.hpp:143` and `EditorAppFrame.cpp:524` say "plan 3's job".
   - What *does* exist:
     - plan 1's clean-exit hook: `Diagnostics::SetCleanExitHook` / `RequestCleanExit` (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Base/Diagnostics.hpp:418-438`), and `EditorApp::InstallCleanExitHook` / `CleanExitRequested` (`EditorApp.hpp:144,148`);
     - `EditorLock` (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Project/Project.hpp:167-208`), whose stale lock nothing reads.
   - So TE6-13..TE6-15 build the text slice of s8 **in s8's own shapes**:
     - the s8.5 marker schema;
     - files under `<project>/Saved/Autosaves/`;
     - the s8.6 offer: per-entry checkbox, Restore Selected / Skip;
     - the s8.5 "never under a debugger or `--headless`" rule.
   - They write their own marker, `Saved/Autosaves/Text/RestoreData.json`, so plan 3 can later own `Saved/Autosaves/RestoreData.json` and fold the text entries into its one prompt without a migration (CANON D20).
2. **The CommandStack has no prune API, and commands are not keyed by asset.** `ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Edit/CommandStack.hpp:53-191`.
   - Document steps hold a `std::weak_ptr<Doc*>` "anchor", e.g. `ShaderEditorDocument.cpp:216-223`.
   - A step expires when its anchor dies, and expired steps are discarded lazily, top-down, on Undo/Redo (`CommandStack.cpp:245-297`).
   - "Prune-on-invalidate" is the **Inspector history** rule (`InspectorHost::InvalidateSource` / `PruneStale`, `ArcaneEditor/src/Panels/InspectorHost.hpp:96,166`), not an undo-stack one.
   - So TE6-6 adds `CommandStack::PruneExpired()`. A clean reload then:
     - re-mints the document's anchor, which expires every pre-reload step;
     - prunes them eagerly;
     - calls `InspectorHost::InvalidateSource` for the document.
   - Together these are the "global CommandStack entries for that asset pruned" of s5.4 (CANON D22).
3. **"Open as text" already exists, but it opens the file in the OS default editor.**
   - The entry points are:
     - the Asset Browser row menu: `AssetPanelCommon.cpp:390-391`;
     - the Assets menu: `EditorPanels.cpp:400-401`;
     - the Inspector asset page: `AssetInspectorSource.cpp:393`;
     - the Problems locator route: `EditorAppProject.cpp:260-261`.
   - All of them end in `OsShell::OpenAsText`: `EditorAppFrame.cpp:190-200`, through `AssetPathAction`.
   - TE6-12 builds the in-editor backend (`EditorApp::OpenAsText`, `OpenAsTextFlow`); **TE7-11** re-points the four sites straight to `Files().OpenWith(path, OpenerId::ArcaneText())` (CANON B6). No new menu rows are needed.
4. **The editor has no OS file watcher.**
   - `EditorApp::PollAssetWatch` (`EditorAppProject.cpp:432-746`) is a ~1 Hz mtime poll with hard-coded per-kind branches.
   - Only materials reload an open document, and that reload never touches undo history.
   - Sprite, Mesh and InputActions documents ignore external changes. TE6-7..TE6-11 is the s5.4 audit plus its fixes.
5. **No timing baseline mechanism exists.** `scripts/automation-baselines.json` holds suite-wide assertion and case counts only, and `check-baselines.ps1` compares those two metrics.
   - TE6-18 adds a `perf[]` table (ceilings per configuration), a test helper that reads it, and a `-PerfReportPath` mode for the checker (CANON D32).
   - The precedent for an inline ceiling with headroom was the removed `PhysicsPerfTripwireTest` (`a0d5f03d6`).

### Task TE6-6: `CommandStack::PruneExpired` -- eager removal of a reloaded document's steps (spec s5.4)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Edit/CommandStack.hpp`. Declare the method after `Clear` (`:147`).
- Modify: `ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Edit/CommandStack.cpp`. Add the method after `DiscardExpired` (`:251-255`).
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/CommandStackTest.cpp`. Append cases that reuse the file's `DocStep` / `CountingCommand` fakes (`:310-343`).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `CommandStack::Expired` (private, `:219`).
- Produces: `std::size_t Arcane::CommandStack::PruneExpired()`. It removes every expired, non-scene transaction from both the undo and redo deques, wherever it sits, and keeps the order of everything else.

  Why non-scene only: `SceneStateId()` (`CommandStack.cpp:299-307`) is the scene's dirty clock. Pruning only `!affectsScene` steps leaves it unchanged by construction. Every document step returns `AffectsScene() == false` (`ShaderEditorDocument.cpp:219`).

  ABI: this is an added non-virtual member of an `ARC_API` class. It changes no layout and needs no `kGamePluginABIVersion` bump (GATE-1 Step 1 checks this).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```cpp
TEST_CASE("PruneExpired removes expired document steps anywhere, keeps live order and the scene clock", "[edit][undo]")
{
    auto reg = MakeReg();
    Arcane::CommandStack stack([&reg]() -> Astra::Registry& { return *reg; });
    int u = 0, r = 0, du = 0, dr = 0;
    auto anchor = std::make_shared<int>(0);
    stack.Push(std::make_unique<DocStep>(anchor, &du, &dr, "doc 1"));
    stack.Push(std::make_unique<CountingCommand>(&u, &r, "Scene A"));
    stack.Push(std::make_unique<DocStep>(anchor, &du, &dr, "doc 2"));
    stack.Push(std::make_unique<CountingCommand>(&u, &r, "Scene B"));
    stack.Undo();                                            // Scene B -> redo
    const std::uint64_t sceneId = stack.SceneStateId();

    anchor.reset();                                          // the document reloaded: its anchor re-minted
    CHECK(stack.PruneExpired() == 2);                        // doc 1 (bottom) and doc 2 (middle)
    CHECK(stack.SceneStateId() == sceneId);
    CHECK(std::string(stack.UndoLabel()) == "Scene A");
    stack.Undo();
    CHECK(u == 2);                                           // Scene B (earlier) + Scene A
    CHECK_FALSE(stack.CanUndo());                            // nothing left below: doc 1 is gone, not skipped
    stack.Redo(); stack.Redo();
    CHECK(r == 2);
    CHECK(du == 0);
    CHECK(dr == 0);
    CHECK(stack.PruneExpired() == 0);                        // idempotent
}

TEST_CASE("PruneExpired never removes a live document step", "[edit][undo]")
{
    auto reg = MakeReg();
    Arcane::CommandStack stack([&reg]() -> Astra::Registry& { return *reg; });
    int du = 0, dr = 0;
    auto dead = std::make_shared<int>(0);
    auto live = std::make_shared<int>(0);
    stack.Push(std::make_unique<DocStep>(live, &du, &dr, "live"));
    stack.Push(std::make_unique<DocStep>(dead, &du, &dr, "dead"));
    dead.reset();
    CHECK(stack.PruneExpired() == 1);
    CHECK(std::string(stack.UndoLabel()) == "live");
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run it to see it fail.** Build. Expected: `error C2039: 'PruneExpired': is not a member of 'Arcane::CommandStack'`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

In `CommandStack.hpp`, after `void Clear(std::string reason);`:

```cpp
        // Removes every EXPIRED, NON-SCENE transaction from both stacks,
        // wherever it sits (Undo/Redo only discard expired entries from the
        // top). Text editor spec s5.4: a dedicated editor that reloads its
        // asset under a clean working copy re-mints its anchor and prunes
        // here, so no pre-reload step survives anywhere in the history.
        // Scene steps are never touched, so SceneStateId() is unchanged.
        // Returns the number removed.
        std::size_t PruneExpired();
```

In `CommandStack.cpp`:

```cpp
    std::size_t CommandStack::PruneExpired()
    {
        const auto prunable = [](const Transaction& t) { return !t.affectsScene && Expired(t); };
        const std::size_t removed = std::erase_if(m_undo, prunable) + std::erase_if(m_redo, prunable);
        return removed;
    }
```

`std::erase_if` on `std::deque` is C++20 and is in `<deque>`, which the header already includes.

```cpp
#include <Arcane/Edit/CommandStack.hpp>
#include <Astra/Registry/Registry.hpp>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    struct Step final : ICommand
    {
        std::weak_ptr<int> anchor;
        explicit Step(std::weak_ptr<int> a) : anchor(std::move(a)) {}
        void Undo() override {}
        void Redo() override {}
        const char* Label() const override { return "doc step"; }
        bool AffectsScene() const override { return false; }
        bool IsExpired() const override { return anchor.expired(); }
    };

    // A dedicated-editor stand-in: "disk" is a string the test changes.
    struct FakeDoc final : EditorDocument
    {
        Guid guid = Guid::Generate();
        std::string title = "fake";
        std::string memory = "v1", saved = "v1", disk = "v1";
        std::shared_ptr<int> anchor = std::make_shared<int>(0);
        int reloads = 0;

        const std::string& Title() const override { return title; }
        Guid AssetGuid() const override { return guid; }
        bool Dirty() const override { return memory != saved; }
        bool Save() override { saved = disk = memory; return true; }
        void Draw(bool&) override {}
        void NoteMoved(const std::filesystem::path&) override {}
        ExternalReloadResult ReloadFromExternalChange() override
        {
            if (disk == saved && memory == saved) return ExternalReloadResult::Unchanged;   // our own save's echo
            memory = saved = disk;
            ++reloads;
            return ExternalReloadResult::Reloaded;
        }
        void ExpireHistory() override { anchor = std::make_shared<int>(0); }
    };

    std::unique_ptr<Astra::Registry> Reg()
    {
        return std::make_unique<Astra::Registry>(std::make_shared<Astra::ComponentRegistry>());
    }
}

TEST_CASE("external asset reload: clean -> reloaded, history pruned, inspector invalidated, note shown", "[text-astext]")
{
    auto reg = Reg();
    CommandStack stack([&reg]() -> Astra::Registry& { return *reg; });
    DocumentHost host;
    auto* doc = static_cast<FakeDoc*>(host.Add(std::make_unique<FakeDoc>()));
    stack.Push(std::make_unique<Step>(doc->anchor));
    doc->memory = "v2"; doc->Save();                         // an edit, saved: clean with one step
    REQUIRE(stack.CanUndo());

    int invalidated = 0;
    const ExternalReloadContext ctx{ &stack, [&](EditorDocument&) { ++invalidated; } };
    doc->disk = "v3";                                        // Open as Text saved new bytes
    CHECK(ApplyExternalAssetChange(host, doc->guid, ctx) == ExternalChangeOutcome::Reloaded);
    CHECK(doc->memory == "v3");
    CHECK_FALSE(stack.CanUndo());                            // the pre-reload step is gone
    CHECK(invalidated == 1);
    CHECK(doc->ExternalStrip().HistoryNoteShown());
    CHECK(ExternalChangeStrip::kHistoryClearedText == "History cleared: the file was changed outside this editor");
}
```

`EditorDocument.hpp` additions. Put the enum above the class, include `"Documents/ExternalChangeStrip.hpp"`, and add the class members after `FlushGesture`:

```cpp
    // Text editor spec s5.4: what a document did with "your file changed on disk".
    enum class ExternalReloadResult : std::uint8_t
    {
        Unchanged,     // the file holds what this document last loaded/saved (our own save's echo)
        Reloaded,      // the working copy was replaced from disk
        Failed,        // the file did not load; the in-memory copy is kept
        Unsupported,   // this document type does not reload (the default)
    };

        // ---- external change (text editor spec s5.4) ------------------------
        // Replace the working copy from disk, DISCARDING it -- callers gate on
        // Dirty() (ApplyExternalAssetChange never reloads a dirty document
        // without the user's Reload). Unchanged when the file equals what the
        // document holds. Not "ReloadFromDisk": TextDocument has a non-virtual
        // void ReloadFromDisk() (TE2-17) that would hide this virtual; text
        // documents reload through their own poll and never override this.
        virtual ExternalReloadResult ReloadFromExternalChange() { return ExternalReloadResult::Unsupported; }
        // Make every undo step this document pushed so far inert: re-mint the
        // anchor its commands hold weakly. The caller prunes the stack after.
        virtual void ExpireHistory() {}
        // The toolbar note / conflict banner (each document draws it under its toolbar).
        ExternalChangeStrip& ExternalStrip() noexcept { return m_externalStrip; }
        const ExternalChangeStrip& ExternalStrip() const noexcept { return m_externalStrip; }

    private:
        ExternalChangeStrip m_externalStrip;
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/ExternalChangeStrip.hpp
#pragma once
// The one-line strip a dedicated editor draws under its toolbar for an
// external change (text editor spec s5.4): the "History cleared" note after a
// clean reload, or the conflict banner (Reload / Keep mine) when the document
// had unsaved changes. Model + one Draw; the model is what the tests drive.
#include <functional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class ExternalChangeStrip
    {
    public:
        static constexpr std::string_view kHistoryClearedText =
            "History cleared: the file was changed outside this editor";

        void NoteHistoryCleared() { m_conflict = false; m_reload = {}; m_history = true; }
        void NoteConflict(std::string fileName, std::function<void()> reloadDiscardingMine)
        {
            m_conflict = true;
            m_file = std::move(fileName);
            m_reload = std::move(reloadDiscardingMine);
        }
        void Dismiss() { m_history = false; m_conflict = false; m_reload = {}; }
        // The banner's buttons (Draw calls them; tests call them directly).
        void ChooseReload() { auto run = std::move(m_reload); m_conflict = false; m_reload = {}; if (run) run(); }
        void ChooseKeepMine() { m_conflict = false; m_reload = {}; }

        [[nodiscard]] bool HistoryNoteShown() const noexcept { return m_history; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool ConflictShown() const noexcept { return m_conflict; }
        // Draws the strip inside the caller's window; false (nothing drawn) when empty.
        bool Draw();

    private:
        bool m_history = false;
        bool m_conflict = false;
        std::string m_file;
        std::function<void()> m_reload;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/ExternalChangeStrip.cpp
#include "Documents/ExternalChangeStrip.hpp"

#include <imgui.h>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    bool ExternalChangeStrip::Draw()
    {
        if (!m_conflict && !m_history)
            return false;
        ImGui::PushID("##external_change_strip");
        if (m_conflict)
        {
            ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
            ImGui::TextUnformatted((m_file + " changed on disk, and you have unsaved changes here.").c_str());
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Reload (discard mine)"))
                ChooseReload();
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Keep mine"))
                ChooseKeepMine();
        }
        else
        {
            ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", std::string(kHistoryClearedText).c_str());
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Dismiss"))
                Dismiss();
        }
        ImGui::PopID();
        ImGui::Separator();
        return true;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/ExternalAssetReload.hpp
#pragma once
// Text editor spec s5.4: "the same rule applies to any external change that
// reloads an asset under a clean dedicated editor". ONE function every
// trigger calls -- PollAssetWatch's mtime sweep and Open as Text's save.
#include "Documents/EditorDocument.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Guid.hpp>

#include <functional>

namespace Arcane { class CommandStack; }

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class DocumentHost;

    struct ExternalReloadContext
    {
        Arcane::CommandStack* undo = nullptr;                      // the ONE editor history (EditorApp::m_undo); null = no history to prune
        std::function<void(EditorDocument&)> invalidateInspector;  // InspectorHost::InvalidateSource (prune-on-invalidate)
    };

    enum class ExternalChangeOutcome : std::uint8_t { NoDocument, Unchanged, Reloaded, Conflict, Failed, Unsupported };

    // Reload `doc` from disk discarding its working copy, then clear its
    // history: re-mint its anchor, prune the stack, invalidate its Inspector
    // history, show the toolbar note. Unchanged/Failed/Unsupported clear nothing.
    ExternalReloadResult ReloadAndClearHistory(EditorDocument& doc, const ExternalReloadContext& ctx);

    // Every open document for `guid` (except `origin` and text documents,
    // which TE2's own watcher handles): clean -> ReloadAndClearHistory; dirty
    // -> the conflict banner. Returns the strongest outcome seen.
    ExternalChangeOutcome ApplyExternalAssetChange(DocumentHost& docs, const Arcane::Guid& guid,
                                                   const ExternalReloadContext& ctx,
                                                   const EditorDocument* origin = nullptr);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/ExternalAssetReload.cpp
#include "Documents/ExternalAssetReload.hpp"

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Edit/CommandStack.hpp>

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    ExternalReloadResult ReloadAndClearHistory(EditorDocument& doc, const ExternalReloadContext& ctx)
    {
        const ExternalReloadResult r = doc.ReloadFromExternalChange();
        if (r != ExternalReloadResult::Reloaded)
            return r;
        doc.ExpireHistory();                       // every pre-reload step now holds a dead anchor
        if (ctx.undo)
            (void)ctx.undo->PruneExpired();        // ...and is removed, not merely skipped
        if (ctx.invalidateInspector)
            ctx.invalidateInspector(doc);          // its Inspector history keys named the old objects
        doc.ExternalStrip().NoteHistoryCleared();
        return r;
    }

    ExternalChangeOutcome ApplyExternalAssetChange(DocumentHost& docs, const Arcane::Guid& guid,
                                                   const ExternalReloadContext& ctx, const EditorDocument* origin)
    {
        ExternalChangeOutcome best = ExternalChangeOutcome::NoDocument;
        const auto rank = [](ExternalChangeOutcome o) { return static_cast<int>(o); };
        docs.ForEach([&](EditorDocument& d)
        {
            if (&d == origin || d.AssetGuid() != guid || dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(&d))
                return;
            ExternalChangeOutcome o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Unsupported;
            if (d.Dirty())
            {
                // s5.4: "has unsaved changes -> shows its own conflict banner
                // instead of silently losing either side".
                EditorDocument* target = &d;
                d.ExternalStrip().NoteConflict(d.Title(), [target, ctx] { (void)ReloadAndClearHistory(*target, ctx); });
                o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Conflict;
            }
            else
            {
                switch (ReloadAndClearHistory(d, ctx))
                {
                    case ExternalReloadResult::Unchanged:   o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Unchanged; break;
                    case ExternalReloadResult::Reloaded:    o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Reloaded; break;
                    case ExternalReloadResult::Failed:      o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Failed; break;
                    case ExternalReloadResult::Unsupported: o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Unsupported; break;
                }
            }
            if (best == ExternalChangeOutcome::NoDocument || rank(o) > rank(best))
                best = o;
        });
        return best;
    }
}
```

The conflict closure captures `target` as a raw pointer. That is sound: the strip is a member of the document, so the closure dies with the document. `ctx` is captured by value, so the stack pointer and callback stay valid for the app's lifetime.

```cpp
    ExternalReloadResult ShaderEditorDocument::ReloadFromExternalChange()
    {
        auto data = Arcane::LoadMaterialAsset(m_path);
        if (!data)
        {
            ARC_WARN("'{}': reload from disk failed -- keeping the in-memory copy", m_title);
            return ExternalReloadResult::Failed;
        }
        if (!Dirty() && Arcane::SaveMaterialAssetToString(*data) == Arcane::SaveMaterialAssetToString(m_data))
            return ExternalReloadResult::Unchanged;   // our own save's echo (or a touch): nothing to reload
        if (Arcane::CommandStack* s = UndoStack())
            EditGesture::ClosePending(*s, m_gesture); // never strand a parked gesture across the swap
        m_data = std::move(*data);
        // ... the existing body from `m_snippet = m_data.snippet;` through
        //     RegenerateFromGraph() stays exactly as it is ...
        return ExternalReloadResult::Reloaded;
    }

    void ShaderEditorDocument::ExpireHistory()
    {
        // The anchor every ParamEdit/Graph/PassList/MeshMaterialMetadata step
        // holds weakly (:216-223). A fresh control block orphans the old one:
        // every pre-reload step reports IsExpired() from here on.
        m_anchor = std::make_shared<ShaderEditorDocument*>(this);
    }
```

```cpp
    ExternalReloadResult InputActionsDocument::ReloadFromExternalChange()
    {
        std::error_code ec;
        if (!std::filesystem::exists(path_, ec))
            return ExternalReloadResult::Failed;
        nlohmann::json fresh = ReadDraft(path_);
        if (!model_.Dirty() && fresh == model_.Draft())
            return ExternalReloadResult::Unchanged;
        model_.ReloadFrom(std::move(fresh));
        PublishWarnings();
        return ExternalReloadResult::Reloaded;
    }
    void InputActionsDocument::ExpireHistory() { model_.ExpireHistory(); }
```

CANON A10 lists `docs`, `reload`, `afterAssetSave` and `Open`. `services`, `lastError` and `AfterSave` are additive: a text document cannot be opened without the app's services (syntax, clipboard, the composed `afterSave`).

  - `Arcane::Editor::OpenAsTextFlow EditorApp::MakeOpenAsTextFlow()` (private)

**The rule.** A file whose extension has a **dedicated** editor factory (`docs.HasDedicatedFactory(path)`, TE2-19) opens **locked**:
- read-only, with `TextReadOnlyReason::Locked`;
- the banner `'<name>' has its own editor. This view is read-only.`;
- one button, **Enable editing**.

Every other file opens editable, exactly as TE2's routes open it. `HasFactory` is the wrong test for this. After TE2-20 it answers true for `.md`, `.arcsyntax` and every file the fallback claims, so every file would open locked.

**The save.** The app's text `afterSave` is ONE composed lambda (CANON B21). TE2-20 starts it as a no-op, TE3-30 appends `NotifySaved`, and this task appends `OpenAsTextFlow::AfterSave`. `AfterSave` looks up the saved document's asset guid: `AssetGuid()`, falling back to `AssetRegistry::PeekId(CanonicalPath())`.
- For an asset, it runs `ApplyExternalAssetChange(docs, guid, reload, &saved)`:
  - a clean dedicated editor reloads, its history is cleared and the note is shown;
  - a dirty one shows its conflict banner.

  It then calls `afterAssetSave(path)`. In the app, that callback invalidates the asset's caches by kind, which is "the registry's reload of that asset" (s5.4), and re-baselines `m_materialMtimes`.
- A non-asset save does nothing more.

Every text save runs this, not only the ones from Open as Text. A `.arcmat` opened from anywhere and saved as text reloads its material editor.

```cpp
    void WriteFile(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view text)
    {
        std::filesystem::create_directories(p.parent_path());
        std::ofstream out(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        out << text;
    }

    // Replace the whole text in ONE transaction, through TE1's command class
    // (product code never calls TextBuffer::BeginTransaction/Edit/EndTransaction).
    void ReplaceAll(TextDocument& t, std::string text)
    {
        const Text::ByteOffset size = t.Buffer().Text().Size();
        Text::TextCommands(t.Buffer(), t.Model().selections, DefaultEditContext(t.Model()))
            .EditAndMap(Text::TransactionKind::Other, { Text::EditOp{ Text::ByteRange{ 0, size }, std::move(text) } },
                        Text::Bias::Left, Text::Bias::Left, Text::Bias::Right);
    }

    struct Fixture
    {
        std::unique_ptr<Astra::Registry> reg = std::make_unique<Astra::Registry>(std::make_shared<Astra::ComponentRegistry>());
        CommandStack stack{ [this]() -> Astra::Registry& { return *reg; } };
        DocumentHost host;
        std::filesystem::path path;
        SpriteDocument* sprite = nullptr;
        TextDocumentServices services;
        int assetSaves = 0;   // the app's afterAssetSave (cache invalidation) stand-in

        explicit Fixture(const char* name)
        {
            path = FreshDir(name) / "s.arcsprite";
            SpriteAssetData data = SpriteDocument::NewSpriteData(Guid::Generate(), "s");
            REQUIRE(SaveSpriteAsset(path, data));
            host.RegisterFactory(".arcsprite", [this](const std::filesystem::path& p) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> {
                SpriteDocument::Services sv; sv.undo = [this] { return &stack; };
                return std::make_unique<SpriteDocument>(sv, p, *LoadSpriteAsset(p)); });
            sprite = static_cast<SpriteDocument*>(host.OpenPath(path));
            REQUIRE(sprite);
            // The app's services (TE2-20 wiring): the asset id from the file,
            // and afterSave composed with the flow's AfterSave (TE6-12).
            services.peekGuid = [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return AssetRegistry::PeekId(p).value_or(Guid::Nil()); };
            services.afterSave = [this](TextDocument& d) { Flow().AfterSave(d); };
        }

        OpenAsTextFlow Flow()
        {
            return OpenAsTextFlow{ host, ExternalReloadContext{ &stack, {} },
                                   [this](const std::filesystem::path&) { ++assetSaves; }, services };
        }

        void EditSprite()
        {
            const SpriteAssetData before = sprite->Data();
            SpriteAssetData edited = before;
            edited.pixelsPerUnit = 33.0f;
            sprite->ApplySpriteData(edited);
            sprite->PushDataEdit("ppu", before);
        }
    };

    constexpr std::string_view kGrammar = R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":"Test","scope":"source.t","files":[".tst"],
        "patterns":[{"match":"//.*$","scope":"comment.line.t"},{"match":"[0-9]+","scope":"constant.numeric.t"}]})";
}

TEST_CASE("open as text: an asset with a dedicated editor opens locked; Enable editing unlocks", "[text-astext][witness][text]")
{
    Fixture f("locked");
    OpenAsTextFlow flow = f.Flow();
    TextDocument* t = flow.Open(f.path);
    REQUIRE(t);
    CHECK(flow.lastError.empty());
    CHECK(t->LockedByDedicatedEditor());
    CHECK(t->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(t->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::Locked);
    CHECK(t->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::Locked);
    CHECK(t->Banner().message == "'s.arcsprite' has its own editor. This view is read-only.");
    CHECK(BannerActions(t->Banner()) == std::vector<TextBannerAction>{ TextBannerAction::EnableEditing });
    CHECK(std::string_view(BannerActionLabel(TextBannerAction::EnableEditing)) == "Enable editing");
    CHECK_FALSE(t->Save());                                      // locked: nothing is written

    CHECK(t->EnableEditing());
    CHECK_FALSE(t->LockedByDedicatedEditor());
    CHECK_FALSE(t->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(t->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(f.Flow().Open(f.path) == t);                           // one tab per canonical path
    CHECK(f.host.Count() == 2u);                                 // the sprite editor + one text tab

    OpenAsTextFlow missing = f.Flow();
    CHECK(missing.Open(f.path.parent_path() / "missing.txt") == nullptr);
    CHECK_FALSE(missing.lastError.empty());                      // TE2-15's error text, for the caller to show
}

TEST_CASE("open as text: another spelling of an open file finds its one tab (canonical lookup first)", "[text-astext][witness][text]")
{
    // Spec s5.3: any spelling of an open file is its one tab. Open canonicalises
    // the RAW path (TE2-5's CanonicalFilePath) BEFORE FindByCanonicalPath, so a
    // differently-cased or `..`-containing spelling must not open a second tab.
    Fixture f("spelling");
    TextDocument* t = f.Flow().Open(f.path);
    REQUIRE(t);
    REQUIRE(f.host.Count() == 2u);                               // the sprite editor + one text tab

    const std::filesystem::path dir = f.path.parent_path();
    const std::filesystem::path dotted = dir / ".." / dir.filename() / "s.arcsprite";
    const std::filesystem::path upper = dir / "S.ARCSPRITE";     // NTFS is case-insensitive
    REQUIRE(dotted != f.path);
    REQUIRE(upper != f.path);

    OpenAsTextFlow viaDots = f.Flow();
    CHECK(viaDots.Open(dotted) == t);
    CHECK(viaDots.lastError.empty());
    OpenAsTextFlow viaCase = f.Flow();
    CHECK(viaCase.Open(upper) == t);
    CHECK(viaCase.lastError.empty());
    CHECK(f.host.Count() == 2u);                                 // still one text tab
    CHECK(t->LockedByDedicatedEditor());                         // the reopen left the lock alone
}

TEST_CASE("open as text: save under a CLEAN dedicated editor reloads it, clears its history, shows the note", "[text-astext][witness][text]")
{
    Fixture f("clean");
    f.EditSprite();
    REQUIRE(f.sprite->Save());                                   // clean, one undo step
    REQUIRE(f.stack.CanUndo());

    TextDocument* t = f.Flow().Open(f.path);
    REQUIRE(t);
    REQUIRE(t->EnableEditing());
    std::string text = t->Buffer().Text().ToString();
    const auto at = text.find("33");
    REQUIRE(at != std::string::npos);
    text.replace(at, 2, "77");
    ReplaceAll(*t, text);
    REQUIRE(t->Save());

    CHECK(f.sprite->Data().pixelsPerUnit == 77.0f);
    CHECK_FALSE(f.stack.CanUndo());
    CHECK(f.sprite->ExternalStrip().HistoryNoteShown());
    CHECK(f.assetSaves == 1);                                    // the app's cache invalidation ran once
}

TEST_CASE("open as text: save under a DIRTY dedicated editor raises its conflict banner, losing nothing", "[text-astext][witness][text]")
{
    Fixture f("dirty");
    f.EditSprite();                                              // unsaved: ppu 33 in memory only
    TextDocument* t = f.Flow().Open(f.path);
    REQUIRE(t);
    REQUIRE(t->EnableEditing());
    std::string text = t->Buffer().Text().ToString();
    text += "\n";                                                // any byte change
    ReplaceAll(*t, text);
    REQUIRE(t->Save());

    CHECK(f.sprite->Data().pixelsPerUnit == 33.0f);              // the editor's unsaved value survives
    CHECK(f.sprite->ExternalStrip().ConflictShown());
    CHECK(f.stack.CanUndo());
}

TEST_CASE("open as text: a grammar saved as text reloads the grammar AND runs the asset path (F4)", "[text-astext][witness][text]")
{
    Fixture f("grammar");
    // The grammar lives in the service's engine search dir. Both sides use the
    // CANONICAL spelling: TEMP can be an 8.3 path, and NotifySaved matches the
    // saved document's canonical path against the search dirs.
    const auto written = f.path.parent_path() / "engine" / "Test.arcsyntax";
    WriteFile(written, kGrammar);
    const std::filesystem::path grammar = CanonicalFilePath(written).value_or(written);
    TextSyntaxService svc(std::make_unique<Text::ManualHighlightExecutor>(), grammar.parent_path());
    const std::uint64_t gen = svc.Registry().Generation();

    // .arcsyntax is a TEXT route in the app (TE2-15's ExplicitTextExtensions),
    // so HasFactory is true; it has no dedicated editor, so it opens unlocked.
    f.host.RegisterTextFactory(".arcsyntax", [](const std::filesystem::path&) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> { return nullptr; });
    REQUIRE(f.host.HasFactory(grammar));
    REQUIRE_FALSE(f.host.HasDedicatedFactory(grammar));

    // The app's composition, link by link (CANON B21): TE2-20's no-op start,
    // TE3-30's NotifySaved, then TE6-12's AfterSave -- each extends `prev`.
    const Guid assetId = Guid::Generate();
    f.services.peekGuid = [assetId](const std::filesystem::path&) { return assetId; };   // the asset path runs
    f.services.afterSave = [](TextDocument&) {};
    f.services.afterSave = [&svc, prev = std::move(f.services.afterSave)](TextDocument& d)
    {
        if (prev) prev(d);
        svc.NotifySaved(d.CanonicalPath());
    };
    f.services.afterSave = [&f, prev = std::move(f.services.afterSave)](TextDocument& d)
    {
        if (prev) prev(d);
        f.Flow().AfterSave(d);
    };

    TextDocument* t = f.Flow().Open(grammar);
    REQUIRE(t);
    CHECK_FALSE(t->LockedByDedicatedEditor());
    CHECK_FALSE(t->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(t->AssetGuid() == assetId);
    std::string text = t->Buffer().Text().ToString();
    const auto at = text.find("comment.line.t");
    REQUIRE(at != std::string::npos);
    text.replace(at, std::string_view("comment.line.t").size(), "comment.block.t");
    ReplaceAll(*t, text);
    REQUIRE(t->Save());

    CHECK(svc.Registry().Generation() > gen);                    // the grammar reloaded live (TE3-30)
    CHECK(f.assetSaves == 1);                                    // AND the asset path ran (TE6-12)
}
```

```cpp
    void TextDocument::SetReadOnlyLock(bool locked)
    {

        RecomputeReadOnly();
        if (locked)
        {
            // A save, disk or content banner already up keeps the strip: it
            // needs its own answer first. ApplyBannerAction hands the strip
```
