```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/OpenAsText.hpp
#pragma once
// Text editor spec s5.4 (D10): Open as Text, the app-free half of
// EditorApp::OpenAsText. FileOpener's Arcane backend (TE7-9) reaches it
// through EditorApp::OpenAsText; the [text-astext] witness drives it
// directly. A file whose extension has a DEDICATED editor opens locked.
#include "Documents/ExternalAssetReload.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class DocumentHost;

    struct OpenAsTextFlow
    {
        DocumentHost&         docs;
        ExternalReloadContext reload;
        // App extras after an ASSET was saved as text (cache invalidation by
        // kind, the asset-watch re-baseline); may be empty.
        std::function<void(const std::filesystem::path&)> afterAssetSave;
        // The services every text document the app opens carries (syntax,
        // clipboard, the composed afterSave). Additive to CANON A10.
        TextDocumentServices  services;
        // Why the last Open returned null (TE2-15's error text); empty after a success.
        std::string           lastError;

        // Focus the existing text tab for `path` (TE2's canonical identity), or open one.
        TextDocument* Open(const std::filesystem::path& path);
        // The afterSave link (CANON B21): for an asset, every other open
        // editor of it reloads (clean) or shows its conflict banner (dirty),
        // then afterAssetSave runs. A non-asset save does nothing here.
        void AfterSave(const TextDocument& saved) const;
    };
}
```

**`OpenAsText.cpp`:**

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/OpenAsText.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/OpenAsText.hpp"

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Project/AssetRegistry.hpp>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    TextDocument* OpenAsTextFlow::Open(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        lastError.clear();
        // Spec s5.3: any spelling of an open file is its one tab. The host
        // keys text documents by CanonicalFilePath (TE2-5), so the RAW path is
        // canonicalised FIRST and the lookup asks with that spelling (a
        // differently-cased or `..` path finds the existing tab).
        const std::filesystem::path canonical = CanonicalFilePath(path).value_or(path);
        if (EditorDocument* existing = docs.FindByCanonicalPath(canonical))
            if (auto* text = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(existing))
            {
                text->NoteReopened();   // as DocumentHost::OpenPath does for an open document
                return text;
            }

        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(path, services, error);
        if (!doc)
        {
            lastError = std::move(error);
            return nullptr;
        }
        // TE2-19's HasDedicatedFactory, never HasFactory: after TE2-20 HasFactory
        // is true for every text route and the fallback, so every file would lock.
        if (docs.HasDedicatedFactory(canonical))
            doc->SetReadOnlyLock(true);   // spec s5.4: read-only until Enable editing
        return static_cast<TextDocument*>(docs.Add(std::move(doc)));
    }

    void OpenAsTextFlow::AfterSave(const TextDocument& saved) const
    {
        const std::filesystem::path file = saved.CanonicalPath();
        Arcane::Guid guid = saved.AssetGuid();
        if (!guid.IsValid())
            guid = Arcane::AssetRegistry::PeekId(file).value_or(Arcane::Guid::Nil());
        if (!guid.IsValid())
            return;   // not an asset: TE2's save is the whole story
        // The saved text document is the origin; ApplyExternalAssetChange
        // skips text documents anyway (TE2-17 polls its own file).
        (void)ApplyExternalAssetChange(docs, guid, reload, &saved);
        if (afterAssetSave)
            afterAssetSave(file);
    }
}
```

`AfterSave` is `const` and still calls a function that takes `DocumentHost&`. That is fine: `docs` is a reference member, and a const member function does not make the referent const.

```cpp
    Arcane::Editor::OpenAsTextFlow EditorApp::MakeOpenAsTextFlow()
    {
        return Arcane::Editor::OpenAsTextFlow{ m_documents, ExternalReloadCtx(),
            [this](const std::filesystem::path& saved)
            {
                const std::optional<Arcane::Guid> g = Arcane::AssetRegistry::PeekId(saved);
                if (!g)
                    return;
                if (const auto* e = m_assetModel.Find(*g))
                    InvalidateAssetCaches(*g, e->kind);   // the registry-side reload of that asset (s5.4)
                // Our own write must not bounce back from PollAssetWatch as an
                // external edit: re-baseline under the key the watch uses
                // (the project's resolved path, not the canonical spelling).
                const Arcane::Project* project = m_runtime ? m_runtime->CurrentProject() : nullptr;
                const std::optional<std::filesystem::path> resolved =
                    project ? project->ResolveAsset(Arcane::AssetId::FromGuid(*g)) : std::nullopt;
                std::error_code ec;
                const auto mtime = std::filesystem::last_write_time(resolved.value_or(saved), ec);
                if (!ec)
                    m_materialMtimes[resolved.value_or(saved).generic_string()] = mtime;
            },
            m_textDocumentServices };
    }

    Arcane::Editor::EditorDocument* EditorApp::OpenAsText(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        Arcane::Editor::OpenAsTextFlow flow = MakeOpenAsTextFlow();
        Arcane::Editor::TextDocument* doc = flow.Open(path);
        if (!doc)
            ARC_WARN("Open as text: {}", flow.lastError);
        return doc;
    }
```

`ExternalReloadCtx()` is TE6-11's. `m_materialMtimes` is keyed by the resolved asset path, as in TE6-11's Sprite/InputActions branches.

## Chunk TE7: Openers (D15)

**Reconciled against `CANON.md` (2026-10-07).** No TE7 task is dropped; every id TE7-1..TE7-18 keeps its number. Execution position (CANON E): after TE6-6..TE6-12, before the TE6 essentials remainder (TE6-3/4/5, TE6-21/22, TE6-13/14/15, TE6-18/19/20, TE6-23/24) and GATE-1.

Delivers spec s5.6 (revision 5, `51bd47b8`): one `FileOpener` service that every file-open route in the editor goes through, with the user choosing per file type between the Arcane Text Editor, Visual Studio, the system default program, a custom program, or (for assets) the asset's own Arcane editor. It covers the pure resolution order, the two `editor.files.*` settings, custom-program launching with correct Windows quoting, a line-and-column jump in Visual Studio, detected presets, the Preferences > Editor > Files > Open With page, the Open With submenu on every file context menu, re-routing of every existing open path (with a guard test so none can bypass `FileOpener` again), and the C and C++ grammars (s4.7).
Depends on TE1 (`Rope`, `Point`, `Utf8::DecodeAt`), TE2 (`TextDocument`, `DocumentHost::FindByCanonicalPath`, `RegisterTextDocumentRoutes` and its fallback claims predicate, `IsCppSourcePath`, `SniffsAsText`, `CanonicalFilePath`, `TextDocument::GoTo`), TE3 (`Text::NormaliseExtension`, the `.arcsyntax` format and the TE3-20 scope-test helpers) and TE6-12 (`EditorApp::OpenAsText`, `OpenAsTextFlow` -- the backend only; TE6-12 re-points no entry point, CANON B6). It runs after TE6-6..TE6-12 and before the rest of the TE6 essentials and GATE-1, so TE6-14/15/23 call `FileOpener` themselves and nothing is re-routed twice. GATE-1's grep sweep becomes `[openers-guard]` (TE7-10/11).
Later chunks and spec 2 get `Openers::FileOpener::Open` / `OpenWith` (Goto Anything, Find in Files, vim global marks), `Openers::FilePosition`, `Openers::PositionFrom`, and the `[openers-guard]` rule.

### The skeleton line this chunk supersedes

The skeleton's Global Constraint "The text editor never opens `.cpp .cxx .cc .c .hpp .hxx .hh .h .inl` -- those route to `IdeLaunch`" is replaced by D15: C/C++ **default** to Visual Studio through `FileOpener`, and the user may choose the Arcane Text Editor (spec D1 amended, D15, s1 "It edits any text", s1.2 amended non-goal; CANON D1). TE2 never builds a C++ route (CANON B5): its fallback claims predicate keeps an interim `!IsCppSourcePath(p)` exclusion, which TE7-9 removes.

### Names this chunk consumes from other chunks (canonical per CANON.md Section A)

| From | Name and contract assumed here |
|---|---|
| skeleton / TE1 (binding) | `Arcane::Text::Point{row, col}` (col in bytes), `Arcane::Text::ByteRange`, `Arcane::Text::Rope::FromUtf8`, `LineCount()`, `LineStart(row)`, `LineEnd(row)` (excludes the line break), `CopyTo(ByteRange, std::string&)` (replaces `out`) |

- Modify: `premake5.lua:1466` (open the TE7 block in the ArcaneTests `files` list)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Arcane::Text::NormaliseExtension` (TE3-3, `TextEditor/Syntax/LanguageOverrides.hpp`) and `Arcane::Editor::IsCppSourcePath` (TE2-15, `TextEditor/Document/TextSniff.hpp`) -- one extension normaliser and one C/C++ list in the editor (CANON B18). Both `.cpp` files are already in the ArcaneTests `files` list (TE2/TE3 blocks), so this task needs TE2-15 and TE3-3 landed.
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Editor::Openers`):
  - `enum class OpenerKind : std::uint8_t { ArcaneText, VisualStudio, SystemDefault, Custom, Dedicated };`
  - `struct OpenerId { OpenerKind kind; std::string custom; static OpenerId ArcaneText(); VisualStudio(); SystemDefault(); Dedicated(); Custom(std::string); operator== }`
  - `std::string FormatOpenerId(const OpenerId&)`, `std::optional<OpenerId> ParseOpenerId(std::string_view)`, `bool IsValidCustomId(std::string_view)`
  - `kGroupSource` / `kGroupText` / `kGroupAsset` (`"source"`, `"text"`, `"asset"`), `kDefaultOpenWith` = `"source=visualStudio;text=arcaneText;asset=dedicated"`
  - `bool IsSourceExtension(std::string_view)` (= `IsCppSourcePath(std::filesystem::path("x") += Text::NormaliseExtension(ext))`), `std::string NormaliseKey(std::string_view)`, `std::string ExtensionOf(const std::filesystem::path&)` (UTF-8, never throws). No `Openers::NormaliseExtension`: callers use `Text::NormaliseExtension`.
  - `struct OpenWithEntry { std::string key; OpenerId opener; }`, `ParseOpenWith`, `FormatOpenWith`, `SetOpenWith(text, key, std::optional<OpenerId>)`, `ValidateOpenWith`
  - `enum class FileGroup { Source, Text, Asset, Binary }`, `struct FileFacts { bool openInTextDocument, hasDedicatedEditor, isText; }` (`hasDedicatedEditor` = a dedicated Arcane editor's factory takes the file -- never the text routes; TE7-9 answers it with TE2-19's `DocumentHost::HasDedicatedFactory`), `FileGroup GroupOf(path, facts)`
  - `enum class ResolveReason { AlreadyOpen, Explicit, Extension, Group, BuiltInDefault }`, `struct Resolution { OpenerId opener; ResolveReason reason; std::string matchedKey; std::vector<std::string> skipped; }`
  - `Resolution ResolveOpener(path, facts, std::span<const OpenWithEntry>, std::span<const std::string> customIds, const std::optional<OpenerId>& explicitOpener = std::nullopt)`
  - `std::string_view OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind)`

The resolution order this task pins (spec s5.6 "Rules", "Choosing"):
1. **Explicit** (Open With, Open as Text): the user's one-off choice for this open.
2. **Already open**: a file shown by an Arcane `TextDocument` is focused there, whatever the settings say ("no second copy in another tool behind the user's back").
3. The file's **extension** entry (`.lua=custom:vscode`).
4. Its **group** key: `asset` when an Arcane editor opens it, `source` for the nine C/C++ extensions, `text` for any other text file. A binary file has no group key.
5. The **built-in default** for the group: source -> `visualStudio`, asset -> `dedicated`, text -> `arcaneText`, binary -> `systemDefault`.

An entry that cannot apply is skipped and named in `Resolution::skipped`: `dedicated` for a file with no Arcane editor, or `custom:<id>` naming no entry in `editor.files.customEditors`. FileOpener (TE7-8) publishes these as Problems rows.

`dedicated` is overridable per extension or through the `asset` key ("not overridable to nothing": there is no "nothing" opener, and Open as Text stays available).

```cpp
TEST_CASE("OpenerId: format and parse round-trip; malformed ids are refused", "[text-openers]")
{
    for (const OpenerId& id : { OpenerId::ArcaneText(), OpenerId::VisualStudio(), OpenerId::SystemDefault(),
                                OpenerId::Dedicated(), OpenerId::Custom("vscode"), OpenerId::Custom("nvim-wt") })
    {
        const std::optional<OpenerId> back = ParseOpenerId(FormatOpenerId(id));
        REQUIRE(back.has_value());
        CHECK(*back == id);
    }
    CHECK(FormatOpenerId(OpenerId::Custom("vscode")) == "custom:vscode");
    CHECK(ParseOpenerId("  visualStudio ") == OpenerId::VisualStudio());
    CHECK_FALSE(ParseOpenerId("notepad").has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(ParseOpenerId("custom:").has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(ParseOpenerId("custom:Bad Id").has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(ParseOpenerId("custom:a;b").has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(ParseOpenerId("custom:-lead").has_value());
    CHECK(IsValidCustomId("nvim-wt"));
    CHECK(IsValidCustomId("ed_2"));
    CHECK_FALSE(IsValidCustomId("Ed"));
}

TEST_CASE("IsSourceExtension and NormaliseKey use the editor's one C/C++ list and one normaliser", "[text-openers]")
{
    for (const char* e : { ".c", ".cc", ".cpp", ".cxx", ".h", ".hh", ".hpp", ".hxx", ".inl", "CPP", " .Hpp " })
    {
        INFO(e);
        CHECK(IsSourceExtension(e));
    }
    CHECK_FALSE(IsSourceExtension(".hlsl"));
    CHECK_FALSE(IsSourceExtension(".c++"));   // TE2-15's IsCppSourcePath list is the nine; the C++ grammar claims more
    CHECK_FALSE(IsSourceExtension(""));
    CHECK(NormaliseKey(" .CPP ") == ".cpp");
    CHECK(NormaliseKey("Lua") == ".lua");
    CHECK(NormaliseKey(" Source ") == "source");
    CHECK(ExtensionOf("D:/p/Caf\xC3\xA9.MD") == ".md");
}

TEST_CASE("OpenWith map: parse normalises keys, folds repeats, reports bad entries", "[text-openers]")
{
    const std::vector<OpenWithEntry> v =
        ParseOpenWith(" .CPP = arcaneText ; LUA=custom:vscode;;Text=systemDefault;.x=nope;=arcaneText;.cpp=visualStudio");
    REQUIRE(v.size() == 3);
    CHECK(v[0].key == ".cpp");
    CHECK(v[0].opener == OpenerId::VisualStudio());   // a repeated key keeps its first position and its last value
    CHECK(v[1].key == ".lua");
    CHECK(v[1].opener == OpenerId::Custom("vscode"));
    CHECK(v[2].key == "text");
    CHECK(v[2].opener == OpenerId::SystemDefault());

    const std::vector<std::string> problems = ValidateOpenWith(".cpp=arcaneText;.x=nope;=arcaneText;nothing");
    REQUIRE(problems.size() == 3);
    CHECK(problems[0] == "'.x=nope': 'nope' is not an opener (arcaneText, visualStudio, systemDefault, dedicated, custom:<id>)");
    CHECK(problems[1] == "'=arcaneText' names no extension");
    CHECK(problems[2] == "'nothing' has no '='");
}

TEST_CASE("OpenWith map: Set replaces in place, appends, removes", "[text-openers]")
{
    const std::string base(kDefaultOpenWith);
    CHECK(SetOpenWith(base, "CPP", OpenerId::ArcaneText()) == base + ";.cpp=arcaneText");
    CHECK(SetOpenWith(base, "source", OpenerId::ArcaneText()) == "source=arcaneText;text=arcaneText;asset=dedicated");
    CHECK(SetOpenWith(base, "text", std::nullopt) == "source=visualStudio;asset=dedicated");
    CHECK(SetOpenWith("", ".md", OpenerId::Custom("vscode")) == ".md=custom:vscode");
}

TEST_CASE("OpenWith map: Format(Parse(x)) is a fixed point and keys stay unique", "[text-openers]")
{
    rc::prop("round trip", [] {
        const auto keys = *rc::gen::container<std::vector<std::string>>(
            rc::gen::element<std::string>(".c", ".lua", ".MD", "log", "text", "source", "asset", ".hpp"));
        std::string text;
        for (const std::string& k : keys)
        {
            const int pick = *rc::gen::inRange(0, 6);
            const std::optional<OpenerId> id =
                pick == 0 ? std::optional<OpenerId>(OpenerId::ArcaneText())
              : pick == 1 ? std::optional<OpenerId>(OpenerId::VisualStudio())
              : pick == 2 ? std::optional<OpenerId>(OpenerId::SystemDefault())
              : pick == 3 ? std::optional<OpenerId>(OpenerId::Dedicated())
              : pick == 4 ? std::optional<OpenerId>(OpenerId::Custom("ed-" + std::to_string(*rc::gen::inRange(0, 9))))
              : std::nullopt;
            text = SetOpenWith(text, k, id);
        }
        const std::vector<OpenWithEntry> entries = ParseOpenWith(text);
        RC_ASSERT(FormatOpenWith(entries) == text);
        RC_ASSERT(ValidateOpenWith(text).empty());
        std::set<std::string> seen;
        for (const OpenWithEntry& e : entries)
            RC_ASSERT(seen.insert(e.key).second);
    });
}

TEST_CASE("ResolveOpener: built-in defaults per group (spec s5.6)", "[text-openers]")
{
    const FileFacts text{ false, false, true };
    const FileFacts asset{ false, true, true };
    const FileFacts binary{ false, false, false };
    for (const char* f : { "a.c", "a.cc", "a.cpp", "a.cxx", "a.h", "a.hh", "a.hpp", "a.hxx", "a.inl", "A.CPP" })
    {
        INFO(f);
        const Resolution r = ResolveOpener(f, text, {}, {});
        CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::VisualStudio());
        CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::BuiltInDefault);
    }
    CHECK(ResolveOpener("notes.md", text, {}, {}).opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    CHECK(ResolveOpener("Makefile", text, {}, {}).opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    CHECK(ResolveOpener("brick.arcmat", asset, {}, {}).opener == OpenerId::Dedicated());
    CHECK(ResolveOpener("crash.dmp", binary, {}, {}).opener == OpenerId::SystemDefault());
    CHECK(GroupOf("x.hpp", asset) == FileGroup::Asset);   // an Arcane editor wins the group
}

TEST_CASE("ResolveOpener: the shipped default map answers by group key", "[text-openers]")
{
    const std::vector<OpenWithEntry> map = ParseOpenWith(kDefaultOpenWith);
    const Resolution cpp = ResolveOpener("D:/p/Game.cpp", FileFacts{ false, false, true }, map, {});
    CHECK(cpp.opener == OpenerId::VisualStudio());
    CHECK(cpp.reason == ResolveReason::Group);
    CHECK(cpp.matchedKey == "source");
    const Resolution md = ResolveOpener("D:/p/README.md", FileFacts{ false, false, true }, map, {});
    CHECK(md.opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    CHECK(md.matchedKey == "text");
    const Resolution mat = ResolveOpener("D:/p/brick.arcmat", FileFacts{ false, true, true }, map, {});
    CHECK(mat.opener == OpenerId::Dedicated());
    CHECK(mat.matchedKey == "asset");
    const Resolution dmp = ResolveOpener("D:/p/crash.dmp", FileFacts{ false, false, false }, map, {});
    CHECK(dmp.opener == OpenerId::SystemDefault());
    CHECK(dmp.reason == ResolveReason::BuiltInDefault);
}

TEST_CASE("ResolveOpener: explicit, then already open, then extension, then group, then default", "[text-openers]")
{
    const std::vector<OpenWithEntry> map = ParseOpenWith("source=visualStudio;.cpp=custom:vscode;text=systemDefault");
    const std::vector<std::string> customs{ "vscode" };
    FileFacts f{ false, false, true };

    Resolution r = ResolveOpener("a.cpp", f, map, customs);
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::Custom("vscode"));
    CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::Extension);
    CHECK(r.matchedKey == ".cpp");

    r = ResolveOpener("a.hpp", f, map, customs);
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::VisualStudio());
    CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::Group);

    r = ResolveOpener("a.md", f, map, customs);
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::SystemDefault());

    f.openInTextDocument = true;
    r = ResolveOpener("a.cpp", f, map, customs);
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::AlreadyOpen);

    r = ResolveOpener("a.cpp", f, map, customs, OpenerId::SystemDefault());
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::SystemDefault());
    CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::Explicit);
}

TEST_CASE("ResolveOpener: entries that cannot apply are skipped and named", "[text-openers]")
{
    const std::vector<OpenWithEntry> map = ParseOpenWith(".lua=custom:gone;text=dedicated");
    const Resolution r = ResolveOpener("init.lua", FileFacts{ false, false, true }, map, {});
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::BuiltInDefault);
    REQUIRE(r.skipped.size() == 2);
    CHECK(r.skipped[0] == ".lua=custom:gone: no such entry in editor.files.customEditors");
    CHECK(r.skipped[1] == "text=dedicated: no Arcane editor opens .lua files");

    const Resolution e = ResolveOpener("a.md", FileFacts{ false, false, true }, {}, {}, OpenerId::Dedicated());
    CHECK(e.opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    REQUIRE(e.skipped.size() == 1);
    CHECK(e.skipped[0] == "Open With=dedicated: no Arcane editor opens .md files");
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Who opens what (text editor spec s5.6, D15), the pure half: opener ids,
// the editor.files.openWith map ("key=opener;..."; the settings system has
// no map type, Arcane/Config/CVarTypes.hpp), file groups, and ResolveOpener
// -- the one decision every open route takes through FileOpener. No ImGui,
// no Win32; OpenerIdTest drives it directly.

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    enum class OpenerKind : std::uint8_t { ArcaneText, VisualStudio, SystemDefault, Custom, Dedicated };

    struct OpenerId
    {
        OpenerKind  kind = OpenerKind::ArcaneText;
        std::string custom;   // Custom only: the CustomEditor id

        static OpenerId ArcaneText()    { return { OpenerKind::ArcaneText, {} }; }
        static OpenerId VisualStudio()  { return { OpenerKind::VisualStudio, {} }; }
        static OpenerId SystemDefault() { return { OpenerKind::SystemDefault, {} }; }
        static OpenerId Dedicated()     { return { OpenerKind::Dedicated, {} }; }
        static OpenerId Custom(std::string id) { return { OpenerKind::Custom, std::move(id) }; }
        friend bool operator==(const OpenerId&, const OpenerId&) = default;
    };

    // "arcaneText" | "visualStudio" | "systemDefault" | "dedicated" | "custom:<id>".
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatOpenerId(const OpenerId& id);
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<OpenerId> ParseOpenerId(std::string_view text);
    // [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]* -- never ';', '=' or ':', so it embeds in the map text.
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsValidCustomId(std::string_view id);

    // The three group keys of editor.files.openWith (spec s5.6).
    inline constexpr std::string_view kGroupSource = "source";   // the nine C/C++ extensions
    inline constexpr std::string_view kGroupText   = "text";     // any other text file
    inline constexpr std::string_view kGroupAsset  = "asset";    // files an Arcane editor opens
    // editor.files.openWith's default: C/C++ -> Visual Studio, other text -> the
    // Arcane Text Editor, assets -> their Arcane editor (spec s5.6 "Defaults").
    inline constexpr std::string_view kDefaultOpenWith = "source=visualStudio;text=arcaneText;asset=dedicated";

    // .c .cc .cpp .cxx .h .hh .hpp .hxx .inl, any case, with or without the
    // dot -- TE2-15's IsCppSourcePath list, never a second copy (CANON B18).
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsSourceExtension(std::string_view extension);
    // A map key: the group keys pass through lowercased, anything else is an
    // extension normalised by Text::NormaliseExtension (TE3-3).
    [[nodiscard]] std::string NormaliseKey(std::string_view key);
    // `path`'s extension as UTF-8 (never throws on a non-ASCII path), lowercase with its dot.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string ExtensionOf(const std::filesystem::path& path);

    struct OpenWithEntry
    {
        std::string key;   // ".ext" or a group key
        OpenerId    opener;
    };

    // Parses "key=opener;key=opener". Malformed entries are skipped (ValidateOpenWith
    // names them); a repeated key keeps its first position and its last value.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<OpenWithEntry> ParseOpenWith(std::string_view text);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatOpenWith(std::span<const OpenWithEntry> entries);
    // `text` with `key` mapped to `opener` (replaced in place, else appended);
    // nullopt removes the key.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string SetOpenWith(std::string_view text, std::string_view key,
                                          const std::optional<OpenerId>& opener);
    // One message per entry ParseOpenWith skipped, in order.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> ValidateOpenWith(std::string_view text);

    enum class FileGroup : std::uint8_t { Source, Text, Asset, Binary };

    struct FileFacts
    {
        bool openInTextDocument = false;   // an Arcane TextDocument already shows this file
        bool hasDedicatedEditor = false;   // a DocumentHost extension factory takes it
        bool isText = false;               // the file sniffs as text
    };
    // hasDedicatedEditor: a DEDICATED Arcane editor's factory takes the file
    // (DocumentHost::HasDedicatedFactory, TE2-19) -- never the text routes, which
    // take every text file and would put all of them in the asset group.

    // Asset when an Arcane editor opens it, else Source for the nine C/C++
    // extensions, else Text or Binary by the sniff.
    [[nodiscard]] FileGroup GroupOf(const std::filesystem::path& path, const FileFacts& facts);

    enum class ResolveReason : std::uint8_t { AlreadyOpen, Explicit, Extension, Group, BuiltInDefault };

    struct Resolution
    {
        OpenerId                 opener;
        ResolveReason            reason = ResolveReason::BuiltInDefault;
        std::string              matchedKey;   // ".lua" / "text" (Extension / Group)
        std::vector<std::string> skipped;      // entries passed over, with why
    };

    // Explicit -> already open in a TextDocument -> the extension entry -> the
    // group key -> the group's built-in default (source: Visual Studio, asset:
    // dedicated, text: Arcane Text Editor, binary: system default). Dedicated
    // for a file with no Arcane editor, or a custom id not in `customIds`, is
    // skipped and named in `skipped`.
    [[nodiscard]] Resolution ResolveOpener(const std::filesystem::path& path, const FileFacts& facts,
                                           std::span<const OpenWithEntry> openWith,
                                           std::span<const std::string> customIds,
                                           const std::optional<OpenerId>& explicitOpener = std::nullopt);

    // "Arcane Text Editor", "Visual Studio", "System default", "Custom program", "Arcane editor".
    [[nodiscard]] std::string_view OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind kind);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/OpenerId.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSniff.hpp"        // IsCppSourcePath (TE2-15): the one C/C++ list
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/LanguageOverrides.hpp"  // Text::NormaliseExtension (TE3-3)

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    namespace
    {
        constexpr std::string_view kCustomPrefix = "custom:";

        std::string_view Trim(std::string_view s)
        {
            while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.front()))) s.remove_prefix(1);
            while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.back()))) s.remove_suffix(1);
            return s;
        }

        std::string Lower(std::string_view s)
        {
            std::string out(s);
            for (char& c : out) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
            return out;
        }

        bool IsGroupKey(std::string_view key)
        {
            return key == kGroupSource || key == kGroupText || key == kGroupAsset;
        }

        struct ParsedEntry
        {
            std::optional<OpenWithEntry> entry;
            std::string problem;
        };

        std::vector<ParsedEntry> ParseAll(std::string_view text)
        {
            std::vector<ParsedEntry> out;
            while (!text.empty())
            {
                const std::size_t semi = text.find(';');
                const std::string_view raw = Trim(text.substr(0, semi));
                text = semi == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view() : text.substr(semi + 1);
                if (raw.empty())
                    continue;
                const std::size_t eq = raw.find('=');
                if (eq == std::string_view::npos)
                {
                    out.push_back({ std::nullopt, "'" + std::string(raw) + "' has no '='" });
                    continue;
                }
                const std::string key = NormaliseKey(raw.substr(0, eq));
                if (key.size() < 2)
                {
                    out.push_back({ std::nullopt, "'" + std::string(raw) + "' names no extension" });
                    continue;
                }
                const std::string_view value = Trim(raw.substr(eq + 1));
                const std::optional<OpenerId> opener = ParseOpenerId(value);
                if (!opener)
                {
                    out.push_back({ std::nullopt, "'" + std::string(raw) + "': '" + std::string(value) +
                                                  "' is not an opener (arcaneText, visualStudio, systemDefault, dedicated, custom:<id>)" });
                    continue;
                }
                out.push_back({ OpenWithEntry{ key, *opener }, {} });
            }
            return out;
        }

        const OpenWithEntry* Find(std::span<const OpenWithEntry> entries, std::string_view key)
        {
            for (auto it = entries.rbegin(); it != entries.rend(); ++it)   // last wins, like a re-set key
                if (it->key == key)
                    return &*it;
            return nullptr;
        }
    }

    std::string FormatOpenerId(const OpenerId& id)
    {
        switch (id.kind)
        {
            case OpenerKind::ArcaneText:    return "arcaneText";
            case OpenerKind::VisualStudio:  return "visualStudio";
            case OpenerKind::SystemDefault: return "systemDefault";
            case OpenerKind::Dedicated:     return "dedicated";
            case OpenerKind::Custom:        return std::string(kCustomPrefix) + id.custom;
        }
        return "arcaneText";
    }

    bool IsValidCustomId(std::string_view id)
    {
        if (id.empty())
            return false;
        const auto alnum = [](char c) { return (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9'); };
        if (!alnum(id.front()))
            return false;
        return std::all_of(id.begin(), id.end(), [&](char c) { return alnum(c) || c == '-' || c == '_'; });
    }

    std::optional<OpenerId> ParseOpenerId(std::string_view text)
    {
        text = Trim(text);
        if (text == "arcaneText")    return OpenerId::ArcaneText();
        if (text == "visualStudio")  return OpenerId::VisualStudio();
        if (text == "systemDefault") return OpenerId::SystemDefault();
        if (text == "dedicated")     return OpenerId::Dedicated();
        if (text.starts_with(kCustomPrefix) && IsValidCustomId(text.substr(kCustomPrefix.size())))
            return OpenerId::Custom(std::string(text.substr(kCustomPrefix.size())));
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    bool IsSourceExtension(std::string_view extension)
    {
        const std::string ext = Arcane::Text::NormaliseExtension(extension);
        if (ext.size() < 2)
            return false;   // "" or "." -- no extension
        // CANON B18: TE2-15's list, asked through a stand-in file name.
        return IsCppSourcePath(std::filesystem::path("x") += ext);
    }

    std::string NormaliseKey(std::string_view key)
    {
        const std::string lower = Lower(Trim(key));
        return IsGroupKey(lower) ? lower : Arcane::Text::NormaliseExtension(lower);
    }

    std::string ExtensionOf(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        const std::u8string ext = path.extension().u8string();
        return Arcane::Text::NormaliseExtension(std::string(ext.begin(), ext.end()));
    }

    std::vector<OpenWithEntry> ParseOpenWith(std::string_view text)
    {
        std::vector<OpenWithEntry> out;
        for (ParsedEntry& p : ParseAll(text))
        {
            if (!p.entry)
                continue;
            const auto it = std::find_if(out.begin(), out.end(), [&](const OpenWithEntry& e) { return e.key == p.entry->key; });
            if (it != out.end())
                it->opener = p.entry->opener;
            else
                out.push_back(std::move(*p.entry));
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string FormatOpenWith(std::span<const OpenWithEntry> entries)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const OpenWithEntry& e : entries)
        {
            if (!out.empty())
                out += ';';
            out += e.key;
            out += '=';
            out += FormatOpenerId(e.opener);
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string SetOpenWith(std::string_view text, std::string_view key, const std::optional<OpenerId>& opener)
    {
        std::vector<OpenWithEntry> v = ParseOpenWith(text);
        const std::string k = NormaliseKey(key);
        const auto it = std::find_if(v.begin(), v.end(), [&](const OpenWithEntry& e) { return e.key == k; });
        if (!opener)
        {
            if (it != v.end())
                v.erase(it);
        }
        else if (it != v.end())
            it->opener = *opener;
        else if (k.size() >= 2)
            v.push_back({ k, *opener });
        return FormatOpenWith(v);
    }

    std::vector<std::string> ValidateOpenWith(std::string_view text)
    {
        std::vector<std::string> out;
        for (const ParsedEntry& p : ParseAll(text))
            if (!p.entry)
                out.push_back(p.problem);
        return out;
    }

    FileGroup GroupOf(const std::filesystem::path& path, const FileFacts& facts)
    {
        if (facts.hasDedicatedEditor)
            return FileGroup::Asset;
        if (IsSourceExtension(ExtensionOf(path)))
            return FileGroup::Source;
        return facts.isText ? FileGroup::Text : FileGroup::Binary;
    }

    Resolution ResolveOpener(const std::filesystem::path& path, const FileFacts& facts,
                             std::span<const OpenWithEntry> openWith, std::span<const std::string> customIds,
                             const std::optional<OpenerId>& explicitOpener)
    {
        Resolution r;
        const std::string ext = ExtensionOf(path);
        const auto usable = [&](const OpenerId& id, std::string_view from) {
            if (id.kind == OpenerKind::Dedicated && !facts.hasDedicatedEditor)
            {
                r.skipped.push_back(std::string(from) + "=dedicated: no Arcane editor opens " +
                                    (ext.empty() ? std::string("this file") : ext + " files"));
                return false;
            }
            if (id.kind == OpenerKind::Custom &&
                std::find(customIds.begin(), customIds.end(), id.custom) == customIds.end())
            {
                r.skipped.push_back(std::string(from) + "=custom:" + id.custom +
                                    ": no such entry in editor.files.customEditors");
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        };

        if (explicitOpener && usable(*explicitOpener, "Open With"))
        {
            r.opener = *explicitOpener;
            r.reason = ResolveReason::Explicit;
            return r;
        }
        if (facts.openInTextDocument)
        {
            r.opener = OpenerId::ArcaneText();
            r.reason = ResolveReason::AlreadyOpen;
            return r;
        }
        if (!ext.empty())
            if (const OpenWithEntry* e = Find(openWith, ext); e && usable(e->opener, ext))
            {
                r.opener = e->opener;
                r.reason = ResolveReason::Extension;
                r.matchedKey = ext;
                return r;
            }

        const FileGroup group = GroupOf(path, facts);
        const std::string_view groupKey = group == FileGroup::Source ? kGroupSource
                                        : group == FileGroup::Text   ? kGroupText
                                        : group == FileGroup::Asset  ? kGroupAsset
                                                                     : std::string_view{};
        if (!groupKey.empty())
            if (const OpenWithEntry* e = Find(openWith, groupKey); e && usable(e->opener, groupKey))
            {
                r.opener = e->opener;
                r.reason = ResolveReason::Group;
                r.matchedKey = std::string(groupKey);
                return r;
            }

        r.reason = ResolveReason::BuiltInDefault;
        switch (group)
        {
            case FileGroup::Source: r.opener = OpenerId::VisualStudio();  break;
            case FileGroup::Asset:  r.opener = OpenerId::Dedicated();     break;
            case FileGroup::Text:   r.opener = OpenerId::ArcaneText();    break;
            case FileGroup::Binary: r.opener = OpenerId::SystemDefault(); break;
        }
        return r;
    }

    std::string_view OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind kind)
    {
        switch (kind)
        {
            case OpenerKind::ArcaneText:    return "Arcane Text Editor";
            case OpenerKind::VisualStudio:  return "Visual Studio";
            case OpenerKind::SystemDefault: return "System default";
            case OpenerKind::Custom:        return "Custom program";
            case OpenerKind::Dedicated:     return "Arcane editor";
        }
        return "Arcane Text Editor";
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// editor.files.customEditors (text editor spec s5.6): the user's own
// programs, a JSON array of {id, name, exe, args} held in one string setting
// (the settings system has no list type; editor.text.vim.remaps does the
// same). Pure; nlohmann/json.

#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    struct CustomEditor
    {
        std::string id;     // [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*: "custom:<id>" in editor.files.openWith
        std::string name;   // what the menus show
        std::string exe;    // an absolute path, or a bare program name looked up on PATH
        std::string args;   // the template: {file} {line} {col} {project} {solution}; empty = "{file}" quoted
        friend bool operator==(const CustomEditor&, const CustomEditor&) = default;
    };

    struct CustomEditorList
    {
        std::vector<CustomEditor> editors;   // the usable entries, in order (an entry with an empty exe is kept, and reported)
        std::vector<std::string>  problems;  // one line per rejected or incomplete entry (Problems rows, the Open With page)
    };

    [[nodiscard]] CustomEditorList ParseCustomEditors(std::string_view json);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatCustomEditors(std::span<const CustomEditor> editors);
    [[nodiscard]] const CustomEditor* FindCustomEditor(std::span<const CustomEditor> editors, std::string_view id);
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> CustomEditorIds(std::span<const CustomEditor> editors);
    // "Visual Studio Code" -> "visual-studio-code"; "-2", "-3"... when taken; "program" when nothing is left.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string MintCustomEditorId(std::string_view name, std::span<const CustomEditor> existing);
    // `editor.args`, or "\"{file}\"" when empty -- an entry always receives the file.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string EffectiveArgs(const CustomEditor& editor);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/CustomEditors.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"

#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"   // IsValidCustomId

#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    namespace
    {
        bool AllSpace(std::string_view s)
        {
            return std::all_of(s.begin(), s.end(), [](char c) { return std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) != 0; });
        }
    }

    CustomEditorList ParseCustomEditors(std::string_view json)
    {
        CustomEditorList out;
        if (AllSpace(json))
            return out;
        const nlohmann::json doc = nlohmann::json::parse(json.begin(), json.end(), nullptr, false);
        if (doc.is_discarded() || !doc.is_array())
        {
            out.problems.push_back("editor.files.customEditors is not a JSON array");
            return out;
        }
        std::size_t index = 0;
        for (const nlohmann::json& item : doc)
        {
            const std::string where = "editor.files.customEditors[" + std::to_string(index++) + "]";
            if (!item.is_object())
            {
                out.problems.push_back(where + " is not an object");
                continue;
            }
            const auto str = [&](const char* key) -> std::string {
                const auto it = item.find(key);
                return it != item.end() && it->is_string() ? it->get<std::string>() : std::string();
            };
            CustomEditor e{ str("id"), str("name"), str("exe"), str("args") };
            if (!IsValidCustomId(e.id))
            {
                out.problems.push_back(where + ": id '" + e.id + "' must be lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'");
                continue;
            }
            if (FindCustomEditor(out.editors, e.id))
            {
                out.problems.push_back(where + ": id '" + e.id + "' is used twice");
                continue;
            }
            if (AllSpace(e.exe))   // kept: a half-filled entry on the Open With page; launching it says "names no program"
                out.problems.push_back(where + " (" + e.id + "): exe is empty");
            if (e.name.empty())
                e.name = e.id;
            out.editors.push_back(std::move(e));
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string FormatCustomEditors(std::span<const CustomEditor> editors)
    {
        nlohmann::json arr = nlohmann::json::array();
        for (const CustomEditor& e : editors)
            arr.push_back({ { "id", e.id }, { "name", e.name }, { "exe", e.exe }, { "args", e.args } });
        return arr.dump();
    }

    const CustomEditor* FindCustomEditor(std::span<const CustomEditor> editors, std::string_view id)
    {
        const auto it = std::find_if(editors.begin(), editors.end(), [&](const CustomEditor& e) { return e.id == id; });
        return it == editors.end() ? nullptr : &*it;
    }

    std::vector<std::string> CustomEditorIds(std::span<const CustomEditor> editors)
    {
        std::vector<std::string> out;
        out.reserve(editors.size());
        for (const CustomEditor& e : editors)
            out.push_back(e.id);
        return out;
    }

    std::string MintCustomEditorId(std::string_view name, std::span<const CustomEditor> existing)
    {
        std::string base;
        for (const char raw : name)
        {
            const char c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(raw)));
            const bool keep = (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9');
            if (keep)
                base.push_back(c);
            else if (!base.empty() && base.back() != '-')
                base.push_back('-');
        }
        while (!base.empty() && base.back() == '-')
            base.pop_back();
        if (base.empty())
            base = "program";
        if (!FindCustomEditor(existing, base))
            return base;
        for (int n = 2;; ++n)
        {
            const std::string candidate = base + "-" + std::to_string(n);
            if (!FindCustomEditor(existing, candidate))
                return candidate;
        }
    }

    std::string EffectiveArgs(const CustomEditor& editor)
    {
        return AllSpace(editor.args) ? std::string("\"{file}\"") : editor.args;
    }
}
```

- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Editor`):
  - `struct FileOpenerSettings { std::string openWith; std::string customEditors; }` registered as `editor.files.openWith` / `editor.files.customEditors`
  - `kOpenWithPageCategory` = `"Editor/Files/Open With"`
  - `std::vector<Openers::OpenWithEntry> CurrentOpenWith()`, `std::vector<Openers::CustomEditor> CurrentCustomEditors()`
  - `bool WriteFilesSetting(std::string_view field, std::string value)`, `bool SetOpenerFor(std::string_view key, const std::optional<Openers::OpenerId>&)`, `bool SetCustomEditors(std::span<const Openers::CustomEditor>)`

Decisions recorded here:
- **Representation.** There is no map or list cvar type: `CVarType` has thirteen value types (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Config/CVarTypes.hpp`). So `openWith` is the `key=opener;...` string of TE7-1, and `customEditors` is the JSON of TE7-2. TE3's `editor.text.languageByExtension` and TE5's `editor.text.vim.remaps` already do the same.
- **Scope.** `PreferencesProject`, per spec. A project's committed config can suggest a map on the `Project` rung, and the user's Preferences edit writes `User` ("This project", the home default of a per-project row) or `EditorUser` ("All projects"). Every write goes through `EditPreference`, so the row's All projects / This project switch is honoured.
  - The map is one string, so a user edit starts from the effective value. Project suggestions present at that moment are kept in the user's copy.
- **Hidden rows.** Both rows carry `CVarFlags::Hidden`. The Open With page (TE7-15) is their editor, and Show advanced reveals the raw strings.
- **Where the page lives.** The Preferences tree has fixed roots (`kRootOrder` in `Settings/SettingsModel.cpp:17-18`: Project, Appearance, Keyboard, Layout, Editor, Engine, Game, Plugins). A path under none of them is filed under "Engine". The spec's "Preferences > Files > Open With" is therefore **Editor > Files > Open With**.

`ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/FileOpenerSettings.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// editor.files.* (text editor spec s5.6, D15): who opens what. Two string
// settings, because the settings system has no map or list type
// (Arcane/Config/CVarTypes.hpp): openWith is "key=opener;..."
// (Openers::ParseOpenWith) and customEditors a JSON array
// (Openers::ParseCustomEditors). PreferencesProject: a project's committed
// config may suggest a map on the Project rung; the user's Preferences
// override it. Both rows are Hidden -- Preferences > Editor > Files > Open
// With (OpenWithPage) is their editor; Show advanced reveals the raw text.

#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"

#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    // The Preferences node the page and both rows share (under the Editor
    // root: SettingsModel's fixed roots would file a bare "Files" under Engine).
    inline constexpr std::string_view kOpenWithPageCategory = "Editor/Files/Open With";

    struct FileOpenerSettings
    {
        std::string openWith = std::string(Openers::kDefaultOpenWith);
        std::string customEditors = "[]";
    };

    // The live values, parsed (malformed entries dropped; FileOpener reports them).
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Openers::OpenWithEntry> CurrentOpenWith();
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Openers::CustomEditor> CurrentCustomEditors();

    // editor.files.<field> on the rung a Preferences edit of it belongs to
    // (EditPreference: This project by default for a PreferencesProject row,
    // All projects once the row's switch says so), then NoteSettingEdited
    // (the debounced archive) and Publish. False when the name is unknown or
    // the registry refused the write.
    bool WriteFilesSetting(std::string_view field, std::string value);
    // "Always use this for .ext" / the Open With page: map one key (nullopt removes it).
    bool SetOpenerFor(std::string_view key, const std::optional<Openers::OpenerId>& opener);
    bool SetCustomEditors(std::span<const Openers::CustomEditor> editors);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/FileOpenerSettings.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Settings/FileOpenerSettings.hpp"

#include "Settings/SettingsHost.hpp"   // NoteSettingEdited

#include <Arcane/Config/CVarRegistry.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Config/PreferenceScope.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Reflection.hpp>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    ARC_REFLECT_TYPE(FileOpenerSettings)
        ARC_REFLECT_TYPE_ATTR(Settings, "editor.files", SettingScope::PreferencesProject, ApplyMode::Live, Audience::Editor,
                              "Editor/Files/Open With")   // kOpenWithPageCategory
        ARC_REFLECT_FIELD(FileOpenerSettings, openWith)
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(DisplayName, "Open with (raw)") ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Flags, CVarFlags::Hidden)
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Keywords, "opener open file type association extension visual studio external editor vscode")
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Tooltip, "Who opens each file type: .ext=opener;... plus the group keys source (C and C++), "
                                      "text and asset (files with an Arcane editor). Openers: arcaneText, visualStudio, "
                                      "systemDefault, dedicated, custom:<id>. Edit it on the Open With page.")
        ARC_REFLECT_FIELD(FileOpenerSettings, customEditors)
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(DisplayName, "Custom programs (raw)") ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Flags, CVarFlags::Hidden)
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Keywords, "custom program external editor command line arguments vscode sublime notepad++ rider clion neovim")
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Tooltip, "Your own programs as a JSON array of {id, name, exe, args}. args may use {file}, "
                                      "{line}, {col}, {project} and {solution}. Edit them on the Open With page.")
    ARC_END_REFLECT_TYPE()

    ARC_SETTINGS(FileOpenerSettings);

    std::vector<Openers::OpenWithEntry> CurrentOpenWith()
    {
        return Openers::ParseOpenWith(Arcane::Settings<FileOpenerSettings>().openWith);
    }

    std::vector<Openers::CustomEditor> CurrentCustomEditors()
    {
        return Openers::ParseCustomEditors(Arcane::Settings<FileOpenerSettings>().customEditors).editors;
    }

    bool WriteFilesSetting(std::string_view field, std::string value)
    {
        Arcane::CVarRegistry& reg = Arcane::CVarRegistry::Get();
        const std::string name = "editor.files." + std::string(field);
        if (reg.Find(name).IsStale())
            return false;
        const Arcane::SetBy rung = Arcane::PreferenceRung(Arcane::SettingScope::PreferencesProject,
                                                          Arcane::PreferenceTargetOf(reg, name));
        if (Arcane::EditPreference(reg, name, Arcane::CVarValue::String(std::move(value))) != Arcane::SetResult::Applied)
            return false;
        NoteSettingEdited(rung, name);
        reg.Publish();
        return true;
    }

    bool SetOpenerFor(std::string_view key, const std::optional<Openers::OpenerId>& opener)
    {
        return WriteFilesSetting("openWith", Openers::SetOpenWith(Arcane::Settings<FileOpenerSettings>().openWith, key, opener));
    }

    bool SetCustomEditors(std::span<const Openers::CustomEditor> editors)
    {
        return WriteFilesSetting("customEditors", Openers::FormatCustomEditors(editors));
    }
}
```

### Task TE7-4: Argument templates -- `{file}` `{line}` `{col}` `{project}` `{solution}` with Windows quoting (spec s5.6 "Custom program")

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.cpp`
- Modify: `premake5.lua` (append to the TE7 block)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/CommandTemplateTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE7-2 `CustomEditor`, `EffectiveArgs`; `Arcane::Editor::RuntimeLaunch::QuoteArg(const std::wstring&)` (`Project/RuntimeLaunch.hpp:30`, the one Win32 argv escaper, already source-compiled into ArcaneTests at premake5.lua:1403).
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Editor::Openers`):
  - `struct TemplateContext { std::filesystem::path file; std::uint32_t line = 1, column = 1; std::filesystem::path project, solution; }`
  - `struct ExpandedArgs { std::vector<std::wstring> argv; std::string error; bool Ok() const; }`
  - `std::vector<std::wstring> SplitCommandLine(std::wstring_view)`, `ExpandedArgs ExpandTemplate(std::string_view, const TemplateContext&)`
  - `std::wstring BuildCommandLine(const std::filesystem::path& program, std::span<const std::wstring> argv)`
  - `std::string PreviewCommandLine(const CustomEditor&, const TemplateContext&)`
  - `std::wstring Utf8ToWide(std::string_view)`, `std::string WideToUtf8(std::wstring_view)`, `std::string PathUtf8(const std::filesystem::path&)`

The approach, so quoting is right by construction:
1. The template is split into arguments by **CommandLineToArgvW's own rules**. Whatever the user quoted stays one argument: `-g "{file}:{line}:{col}"` is two arguments.
2. Placeholders expand **inside** each argument. A `{file}` holding spaces therefore never splits, quoted in the template or not.
3. Every argument is re-quoted with `RuntimeLaunch::QuoteArg`.

The tests prove the round trip against the real `CommandLineToArgvW`, including `{project}` ending in a backslash and values holding quotes. `{{` and `}}` are literal braces. An unknown placeholder, or `{project}` / `{solution}` when there is none, is an error the Preferences preview shows.

```cpp
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers;
using V = std::vector<std::wstring>;

TEST_CASE("SplitCommandLine: CommandLineToArgvW's rules for the arguments", "[text-openers]")
{
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(L"") == V{});
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(L"  a\tb  ") == V{ L"a", L"b" });
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(LR"(-g "{file}:{line}:{col}")") == V{ L"-g", L"{file}:{line}:{col}" });
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(LR"("" x)") == V{ L"", L"x" });
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(LR"(a\\b c\"d)") == V{ LR"(a\\b)", LR"(c"d)" });
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(LR"("a\\" b)") == V{ LR"(a\)", L"b" });
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(LR"("a""b c")") == V{ LR"(a"b)", L"c" });   // "" inside quotes: a literal quote that ends the quoted run
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(LR"(""")") == V{ LR"(")" });
}

TEST_CASE("ExpandTemplate: placeholders expand inside arguments; quoting is per argument", "[text-openers]")
{
    TemplateContext c;
    c.file = L"D:\\My Game\\Source\\Game Mode.cpp";
    c.line = 42;
    c.column = 7;
    c.project = L"D:\\My Game\\";
    c.solution = L"D:\\My Game\\MyGame.slnx";
    CHECK(ExpandTemplate(R"(-g "{file}:{line}:{col}")", c).argv == V{ L"-g", L"D:\\My Game\\Source\\Game Mode.cpp:42:7" });
    CHECK(ExpandTemplate(R"("{file}:{line}:{col}")", c).argv == V{ L"D:\\My Game\\Source\\Game Mode.cpp:42:7" });
    CHECK(ExpandTemplate(R"(-n{line} -c{col} "{file}")", c).argv == V{ L"-n42", L"-c7", L"D:\\My Game\\Source\\Game Mode.cpp" });
    CHECK(ExpandTemplate(R"(--line {line} --column {col} "{file}")", c).argv
          == V{ L"--line", L"42", L"--column", L"7", L"D:\\My Game\\Source\\Game Mode.cpp" });

    CHECK(ExpandTemplate(R"(--root "{project}" --sln {solution} {{literal}})", c).argv
          == V{ L"--root", L"D:\\My Game\\", L"--sln", L"D:\\My Game\\MyGame.slnx", L"{literal}" });

#ifdef _WIN32
namespace
{
    struct LocalFreeDeleter { void operator()(LPWSTR* p) const { ::LocalFree(p); } };

    V Reference(const std::wstring& commandLine, bool dropProgram)
    {
        int argc = 0;
        std::unique_ptr<LPWSTR, LocalFreeDeleter> argv(::CommandLineToArgvW(commandLine.c_str(), &argc));
        V out;
        for (int i = dropProgram ? 1 : 0; i < argc; ++i)
            out.emplace_back(argv.get()[i]);
        return out;
    }
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// A custom program's argument template (text editor spec s5.6) -> argv ->
// one Windows command line. The template is split by CommandLineToArgvW's
// own rules (what the user quoted stays one argument), placeholders expand
// INSIDE each argument (so a {file} with spaces never splits, quoted or not),
// and every argument is re-quoted with RuntimeLaunch::QuoteArg -- a
// {project} ending in a backslash or a value holding a quote reaches the
// program as exactly one argument. Placeholders: {file} {line} {col}
// {project} {solution}; {{ and }} are literal braces. Pure;
// CommandTemplateTest round-trips it through the real CommandLineToArgvW.

#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    struct TemplateContext
    {
        std::filesystem::path file;
        std::uint32_t line = 1;           // 1-based
        std::uint32_t column = 1;         // 1-based, in characters
        std::filesystem::path project;    // the project root; empty = no project open
        std::filesystem::path solution;   // the project's .slnx; empty = none generated yet
    };

    struct ExpandedArgs
    {
        std::vector<std::wstring> argv;   // the arguments, without the program
        std::string error;                // empty = expanded
        [[nodiscard]] bool Ok() const noexcept { return error.empty(); }
    };

    // CommandLineToArgvW's rules for the arguments after argv[0]: space and tab
    // separate outside quotes; 2n backslashes before a quote give n and the
    // quote toggles; 2n+1 give n and a literal quote; other backslashes are
    // literal; inside quotes, "" is a literal quote that ends the quoted run.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::wstring> SplitCommandLine(std::wstring_view args);
    [[nodiscard]] ExpandedArgs ExpandTemplate(std::string_view argsTemplate, const TemplateContext& context);
    // QuoteArg(program) + ' ' + QuoteArg(each argument).
    [[nodiscard]] std::wstring BuildCommandLine(const std::filesystem::path& program, std::span<const std::wstring> argv);
    // The command line `editor` would run for `context` (EffectiveArgs), as
    // UTF-8 -- the Open With page's live preview; "error: <why>" when it does not expand.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string PreviewCommandLine(const CustomEditor& editor, const TemplateContext& context);

    [[nodiscard]] std::wstring Utf8ToWide(std::string_view utf8);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string WideToUtf8(std::wstring_view wide);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string PathUtf8(const std::filesystem::path& path);   // never throws on a non-ASCII path
}
```

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"

#include "Project/RuntimeLaunch.hpp"   // QuoteArg -- the one Win32 argv escaper

#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>   // MultiByteToWideChar / WideCharToMultiByte
#endif

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    namespace
    {
        std::wstring Native(const std::filesystem::path& p)
        {
            std::filesystem::path copy = p;
            copy.make_preferred();
            return copy.wstring();
        }
    }

    std::wstring Utf8ToWide(std::string_view utf8)
    {
#ifdef _WIN32
        if (utf8.empty())
            return {};
        const int n = ::MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8.data(), static_cast<int>(utf8.size()), nullptr, 0);
        if (n <= 0)
            return {};
        std::wstring out(static_cast<std::size_t>(n), L'\0');
        ::MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8.data(), static_cast<int>(utf8.size()), out.data(), n);
        return out;
#else
        return std::filesystem::path(std::u8string(utf8.begin(), utf8.end())).wstring();
#endif
    }

    std::string WideToUtf8(std::wstring_view wide)
    {
#ifdef _WIN32
        if (wide.empty())
            return {};
        const int n = ::WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wide.data(), static_cast<int>(wide.size()), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
        if (n <= 0)
            return {};
        std::string out(static_cast<std::size_t>(n), '\0');
        ::WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wide.data(), static_cast<int>(wide.size()), out.data(), n, nullptr, nullptr);
        return out;
#else
        const std::u8string u8 = std::filesystem::path(std::wstring(wide)).u8string();
        return std::string(u8.begin(), u8.end());
#endif
    }

    std::string PathUtf8(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        return WideToUtf8(path.wstring());
    }

    std::vector<std::wstring> SplitCommandLine(std::wstring_view s)
    {
        std::vector<std::wstring> out;
        std::wstring cur;
        bool inArg = false;      // a token has started (a bare "" is an empty argument)
        bool inQuotes = false;
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < s.size())
        {
            const wchar_t c = s[i];
            if ((c == L' ' || c == L'\t') && !inQuotes)
            {
                if (inArg)
                {
                    out.push_back(std::move(cur));
                    cur.clear();
                    inArg = false;
                }
                ++i;
                continue;
            }
            inArg = true;
            if (c == L'\\')
            {
                std::size_t n = 0;
                while (i < s.size() && s[i] == L'\\')
                {
                    ++n;
                    ++i;
                }
                if (i < s.size() && s[i] == L'"')
                {
                    cur.append(n / 2, L'\\');
                    if (n % 2 == 1)
                    {
                        cur.push_back(L'"');   // an escaped quote; the next turn sees what follows it
                        ++i;
                    }
                    // even: the quote is a delimiter, handled by the next turn
                }
                else
                    cur.append(n, L'\\');
                continue;
            }
            if (c == L'"')
            {
                ++i;
                if (inQuotes && i < s.size() && s[i] == L'"')
                {
                    cur.push_back(L'"');   // "" inside quotes: a literal quote, and the quoted run ends
                    ++i;
                    inQuotes = false;
                    continue;
                }
                inQuotes = !inQuotes;
                continue;
            }
            cur.push_back(c);
            ++i;
        }
        if (inArg)
            out.push_back(std::move(cur));
        return out;
    }

    ExpandedArgs ExpandTemplate(std::string_view argsTemplate, const TemplateContext& c)
    {
        ExpandedArgs out;
        for (const std::wstring& token : SplitCommandLine(Utf8ToWide(argsTemplate)))
        {
            std::wstring arg;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < token.size(); ++i)
            {
                const wchar_t ch = token[i];
                const bool doubled = i + 1 < token.size() && token[i + 1] == ch;
                if ((ch == L'{' || ch == L'}') && doubled)
                {
                    arg.push_back(ch);
                    ++i;
                    continue;
                }
                if (ch == L'}')
                {
                    out.error = "unmatched '}' in the arguments (write }} for a literal brace)";
                    return out;
                }
                if (ch != L'{')
                {
                    arg.push_back(ch);
                    continue;
                }
                const std::size_t close = token.find(L'}', i + 1);
                if (close == std::wstring::npos)
                {
                    out.error = "unclosed '{' in the arguments (write {{ for a literal brace)";
                    return out;
                }
                const std::wstring name = token.substr(i + 1, close - i - 1);
                if (name == L"file")
                    arg += Native(c.file);
                else if (name == L"line")
                    arg += std::to_wstring(c.line);
                else if (name == L"col")
                    arg += std::to_wstring(c.column);
                else if (name == L"project")
                {
                    if (c.project.empty())
                    {
                        out.error = "{project} is used but no project is open";
                        return out;
                    }
                    arg += Native(c.project);
                }
                else if (name == L"solution")
                {
                    if (c.solution.empty())
                    {
                        out.error = "{solution} is used but the project has no solution (.slnx) yet";
                        return out;
                    }
                    arg += Native(c.solution);
                }
                else
                {
                    out.error = "unknown placeholder {" + WideToUtf8(name) +
                                "} (use {file}, {line}, {col}, {project} or {solution})";
                    return out;
                }
                i = close;
            }
            out.argv.push_back(std::move(arg));
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::wstring BuildCommandLine(const std::filesystem::path& program, std::span<const std::wstring> argv)
    {
        std::wstring cmd = RuntimeLaunch::QuoteArg(Native(program));
        for (const std::wstring& a : argv)
        {
            cmd.push_back(L' ');
            cmd += RuntimeLaunch::QuoteArg(a);
        }
        return cmd;
    }

    std::string PreviewCommandLine(const CustomEditor& editor, const TemplateContext& context)
    {
        const ExpandedArgs args = ExpandTemplate(EffectiveArgs(editor), context);
        if (!args.Ok())
            return "error: " + args.error;
        return WideToUtf8(BuildCommandLine(std::filesystem::path(Utf8ToWide(editor.exe)), args.argv));
    }
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE7-4 (`ExpandTemplate`, `BuildCommandLine`, `Utf8ToWide`, `WideToUtf8`, `PathUtf8`, `TemplateContext`), TE7-2 (`CustomEditor`, `EffectiveArgs`); `Arcane::Toolchain::FindOnPath(std::string_view command, std::string_view searchPath, std::string_view pathExt)` (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Build/Toolchain.hpp:59-61`, exported); `Arcane::Test::TempDir` (`Helpers/TestEnvironment.hpp:33`); `Arcane::Editor::ModuleBuild::ExeDir()` (how `BuildDriverTest.cpp:100-104` finds `arcbuild-process-fixture.exe`).
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Editor::Openers`):
  - `enum class LaunchError : std::uint8_t { None, NoProgram, ProgramNotFound, BatchFileRefused, TemplateError, AccessDenied, NotAProgram, NeedsElevation, Failed, Unsupported };`
  - `struct LaunchResult { LaunchError error; std::string message; std::uint32_t processId; bool Ok() const; }`

  - `LaunchResult LaunchCustomEditor(const CustomEditor&, const TemplateContext&)`
- The fixture gains `--record <path>` (argv[1] only): its `ARG:`/`CWD:` lines go to `<path>` instead of stdout, for a detached child whose stdout nobody reads.

Launch rules:
- **Detached, in its own console.** The launch is `CreateProcessW` with `CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE`. A console program such as `nvim.exe` or `wt.exe` must never share or hijack the editor's console. The flag has no effect on GUI programs.
- **Working directory.** The project root when one is open, else the program's own folder.
- **Batch files are refused** (`.bat`/`.cmd`). Windows runs them through `cmd.exe`, which re-parses the arguments by different rules, so a `{file}` could no longer be quoted safely (the BatBadBut class of bugs). The message tells the user to point the entry at the program's `.exe`.
- **Exe lookup.** A bare name is looked up on `PATH` with `.EXE` only, through `Toolchain::FindOnPath`. A path with a directory but not absolute is refused rather than resolved against an unknown current directory.

```cpp
// TE7-5: launching a custom program opener (text editor spec s5.6). The pure
// halves, plus one [witness] that really CreateProcessW's the
// arcbuild-process-fixture exe and reads back the argv it received.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Helpers/TestEnvironment.hpp"
#include "Project/ModuleBuild.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/ProgramLaunch.hpp"

#include <chrono>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers;

namespace
{
    fs::path FixtureExe()
    {
        return (Arcane::Editor::ModuleBuild::ExeDir() / ".." / "arcbuild-process-fixture" / "arcbuild-process-fixture.exe")
            .lexically_normal();
    }

    // The fixture writes its lines with an fflush each; CWD: is last.
    std::vector<std::string> WaitForRecord(const fs::path& record)
    {
        const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(10);
        while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline)
        {
            std::vector<std::string> lines;
            std::ifstream in(record, std::ios::binary);
            for (std::string line; std::getline(in, line);)
                lines.push_back(line);
            if (!lines.empty() && lines.back().starts_with("CWD:"))
                return lines;
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));
        }
        return {};
    }
}

TEST_CASE("ClassifyCreateProcessError maps the Win32 codes a launch meets", "[text-openers]")
{
    CHECK(ClassifyCreateProcessError(2) == LaunchError::ProgramNotFound);     // ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
    CHECK(ClassifyCreateProcessError(3) == LaunchError::ProgramNotFound);     // ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND
    CHECK(ClassifyCreateProcessError(5) == LaunchError::AccessDenied);        // ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED
    CHECK(ClassifyCreateProcessError(193) == LaunchError::NotAProgram);       // ERROR_BAD_EXE_FORMAT
    CHECK(ClassifyCreateProcessError(740) == LaunchError::NeedsElevation);    // ERROR_ELEVATION_REQUIRED
    CHECK(ClassifyCreateProcessError(1450) == LaunchError::Failed);
    for (int e = static_cast<int>(LaunchError::NoProgram); e <= static_cast<int>(LaunchError::Unsupported); ++e)
        CHECK_FALSE(DescribeLaunchError(static_cast<LaunchError>(e)).empty());
}

TEST_CASE("ResolveProgram: absolute paths, bare names on the given PATH, nothing else", "[text-openers]")
{
    Arcane::Test::TempDir dir("openers_resolve");
    { std::ofstream(dir.path / "tool.exe") << "MZ"; }
    { std::ofstream(dir.path / "script.cmd") << "@echo off"; }
    const std::string search = PathUtf8(dir.path);
    const fs::path tool = dir.path / "tool.exe";
    // equivalent(), not ==: FindOnPath appends the PATHEXT spelling (".EXE"),
    // and NTFS names are case-insensitive while path::operator== is not.
    const fs::path bare = ResolveProgram("tool", search);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(bare.empty());
    CHECK(fs::equivalent(bare, tool));
    const fs::path named = ResolveProgram("tool.exe", search);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(named.empty());
    CHECK(fs::equivalent(named, tool));
    const fs::path absolute = ResolveProgram(PathUtf8(tool), "");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(absolute.empty());
    CHECK(fs::equivalent(absolute, tool));
    CHECK(ResolveProgram("missing", search).empty());
    CHECK(ResolveProgram("sub\\tool.exe", search).empty());   // relative with a folder: refused
    CHECK(ResolveProgram("", search).empty());
}
```
