`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/ProgramLaunch.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Launching a custom program opener (text editor spec s5.6): resolve the
// exe, expand its argument template (CommandTemplate), CreateProcessW it
// DETACHED in its own console (CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE: a console program like
// nvim or wt never shares the editor's; GUI programs ignore the flag), and
// map every failure to words the Problems row shows. Batch files are
// refused: Windows runs them through cmd.exe, which re-parses arguments by
// different rules, so a {file} could no longer be quoted safely.

#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    enum class LaunchError : std::uint8_t
    {
        None,
        NoProgram,          // the entry names no exe
        ProgramNotFound,    // not an existing file, not on PATH
        BatchFileRefused,   // .bat / .cmd
        TemplateError,      // ExpandTemplate refused the args
        AccessDenied,
        NotAProgram,        // ERROR_BAD_EXE_FORMAT
        NeedsElevation,     // ERROR_ELEVATION_REQUIRED
        Failed,             // any other CreateProcessW error
        Unsupported,        // not Windows
    };

    struct LaunchResult
    {
        LaunchError   error = LaunchError::None;
        std::string   message;      // what the Problems row says after "with <program>: "
        std::uint32_t processId = 0;
        [[nodiscard]] bool Ok() const noexcept { return error == LaunchError::None; }
    };

    [[nodiscard]] LaunchError ClassifyCreateProcessError(std::uint32_t win32Error) noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] std::string DescribeLaunchError(LaunchError error);

    // An absolute path that is a file -> itself (normalised); a bare name ->
    // the first `<dir>\<name>[.EXE]` on `searchPath` (Toolchain::FindOnPath, .EXE
    // only: a .cmd on PATH is found verbatim and then refused as a batch file);
    // anything else (relative with a folder, empty, missing) -> empty.
    [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path ResolveProgram(std::string_view exe, std::string_view searchPath);
    [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path ResolveProgram(std::string_view exe);   // the process PATH
    // The process PATH as UTF-8 (GetEnvironmentVariableW on Windows) -- shared with preset detection.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string ProcessPathVariable();

    // Resolve, expand EffectiveArgs(editor), launch. The working directory is
    // the project root when it exists, else the program's folder.
    LaunchResult LaunchCustomEditor(const CustomEditor& editor, const TemplateContext& context);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/ProgramLaunch.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/ProgramLaunch.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Build/Toolchain.hpp>   // FindOnPath -- the shell-free PATH search shared with arcbuild

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cwctype>
#include <system_error>

#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>   // CreateProcessW, GetEnvironmentVariableW
#endif

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    namespace
    {
        std::string_view Trim(std::string_view s)
        {
            while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.front()))) s.remove_prefix(1);
            while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.back()))) s.remove_suffix(1);
            return s;
        }

        bool IsBatch(const std::filesystem::path& exe)
        {
            std::wstring ext = exe.extension().wstring();
            for (wchar_t& c : ext)
                c = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(static_cast<wint_t>(c)));
            return ext == L".bat" || ext == L".cmd";
        }
    }

    std::string ProcessPathVariable()
    {
#ifdef _WIN32
        const DWORD n = ::GetEnvironmentVariableW(L"PATH", nullptr, 0);
        if (n == 0)
            return {};
        std::wstring w(n, L'\0');
        const DWORD got = ::GetEnvironmentVariableW(L"PATH", w.data(), n);
        w.resize(got);
        return WideToUtf8(w);
#else
        const char* p = std::getenv("PATH");
        return p ? std::string(p) : std::string();
#endif
    }

    LaunchError ClassifyCreateProcessError(std::uint32_t win32Error) noexcept
    {
        switch (win32Error)
        {
            case 0:   return LaunchError::None;
            case 2:                                    // ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
            case 3:   return LaunchError::ProgramNotFound;   // ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND
            case 5:   return LaunchError::AccessDenied;      // ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED
            case 193: return LaunchError::NotAProgram;       // ERROR_BAD_EXE_FORMAT
            case 740: return LaunchError::NeedsElevation;    // ERROR_ELEVATION_REQUIRED
            default:  return LaunchError::Failed;
        }
    }

    std::string DescribeLaunchError(LaunchError error)
    {
        switch (error)
        {
            case LaunchError::None:             return "launched";
            case LaunchError::NoProgram:        return "the entry names no program";
            case LaunchError::ProgramNotFound:  return "the program was not found";
            case LaunchError::BatchFileRefused: return "batch files are not launched (Windows re-parses their arguments "
                                                       "through cmd.exe, so a file name could not be quoted safely); "
                                                       "point the entry at the program's .exe";
            case LaunchError::TemplateError:    return "the arguments do not expand";
            case LaunchError::AccessDenied:     return "Windows denied access to the program";
            case LaunchError::NotAProgram:      return "the file is not a Windows program";
            case LaunchError::NeedsElevation:   return "the program asks to run as administrator; Arcane does not elevate";
            case LaunchError::Failed:           return "Windows could not start the program";
            case LaunchError::Unsupported:      return "custom programs launch on Windows only";
        }
        return "unknown launch error";
    }

    std::filesystem::path ResolveProgram(std::string_view exe, std::string_view searchPath)
    {
        const std::filesystem::path p(Utf8ToWide(Trim(exe)));
        if (p.empty())
            return {};
        std::error_code ec;
        if (p.is_absolute())
            return std::filesystem::is_regular_file(p, ec) ? p.lexically_normal() : std::filesystem::path{};
        if (p.has_parent_path())
            return {};   // "tools\x.exe": relative to what? refused, never resolved against an unknown cwd
        return Arcane::Toolchain::FindOnPath(WideToUtf8(p.wstring()), searchPath, ".EXE");
    }

    std::filesystem::path ResolveProgram(std::string_view exe)
    {
        return ResolveProgram(exe, ProcessPathVariable());
    }

    LaunchResult LaunchCustomEditor(const CustomEditor& editor, const TemplateContext& context)
    {
        LaunchResult r;
        if (Trim(editor.exe).empty())
        {
            r.error = LaunchError::NoProgram;
            r.message = DescribeLaunchError(r.error);
            return r;
        }
        const std::filesystem::path exe = ResolveProgram(editor.exe);
        if (exe.empty())
        {
            r.error = LaunchError::ProgramNotFound;
            r.message = "'" + editor.exe + "' was not found (not an existing file, and not on PATH)";
            return r;
        }
        if (IsBatch(exe))
        {
            r.error = LaunchError::BatchFileRefused;
            r.message = DescribeLaunchError(r.error);
            return r;
        }
        const ExpandedArgs args = ExpandTemplate(EffectiveArgs(editor), context);
        if (!args.Ok())
        {
            r.error = LaunchError::TemplateError;
            r.message = args.error;
            return r;
        }
#ifdef _WIN32
        std::wstring cmd = BuildCommandLine(exe, args.argv);   // lpCommandLine must be mutable
        std::error_code ec;
        const std::filesystem::path cwd =
            (!context.project.empty() && std::filesystem::is_directory(context.project, ec)) ? context.project : exe.parent_path();
        const std::wstring cwdText = cwd.wstring();
        STARTUPINFOW si{};
        si.cb = sizeof(si);
        PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
        const BOOL ok = ::CreateProcessW(exe.c_str(), cmd.data(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE, nullptr,
                                         cwdText.empty() ? nullptr : cwdText.c_str(), &si, &pi);
        if (!ok)
        {
            const DWORD e = ::GetLastError();
            r.error = ClassifyCreateProcessError(e);
            r.message = DescribeLaunchError(r.error) + " (Windows error " + std::to_string(e) + ")";
            return r;
        }
        r.processId = pi.dwProcessId;
        ::CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
        ::CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
        return r;
#else
        r.error = LaunchError::Unsupported;
        r.message = DescribeLaunchError(r.error);
        return r;
#endif
    }
}
```

### Task TE7-6: Visual Studio jumps to the line and column (spec s5.6 "Openers" table, Visual Studio row)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/Project/IdeLaunch.hpp:126-132` (declare `OpenFileAt`), `ArcaneEditor/src/Project/IdeLaunch.cpp` (`OpenFileIn` :328-355 hands back the window; a new `MoveCaret`; `Open` :421-464 takes a column; `OpenFileAtLine` :487-491 forwards; the non-Windows stubs :493-517)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/IdeLaunchTest.cpp` (one `[ide-desk]` case appended)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the late-bound DTE plumbing already in `IdeLaunch.cpp` (`InvokeNamed`, `GetProperty`, `Bstr`, `Com<T>`, `GoToLine`).
- Produces: `IdeLaunch::Outcome IdeLaunch::OpenFileAt(const std::filesystem::path& devenv, const std::filesystem::path& solution, const std::filesystem::path& file, int line, int column)`.

How the jump works:
- **In a running instance**, after `ItemOperations.OpenFile` the caret goes to `line`/`column` through `Window.Document.Selection.MoveToLineAndOffset(Line, Offset, Extend=false)` (EnvDTE `TextSelection`, late-bound). The `Window` is the one `OpenFile` returned, so the right document is moved even if focus changed.
- **Fallback.** If that call fails (e.g. the file opened in a non-text view), the existing `DTE.ExecuteCommand("Edit.GoTo", "<line>")` runs. A failed jump still counts as `OpenedInInstance`, as today.
- **A new devenv** gets `/Command "Edit.GoTo <line>"` (unchanged `ComposeLaunchArgs`). devenv's command line takes no column, so the column applies only to a running instance.
- `MoveToLineAndOffset`'s `Offset` is 1-based in characters as Visual Studio counts them (a tab is one), which matches `FilePosition::column`.

1. `OpenFileIn` (:328-355) gains an out-parameter for the window `ItemOperations.OpenFile` returns:

```cpp
        bool OpenFileIn(IDispatch* dte, const std::filesystem::path& file, Com<IDispatch>* window = nullptr)
        {
            Com<IDispatch> ops = GetProperty(dte, L"ItemOperations");
            if (!ops)
                return false;
            // ItemOperations.OpenFile(FileName, ViewKind) -- ViewKind is
            // vsViewKindTextView, the code editor (UE passes the same one).
            // DISPPARAMS order is LAST argument FIRST: [0] = ViewKind,
            // [1] = FileName. The BSTRs are owned by the two Bstr locals, so
            // the VARIANTs are NOT VariantClear'd (that would double-free).
            Bstr fileName(file.wstring());
            Bstr viewKind(L"{7651A701-06E5-11D1-8EBD-00A0C90F26EA}");
            std::vector<VARIANT> args(2);
            ::VariantInit(&args[0]);
            args[0].vt      = VT_BSTR;
            args[0].bstrVal = viewKind.b;
            ::VariantInit(&args[1]);
            args[1].vt      = VT_BSTR;
            args[1].bstrVal = fileName.b;
            VARIANT result;
            ::VariantInit(&result);
            const HRESULT hr = InvokeNamed(ops.Get(), L"OpenFile", DISPATCH_METHOD, args, &result);
            if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && window && result.vt == VT_DISPATCH && result.pdispVal)
            {
                *window->Out() = result.pdispVal;   // take the reference Invoke handed us (EnvDTE.Window)
                result.vt = VT_EMPTY;               // ownership moved; VariantClear must not release it
            }
            ::VariantClear(&result);
            if (FAILED(hr))
                ARC_WARN("IdeLaunch: ItemOperations.OpenFile('{}') failed (hr=0x{:08x})",
                         file.string(), static_cast<unsigned>(hr));
            return SUCCEEDED(hr);
        }
```

2. After `GoToLine` (:360-378), add `MoveCaret`:

```cpp
        // <window>.Document.Selection.MoveToLineAndOffset(Line, Offset, Extend)
        // (EnvDTE.TextSelection), late-bound like everything here. `window` is
        // what ItemOperations.OpenFile returned; without one, DTE.ActiveDocument.
        // DISPPARAMS order is LAST argument FIRST: [0] = Extend (VARIANT_FALSE),
        // [1] = Offset, [2] = Line -- by-value scalars, nothing to free.
        bool MoveCaret(IDispatch* dte, IDispatch* window, int line, int column)
        {
            Com<IDispatch> doc = window ? GetProperty(window, L"Document") : GetProperty(dte, L"ActiveDocument");
            if (!doc)
                return false;
            Com<IDispatch> selection = GetProperty(doc.Get(), L"Selection");
            if (!selection)
                return false;
            std::vector<VARIANT> args(3);
            for (VARIANT& v : args)
                ::VariantInit(&v);
            args[0].vt      = VT_BOOL;
            args[0].boolVal = VARIANT_FALSE;
            args[1].vt      = VT_I4;
            args[1].lVal    = column;
            args[2].vt      = VT_I4;
            args[2].lVal    = line;
            const HRESULT hr = InvokeNamed(selection.Get(), L"MoveToLineAndOffset", DISPATCH_METHOD, args, nullptr);
            if (FAILED(hr))
                ARC_WARN("IdeLaunch: TextSelection.MoveToLineAndOffset({}, {}) failed (hr=0x{:08x}) -- falling back to Edit.GoTo",
                         line, column, static_cast<unsigned>(hr));
            return SUCCEEDED(hr);
        }
```

### Task TE7-7: Detected presets -- VS Code, Sublime Text, Notepad++, Rider, CLion, Neovim in Windows Terminal (spec s5.6 "Presets")

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/EditorPresets.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/EditorPresets.cpp`
- Modify: `premake5.lua` (append to the TE7 block)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/EditorPresetsTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE7-2 `CustomEditor`; TE7-4 `WideToUtf8`, `Utf8ToWide`, `PathUtf8`; TE7-5 `ProcessPathVariable`; `Arcane::Toolchain::FindOnPath`.
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Editor::Openers`):
  - `struct UninstallEntry { std::wstring displayName, installLocation, displayIcon; }`
  - `class InstalledAppProbe` (pure virtual `AppPath`, `UninstallEntries`, `OnPath`, `IsFile`) and `class WindowsInstalledAppProbe final : public InstalledAppProbe`
  - `struct DetectedEditor { CustomEditor editor; std::string foundBy; }`, `std::vector<DetectedEditor> DetectInstalledEditors(const InstalledAppProbe&)`
  - `std::filesystem::path ExeFromDisplayIcon(std::wstring_view)`, `std::string EscapeTemplateLiteral(std::string_view)`

The presets and their templates are the spec's, verbatim:

| id | Program | Args | Found through |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vscode` | `Code.exe` | `-g "{file}:{line}:{col}"` | uninstall `Microsoft Visual Studio Code*` -> `InstallLocation\Code.exe`; PATH shim `code.cmd` -> `..\Code.exe` |
| `sublime` | `subl.exe` (else `sublime_text.exe`) | `"{file}:{line}:{col}"` | App Paths `sublime_text.exe`; uninstall `Sublime Text*`; PATH `subl.exe` |
| `notepadpp` | `notepad++.exe` | `-n{line} -c{col} "{file}"` | App Paths; uninstall `Notepad++*` (InstallLocation or DisplayIcon); PATH |
| `rider` | `bin\rider64.exe` | `--line {line} --column {col} "{file}"` | uninstall `JetBrains Rider*`; PATH `rider64.exe` |
| `clion` | `bin\clion64.exe` | `--line {line} --column {col} "{file}"` | uninstall `CLion*`; PATH `clion64.exe` |
| `nvim-wt` | `wt.exe` | `nvim +{line} "{file}"` (or `"<abs nvim.exe>" +{line} "{file}"` when Neovim is installed but not on PATH) | `wt.exe` via App Paths / PATH, **and** `nvim.exe` via PATH / uninstall `Neovim*` -> `bin\nvim.exe` |

Rules:
- The order is App Paths, then uninstall keys, then PATH. The first hit wins.
- A preset is offered only when its program file exists.
- Every registry access is `KEY_READ`. Nothing is written, and file associations are never touched (`[openers-guard]` checks this, TE7-10).
- **Known limitation**, recorded here and on the page tooltip: Windows Terminal treats `;` on its command line as a subcommand separator, so a `{file}` containing `;` breaks the `nvim-wt` preset.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test** -- `ArcaneTests/src/Text/EditorPresetsTest.cpp`:

```cpp
// TE7-7: detected presets (text editor spec s5.6). The detection rules run
// against a fake registry/PATH; one smoke case reads the real machine.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/EditorPresets.hpp"

#include <cwctype>
#include <filesystem>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers;

namespace
{
    struct FakeProbe final : InstalledAppProbe
    {
        std::map<std::wstring, fs::path> appPaths, onPath;
        std::vector<UninstallEntry> installs;
        std::set<std::wstring> files;

        static std::wstring Key(const fs::path& p)
        {
            std::wstring s = p.lexically_normal().wstring();
            for (wchar_t& c : s)
                c = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(static_cast<wint_t>(c)));
            return s;
        }
        void AddFile(const fs::path& p) { files.insert(Key(p)); }

        std::optional<fs::path> AppPath(std::wstring_view n) const override
        {
            const auto it = appPaths.find(std::wstring(n));
            return it == appPaths.end() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<fs::path>(it->second);
        }
        std::vector<UninstallEntry> UninstallEntries() const override { return installs; }
        std::optional<fs::path> OnPath(std::wstring_view n) const override
        {
            const auto it = onPath.find(std::wstring(n));
            return it == onPath.end() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<fs::path>(it->second);
        }
        bool IsFile(const fs::path& p) const override { return files.contains(Key(p)); }
    };
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// Detected presets for custom program openers (text editor spec s5.6
// "Presets"): Visual Studio Code, Sublime Text, Notepad++, JetBrains Rider,
// CLion and Neovim in Windows Terminal, each with the spec's argument
// template. Detection READS the registry's App Paths and uninstall keys and
// PATH through an injectable InstalledAppProbe (EditorPresetsTest fakes it);
// a preset whose program file is not there is not offered. Nothing here
// writes the registry or touches file associations (OpenersGuardTest).
// Limitation: Windows Terminal splits its command line on ';', so a {file}
// containing ';' breaks the nvim-wt preset.

#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    struct UninstallEntry
    {
        std::wstring displayName;       // "Microsoft Visual Studio Code (User)"
        std::wstring installLocation;   // may be empty
        std::wstring displayIcon;       // "\"C:\\...\\app.exe\",0" -- may be empty
    };

    class InstalledAppProbe
    {
    public:
        virtual ~InstalledAppProbe() = default;
        // ...\CurrentVersion\App Paths\<exeName>, default value: HKCU, then HKLM (64-bit, then 32-bit view).
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::optional<std::filesystem::path> AppPath(std::wstring_view exeName) const = 0;
        // Every ...\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\* subkey with a DisplayName: HKLM 64-bit, HKLM 32-bit, HKCU.
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::vector<UninstallEntry> UninstallEntries() const = 0;
        // <dir>\<exeName> for the first PATH directory that holds it.
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::optional<std::filesystem::path> OnPath(std::wstring_view exeName) const = 0;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual bool IsFile(const std::filesystem::path& path) const = 0;
    };

    // This machine: RegOpenKeyExW(KEY_READ | view) / RegEnumKeyExW /
    // RegGetValueW (REG_EXPAND_SZ expanded with ExpandEnvironmentStringsW) and
    // Toolchain::FindOnPath over the process PATH. Read-only.
    class WindowsInstalledAppProbe final : public InstalledAppProbe
    {
    public:
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::filesystem::path> AppPath(std::wstring_view exeName) const override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<UninstallEntry> UninstallEntries() const override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::filesystem::path> OnPath(std::wstring_view exeName) const override;
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsFile(const std::filesystem::path& path) const override;
    };

    struct DetectedEditor
    {
        CustomEditor editor;   // ready for editor.files.customEditors
        std::string  foundBy;  // "App Paths" / "installed: <DisplayName>" / "PATH"
    };

    // In preset order (vscode, sublime, notepadpp, rider, clion, nvim-wt); each at most once.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<DetectedEditor> DetectInstalledEditors(const InstalledAppProbe& probe);
    // "\"C:\\x\\a.exe\",0" / "C:\\x\\a.exe,0" / "C:\\x\\a.exe" -> C:\x\a.exe; not an .exe -> empty.
    [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path ExeFromDisplayIcon(std::wstring_view displayIcon);
    // A literal for an argument template: { -> {{ and } -> }} (a path is never a placeholder).
    [[nodiscard]] std::string EscapeTemplateLiteral(std::string_view text);
}
```

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/EditorPresets.hpp"

#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"   // WideToUtf8, PathUtf8
#include "Project/Openers/ProgramLaunch.hpp"     // ProcessPathVariable

#include <Arcane/Build/Toolchain.hpp>            // FindOnPath

#include <algorithm>
#include <cwctype>
#include <iterator>
#include <system_error>
#include <utility>

#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>   // RegOpenKeyExW, RegEnumKeyExW, RegGetValueW, ExpandEnvironmentStringsW
#pragma comment(lib, "advapi32.lib")
#endif

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    namespace
    {
        struct PresetRule
        {
            const char* id;
            const char* name;
            const char* args;
            std::vector<std::wstring> appPaths;          // App Paths\<exe>
            std::vector<std::wstring> displayPrefixes;   // uninstall DisplayName starts with (any case)
            std::vector<std::wstring> installExes;       // under InstallLocation, first that exists wins
            std::vector<std::wstring> pathExes;          // bare names on PATH
            std::vector<std::pair<std::wstring, std::wstring>> pathShims;   // a PATH script -> the exe relative to its folder
        };

        const std::vector<PresetRule>& Rules()
        {
            static const std::vector<PresetRule> rules = {
                { "vscode", "Visual Studio Code", "-g \"{file}:{line}:{col}\"",
                  {}, { L"Microsoft Visual Studio Code" }, { L"Code.exe" }, {}, { { L"code.cmd", L"..\\Code.exe" } } },
                { "sublime", "Sublime Text", "\"{file}:{line}:{col}\"",
                  { L"sublime_text.exe" }, { L"Sublime Text" }, { L"subl.exe", L"sublime_text.exe" }, { L"subl.exe" }, {} },
                { "notepadpp", "Notepad++", "-n{line} -c{col} \"{file}\"",
                  { L"notepad++.exe" }, { L"Notepad++" }, { L"notepad++.exe" }, { L"notepad++.exe" }, {} },
                { "rider", "JetBrains Rider", "--line {line} --column {col} \"{file}\"",
                  {}, { L"JetBrains Rider" }, { L"bin\\rider64.exe" }, { L"rider64.exe" }, {} },
                { "clion", "CLion", "--line {line} --column {col} \"{file}\"",
                  {}, { L"CLion" }, { L"bin\\clion64.exe" }, { L"clion64.exe" }, {} },
            };
            return rules;
        }

        std::wstring LowerW(std::wstring_view s)
        {
            std::wstring out(s);
            for (wchar_t& c : out)
                c = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(static_cast<wint_t>(c)));
            return out;
        }

        bool StartsWithI(std::wstring_view text, std::wstring_view prefix)
        {
            return text.size() >= prefix.size() && LowerW(text.substr(0, prefix.size())) == LowerW(prefix);
        }

        bool SameFileNameI(const std::filesystem::path& a, const std::filesystem::path& b)
        {
            return LowerW(a.filename().wstring()) == LowerW(b.filename().wstring());
        }

        struct Found
        {
            std::filesystem::path exe;
            std::string foundBy;
        };

        // App Paths names one exe; a preset that prefers a sibling (subl.exe
        // beside sublime_text.exe) takes it when it is there.
        std::filesystem::path PreferListed(const InstalledAppProbe& probe, const std::filesystem::path& found,
                                           const std::vector<std::wstring>& installExes)
        {
            for (const std::wstring& rel : installExes)
            {
                const std::filesystem::path candidate = found.parent_path() / std::filesystem::path(rel).filename();
                if (probe.IsFile(candidate))
                    return candidate;
            }
            return found;
        }

        std::optional<Found> FindProgram(const InstalledAppProbe& probe, const std::vector<UninstallEntry>& installs,
                                         const PresetRule& rule)
        {
            for (const std::wstring& name : rule.appPaths)
                if (const auto p = probe.AppPath(name); p && probe.IsFile(*p))
                    return Found{ PreferListed(probe, *p, rule.installExes), "App Paths" };

            for (const UninstallEntry& e : installs)
            {
                const bool named = std::any_of(rule.displayPrefixes.begin(), rule.displayPrefixes.end(),
                                               [&](const std::wstring& pre) { return StartsWithI(e.displayName, pre); });
                if (!named)
                    continue;
                const std::string by = "installed: " + WideToUtf8(e.displayName);
                if (!e.installLocation.empty())
                    for (const std::wstring& rel : rule.installExes)
                        if (const std::filesystem::path p = (std::filesystem::path(e.installLocation) / rel).lexically_normal();
                            probe.IsFile(p))
                            return Found{ p, by };
                if (const std::filesystem::path icon = ExeFromDisplayIcon(e.displayIcon); !icon.empty() && probe.IsFile(icon))
                    for (const std::wstring& rel : rule.installExes)
                        if (SameFileNameI(icon, rel))
                            return Found{ icon, by };
            }

            for (const std::wstring& name : rule.pathExes)
                if (const auto p = probe.OnPath(name); p && probe.IsFile(*p))
                    return Found{ *p, "PATH" };
            for (const auto& [script, rel] : rule.pathShims)
                if (const auto p = probe.OnPath(script))
                    if (const std::filesystem::path exe = (p->parent_path() / rel).lexically_normal(); probe.IsFile(exe))
                        return Found{ exe, "PATH" };
            return std::nullopt;
        }

        std::optional<DetectedEditor> DetectNeovimInTerminal(const InstalledAppProbe& probe,
                                                             const std::vector<UninstallEntry>& installs)
        {
            std::optional<std::filesystem::path> wt = probe.AppPath(L"wt.exe");
            if (!wt || !probe.IsFile(*wt))
                wt = probe.OnPath(L"wt.exe");
            if (!wt || !probe.IsFile(*wt))
                return std::nullopt;

            std::string nvim;
            std::string by = "PATH";
            if (const auto onPath = probe.OnPath(L"nvim.exe"); onPath && probe.IsFile(*onPath))
                nvim = "nvim";
            else
                for (const UninstallEntry& e : installs)
                {
                    if (!StartsWithI(e.displayName, L"Neovim") || e.installLocation.empty())
                        continue;
                    const std::filesystem::path p = (std::filesystem::path(e.installLocation) / L"bin\\nvim.exe").lexically_normal();
                    if (!probe.IsFile(p))
                        continue;
                    nvim = "\"" + EscapeTemplateLiteral(PathUtf8(p)) + "\"";
                    by = "installed: " + WideToUtf8(e.displayName);
                    break;
                }
            if (nvim.empty())
                return std::nullopt;
            return DetectedEditor{ CustomEditor{ "nvim-wt", "Neovim (Windows Terminal)", PathUtf8(*wt),
                                                 nvim + " +{line} \"{file}\"" }, by };
        }
    }

    std::vector<DetectedEditor> DetectInstalledEditors(const InstalledAppProbe& probe)
    {
        const std::vector<UninstallEntry> installs = probe.UninstallEntries();
        std::vector<DetectedEditor> out;
        for (const PresetRule& rule : Rules())
            if (const std::optional<Found> f = FindProgram(probe, installs, rule))
                out.push_back(DetectedEditor{ CustomEditor{ rule.id, rule.name, PathUtf8(f->exe), rule.args }, f->foundBy });
        if (std::optional<DetectedEditor> nvim = DetectNeovimInTerminal(probe, installs))
            out.push_back(std::move(*nvim));
        return out;
    }

    std::filesystem::path ExeFromDisplayIcon(std::wstring_view icon)
    {
        std::wstring s(icon);
        const auto trim = [](std::wstring& t) {
            while (!t.empty() && std::iswspace(static_cast<wint_t>(t.front()))) t.erase(t.begin());
            while (!t.empty() && std::iswspace(static_cast<wint_t>(t.back()))) t.pop_back();
        };
        trim(s);
        if (!s.empty() && s.front() == L'"')
        {
            const std::size_t close = s.find(L'"', 1);
            if (close == std::wstring::npos)
                return {};
            s = s.substr(1, close - 1);
        }
        else if (const std::size_t comma = s.rfind(L','); comma != std::wstring::npos)
            s = s.substr(0, comma);   // ",0" is the icon index
        trim(s);
        const std::filesystem::path p(s);
        return LowerW(p.extension().wstring()) == L".exe" ? p : std::filesystem::path{};
    }

    std::string EscapeTemplateLiteral(std::string_view text)
    {
        std::string out;
        out.reserve(text.size());
        for (const char c : text)
        {
            out.push_back(c);
            if (c == '{' || c == '}')
                out.push_back(c);
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::optional<std::filesystem::path> WindowsInstalledAppProbe::OnPath(std::wstring_view exeName) const
    {
        const std::filesystem::path p = Arcane::Toolchain::FindOnPath(WideToUtf8(exeName), ProcessPathVariable(), {});
        if (p.empty())
            return std::nullopt;
        return p;
    }

    bool WindowsInstalledAppProbe::IsFile(const std::filesystem::path& path) const
    {
        std::error_code ec;
        return std::filesystem::is_regular_file(path, ec);
    }

#ifdef _WIN32
    namespace
    {
        constexpr wchar_t kAppPaths[]  = L"SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\App Paths\\";
        constexpr wchar_t kUninstall[] = L"SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Uninstall";

        struct Key   // read-only, closed on scope exit
        {
            HKEY h = nullptr;
            Key(HKEY root, const std::wstring& sub, REGSAM view)
            {
                if (::RegOpenKeyExW(root, sub.c_str(), 0, KEY_READ | view, &h) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
                    h = nullptr;
            }
            ~Key() { if (h) ::RegCloseKey(h); }
            Key(const Key&) = delete;
            Key& operator=(const Key&) = delete;
            explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return h != nullptr; }
        };

        // REG_SZ / REG_EXPAND_SZ (RRF_NOEXPAND: we expand ourselves, so a value's
        // type is never refused). `value` null = the key's default value.
        std::optional<std::wstring> ReadString(HKEY key, const wchar_t* value)
        {
            const DWORD flags = RRF_RT_REG_SZ | RRF_RT_REG_EXPAND_SZ | RRF_NOEXPAND;
            DWORD type = 0;
            DWORD bytes = 0;
            if (::RegGetValueW(key, nullptr, value, flags, &type, nullptr, &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS || bytes < sizeof(wchar_t))
                return std::nullopt;
            std::wstring s(bytes / sizeof(wchar_t), L'\0');
            if (::RegGetValueW(key, nullptr, value, flags, &type, s.data(), &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
                return std::nullopt;
            s.resize(bytes / sizeof(wchar_t));
            while (!s.empty() && s.back() == L'\0')
                s.pop_back();
            if (type == REG_EXPAND_SZ)
            {
                const DWORD n = ::ExpandEnvironmentStringsW(s.c_str(), nullptr, 0);
                if (n > 0)
                {
                    std::wstring expanded(n, L'\0');
                    const DWORD got = ::ExpandEnvironmentStringsW(s.c_str(), expanded.data(), n);
                    expanded.resize(got > 0 ? got - 1 : 0);   // got counts the terminator
                    s = std::move(expanded);
                }
            }
            return s;
        }

        std::wstring Unquote(std::wstring s)
        {
            while (!s.empty() && std::iswspace(static_cast<wint_t>(s.back()))) s.pop_back();
            while (!s.empty() && std::iswspace(static_cast<wint_t>(s.front()))) s.erase(s.begin());
            if (s.size() >= 2 && s.front() == L'"' && s.back() == L'"')
                s = s.substr(1, s.size() - 2);
            return s;
        }
    }

    std::optional<std::filesystem::path> WindowsInstalledAppProbe::AppPath(std::wstring_view exeName) const
    {
        const std::wstring sub = std::wstring(kAppPaths) + std::wstring(exeName);
        const std::pair<HKEY, REGSAM> places[] = {
            { HKEY_CURRENT_USER, REGSAM{} }, { HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, KEY_WOW64_64KEY }, { HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, KEY_WOW64_32KEY },
        };
        for (const auto& [root, view] : places)
        {
            const Key key(root, sub, view);
            if (!key)
                continue;
            if (const std::optional<std::wstring> v = ReadString(key.h, nullptr); v && !v->empty())
                return std::filesystem::path(Unquote(*v));
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    std::vector<UninstallEntry> WindowsInstalledAppProbe::UninstallEntries() const
    {
        std::vector<UninstallEntry> out;
        const std::pair<HKEY, REGSAM> places[] = {
            { HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, KEY_WOW64_64KEY }, { HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, KEY_WOW64_32KEY }, { HKEY_CURRENT_USER, REGSAM{} },
        };
        for (const auto& [root, view] : places)
        {
            const Key parent(root, kUninstall, view);
            if (!parent)
                continue;
            for (DWORD i = 0;; ++i)
            {
                wchar_t name[256];   // registry key names are at most 255 characters
                DWORD len = static_cast<DWORD>(std::size(name));
                const LSTATUS st = ::RegEnumKeyExW(parent.h, i, name, &len, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
                if (st == ERROR_NO_MORE_ITEMS)
                    break;
                if (st != ERROR_SUCCESS)
                    continue;
                const Key sub(parent.h, std::wstring(name, len), view);
                if (!sub)
                    continue;
                UninstallEntry e;
                e.displayName = ReadString(sub.h, L"DisplayName").value_or(L"");
                if (e.displayName.empty())
                    continue;
                e.installLocation = Unquote(ReadString(sub.h, L"InstallLocation").value_or(L""));
                e.displayIcon = ReadString(sub.h, L"DisplayIcon").value_or(L"");
                out.push_back(std::move(e));
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
#else
    std::optional<std::filesystem::path> WindowsInstalledAppProbe::AppPath(std::wstring_view) const { return std::nullopt; }
    std::vector<UninstallEntry> WindowsInstalledAppProbe::UninstallEntries() const { return {}; }
#endif
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE7-1 (`ResolveOpener`, `ValidateOpenWith`, `OpenerDisplayName`), TE7-2 (`CustomEditor`, `ParseCustomEditors`, `FindCustomEditor`, `CustomEditorIds`), TE7-3 (`FileOpenerSettings`, `CurrentOpenWith`, `CurrentCustomEditors`), TE7-4 `PathUtf8`; `Arcane::Diagnostic`, `Arcane::DiagLocator::File(std::string, int, int)`, `Arcane::Diagnostics::Publish(std::string_view key, std::span<const Diagnostic>)` (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Base/Diagnostics.hpp:708-773`); `Arcane::Editor::DiagnosticStore::InstallAsEngineSink()` / `Snapshot()` in the test (`Panels/DiagnosticStore.hpp`, already in the ArcaneTests list at premake5.lua:1418).
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Editor::Openers`):
  - `struct FilePosition { std::uint32_t line = 1, column = 1; }` (1-based, column in characters), `std::optional<FilePosition> PositionFrom(int line, int column) noexcept` (`line <= 0` -> none; `column <= 0` -> 1)
  - `struct OpenOutcome { bool ok; std::string error; EditorDocument* document; }`
  - `struct FileOpenerBackends { isOpenInTextDocument, hasDedicatedEditor, isText, openArcaneText, openDedicated, openVisualStudio, openSystemDefault, openCustom }`
  - `struct OpenResult { bool ok; OpenerId opener; ResolveReason reason; EditorDocument* document; std::string error; }`
  - `struct OpenFailure { std::filesystem::path path; OpenerId opener; std::string openerName, error; std::optional<FilePosition> at; bool offerArcaneText; }`
  - `std::string OpenerName(const OpenerId&, std::span<const CustomEditor>)`
  - `class FileOpener { Open(path, at); OpenWith(path, opener, at); OpenWithProgram(program, path, at); PendingOffer(); OfferSerial(); AcceptOffer(); DismissOffer(); Failures(); ClearFailures(); kFailuresKey = "files:open"; kConfigKey = "files:openWith"; }`

`FilePosition` is 1-based with the column in characters. That is what compilers, crash frames, `DiagLocator` and every external editor speak. `Text::Point` is 0-based with the column in bytes. The Arcane backend converts (TE7-9 `ToBufferPoint`).

Failure handling (spec s5.6 "Rules"):
- A backend that fails publishes one Warning row per failing file under `files:open`. The row is code `files.open.failed`, worded "Could not open <file> with <opener>: <error>", with a `File` locator at the position. It is never silent.
- A later successful open of that file clears its row.
- When the file is text and the failed opener was not the Arcane Text Editor, the failure also arms the **offer** that `OpenFailurePrompt` (TE7-9) shows; `AcceptOffer()` opens it in the Arcane Text Editor.
- Resolution skips and malformed settings publish under `files:openWith` with code `files.openWith.invalid`.

```cpp
// TE7-8: FileOpener with recording backends (text editor spec s5.6).
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp"            // ScopedCodeRung
#include "Panels/DiagnosticStore.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/FileOpener.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/CVarRegistry.hpp>

#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers;
using Arcane::CVarValue;

namespace
{
    std::string Pos(std::optional<FilePosition> at)
    {
        return at ? "@" + std::to_string(at->line) + ":" + std::to_string(at->column) : std::string();
    }

    struct Recorder
    {
        std::vector<std::string> calls;
        bool textOpen = false, dedicated = false, isText = true;
        OpenOutcome next{ true, {}, nullptr };

        FileOpenerBackends Backends()
        {
            FileOpenerBackends b;
            b.isOpenInTextDocument = [this](const fs::path&) { return textOpen; };
            b.hasDedicatedEditor   = [this](const fs::path&) { return dedicated; };
            b.isText               = [this](const fs::path&) { return isText; };
            b.openArcaneText = [this](const fs::path& p, std::optional<FilePosition> at) {
                calls.push_back("text:" + p.filename().string() + Pos(at));
                return next;
            };
            b.openDedicated = [this](const fs::path& p) {
                calls.push_back("dedicated:" + p.filename().string());
                return next;
            };
            b.openVisualStudio = [this](const fs::path& p, std::optional<FilePosition> at) {
                calls.push_back("vs:" + p.filename().string() + Pos(at));
                return next;
            };
            b.openSystemDefault = [this](const fs::path& p) {
                calls.push_back("system:" + p.filename().string());
                return next;
            };
            b.openCustom = [this](const CustomEditor& e, const fs::path& p, std::optional<FilePosition> at) {
                calls.push_back("custom:" + e.id + ":" + p.filename().string() + Pos(at));
                return next;
            };
            return b;
        }
    };
}

{

    FileOpener files(rec.Backends());
    CHECK(files.Open("D:/p/Game.cpp", FilePosition{ 12, 4 }).opener == OpenerId::VisualStudio());
    CHECK(files.Open("D:/p/README.md").ok);
    rec.isText = false;
    rec.dedicated = true;

    rec.dedicated = false;
    CHECK(files.Open("D:/p/crash.dmp").opener == OpenerId::SystemDefault());
    CHECK(rec.calls == std::vector<std::string>{ "vs:Game.cpp@12:4", "text:README.md", "dedicated:Brick.arcmat", "system:crash.dmp" });
}

TEST_CASE("FileOpener: the setting moves .cpp to the Arcane Text Editor; an open text tab wins over Visual Studio", "[text-openers]")
{

        CHECK(files.Open("D:/p/Game.cpp").opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());

    rec.textOpen = true;

TEST_CASE("FileOpener: a custom opener receives its CustomEditor; Open With overrides the map; a one-off program needs no entry", "[text-openers]")
{

        CVarValue::String(R"([{"id":"vscode","name":"Visual Studio Code","exe":"C:/VSC/Code.exe","args":"-g \"{file}:{line}:{col}\""}])"));

TEST_CASE("FileOpener: a failing opener publishes a Problems row and offers the Arcane Text Editor for a text file", "[text-openers]")
{
    Arcane::Editor::DiagnosticStore store;
    store.InstallAsEngineSink();
    Recorder rec;
    rec.next = OpenOutcome{ false, "no Visual Studio install found (vswhere found no devenv.exe)", nullptr };
    FileOpener files(rec.Backends());

    const OpenResult r = files.Open("D:/p/Game.cpp", FilePosition{ 7, 2 });
    CHECK_FALSE(r.ok);
    std::vector<Arcane::Diagnostic> rows = store.Snapshot();
    REQUIRE(rows.size() == 1);
    CHECK(rows[0].code == "files.open.failed");
    CHECK(rows[0].severity == Arcane::DiagSeverity::Warning);
    CHECK(rows[0].message == "Could not open Game.cpp with Visual Studio: no Visual Studio install found (vswhere found no devenv.exe)");
    CHECK(rows[0].locator.kind == Arcane::DiagLocator::Kind::File);
    CHECK(rows[0].locator.line == 7);
    CHECK(rows[0].locator.col == 2);
    REQUIRE(files.PendingOffer().has_value());
    CHECK(files.PendingOffer()->offerArcaneText);
    CHECK(files.OfferSerial() == 1u);

    rec.next = OpenOutcome{ true, {}, nullptr };
    const OpenResult accepted = files.AcceptOffer();
    CHECK(accepted.ok);
    CHECK(accepted.opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    CHECK(rec.calls.back() == "text:Game.cpp@7:2");
    CHECK_FALSE(files.PendingOffer().has_value());
    CHECK(store.Snapshot().empty());   // the successful open cleared the file's row
}

TEST_CASE("FileOpener: no offer for a binary file, nor when the Arcane Text Editor itself failed", "[text-openers]")
{
    Arcane::Editor::DiagnosticStore store;
    store.InstallAsEngineSink();
    Recorder rec;
    rec.next = OpenOutcome{ false, "No program is associated with this file type", nullptr };
    rec.isText = false;
    FileOpener files(rec.Backends());
    (void)files.Open("D:/p/crash.dmp");
    CHECK_FALSE(files.PendingOffer().has_value());
    rec.isText = true;
    (void)files.OpenWith("D:/p/a.md", OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    CHECK_FALSE(files.PendingOffer().has_value());
    CHECK(store.Snapshot().size() == 2);
    CHECK(files.Failures().size() == 2);
    files.ClearFailures();
    CHECK(store.Snapshot().empty());
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/FileOpener.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// FileOpener (text editor spec s5.6, D15): the ONE way the editor opens a
// file. Every route -- Asset Browser double-click / Enter, Problems and
// crash-report links, Open as Text, Open With, the IDE bridge's source rows,
// and spec 2's Goto Anything / Find in Files -- calls Open or OpenWith. The
// backends that actually open things are injected (FileOpenerWiring builds
// the app's), so this class is headless-testable; OpenersGuardTest fails any
// open path that bypasses it.
//
// Failure is never silent: a backend that fails publishes a Problems row
// under "files:open" naming the opener and the error, and -- for a text
// file whose opener was not the Arcane Text Editor -- arms the "Open in
// Arcane Text Editor instead" offer that OpenFailurePrompt shows. Entries
// the resolution skipped and malformed editor.files.* text publish under
// "files:openWith".

#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor { class EditorDocument; }

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    // 1-based line and column, the column in characters -- what compilers,
    // crash frames, DiagLocator and external editors speak. (Text::Point is
    // 0-based bytes; the Arcane backend converts.)
    struct FilePosition
    {
        std::uint32_t line = 1;
        std::uint32_t column = 1;
        friend bool operator==(const FilePosition&, const FilePosition&) = default;
    };
    // line <= 0 -> no position; column <= 0 -> column 1.
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<FilePosition> PositionFrom(int line, int column) noexcept;

    struct OpenOutcome
    {
        bool ok = false;
        std::string error;                    // the Problems row's "<error>" when !ok
        EditorDocument* document = nullptr;   // set when an Arcane document shows the file
    };

    struct FileOpenerBackends
    {
        std::function<bool(const std::filesystem::path&)> isOpenInTextDocument;
        std::function<bool(const std::filesystem::path&)> hasDedicatedEditor;
        std::function<bool(const std::filesystem::path&)> isText;
        std::function<OpenOutcome(const std::filesystem::path&, std::optional<FilePosition>)> openArcaneText;
        std::function<OpenOutcome(const std::filesystem::path&)> openDedicated;
        std::function<OpenOutcome(const std::filesystem::path&, std::optional<FilePosition>)> openVisualStudio;
        std::function<OpenOutcome(const std::filesystem::path&)> openSystemDefault;
        std::function<OpenOutcome(const CustomEditor&, const std::filesystem::path&, std::optional<FilePosition>)> openCustom;
    };

    struct OpenResult
    {
        bool ok = false;
        OpenerId opener;
        ResolveReason reason = ResolveReason::BuiltInDefault;
        EditorDocument* document = nullptr;
        std::string error;
    };

    struct OpenFailure
    {
        std::filesystem::path path;
        OpenerId opener;
        std::string openerName;
        std::string error;
        std::optional<FilePosition> at;
        bool offerArcaneText = false;   // a text file, and the failed opener was not the Arcane Text Editor
    };

    // "Arcane Text Editor", "Visual Studio", "the system default program",
    // "its Arcane editor", or a custom entry's name ("custom:<id>" when unknown).
    [[nodiscard]] std::string OpenerName(const OpenerId& opener, std::span<const CustomEditor> customs);

    class FileOpener
    {
    public:
        static constexpr std::string_view kFailuresKey = "files:open";
        static constexpr std::string_view kConfigKey   = "files:openWith";

        explicit FileOpener(FileOpenerBackends backends);

        // The file's opener decides (spec s5.6 resolution order).
        OpenResult Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::optional<FilePosition> at = std::nullopt);
        // A one-off choice: Open With, Open as Text (ArcaneText).
        OpenResult OpenWith(const std::filesystem::path& path, const OpenerId& opener,
                            std::optional<FilePosition> at = std::nullopt);
        // Open With > Choose... without "Always": a program not in editor.files.customEditors.
        OpenResult OpenWithProgram(const CustomEditor& program, const std::filesystem::path& path,
                                   std::optional<FilePosition> at = std::nullopt);

        [[nodiscard]] const std::optional<OpenFailure>& PendingOffer() const noexcept { return m_offer; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t OfferSerial() const noexcept { return m_offerSerial; }   // bumps per new offer
        OpenResult AcceptOffer();                        // the offered file in the Arcane Text Editor
        void DismissOffer() noexcept { m_offer.reset(); }
        [[nodiscard]] std::span<const OpenFailure> Failures() const noexcept { return m_failures; }
        void ClearFailures();                            // project switch: rows and offer gone

    private:
        OpenResult Run(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::optional<FilePosition> at,
                       const std::optional<OpenerId>& explicitOpener, const CustomEditor* oneOff);
        OpenOutcome Dispatch(const OpenerId& opener, const std::filesystem::path& path, std::optional<FilePosition> at,
                             std::span<const CustomEditor> customs, const CustomEditor* oneOff);
        void NoteFailure(OpenFailure failure);
        void NoteSuccess(const std::filesystem::path& path);
        void PublishFailures() const;
        void PublishConfig(std::vector<std::string> problems);

        FileOpenerBackends m_backends;
        std::vector<OpenFailure> m_failures;
        std::optional<OpenFailure> m_offer;
        std::uint64_t m_offerSerial = 0;
        std::vector<std::string> m_configPublished;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/FileOpener.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/FileOpener.hpp"

#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"   // PathUtf8
#include "Settings/FileOpenerSettings.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Base/Diagnostics.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <utility>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    namespace
    {
        bool SamePath(const std::filesystem::path& a, const std::filesystem::path& b)
        {
            return a.lexically_normal() == b.lexically_normal();
        }
    }

    std::optional<FilePosition> PositionFrom(int line, int column) noexcept
    {
        if (line <= 0)
            return std::nullopt;
        return FilePosition{ static_cast<std::uint32_t>(line), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(column > 0 ? column : 1) };
    }

    std::string OpenerName(const OpenerId& opener, std::span<const CustomEditor> customs)
    {
        switch (opener.kind)
        {
            case OpenerKind::ArcaneText:    return "the Arcane Text Editor";
            case OpenerKind::VisualStudio:  return "Visual Studio";
            case OpenerKind::SystemDefault: return "the system default program";
            case OpenerKind::Dedicated:     return "its Arcane editor";
            case OpenerKind::Custom:
                if (const CustomEditor* e = FindCustomEditor(customs, opener.custom))
                    return e->name;
                return "custom:" + opener.custom;
        }
        return "the Arcane Text Editor";
    }

    FileOpener::FileOpener(FileOpenerBackends backends)
        : m_backends(std::move(backends))
    {
    }

    OpenResult FileOpener::Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::optional<FilePosition> at)
    {
        return Run(path, at, std::nullopt, nullptr);
    }

    OpenResult FileOpener::OpenWith(const std::filesystem::path& path, const OpenerId& opener, std::optional<FilePosition> at)
    {
        return Run(path, at, opener, nullptr);
    }

    OpenResult FileOpener::OpenWithProgram(const CustomEditor& program, const std::filesystem::path& path,
                                           std::optional<FilePosition> at)
    {
        return Run(path, at, std::nullopt, &program);
    }

    OpenResult FileOpener::AcceptOffer()
    {
        if (!m_offer)
            return {};
        const OpenFailure offered = *m_offer;
        m_offer.reset();
        return Run(offered.path, offered.at, OpenerId::ArcaneText(), nullptr);
    }

    void FileOpener::ClearFailures()
    {
        m_failures.clear();
        m_offer.reset();
        PublishFailures();
    }

    OpenResult FileOpener::Run(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::optional<FilePosition> at,
                               const std::optional<OpenerId>& explicitOpener, const CustomEditor* oneOff)
    {
        const FileOpenerSettings& settings = Arcane::Settings<FileOpenerSettings>();
        const CustomEditorList customList = ParseCustomEditors(settings.customEditors);
        const std::vector<OpenWithEntry> map = ParseOpenWith(settings.openWith);

        std::vector<std::string> problems;
        for (const std::string& p : ValidateOpenWith(settings.openWith))
            problems.push_back("editor.files.openWith: " + p);
        for (const std::string& p : customList.problems)
            problems.push_back(p);

        FileFacts facts;
        facts.openInTextDocument = m_backends.isOpenInTextDocument && m_backends.isOpenInTextDocument(path);
        facts.hasDedicatedEditor = m_backends.hasDedicatedEditor && m_backends.hasDedicatedEditor(path);
        facts.isText             = m_backends.isText && m_backends.isText(path);

        OpenResult result;
        if (oneOff)
        {
            result.opener = OpenerId::Custom(oneOff->id);
            result.reason = ResolveReason::Explicit;
        }
        else
        {
            const std::vector<std::string> ids = CustomEditorIds(customList.editors);
            const Resolution r = ResolveOpener(path, facts, map, ids, explicitOpener);
            for (const std::string& s : r.skipped)
                problems.push_back("editor.files.openWith: " + s);
            result.opener = r.opener;
            result.reason = r.reason;
        }
        PublishConfig(std::move(problems));

        const OpenOutcome outcome = Dispatch(result.opener, path, at, customList.editors, oneOff);
        result.ok = outcome.ok;
        result.document = outcome.document;
        result.error = outcome.error;
        if (outcome.ok)
            NoteSuccess(path);
        else
            NoteFailure(OpenFailure{ path, result.opener,
                                     oneOff ? oneOff->name : OpenerName(result.opener, customList.editors),
                                     outcome.error, at,
                                     facts.isText && result.opener.kind != OpenerKind::ArcaneText });
        return result;
    }

    OpenOutcome FileOpener::Dispatch(const OpenerId& opener, const std::filesystem::path& path,
                                     std::optional<FilePosition> at, std::span<const CustomEditor> customs,
                                     const CustomEditor* oneOff)
    {
        const auto missing = [](const char* what) {
            return OpenOutcome{ false, std::string("this host has no ") + what + " opener", nullptr };
        };
        switch (opener.kind)
        {
            case OpenerKind::ArcaneText:
                return m_backends.openArcaneText ? m_backends.openArcaneText(path, at) : missing("Arcane Text Editor");
            case OpenerKind::Dedicated:
                return m_backends.openDedicated ? m_backends.openDedicated(path) : missing("dedicated editor");
            case OpenerKind::VisualStudio:
                return m_backends.openVisualStudio ? m_backends.openVisualStudio(path, at) : missing("Visual Studio");
            case OpenerKind::SystemDefault:
                return m_backends.openSystemDefault ? m_backends.openSystemDefault(path) : missing("system default");
            case OpenerKind::Custom:
            {
                const CustomEditor* e = oneOff ? oneOff : FindCustomEditor(customs, opener.custom);
                if (!e)
                    return OpenOutcome{ false, "custom:" + opener.custom + " is not defined in editor.files.customEditors", nullptr };
                return m_backends.openCustom ? m_backends.openCustom(*e, path, at) : missing("custom program");
            }
        }
        return OpenOutcome{ false, "unknown opener", nullptr };
    }

    void FileOpener::NoteFailure(OpenFailure failure)
    {
        std::erase_if(m_failures, [&](const OpenFailure& f) { return SamePath(f.path, failure.path); });
        if (failure.offerArcaneText)
        {
            m_offer = failure;
            ++m_offerSerial;
        }
        m_failures.push_back(std::move(failure));
        PublishFailures();
    }

    void FileOpener::NoteSuccess(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        const std::size_t erased = std::erase_if(m_failures, [&](const OpenFailure& f) { return SamePath(f.path, path); });
        if (m_offer && SamePath(m_offer->path, path))
            m_offer.reset();
        if (erased > 0)
            PublishFailures();
    }

    void FileOpener::PublishFailures() const
    {
        std::vector<Arcane::Diagnostic> rows;
        rows.reserve(m_failures.size());
        for (const OpenFailure& f : m_failures)
        {
            Arcane::Diagnostic d;
            d.severity = Arcane::DiagSeverity::Warning;
            d.scope    = Arcane::DiagScope::Project;
            d.code     = "files.open.failed";
            d.message  = "Could not open " + PathUtf8(f.path.filename()) + " with " + f.openerName + ": " + f.error;
            d.detail   = f.offerArcaneText
                ? "The Arcane Text Editor can open it instead (right-click this row: Open With). "
                  "Change the default in Preferences > Editor > Files > Open With."
                : "Change the opener in Preferences > Editor > Files > Open With, or right-click this row: Open With.";
            d.locator  = Arcane::DiagLocator::File(PathUtf8(f.path), f.at ? static_cast<int>(f.at->line) : 0,
                                                   f.at ? static_cast<int>(f.at->column) : 0);
            rows.push_back(std::move(d));
        }
        Arcane::Diagnostics::Publish(kFailuresKey, rows);
    }

    void FileOpener::PublishConfig(std::vector<std::string> problems)
    {
        if (problems == m_configPublished)
            return;
        std::vector<Arcane::Diagnostic> rows;
        rows.reserve(problems.size());
        for (const std::string& p : problems)
        {
            Arcane::Diagnostic d;
            d.severity = Arcane::DiagSeverity::Warning;
            d.scope    = Arcane::DiagScope::Project;
            d.code     = "files.openWith.invalid";
            d.message  = p;
            d.detail   = "Fix it on Preferences > Editor > Files > Open With.";
            rows.push_back(std::move(d));
        }
        Arcane::Diagnostics::Publish(kConfigKey, rows);
        m_configPublished = std::move(problems);
    }
}
```

The five backends:

| Opener | Backend |
|---|---|
| Arcane Text Editor | `EditorApp::OpenAsText(path)` (TE6-12: focuses the canonical tab or opens one; a dedicated-editor asset opens locked), then `DocumentHost::Focus`, then `TextDocument::GoTo(ToBufferPoint(...))` when there is a position. It never goes through `DocumentHost::OpenPath`, whose extension factories would open a material's dedicated editor instead. |
| Dedicated | `DocumentHost::OpenPath(path)` |
| Visual Studio | `EditorApp::OpenInIde(path, line, column)`: solution discovery or generation, the Console line, then `IdeLaunch::OpenFileAt` |
| System default | `OsShell::ShellOpen(path)`. An extension with no association fails here with "No program is associated with this file type" and gets the Problems row; it does not fall back to the Open With picker, which `OsShell::OpenAsText` would. |
| Custom | `LaunchCustomEditor(editor, {file, line, col, project root, DiscoverSolution(root)})` |

**The crash viewer's `[file:line]` link** (`OpenSourceAtLine`) now asks `FileOpener` too: a `.cpp` reaches Visual Studio by the default opener. Its old silent `ShellOpen` fallback on NoDevenv/NoSolution/DetectionFailed is replaced by the spec's rule: the Problems row plus the offer.

**TE2's interim C++ exclusion is removed** (CANON B5, C TE7 #3). TE2 never built a C++ route; its fallback claims predicate kept `!IsCppSourcePath(p)` only until this task. The skeleton's "never opens .cpp" constraint is superseded by D15. A `.cpp` reaching the text routes, which only `FileOpener`'s Arcane backend or a FileOpener-resolved dedicated open can do, opens a `TextDocument`. TE2-20's `[text-doc]` case that pinned the refusal inverts; nothing else of TE2's is deleted.

**"Has a dedicated editor" is not `HasFactory`.** After TE2-20, `DocumentHost::HasFactory` is true for every text file: the explicit text extensions have the text factory, and the fallback claims everything else that is not a known binary format (and, once the exclusion goes, C/C++). Read as `FileFacts::hasDedicatedEditor`, it would put every text file in the `asset` group, so `source=visualStudio` and `text=...` would never apply and a `.cpp` would open as text by default. The wiring asks TE2-19's `HasDedicatedFactory` instead, and the test below pins it over the real routes.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("Wiring: IDE, shell and launch outcomes map to OpenOutcome words", "[text-openers]")
{
    CHECK(OutcomeFromIde(IdeLaunch::Outcome::OpenedInInstance).ok);
    CHECK(OutcomeFromIde(IdeLaunch::Outcome::Launched).ok);
    CHECK(OutcomeFromIde(IdeLaunch::Outcome::Activated).ok);
    const OpenOutcome noVs = OutcomeFromIde(IdeLaunch::Outcome::NoDevenv);
    CHECK_FALSE(noVs.ok);
    CHECK(noVs.error == IdeLaunch::Describe(IdeLaunch::Outcome::NoDevenv));
    CHECK_FALSE(OutcomeFromIde(IdeLaunch::Outcome::Blocked).ok);   // busy: a row, not silence
    CHECK(OutcomeFromShell(OsShell::ShellResult::Ok).ok);
    const OpenOutcome noAssoc = OutcomeFromShell(OsShell::ShellResult::NoHandler);
    CHECK_FALSE(noAssoc.ok);
    CHECK(noAssoc.error == "No program is associated with this file type");

    missing.error = LaunchError::ProgramNotFound;

    CHECK(OutcomeFromLaunch(missing).error == missing.message);

TEST_CASE("Wiring: ToBufferPoint turns a 1-based character position into row and byte column, clamped", "[text-openers]")
{
    const Arcane::Text::Rope text = Arcane::Text::Rope::FromUtf8("ab\ncaf\xC3\xA9 x\n");
    CHECK(ToBufferPoint(text, FilePosition{ 1, 1 }).row == 0u);
    const Arcane::Text::Point p = ToBufferPoint(text, FilePosition{ 2, 5 });   // after "caf" + U+00E9
    CHECK(p.row == 1u);
    CHECK(p.col == 5u);
    CHECK(ToBufferPoint(text, FilePosition{ 2, 99 }).col == 7u);            // clamped to the line's 7 bytes
    const Arcane::Text::Point last = ToBufferPoint(text, FilePosition{ 9, 3 });
    CHECK(last.row == 2u);                                                  // clamped to the last (empty) row
    CHECK(last.col == 0u);
}

TEST_CASE("Wiring: the Arcane backend opens a TextDocument through openAsText, even for a .cpp", "[text-openers]")
{
    Arcane::Test::TempDir dir("openers_wiring");
    const fs::path cpp = dir.path / "Game.cpp";
    { std::ofstream(cpp, std::ios::binary) << "int main()\n{\n    return 0;\n}\n"; }
    DocumentHost host;
    OpenerHost oh;
    oh.documents = &host;
    oh.openAsText = [&host](const fs::path& p) -> EditorDocument* {
        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(p, {}, error);
        INFO(error);
        return doc ? host.Add(std::move(doc)) : nullptr;
    };
    oh.openInIde = [](const fs::path&, int, int) { return IdeLaunch::Outcome::NoDevenv; };
    const FileOpenerBackends b = MakeFileOpenerBackends(std::move(oh));

    CHECK_FALSE(b.isOpenInTextDocument(cpp));
    CHECK_FALSE(b.hasDedicatedEditor(cpp));
    CHECK(b.isText(cpp));                                    // TE2's sniff: no NUL in the first 8 KB
    const OpenOutcome vs = b.openVisualStudio(cpp, FilePosition{ 3, 5 });
    CHECK_FALSE(vs.ok);
    const OpenOutcome text = b.openArcaneText(cpp, FilePosition{ 3, 5 });
    REQUIRE(text.ok);
    auto* doc = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(text.document);
    REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
    CHECK(fs::equivalent(doc->CanonicalPath(), cpp));
    CHECK(b.isOpenInTextDocument(cpp));
    // Any spelling of the path finds the open tab (the host's key is CanonicalFilePath).
    std::wstring upper = cpp.wstring();
    for (wchar_t& c : upper)
        c = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towupper(c));
    CHECK(b.isOpenInTextDocument(fs::path(upper)));
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/FileOpenerWiring.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// FileOpener's five backends over the editor's real machinery (text editor
// spec s5.6). The app fills an OpenerHost with its own entry points
// (EditorAppOpeners.cpp); tests fill it with a bare DocumentHost and fakes.
// With EditorAppOpeners.cpp, this is the only code that reaches
// DocumentHost::OpenPath, IdeLaunch file opens or OsShell::ShellOpen for an
// OPEN (OpenersGuardTest).

#include "Project/IdeLaunch.hpp"
#include "Project/OsShell.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/FileOpener.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/ProgramLaunch.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>

namespace Arcane::Editor { class DocumentHost; class EditorDocument; }

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    struct OpenerHost
    {
        DocumentHost* documents = nullptr;
        // Focus the file's text tab or open one (EditorApp::OpenAsText, TE6-12).
        std::function<EditorDocument*(const std::filesystem::path&)> openAsText;
        // EditorApp::OpenInIde(file, line, column): solution discovery + IdeLaunch::OpenFileAt.
        std::function<IdeLaunch::Outcome(const std::filesystem::path&, int, int)> openInIde;
        std::function<OsShell::ShellResult(const std::filesystem::path&)> shellOpen;            // default: OsShell::ShellOpen
        std::function<LaunchResult(const CustomEditor&, const TemplateContext&)> launch;        // default: LaunchCustomEditor
        std::function<std::filesystem::path()> projectRoot;                                    // {project}; empty = none
        std::function<std::filesystem::path()> solution;                                       // {solution}; empty = none
        std::function<bool(const std::filesystem::path&)> isText;                              // default: SniffsAsText
    };

    [[nodiscard]] FileOpenerBackends MakeFileOpenerBackends(OpenerHost host);

    [[nodiscard]] OpenOutcome OutcomeFromIde(IdeLaunch::Outcome outcome);       // Activated/OpenedInInstance/Launched = ok
    [[nodiscard]] OpenOutcome OutcomeFromShell(OsShell::ShellResult result);    // Ok = ok; else OsShell::Describe
    [[nodiscard]] OpenOutcome OutcomeFromLaunch(const LaunchResult& result);    // Ok = ok; else its message

    // 1-based line / character column -> 0-based row / byte column, clamped
    // to the buffer (row) and the line (column).
    [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::Point ToBufferPoint(const Arcane::Text::Rope& text, FilePosition at);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/FileOpenerWiring.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/FileOpenerWiring.hpp"

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"                  // Utf8::DecodeAt (TE1-1)
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"      // TextDocument, GoTo (TE2-15/19)
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"        // CanonicalFilePath (TE2-5): the host's key
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSniff.hpp"         // SniffsAsText (TE2-15)

#include <algorithm>
#include <memory>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    OpenOutcome OutcomeFromIde(IdeLaunch::Outcome outcome)
    {
        switch (outcome)
        {
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::Activated:
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::OpenedInInstance:
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::Launched:
                return OpenOutcome{ true, {}, nullptr };
            default:
                return OpenOutcome{ false, IdeLaunch::Describe(outcome), nullptr };
        }
    }

    OpenOutcome OutcomeFromShell(OsShell::ShellResult result)
    {
        if (result == OsShell::ShellResult::Ok)
            return OpenOutcome{ true, {}, nullptr };
        return OpenOutcome{ false, std::string(OsShell::Describe(result)), nullptr };
    }

    OpenOutcome OutcomeFromLaunch(const LaunchResult& result)
    {
        if (result.Ok())
            return OpenOutcome{ true, {}, nullptr };
        return OpenOutcome{ false, result.message, nullptr };
    }

    Arcane::Text::Point ToBufferPoint(const Arcane::Text::Rope& text, FilePosition at)
    {
        const std::uint32_t rows = text.LineCount();
        const std::uint32_t wanted = at.line == 0 ? 0u : at.line - 1;
        const std::uint32_t row = std::min(wanted, rows == 0 ? 0u : rows - 1);
        std::string line;
        text.CopyTo(Arcane::Text::ByteRange{ text.LineStart(row), text.LineEnd(row) }, line);
        std::size_t byte = 0;
        for (std::uint32_t c = 1; c < at.column && byte < line.size(); ++c)
            byte += std::max<std::size_t>(1, Arcane::Text::Utf8::DecodeAt(line, byte).length);
        return Arcane::Text::Point{ row, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min(byte, line.size())) };
    }

    FileOpenerBackends MakeFileOpenerBackends(OpenerHost host)
    {
        const auto h = std::make_shared<OpenerHost>(std::move(host));
        FileOpenerBackends b;
        b.isOpenInTextDocument = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p) {
            if (!h->documents)
                return false;
            // The host keys text documents by CanonicalFilePath (TE2-19/20), so
            // any spelling of an open file finds its tab.
            const std::optional<std::filesystem::path> key = CanonicalFilePath(p);
            return dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(h->documents->FindByCanonicalPath(key ? *key : p)) != nullptr;
        };
        // A DEDICATED editor only: HasFactory is also true for every text file
        // (the text routes), which would put them all in the asset group.
        b.hasDedicatedEditor = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return h->documents && h->documents->HasDedicatedFactory(p); };
        b.isText = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return h->isText ? h->isText(p) : SniffsAsText(p); };
        b.openArcaneText = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p, std::optional<FilePosition> at) -> OpenOutcome {
            EditorDocument* doc = h->openAsText ? h->openAsText(p) : nullptr;
            if (!doc)
                return OpenOutcome{ false, "the Arcane Text Editor could not open it (see the Console)", nullptr };
            if (h->documents)
                h->documents->Focus(doc);
            if (at)
                if (auto* t = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(doc))
                    t->GoTo(ToBufferPoint(t->Buffer().Text(), *at));
            return OpenOutcome{ true, {}, doc };
        };
        b.openDedicated = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p) -> OpenOutcome {
            EditorDocument* doc = h->documents ? h->documents->OpenPath(p) : nullptr;
            if (!doc)
                return OpenOutcome{ false, "its Arcane editor could not open it (see the Console)", nullptr };
            return OpenOutcome{ true, {}, doc };
        };
        b.openVisualStudio = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p, std::optional<FilePosition> at) -> OpenOutcome {
            if (!h->openInIde)
                return OpenOutcome{ false, "this host has no Visual Studio opener", nullptr };
            return OutcomeFromIde(h->openInIde(p, at ? static_cast<int>(at->line) : 0, at ? static_cast<int>(at->column) : 0));
        };
        b.openSystemDefault = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p) {
            return OutcomeFromShell(h->shellOpen ? h->shellOpen(p) : OsShell::ShellOpen(p));
        };
        b.openCustom = [h](const CustomEditor& e, const std::filesystem::path& p, std::optional<FilePosition> at) {
            TemplateContext c;
            c.file = p;
            c.line = at ? at->line : 1;
            c.column = at ? at->column : 1;
            c.project = h->projectRoot ? h->projectRoot() : std::filesystem::path{};
            c.solution = h->solution ? h->solution() : std::filesystem::path{};
            return OutcomeFromLaunch(h->launch ? h->launch(e, c) : LaunchCustomEditor(e, c));
        };
        return b;
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// "Open in Arcane Text Editor instead" (text editor spec s5.6 "Rules"): a
// small non-modal popup raised once per offer FileOpener arms (an external
// opener failed on a text file). The Problems row stays either way; this is
// the one-click way out. Drawn by the app every frame, outside any window.

#include <cstdint>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    class FileOpener;

    inline constexpr const char* kOpenFailurePromptId = "Could not open file##files_open_failed";

    struct OpenFailurePromptState
    {
        std::uint64_t shownSerial = 0;   // the FileOpener::OfferSerial last raised
    };

    void DrawOpenFailurePrompt(FileOpener& files, OpenFailurePromptState& state);
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/OpenFailurePrompt.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/OpenFailurePrompt.hpp"

#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"   // PathUtf8
#include "Project/Openers/FileOpener.hpp"

#include <imgui.h>

#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    void DrawOpenFailurePrompt(FileOpener& files, OpenFailurePromptState& state)
    {
        if (files.PendingOffer() && files.OfferSerial() != state.shownSerial)
        {
            state.shownSerial = files.OfferSerial();
            ImGui::OpenPopup(kOpenFailurePromptId);
        }
        if (!ImGui::BeginPopup(kOpenFailurePromptId))
            return;
        const std::optional<OpenFailure>& offer = files.PendingOffer();
        if (!offer)
        {
            ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
            ImGui::EndPopup();
            return;
        }
        const std::string headline = "Could not open " + PathUtf8(offer->path.filename()) + " with " + offer->openerName + ".";
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(headline.c_str());
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", offer->error.c_str());
        ImGui::Separator();
        if (ImGui::Button("Open in Arcane Text Editor instead"))
        {
            (void)files.AcceptOffer();
            ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button("Dismiss"))
        {
            files.DismissOffer();
            ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        }
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    }
}
```
