```cpp
// Who opens what (text editor spec s5.6, D15) -- EditorApp's half of
// FileOpener: the backends over live app state (InstallFileOpener), Visual
// Studio (OpenInIde, moved here from EditorAppProject.cpp) and the crash
// viewer's [file:line] link. With FileOpenerWiring.cpp this is the only file
// that reaches IdeLaunch / OsShell::ShellOpen / EditorApp::OpenAsText for an
// OPEN; OpenersGuardTest enforces it.

#include "App/EditorApp.hpp"

#include "Project/IdeLaunch.hpp"
#include "Project/OsShell.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/FileOpenerWiring.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/ProgramLaunch.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Base/Log.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Build/Toolchain.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Project/Project.hpp>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    void EditorApp::InstallFileOpener()
    {
        Openers::OpenerHost host;
        host.documents   = &m_documents;
        host.openAsText  = [this](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return OpenAsText(p); };   // TE6-12: the tab, or a new one (locked for dedicated-editor assets)
        host.openInIde   = [this](const std::filesystem::path& p, int line, int column) { return OpenInIde(p, line, column); };
        host.shellOpen   = [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return OsShell::ShellOpen(p); };
        host.launch      = [](const Openers::CustomEditor& e, const Openers::TemplateContext& c) { return Openers::LaunchCustomEditor(e, c); };
        host.projectRoot = [this] {
            const Arcane::Project* p = m_runtime ? m_runtime->CurrentProject() : nullptr;
            return p ? p->Root() : std::filesystem::path{};
        };
        host.solution = [this] {
            const Arcane::Project* p = m_runtime ? m_runtime->CurrentProject() : nullptr;
            return p ? Arcane::Toolchain::DiscoverSolution(p->Root()) : std::filesystem::path{};
        };
        m_files = std::make_unique<Openers::FileOpener>(Openers::MakeFileOpenerBackends(std::move(host)));
    }

    Openers::FileOpener& EditorApp::Files()
    {
        return *m_files;
    }

    // ---- moved verbatim from EditorAppProject.cpp:2967-3013, plus the column ----
    IdeLaunch::Outcome EditorApp::OpenInIde(const std::filesystem::path& file, int line, int column)
    {
        const Arcane::Project* proj = m_runtime->CurrentProject();
        if (!proj)
        {
            ARC_ERROR("IDE: no open project -- nothing to open");
            return IdeLaunch::Outcome::NoSolution;
        }
        RefreshDevenv();

        // The solution to hand devenv, or to find in a running instance. A
        // project that has never been generated has none yet: run premake
        // alone (RegenerateSolution) and look again.
        std::filesystem::path solution = Arcane::Toolchain::DiscoverSolution(proj->Root());
        if (solution.empty())
        {
            ARC_INFO("IDE: no solution in {} yet -- generating (arcbuild generate)", proj->Root().generic_string());
            RegenerateSolution();
            solution = Arcane::Toolchain::DiscoverSolution(proj->Root());
        }

        const IdeLaunch::Outcome outcome = file.empty()
            ? IdeLaunch::OpenSolution(m_devenv.Path(), solution)
            : IdeLaunch::OpenFileAt(m_devenv.Path(), solution, file, line, column);

        // One Console line per click, its severity by whether the click did
        // what it asked: the three "it worked" outcomes are info, the
        // transient one (Blocked) a warning, everything else an error.
        const std::string what = file.empty()
            ? solution.filename().string()
            : file.filename().string() + (line > 0 ? ":" + std::to_string(line) : std::string())
                                       + (line > 0 && column > 0 ? ":" + std::to_string(column) : std::string());
        switch (outcome)
        {
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::Activated:
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::OpenedInInstance:
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::Launched:
                ARC_INFO("IDE: {} -- {}", what, IdeLaunch::Describe(outcome));
                break;
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::Blocked:
                ARC_WARN("IDE: {} -- {}", what, IdeLaunch::Describe(outcome));
                break;
            default:
                ARC_ERROR("IDE: {} -- {}", what, IdeLaunch::Describe(outcome));
                break;
        }
        return outcome;
    }

    void EditorApp::OpenSourceAtLine(const std::filesystem::path& file, int line)
    {
        // The crash viewer's [file:line] link (node-page phase s8.1): the
        // file's opener decides -- a .cpp reaches Visual Studio by default. A
        // failure is the files:open Problems row + the offer (spec s5.6),
        // never the old silent shell fallback.
        (void)m_files->Open(file, Openers::PositionFrom(line, 0));
    }
}
```

```cpp
// THE RULE (text editor spec s5.6, D15): every file open in the editor goes
// through Openers::FileOpener. This guard fails when editor code opens a
// file any other way -- an IdeLaunch file open, a file-opening OpenInIde,
// OsShell::ShellOpen / OpenAsText, ShellExecute, DocumentHost::OpenPath /
// OpenAt, EditorApp::OpenAsText -- outside the opener's own implementation
// files. It also fails any registry WRITE or file-association change: preset
// detection reads the registry, nothing in the editor changes it. Comments
// are exempt. [openers-guard]

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Helpers/ReferenceProjectDir.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <regex>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace
{
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;

    struct Rule
    {
        const char* what;
        std::regex pattern;
        std::vector<std::string> allowed;   // repo-relative, '/' separators
    };

    const std::vector<Rule>& Rules()
    {
        static const std::vector<Rule> rules = {
            { "IdeLaunch file open", std::regex(R"rx(IdeLaunch::Open(File|FileAtLine|FileAt)\s*\()rx"),
              { "ArcaneEditor/src/Project/IdeLaunch.cpp", "ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorAppOpeners.cpp" } },
            { "OpenInIde with a file", std::regex(R"rx((^|[^\w:])OpenInIde\s*\((?!\s*\{\s*\}\s*\)))rx"),
              { "ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorApp.hpp", "ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorAppOpeners.cpp" } },
            { "OS shell open", std::regex(R"rx(OsShell::(ShellOpen|OpenAsText)\s*\()rx"),
              { "ArcaneEditor/src/Project/OsShell.cpp", "ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/FileOpenerWiring.cpp",
                "ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorAppOpeners.cpp" } },
            { "ShellExecute", std::regex(R"rx(\bShellExecute(Ex)?[AW]?\s*\()rx"),
              { "ArcaneEditor/src/Project/OsShell.cpp" } },
            { "DocumentHost::OpenPath", std::regex(R"rx((\.|->)OpenPath\s*\()rx"),
              { "ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/DocumentHost.cpp", "ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/FileOpenerWiring.cpp" } },
            { "DocumentHost::OpenAt", std::regex(R"rx((\.|->)OpenAt\s*\()rx"),
              { "ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/DocumentHost.cpp", "ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/FileOpenerWiring.cpp" } },
            { "EditorApp::OpenAsText", std::regex(R"rx((^|[^\w:])OpenAsText\s*\()rx"),
              { "ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorApp.hpp", "ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorAppOpeners.cpp",
                "ArcaneEditor/src/Project/OsShell.hpp", "ArcaneEditor/src/Project/OsShell.cpp" } },
            { "registry write / file association change",
              std::regex(R"rx(\b(RegSetValue(Ex)?[AW]?|RegSetKeyValue[AW]?|RegCreateKey(Ex)?[AW]?|RegDeleteKey(Ex)?[AW]?|RegDeleteValue[AW]?|SHSetValue[AW]?|AssocCreate|SHChangeNotify)\s*\()rx"),
              {} },
        };
        return rules;
    }

    // TE7-10 -> TE7-11: the app-side open sites TE7-11 re-routes. TE7-11 deletes this list.
    const std::vector<std::string> kPendingTE7_11 = {
        "ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorApp.cpp",
        "ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorAppFrame.cpp",
        "ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorAppProject.cpp",
        "ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/CrashReportDocument.cpp",
    };

    // Drop a // comment outside a string literal, and track /* */ blocks
    // (PathsGuardTest.cpp:36-58's scanner, file-local there).
    std::string StripComments(const std::string& line, bool& inBlock)
    {
        std::string out;
        bool inString = false;
        char quote = 0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < line.size(); ++i)
        {
            const char c = line[i];
            const char next = i + 1 < line.size() ? line[i + 1] : '\0';
            if (inBlock) { if (c == '*' && next == '/') { inBlock = false; ++i; } continue; }
            if (inString)
            {
                out += c;
                if (c == '\\' && next) { out += next; ++i; }
                else if (c == quote) inString = false;
                continue;
            }
            if (c == '"' || c == '\'') { inString = true; quote = c; out += c; continue; }
            if (c == '/' && next == '/') break;
            if (c == '/' && next == '*') { inBlock = true; ++i; continue; }
            out += c;
        }
        return out;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Openers guard: no editor code opens a file except through FileOpener", "[openers-guard]")
{
    const fs::path repo = Arcane::Test::FindReferenceProjectDir().parent_path();
    REQUIRE_FALSE(repo.empty());
    const fs::path root = repo / "ArcaneEditor" / "src";
    REQUIRE(fs::is_directory(root));
    std::vector<std::string> hits;
    std::size_t scanned = 0;
    for (const auto& entry : fs::recursive_directory_iterator(root))
    {
        if (!entry.is_regular_file())
            continue;
        const std::string ext = entry.path().extension().string();
        if (ext != ".cpp" && ext != ".hpp" && ext != ".h")
            continue;
        const std::string rel = fs::relative(entry.path(), repo).generic_string();
        if (std::find(kPendingTE7_11.begin(), kPendingTE7_11.end(), rel) != kPendingTE7_11.end())
            continue;
        ++scanned;
        std::ifstream in(entry.path());
        bool inBlock = false;
        int lineNo = 0;
        for (std::string line; std::getline(in, line);)
        {
            ++lineNo;
            const std::string code = StripComments(line, inBlock);
            for (const Rule& r : Rules())
                if (std::regex_search(code, r.pattern) &&
                    std::find(r.allowed.begin(), r.allowed.end(), rel) == r.allowed.end())
                    hits.push_back(rel + ":" + std::to_string(lineNo) + "  [" + r.what + "]  " + line);
        }
    }
    CHECK(scanned > 100);   // the walk really ran over the editor
    std::string report;
    for (const std::string& h : hits)
        report += "  " + h + "\n";
    INFO("open paths that bypass Openers::FileOpener (text editor spec s5.6):\n" << report);
    CHECK(hits.empty());
}
```

```cpp
    // Resolve + route a double-click / Enter-open. A scene is not a file
    // open (it replaces the editing session), so its path comes back in
    // `actions.openScene` for the host to load under the unsaved-changes
    // guard; every other kind comes back in `actions.openFile` and the host
    // opens it through FileOpener (text editor spec s5.6) -- never here,
    // mid-draw. `docs` is no longer used to open; it stays in the signature
    // the four panel call sites share.
    void OpenAssetRow(const AssetPanelEntry& e, const Arcane::Project* project,
                      DocumentHost& docs, AssetPanelActions& actions)
    {
        (void)docs;
        if (!project)
            return;
        const auto path = project->ResolveAsset(Arcane::AssetId::FromGuid(e.guid));
        if (path)
        {
            if (e.kind == AssetKind::Scene)
                actions.openScene = *path;
            else
                actions.openFile = *path;
        }
        else
            ARC_WARN("Assets: '{}' did not resolve to a file", e.mountPath);
    }
```

Behaviour that changes on purpose (spec s5.6):
- A Problems `file:line` row opens with the file's opener **at its line and column**. A `.cpp` row goes to Visual Studio by default (as TE2-20's interim `OpenSourceAtLine` did, now through the user's choice). Text goes to the Arcane Text Editor at the line and column (TE2-20 dropped the column).
- "Open as text" on an asset (Asset Browser row menu, Assets menu, Inspector page) opens the Arcane Text Editor (TE6-12's locked tab for a dedicated-editor asset) instead of the OS editor; a Problems open-as-text row opens with the file's opener.
- `--open-path` opens with the file's opener (a `.md` in an Arcane tab; a `.cpp` in Visual Studio by default) at its line and column.
- A crash report's "Open .txt / .log / .symbolized.txt" opens in the Arcane Text Editor by default, and "Open .dmp" with the system default (binary).
- A Problems asset row, a created asset and a dedicated asset open honour the user's opener. A graph-node row asks for the dedicated editor explicitly: only it can show the node.

```cpp
    Arcane::Editor::EditorDocument* EditorApp::OpenAssetDocument(const Arcane::Guid& guid,
                                                                 std::optional<Arcane::Editor::Openers::OpenerId> opener)
    {
        if (!guid.IsValid())
            return nullptr;
        const Arcane::Project* project = m_runtime ? m_runtime->CurrentProject() : nullptr;
        if (!project)
            return nullptr;
        const auto path = project->ResolveAsset(Arcane::AssetId::FromGuid(guid));
        if (!path)
            return nullptr;
        const Arcane::Editor::Openers::OpenResult r = opener ? m_files->OpenWith(*path, *opener) : m_files->Open(*path);
        return r.document;
    }
```

The menu lists, in order:
- **Arcane editor**, when the file has one;
- **Arcane Text Editor**, **Visual Studio**, **System default**;
- each custom program by name. The current default for the file is suffixed "(default)";
- **Choose...** -- an OS picker for a program, launched once;
- **Always use this for `.ext`** -- a checkbox that stays open when clicked and writes `editor.files.openWith` with the pick. With Choose... it also adds the program to `editor.files.customEditors`; an entry with the same exe is reused.

The menu only *reports* the pick. The app performs it (`ApplyOpenWithChoice`), the same "panel reports, app performs" split every panel action uses.

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/OpenWithMenu.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// The Open With submenu body (text editor spec s5.6), shared by every file
// context menu: Asset Browser rows, the Inspector asset page, Problems rows
// and document tabs. BuildOpenWithMenu is pure (what the menu lists, which
// opener is the file's current default); DrawOpenWithItems draws it inside
// the caller's BeginMenu / BeginPopup and REPORTS the pick -- the app
// performs it (EditorApp::ApplyOpenWithChoice), like every panel action.

#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    struct OpenWithItem
    {
        OpenerId    opener;
        std::string label;
        bool        isDefault = false;   // what a plain open would use for this file
    };

    struct OpenWithMenuModel
    {
        std::string extension;             // ".cpp"; empty = no "Always use this" row
        std::vector<OpenWithItem> items;
    };

    struct OpenWithChoice
    {
        enum class Kind : std::uint8_t { None, Opener, Choose };
        Kind     kind = Kind::None;
        OpenerId opener;                   // Kind::Opener
        bool     always = false;           // "Always use this for .ext" was ticked
    };

    [[nodiscard]] OpenWithMenuModel BuildOpenWithMenu(const std::filesystem::path& path, bool hasDedicatedEditor,
                                                      std::string_view openWith, std::string_view customEditorsJson);
    // The live editor.files.* values.
    [[nodiscard]] OpenWithMenuModel BuildOpenWithMenu(const std::filesystem::path& path, bool hasDedicatedEditor);

    // Inside the caller's open menu/popup. The "Always" tick lives in the
    // popup window's ImGui storage and resets after a pick.
    [[nodiscard]] OpenWithChoice DrawOpenWithItems(const OpenWithMenuModel& model);

    // Open With > Choose...: the picked program as a custom editor. An entry
    // with the same exe (any case) is reused; otherwise a new id is minted
    // from the exe's stem and the args are the quoted file.
    struct ChosenProgram
    {
        CustomEditor editor;
        bool isNew = false;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] ChosenProgram PlanChosenProgram(const std::filesystem::path& exe, std::span<const CustomEditor> existing);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/OpenWithMenu.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/OpenWithMenu.hpp"

#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"   // PathUtf8, Utf8ToWide
#include "Settings/FileOpenerSettings.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <imgui.h>

#include <cwctype>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    namespace
    {
        std::wstring LowerNormal(const std::filesystem::path& p)
        {
            std::wstring s = p.lexically_normal().wstring();
            for (wchar_t& c : s)
                c = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(static_cast<wint_t>(c)));
            return s;
        }
    }

    OpenWithMenuModel BuildOpenWithMenu(const std::filesystem::path& path, bool hasDedicatedEditor,
                                        std::string_view openWith, std::string_view customEditorsJson)
    {
        OpenWithMenuModel m;
        m.extension = ExtensionOf(path);
        const std::vector<CustomEditor> customs = ParseCustomEditors(customEditorsJson).editors;
        const std::vector<OpenWithEntry> map = ParseOpenWith(openWith);
        const std::vector<std::string> ids = CustomEditorIds(customs);
        const OpenerId current = ResolveOpener(path, FileFacts{ false, hasDedicatedEditor, true }, map, ids).opener;

        const auto add = [&](OpenerId id, std::string label) {
            const bool isDefault = id == current;
            m.items.push_back(OpenWithItem{ std::move(id), std::move(label), isDefault });
        };
        if (hasDedicatedEditor)
            add(OpenerId::Dedicated(), std::string(OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind::Dedicated)));
        add(OpenerId::ArcaneText(), std::string(OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind::ArcaneText)));
        add(OpenerId::VisualStudio(), std::string(OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind::VisualStudio)));
        add(OpenerId::SystemDefault(), std::string(OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind::SystemDefault)));
        for (const CustomEditor& e : customs)
            add(OpenerId::Custom(e.id), e.name);
        return m;
    }

    OpenWithMenuModel BuildOpenWithMenu(const std::filesystem::path& path, bool hasDedicatedEditor)
    {
        const FileOpenerSettings& s = Arcane::Settings<FileOpenerSettings>();
        return BuildOpenWithMenu(path, hasDedicatedEditor, s.openWith, s.customEditors);
    }

    OpenWithChoice DrawOpenWithItems(const OpenWithMenuModel& model)
    {
        OpenWithChoice choice;
        ImGuiStorage* storage = ImGui::GetStateStorage();
        const ImGuiID alwaysId = ImGui::GetID("##openwith_always");
        bool always = storage->GetBool(alwaysId, false);

        for (const OpenWithItem& item : model.items)
        {
            const std::string label = item.isDefault ? item.label + " (default)" : item.label;
            if (ImGui::MenuItem(label.c_str()))
            {
                choice.kind = OpenWithChoice::Kind::Opener;
                choice.opener = item.opener;
            }
        }
        ImGui::Separator();
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("Choose..."))
            choice.kind = OpenWithChoice::Kind::Choose;
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("Pick a program for this file. Tick \"Always use this\" first to keep it as a custom program.");
        if (!model.extension.empty())
        {
            ImGui::Separator();
            ImGui::PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_AutoClosePopups, false);   // ticking keeps the menu open
            const std::string alwaysLabel = "Always use this for " + model.extension;
            if (ImGui::MenuItem(alwaysLabel.c_str(), nullptr, always))
            {
                always = !always;
                storage->SetBool(alwaysId, always);
            }
            ImGui::PopItemFlag();
        }
        choice.always = always && !model.extension.empty();
        if (choice.kind != OpenWithChoice::Kind::None)
            storage->SetBool(alwaysId, false);   // the tick belongs to one pick
        return choice;
    }

    ChosenProgram PlanChosenProgram(const std::filesystem::path& exe, std::span<const CustomEditor> existing)
    {
        const std::wstring key = LowerNormal(exe);
        for (const CustomEditor& e : existing)
            if (LowerNormal(std::filesystem::path(Utf8ToWide(e.exe))) == key)
                return ChosenProgram{ e, false };
        const std::string stem = PathUtf8(exe.stem());
        CustomEditor editor{ MintCustomEditorId(stem, existing), stem, PathUtf8(exe), "\"{file}\"" };
        return ChosenProgram{ std::move(editor), true };
    }
}
```

```cpp
    void EditorApp::ApplyOpenWithChoice(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::optional<Openers::FilePosition> at,
                                        const Openers::OpenWithChoice& choice)
    {
        using Kind = Openers::OpenWithChoice::Kind;
        const std::string ext = Openers::ExtensionOf(path);
        if (choice.kind == Kind::Opener)
        {
            if (choice.always && ext.size() > 1 && !SetOpenerFor(ext, choice.opener))
                ARC_WARN("Open With: could not save {} as the opener for {} files", Openers::FormatOpenerId(choice.opener), ext);
            (void)m_files->OpenWith(path, choice.opener, at);
        }
        else if (choice.kind == Kind::Choose)
        {
            m_openWithChoose = PendingChoose{ path, at, choice.always };
            if (m_gpu)
                m_gpu->Win().ShowOpenFileDialog(&PathPickedThunk,
                    new PathDialogRequest{ &m_dialogs.openWithProgram, m_dialogs.openWithProgram.Arm() }, "Programs", "exe");
        }
    }

    void EditorApp::ConsumeOpenWithProgramPick()
    {
        const std::optional<std::string> exe = m_dialogs.openWithProgram.Take();
        if (!exe || !m_openWithChoose)
            return;
        const PendingChoose pending = *m_openWithChoose;
        m_openWithChoose.reset();
        const std::vector<Openers::CustomEditor> customs = CurrentCustomEditors();
        const Openers::ChosenProgram chosen =
            Openers::PlanChosenProgram(std::filesystem::path(Openers::Utf8ToWide(*exe)), customs);
        if (!pending.always)
        {
            (void)m_files->OpenWithProgram(chosen.editor, pending.path, pending.at);
            return;
        }
        std::vector<Openers::CustomEditor> next = customs;
        if (chosen.isNew)
            next.push_back(chosen.editor);
        const std::string ext = Openers::ExtensionOf(pending.path);
        if (!SetCustomEditors(next) || (ext.size() > 1 && !SetOpenerFor(ext, Openers::OpenerId::Custom(chosen.editor.id))))
            ARC_WARN("Open With: could not save {} as the opener for {} files", chosen.editor.name, ext);
        (void)m_files->OpenWith(pending.path, Openers::OpenerId::Custom(chosen.editor.id), pending.at);
    }
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ImGui::FindWindowByName`, `ImGuiWindow::DockIsActive`, `DockTabIsVisible`, `DC.DockTabItemRect`, `TitleBarRect()` (`imgui_internal.h`, ImGui 1.92.9; `imgui.cpp:5182-5186` sets `DC.DockTabItemRect` for a docked window's tab); TE7-12 (`BuildOpenWithMenu`, `DrawOpenWithItems`, `ApplyOpenWithChoice`); TE2 `TextDocument::CanonicalPath()`.
- Produces:
  - `virtual std::string EditorDocument::WindowName() const` (default `Title()`): the exact name passed to `ImGui::Begin`
  - `void DocumentHost::SetTabMenu(std::function<void(EditorDocument&, const std::filesystem::path&)>)`
  - `std::filesystem::path DocumentHost::PathOf(const EditorDocument&) const`: the file the document was opened from through `OpenPath`, kept across `NoteAssetMoved`; empty when unknown, e.g. a `TextDocument` added by `OpenAsTextFlow`, whose `CanonicalPath()` the app uses instead

Every document draws its own `ImGui::Begin`, so the host cannot put a context menu between Begin and the content. After each document's `Draw`, `DocumentHost::DrawAll` finds the document's window by `WindowName()` and checks for a right-click on its dock tab, or its title bar while floating. It then opens one host popup whose body is the app's tab menu, an "Open With" submenu. The pick is performed after `DrawAll` returns, because a mid-draw open could add a document to the list being drawn.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("DocumentHost::PathOf remembers the opened file and follows a move", "[text-openers]")
{
    Arcane::Test::TempDir dir("openers_pathof");
    const fs::path one = Touch(dir.path / "one.fake");
    const fs::path moved = Touch(dir.path / "sub" / "one.fake");
    DocumentHost host;
    const Arcane::Guid guid = Arcane::Guid::Generate();
    host.RegisterFactory(".fake", [guid](const fs::path& p) { return std::make_unique<FakeDoc>(p.stem().string(), guid); });
    EditorDocument* doc = host.OpenPath(one);
    REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
    CHECK(host.PathOf(*doc) == one);
    host.NoteAssetMoved(guid, moved);
    CHECK(host.PathOf(*doc) == moved);
    FakeDoc stray("stray", Arcane::Guid::Generate());
    CHECK(host.PathOf(stray).empty());
}

TEST_CASE("DocumentHost: a right-click on a document's title bar raises the tab menu for it", "[text-openers][settings-ui]")
{
    HeadlessImGui imgui;
    Arcane::Test::TempDir dir("openers_tabmenu");
    const fs::path one = Touch(dir.path / "one.fake");
    DocumentHost host;
    const Arcane::Guid guid = Arcane::Guid::Generate();
    host.RegisterFactory(".fake", [guid](const fs::path& p) { return std::make_unique<FakeDoc>(p.stem().string(), guid); });
    EditorDocument* doc = host.OpenPath(one);
    REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);

    EditorDocument* seenDoc = nullptr;
    fs::path seenPath;
    host.SetTabMenu([&](EditorDocument& d, const fs::path& p) {
        seenDoc = &d;
        seenPath = p;
        ImGui::TextUnformatted("tab menu");
    });

    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    const auto frame = [&] {
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        host.DrawAll(0);
        ImGui::Render();
    };
    frame();                                    // the window exists; its title bar spans y 100..~119
    io.AddMousePosEvent(150.0f, 105.0f);
    frame();
    CHECK(seenDoc == nullptr);                  // hovering is not a click
    io.AddMouseButtonEvent(ImGuiMouseButton_Right, true);
    frame();
    io.AddMouseButtonEvent(ImGuiMouseButton_Right, false);
    frame();
    CHECK(seenDoc == doc);
    CHECK(seenPath == one);
}
```

The page, top to bottom:
1. **File types** -- one row per group, then one per extension entry. The groups are always shown: "C and C++ source", "Other text files", "Files with an Arcane editor". Each row has an opener dropdown; "Arcane editor" is offered on the asset row and on extensions an Arcane editor opens. Extension rows have Remove. An "Add file type" field and button follow.
2. **Custom programs** -- Detect installed editors lists found presets with Add (disabled when already added), and Add custom program adds a blank entry. Each entry edits name, program (with Browse...) and arguments, and shows a **live preview of the exact command line** for a sample file `<project>\Source\Example.cpp` at line 42, column 7, or the template error. Remove drops the entry and every `editor.files.openWith` entry that named it.
3. Any `editor.files.customEditors` problems, in the warning colour.

Every edit writes through `WriteFilesSetting`, so the row's All projects / This project switch, the archive and Publish all apply.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("Open With page: choices, labels, remove/add custom programs", "[settings-ui][files]")

    const std::vector<O::CustomEditor> customs{ { "vscode", "Visual Studio Code", "C:/VSC/Code.exe", "" } };
    const std::vector<O::OpenerId> plain = OpenerChoices(false, customs);
    CHECK(plain == std::vector<O::OpenerId>{ O::OpenerId::ArcaneText(), O::OpenerId::VisualStudio(),
                                             O::OpenerId::SystemDefault(), O::OpenerId::Custom("vscode") });
    CHECK(OpenerChoices(true, customs).front() == O::OpenerId::Dedicated());
    CHECK(OpenerLabel(O::OpenerId::Custom("vscode"), customs) == "Visual Studio Code");
    CHECK(OpenerLabel(O::OpenerId::Custom("gone"), customs) == "custom:gone (missing)");

    const FilesSettingsText in{ ".lua=custom:vscode;.md=custom:vscode;text=arcaneText", O::FormatCustomEditors(customs) };
    const FilesSettingsText removed = RemoveCustomEditor(in, "vscode");
    CHECK(removed.openWith == "text=arcaneText");
    CHECK(O::ParseCustomEditors(removed.customEditors).editors.empty());
    const FilesSettingsText added = AddCustomEditor(removed, customs[0]);
    CHECK(O::ParseCustomEditors(added.customEditors).editors == customs);
    CHECK(AddCustomEditor(added, customs[0]).customEditors == added.customEditors);   // an existing id is not added twice
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/OpenWithPage.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Preferences > Editor > Files > Open With (text editor spec s5.6
// "Choosing"): who opens each kind of file, and the user's own programs.
// The page edits editor.files.openWith / editor.files.customEditors through
// WriteFilesSetting (the row's All projects / This project switch, the
// archive, Publish); both rows are Hidden, so this page is their editor.
// The pure halves (rows, choices, list edits, the preview context) are
// [settings-ui]-tested; DrawOpenWithPage draws them.

#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/EditorPresets.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct OpenWithPageState
    {
        std::function<void()> requestBrowseExe;                                    // EditorApp: the OS picker -> DialogInbox::openWithExe
        std::function<std::vector<Openers::DetectedEditor>()> detect;              // EditorApp: DetectInstalledEditors(WindowsInstalledAppProbe)
        std::function<bool(const std::filesystem::path&)> hasDedicatedEditor;      // EditorApp: DocumentHost::HasDedicatedFactory (TE2-19)
        std::function<std::filesystem::path()> projectRoot;                        // the preview's {project}
        std::function<std::filesystem::path()> solution;                           // the preview's {solution}
        std::vector<Openers::DetectedEditor> detected;
        bool detectRan = false;
        std::string browseFor;                 // the custom id the pending Browse... answers
        char newExtension[32] = {};
    };

    struct OpenWithRow
    {
        std::string key;              // "source" / "text" / "asset" / ".ext"
        std::string label;
        Openers::OpenerId opener;     // the entry's opener, or the group's built-in default
        bool isGroup = false;
        bool explicitEntry = false;   // the map holds this key
    };

    // The three groups (always shown), then the extension entries sorted by key.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<OpenWithRow> OpenWithRows(std::string_view openWith);
    // Arcane editor (when offered), Arcane Text Editor, Visual Studio, System default, then each custom program.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Openers::OpenerId> OpenerChoices(bool offerDedicated, std::span<const Openers::CustomEditor> customs);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string OpenerLabel(const Openers::OpenerId& id, std::span<const Openers::CustomEditor> customs);

    struct FilesSettingsText
    {
        std::string openWith;
        std::string customEditors;
    };
    // Drops the program and every openWith entry naming it.
    [[nodiscard]] FilesSettingsText RemoveCustomEditor(const FilesSettingsText& in, std::string_view id);
    // Appends `editor` unless its id is already there.
    [[nodiscard]] FilesSettingsText AddCustomEditor(const FilesSettingsText& in, const Openers::CustomEditor& editor);
    // <projectRoot or C:\Project>\Source\Example.cpp, line 42, column 7.
    [[nodiscard]] Openers::TemplateContext PreviewContext(const std::filesystem::path& projectRoot,
                                                          const std::filesystem::path& solution);
    // The Browse... answer: set the exe of the entry `state.browseFor` names. False when it is gone.
    bool ApplyBrowsedProgram(OpenWithPageState& state, const std::string& exePath);

    void DrawOpenWithPage(void* user);   // user = OpenWithPageState*
}
```

```cpp
            O::OpenerId builtIn;
        };

        std::vector<GroupInfo> Groups()
        {
            return {
                { O::kGroupSource, "C and C++ source (.c .cc .cpp .cxx .h .hh .hpp .hxx .inl)", O::OpenerId::VisualStudio() },
                { O::kGroupText,   "Other text files", O::OpenerId::ArcaneText() },
                { O::kGroupAsset,  "Files with an Arcane editor (materials, sprites, meshes, ...)", O::OpenerId::Dedicated() },
            };
        }

        const O::OpenWithEntry* FindKey(std::span<const O::OpenWithEntry> entries, std::string_view key)
        {
            const auto it = std::find_if(entries.begin(), entries.end(), [&](const O::OpenWithEntry& e) { return e.key == key; });
            return it == entries.end() ? nullptr : &*it;
        }
    }

    std::vector<OpenWithRow> OpenWithRows(std::string_view openWith)
    {
        const std::vector<O::OpenWithEntry> entries = O::ParseOpenWith(openWith);
        std::vector<OpenWithRow> rows;
        for (const GroupInfo& g : Groups())
        {
            const O::OpenWithEntry* e = FindKey(entries, g.key);
            rows.push_back(OpenWithRow{ std::string(g.key), g.label, e ? e->opener : g.builtIn, true, e != nullptr });
        }
        std::vector<OpenWithRow> exts;
        for (const O::OpenWithEntry& e : entries)
            if (e.key.starts_with('.'))
                exts.push_back(OpenWithRow{ e.key, e.key, e.opener, false, true });
        std::sort(exts.begin(), exts.end(), [](const OpenWithRow& a, const OpenWithRow& b) { return a.key < b.key; });
        rows.insert(rows.end(), exts.begin(), exts.end());
        return rows;
    }

    std::vector<O::OpenerId> OpenerChoices(bool offerDedicated, std::span<const O::CustomEditor> customs)
    {
        std::vector<O::OpenerId> out;
        if (offerDedicated)
            out.push_back(O::OpenerId::Dedicated());
        out.push_back(O::OpenerId::ArcaneText());
        out.push_back(O::OpenerId::VisualStudio());
        out.push_back(O::OpenerId::SystemDefault());
        for (const O::CustomEditor& e : customs)
            out.push_back(O::OpenerId::Custom(e.id));
        return out;
    }

    std::string OpenerLabel(const O::OpenerId& id, std::span<const O::CustomEditor> customs)
    {
        if (id.kind != O::OpenerKind::Custom)
            return std::string(O::OpenerDisplayName(id.kind));
        if (const O::CustomEditor* e = O::FindCustomEditor(customs, id.custom))
            return e->name;
        return "custom:" + id.custom + " (missing)";
    }

    FilesSettingsText RemoveCustomEditor(const FilesSettingsText& in, std::string_view id)
    {
        std::vector<O::CustomEditor> list = O::ParseCustomEditors(in.customEditors).editors;
        std::erase_if(list, [&](const O::CustomEditor& e) { return e.id == id; });
        std::vector<O::OpenWithEntry> map = O::ParseOpenWith(in.openWith);
        std::erase_if(map, [&](const O::OpenWithEntry& e) { return e.opener.kind == O::OpenerKind::Custom && e.opener.custom == id; });
        return FilesSettingsText{ O::FormatOpenWith(map), O::FormatCustomEditors(list) };
    }

    FilesSettingsText AddCustomEditor(const FilesSettingsText& in, const O::CustomEditor& editor)
    {
        std::vector<O::CustomEditor> list = O::ParseCustomEditors(in.customEditors).editors;
        if (!O::FindCustomEditor(list, editor.id))
            list.push_back(editor);
        return FilesSettingsText{ in.openWith, O::FormatCustomEditors(list) };
    }

    O::TemplateContext PreviewContext(const std::filesystem::path& projectRoot, const std::filesystem::path& solution)
    {
        O::TemplateContext c;
        const std::filesystem::path root = projectRoot.empty() ? std::filesystem::path(L"C:\\Project") : projectRoot;
        c.file = root / "Source" / "Example.cpp";
        c.line = 42;
        c.column = 7;
        c.project = root;
        c.solution = solution.empty() ? root / "Project.slnx" : solution;
        return c;
    }

    bool ApplyBrowsedProgram(OpenWithPageState& state, const std::string& exePath)
    {
        const std::string id = std::move(state.browseFor);
        state.browseFor.clear();
        std::vector<O::CustomEditor> list = CurrentCustomEditors();
        const auto it = std::find_if(list.begin(), list.end(), [&](const O::CustomEditor& e) { return e.id == id; });
        if (it == list.end())
            return false;
        it->exe = exePath;
        return SetCustomEditors(list);
    }

    void DrawOpenWithPage(void* user)
    {
        OpenWithPageState& st = *static_cast<OpenWithPageState*>(user);
        const FileOpenerSettings& s = Arcane::Settings<FileOpenerSettings>();
        const FilesSettingsText text{ s.openWith, s.customEditors };
        const O::CustomEditorList customs = O::ParseCustomEditors(text.customEditors);

        ImGui::TextWrapped("Choose who opens each kind of file. A file already open in an Arcane text tab is always "
                           "focused there. Right-click any file for Open With to choose once.");

        ImGui::SeparatorText("File types");
        if (ImGui::BeginTable("##openwith_types", 3, ImGuiTableFlags_SizingStretchProp | ImGuiTableFlags_RowBg))
        {
            for (const OpenWithRow& row : OpenWithRows(text.openWith))
            {
                ImGui::TableNextRow();
                ImGui::PushID(row.key.c_str());
                ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                ImGui::TextUnformatted(row.label.c_str());
                ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                const bool offerDedicated = row.key == O::kGroupAsset ||
                    (!row.isGroup && st.hasDedicatedEditor && st.hasDedicatedEditor(std::filesystem::path(L"x" + O::Utf8ToWide(row.key))));
                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1.0f);
                if (ImGui::BeginCombo("##opener", OpenerLabel(row.opener, customs.editors).c_str()))
                {
                    for (const O::OpenerId& id : OpenerChoices(offerDedicated, customs.editors))
                        if (ImGui::Selectable(OpenerLabel(id, customs.editors).c_str(), id == row.opener))
                            (void)WriteFilesSetting("openWith", O::SetOpenWith(text.openWith, row.key, id));
                    ImGui::EndCombo();
                }
                ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                if (!row.isGroup && ImGui::SmallButton("Remove"))
                    (void)WriteFilesSetting("openWith", O::SetOpenWith(text.openWith, row.key, std::nullopt));
                ImGui::PopID();
            }
            ImGui::EndTable();
        }
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 8.0f);
        ImGui::InputTextWithHint("##newext", ".ext", st.newExtension, sizeof(st.newExtension));
        ImGui::SameLine();
        const std::string newExt = Arcane::Text::NormaliseExtension(st.newExtension);   // TE3-3's, the one normaliser
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(newExt.size() < 2);
        if (ImGui::Button("Add file type"))
        {
            (void)WriteFilesSetting("openWith", O::SetOpenWith(text.openWith, newExt, O::OpenerId::ArcaneText()));
            st.newExtension[0] = '\0';
        }
        ImGui::EndDisabled();

        ImGui::SeparatorText("Custom programs");
        if (ImGui::Button("Detect installed editors"))
        {
            st.detected = st.detect ? st.detect() : std::vector<O::DetectedEditor>{};
            st.detectRan = true;
        }
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("Looks for Visual Studio Code, Sublime Text, Notepad++, JetBrains Rider, CLion and Neovim "
                              "in Windows Terminal (App Paths, installed programs, PATH). Nothing on the system is changed.");
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button("Add custom program"))
        {
            const O::CustomEditor blank{ O::MintCustomEditorId("program", customs.editors), "Program", "", "\"{file}\"" };
            (void)WriteFilesSetting("customEditors", AddCustomEditor(text, blank).customEditors);
        }
        if (st.detectRan)
        {
            if (st.detected.empty())
                ImGui::TextDisabled("No supported editors were found.");
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < st.detected.size(); ++i)
            {
                const O::DetectedEditor& d = st.detected[i];
                ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(i));
                const bool have = O::FindCustomEditor(customs.editors, d.editor.id) != nullptr;
                ImGui::BeginDisabled(have);
                if (ImGui::SmallButton(have ? "Added" : "Add"))
                    (void)WriteFilesSetting("customEditors", AddCustomEditor(text, d.editor).customEditors);
                ImGui::EndDisabled();
                ImGui::SameLine();
                ImGui::Text("%s  (%s)", d.editor.name.c_str(), d.foundBy.c_str());
                ImGui::SameLine();
                ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", d.editor.exe.c_str());
                ImGui::PopID();
            }
        }

        const O::TemplateContext sample = PreviewContext(st.projectRoot ? st.projectRoot() : std::filesystem::path{},
                                                         st.solution ? st.solution() : std::filesystem::path{});
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < customs.editors.size(); ++i)
        {
            O::CustomEditor e = customs.editors[i];
            ImGui::PushID(e.id.c_str());
            ImGui::Separator();
            bool changed = false;
            changed |= InputTextString("Name", &e.name);
            changed |= InputTextString("Program", &e.exe);
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Browse...") && st.requestBrowseExe)
            {
                st.browseFor = e.id;
                st.requestBrowseExe();
            }
            changed |= InputTextString("Arguments", &e.args);
            ImGui::SetItemTooltip("{file} {line} {col} {project} {solution}; {{ and }} are literal braces. Empty = the quoted file.");
            const std::string preview = O::PreviewCommandLine(e, sample);
            if (preview.starts_with("error: "))
                ImGui::TextColored(Theme::kWarning, "%s", preview.c_str());
            else
                ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", preview.c_str());
            const bool remove = ImGui::SmallButton("Remove");
            ImGui::PopID();
            if (remove)
            {
                const FilesSettingsText next = RemoveCustomEditor(text, e.id);
                (void)WriteFilesSetting("openWith", next.openWith);
                (void)WriteFilesSetting("customEditors", next.customEditors);
                break;   // the list changed under the loop
            }
            if (changed)
            {
                std::vector<O::CustomEditor> list = customs.editors;
                list[i] = e;
                (void)SetCustomEditors(list);
            }
        }
        for (const std::string& p : customs.problems)
            ImGui::TextColored(Theme::kWarning, "%s", p.c_str());
    }
}
```

### Task TE7-16: The C grammar, ported from lite-xl `language_c.lua` (spec s4.7, s10)

**Files:**
- Create: `data/Syntaxes/C.arcsyntax`, `data/Syntaxes/tests/syntax_test_c.c`, `ArcaneTests/src/Text/CGrammarFilesTest.cpp`
- Modify: `NOTICE.md` (the lite-xl row TE3 adds for the Lua/Markdown grammar content now also names C and C++); `ArcaneTests/src/Text/GrammarScopeTests.cpp` (TE3's per-grammar file: a C case, and the shipped-set case gains "C")
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/CGrammarFilesTest.cpp` and `GrammarScopeTests.cpp`, tags `[text-grammar-c][text-syntax-data]`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE3's `.arcsyntax` format and earliest-match tokenizer; TE3-20's `RequireScopeTest`, `RequireNoGrammarProblems`, `ShippedGrammars()` (`Helpers/TextShippedGrammars.hpp`); TE3-29's shipped-set case; `Arcane::Test::FindReferenceProjectDir()`; nlohmann/json.
- Produces: the grammar named `C` (`source.c`, files `.c`) with the scopes:
  - `comment.line.double-slash.c`, `comment.block.c`
  - `string.quoted.double.c`, `string.quoted.single.c`, `string.quoted.other.include.c`
  - `constant.numeric{,.hex,.octal}.c`, `constant.other.c`, `constant.language.c`
  - `keyword.control.c`, `keyword.other.c`, `keyword.other.octal-prefix.c`, `keyword.control.directive.c`, `keyword.operator.c`
  - `storage.type.c`, `entity.name.type.c`, `entity.name.function.c`

**How the port maps lite-xl onto `.arcsyntax`** (MIT; notice in the file's `notice` and in `NOTICE.md`):
- **Rule order is lite-xl's, one for one.** lite-xl tries its patterns in order, anchored at the current token. TE3's tokenizer takes the earliest match and breaks ties by the first rule. The two agree here because every word start is matched by the final identifier rule, so the earliest position is always the current token. Then, as in lite-xl, the first listed rule that matches there wins.
- **Lua patterns -> PCRE2.**

  | Lua | PCRE2 |
  |---|---|
  | `%a %w %u %d %s` | `[A-Za-z] [A-Za-z0-9] [A-Z] \d \s` |
  | `%f[(]` (frontier) | `(?=\()` |
  | `%f[#]#` | `(?<!#)#` |
  | `.-` (lazy) | `.*?` |
  | `^` | `^` |
  | `{ "/%*", "%*/" }` | a `begin`/`end` region |
  | `{ '"', '"', '\\' }` | a region with `escape: "\\\\."` |
  | `regex = ...` (isuf / fsuf / digitsep) | verbatim |

- **Capture types: one lite-xl behaviour needs care.** lite-xl splits a multi-capture match with `()` position captures and then looks **every piece's text** up in `symbols`, so a keyword inside a "type name" capture still gets the keyword colour. `.arcsyntax` keyword lookup applies to a whole match only. So each declaration rule starts with a negative lookahead over the whole symbols list, `(?!(?:if|...|NULL)\b)`. When the first word is a keyword, the rule does not match; the identifier rule colours the keyword, and the next word starts a fresh match. The samples below pin that the colours equal lite-xl's (`static int x`, `int main(`, `const char* kName`, `return foo(`).
- **lite-xl's type names map to TextMate scopes** so `.arctheme` prefix resolution finds them:
  - `keyword` becomes `keyword.control.c` for flow words and `keyword.other.c` for the rest; both resolve through `keyword`.
  - `keyword2` becomes `storage.type.c`.
  - `literal` becomes `constant.language.c` for `true false NULL`, and `entity.name.type.c` for a declaration's type name. lite-xl overloads `literal` for both.
  - `function` becomes `entity.name.function.c`.
  - `number` becomes `constant.numeric.*`. lite-xl also colours UPPER_CASE constants and `__MAGIC__` as `number`; here they are `constant.other.c`.
  - `operator` becomes `keyword.operator.c`.
  - `symbol` (a `#define`'s name) is left unscoped.
- **Kept as lite-xl has it.**
  - An octal literal's leading `0` is coloured as a keyword (`keyword.other.octal-prefix.c`), and the rest as `constant.numeric.octal.c`.
  - An UPPER_CASE constant at the very end of a line is not recognised, because lite-xl's frontier needs a following character.
- **Not from lite-xl, written fresh:** `indent`, `brackets`, `autoClose`, `symbols` (functions and struct/union/enum names for spec 2's `@`), and `#pragma region` fold markers. lite-xl has none of these.

Every rule and every sample assertion below was run through TE3's tokenizer model and its runner model (`scratchpad/texteditor/te3/proto.py`): 259 assertions, 0 failures.

```cpp
// TE7-16 / TE7-17: the C and C++ grammar files' metadata (text editor spec
// s4.7). Their highlighting is pinned by data/Syntaxes/tests/syntax_test_c.c
// and syntax_test_cpp.cpp, which the [text-grammar-c] / [text-grammar-cpp]
// cases in GrammarScopeTests.cpp run through TE3-20's RequireScopeTest.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Helpers/ReferenceProjectDir.hpp"

#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <set>
#include <string>

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

namespace
{
    nlohmann::json LoadGrammar(const char* file)
    {
        const fs::path p = Arcane::Test::FindReferenceProjectDir().parent_path() / "data" / "Syntaxes" / file;
        std::ifstream in(p);
        REQUIRE(in.good());
        return nlohmann::json::parse(in);
    }

    // No word may carry two keyword scopes in one rule (a typo would make the
    // colour depend on map order).
    void CheckKeywordTablesDisjoint(const nlohmann::json& g)
    {
        for (const nlohmann::json& rule : g["patterns"])
        {
            if (!rule.contains("keywords"))
                continue;
            std::set<std::string> seen;
            for (const auto& [scope, words] : rule["keywords"].items())
                for (const nlohmann::json& w : words)
                {
                    INFO(scope << " " << w.get<std::string>());
                    CHECK(seen.insert(w.get<std::string>()).second);
                }
        }
    }
}

TEST_CASE("C grammar: name, scope, .c only, lite-xl notice, both comment forms", "[text-grammar-c][text-syntax-data]")
{
    const nlohmann::json g = LoadGrammar("C.arcsyntax");
    CHECK(g["format"] == "arcsyntax");
    CHECK(g["name"] == "C");
    CHECK(g["scope"] == "source.c");
    CHECK(g["files"] == nlohmann::json::array({ ".c" }));
    CHECK(g["notice"].get<std::string>().find("lite-xl data/plugins/language_c.lua (MIT License") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(g["comment"]["line"] == "//");
    CHECK(g["comment"]["block"] == nlohmann::json::array({ "/*", "*/" }));
    CHECK(g["lineLocal"] == false);
    CHECK(g["patterns"].size() == 31u);
    CheckKeywordTablesDisjoint(g);
}
```

```json
{
  "format": "arcsyntax",
  "version": 1,
  "name": "C",
  "scope": "source.c",
  "notice": "Rules translated from lite-xl data/plugins/language_c.lua (MIT License; Copyright (c) 2020 rxi, 2020-2022 Francesco Abbate, 2022-present Lite XL Team). See NOTICE.md.",
  "files": [".c"],
  "comment": {"line": "//", "block": ["/*", "*/"]},
  "brackets": [["(", ")"], ["[", "]"], ["{", "}"]],
  "autoClose": [["\"", "\""], ["'", "'"], ["(", ")"], ["[", "]"], ["{", "}"]],
  "indent": {"increase": "\\{\\s*(?://.*)?$", "decrease": "^\\s*\\}"},
  "wordChars": "A-Za-z0-9_",
  "symbols": [
    {"match": "^\\s*(?!return\\b|else\\b|if\\b|while\\b|for\\b|switch\\b|case\\b|do\\b)[A-Za-z_][\\w:<>,*& ]*?[\\s*&]+([A-Za-z_][\\w:]*)\\s*\\(", "name": 1, "kind": "function"},
    {"match": "^\\s*(?:typedef\\s+)?(?:struct|union|enum)\\s+([A-Za-z_]\\w*)", "name": 1, "kind": "type"}
  ],
  "foldMarkers": {"begin": "^\\s*#\\s*pragma\\s+region\\b", "end": "^\\s*#\\s*pragma\\s+endregion\\b"},
  "lineLocal": false,
  "patterns": [
    {"match": "//.*$", "scope": "comment.line.double-slash.c"},
    {"begin": "/\\*", "end": "\\*/", "scope": "comment.block.c"},
```

### Task TE7-17: The C++ grammar, ported from lite-xl `language_cpp.lua` (spec s4.7, s10)

**Files:**
- Create: `data/Syntaxes/CPP.arcsyntax`, `data/Syntaxes/tests/syntax_test_cpp.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/CGrammarFilesTest.cpp` (the C++ cases); `ArcaneTests/src/Text/GrammarScopeTests.cpp` (a C++ case; the shipped-set list gains "C++" -- fifteen names, the count derived from the list)
- Test: the same, tags `[text-grammar-cpp][text-syntax-data]`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: as TE7-16.
- Produces: the grammar named `C++` (`source.cpp`) with the C scopes (suffix `.cpp`) plus `constant.numeric.binary.cpp`. Its files are `.cpp .cc .cxx .c++ .h .hh .hpp .hxx .h++ .inl .ino .cu .cuh`.
  - `.h` is C++, as in lite-xl: a header is far more often C++ in an Arcane project.
  - lite-xl's case-sensitive `%.C$` and `%.H$` are dropped. Extension matching is case-insensitive here, so they would collide with `.c` and `.h`.

On top of the C rules, the C++ port adds (in lite-xl's order):
- `0b` binary literals;
- `:` in the operator class;
- `class` and `namespace` with their names;
- `static constexpr` / `constinit` / `consteval`;
- the `Type ::` method-declaration rule;
- the `name ::` scope-access rule;
- `#include` with `\s+`;
- the C++ keyword list.

The method rule backtracks exactly as lite-xl's Lua pattern does (`Foo::` is split into two pieces, both `entity.name.type.cpp`). With the keyword lookahead, lite-xl's mis-colouring of `return ::f()` (as two type-name pieces) does not happen. That is the one intentional difference, and it is noted in the self-review.

**Known limitation** (lite-xl has it too): raw string literals `R"(...)"` are not recognised, so `)"` inside one ends the string early.

Validated with the same model: 271 assertions, 0 failures.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("C++ grammar: name, scope, the header and source extensions, lite-xl notice", "[text-grammar-cpp][text-syntax-data]")
{
    const nlohmann::json g = LoadGrammar("CPP.arcsyntax");
    CHECK(g["name"] == "C++");
    CHECK(g["scope"] == "source.cpp");
    CHECK(g["files"] == nlohmann::json::array({ ".cpp", ".cc", ".cxx", ".c++", ".h", ".hh", ".hpp", ".hxx", ".h++",
                                                ".inl", ".ino", ".cu", ".cuh" }));
    CHECK(g["notice"].get<std::string>().find("lite-xl data/plugins/language_cpp.lua (MIT License") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(g["patterns"].size() == 39u);
    CheckKeywordTablesDisjoint(g);
}

TEST_CASE("No other shipped grammar claims a C or C++ extension", "[text-grammar-cpp][text-syntax-data]")
{
    const std::set<std::string> ours{ ".c", ".cpp", ".cc", ".cxx", ".c++", ".h", ".hh", ".hpp", ".hxx", ".h++",
                                      ".inl", ".ino", ".cu", ".cuh" };
    const fs::path dir = Arcane::Test::FindReferenceProjectDir().parent_path() / "data" / "Syntaxes";
    for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(dir))
    {
        if (entry.path().extension() != ".arcsyntax")
            continue;
        std::ifstream in(entry.path());
        const nlohmann::json g = nlohmann::json::parse(in);
        if (g["name"] == "C" || g["name"] == "C++")
            continue;
        for (const nlohmann::json& f : g.value("files", nlohmann::json::array()))
        {
            INFO(entry.path().filename().string() << " claims " << f.get<std::string>());
            CHECK_FALSE(ours.contains(f.get<std::string>()));
        }
    }
}
```

### Task TE7-18: Witnesses -- `.cpp` to Visual Studio by default and to an Arcane tab by setting; a custom program's exact argv; a failing opener's row and offer (spec s5.6, s11.4 style)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/OpenersWitnessTest.cpp`
- Test: the same (`[witness][text-openers]`, plus one `[ide-desk]`)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - TE7-8 (`FileOpener`, `FilePosition`, `OpenResult`), TE7-9 (`OpenerHost`, `MakeFileOpenerBackends`), TE7-4 `PathUtf8`, TE7-6 `IdeLaunch::OpenFileAt`
  - TE7-5's process fixture `--record`
  - TE2 (`TextDocument`, `CanonicalPath()` by value, `ReadOnly()`, `DocumentHost::FindByCanonicalPath`, `RegisterTextDocumentRoutes` + `TextRouteServices`), TE2-19 `DocumentHost::HasDedicatedFactory`, TE6-12 `OpenAsTextFlow`
  - `DocumentHost::Count()` (`Documents/DocumentHost.hpp:65`), `DiagnosticStore`, `ScopedCodeRung`, `TempDir`, `ModuleBuild::ExeDir()`
- Produces: the D15 witnesses GATE-1 runs with the other `[witness]` cases.

The witnesses run the real app wiring (`MakeFileOpenerBackends` over a real `DocumentHost`), the real text open (`OpenAsTextFlow` + `TextDocument`), the real settings and the real `CreateProcessW`. Only the Visual Studio backend is a recorder in the headless witness. The `[ide-desk]` case drives the real Visual Studio.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test** -- `ArcaneTests/src/Text/OpenersWitnessTest.cpp`:

```cpp
// TE7-18: the D15 witnesses (text editor spec s5.6). A real DocumentHost,
// the real FileOpener wiring, real TextDocuments through OpenAsTextFlow,
// real editor.files.* settings, a real CreateProcessW of the process fixture
// and a real failing launch. Visual Studio is a recorder here; the
// [ide-desk] case drives the real one.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp"
#include "Helpers/TestEnvironment.hpp"
#include "Panels/DiagnosticStore.hpp"
#include "Project/IdeLaunch.hpp"
#include "Project/ModuleBuild.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/FileOpener.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/FileOpenerWiring.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/OpenAsText.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocumentRoutes.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/CVarRegistry.hpp>

#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using namespace Arcane::Editor;
using namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers;
using Arcane::CVarValue;

namespace
{
    fs::path FixtureExe()
    {
        return (ModuleBuild::ExeDir() / ".." / "arcbuild-process-fixture" / "arcbuild-process-fixture.exe").lexically_normal();
    }

    std::vector<std::string> WaitForRecord(const fs::path& record)
    {
        const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(10);
        while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline)
        {
            std::vector<std::string> lines;
            std::ifstream in(record, std::ios::binary);
            for (std::string line; std::getline(in, line);)
                lines.push_back(line);
            if (!lines.empty() && lines.back().starts_with("CWD:"))
                return lines;
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));
        }
        return {};
    }

    // The app's wiring over a real DocumentHost with the real text routes
    // (TE2-20, as the app registers them); Visual Studio recorded.
    struct Rig
    {
        DocumentHost host;
        OpenAsTextFlow flow{ host, {}, {} };
        std::vector<std::string> ideCalls;
        IdeLaunch::Outcome ideAnswer = IdeLaunch::Outcome::OpenedInInstance;
        fs::path project, solution;
        std::unique_ptr<FileOpener> files;

        Rig()
        {
            RegisterTextDocumentRoutes(host, TextRouteServices{});   // HasFactory is now true for every text file
            OpenerHost h;
            h.documents = &host;
            h.openAsText = [this](const fs::path& p) -> EditorDocument* { return flow.Open(p); };
            h.openInIde = [this](const fs::path& p, int line, int column) {
                ideCalls.push_back(PathUtf8(p.filename()) + ":" + std::to_string(line) + ":" + std::to_string(column));
                return ideAnswer;
            };
            h.projectRoot = [this] { return project; };
            h.solution = [this] { return solution; };
            files = std::make_unique<FileOpener>(MakeFileOpenerBackends(std::move(h)));
        }
    };
}

TEST_CASE("Witness: a .cpp opens with Visual Studio by default; switching editor.files.openWith opens it in an Arcane tab", "[witness][text-openers]")
{
    Arcane::Test::TempDir dir("openers_witness_cpp");
    const fs::path cpp = dir.path / "Game Mode.cpp";
    { std::ofstream(cpp, std::ios::binary) << "#include <cstdio>\nint main()\n{\n    return 0;\n}\n"; }
    Rig rig;

    OpenResult r = rig.files->Open(cpp, FilePosition{ 4, 5 });
    CHECK(r.ok);
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::VisualStudio());
    CHECK(rig.ideCalls == std::vector<std::string>{ "Game Mode.cpp:4:5" });
    CHECK(rig.host.Count() == 0u);   // nothing opened inside Arcane

    {
        Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung map("editor.files.openWith", CVarValue::String("source=arcaneText;text=arcaneText;asset=dedicated"));
        r = rig.files->Open(cpp, FilePosition{ 4, 5 });
        CHECK(r.ok);
        CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
        auto* doc = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(r.document);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        CHECK(fs::equivalent(doc->CanonicalPath(), cpp));
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());   // a .cpp has no dedicated editor: an editable tab, not TE6-12's locked one
        CHECK(rig.host.Count() == 1u);
    }

    // Back on the default map: the open tab wins -- no second copy in
    // Visual Studio behind the user's back (spec s5.6 "Rules").
    r = rig.files->Open(cpp);
    CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::AlreadyOpen);
    CHECK(rig.host.Count() == 1u);
    CHECK(rig.ideCalls.size() == 1u);
}

TEST_CASE("Witness: the default opener puts a .cpp in the running Visual Studio on this desk", "[ide-desk]")
{
    const char* sln = std::getenv("ARCANE_IDE_DESK");
    const char* file = std::getenv("ARCANE_IDE_DESK_FILE");   // a .cpp of 3+ lines
    if (!sln || !*sln || !file || !*file)
        SKIP("ARCANE_IDE_DESK / ARCANE_IDE_DESK_FILE not set -- desk-only probe");
    DocumentHost host;
    OpenerHost h;
    h.documents = &host;
    // The real route minus any devenv launch: a closed solution answers NoDevenv.
    h.openInIde = [sln](const fs::path& p, int line, int column) { return IdeLaunch::OpenFileAt({}, fs::path(sln), p, line, column); };
    FileOpener files(MakeFileOpenerBackends(std::move(h)));
    const OpenResult r = files.Open(fs::path(file), FilePosition{ 2, 3 });
    INFO(r.error << " -- Visual Studio should show the file, caret on line 2, column 3");
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::VisualStudio());
    CHECK(r.ok);
}

#ifdef _WIN32
TEST_CASE("Witness: a custom program opener launches the fixture with the right argv", "[witness][text-openers]")
{
    Arcane::Test::TempDir dir("openers_witness_custom");
    const fs::path record = dir.path / "argv record.txt";
    const fs::path lua = dir.path / "init script.lua";
    const fs::path sln = dir.path / "My Game.slnx";
    { std::ofstream(lua) << "print(1)\n"; }
    { std::ofstream(sln) << "<Solution />\n"; }
    nlohmann::json list = nlohmann::json::array();
    list.push_back({ { "id", "fixture" }, { "name", "Fixture" }, { "exe", PathUtf8(FixtureExe()) },
                     { "args", "--record \"" + PathUtf8(record) + "\" -g \"{file}:{line}:{col}\" --sln {solution} --root \"{project}\"" } });
    Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung customs("editor.files.customEditors", CVarValue::String(list.dump()));
    Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung map("editor.files.openWith",
        CVarValue::String(".lua=custom:fixture;source=visualStudio;text=arcaneText;asset=dedicated"));
    Rig rig;
    rig.project = dir.path;
    rig.solution = sln;

    const OpenResult r = rig.files->Open(lua, FilePosition{ 12, 3 });
    INFO(r.error);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::Custom("fixture"));
    const std::vector<std::string> lines = WaitForRecord(record);
    REQUIRE(lines.size() == 7);
    CHECK(lines[0] == "ARG:0:-g");
    CHECK(lines[1] == "ARG:1:" + PathUtf8(lua) + ":12:3");
    CHECK(lines[2] == "ARG:2:--sln");
    CHECK(lines[3] == "ARG:3:" + PathUtf8(sln));
    CHECK(lines[4] == "ARG:4:--root");
    CHECK(lines[5] == "ARG:5:" + PathUtf8(dir.path));
    CHECK(lines[6] == "CWD:" + PathUtf8(dir.path));
    CHECK(rig.host.Count() == 0u);
}

TEST_CASE("Witness: a failing opener gives a Problems row and the fallback offer, which opens an Arcane tab", "[witness][text-openers]")
{
    Arcane::Test::TempDir dir("openers_witness_fail");
    const fs::path md = dir.path / "notes.md";
    { std::ofstream(md) << "# Notes\n\nSome text.\n"; }
    const fs::path missing = dir.path / "no such editor.exe";
    nlohmann::json list = nlohmann::json::array();
    list.push_back({ { "id", "missing" }, { "name", "Missing Editor" }, { "exe", PathUtf8(missing) }, { "args", "" } });
    Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung customs("editor.files.customEditors", CVarValue::String(list.dump()));
    Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung map("editor.files.openWith",
        CVarValue::String(".md=custom:missing;source=visualStudio;text=arcaneText;asset=dedicated"));
    DiagnosticStore store;
    store.InstallAsEngineSink();
    Rig rig;

    const OpenResult r = rig.files->Open(md, FilePosition{ 3, 2 });
    CHECK_FALSE(r.ok);
    const std::vector<Arcane::Diagnostic> rows = store.Snapshot();
    REQUIRE(rows.size() == 1);
    CHECK(rows[0].code == "files.open.failed");
    CHECK(rows[0].message == "Could not open notes.md with Missing Editor: '" + PathUtf8(missing) +
                             "' was not found (not an existing file, and not on PATH)");
    CHECK(rows[0].locator.line == 3);
    REQUIRE(rig.files->PendingOffer().has_value());
    CHECK(rig.files->PendingOffer()->offerArcaneText);

    const OpenResult accepted = rig.files->AcceptOffer();
    REQUIRE(accepted.ok);
    auto* doc = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(accepted.document);
    REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
    CHECK(fs::equivalent(doc->CanonicalPath(), md));
    CHECK(rig.host.Count() == 1u);
    CHECK(store.Snapshot().empty());   // the successful open cleared the row
    CHECK_FALSE(rig.files->PendingOffer().has_value());
}
```

**Decisions and spec gaps to reconcile**
1. **Explicit before already-open.** Open With / Open as Text are honoured even when a text tab shows the file. The spec's "regardless of the opener **setting**" is read as covering resolution from settings, not the user's own one-off pick. 2. **`dedicated` is overridable** through a `.ext` entry or the `asset` key ("never forced tooling"). The assignment ordered "dedicated-editor assets" before the map. The built-in default is still the dedicated editor, and "nothing" is not an opener.

### Task TE6-3: Follow over TE2-17's poll -- the follow cadence, a per-poll chunk cap, `FollowAvailable` (spec s3.5, s5.3)

TE2 owns change detection, the clean-only append, truncation, rotation and deletion (CANON B1: TE2-4's classifier, TE2-17's `PollDisk` / `AppendTail` / `ReloadFromDisk`; appends are applied on the first poll that sees them, CANON C TE2 #12). Follow adds three things on top and nothing else: a faster poll while `Follow()` is on, a cap on how many appended bytes one poll reads (the rest arrives on later polls), and the question "should the status strip offer Follow at all". The Follow state itself is TE2-16's `TextDocument::SetFollow(bool)` / `Follow()`, unchanged here; TE6-4 makes `SetFollow(true)` scroll the primary view to the end (it produces `TextEditorView::ScrollToEnd`).

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp`: add `followPollSeconds` and `followChunkKB` to `struct TextSettings`.
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.cpp`: two `ARC_REFLECT_FIELD` rows inside the `ARC_REFLECT_TYPE(TextSettings)` block, before `ARC_END_REFLECT_TYPE()`.
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp` and `.cpp`:
  - `bool FollowAvailable() const` (new, public);
  - TE2-17's `Tick(double)` rewritten (the Follow cadence);
  - the `DiskChange::Appended` branch of TE2-17's private `ObserveDisk(const FileStamp&) const` rewritten (the per-poll cap and the CR hold-back); `ActOnDisk` and `AppendTail` stay TE2-17's.
- Modify: `docs/superpowers/audits/2026-10-03-settings-inventory.md`: two rows in the Part 3 `### Text editor` table, one row in the "Post-freeze amendments" table (the inventory is FROZEN).
- Modify: `scripts/settings-frozen-names.txt`: regenerated by the lint, never by hand.
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextDocumentFollowTest.cpp` (tag `[text-follow]`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextPolishSettingsTest.cpp` (new; later TE6 tasks append their settings cases here)

No new source file and no `premake5.lua` change: everything lives in TE2's `TextDocument` and TE1's `TextSettings`, which ArcaneTests already source-compiles. The two test files are picked up by the ArcaneTests `ArcaneTests/src/**.cpp` glob once premake is re-run.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - TE2-16 `TextDocument::SetFollow(bool)`, `Follow() const` (the state, CANON B22);
  - TE2-17 `TextDocument::Tick(double) override`, `PollDisk()` (appends act on the poll that sees them; replacements after two equal polls via `m_pendingStamp`), the private `struct DiskObservation { DiskChange change; std::string window; std::string tail; bool splitsCrLf; }`, `DiskObservation ObserveDisk(const FileStamp&) const`, `ActOnDisk(const DiskObservation&, const FileStamp&)`, `AppendTail(window, tail, now)` (decodes the consumed tail with `Text::DecodeFragment(bytes, Encoding(), Buffer().Eols().Dominant())`, CANON B2), `m_pollElapsed`, `m_synced`, `m_canonical`, `Encoding()`, and `std::uint64_t AppendCount() const` (CANON A11);
  - TE2-4 `CompleteTailLength`, `TailSplitsCrLf`, `LastUnitOf` (all over `Text::TextEncoding`; `Utf8Bom` behaves as `Utf8`), `DiskChange`;
  - TE2-5 `std::optional<std::string> ReadRangeShared(const std::filesystem::path&, std::uint64_t offset, std::uint64_t length)` (opens with read, write and delete sharing);
  - TE2-15 `TextDocument::Open(path, TextDocumentServices, std::string& error)`, `CanonicalPath()` (by value), `Buffer()`, `Model()`, `Synced()`, `Dirty()`, `Save()`;
  - TE2-2 `TextSettings::watchPollSeconds`; TE3-3 `Text::NormaliseExtension(std::string_view)`;
  - TE1-11 `Text::TextEncoding`; TE1 `TextBuffer::{ChangeId, CanUndo, Eols}`, `Text::TextCommands`; TE2-11 `DefaultEditContext(TextModel&)`;
  - `Test::RequireDefault`, `Test::ScopedCodeRung` (`ArcaneTests/src/Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp`); `scripts/settings-inventory-lint.ps1 -RequireFrozen -EmitFrozen` (the frozen-inventory route TE2-2 and TE4-3 use).
- Produces:
  - `bool TextDocument::FollowAvailable() const` = `AppendCount() > 0 || Text::NormaliseExtension(CanonicalPath().extension().string()) == ".log"` (CANON A11);
  - settings `editor.text.followPollSeconds` (`double`, default 0.25, Dev, range 0.05..5) and `editor.text.followChunkKB` (`std::uint32_t`, default 4096, Dev, range 1..65536) (CANON A12; both are s8 amendments, CANON D29);
  - the behaviour: while `Follow()` is on, `Tick` polls every `followPollSeconds` instead of every `watchPollSeconds`; every append (Follow or not) reads at most `followChunkKB * 1024` bytes per poll.
- Does NOT produce: a follow class, file or poll of its own (CANON A11/B1: TE2-17's poll is the only one), and no `ScrollToEnd` call (TE6-4 adds it to `SetFollow`).

**Why the cap applies to every append, not only under Follow.** A program that dumps 200 MB into a log the editor has open (Follow or not) would otherwise make one poll read, decode and append 200 MB inside a frame. With the cap, one poll costs at most one `followChunkKB` read + decode + `AppendExternal`; the rest arrives on the following polls while the document stays clean (the synced size advances only by what was appended, so the next poll classifies the remainder as `Appended` again).

**Why the CR hold-back.** TE2-4's `TailSplitsCrLf` turns an append whose first unit is `\n` after a file that ended in `\r` into a full reload (the old text's lone CR would otherwise become a blank line). That rule is right for a writer that really stopped after `\r`, but our own chunk cut must never manufacture the case: when the cap cut the tail (`take < available`) and the trimmed tail's last unit is `\r`, that unit is held back with the rest (one byte for `Utf8` / `Utf8Bom` / `Windows1252`, two for `Utf16LE` / `Utf16BE`).

**TE4-3's hidden contract case.** TE4-3's `[.te6-recovery-contract]` case checks `followPollSeconds` / `followChunkKB` and TE6-13's `recoveryMaxMB` / `recoveryIntervalSeconds` together (CANON C TE4 #3). This task makes its two follow lines true (the defaults, the Dev flag) but does NOT remove the `.` from the tag: the recovery names do not exist until TE6-13, which registers them and un-hides the case. `TextPolishSettingsTest.cpp` below asserts the same follow lines now, so they are green from this task on.

```cpp
    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }

    void AppendAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
```
