```cpp
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::app).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }

    std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> OpenOrFail(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(p, {}, error);
        INFO(error);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        return doc;
    }

    std::string TextOf(TextDocument& d) { return d.Buffer().Text().ToString(); }

    // A user edit at the primary cursor, through TE1's commands (one undo step).
    void Type(TextDocument& doc, std::string_view text)
    {
        Text::TextCommands(doc.Buffer(), doc.Model().selections, DefaultEditContext(doc.Model())).InsertText(text);
    }

    // ASCII -> UTF-16LE code units (no BOM).
    std::string Utf16Le(std::string_view ascii)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const char c : ascii) { out += c; out += '\0'; }
        return out;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("follow: under Follow, Tick polls every editor.text.followPollSeconds; without it, every watchPollSeconds", "[text-follow]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te6-follow-cadence");
    const std::filesystem::path plainPath = s.dir / "plain.log";
    const std::filesystem::path followPath = s.dir / "follow.log";
    WriteAll(plainPath, "1\n");
    WriteAll(followPath, "1\n");
    auto plain = OpenOrFail(plainPath);
    auto followed = OpenOrFail(followPath);
    followed->SetFollow(true);
    REQUIRE(followed->Follow());

    AppendAll(plainPath, "2\n");
    AppendAll(followPath, "2\n");

    followed->Tick(0.2);                                   // 0.2 s < followPollSeconds (0.25): no poll yet
    CHECK(TextOf(*followed) == "1\n");
    followed->Tick(0.1);                                   // 0.3 s: one poll, and an append acts on the first poll
    CHECK(TextOf(*followed) == "1\n2\n");

    plain->Tick(0.3);                                      // not following: watchPollSeconds (1.0) governs
    CHECK(TextOf(*plain) == "1\n");
    plain->Tick(0.8);                                      // 1.1 s: one poll
    CHECK(TextOf(*plain) == "1\n2\n");

    followed->SetFollow(false);                            // back to the watch cadence
    AppendAll(followPath, "3\n");
    followed->Tick(0.3);
    CHECK(TextOf(*followed) == "1\n2\n");
    followed->Tick(0.8);
    CHECK(TextOf(*followed) == "1\n2\n3\n");
}

TEST_CASE("follow: a burst larger than editor.text.followChunkKB arrives over several polls and stays clean", "[text-follow]")
{
    const Test::ScopedCodeRung chunk("editor.text.followChunkKB", CVarValue::UInt32(4));   // 4096 bytes per poll
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te6-follow-burst");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "burst.log";
    WriteAll(p, "head\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    Type(*doc, "> ");
    REQUIRE(doc->Save());                                  // clean, with one undo entry
    REQUIRE(doc->Buffer().CanUndo());
    const std::uint64_t changeId = doc->Buffer().ChangeId();
    const std::uint64_t base = std::filesystem::file_size(p);   // "> head\n" = 7 bytes
    REQUIRE(base == 7u);

    std::string burst;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) burst += std::string(99, 'x') + "\n";   // 10000 bytes, no CR anywhere
    REQUIRE(burst.size() == 10000u);
    AppendAll(p, burst);

    doc->PollDisk();                                       // Follow is OFF: the cap applies to every append
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "> head\n" + burst.substr(0, 4096));
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == base + 4096u);       // synced size advanced by exactly what was appended
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "> head\n" + burst.substr(0, 8192));
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "> head\n" + burst);
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == base + 10000u);
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 3u);

    doc->PollDisk();                                       // nothing left: nothing changes
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "> head\n" + burst);
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 3u);

    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().ChangeId() == changeId);           // appends are not edits (spec s3.5)
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().CanUndo());                        // history intact...
    REQUIRE(doc->Buffer().Undo(doc->Model().selections));  // ...and the pre-append edit still undoes
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "head\n" + burst);
}

TEST_CASE("follow: a chunk cut between CR and LF holds the CR back -- the CRLF is appended whole, never a reload", "[text-follow]")
{
    const Test::ScopedCodeRung chunk("editor.text.followChunkKB", CVarValue::UInt32(4));
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te6-follow-crlf");

    SECTION("UTF-8: one byte held back")
    {
        const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "crlf.log";
        WriteAll(p, "a\r\n");
        auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
        const std::uint64_t changeId = doc->Buffer().ChangeId();
        REQUIRE_FALSE(doc->Buffer().CanUndo());
        const std::string ys(4095, 'y');
        AppendAll(p, ys + "\r\n" + "tail\r\n");           // byte 4096 of the tail is the CR

        doc->PollDisk();
        CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "a\n" + ys);                 // the CR waits with the rest
        CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 3u + 4095u);
        doc->PollDisk();
        CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "a\n" + ys + "\ntail\n");
        CHECK(doc->Buffer().Eols().Dominant() == Text::Eol::CRLF);
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().Eols().IsMixed());
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().CanUndo());              // a reload would have been one undoable step
        CHECK(doc->Buffer().ChangeId() == changeId);
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
        CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 2u);
    }

    SECTION("UTF-16LE: one two-byte unit held back")
    {
        const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "crlf16.log";
        WriteAll(p, std::string("\xFF\xFE", 2) + Utf16Le("a\r\n"));
        auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
        REQUIRE(doc->Encoding() == Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
        const std::uint64_t changeId = doc->Buffer().ChangeId();
        const std::string ys(2047, 'y');                   // 4094 bytes; bytes 4094..4095 are the CR unit
        AppendAll(p, Utf16Le(ys + "\r\n" + "z\r\n"));

        doc->PollDisk();
        CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "a\n" + ys);
        CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 8u + 4094u);     // BOM + "a\r\n" = 8 bytes
        doc->PollDisk();
        CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "a\n" + ys + "\nz\n");
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().CanUndo());
        CHECK(doc->Buffer().ChangeId() == changeId);
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
        CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 2u);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("follow: the status strip offers Follow for a .log, or once the file has grown under the document", "[text-follow]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te6-follow-available");
    const std::filesystem::path notes = s.dir / "notes.txt";
    const std::filesystem::path log = s.dir / "Game.LOG";
    WriteAll(notes, "a\n");
    WriteAll(log, "boot\n");

    auto logDoc = OpenOrFail(log);
    CHECK(logDoc->FollowAvailable());                      // the extension is compared lowercased (TE3-3 NormaliseExtension)

    auto doc = OpenOrFail(notes);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->FollowAvailable());
    AppendAll(notes, "b\n");
    doc->PollDisk();
    REQUIRE(doc->AppendCount() == 1u);
    CHECK(doc->FollowAvailable());                         // it grew: it behaves like a log
}
```

```cpp
    void TextDocument::Tick(double dt)
    {
        // Follow polls faster (spec s3.5: a followed log should feel live); every other
        // open document is checked at the watch cadence. Both read the same poll.
        const TextSettings& s = Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>();
        const double interval = Follow() ? s.followPollSeconds : s.watchPollSeconds;
        m_pollElapsed += dt;
        if (m_pollElapsed < interval)
            return;
        m_pollElapsed = 0.0;
        PollDisk();
    }
```

In TE2-17's `TextDocument::ObserveDisk(const FileStamp& now) const`, replace the `if (seen.change == DiskChange::Appended) { ... }` block (the tail read) whole -- everything before it (the window read and hash, `ClassifyDiskChange`) stays TE2-17's, and so do `PollDisk`'s two-equal-polls rule for replacements, `ActOnDisk` (`NoteExternalWrite`, the `DecideDiskAction` switch) and `AppendTail` (the `Text::DecodeFragment` decode in the document's encoding, the synced state advanced by the consumed bytes only):

```cpp
        if (seen.change == DiskChange::Appended)
        {
            // TE6-3: one poll reads at most editor.text.followChunkKB of the tail, Follow or
            // not -- a burst never stalls a frame; the rest arrives on the next polls, and the
            // document stays clean (AppendTail advances the synced size only by what it appended).
            const std::uint64_t available = now.size - oldSize;
            const std::uint64_t cap = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::max<std::uint32_t>(1u, Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().followChunkKB)) * 1024u;
            const std::uint64_t take = std::min(available, cap);
            if (std::optional<std::string> t = ReadRangeShared(m_canonical, oldSize, take))
            {
                seen.tail = std::move(*t);
                seen.tail.resize(CompleteTailLength(seen.tail, Encoding()));   // a partial character waits for the next poll
                if (take < available && !seen.tail.empty() && LastUnitOf(seen.tail, Encoding()) == u'\r')
                {
                    // Our own cut must never split a CRLF: a CR held back here arrives with its LF
                    // on the next poll. Left in, the next tail would start with LF after a CR and
                    // TailSplitsCrLf would turn a plain append into a full reload.
                    const Text::TextEncoding enc = Encoding();
                    const bool utf16 = enc == Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE || enc == Text::TextEncoding::Utf16BE;
                    seen.tail.resize(seen.tail.size() - (utf16 ? 2u : 1u));
                }
                seen.splitsCrLf = TailSplitsCrLf(m_synced.lastUnit, seen.tail, Encoding());
            }
            else
                seen.change = DiskChange::Rewritten;   // the tail could not be read: treat it as a replacement
        }
```

(`oldSize` is TE2-17's `m_synced.stamp.size`, captured at the top of `ObserveDisk`. `seen.tail` now holds complete characters only, so `AppendTail`'s own `CompleteTailLength` trim is a no-op on it. An empty `seen.tail` after the trims is TE2-17's "only a partial character so far" case: `AppendTail` returns without touching the synced state, and the next poll reads it whole. With `followChunkKB >= 1` the cap is at least 1024 bytes, so a trim can only empty a tail the writer itself left incomplete. `TextDocument.cpp` already includes `<algorithm>` for TE2-17's `std::min`.)

```cpp
#include <fstream>
#include <functional>
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Editor;
using Arcane::Text::Rope;

namespace
{
    struct ImGuiHarness   // TE2-13's bare-context harness
    {
        ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
        ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
        ImGuiHarness()
        {
            ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
            ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
            io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(1024, 768);
            io.IniFilename = nullptr;
            unsigned char* px = nullptr;
            int w = 0, h = 0;
            io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
        }
        ~ImGuiHarness()
        {
            ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
            ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
        }
        void Frame(const std::function<void()>& body)
        {
            ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
            ImGui::NewFrame();
            ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(0, 0));
            ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(600, 400));
            ImGui::Begin("doc", nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings);
            body();
            ImGui::End();
            ImGui::Render();
        }
    };

    std::string Rows(int n)
    {
        std::string s;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) s += "row " + std::to_string(i) + "\n";
        return s;   // n + 1 display rows (the empty last one)
    }

    std::filesystem::path WriteTemp(const char* name, const std::string& text)
    {
        const std::filesystem::path p = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name;
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary) << text;
        return p;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("follow toggle: text.toggleFollow is a TextDocument row, unbound by default, registered and conflict-free", "[text-follow]")
{
    const auto it = std::find_if(kTextActionTable.begin(), kTextActionTable.end(),
                                 [](const TextActionRow& r) { return r.desc.id == "text.toggleFollow"; });
    REQUIRE(it != kTextActionTable.end());
    CHECK(it->action == TextAction::ToggleFollow);
    CHECK(FindTextAction(TextAction::ToggleFollow) == &*it);
    CHECK(it->desc.context == ActionContext::TextDocument);
    CHECK_FALSE(it->repeats);
    const auto chord = ParseKeyChord(it->desc.defaultChord);
    REQUIRE(chord.has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(chord->Bound());                           // Ctrl+Shift+F stays free for spec 2's Find in Files
    for (const EditorActionDesc& d : kEditorActionTable) { INFO(d.id); CHECK(d.id != "text.toggleFollow"); }

    CVarRegistry reg;
    EditorActions actions(reg);
    RegisterEditorActions(actions);
    CHECK_FALSE(reg.Find("editor.keys.text.toggleFollow").IsStale());   // rebindable from the Shortcuts page
    CHECK(actions.ConflictsOf("text.toggleFollow").empty());
}

TEST_CASE("follow toggle: after a view frame, Follow survives unless the user scrolled away from the end", "[text-follow]")
{
    CHECK(FollowAfterViewFrame(true, /*userScrolled*/false, /*atEnd*/true));
    CHECK(FollowAfterViewFrame(true, false, false));            // an append moved the end; the next append chases it
    CHECK_FALSE(FollowAfterViewFrame(true, true, false));       // the user scrolled up: off
    CHECK(FollowAfterViewFrame(true, true, true));              // scrolling while at the end keeps it
    CHECK_FALSE(FollowAfterViewFrame(false, false, true));      // never turns itself on
    CHECK_FALSE(FollowAfterViewFrame(false, true, false));
}

TEST_CASE("follow view: ScrollToEnd puts the last row in view at the next Draw; AtEnd reads it", "[text-follow][text-view]")
{
    ImGuiHarness h;
    TextModel model(Rope::FromUtf8(Rows(200)));
    TextEditorView view(model);
    const auto draw = [&] { h.Frame([&] { view.Draw("##tv", ImVec2(0, 0), false); }); };
    draw();
    REQUIRE(view.VisibleRowCount() > 0u);
    REQUIRE(view.VisibleRowCount() < view.Display().DisplayRowCount());
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() == 0u);
    CHECK_FALSE(view.AtEnd());

    view.ScrollToEnd();
    CHECK(view.AtEnd());                                    // a pending ScrollToEnd counts
    draw();
    CHECK(view.AtEnd());
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() > 0u);
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() + view.VisibleRowCount() >= view.Display().DisplayRowCount());
    CHECK_FALSE(view.UserScrolledThisFrame());              // a programmatic scroll is never the user's
    draw();
    CHECK(view.AtEnd());                                    // ImGui's own clamp next frame keeps the end in view

    model.buffer.AppendExternal("more 1\nmore 2\nmore 3\n");   // the file grew: the end moved away
    draw();
    CHECK_FALSE(view.AtEnd());
    CHECK_FALSE(view.UserScrolledThisFrame());
    view.ScrollToEnd();
    draw();
    CHECK(view.AtEnd());

    TextModel shortModel(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\n"));
    TextEditorView shortView(shortModel);
    h.Frame([&] { shortView.Draw("##short", ImVec2(0, 0), false); });
    CHECK(shortView.AtEnd());                               // everything fits: the end is in view
}

TEST_CASE("follow view: a wheel scroll is the user's for one frame; a caret reveal counts when it lands", "[text-follow][text-view]")
{
    ImGuiHarness h;
    TextModel model(Rope::FromUtf8(Rows(200)));
    TextEditorView view(model);
    const auto draw = [&] { h.Frame([&] { view.Draw("##tv", ImVec2(0, 0), false); }); };
    draw();
    view.ScrollToEnd();
    draw();
    REQUIRE(view.AtEnd());

    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    const TextViewFacts f = view.Facts();
    io.AddMousePosEvent(f.clipMin.x + f.gutterWidth + 40.0f, f.clipMin.y + 40.0f);
    draw();                                                 // the hover lands
    CHECK_FALSE(view.UserScrolledThisFrame());
    io.AddMouseWheelEvent(0.0f, 3.0f);                      // wheel up
    draw();
    CHECK(view.UserScrolledThisFrame());
    CHECK_FALSE(view.AtEnd());
    draw();
    CHECK_FALSE(view.UserScrolledThisFrame());              // cleared at the start of the next Draw

    view.ScrollToEnd();
    draw();
    REQUIRE(view.AtEnd());
    view.RevealOffset(0, false);                            // what Ctrl+Home / PageUp do through EnsureCursorVisible
    draw();                                                 // the view asks ImGui for the scroll...
    draw();                                                 // ...which lands in this frame's Begin
    CHECK(view.UserScrolledThisFrame());
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() == 0u);
    CHECK_FALSE(view.AtEnd());
}

TEST_CASE("follow toggle: RunTextAction(ToggleFollow) flips Follow; turning it on asks the primary view for the end", "[text-follow]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path p = WriteTemp("te6-toggle-follow.log", Rows(200));
    std::string error;
    auto doc = TextDocument::Open(p, {}, error);
    INFO(error);
    REQUIRE(doc);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Follow());
    CHECK(doc->FollowAvailable());                          // a .log
    doc->RunTextAction(TextAction::ToggleFollow);
    CHECK(doc->Follow());
    CHECK(doc->View().AtEnd());                             // SetFollow(true) -> View().ScrollToEnd(), pending
    doc->RunTextAction(TextAction::ToggleFollow);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Follow());
    doc.reset();
    std::filesystem::remove(p);
}

TEST_CASE("follow toggle: scrolling the primary view away from the end turns Follow off; frames without a user scroll keep it", "[text-follow]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path p = WriteTemp("te6-auto-unfollow.log", Rows(200));
    std::string error;
    auto doc = TextDocument::Open(p, {}, error);
    REQUIRE(doc);
    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(1280, 800);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr; int w = 0, h = 0;
    io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
    const auto frame = [&] {
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(900, 600), ImGuiCond_Always);
        bool close = false;
        doc->Draw(close);
        ImGui::Render();
    };

    frame();                                                // the document settles (open-time focus, layout)
    doc->SetFollow(true);
    frame();
    frame();
    CHECK(doc->Follow());                                   // no user scroll: it stays on
    CHECK(doc->View().AtEnd());

    doc->View().RevealOffset(0, false);                     // a navigation key's reveal to the top
    frame();
    frame();
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Follow());                             // tail -f: reading back stops the chase

    doc->SetFollow(true);                                   // back on: scrolls to the end again
    frame();
    frame();
    CHECK(doc->Follow());
    CHECK(doc->View().AtEnd());

    doc.reset();
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
    std::filesystem::remove(p);
}

TEST_CASE("follow toggle: the status strip draws the toggle only when Follow is available and reports nothing unclicked", "[text-follow]")

    ImGuiHarness h;
    TextStatusStrip strip;

    state.encodingLabel = "UTF-8";

    for (const bool available : { false, true })
        for (const bool following : { false, true })
        {
            state.followAvailable = available;
            state.following = following;
            actions = {};
            h.Frame([&] { strip.Draw(state, actions); });
            CHECK_FALSE(actions.toggleFollow);
        }
}
```

  - `text-writer-fixture.exe`. It takes `--file <p> --share rw|rwd` followed by ops, executed in order:
    - `--append <text>` (`\n` in the text is a newline);
    - `--signal <name>`: creates `<p>.<name>`;
    - `--wait <name>`: waits up to 30 s for `<p>.<name>`, exit 4 on timeout;
    - `--rotate`: close, `MoveFileExW(p, p.1, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)`, reopen with `CREATE_ALWAYS`;
    - `--truncate`;
    - `--hold <ms>`.
  - Exit codes: 0 ok, 2 bad args, 3 Win32 failure (message on stderr with `GetLastError`), 4 wait timeout.
  - `Arcane::Test::ChildProcess` (`Started`, `Wait(ms)`, `ExitCode`).

Why this is a witness in the test process rather than a host run: the editor host has no way to type or watch a document from automation. The behaviour under test is entirely `TextDocument`'s disk poll (TE2-17) with Follow's cadence and chunk cap (TE6-3) against a real second process, real sharing modes, a real rename and a real truncation. The host adds only drawing, which TE6-23's log golden covers. The process boundary is the part that matters, so it is real.

TF-W4 is the witness reinforcement of CANON Review Focus F1 ("Follow never shows a log that is still being written"): TE2-17's own test (CANON C TE2 #12) grows a file between polls in-process; TF-W4 has a second process append a line every 100 ms for 3 s and requires the lines in the buffer while that process is still running.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextFollowWitnessTest.cpp
// s11.4: "open a log another process holds open for writing (no delete
// sharing), follow it while it grows, survive a rotation and a truncation";
// "a dirty document whose file grows shows the banner, not an append; an
// append to a clean document leaves it clean with its undo history intact".
// TF-W4 (CANON F1): lines appear while the writer is still writing.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/ChildProcess.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    std::filesystem::path FixtureExe() { return std::filesystem::current_path() / "text-writer-fixture.exe"; }
    std::filesystem::path Dir()
    {
        const auto d = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-text-follow-witness";
        std::error_code ec;
        std::filesystem::remove_all(d, ec);
        std::filesystem::create_directories(d);
        return d;
    }
    void Touch(const std::filesystem::path& p) { std::ofstream(p).put('x'); }
    bool Exists(const std::filesystem::path& p) { return std::filesystem::exists(p); }

    std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> OpenOrFail(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(p, {}, error);
        INFO(error);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        return doc;
    }

    // Ticks the document (TE2-17's poll; Follow's 0.25 s cadence when on) until `pred` holds or 10 s pass.
    template <class Pred> bool PumpUntil(TextDocument& doc, Pred pred)
    {
        const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(10);
        while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline)
        {
            doc.Tick(0.3);                                   // > followPollSeconds: every tick polls under Follow
            if (pred()) return true;
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));
        }
        return false;
    }
    std::string TextOf(TextDocument& d) { return d.Buffer().Text().ToString(); }

    // One user edit at the primary cursor through TE1's commands (one undo step).
    void Type(TextDocument& doc, std::string_view text)
    {
        Text::TextCommands(doc.Buffer(), doc.Model().selections, DefaultEditContext(doc.Model())).InsertText(text);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("TF-W1: follow a log another process writes (no delete sharing) through growth, rotation and truncation", "[witness][text]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    const auto log = dir / "game.log";
    { std::ofstream(log, std::ios::binary) << "[info] boot\n"; }

    auto doc = OpenOrFail(log);
    doc->SetFollow(true);

    Test::ChildProcess writer(FixtureExe(), {
        "--file", log.string(), "--share", "rw",
        "--wait", "opened",
        "--append", "[warn] one\\n", "--signal", "s1", "--wait", "g1",
        "--rotate", "--append", "[info] fresh\\n", "--signal", "s2", "--wait", "g2",
        "--append", "[info] more\\n", "--truncate", "--append", "[error] after truncate\\n", "--signal", "s3",
        "--hold", "500" });
    REQUIRE(writer.Started());
    Touch(log.string() + ".opened");

    // growth: appended, still clean, nothing on the undo stack
    REQUIRE(PumpUntil(*doc, [&] { return TextOf(*doc) == "[info] boot\n[warn] one\n"; }));
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().Dirty());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().CanUndo());                    // an append is not an undo entry (s3.5)
    Touch(log.string() + ".g1");

    // rotation: game.log was renamed to game.log.1 and re-created -> a reload, not an append
    REQUIRE(PumpUntil(*doc, [&] { return TextOf(*doc) == "[info] fresh\n"; }));
    CHECK(Exists(dir / "game.log.1"));
    CHECK(doc->Follow());                                    // a rotation does not stop following
    Touch(log.string() + ".g2");

    // truncation (then new text): a reload to the truncated-then-appended content
    REQUIRE(PumpUntil(*doc, [&] { return TextOf(*doc) == "[error] after truncate\n"; }));
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().Dirty());

    REQUIRE(writer.Wait(30000));
    CHECK(writer.ExitCode() == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("TF-W2: a dirty document whose file grows shows the banner and appends nothing", "[witness][text]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    const auto log = dir / "notes.txt";
    { std::ofstream(log, std::ios::binary) << "a\n"; }
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(log);
    Type(*doc, "X");                                         // one user edit: dirty
    REQUIRE(doc->Buffer().Dirty());

    Test::ChildProcess writer(FixtureExe(), { "--file", log.string(), "--share", "rw", "--append", "b\\n" });
    REQUIRE(writer.Wait(10000));
    CHECK(writer.ExitCode() == 0);
    doc->PollDisk();
    doc->PollDisk();                                         // a second equal look: whatever TE2-17 debounces has settled
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "Xa\n");                           // nothing appended into a dirty buffer
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::ChangedOnDisk);   // TE2-17's s5.3 dirty banner
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Dirty());
}

TEST_CASE("TF-W3: an append to a clean document keeps it clean with its undo history intact", "[witness][text]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    const auto log = dir / "notes.txt";
    { std::ofstream(log, std::ios::binary) << "a\n"; }
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(log);
    Type(*doc, "X");
    REQUIRE(doc->Save());                                    // clean, with one undo entry
    REQUIRE_FALSE(doc->Buffer().Dirty());
    const std::uint64_t changeId = doc->Buffer().ChangeId();

    Test::ChildProcess writer(FixtureExe(), { "--file", log.string(), "--share", "rw", "--append", "b\\n" });
    REQUIRE(writer.Wait(10000));
    CHECK(writer.ExitCode() == 0);
    doc->PollDisk();
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "Xa\nb\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().Dirty());                      // s3.5: changeId == savedChangeId still
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().ChangeId() == changeId);
    REQUIRE(doc->Buffer().Undo(doc->Model().selections));   // the pre-append edit is still undoable
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "a\nb\n");
}

TEST_CASE("TF-W4: a followed log shows its lines while the writer is still writing them (CANON F1)", "[witness][text]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    const auto log = dir / "live.log";
    { std::ofstream(log, std::ios::binary) << "[info] start\n"; }
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(log);
    doc->SetFollow(true);
    const bool canUndo = doc->Buffer().CanUndo();
    const std::uint64_t changeId = doc->Buffer().ChangeId();

    // One line every 100 ms for 3 s: the stamp changes on almost every poll, so an
    // append that waited for two equal stamps would show nothing until the end.
    std::vector<std::string> args = { "--file", log.string(), "--share", "rw" };
    std::string expected = "[info] start\n";
    for (int i = 0; i < 30; ++i)
    {
        args.push_back("--append");
        args.push_back("tick " + std::to_string(i) + "\\n");
        args.push_back("--hold");
        args.push_back("100");
        expected += "tick " + std::to_string(i) + "\n";
    }
    Test::ChildProcess writer(FixtureExe(), args);
    REQUIRE(writer.Started());

    REQUIRE(PumpUntil(*doc, [&] { return TextOf(*doc).find("tick 5\n") != std::string::npos; }));
    CHECK_FALSE(writer.Wait(0));                             // the writer is still running (tick 5 lands ~0.6 s into 3 s)
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc).starts_with("[info] start\ntick 0\ntick 1\n"));   // in order, nothing lost or doubled
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().CanUndo() == canUndo);               // appends never touch the history
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().ChangeId() == changeId);

    REQUIRE(PumpUntil(*doc, [&] { return TextOf(*doc) == expected; }));
    REQUIRE(writer.Wait(30000));
    CHECK(writer.ExitCode() == 0);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().CanUndo() == canUndo);
    CHECK(doc->Follow());
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/ChildProcess.hpp
#pragma once
// A child process that runs WHILE the test does (HostWitness::RunWitness
// waits for exit; a follow witness must interleave). No window, no pipes.
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <Windows.h>

namespace Arcane::Test
{
    class ChildProcess
    {
    public:
        ChildProcess(const std::filesystem::path& exe, const std::vector<std::string>& args)
        {
            std::wstring cmd = L"\"" + exe.wstring() + L"\"";
            for (const std::string& a : args)
                cmd += L" \"" + std::filesystem::path(a).wstring() + L"\"";
            STARTUPINFOW si{};
            si.cb = sizeof(si);
            PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
            if (::CreateProcessW(exe.c_str(), cmd.data(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
                                 nullptr, nullptr, &si, &pi))
            {
                m_process = pi.hProcess;
                ::CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
            }
        }
        ~ChildProcess()
        {
            if (!m_process) return;
            if (::WaitForSingleObject(m_process, 0) == WAIT_TIMEOUT)
                ::TerminateProcess(m_process, 99);
            ::CloseHandle(m_process);
        }
        ChildProcess(const ChildProcess&) = delete;
        ChildProcess& operator=(const ChildProcess&) = delete;

        [[nodiscard]] bool Started() const noexcept { return m_process != nullptr; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool Wait(std::uint32_t ms) const { return m_process && ::WaitForSingleObject(m_process, ms) == WAIT_OBJECT_0; }
        [[nodiscard]] int ExitCode() const
        {
            DWORD code = 0;
            return m_process && ::GetExitCodeProcess(m_process, &code) ? static_cast<int>(code) : -1;
        }

    private:
        HANDLE m_process = nullptr;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/text-writer-fixture/TextWriterFixtureMain.cpp
// A log writer for the text editor's follow witness (TE6-5). Holds the file
// open for WRITING between ops with FILE_SHARE_READ|FILE_SHARE_WRITE ("rw",
// no delete sharing: the common logger case s11.4 names) or with
// FILE_SHARE_DELETE too ("rwd"). Ops run in argv order. Dependency-free.
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <Windows.h>

#include <cstdio>
#include <cwchar>
#include <string>

namespace
{
    std::wstring g_file;
    DWORD g_share = FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE;
    HANDLE g_h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;

    int Fail(const char* what)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "text-writer-fixture: %s failed (GetLastError %lu)\n", what, ::GetLastError());
        return 3;
    }
    bool Open(DWORD disposition)
    {
        g_h = ::CreateFileW(g_file.c_str(), FILE_APPEND_DATA | GENERIC_WRITE, g_share, nullptr, disposition,
                            FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
        return g_h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    }
    std::string Unescape(const wchar_t* w)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const wchar_t* p = w; *p; ++p)
        {
            if (p[0] == L'\\' && p[1] == L'n') { out += '\n'; ++p; continue; }
            out += static_cast<char>(*p);   // ASCII payloads only (witness text)
        }
        return out;
    }
    bool WaitFor(const std::wstring& path)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < 3000; ++i)                // 30 s
        {
            if (::GetFileAttributesW(path.c_str()) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) return true;
            ::Sleep(10);
        }
        return false;
    }
}

int wmain(int argc, wchar_t** argv)
{
    int i = 1;
    for (; i + 1 < argc; i += 2)
    {
        const std::wstring k = argv[i];
        if (k == L"--file") g_file = argv[i + 1];
        else if (k == L"--share")
            g_share = std::wstring(argv[i + 1]) == L"rwd" ? (FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE)
                                                          : (FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE);
        else break;
    }
    if (g_file.empty()) return 2;
    if (!Open(OPEN_ALWAYS)) return Fail("CreateFileW");

    for (; i < argc; ++i)
    {
        const std::wstring op = argv[i];
        const bool hasArg = i + 1 < argc;
        if (op == L"--append" && hasArg)
        {
            const std::string s = Unescape(argv[++i]);
            DWORD n = 0;
            if (!::WriteFile(g_h, s.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(s.size()), &n, nullptr) || n != s.size()) return Fail("WriteFile");
            ::FlushFileBuffers(g_h);
        }
        else if (op == L"--signal" && hasArg)
        {
            const std::wstring p = g_file + L"." + argv[++i];
            HANDLE s = ::CreateFileW(p.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
            if (s == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return Fail("signal");
            ::CloseHandle(s);
        }
        else if (op == L"--wait" && hasArg)
        {
            if (!WaitFor(g_file + L"." + argv[++i])) return 4;
        }
        else if (op == L"--rotate")
        {
            ::CloseHandle(g_h);
            const std::wstring rotated = g_file + L".1";
            if (!::MoveFileExW(g_file.c_str(), rotated.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)) return Fail("MoveFileExW");
            if (!Open(CREATE_ALWAYS)) return Fail("CreateFileW (rotate)");
        }
        else if (op == L"--truncate")
        {
            LARGE_INTEGER zero{};
            if (!::SetFilePointerEx(g_h, zero, nullptr, FILE_BEGIN) || !::SetEndOfFile(g_h)) return Fail("truncate");
        }
        else if (op == L"--hold" && hasArg)
        {
            ::Sleep(static_cast<DWORD>(std::wcstoul(argv[++i], nullptr, 10)));
        }
        else return 2;
    }
    ::CloseHandle(g_h);
    return 0;
}
```

### Task TE6-21: `VcsProbe` -- walk up for git (+ Git LFS `lockable`), Perforce, Lore, Unity Version Control (D14, spec s5.3)

**Lane (CANON E):** TE6-21 is lane L6 -- pure, it can start any time (no producer dependency) and merges before TE6-22, which consumes it.

**Research behind each detector.** Verified 2026-10-07; the sources are in the TE6 report.

| VCS | Marker | Does it set read-only? |
|---|---|---|
| Git | `.git` **directory, or file** (`gitdir: <path>`: worktrees, submodules) | No, except Git LFS below |
| Git LFS | a `.gitattributes` line with the `lockable` attribute set (`git lfs track --lockable` writes `<pat> filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text lockable`). `$GIT_DIR/info/attributes` is also read. | **Yes.** The post-checkout/merge/commit hooks make lockable files read-only unless locked by you (`lfs.setlockablereadonly`, default true). git-lfs's own matcher collects lines where `lockable` is set and ignores `-lockable` / `!lockable` lines (git-lfs `locking/lockable.go`); the probe matches git-lfs, not strict last-line-wins gitattributes. |
| Perforce | the file named by `P4CONFIG` (env var, else `p4 set`'s registry value at `HKCU\Software\Perforce\environment`), searched from the directory upward. `P4CONFIG` has no default; `.p4config` is checked too as the common convention. | **Yes** by default (`noallwrite`: unopened files are read-only) |
| Lore (Epic) | a `.lore` **directory** (legacy `.urc`), any ASCII case, at the working-tree root (`lore-client/src/cli/util.rs` `get_repository_path`) | **No.** Lore "informs rather than blocks" (docs/faq.md). No code sets read-only as of `6e87521`. SWFS instances keep `.lore` outside the tree and are not found by a walk-up (stated limit). |
| Unity Version Control (Plastic SCM) | a `.plastic` directory at the workspace root holding `plastic.workspace` / `plastic.selector` (Plastic SCM book p.221) | Only when the opt-in `SetFilesAsReadOnly` client setting is on, or via `readonly.conf` (book p.227) |

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.cpp`
- Modify: `premake5.lua`, the ArcaneTests `files` list: add `VcsProbe.cpp`.
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VcsProbeTest.cpp`, tag `[text-vcs]`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nothing beyond `<filesystem>` and Win32 `RegGetValueW`.
- Produces:
  - `enum class VcsKind { None, Git, GitLfsLockable, Perforce, Lore, UnityVcs }`
  - `struct VcsGuess { VcsKind kind; std::filesystem::path root; std::string detail; }`
  - `struct VcsProbeEnv { std::optional<std::string> p4config; }`: injected in tests; `VcsProbeEnv::FromSystem()` reads `P4CONFIG` and then the registry
  - `VcsGuess ProbeVcs(const std::filesystem::path& file, const VcsProbeEnv& env)`
  - `bool GitLfsLockable(std::string_view attributesText, const std::filesystem::path& attrDir, const std::filesystem::path& file)`
  - `bool GitPatternMatches(std::string_view pattern, std::string_view relPath)`

  Rules:
  - The walk goes from the file's directory up to the volume root. The **first** directory holding any marker decides; the nearest workspace wins.
  - Within one directory the order is:
    1. Git with the path lockable -> `GitLfsLockable`;
    2. Perforce;
    3. Unity VCS;
    4. Lore;
    5. Git.
  - Matching is case-insensitive (Windows `core.ignorecase` default; Lore's "any ASCII case").
  - The probe is cheap: a few `exists` calls per level, and reads only `.gitattributes` / `info/attributes` text.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VcsProbeTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp"

#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

namespace
{
    // NOT the suite's TEMP: the gate sets TEMP to <worktree>\.tmp-tests, which
    // sits inside the Arcane-text git worktree, so every probe there would
    // find that .git. %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp is wrapped by no repository; Root()
    // proves it per fixture before any check runs.
    fs::path ProbeBase()
    {
        const char* lad = std::getenv("LOCALAPPDATA");
        REQUIRE(lad != nullptr);
        return fs::path(lad) / "Temp" / "arcane-vcsprobe";
    }
    fs::path Root(const char* name)
    {
        const fs::path r = ProbeBase() / name;
        fs::remove_all(r);
        fs::create_directories(r);
        const fs::path probe = r / "pollution-probe.txt";
        std::ofstream(probe) << "x";
        INFO("a VCS marker sits above " << r.string() << " -- the fixtures need a marker-free ancestry");
        REQUIRE(ProbeVcs(probe, VcsProbeEnv{}).kind == VcsKind::None);
        fs::remove(probe);
        return r;
    }
    void Put(const fs::path& p, std::string_view text = "x")
    {
        fs::create_directories(p.parent_path());
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary) << text;
    }
    const VcsProbeEnv kNoP4{};
}

TEST_CASE("vcs probe: git patterns follow gitignore placement rules", "[text-vcs]")
{
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("*.psd", "art/deep/hero.psd"));          // no slash: basename at any depth
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("*.PSD", "art/hero.psd"));               // case-insensitive (Windows core.ignorecase)
    CHECK_FALSE(GitPatternMatches("*.psd", "art/hero.png"));
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("/art/*.psd", "art/hero.psd"));          // leading slash: anchored
    CHECK_FALSE(GitPatternMatches("/art/*.psd", "x/art/hero.psd"));
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("art/*.psd", "art/hero.psd"));           // a middle slash anchors too
    CHECK_FALSE(GitPatternMatches("art/*.psd", "art/sub/hero.psd")); // '*' never crosses '/'
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("art/**/*.psd", "art/a/b/hero.psd"));
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("**/maps/*.umap", "Content/maps/l1.umap"));
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("Content/**", "Content/a/b.uasset"));
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("hero?.psd", "hero1.psd"));
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("hero[0-9].psd", "hero7.psd"));
}

TEST_CASE("vcs probe: Git LFS lockable patterns (git-lfs semantics)", "[text-vcs]")
{
    const fs::path root = Root("lfs");
    const std::string attrs =
        "*.txt text\n"
        "*.psd filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text lockable\n"
        "Maps/*.umap filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text lockable\n"
        "*.png filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text -lockable\n";
    CHECK(GitLfsLockable(attrs, root, root / "art" / "hero.psd"));
    CHECK(GitLfsLockable(attrs, root, root / "Maps" / "l1.umap"));
    CHECK_FALSE(GitLfsLockable(attrs, root, root / "Other" / "Maps" / "l1.umap"));   // anchored pattern
    CHECK_FALSE(GitLfsLockable(attrs, root, root / "a.png"));                       // -lockable is not "set"
    CHECK_FALSE(GitLfsLockable(attrs, root, root / "notes.txt"));
    CHECK_FALSE(GitLfsLockable("# *.psd lockable\n", root, root / "a.psd"));        // comments
}

TEST_CASE("vcs probe: each VCS is identified from a temp-directory fixture", "[text-vcs]")
{
    SECTION("git LFS lockable")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("git-lfs");
        fs::create_directories(r / ".git");
        Put(r / ".gitattributes", "*.psd filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text lockable\n");
        Put(r / "art" / "hero.psd");
        Put(r / "art" / "readme.md");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "art" / "hero.psd", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::GitLfsLockable);
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "art" / "readme.md", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Git);
    }
    SECTION("git LFS lockable from a nested .gitattributes and from .git/info/attributes")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("git-lfs-nested");
        fs::create_directories(r / ".git" / "info");
        Put(r / ".git" / "info" / "attributes", "*.wav lockable\n");
        Put(r / "Content" / ".gitattributes", "*.uasset lockable\n");
        Put(r / "Content" / "a.uasset");
        Put(r / "Content" / "b.wav");
        Put(r / "a.uasset");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "Content" / "a.uasset", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::GitLfsLockable);
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "Content" / "b.wav", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::GitLfsLockable);
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "a.uasset", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Git);       // the nested file's patterns are relative to Content/
    }
    SECTION(".git as a FILE (worktree / submodule)")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("git-file");
        Put(r / ".git", "gitdir: D:/elsewhere/.git/worktrees/x\n");
        Put(r / "a.txt");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "a.txt", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Git);
    }
    SECTION("Perforce via .p4config, and via a custom P4CONFIG name")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("p4");
        Put(r / ".p4config", "P4CLIENT=ws\n");
        Put(r / "Source" / "a.ini");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "Source" / "a.ini", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Perforce);
        const fs::path r2 = Root("p4-custom");
        Put(r2 / "p4.cfg", "P4CLIENT=ws\n");
        Put(r2 / "b.ini");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r2 / "b.ini", VcsProbeEnv{ "p4.cfg" }).kind == VcsKind::Perforce);
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r2 / "b.ini", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::None);
    }
    SECTION("Lore: a .lore directory, the legacy .urc, any case; a .lore FILE is not a workspace")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("lore");
        fs::create_directories(r / ".lore");
        Put(r / "a.json");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "a.json", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Lore);
        const fs::path r2 = Root("urc");
        fs::create_directories(r2 / ".URC");
        Put(r2 / "a.json");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r2 / "a.json", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Lore);
        const fs::path r3 = Root("lore-file");
        Put(r3 / ".lore");
        Put(r3 / "a.json");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r3 / "a.json", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::None);
    }
    SECTION("Unity Version Control: .plastic with plastic.workspace; an empty .plastic is not enough")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("plastic");
        Put(r / ".plastic" / "plastic.workspace", "ws\n");
        Put(r / "Assets" / "a.prefab");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "Assets" / "a.prefab", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::UnityVcs);
        const fs::path r2 = Root("plastic-empty");
        fs::create_directories(r2 / ".plastic");
        Put(r2 / "a.prefab");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r2 / "a.prefab", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::None);
    }
    SECTION("nearest workspace wins; same directory: lockable git > Perforce > Unity > Lore > git")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("nested");
        Put(r / ".p4config");
        fs::create_directories(r / "sub" / ".git");
        Put(r / "sub" / "a.txt");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "sub" / "a.txt", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Git);
        const fs::path r2 = Root("same-dir");
        fs::create_directories(r2 / ".git");
        Put(r2 / ".p4config");
        Put(r2 / "a.txt");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r2 / "a.txt", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Perforce);
    }
    SECTION("none found")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("none");
        Put(r / "a.txt");
        const VcsGuess g = ProbeVcs(r / "a.txt", kNoP4);
        CHECK(g.kind == VcsKind::None);
    }
}
```

`Root()` puts the fixtures under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp`, and each fixture REQUIREs a marker-free ancestry first. That way a polluted machine fails loudly instead of passing wrong: the "none found" and custom-P4CONFIG cases are only meaningful with nothing above the fixture.

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp
#pragma once
// D14 (text editor spec s5.3): a read-only file in a game project usually
// means LOCKED BY SOURCE CONTROL. VcsProbe walks up from a file and names the
// likely VCS so the save banner can word itself; it never runs a VCS tool.
// It is the seam the source-control spec (s12.3: git first, then Lore) extends.
#include <filesystem>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    enum class VcsKind : std::uint8_t { None, Git, GitLfsLockable, Perforce, Lore, UnityVcs };

    struct VcsGuess
    {
        VcsKind               kind = VcsKind::None;
        std::filesystem::path root;     // the directory holding the marker
        std::string           detail;   // e.g. the P4CONFIG file name, the matching .gitattributes
    };

    struct VcsProbeEnv
    {
        std::optional<std::string> p4config;   // P4CONFIG's value; nullopt = unset
        static VcsProbeEnv FromSystem();       // env var P4CONFIG, else HKCU\Software\Perforce\environment\P4CONFIG
    };

    [[nodiscard]] VcsGuess ProbeVcs(const std::filesystem::path& file, const VcsProbeEnv& env);
    // gitignore-style pattern against a '/'-separated path relative to the attributes file's directory.
    [[nodiscard]] bool GitPatternMatches(std::string_view pattern, std::string_view relPath);
    // git-lfs semantics: any line whose pattern matches and which SETS lockable.
    [[nodiscard]] bool GitLfsLockable(std::string_view attributesText, const std::filesystem::path& attrDir,
                                      const std::filesystem::path& file);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp"

#include <cctype>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>

#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <Windows.h>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    namespace
    {
        char Fold(char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))); }

        // Glob over one path: '*' and '?' never cross '/', "**" crosses
        // directories, [..] classes (with '!' or '^' negation and ranges).
        bool Glob(std::string_view p, std::string_view s)
        {
            if (p.empty()) return s.empty();
            if (p.starts_with("**"))
            {
                std::string_view rest = p.substr(2);
                if (rest.starts_with('/')) rest.remove_prefix(1);
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i <= s.size(); ++i)
                    if ((i == 0 || s[i - 1] == '/' || rest.empty()) && Glob(rest, s.substr(i))) return true;
                return false;
            }
            if (p[0] == '*')
            {
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i <= s.size(); ++i)
                {
                    if (Glob(p.substr(1), s.substr(i))) return true;
                    if (i < s.size() && s[i] == '/') break;
                }
                return false;
            }
            if (s.empty()) return false;
            if (p[0] == '?') return s[0] != '/' && Glob(p.substr(1), s.substr(1));
            if (p[0] == '[')
            {
                const std::size_t close = p.find(']', 1);
                if (close != std::string_view::npos)
                {
                    std::string_view cls = p.substr(1, close - 1);
                    const bool neg = !cls.empty() && (cls[0] == '!' || cls[0] == '^');
                    if (neg) cls.remove_prefix(1);
                    bool hit = false;
                    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < cls.size(); ++i)
                    {
                        if (i + 2 < cls.size() && cls[i + 1] == '-')
                        {
                            if (Fold(s[0]) >= Fold(cls[i]) && Fold(s[0]) <= Fold(cls[i + 2])) hit = true;
                            i += 2;
                        }
                        else if (Fold(s[0]) == Fold(cls[i])) hit = true;
                    }
                    return hit != neg && s[0] != '/' && Glob(p.substr(close + 1), s.substr(1));
                }
            }
            if (p[0] == '\\' && p.size() > 1) return Fold(p[1]) == Fold(s[0]) && Glob(p.substr(2), s.substr(1));
            return Fold(p[0]) == Fold(s[0]) && Glob(p.substr(1), s.substr(1));
        }

        std::string ReadText(const fs::path& p)
        {
            std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
            std::stringstream ss;
            ss << f.rdbuf();
            return ss.str();
        }

        bool IsDir(const fs::path& p) { std::error_code ec; return fs::is_directory(p, ec); }
        bool Exists(const fs::path& p) { std::error_code ec; return fs::exists(p, ec); }

        std::string Rel(const fs::path& from, const fs::path& file)
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            return fs::relative(file, from, ec).generic_string();
        }
    }

    bool GitPatternMatches(std::string_view pattern, std::string_view relPath)
    {
        std::string_view pat = pattern;
        if (pat.ends_with('/')) pat.remove_suffix(1);         // a directory pattern: gitattributes never matches files by it
        const bool anchored = pat.find('/') != std::string_view::npos;
        if (pat.starts_with('/')) pat.remove_prefix(1);
        if (anchored) return Glob(pat, relPath);
        const std::size_t slash = relPath.rfind('/');
        return Glob(pat, slash == std::string_view::npos ? relPath : relPath.substr(slash + 1));
    }

    bool GitLfsLockable(std::string_view text, const fs::path& attrDir, const fs::path& file)
    {
        const std::string rel = Rel(attrDir, file);
        if (rel.empty() || rel.starts_with("..")) return false;
        std::istringstream in{ std::string(text) };
        for (std::string line; std::getline(in, line);)
        {
            if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
            std::istringstream words(line);
            std::string pattern;
            if (!(words >> pattern) || pattern.starts_with('#')) continue;
            bool lockable = false;
            for (std::string a; words >> a;)
                if (a == "lockable" || a == "lockable=true") lockable = true;   // -lockable / !lockable: not set (git-lfs skips them)
            if (lockable && GitPatternMatches(pattern, rel)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    VcsProbeEnv VcsProbeEnv::FromSystem()
    {
        VcsProbeEnv env;
        if (const char* v = std::getenv("P4CONFIG"); v && *v) { env.p4config = v; return env; }
        wchar_t buf[512]{};
        DWORD bytes = sizeof(buf);
        if (::RegGetValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, L"Software\\Perforce\\environment", L"P4CONFIG",
                           RRF_RT_REG_SZ, nullptr, buf, &bytes) == ERROR_SUCCESS && buf[0] != L'\0')
            env.p4config = fs::path(buf).string();
        return env;
    }

    VcsGuess ProbeVcs(const fs::path& file, const VcsProbeEnv& env)
    {
        std::error_code ec;
        fs::path dir = fs::absolute(file, ec).parent_path();
        std::vector<fs::path> walked;                              // the file's dir upward, for .gitattributes
        while (!dir.empty())
        {
            walked.push_back(dir);
            const fs::path git = dir / ".git";
            const bool hasGit = Exists(git);                      // directory OR gitfile
            bool lockable = false;
            if (hasGit)
            {
                for (const fs::path& d : walked)                   // every .gitattributes between file and root
                    if (const fs::path a = d / ".gitattributes"; Exists(a) && GitLfsLockable(ReadText(a), d, file))
                        lockable = true;
                if (IsDir(git))
                    if (const fs::path info = git / "info" / "attributes"; Exists(info) && GitLfsLockable(ReadText(info), dir, file))
                        lockable = true;
            }
            const bool p4 = (env.p4config && Exists(dir / *env.p4config)) || Exists(dir / ".p4config");
            const bool unity = IsDir(dir / ".plastic") &&
                               (Exists(dir / ".plastic" / "plastic.workspace") || Exists(dir / ".plastic" / "plastic.selector"));
            const bool lore = IsDir(dir / ".lore") || IsDir(dir / ".urc");   // NTFS lookups are case-insensitive
            if (hasGit && lockable) return { VcsKind::GitLfsLockable, dir, ".gitattributes lockable" };
            if (p4)                 return { VcsKind::Perforce, dir, env.p4config.value_or(".p4config") };
            if (unity)              return { VcsKind::UnityVcs, dir, ".plastic" };
            if (lore)               return { VcsKind::Lore, dir, ".lore" };
            if (hasGit)             return { VcsKind::Git, dir, ".git" };
            const fs::path parent = dir.parent_path();
            if (parent == dir) break;
            dir = parent;
        }
        return {};
    }
}
```

### Task TE6-22: The D14 wording: VcsReadOnlyReason over TE2-16's read-only banner (spec s5.3, D14)

**Ownership (CANON B3):** TE2-16 owns the D14 mechanics -- the `SaveReadOnly` / `SaveAccessDenied` banners, Save As first, the `RemoveReadOnlyAndSave` -> `ConfirmRemoveReadOnly` confirm step and `SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic` (the one place the read-only flag is cleared). This task supplies only the wording: the phrase TE2-16 inserts through `TextDocumentServices::readOnlyReason`. There is no second banner, no banner id string, and no second remove path. **Order (CANON E):** after TE6-21 (lane L6 merges first) and TE2-16/TE2-20.

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp` / `.cpp` (TE6-21's files): add `VcsReadOnlyReason`.
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorApp.cpp`: in TE2-20's text-route block (the `Arcane::Editor::TextRouteServices text;` block after the `.arcinput` `RegisterFactory` call), set `text.document.readOnlyReason`; add `#include "TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp"`.
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VcsReadOnlyReasonTest.cpp`, tags `[text-vcs]` (the phrases) and `[witness][text]` (the phrases inside TE2-16's banner flow on real files).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - TE6-21 `enum class VcsKind`, `struct VcsGuess`, `struct VcsProbeEnv` (`FromSystem()`), `VcsGuess ProbeVcs(const std::filesystem::path&, const VcsProbeEnv&)`
  - TE2-16 `TextDocumentServices::readOnlyReason` (`std::function<std::string(const std::filesystem::path&)>`; null = "it may be under version control"), `TextDocumentServices::saveOps` (`const SaveFileOps*`), `TextBannerKind::{SaveReadOnly, SaveAccessDenied, None}`, `TextBannerAction::{SaveAs, RemoveReadOnlyAndSave, ConfirmRemoveReadOnly, Cancel}`, `TextBanner::{kind, message, confirmingRemoveReadOnly}`, `BannerActions(const TextBanner&)`, `TextDocument::Save()`, `Banner()`, `ApplyBannerAction(TextBannerAction)`. TE2-16 builds the messages as `"'<name>' is read-only -- " + phrase + ". ..."`, the confirm step as `"Remove the read-only flag from '<name>' and save? " + phrase + " -- ..."` (CANON C TE2 #10e: the confirm repeats the phrase), and an ACL denial as `"Windows denied writing '<name>' -- " + phrase + ". Save As keeps your changes elsewhere."` with actions `{ SaveAs, Cancel }`.
  - TE2-6 `struct SaveFileOps { replaceFile; moveFile; listHolders; }` (the test injects an `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED` replace to produce the ACL case)
  - TE2-15 `TextDocument::Open(path, services, error)`, `Buffer()`, `Model()`; TE2-11 `DefaultEditContext(TextModel&)`; TE1 `Text::TextCommands(...).InsertText(std::string_view)`
- Produces:
  - `std::string VcsReadOnlyReason(const VcsGuess&)`: the D14 phrase -- lower-case start, no file name, no trailing period, so it reads inside each of TE2-16's three sentences.
  - the app wiring `text.document.readOnlyReason = [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return VcsReadOnlyReason(ProbeVcs(p, VcsProbeEnv::FromSystem())); };`

  The phrases (spec s5.3; the research table in TE6-21):

  | `VcsKind` | Phrase |
  |---|---|
  | `GitLfsLockable` | `it is a Git LFS lockable file: lock it first (git lfs lock), then save` |
  | `Perforce` | `it is not checked out in Perforce: check it out (p4 edit), then save` |
  | `UnityVcs` | `Unity Version Control can keep files read-only until you check them out` |
  | `Lore` | `it is inside a Lore workspace; Lore marks locks without setting read-only, so another tool or teammate did` |
  | `Git` | `it is in a Git repository and may be locked by your team's workflow` |
  | `None` | `it may be under version control` (the same words as TE2-16's null-service default) |

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VcsReadOnlyReasonTest.cpp
// D14 (spec s5.3): the read-only save banner is TE2-16's; this task words it.
// The phrases name the likely VCS; the banner flow tests run TE2-16's real
// save path with the app's exact readOnlyReason lambda.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <memory>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <Windows.h>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Editor;
using A = TextBannerAction;

namespace
{
    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            Clear();
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir() { Clear(); }
        void Clear()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            if (std::filesystem::exists(dir, ec))
                for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator(dir, ec))
                    ::SetFileAttributesW(e.path().c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL);
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, const std::string& bytes) { std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary) << bytes; }

    std::string ReadAll(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::ifstream in(p, std::ios::binary);
        std::stringstream ss;
        ss << in.rdbuf();
        return ss.str();
    }

    // Exactly the app's wiring (EditorApp.cpp, TE2-20's text-route block).
    TextDocumentServices VcsServices()
    {
        TextDocumentServices s;
        s.readOnlyReason = [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return VcsReadOnlyReason(ProbeVcs(p, VcsProbeEnv::FromSystem())); };
        return s;
    }

    std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> OpenOrFail(const std::filesystem::path& p, TextDocumentServices s)
    {
        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(p, std::move(s), error);
        INFO(error);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        return doc;
    }

    void TypeAtStart(TextDocument& doc, std::string_view text)
    {
        doc.Model().selections.SetSingle(0, 0);
        Text::TextCommands(doc.Buffer(), doc.Model().selections, DefaultEditContext(doc.Model())).InsertText(text);
    }

    bool Has(const std::string& haystack, const std::string& needle) { return haystack.find(needle) != std::string::npos; }

    std::uint32_t DeniedReplace(const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*) { return ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED; }
    std::uint32_t PassMove(const wchar_t* from, const wchar_t* to, std::uint32_t flags)
    {
        return ::MoveFileExW(from, to, flags) ? 0u : ::GetLastError();
    }
    const SaveFileOps kAclDeniedOps{ &DeniedReplace, &PassMove, nullptr };
}

TEST_CASE("vcs read-only reason: the D14 phrase names the likely VCS", "[text-vcs]")
{
    CHECK(VcsReadOnlyReason({ VcsKind::GitLfsLockable }) == "it is a Git LFS lockable file: lock it first (git lfs lock), then save");
    CHECK(VcsReadOnlyReason({ VcsKind::Perforce }) == "it is not checked out in Perforce: check it out (p4 edit), then save");
    CHECK(VcsReadOnlyReason({ VcsKind::UnityVcs }) == "Unity Version Control can keep files read-only until you check them out");
    CHECK(VcsReadOnlyReason({ VcsKind::Lore }) ==
          "it is inside a Lore workspace; Lore marks locks without setting read-only, so another tool or teammate did");
    CHECK(VcsReadOnlyReason({ VcsKind::Git }) == "it is in a Git repository and may be locked by your team's workflow");
    CHECK(VcsReadOnlyReason({ VcsKind::None }) == "it may be under version control");
    for (const VcsKind k : { VcsKind::None, VcsKind::Git, VcsKind::GitLfsLockable, VcsKind::Perforce, VcsKind::Lore, VcsKind::UnityVcs })
    {
        const std::string phrase = VcsReadOnlyReason({ k });
        CHECK_FALSE(phrase.empty());
        CHECK(phrase.back() != '.');                          // TE2-16's sentences supply the punctuation

TEST_CASE("vcs read-only reason: TE2-16's read-only banner and its confirm step carry the phrase; the confirm saves", "[witness][text]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te6-22-readonly");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "Game.ini";
    WriteAll(p, "[a]\nx=1\n");
    WriteAll(s.dir / ".p4config", "P4CLIENT=ws\n");          // the nearest workspace marker: Perforce
    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY));
    const std::string phrase = VcsReadOnlyReason(ProbeVcs(p, VcsProbeEnv::FromSystem()));
    REQUIRE(phrase == VcsReadOnlyReason({ VcsKind::Perforce }));

    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, VcsServices());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());                             // the attribute refuses the SAVE, not the edit
    TypeAtStart(*doc, ";");

    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Save());                                 // refused, never silently forced (D14)
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveReadOnly);
    CHECK(Has(doc->Banner().message, phrase));
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::SaveAs, A::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave, A::Cancel });   // Save As first
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Dirty());
    CHECK((::GetFileAttributesW(p.c_str()) & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0);

    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave);         // asks first, repeating the VCS warning
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveReadOnly);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().confirmingRemoveReadOnly);
    CHECK(Has(doc->Banner().message, phrase));
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly, A::Cancel });
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "[a]\nx=1\n");                        // nothing written yet
    CHECK((::GetFileAttributesW(p.c_str()) & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0);

    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly);         // TE2-16's SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == ";[a]\nx=1\n");
    CHECK((::GetFileAttributesW(p.c_str()) & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("vcs read-only reason: an ACL denial is SaveAccessDenied with the phrase and no remove option", "[witness][text]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te6-22-acl");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "Game.ini";
    WriteAll(p, "[a]\n");
    WriteAll(s.dir / ".p4config", "P4CLIENT=ws\n");
    TextDocumentServices services = VcsServices();
    services.saveOps = &kAclDeniedOps;                        // ReplaceFileW answers ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED: an ACL, not the attribute
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, std::move(services));
    TypeAtStart(*doc, ";");

    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Save());
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveAccessDenied);
    CHECK(Has(doc->Banner().message, VcsReadOnlyReason({ VcsKind::Perforce })));
    const std::vector<A> actions = BannerActions(doc->Banner());
    CHECK(actions == std::vector<A>{ A::SaveAs, A::Cancel });
    CHECK(std::find(actions.begin(), actions.end(), A::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave) == actions.end());   // s5.3: no remove for ACLs
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Dirty());
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "[a]\n");
}
```

`Tick`'s return value is the list of documents that just went over the cap. This task only returns it; TE6-15 turns each path into the one-time note through `TextDocument::ShowNote` (TE2-15's one note channel, which the status strip draws; CANON B11).

The layout follows crash-window s8.4/s8.5 (see finding 1):
- the directory is `<project>/Saved/Autosaves/Text/`;
- each snapshot is `<HashBytes of the lowercased canonical path, 16 hex digits>.arcrecover` (TE2-3's FNV-1a 64), holding the rope's bytes;
- the marker is `RestoreData.json`. It uses the s8.5 schema `{ restoreEnabled, entries: [ { originalPath, autosavePath, stateId, writtenUtc } ] }`, with `stateId` = the buffer `ChangeId` and two text fields added (`encoding`, `bytes`).
- The marker is never written under `--headless` or a debugger (s8.5). The app decides that through `Config::enabled`, in TE6-15.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextRecoveryTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextRecovery.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <functional>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    std::filesystem::path Dir()
    {
        const auto d = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-text-recovery";
        std::filesystem::remove_all(d);
        std::filesystem::create_directories(d);
        return d;
    }
    // A worker the test drives: Submit queues, RunAll executes.
    struct ManualWorker
    {
        std::vector<std::function<void()>> jobs;
        TextRecovery::Submit Submit() { return [this](std::function<void()> j) { jobs.push_back(std::move(j)); }; }
        void RunAll() { auto js = std::move(jobs); jobs.clear(); for (auto& j : js) j(); }
    };
    TextRecoveryDoc Doc(std::string path, std::string text, std::uint64_t changeId, bool dirty)
    {
        return TextRecoveryDoc{ std::move(path), Text::RopeSnapshot{ Text::Rope::FromUtf8(text), changeId }, changeId, dirty,
                                std::string(Text::EncodingId(Text::TextEncoding::Utf8)) };
    }
    std::string ReadAll(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
        std::stringstream s;
        s << f.rdbuf();
        return s.str();
    }
}

TEST_CASE("recovery: only dirty buffers are snapshotted, on the worker", "[text-recovery]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    ManualWorker w;
    TextRecovery rec({ dir, w.Submit(), true });
    const TextRecoveryDoc docs[] = { Doc("C:/p/a.md", "dirty text\n", 7, true), Doc("C:/p/b.md", "clean\n", 3, false) };
    CHECK(rec.Tick(100.0, docs).empty());
    CHECK(rec.WriteInFlight());
    CHECK(std::filesystem::is_empty(dir));                    // nothing written on the UI thread
    w.RunAll();
    CHECK_FALSE(rec.WriteInFlight());

    const auto marker = ParseRecoveryMarker(ReadAll(dir / "RestoreData.json"));
    REQUIRE(marker);
    CHECK(marker->restoreEnabled);
    REQUIRE(marker->entries.size() == 1);
    CHECK(marker->entries[0].originalPath == "C:/p/a.md");
    CHECK(marker->entries[0].changeId == 7);
    CHECK(marker->entries[0].encoding == "utf-8");             // Text::EncodingId(TextEncoding::Utf8)
    CHECK(ReadAll(dir / marker->entries[0].snapshotFile) == "dirty text\n");
}

{
    const auto dir = Dir();

    const std::string big(static_cast<std::size_t>(capMB) * 1024u * 1024u + 1u, 'a');
    const TextRecoveryDoc docs[] = { Doc("C:/p/huge.log", big, 2, true) };

TEST_CASE("recovery: snapshotting never stalls a frame (no I/O, no copy, no wait on the UI thread)", "[text-recovery]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    ManualWorker w;                                           // the worker never runs during this case's Ticks
    TextRecovery rec({ dir, w.Submit(), true });
    const std::string sixteenMB(16u * 1024u * 1024u - 1u, 'q');
    const TextRecoveryDoc docs[] = { Doc("C:/p/big.txt", sixteenMB, 1, true) };

    const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    rec.Tick(100.0, docs);                                   // decides + submits; the job holds the O(1) snapshot
    const TextRecoveryDoc newer[] = { Doc("C:/p/big.txt", sixteenMB, 2, true) };
    rec.Tick(200.0, newer);                                  // a write is in flight: returns at once, never waits
    const double ms = std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();
    INFO("two Ticks over a 16 MB dirty buffer with the worker blocked: " << ms << " ms");
    CHECK(ms < 2.0);
    CHECK(w.jobs.size() == 1);                               // the second Tick queued nothing
    CHECK(std::filesystem::is_empty(dir));
    w.RunAll();
}

TEST_CASE("recovery: clean shutdown disables the marker and removes the snapshots", "[text-recovery]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    ManualWorker w;
    TextRecovery rec({ dir, w.Submit(), true });
    const TextRecoveryDoc docs[] = { Doc("C:/p/a.md", "x\n", 7, true) };
    rec.Tick(100.0, docs); w.RunAll();
    rec.MarkCleanShutdown();
    const auto marker = ParseRecoveryMarker(ReadAll(dir / "RestoreData.json"));
    REQUIRE(marker);
    CHECK_FALSE(marker->restoreEnabled);
    for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(dir))
        CHECK(e.path().extension() != ".arcrecover");
}

TEST_CASE("recovery: disabled (headless / debugger) writes nothing at all", "[text-recovery]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    ManualWorker w;
    TextRecovery rec({ dir, w.Submit(), false });
    const TextRecoveryDoc docs[] = { Doc("C:/p/a.md", "x\n", 7, true) };
    rec.Tick(100.0, docs);
    rec.MarkCleanShutdown();
    CHECK(w.jobs.empty());
    CHECK(std::filesystem::is_empty(dir));
}
```
