```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextRecovery.hpp
#pragma once

// Crash safety for unsaved text (text editor spec s5.3), in the shapes of the
// crash-window spec's s8 (autosave + recovery), whose own plan 3 is not built:
// <project>/Saved/Autosaves/Text/<stem>.arcrecover + RestoreData.json with
// s8.5's schema. Only DIRTY buffers are snapshotted; the write runs on a
// worker from an O(1) RopeSnapshot, so the UI thread never copies or writes;
// a buffer above editor.text.recoveryMaxMB is skipped with a one-time note.
// ONE write in flight at a time: a Tick that finds one in flight returns.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <atomic>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <set>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct TextRecoveryEntry
    {
        std::string   originalPath;   // canonical, generic separators
        std::string   snapshotFile;   // file name inside the recovery dir (s8.5 "autosavePath")
        std::uint64_t changeId = 0;   // s8.5 "stateId": the buffer ChangeId the snapshot holds
        std::string   writtenUtc;     // ISO 8601, UTC
        std::string   encoding;       // Text::EncodingId at snapshot time ("utf-8", "windows-1252", ...); restore reopens with it
        std::uint64_t bytes = 0;
    };

    struct TextRecoveryMarker
    {
        bool restoreEnabled = false;
        std::vector<TextRecoveryEntry> entries;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::string SerializeRecoveryMarker(const TextRecoveryMarker& m);
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<TextRecoveryMarker> ParseRecoveryMarker(std::string_view json);
    // <project>/Saved/Autosaves/Text; empty without a project (nothing is snapshotted then).
    [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path TextRecoveryDir();
    // "<16 hex digits of HashBytes(lowercased canonicalPath)>.arcrecover" (TE2-3's FNV-1a 64).
    [[nodiscard]] std::string RecoveryFileName(std::string_view canonicalPath);

    struct TextRecoveryDoc
    {
        std::string        path;              // CanonicalPath().generic_string()
        Text::RopeSnapshot snapshot;          // Buffer().Snapshot()
        std::uint64_t      changeId = 0;      // Buffer().ChangeId()
        bool               dirty = false;     // Dirty()
        std::string        encoding;          // std::string(Text::EncodingId(Encoding()))
    };

    class TextRecovery
    {
    public:
        using Submit = std::function<void(std::function<void()>)>;
        struct Config
        {
            std::filesystem::path dir;
            Submit                submit;
            bool                  enabled = true;
        };

        explicit TextRecovery(Config config);
        ~TextRecovery();                    // Flush(): never abandon a half-written snapshot
        TextRecovery(const TextRecovery&) = delete;
        TextRecovery& operator=(const TextRecovery&) = delete;

        std::vector<std::string> Tick(double nowSeconds, std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc> docs);
        // Tick ignoring the interval (clean-exit hook: snapshot everything dirty now).
        void SnapshotNow(std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc> docs);
        void Flush();                       // waits for the in-flight write
        void MarkCleanShutdown();           // marker disabled, snapshots removed (s8.5 clean shutdown)
        [[nodiscard]] bool WriteInFlight() const noexcept { return m_inFlight.load(std::memory_order_acquire); }

    private:
        struct WriteItem { TextRecoveryEntry entry; Text::RopeSnapshot snapshot; };
        std::vector<std::string> Plan(std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc> docs);
        void Launch(std::vector<WriteItem> writes, std::vector<std::string> deletes, TextRecoveryMarker marker);
        static void WriteAtomically(const std::filesystem::path& file, const std::function<void(std::FILE*)>& body);

        Config                                   m_config;
        double                                   m_next = 0.0;
        std::map<std::string, TextRecoveryEntry> m_entries;    // by originalPath: what the marker lists
        std::set<std::string>                    m_skipped;    // over the cap and already noted
        std::atomic<bool>                        m_inFlight{ false };
        std::mutex                               m_doneMutex;
        std::condition_variable                  m_doneCv;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextRecovery.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextRecovery.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp"   // HashBytes (TE2-3, FNV-1a 64)
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Platform/Paths.hpp>
#include <Json.hpp>

#include <cctype>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <format>

#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <Windows.h>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        std::string NowUtc()
        {
            return std::format("{:%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ}",
                               std::chrono::floor<std::chrono::seconds>(std::chrono::system_clock::now()));
        }
        std::string Lower(std::string_view s)
        {
            std::string out(s);
            for (char& c : out) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
            return out;
        }
    }

    std::string RecoveryFileName(std::string_view canonicalPath)
    {
        return std::format("{:016x}.arcrecover", HashBytes(Lower(canonicalPath)));
    }

    std::filesystem::path TextRecoveryDir()
    {
        return Paths::Join(Paths::Location::ProjectSaved, Paths::Current(),
                           std::filesystem::path("Autosaves") / "Text");
    }

    std::string SerializeRecoveryMarker(const TextRecoveryMarker& m)
    {
        nlohmann::json j;
        j["restoreEnabled"] = m.restoreEnabled;
        j["entries"] = nlohmann::json::array();
        for (const TextRecoveryEntry& e : m.entries)
            j["entries"].push_back({ { "originalPath", e.originalPath }, { "autosavePath", e.snapshotFile },
                                     { "stateId", e.changeId }, { "writtenUtc", e.writtenUtc },
                                     { "encoding", e.encoding }, { "bytes", e.bytes } });
        return j.dump(2);
    }

    std::optional<TextRecoveryMarker> ParseRecoveryMarker(std::string_view json)
    {
        const nlohmann::json j = nlohmann::json::parse(json, nullptr, /*allow_exceptions*/ false);
        if (!j.is_object() || !j.contains("restoreEnabled") || !j["restoreEnabled"].is_boolean())
            return std::nullopt;
        TextRecoveryMarker m;
        m.restoreEnabled = j["restoreEnabled"].get<bool>();
        if (j.contains("entries") && j["entries"].is_array())
            for (const nlohmann::json& e : j["entries"])
            {
                if (!e.is_object() || !e.contains("originalPath") || !e.contains("autosavePath")) continue;
                TextRecoveryEntry r;
                r.originalPath = e.value("originalPath", std::string{});
                r.snapshotFile = e.value("autosavePath", std::string{});
                r.changeId     = e.value("stateId", std::uint64_t{ 0 });
                r.writtenUtc   = e.value("writtenUtc", std::string{});
                r.encoding     = e.value("encoding", std::string{});
                r.bytes        = e.value("bytes", std::uint64_t{ 0 });
                if (r.snapshotFile.find_first_of("/\\") != std::string::npos) continue;   // a name, never a path
                m.entries.push_back(std::move(r));
            }
        return m;
    }

    TextRecovery::TextRecovery(Config config) : m_config(std::move(config)) {}
    TextRecovery::~TextRecovery() { Flush(); }

    void TextRecovery::Flush()
    {
        std::unique_lock lock(m_doneMutex);
        m_doneCv.wait(lock, [this] { return !m_inFlight.load(std::memory_order_acquire); });
    }

    std::vector<std::string> TextRecovery::Tick(double nowSeconds, std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc> docs)
    {
        if (!m_config.enabled || m_config.dir.empty() || WriteInFlight() || nowSeconds < m_next)
            return {};
        m_next = nowSeconds + Settings<TextSettings>().recoveryIntervalSeconds;
        return Plan(docs);
    }

    void TextRecovery::SnapshotNow(std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc> docs)
    {
        if (!m_config.enabled || m_config.dir.empty())
            return;
        Flush();
        (void)Plan(docs);
    }

    std::vector<std::string> TextRecovery::Plan(std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc> docs)
    {
        const std::uint64_t capBytes = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(Settings<TextSettings>().recoveryMaxMB) * 1024u * 1024u;
        std::vector<std::string> newlySkipped;
        std::vector<WriteItem> writes;
        std::vector<std::string> deletes;
        std::set<std::string> seen;
        bool changed = false;

        for (const TextRecoveryDoc& d : docs)
        {
            seen.insert(d.path);
            const auto it = m_entries.find(d.path);
            if (!d.dirty)
            {
                m_skipped.erase(d.path);
                if (it != m_entries.end()) { deletes.push_back(it->second.snapshotFile); m_entries.erase(it); changed = true; }
                continue;
            }
            if (d.snapshot.rope.Size() > capBytes)
            {
                if (m_skipped.insert(d.path).second) newlySkipped.push_back(d.path);
                if (it != m_entries.end()) { deletes.push_back(it->second.snapshotFile); m_entries.erase(it); changed = true; }
                continue;
            }
            m_skipped.erase(d.path);
            if (it != m_entries.end() && it->second.changeId == d.changeId)
                continue;                                                  // already on disk
            TextRecoveryEntry e{ d.path, RecoveryFileName(d.path), d.changeId, NowUtc(), d.encoding, d.snapshot.rope.Size() };
            m_entries[d.path] = e;
            writes.push_back({ std::move(e), d.snapshot });                 // RopeSnapshot copy is O(1) (s3.1)
            changed = true;
        }
        for (auto it = m_entries.begin(); it != m_entries.end();)          // documents closed since the last plan
        {
            if (seen.contains(it->first)) { ++it; continue; }
            deletes.push_back(it->second.snapshotFile);
            it = m_entries.erase(it);
            changed = true;
        }
        if (!changed)
            return newlySkipped;

        TextRecoveryMarker marker;
        for (const auto& [path, e] : m_entries) marker.entries.push_back(e);
        marker.restoreEnabled = !marker.entries.empty();
        Launch(std::move(writes), std::move(deletes), std::move(marker));
        return newlySkipped;
    }

    void TextRecovery::WriteAtomically(const std::filesystem::path& file, const std::function<void(std::FILE*)>& body)
    {
        const std::filesystem::path tmp = file.string() + ".tmp";
        std::FILE* f = nullptr;
        if (_wfopen_s(&f, tmp.c_str(), L"wb") != 0 || !f)
            return;
        body(f);
        std::fflush(f);
        std::fclose(f);
        ::MoveFileExW(tmp.c_str(), file.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH);
    }

    void TextRecovery::Launch(std::vector<WriteItem> writes, std::vector<std::string> deletes, TextRecoveryMarker marker)
    {
        m_inFlight.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        auto job = [this, writes = std::move(writes), deletes = std::move(deletes), marker = std::move(marker)]() mutable {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::create_directories(m_config.dir, ec);
            for (const WriteItem& w : writes)
                WriteAtomically(m_config.dir / w.entry.snapshotFile, [&](std::FILE* f) {
                    w.snapshot.rope.ForEachChunk({ 0, w.snapshot.rope.Size() },
                                                 [&](std::string_view chunk) { std::fwrite(chunk.data(), 1, chunk.size(), f); });
                });
            for (const std::string& name : deletes)
                std::filesystem::remove(m_config.dir / name, ec);
            const std::string text = SerializeRecoveryMarker(marker);   // written LAST: it never names a file not yet on disk
            WriteAtomically(m_config.dir / "RestoreData.json", [&](std::FILE* f) { std::fwrite(text.data(), 1, text.size(), f); });
            {
                std::lock_guard lock(m_doneMutex);
                m_inFlight.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
            }
            m_doneCv.notify_all();
        };
        if (m_config.submit) m_config.submit(std::move(job));
        else job();
    }

    void TextRecovery::MarkCleanShutdown()
    {
        if (!m_config.enabled || m_config.dir.empty())
            return;
        Flush();
        std::error_code ec;
        if (std::filesystem::exists(m_config.dir, ec))
            for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(m_config.dir, ec))
                if (e.path().extension() == ".arcrecover")
                    std::filesystem::remove(e.path(), ec);
        m_entries.clear();
        m_skipped.clear();
        if (std::filesystem::exists(m_config.dir, ec))
        {
            const std::string text = SerializeRecoveryMarker({});
            WriteAtomically(m_config.dir / "RestoreData.json", [&](std::FILE* f) { std::fwrite(text.data(), 1, text.size(), f); });
        }
    }
}

### Task TE6-14: The recovery offer -- reading a leftover marker, the restore model, restoring into dirty text documents (spec s5.3; crash-window s8.6 shape)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextRecoveryOffer.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextRecoveryOffer.cpp`
- Modify: `premake5.lua`, the ArcaneTests `files` list: add `TextRecoveryOffer.cpp`.
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextRecoveryOfferTest.cpp`, tags `[text-recovery][witness][text]`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - TE6-13 (`TextRecoveryEntry`, `TextRecoveryMarker`, `ParseRecoveryMarker`, `SerializeRecoveryMarker`, `RecoveryFileName`)
  - TE2-15 `TextDocument`: `Buffer()`, `Model()`, `Encoding()`, `bool ReopenWithEncoding(Text::TextEncoding)` (refused while dirty; returns false), `ReadOnly()`, `LockedByDedicatedEditor()` (TE6-12), `Banner()`
  - TE1-11 `std::optional<Text::TextEncoding> Text::EncodingFromId(std::string_view)`
  - TE1-14 `Text::TextCommands(TextBuffer&, SelectionSet&, EditContext)` + `EditAndMap(TransactionKind, std::vector<EditOp>, Bias, Bias, Bias)`; TE2-11 `Editor::DefaultEditContext(TextModel&)` (`TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp`)
  - tests only: TE6-12 `OpenAsTextFlow { DocumentHost& docs; ExternalReloadContext reload; afterAssetSave; TextDocumentServices services; std::string lastError; TextDocument* Open(path); }` behind the `openText` function, `DocumentHost::RegisterFactory`
- Produces:
  - `struct TextRecoveryOffer { struct Row { TextRecoveryEntry entry; bool selected = true; bool originalNewer = false; bool originalMissing = false; }; std::vector<Row> rows; }`
  - `std::optional<TextRecoveryOffer> BuildTextRecoveryOffer(const std::filesystem::path& dir)`: present only for an **enabled** marker with entries whose snapshot files exist
  - `struct RestoreReport { std::vector<std::string> restored; std::vector<std::string> failed; }`
  - `RestoreReport RestoreSelected(const TextRecoveryOffer&, const std::filesystem::path& dir, const std::function<TextDocument*(const std::filesystem::path&)>& openText)` (CANON A11). The app passes a FileOpener-backed `openText` (TE6-15); tests pass a lambda over an `OpenAsTextFlow`. This file never names FileOpener, `EditorApp::OpenAsText` or `DocumentHost::OpenAt`.
  - `void ResolveOffer(const std::filesystem::path& dir)`: writes the marker `restoreEnabled:false`

  The leftover enabled marker *is* the crash detector. A clean shutdown always disables it (TE6-13 `MarkCleanShutdown`); only a crash, a kill, or an OS cut-off clean exit leaves it on (s8.5, crash-window s5.7).

  Restore sequence:
  1. Open the original through `openText`.
  2. Reopen it with the recorded encoding (`Text::EncodingFromId(entry.encoding)`) when it differs. `ReopenWithEncoding` returns `bool`: a refusal (the tab was already open and dirty) fails the row with a reason and changes nothing.
  3. Replace the whole text with the snapshot as **one undo transaction** through `Text::TextCommands(...).EditAndMap(TransactionKind::Other, ...)` -- never raw `BeginTransaction` / `Edit` / `EndTransaction` (s2.1: only `TextCommands` changes text). The document reads **dirty** and one Ctrl+Z shows the on-disk version.
  4. The tab's lock is left alone. A file that has a dedicated Arcane editor (an asset being edited through Open as Text when the session died) comes back through the opener's Arcane-text route, which `OpenAsTextFlow` opens **locked** (TE2-19's `DocumentHost::HasDedicatedFactory`, applied by TE6-12): read-only, the `TextBannerKind::Locked` banner with **Enable editing**, and dirty with the recovered text. The dedicated editor may hold the disk version meanwhile; the Locked banner is the prompt, and saving requires the explicit unlock, whose save then runs TE6-12's asset-reload path. This answers the old Review Focus item "a recovery offer for a file now open in a dedicated editor"; the third test case pins it.

  Known limit (CANON D20): recovered text takes the file's **dominant** line ending. The rope holds LF and the snapshot holds the rope's bytes, so per-line exceptions of the lost session are not recovered. The offer dialog says so (TE6-15).

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextRecoveryOfferTest.cpp
// s11.4: "crash recovery restores an unsaved buffer". The "crash" is the
// process state a crash loses: the session's TextRecovery is dropped WITHOUT
// MarkCleanShutdown, so its enabled marker stays; the next session reads it.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "Documents/ExternalAssetReload.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/OpenAsText.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextRecovery.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextRecoveryOffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    struct Paths2 { std::filesystem::path root, recovery, file; };
    Paths2 Setup()
    {
        const auto root = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-text-recovery-offer";
        std::filesystem::remove_all(root);
        std::filesystem::create_directories(root / "rec");
        const auto file = root / "notes.md";
        { std::ofstream(file, std::ios::binary) << "# on disk\n"; }
        return { root, root / "rec", file };
    }
    // The whole-text replacement the product uses: one TextCommands transaction.
    void ReplaceAll(TextDocument& t, std::string_view text)
    {
        Text::TextBuffer& buf = t.Buffer();
        Text::TextCommands(buf, t.Model().selections, DefaultEditContext(t.Model()))
            .EditAndMap(Text::TransactionKind::Other,
                        { Text::EditOp{ Text::ByteRange{ 0, buf.Text().Size() }, std::string(text) } },
                        Text::Bias::Left, Text::Bias::Left, Text::Bias::Right);
    }
    // The tests' openText: a lambda over TE6-12's OpenAsTextFlow (the app passes
    // a FileOpener-backed one, TE6-15). Records what it opened.
    struct FlowOpener
    {
        DocumentHost& host;
        std::vector<TextDocument*> opened;
        std::function<TextDocument*(const std::filesystem::path&)> Fn()
        {
            return [this](const std::filesystem::path& f) -> TextDocument* {
                TextDocument* t = OpenAsTextFlow{ host, ExternalReloadContext{}, {}, TextDocumentServices{} }.Open(f);
                if (t) opened.push_back(t);
                return t;
            };
        }
    };
}

TEST_CASE("recovery offer: a crashed session's unsaved buffer is offered and restored dirty, one undo from disk", "[text-recovery][witness][text]")
{
    const Paths2 p = Setup();
    {   // ---- session 1: edit, snapshot, crash (no MarkCleanShutdown) ----
        DocumentHost host;
        TextDocument* t = OpenAsTextFlow{ host, ExternalReloadContext{}, {}, TextDocumentServices{} }.Open(p.file);
        REQUIRE(t);
        ReplaceAll(*t, "# unsaved work\n");
        TextRecovery rec({ p.recovery, {}, true });           // null submit: runs inline
        const TextRecoveryDoc docs[] = { { t->CanonicalPath().generic_string(), t->Buffer().Snapshot(),
                                           t->Buffer().ChangeId(), t->Dirty(), std::string(Text::EncodingId(t->Encoding())) } };
        rec.Tick(1000.0, docs);
    }   // the TextRecovery dtor flushes but leaves the marker enabled: the crash

    // ---- session 2 ----
    const std::optional<TextRecoveryOffer> offer = BuildTextRecoveryOffer(p.recovery);
    REQUIRE(offer);
    REQUIRE(offer->rows.size() == 1);
    CHECK(offer->rows[0].selected);
    CHECK_FALSE(offer->rows[0].originalMissing);
    CHECK(offer->rows[0].entry.encoding == "utf-8");

    DocumentHost host;
    FlowOpener opener{ host };
    const RestoreReport r = RestoreSelected(*offer, p.recovery, opener.Fn());
    CHECK(r.failed.empty());
    REQUIRE(r.restored.size() == 1);
    REQUIRE(opener.opened.size() == 1);
    TextDocument* t = opener.opened[0];
    CHECK(t->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "# unsaved work\n");
    CHECK(t->Dirty());
    CHECK_FALSE(t->ReadOnly());                                  // a plain .md: no dedicated editor, no lock
    Text::TextCommands(t->Buffer(), t->Model().selections, DefaultEditContext(t->Model())).Undo();   // ONE step
    CHECK(t->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "# on disk\n");

    ResolveOffer(p.recovery);
    CHECK_FALSE(BuildTextRecoveryOffer(p.recovery).has_value());   // asked once
}

TEST_CASE("recovery offer: a file with a dedicated editor is restored LOCKED (read-only, Locked banner) and dirty", "[text-recovery]")
{
    // Review Focus "a recovery offer for a file now open in a dedicated
    // editor": the restore never unlocks. The opener's Arcane-text route opens
    // an extension with a dedicated factory locked (TE2-19's HasDedicatedFactory, TE6-12's rule),
    // so the user sees the Locked banner over the recovered (dirty) text and
    // must choose Enable editing before a save can reach the asset.
    const Paths2 p = Setup();
    const std::filesystem::path asset = p.root / "hero.arcsprite";
    { std::ofstream(asset, std::ios::binary) << "{ \"pixelsPerUnit\": 16 }\n"; }
    TextRecoveryMarker m;
    m.restoreEnabled = true;
    const std::string original = asset.generic_string();
    m.entries.push_back({ original, RecoveryFileName(original), 4, "2026-10-07T00:00:00Z", "utf-8", 24 });
    { std::ofstream(p.recovery / "RestoreData.json", std::ios::binary) << SerializeRecoveryMarker(m); }
    { std::ofstream(p.recovery / RecoveryFileName(original), std::ios::binary) << "{ \"pixelsPerUnit\": 32 }\n"; }

    DocumentHost host;
    host.RegisterFactory(".arcsprite", [](const std::filesystem::path&) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> { return nullptr; });

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextRecoveryOffer.hpp
#pragma once
// The recovery offer (crash-window spec s8.6 shape, text editor spec s5.3):
// an ENABLED marker left behind is the crash detector; each row has a
// checkbox, the file, its snapshot time, and a warning when the original is
// newer than the snapshot or gone. Restore Selected / Skip both resolve it.
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextRecovery.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class TextDocument;

    struct TextRecoveryOffer
    {
        struct Row
        {
            TextRecoveryEntry entry;
            bool selected = true;
            bool originalNewer = false;     // modified on disk after the snapshot was written
            bool originalMissing = false;
        };
        std::vector<Row> rows;
    };

    struct RestoreReport
    {
        std::vector<std::string> restored;
        std::vector<std::string> failed;    // "<path>: <why>"
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<TextRecoveryOffer> BuildTextRecoveryOffer(const std::filesystem::path& dir);
    // `openText` opens (or focuses) the file in an Arcane text tab and returns
    // it, or nullptr. The app passes FileOpener's Arcane-text route (TE6-15);
    // the tests pass a lambda over OpenAsTextFlow. The restore never unlocks a
    // tab the opener opened locked (a file with a dedicated editor).
    RestoreReport RestoreSelected(const TextRecoveryOffer& offer, const std::filesystem::path& dir,
                                  const std::function<TextDocument*(const std::filesystem::path&)>& openText);
    void ResolveOffer(const std::filesystem::path& dir);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextRecoveryOffer.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextRecoveryOffer.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"

#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        std::optional<std::string> ReadAll(const std::filesystem::path& p)
        {
            std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
            if (!f) return std::nullopt;
            std::stringstream s;
            s << f.rdbuf();
            return s.str();
        }
    }

    std::optional<TextRecoveryOffer> BuildTextRecoveryOffer(const std::filesystem::path& dir)
    {
        const auto text = ReadAll(dir / "RestoreData.json");
        if (!text) return std::nullopt;
        const auto marker = ParseRecoveryMarker(*text);
        if (!marker || !marker->restoreEnabled) return std::nullopt;
        TextRecoveryOffer offer;
        std::error_code ec;
        for (const TextRecoveryEntry& e : marker->entries)
        {
            const std::filesystem::path snap = dir / e.snapshotFile;
            if (!std::filesystem::exists(snap, ec)) continue;
            TextRecoveryOffer::Row row{ e };
            const std::filesystem::path original(e.originalPath);
            row.originalMissing = !std::filesystem::exists(original, ec);
            if (!row.originalMissing)
                row.originalNewer = std::filesystem::last_write_time(original, ec) > std::filesystem::last_write_time(snap, ec);
            offer.rows.push_back(std::move(row));
        }
        if (offer.rows.empty()) return std::nullopt;
        return offer;
    }

    RestoreReport RestoreSelected(const TextRecoveryOffer& offer, const std::filesystem::path& dir,
                                  const std::function<TextDocument*(const std::filesystem::path&)>& openText)
    {
        RestoreReport report;
        for (const TextRecoveryOffer::Row& row : offer.rows)
        {
            if (!row.selected) continue;
            const std::string& path = row.entry.originalPath;
            if (row.originalMissing) { report.failed.push_back(path + ": the original file no longer exists (snapshot kept in " + dir.generic_string() + ")"); continue; }
            const auto text = ReadAll(dir / row.entry.snapshotFile);
            if (!text) { report.failed.push_back(path + ": the snapshot could not be read"); continue; }
            TextDocument* doc = openText ? openText(std::filesystem::path(path)) : nullptr;
            if (!doc) { report.failed.push_back(path + ": the file could not be opened"); continue; }
            if (const std::optional<Text::TextEncoding> enc = Text::EncodingFromId(row.entry.encoding);
                enc && *enc != doc->Encoding() && !doc->ReopenWithEncoding(*enc))
            {
                // Refused (the tab was already open with unsaved edits): leave it untouched.
                report.failed.push_back(path + ": could not reopen as " + row.entry.encoding +
                                        " (the open tab has unsaved changes; snapshot kept in " + dir.generic_string() + ")");
                continue;
            }
            // The lock is left as the opener set it: a file with a dedicated
            // editor comes back read-only under the Locked banner (TE6-12).
            // ONE TextCommands transaction: the document reads dirty and one
            // Ctrl+Z shows the on-disk version (s2.1: only TextCommands edits).
            TextModel& model = doc->Model();
            Text::TextBuffer& buf = doc->Buffer();
            Text::TextCommands(buf, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model))
                .EditAndMap(Text::TransactionKind::Other,
                            { Text::EditOp{ Text::ByteRange{ 0, buf.Text().Size() }, *text } },
                            Text::Bias::Left, Text::Bias::Left, Text::Bias::Right);
            report.restored.push_back(path);
        }
        return report;
    }

    void ResolveOffer(const std::filesystem::path& dir)
    {
        const auto text = ReadAll(dir / "RestoreData.json");
        TextRecoveryMarker m = text ? ParseRecoveryMarker(*text).value_or(TextRecoveryMarker{}) : TextRecoveryMarker{};
        m.restoreEnabled = false;                     // snapshot files stay until the next clean shutdown sweeps them
        std::ofstream(dir / "RestoreData.json", std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc) << SerializeRecoveryMarker(m);
    }
}
```

The restore edit is a `Text::TextCommands` transaction (`EditAndMap` with `TransactionKind::Other`, CANON A3), the same call TE2-16 uses for save-time edits, so the selections map through it and the undo step restores them. No product or test code in this task calls `TextBuffer::BeginTransaction` / `Edit` / `EndTransaction`.

`TextRecovery.hpp`:

```cpp
    enum class ShutdownRecoveryAction : std::uint8_t { MarkClean, SnapshotAndKeep };
    // Crash-window s5.7: the clean-exit hook (console close, logoff) runs the
    // ordinary exit WITHOUT the unsaved-changes confirms, so dirty text there
    // is snapshotted and the marker stays enabled; every other exit went
    // through the confirms (saved or discarded) and marks clean.
    [[nodiscard]] inline ShutdownRecoveryAction DecideShutdownRecovery(bool cleanExitRequested, bool anyDirtyText) noexcept
    {
        return cleanExitRequested && anyDirtyText ? ShutdownRecoveryAction::SnapshotAndKeep : ShutdownRecoveryAction::MarkClean;
    }

`EditorApp` (`EditorAppProject.cpp`):

```cpp
    std::vector<Arcane::Editor::TextRecoveryDoc> EditorApp::CollectTextRecoveryDocs()
    {
        std::vector<Arcane::Editor::TextRecoveryDoc> docs;
        m_documents.ForEach([&](Arcane::Editor::EditorDocument& d)
        {
            if (auto* t = dynamic_cast<Arcane::Editor::TextDocument*>(&d))
                docs.push_back({ t->CanonicalPath().generic_string(),            // by value: the temporary lives to the end of the call
                                 t->Buffer().Snapshot(), t->Buffer().ChangeId(), t->Dirty(),
                                 std::string(Arcane::Text::EncodingId(t->Encoding())) });
        });
        return docs;
    }

    void EditorApp::StartTextRecovery()
    {
        const std::filesystem::path dir = Arcane::Editor::TextRecoveryDir();
        // Crash-window s8.5: never under --headless (the witness harness kills
        // hosts on timeout) and never under a debugger (UE's rule).
        const bool enabled = !m_config.headless && !::IsDebuggerPresent() && !dir.empty();
        m_textRecoveryOffer = enabled ? Arcane::Editor::BuildTextRecoveryOffer(dir) : std::nullopt;
        m_textRecovery = std::make_unique<Arcane::Editor::TextRecovery>(Arcane::Editor::TextRecovery::Config{
            dir, [this](std::function<void()> job) { m_runtime->Jobs().Submit(std::move(job)); }, enabled });
    }

    void EditorApp::StopTextRecovery(bool cleanShutdown)
    {
        if (!m_textRecovery) return;
        if (cleanShutdown) m_textRecovery->MarkCleanShutdown();
        else { const auto docs = CollectTextRecoveryDocs(); m_textRecovery->SnapshotNow(docs); m_textRecovery->Flush(); }
        m_textRecovery.reset();
        m_textRecoveryOffer.reset();
    }

No view-only headless draw entry exists (CANON A7 dropped it): the perf cases draw the real document window, banner strip, status strip and views.

  Debug: every `[perf]` case `SKIP`s ("perf budgets are measured in Release and Dist"). Debug timings are not comparable, and a skipped case does not count toward `arcanetests.cases` (`check-baselines.ps1` reads passed and failed only).

  The fixture owns the `TextSyntaxService` over the SOURCE grammars (`RepoRoot()/data/Syntaxes`, where TE3-21..29 put the `.arcsyntax` files) with a real `ThreadedHighlightExecutor`, so the perf cases measure the worker exactly as the editor runs it. A document opened with `TextDocumentServices{}` would have `syntax == nullptr` and never colour; always open through `HeadlessTextFrame::Open`. Declare the `HeadlessTextFrame` BEFORE the document it opens: the document holds a pointer to the frame's service and must be destroyed first.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/PerfBudget.hpp
#pragma once
// [perf] ceilings (text editor TE6-18): scripts/automation-baselines.json
// perf[] = [{ name, configuration, ceilingMs, measuredMedianMs, note }].
// A case measures samples, records the median into the perf report
// (ARCANE_PERF_REPORT or %TEMP%\arcane-perf.json) for check-baselines
// -PerfReportPath, and fails above its ceiling. ARCANE_PERF_MEASURE=1 records
// without asserting (the re-baseline run).
#include "Helpers/ConstantScan.hpp"   // RepoRoot()

#include <Json.hpp>
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Test
{
    inline const char* PerfConfiguration()
    {
#if defined(ARC_BUILD_DIST)
        return "Dist";
#elif defined(ARC_BUILD_RELEASE)
        return "Release";
#else
        return "Debug";
#endif
    }

    struct PerfBudget { bool found = false; double ceilingMs = 0.0; };

    inline PerfBudget LoadPerfBudget(std::string_view name)
    {
        std::ifstream in(RepoRoot() / "scripts" / "automation-baselines.json", std::ios::binary);
        std::stringstream ss;
        ss << in.rdbuf();
        const nlohmann::json j = nlohmann::json::parse(ss.str(), nullptr, false);
        if (!j.is_object() || !j.contains("perf") || !j["perf"].is_array()) return {};
        for (const nlohmann::json& e : j["perf"])
            if (e.value("name", std::string{}) == name && e.value("configuration", std::string{}) == PerfConfiguration())
                return { true, e.value("ceilingMs", 0.0) };
        return {};
    }

    inline double Median(std::vector<double> v)
    {
        if (v.empty()) return 0.0;
        std::sort(v.begin(), v.end());
        return v[v.size() / 2];
    }

    inline std::filesystem::path PerfReportPath()
    {
        if (const char* p = std::getenv("ARCANE_PERF_REPORT"); p && *p) return p;
        return std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-perf.json";
    }

    inline void RecordPerf(std::string_view name, double medianMs)
    {
        nlohmann::json j = nlohmann::json::object();
        {
            std::ifstream in(PerfReportPath(), std::ios::binary);
            if (in) { std::stringstream ss; ss << in.rdbuf(); j = nlohmann::json::parse(ss.str(), nullptr, false); }
        }
        if (!j.is_object() || j.value("configuration", std::string{}) != PerfConfiguration())
            j = { { "configuration", PerfConfiguration() }, { "results", nlohmann::json::object() } };
        j["results"][std::string(name)] = medianMs;
        std::ofstream(PerfReportPath(), std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc) << j.dump(2);
    }

    inline void CheckPerfBudget(std::string_view name, const std::vector<double>& samplesMs)
    {
        const double median = Median(samplesMs);
        const double worst = samplesMs.empty() ? 0.0 : *std::max_element(samplesMs.begin(), samplesMs.end());
        RecordPerf(name, median);
        INFO(std::string(name) << " [" << PerfConfiguration() << "]: median " << median << " ms, max " << worst
                               << " ms over " << samplesMs.size() << " samples");
        if (const char* m = std::getenv("ARCANE_PERF_MEASURE"); m && std::string_view(m) == "1")
        {
            WARN("ARCANE_PERF_MEASURE=1: recorded, not asserted");
            return;
        }
        const PerfBudget b = LoadPerfBudget(name);
        INFO("no perf[] entry '" << std::string(name) << "' for " << PerfConfiguration());
        REQUIRE(b.found);
        CHECK(median <= b.ceilingMs);
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/TextPerfFixtures.hpp
#pragma once
// Deterministic s11.5 workloads (no RNG: the same bytes every run) and a
// headless frame driver: one SettingsImGuiHarness frame around the REAL
// document window (TextDocument::Draw), the pattern TE2-13's view tests use.
#include "Helpers/ConstantScan.hpp"                // RepoRoot()
#include "Helpers/SettingsFixtures.hpp"            // SettingsImGuiHarness
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightCache.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightWorker.hpp"   // Text::ThreadedHighlightExecutor (TE3)
#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextSyntaxService.hpp"

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <imgui.h>

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <format>
#include <fstream>
#include <memory>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Test
{
    inline std::string MakeArcaneLog(std::uint64_t bytes)
    {
        static constexpr const char* kLevels[] = { "info", "warn", "error", "debug" };
        std::string s;
        s.reserve(static_cast<std::size_t>(bytes) + 128);
        for (std::uint64_t i = 0; s.size() < bytes; ++i)
            s += std::format("[2026-10-07 12:{:02}:{:02}.{:03}] [{}] [Editor] frame {} took {} us, queue depth {}\n",
                             (i / 60000) % 60, (i / 1000) % 60, i % 1000, kLevels[i % 4], i, (i * 37) % 9000, i % 17);
        return s;
    }

    inline std::string MakeJsonLines(std::uint32_t lines)
    {
        std::string s = "{\n  \"items\": [\n";
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i + 4 < lines; ++i)
            s += std::format("    {{ \"id\": {}, \"name\": \"item {}\", \"on\": {} }},\n", i, i, (i % 2) ? "true" : "false");
        s += "    { \"id\": -1 }\n  ]\n}\n";
        return s;
    }

    inline std::string MakeJson(std::uint64_t bytes)
    {
        std::string s = "{\n  \"items\": [\n";
        for (std::uint64_t i = 0; s.size() < bytes; ++i)
            s += std::format("    {{ \"id\": {}, \"name\": \"item {}\", \"tags\": [\"a\", \"b\"], \"v\": {}.5 }},\n", i, i, i % 1000);
        s += "    { \"id\": -1 }\n  ]\n}\n";
        return s;
    }

    inline std::filesystem::path WriteFixture(const char* name, const std::string& body)
    {
        const auto dir = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-text-perf";
        std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        const auto p = dir / name;
        if (std::filesystem::exists(p) && std::filesystem::file_size(p) == body.size()) return p;   // reuse across cases
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc) << body;
        return p;
    }

    // One ImGui frame around the document window at the golden size. The
    // fixture owns the syntax service (source grammars, the threaded worker)
    // and must outlive every document it opens.
    struct HeadlessTextFrame
    {
        SettingsImGuiHarness harness{ ImVec2(1280.0f, 720.0f) };
        Editor::TextSyntaxService syntax{ std::make_unique<Text::ThreadedHighlightExecutor>(),
                                          RepoRoot() / "data" / "Syntaxes" };
        double clock = 0.0;
        double lastMs = 0.0;

        [[nodiscard]] std::unique_ptr<Editor::TextDocument> Open(const std::filesystem::path& path)
        {
            Editor::TextDocumentServices services;
            services.syntax = &syntax;
            std::string error;
            std::unique_ptr<Editor::TextDocument> doc = Editor::TextDocument::Open(path, std::move(services), error);
            INFO("open " << path.string() << ": " << error);
            REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
            return doc;
        }

        void Frame(Editor::TextDocument& doc)
        {
            const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            clock += 1.0 / 60.0;
            syntax.Tick(clock);                         // styles, grammar reloads (the app ticks it once per frame)
            doc.Tick(1.0 / 60.0);                       // the disk poll and Follow (TE2-17, TE6-3)
            harness.Frame([&] {
                ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(0.0f, 0.0f), ImGuiCond_Always);
                ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(1280.0f, 720.0f), ImGuiCond_Always);
                bool requestClose = false;
                doc.Draw(requestClose);                 // UpdateHighlight + banners + views + status strip
            });
            lastMs = std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();
        }
        [[nodiscard]] double LastFrameMs() const noexcept { return lastMs; }

        // Every visible row has READY tokens (the "coloured" predicate of s11.5).
        // Peek never tokenizes, so asking does not colour anything.
        [[nodiscard]] static bool VisibleColoured(Editor::TextDocument& doc)
        {
            const Text::HighlightCache* cache = doc.Highlight();
            if (cache == nullptr) return false;         // no syntax service: never coloured
            Editor::TextEditorView& view = doc.View();
            const std::uint32_t displayRows = view.Display().DisplayRowCount();
            const std::uint32_t first = view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow();
            const std::uint32_t count = view.VisibleRowCount();
            for (std::uint32_t d = first; d < first + count && d < displayRows; ++d)
                if (cache->Peek(view.Display().DisplayRowToBuffer(d)) == nullptr) return false;
            return true;
        }
    };
}
```

The constant-guard scan covers engine and editor sources, not `ArcaneTests`. `kLevels` needs no marker. `HighlightCache.hpp` and `HighlightWorker.hpp` (which declares `ThreadedHighlightExecutor`) are TE3's headers; `TextSyntaxService.hpp` is TE3-30's. The new test file needs no premake edit when ArcaneTests globs `src/**.cpp`; check with `rg -n "ArcaneTests/src" premake5.lua`, and if the project lists files explicitly, add `TextPerfTest.cpp` to that list and `git add premake5.lua` in Step 5.

```powershell
if ($PerfReportPath) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $PerfReportPath)) {
        Write-Host "no perf report at $PerfReportPath" -ForegroundColor Red
        exit 1
    }
    $perf = Get-Content $PerfReportPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($perf.configuration -ne $Configuration) {
        Write-Host "perf report is for $($perf.configuration), not $Configuration" -ForegroundColor Red
        exit 1
    }
    foreach ($p in $perf.results.PSObject.Properties) {
        $entry = $baseline.perf | Where-Object { $_.name -eq $p.Name -and $_.configuration -eq $Configuration }
        if (-not $entry) {
            Write-Host "perf: $($p.Name) [$Configuration] median $($p.Value) ms (NO CEILING -- not checked)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            continue
        }
        if ([double]$p.Value -gt [double]$entry.ceilingMs) {
            Write-Host "perf: $($p.Name) [$Configuration] median $($p.Value) ms > ceiling $($entry.ceilingMs) ms -- REGRESSED" -ForegroundColor Red
            $failed = $true
        } else {
            Write-Host "perf: $($p.Name) [$Configuration] median $($p.Value) ms <= ceiling $($entry.ceilingMs) ms" -ForegroundColor Green
        }
    }
}

### Task TE6-20: Perf -- Ctrl+End in a 30 MB stateful file stays in the frame budget; scroll cost at 60 lines/frame (spec s11.5)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextPerfTest.cpp` (append two cases)
- Modify: `scripts/automation-baselines.json` (four entries)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE6-18 (`HeadlessTextFrame`, `CheckPerfBudget`); TE4-24 `TextDocument::RunTextAction(TextAction)` with `TextAction::DocumentEnd` (the row `text.documentEnd`, bound to Ctrl+End; `TextEditor/TextActionTable.hpp`) -- the real Ctrl+End: the caret moves to the end and the view reveals it on the next `Draw`; TE4-9 `TextEditorView::SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow(std::uint32_t displayRow)`, `Display()`; TE3-30 `Highlight()` (pointer).
- Produces: the perf names `text.jump.json30MB.frameMs` and `text.scroll.log100MB.frameMs`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```cpp
TEST_CASE("perf: Ctrl+End in a 30 MB stateful file -- plain first, colour later, every frame in budget", "[perf][text-perf]")
{
#if defined(ARC_BUILD_DEBUG)
    SKIP("perf budgets are measured in Release and Dist");
#endif
    const auto path = WriteFixture("thirty.json", MakeJson(30ull * 1024 * 1024));
    HeadlessTextFrame frame;
    std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = frame.Open(path);
    REQUIRE(doc->Highlight() != nullptr);
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) frame.Frame(*doc);           // the top is coloured; the worker is near the top

    doc->RunTextAction(TextAction::DocumentEnd);              // Ctrl+End: caret to the end; the view reveals it next Draw
    frame.Frame(*doc);
    REQUIRE(doc->View().LastVisibleDisplayRow() + 1 >= doc->View().Display().DisplayRowCount());   // the jump landed
    CHECK_FALSE(HeadlessTextFrame::VisibleColoured(*doc));    // s4.4: a far jump draws plain; no sync tokenize from row 0
    std::vector<double> samples{ frame.LastFrameMs() };

}

    Test::SettingsImGuiHarness h(ImVec2(1024.0f, 768.0f));
    TextModel model(Text::Rope::FromUtf8("tail\n"));
    TextEditorView view(model);
    const auto frame = [&]
    {
        h.Frame([&]
        {
            ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(0.0f, 0.0f));
            ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(600.0f, 400.0f));
            ImGui::Begin("doc", nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings);
            view.Draw("##tv", ImVec2(0.0f, 0.0f), false);
            ImGui::End();
        });

    view.InjectCharacters(U"ab\u0001\u00e9");                     // U+0001 drops, as a typed control character does
    CHECK(model.buffer.Text().ToString() == "tail\n");           // queued: nothing changes before a Draw
    frame();
    frame();                                                     // the Focus() the call requested lands within two frames
    CHECK(view.KeyboardActive());
    CHECK(model.buffer.Text().ToString() == "ab\xC3\xA9tail\n");
    CHECK(model.buffer.CanUndo());                               // the typed path: an undoable edit
    frame();
    CHECK(model.buffer.Text().ToString() == "ab\xC3\xA9tail\n");  // drained once: nothing is typed twice

    view.InjectCharacters(U"z");
    frame();
    CHECK(model.buffer.Text().ToString() == "ab\xC3\xA9ztail\n"); // at the caret, after the earlier batch
}

    std::filesystem::path StagedEditor()
    {

        INFO("staged ArcaneEditor not found -- build Arcane.slnx first: " << p.string());
        REQUIRE(std::filesystem::exists(p / "ArcaneEditor.exe"));
        REQUIRE(std::filesystem::exists(p / "ReferenceProject" / "Verify" / "TextSamples" / "golden.json"));
        return p;

    void RunTextGolden(const std::string& slot, const std::vector<std::string>& sets)
    {
        WitnessScratch scratch(StagedEditor(), "text-golden-" + slot);
        WitnessInvocation inv;
        inv.exePath = scratch.Dir() / "ArcaneEditor.exe";
        inv.workingDir = scratch.Dir();
        inv.reportPath = scratch.Dir() / "witness-report.json";
        inv.args = { "--project", "ReferenceProject", "--headless", "--backend", "dx12", "--frames", "60",
                     "--settle", "30", "--report", inv.reportPath.generic_string(), "--compare", slot,
                     "--set", "editor.text.caretBlink=false" };
        for (const std::string& s : sets) { inv.args.push_back("--set"); inv.args.push_back(s); }
        inv.hardCapMs = 120000;
        const WitnessRun run = RunWitness(inv);
        INFO("host stdout: " << run.stdoutPath.string());
        REQUIRE_FALSE(GradeProcessFacts(run).has_value());
        REQUIRE(run.exitCode == 0);
        CHECK(run.report["compare"].at("reference") == slot);
        CHECK(run.report["compare"].at("passed") == true);
        CHECK(run.report["compare"].at("diffCount") == 0);
    }
}

```hlsl
// Golden HLSL sample: keywords, types, semantics, numbers, preprocessor.
#include "Common.hlsli"
#define TILE_SIZE 16

cbuffer Frame : register(b0)
{
    float4x4 viewProj;
    float3   lightDir;
    float    time;
};

Texture2D<float4> albedo : register(t0);
SamplerState      linearClamp : register(s0);

struct VSOut
{
    float4 pos : SV_Position;
    float2 uv  : TEXCOORD0;
};

float4 PSMain(VSOut i) : SV_Target
{
    const float3 n = normalize(float3(0.0, 1.0, 0.25));
    float ndl = saturate(dot(n, -lightDir));
    /* a block comment */
    return albedo.Sample(linearClamp, i.uv) * (0.15 + 0.85 * ndl);
}
```

## Chunk TE5: Vim (Experimental)

> **Reconciled against `CANON.md` (2026-10-07).** Dropped tasks: none (all 58 TE5 task ids are kept). Every CANON Section C TE5 item is applied; see `#### Reconciled against CANON.md` at the end of the self-review.

Delivers the opt-in vim layer (spec s6, D7, D12, D13) as the `Vim/` folder of the `ArcaneText` library plus its editor glue, in four passes: (a) the cursor model, modes, the count/register/operator grammar, every s6.3 motion, operator and text object, Visual/VisualLine/VisualBlock, the s6.6 chord table, `gb`, and the s5.5 keyboard rules in vim modes; (b) registers, dot-repeat, macros, marks, jump and change lists, insert-session undo; (c) the `VimPattern` translator, search, the ex command line and every s6.3 ex command, folds; (d) the `editor.text.vim.*` settings, `:set`, remaps through a key trie, the Vim Preferences page, persistence, and the Shortcuts page's vim meanings. A dev-only headless Neovim oracle (`scripts/vim-oracle.ps1`, pinned version) writes or verifies the per-pass `.vimcases` tables; the multi-cursor table is hand-written and reviewed on its own.

### Vim design contract (binding inside TE5)

- **Namespace and folders.** Pure vim code is `Arcane::Text` in `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/` (compiled into `ArcaneText` by TE1's `{Core,Syntax,Vim}/**` glob, so new files need only a premake re-run). Editor glue is `Arcane::Editor` in `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/VimViewAdapter.*` and `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.*`. Every numeric `constexpr`/`static const` carries `ARC_CONSTANT("why")` on the line above (ConstantGuardTest); every tunable is a `TextVimSettings` field.
- **One mutation path.** Vim never calls `TextBuffer::Edit`. Text changes go through `VimText::Apply` (= `TextCommands(doc.buffer, doc.selections, ctx).ApplyEdits(TransactionKind::Other, ops, after, primaryIndex)`, the member of TE1's `TextCommands` class), cursor moves through `VimText::Select` (= the member `TextCommands(...).SetSelections(next, primaryIndex)`); undo/redo through the members `TextCommands(...).Undo()` / `.Redo()`, never `TextBuffer::Undo/Redo` directly. An operator computes one `EditOp` list for **all** cursors and applies it once, so multi-cursor and undo compose (spec s2.1, s6.2).
- **Positions.** Vim positions are byte offsets on a character; a line's end offset (its `'\n'`, or `Size()` on the last line) is vim's "NUL" position. `VimCursorModel` is the only converter between vim positions and editor selections (spec s6.1).
- **Three state scopes.** `VimGlobals` (one per editor process: registers, last f/t, search state, histories, macros, global marks, session remaps, last change), `VimBufferState` (one per `TextBuffer`, shared by split views: local marks, change list, last insert, last visual), `VimState` (one per `TextEditorView`: mode, parser, insert session, jump list, block corners).
- **Dispatch.** `VimState::HandleKey` -> (TE5b macro recording) -> (TE5d remap trie) -> `FeedResolved` -> per-mode handler. Normal/Visual keys go through `VimCommandParser` (data table `kVimBindings`, TE5a-4) to a `VimParsed`, which `VimState::Execute` routes to `ExecuteMotion` (TE5a-8), `ExecuteOperator` (TE5a-12), `ExtendVisualByObject` (TE5a-18) or `RunAction` (`VimActions.cpp`). Later tasks add `case` branches; every id in the TE5a-4 enums is implemented by the end of TE5d (self-review lists where).

(UTF-8 encoding of a code point is TE1-1's `Utf8::Append`; this task defines no encoder of its own, CANON B13.)

The vim keymap is keyed on characters (the character queue), named keys and Ctrl chords, never on `ImGuiKey_4` (spec s5.5). Key text is the one notation used by macros stored in registers, remaps and the `.vimcases` tables: `<Esc> <CR> <Tab> <BS> <Del> <Up> <Down> <Left> <Right> <Home> <End> <PageUp> <PageDown> <Insert> <Space> <lt> <Bar> <Bslash> <Leader> <C-x> <S-Tab> <A-x>`. An unknown `<...>` is literal text, as in vim.

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimKey.hpp
#pragma once

// One vim key (spec s5.5): a character from the character queue, a named key,
// or a Ctrl chord whose letter is the key's Latin letter. Key TEXT is the one
// notation used by macros in registers (s6.3), remaps (s6.4) and the .vimcases
// tables (s11.3); an unknown <...> is literal text, as in vim.
// Key text is UTF-8: every vim file that formats keys or registers encodes a
// code point with TE1-1's Utf8::Append, which this header brings in (the one
// encoder, CANON B13).

#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class VimNamedKey : std::uint8_t
    {
        None, Esc, Enter, Tab, Backspace, Delete, Up, Down, Left, Right, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Insert,
    };

    struct VimKey
    {
        char32_t    ch    = 0;                    // character keys and Ctrl chords
        VimNamedKey named = VimNamedKey::None;
        bool        ctrl  = false;                // ch is a lowercase Latin letter or a symbol ('[')
        bool        shift = false;                // named keys only (<S-Tab>, <S-Up>)
        bool        alt   = false;

        bool operator==(const VimKey&) const = default;

        static VimKey Char(char32_t c) { VimKey k; k.ch = c; return k; }
        static VimKey Named(VimNamedKey n, bool withShift = false) { VimKey k; k.named = n; k.shift = withShift; return k; }
        static VimKey Ctrl(char32_t c) { VimKey k; k.ch = (c >= U'A' && c <= U'Z') ? c - U'A' + U'a' : c; k.ctrl = true; return k; }

        [[nodiscard]] bool IsChar() const { return named == VimNamedKey::None && !ctrl && !alt && ch != 0; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsEsc() const { return named == VimNamedKey::Esc || (ctrl && ch == U'['); }
    };

    struct VimKeyHash
    {
        std::size_t operator()(const VimKey& k) const noexcept;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::vector<VimKey>> ParseKeys(std::string_view notation, std::string_view leader = "\\");
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatKey(const VimKey& key);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatKeys(std::span<const VimKey> keys);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimKey.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKey.hpp"

#include <array>
#include <cctype>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        struct NamedEntry { std::string_view name; VimNamedKey key; };
        constexpr std::array kNamed = {
            NamedEntry{ "esc", VimNamedKey::Esc },        NamedEntry{ "cr", VimNamedKey::Enter },
            NamedEntry{ "enter", VimNamedKey::Enter },    NamedEntry{ "return", VimNamedKey::Enter },
            NamedEntry{ "tab", VimNamedKey::Tab },        NamedEntry{ "bs", VimNamedKey::Backspace },
            NamedEntry{ "del", VimNamedKey::Delete },     NamedEntry{ "up", VimNamedKey::Up },
            NamedEntry{ "down", VimNamedKey::Down },      NamedEntry{ "left", VimNamedKey::Left },
            NamedEntry{ "right", VimNamedKey::Right },    NamedEntry{ "home", VimNamedKey::Home },
            NamedEntry{ "end", VimNamedKey::End },        NamedEntry{ "pageup", VimNamedKey::PageUp },
            NamedEntry{ "pagedown", VimNamedKey::PageDown }, NamedEntry{ "insert", VimNamedKey::Insert },
        };

        std::string Lower(std::string_view s)
        {
            std::string out(s);
            for (char& c : out) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
            return out;
        }

        // Decodes one UTF-8 code point at s[i]; 0 = invalid or truncated.
        std::size_t DecodeOne(std::string_view s, std::size_t i, char32_t& cp)
        {
            const auto b0 = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]);
            std::size_t len = 0;
            if (b0 < 0x80) { cp = b0; return 1; }
            if ((b0 & 0xE0) == 0xC0) { len = 2; cp = b0 & 0x1F; }
            else if ((b0 & 0xF0) == 0xE0) { len = 3; cp = b0 & 0x0F; }
            else if ((b0 & 0xF8) == 0xF0) { len = 4; cp = b0 & 0x07; }
            else return 0;
            if (i + len > s.size()) return 0;
            for (std::size_t k = 1; k < len; ++k)
            {
                const auto b = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i + k]);
                if ((b & 0xC0) != 0x80) return 0;
                cp = (cp << 6) | (b & 0x3F);
            }
            return len;
        }

        // The inside of a <...> group -> keys, or false when it is not a key name.
        bool ParseAngle(std::string_view inner, std::string_view leader, std::vector<VimKey>& out)
        {
            bool ctrl = false, shift = false, alt = false;
            std::string_view rest = inner;
            while (rest.size() > 2 && rest[1] == '-')
            {
                const char m = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(rest[0])));
                if (m == 'c') ctrl = true;
                else if (m == 's') shift = true;
                else if (m == 'a' || m == 'm') alt = true;
                else return false;
                rest.remove_prefix(2);
            }
            const std::string name = Lower(rest);
            if (!ctrl && !shift && !alt)
            {
                if (name == "lt")     { out.push_back(VimKey::Char(U'<')); return true; }
                if (name == "space")  { out.push_back(VimKey::Char(U' ')); return true; }
                if (name == "bar")    { out.push_back(VimKey::Char(U'|')); return true; }
                if (name == "bslash") { out.push_back(VimKey::Char(U'\\')); return true; }
                if (name == "leader")
                {
                    if (leader.find("<Leader>") != std::string_view::npos || leader.find("<leader>") != std::string_view::npos) return false;
                    const auto expanded = ParseKeys(leader, "\\");
                    if (!expanded) return false;
                    out.insert(out.end(), expanded->begin(), expanded->end());
                    return true;
                }
            }
            for (const NamedEntry& e : kNamed)
                if (name == e.name)
                {
                    VimKey k = VimKey::Named(e.key, shift);
                    k.ctrl = ctrl;
                    k.alt = alt;
                    out.push_back(k);
                    return true;
                }
            char32_t cp = 0;
            if (!rest.empty() && DecodeOne(rest, 0, cp) == rest.size() && (ctrl || alt))
            {
                VimKey k = ctrl ? VimKey::Ctrl(cp) : VimKey::Char(cp);
                k.alt = alt;
                out.push_back(k);
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    std::size_t VimKeyHash::operator()(const VimKey& k) const noexcept
    {
        std::size_t h = static_cast<std::size_t>(k.ch);
        h = h * 31u + static_cast<std::size_t>(k.named);
        h = h * 31u + (k.ctrl ? 1u : 0u) + (k.shift ? 2u : 0u) + (k.alt ? 4u : 0u);
        return h;
    }

    std::optional<std::vector<VimKey>> ParseKeys(std::string_view notation, std::string_view leader)
    {
        std::vector<VimKey> out;
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < notation.size())
        {
            if (notation[i] == '<')
            {
                const std::size_t close = notation.find('>', i + 1);
                if (close != std::string_view::npos && close > i + 1
                    && ParseAngle(notation.substr(i + 1, close - i - 1), leader, out))
                {
                    i = close + 1;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            char32_t cp = 0;
            const std::size_t len = DecodeOne(notation, i, cp);
            if (len == 0) return std::nullopt;
            out.push_back(VimKey::Char(cp));
            i += len;
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string FormatKey(const VimKey& key)
    {
        std::string mods;
        if (key.ctrl) mods += "C-";
        if (key.shift) mods += "S-";
        if (key.alt) mods += "A-";
        if (key.named != VimNamedKey::None)
        {
            std::string_view name = "Esc";
            switch (key.named)
            {
            case VimNamedKey::Esc:       name = "Esc"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::Enter:     name = "CR"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::Tab:       name = "Tab"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::Backspace: name = "BS"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::Delete:    name = "Del"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::Up:        name = "Up"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::Down:      name = "Down"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::Left:      name = "Left"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::Right:     name = "Right"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::Home:      name = "Home"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::End:       name = "End"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::PageUp:    name = "PageUp"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::PageDown:  name = "PageDown"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::Insert:    name = "Insert"; break;
            case VimNamedKey::None:      break;
            }
            return "<" + mods + std::string(name) + ">";
        }
        if (!mods.empty())
        {
            std::string out = "<" + mods;
            Utf8::Append(out, key.ch);
            return out + ">";
        }
        if (key.ch == U'<') return "<lt>";
        std::string out;
        Utf8::Append(out, key.ch);
        return out;
    }

    std::string FormatKeys(std::span<const VimKey> keys)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const VimKey& k : keys) out += FormatKey(k);
        return out;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimCursorModelTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>

#include "TextEditor/Core/DisplayMap.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
namespace CM = Arcane::Text::VimCursorModel;

namespace
{
    // "a\xC3\xA9" = "a" + U+00E9 (2 bytes): multi-byte characters must move as one.
    const Rope kWord = Rope::FromUtf8("abcd");
    const Rope kAccent = Rope::FromUtf8("a\xC3\xA9");
    const Rope kLines = Rope::FromUtf8("one\n\ntwo");   // rows: "one" [0,3) "\n"@3, "" @4, "two" [5,8)
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: Normal mode keeps the cursor on a character", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(kWord, 4) == 3);          // past the last char -> on it
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(kWord, 2) == 2);
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(kAccent, 3) == 1);        // back onto the 2-byte char's first byte
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(kLines, 4) == 4);         // an empty line: the line start is the one exception
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(kLines, 3) == 2);         // "one"'s line end -> 'e'
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(kLines, 8) == 7);         // EOF -> last char
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: inclusive motions take the character under the end", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    CHECK(CM::OperatorRange(kWord, 0, 2, MotionKind::Inclusive).begin == 0);
    CHECK(CM::OperatorRange(kWord, 0, 2, MotionKind::Inclusive).end == 3);
    CHECK(CM::OperatorRange(kWord, 2, 0, MotionKind::Inclusive).end == 3);       // order-free
    CHECK(CM::OperatorRange(kAccent, 0, 1, MotionKind::Inclusive).end == 3);     // the whole 2-byte char
    CHECK(CM::OperatorRange(kWord, 0, 2, MotionKind::Exclusive).end == 2);       // exclusive: not extended
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: linewise ranges take whole lines with their line break", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    const ByteRange mid = CM::OperatorRange(kLines, 0, 1, MotionKind::Linewise);   // rows 0..0
    CHECK(mid.begin == 0);
    CHECK(mid.end == 4);                                                          // "one\n"
    const ByteRange last = CM::LinewiseDeleteRange(kLines, 2, 2);                 // the last row takes the break before it
    CHECK(last.begin == 4);
    CHECK(last.end == 8);
    const ByteRange all = CM::LinewiseDeleteRange(kLines, 0, 2);
    CHECK(all.begin == 0);
    CHECK(all.end == 8);
    CHECK(CM::LinewiseText(kLines, 0, 1) == "one\n\n");
    CHECK(CM::LinewiseText(kLines, 2, 2) == "two\n");                             // registers always end linewise text with \n
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: Visual includes the character under the larger end", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    const ByteRange v = CM::VisualRange(kWord, 3, 1);
    CHECK(v.begin == 1);
    CHECK(v.end == 4);
    const ByteRange e = CM::VisualRange(kLines, 4, 4);                            // empty line: its line break
    CHECK(e.begin == 4);
    CHECK(e.end == 5);
    const ByteRange eol = CM::VisualRange(kLines, 0, 3);                          // v$ on "one": through the break
    CHECK(eol.end == 4);

    const Selection fwd{ 7, 1, 3, std::nullopt };
    const Selection ed = CM::ToEditorVisual(kWord, fwd);
    CHECK(ed.anchor == 1);
    CHECK(ed.head == 4);
    CHECK(ed.id == 7u);
    const Selection back = CM::FromEditorVisual(kWord, ed);
    CHECK(back.anchor == 1);
    CHECK(back.head == 3);

    const Selection rev{ 1, 3, 1, std::nullopt };
    const Selection edRev = CM::ToEditorVisual(kWord, rev);
    CHECK(edRev.anchor == 4);
    CHECK(edRev.head == 1);
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: p inserts after the cursor char, P at it; linewise below/above", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    CHECK(CM::PasteOffset(kWord, 1, true) == 2);
    CHECK(CM::PasteOffset(kWord, 1, false) == 1);
    CHECK(CM::PasteOffset(kAccent, 1, true) == 3);
    CHECK(CM::PasteOffset(kLines, 4, true) == 4);        // empty line: nothing to step over
    CHECK(CM::PasteRow(kLines, 1, true) == 1u);
    CHECK(CM::PasteRow(kLines, 1, false) == 0u);
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: entering and leaving Insert", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    const Rope r = Rope::FromUtf8("  ab\n");
    CHECK(CM::EnterInsert(r, 2, InsertEntry::Before) == 2);
    CHECK(CM::EnterInsert(r, 2, InsertEntry::After) == 3);
    CHECK(CM::EnterInsert(r, 3, InsertEntry::FirstNonBlank) == 2);
    CHECK(CM::EnterInsert(r, 3, InsertEntry::ColumnZero) == 0);
    CHECK(CM::EnterInsert(r, 2, InsertEntry::LineEnd) == 4);
    CHECK(CM::EnterInsert(kLines, 4, InsertEntry::After) == 4);   // `a` on an empty line stays

    CHECK(CM::LeaveInsert(r, 4) == 3);        // back one char
    CHECK(CM::LeaveInsert(r, 0) == 0);        // unless at the line start
    CHECK(CM::LeaveInsert(kAccent, 3) == 1);  // back over a whole multi-byte char
    CHECK(CM::LeaveInsert(r, 5) == 5);        // the empty last line's start
}

TEST_CASE("vim text: virtual columns expand tabs", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    const Rope r = Rope::FromUtf8("\tab\n");
    CHECK(VimText::VirtualColumn(r, 0, 4) == 0u);
    CHECK(VimText::VirtualColumn(r, 1, 4) == 4u);
    CHECK(VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, 0, 2, 4) == 0u);   // inside the tab -> on the tab
    CHECK(VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, 0, 5, 4) == 2u);
    CHECK(VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, 0, 99, 4) == 3u);  // past the end -> the line end
}

TEST_CASE("vim text: MapThrough shifts offsets by bias", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    const std::vector<EditOp> ops = { EditOp{ ByteRange{ 2, 2 }, "XY" }, EditOp{ ByteRange{ 5, 7 }, "" } };
    CHECK(VimText::MapThrough(1, ops, Bias::Right) == 1u);
    CHECK(VimText::MapThrough(2, ops, Bias::Left) == 2u);     // an insertion at the offset: left stays before
    CHECK(VimText::MapThrough(2, ops, Bias::Right) == 4u);
    CHECK(VimText::MapThrough(6, ops, Bias::Left) == 7u);     // inside a deletion: its start (5 + 2)
    CHECK(VimText::MapThrough(9, ops, Bias::Left) == 9u);     // +2 -2
}

TEST_CASE("vim text: Apply is one undo step through TextCommands; Select moves the primary; SyncDisplay hides folded rows", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    TextBuffer buffer(Rope::FromUtf8("one\ntwo\nthree\n"));
    SelectionSet sels;
    FoldModel folds;
    DisplayMap display;
    VimDoc doc{ buffer, sels, folds, display };
    VimText::SyncDisplay(doc);
    CHECK(display.DisplayRowCount() == 4u);

    // one batch for two cursors ("one" -> "ONE", "two" -> "TWO"); the ops arrive unsorted on purpose
    std::vector<EditOp> ops = { EditOp{ ByteRange{ 4, 7 }, "TWO" }, EditOp{ ByteRange{ 0, 3 }, "ONE" } };
    std::vector<Selection> after = { VimText::Caret(doc, 0), VimText::Caret(doc, 4) };
    VimText::Apply(doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), 1);
    CHECK(buffer.Text().ToString() == "ONE\nTWO\nthree\n");
    REQUIRE(sels.Size() == 2u);
    CHECK(sels.Primary().head == 4u);
    CHECK(buffer.UndoDepth() == 1u);
    CHECK(TextCommands(buffer, sels).Undo());                  // undo through the TextCommands class, never buffer.Undo
    CHECK(buffer.Text().ToString() == "one\ntwo\nthree\n");
    CHECK(sels.Size() == 1u);                                  // the pre-edit selections come back

    VimText::Select(doc, { VimText::Caret(doc, 8), VimText::Caret(doc, 2) }, 0);
    CHECK(sels.Primary().head == 8u);                          // primaryIndex names the primary
    CHECK(buffer.UndoDepth() == 0u);                           // a move is not an undo step

    REQUIRE(folds.Fold(buffer.Text(), FoldRange{ 0, 1 }, FoldSource::Manual));
    VimText::SyncDisplay(doc);
    CHECK(display.IsHidden(1));
    CHECK(display.DisplayRowCount() == 3u);
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: editor <-> vim visual conversion round-trips", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    rc::prop("FromEditorVisual(ToEditorVisual(s)) == s", [] {
        const std::vector<std::string> pieces = *rc::gen::container<std::vector<std::string>>(
            rc::gen::element<std::string>("a", "b", " ", "\t", "\n", "\xC3\xA9"));
        std::string text;
        for (const std::string& p : pieces) text += p;
        text += "z";                                  // the last line is never empty: EOF is not a vim position
        const Rope r = Rope::FromUtf8(text);
        // every Normal-mode position plus the line ends of non-last lines (v$)
        std::vector<ByteOffset> positions;
        for (std::uint32_t row = 0; row < r.LineCount(); ++row)
        {
            const ByteOffset s = r.LineStart(row), e = r.LineEnd(row);
            for (ByteOffset o = s; o < e; o = VimText::NextChar(r, o)) positions.push_back(o);
            if (row + 1 < r.LineCount()) positions.push_back(e);
        }
        const ByteOffset a = *rc::gen::elementOf(positions);
        const ByteOffset h = *rc::gen::elementOf(positions);
        const Selection vim{ 1, a, h, std::nullopt };
        const Selection back = CM::FromEditorVisual(r, CM::ToEditorVisual(r, vim));
        RC_ASSERT(back.anchor == a);
        RC_ASSERT(back.head == h);
    });
}

// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp
#pragma once

// The vim layer's one adapter onto TE1's core (spec s2.1): line access,
// grapheme stepping within a line, virtual columns, and the two TextCommands
// entry points every vim change and move goes through. Nothing else in Vim/
// calls a TE1 mutation directly.

#include "TextEditor/Core/DisplayMap.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"   // EditContext

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimDoc
    {
        TextBuffer&        buffer;
        SelectionSet&      selections;
        FoldModel&         folds;
        DisplayMap&        display;
        const EditContext* context = nullptr;   // the view's edit context (MakeEditContext / DefaultEditContext); null = EditContext{}
    };

    namespace VimText
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("vim behaviour: curswant MAXCOL -- after $, j/k stay at the line end (:h $)")
        inline constexpr std::uint32_t kGoalEol = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

        [[nodiscard]] std::string Line(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row);                 // without the line break
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t RowOf(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);
        [[nodiscard]] bool AtLineEnd(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset NextChar(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);                   // within the line; LineEnd stays
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset PrevChar(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);                   // within the line; LineStart stays
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t CharLen(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);                 // 0 at a line end
        [[nodiscard]] char32_t CodePointAt(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);                  // '\n' at a line end, 0 at EOF
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset FirstNonBlank(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row);         // LineEnd when the line is blank
        [[nodiscard]] std::string LeadingWhitespace(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row);
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsBlankLine(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row);                 // empty or spaces/tabs only
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t VirtualColumn(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, std::uint32_t tabSize);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset OffsetForVirtualColumn(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t vcol, std::uint32_t tabSize);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset MapThrough(ByteOffset o, std::span<const EditOp> ops, Bias bias);  // ops sorted

        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Selection> Selections(const VimDoc& d);
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t PrimaryIndex(const VimDoc& d);
        void Apply(VimDoc& d, std::vector<EditOp> ops, std::vector<Selection> after, std::size_t primary);
        void Select(VimDoc& d, std::vector<Selection> next, std::size_t primary);
        [[nodiscard]] Selection Caret(VimDoc& d, ByteOffset o, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal = std::nullopt);
        // Rebuilds d.display from d.folds and the buffer's text (TE4-12 Text::SyncDisplay).
        void SyncDisplay(VimDoc& d);
    }
}
