```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimText.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldActions.hpp"   // Text::SyncDisplay (TE4-12)
#include "TextEditor/Core/Graphemes.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text::VimText
{
    std::string Line(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row)
    {
        std::string out;
        r.CopyTo(ByteRange{ r.LineStart(row), r.LineEnd(row) }, out);
        return out;
    }

    std::uint32_t RowOf(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o) { return r.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(o, r.Size())).row; }

    bool AtLineEnd(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o) { return o >= r.LineEnd(RowOf(r, o)); }

    ByteOffset NextChar(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o)
    {
        const ByteOffset end = r.LineEnd(RowOf(r, o));
        if (o >= end) return end;
        return std::min(NextGraphemeBoundary(r, o), end);
    }

    ByteOffset PrevChar(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o)
    {
        const ByteOffset start = r.LineStart(RowOf(r, o));
        if (o <= start) return start;
        return std::max(PrevGraphemeBoundary(r, o), start);
    }

    std::uint32_t CharLen(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o) { return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(NextChar(r, o) - o); }

    char32_t CodePointAt(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o)
    {
        if (o >= r.Size()) return 0;
        std::string buf;
        r.CopyTo(ByteRange{ o, std::min<ByteOffset>(o + 4, r.Size()) }, buf);
        const Utf8::Unit d = Utf8::DecodeAt(buf, 0);
        return d.valid ? d.cp : U'�';
    }

    ByteOffset FirstNonBlank(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row)
    {
        const std::string line = Line(r, row);
        const std::size_t i = line.find_first_not_of(" \t");
        return r.LineStart(row) + (i == std::string::npos ? line.size() : i);
    }

    std::string LeadingWhitespace(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row)
    {
        const std::string line = Line(r, row);
        return line.substr(0, std::min(line.size(), line.find_first_not_of(" \t")));
    }

    bool IsBlankLine(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row) { return Line(r, row).find_first_not_of(" \t") == std::string::npos; }

    std::uint32_t VirtualColumn(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, std::uint32_t tabSize)
    {
        const std::uint32_t row = RowOf(r, o);
        std::uint32_t col = 0;
        for (ByteOffset p = r.LineStart(row); p < o && p < r.LineEnd(row); p = NextChar(r, p))
            col = CodePointAt(r, p) == U'\t' ? (col / tabSize + 1) * tabSize : col + 1;
        return col;
    }

    ByteOffset OffsetForVirtualColumn(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t vcol, std::uint32_t tabSize)
    {
        std::uint32_t col = 0;
        ByteOffset p = r.LineStart(row);
        const ByteOffset end = r.LineEnd(row);
        while (p < end)
        {
            const std::uint32_t next = CodePointAt(r, p) == U'\t' ? (col / tabSize + 1) * tabSize : col + 1;
            if (vcol < next) return p;
            col = next;
            p = NextChar(r, p);
        }
        return end;
    }

    ByteOffset MapThrough(ByteOffset o, std::span<const EditOp> ops, Bias bias)
    {
        std::int64_t delta = 0;
        for (const EditOp& op : ops)
        {
            const std::int64_t grow = static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.text.size())
                                    - static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.range.end - op.range.begin);
            if (op.range.end < o) { delta += grow; continue; }
            if (op.range.begin > o) break;
            if (op.range.begin == op.range.end)                 // a pure insertion at o
            {
                if (bias == Bias::Right) delta += grow;
                break;
            }
            if (o == op.range.begin && bias == Bias::Left) break;
            const bool atEnd = o == op.range.end;
            return static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.range.begin) + delta
                                           + ((bias == Bias::Right || atEnd) ? static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.text.size()) : 0));
        }
        return static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(o) + delta);
    }

    std::vector<Selection> Selections(const VimDoc& d)
    {
        const std::span<const Selection> all = d.selections.All();
        return std::vector<Selection>(all.begin(), all.end());
    }

    std::size_t PrimaryIndex(const VimDoc& d) { return d.selections.PrimaryIndex(); }

    void Apply(VimDoc& d, std::vector<EditOp> ops, std::vector<Selection> after, std::size_t primary)
    {
        std::stable_sort(ops.begin(), ops.end(), [](const EditOp& a, const EditOp& b) { return a.range.begin < b.range.begin; });
        // One transaction (TE1-14): Begin(current, Other), Edit(ops), selections := after, End(after).
        TextCommands(d.buffer, d.selections, d.context ? *d.context : EditContext{})
            .ApplyEdits(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), std::move(after), primary);
    }

    void Select(VimDoc& d, std::vector<Selection> next, std::size_t primary)
    {
        TextCommands(d.buffer, d.selections, d.context ? *d.context : EditContext{})
            .SetSelections(std::move(next), primary);
    }

    Selection Caret(VimDoc& d, ByteOffset o, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal)
    {
        return Selection{ d.selections.AllocateId(), o, o, goal };
    }

    void SyncDisplay(VimDoc& d)
    {
        Text::SyncDisplay(d.folds, d.display, d.buffer.Text());
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.hpp
#pragma once

// The cursor model, in one place (spec s6.1). The editor's cursors sit BETWEEN
// characters; vim's sit ON one. Every vim feature converts through here:
//   - Normal/Visual: a vim cursor on char c at offset o is the caret at o, o < line end
//     (an empty line is the one exception: o = line start);
//   - inclusive motions extend to o + len(c); exclusive do not; linewise take whole lines + break;
//   - Visual includes the char under the larger end: [min, max + len(char at max));
//   - p inserts at o + len(c), P at o; linewise registers go below / above;
//   - i keeps o, a moves to o + len(c); leaving Insert steps back one char unless at the line start.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class MotionKind : std::uint8_t { Exclusive, Inclusive, Linewise };
    enum class InsertEntry : std::uint8_t { Before, After, FirstNonBlank, ColumnZero, LineEnd };

    struct VimCursor
    {
        ByteOffset anchor = 0;   // the Visual start (= head outside Visual)
        ByteOffset head = 0;     // the vim cursor
        bool operator==(const VimCursor&) const = default;
    };

    namespace VimCursorModel
    {
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset Clamp(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset CharEnd(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset VisualCharEnd(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);    // at a line end: its break
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset PrevVisual(const Rope& r, ByteOffset end);     // inverse of VisualCharEnd
        [[nodiscard]] ByteRange  OperatorRange(const Rope& r, ByteOffset a, ByteOffset b, MotionKind kind);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteRange  LinewiseDeleteRange(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow);
        [[nodiscard]] std::string LinewiseText(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteRange  VisualRange(const Rope& r, ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head);
        [[nodiscard]] Selection  ToEditorVisual(const Rope& r, const Selection& vim);
        [[nodiscard]] Selection  FromEditorVisual(const Rope& r, const Selection& editor);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset PasteOffset(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, bool after);
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t PasteRow(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, bool after);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset EnterInsert(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, InsertEntry entry);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset LeaveInsert(const Rope& r, ByteOffset caret);
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text::VimCursorModel
{
    ByteOffset Clamp(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o)
    {
        o = std::min<ByteOffset>(o, r.Size());
        const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
        const ByteOffset start = r.LineStart(row), end = r.LineEnd(row);
        if (start == end) return start;
        if (o >= end) return VimText::PrevChar(r, end);
        return o;
    }

    ByteOffset CharEnd(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o) { return VimText::NextChar(r, o); }

    ByteOffset VisualCharEnd(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o)
    {
        if (VimText::AtLineEnd(r, o)) return std::min<ByteOffset>(o + 1, r.Size());
        return VimText::NextChar(r, o);
    }

    ByteOffset PrevVisual(const Rope& r, ByteOffset end)
    {
        if (end == 0) return 0;
        const ByteOffset before = end - 1;
        if (before < r.Size() && VimText::AtLineEnd(r, before)) return before;   // the break: a line-end position
        return VimText::PrevChar(r, end);
    }

    ByteRange LinewiseDeleteRange(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow)
    {
        if (lastRow + 1 < r.LineCount()) return ByteRange{ r.LineStart(firstRow), r.LineStart(lastRow + 1) };
        if (firstRow > 0) return ByteRange{ r.LineEnd(firstRow - 1), r.Size() };
        return ByteRange{ 0, r.Size() };
    }

    std::string LinewiseText(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (std::uint32_t row = firstRow; row <= lastRow; ++row)
        {
            out += VimText::Line(r, row);
            out.push_back('\n');
        }
        return out;
    }

    ByteRange OperatorRange(const Rope& r, ByteOffset a, ByteOffset b, MotionKind kind)
    {
        const ByteOffset lo = std::min(a, b), hi = std::max(a, b);
        switch (kind)
        {
        case MotionKind::Exclusive: return ByteRange{ lo, hi };
        case MotionKind::Inclusive: return ByteRange{ lo, CharEnd(r, hi) };
        case MotionKind::Linewise:  return LinewiseDeleteRange(r, VimText::RowOf(r, lo), VimText::RowOf(r, hi));
        }
        return ByteRange{ lo, hi };
    }

    ByteRange VisualRange(const Rope& r, ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head)
    {
        const ByteOffset lo = std::min(anchor, head), hi = std::max(anchor, head);
        return ByteRange{ lo, VisualCharEnd(r, hi) };
    }

    Selection ToEditorVisual(const Rope& r, const Selection& vim)
    {
        Selection out = vim;
        if (vim.head >= vim.anchor) { out.anchor = vim.anchor; out.head = VisualCharEnd(r, vim.head); }
        else                        { out.anchor = VisualCharEnd(r, vim.anchor); out.head = vim.head; }
        return out;
    }

    Selection FromEditorVisual(const Rope& r, const Selection& editor)
    {
        Selection out = editor;
        if (editor.head > editor.anchor)      { out.anchor = editor.anchor; out.head = PrevVisual(r, editor.head); }
        else if (editor.head < editor.anchor) { out.head = editor.head; out.anchor = PrevVisual(r, editor.anchor); }
        return out;
    }

    ByteOffset PasteOffset(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, bool after) { return after ? CharEnd(r, o) : o; }

    std::uint32_t PasteRow(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, bool after)
    {
        const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
        return after ? row + 1 : row;
    }

    ByteOffset EnterInsert(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, InsertEntry entry)
    {
        const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
        switch (entry)
        {
        case InsertEntry::Before:        return o;
        case InsertEntry::After:         return CharEnd(r, o);
        case InsertEntry::FirstNonBlank: return VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row);
        case InsertEntry::ColumnZero:    return r.LineStart(row);
        case InsertEntry::LineEnd:       return r.LineEnd(row);
        }
        return o;
    }

    ByteOffset LeaveInsert(const Rope& r, ByteOffset caret)
    {
        const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, caret);
        if (caret <= r.LineStart(row)) return caret;
        return VimText::PrevChar(r, caret);
    }
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (TE3-2, `TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp`): `static std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const Regex>, RegexError> Regex::Compile(std::string_view, RegexOptions = RegexOptions::None)`, `struct RegexLimits`, `class MatchScratch { explicit MatchScratch(RegexLimits); MatchStatus Match(const Regex&, std::string_view subject, std::size_t start, MatchFlags = MatchFlags::None); }`, `enum class MatchStatus { Match, NoMatch, LimitHit, Error }`. Every pattern is compiled with `PCRE2_UTF | PCRE2_MATCH_INVALID_UTF` (TE3-2), and under UTF `\p{..}` property escapes always use Unicode properties; `RegexOptions::Ucp` only changes `\w \d \s \b` and POSIX classes, so the `[\p{L}\p{N}]` probe needs no option. (TE3-7/8, `TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp`) `struct GrammarDesc { ...; lineComment; blockCommentBegin; blockCommentEnd; indentIncrease; indentDecrease; wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_"; ... }`, `std::expected<GrammarDesc, GrammarError> ParseGrammar(std::string_view jsonText)`, `GrammarError::Text()`, `CompiledGrammar::Rules().Desc()`. (Test helper) `Arcane::Test::RepoRoot()` from `ArcaneTests/src/Helpers/ConstantScan.hpp`; the engine grammar file `data/Syntaxes/Lua.arcsyntax` (TE3, stem `Lua`).
- Produces:
  - `struct VimOptions` (fields and Neovim defaults below), `bool ParseNrFormats(std::string_view, VimOptions&)`, `std::string FormatNrFormats(const VimOptions&)`
  - `struct VimLanguage { name, wordChars, lineComment, blockCommentBegin, blockCommentEnd, indentIncrease, indentDecrease; }`, `VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const GrammarDesc&)`, `VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const CompiledGrammar& g)` (= `VimLanguageFromGrammar(g.Rules().Desc())`), `std::string VimCommentString(const VimLanguage&)`
  - `class VimCharClass { explicit VimCharClass(std::string_view wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_"); VimCharClass(const VimCharClass&); VimCharClass& operator=(const VimCharClass&); int Class(char32_t, bool bigWord) const; bool IsWord(char32_t) const; std::string PcreClass() const; std::string PcreClassNoDigits() const; }` -- owns a private `mutable MatchScratch m_scratch{ RegexLimits{} }` (a one-code-point probe, the one vim matcher that does not use `VimGlobals::scratch`; CANON C TE5 item 4) and shares one compiled `std::shared_ptr<const Regex>` for `^[\p{L}\p{N}]` across instances. Copying copies the word set and the memo and gives the copy a FRESH scratch (`MatchScratch` is non-copyable and pinned to the first thread that matches).

`VimOptions` is the pure value the vim layer reads; its defaults are Neovim's (D13). Until TE5d-1 binds it to `editor.text.vim.*`, the Neovim defaults hold for every option except the ones TE5a-23 and TE5b-1 already register. The word class is the grammar's `wordChars` plus every non-ASCII letter and digit (`\p{L}\p{N}`, spec s11.3), so `w` over `café` matches Neovim; non-ASCII membership is answered by PCRE2 itself (one compiled `^[\p{L}\p{N}]`, matched through the class's own `MatchScratch` and memoized per code point) so Arcane carries no Unicode tables of its own. The vim layer only ever needs the grammar's DESCRIPTION (comment tokens, `wordChars`, indent patterns), so `VimLanguageFromGrammar` takes TE3-7's `GrammarDesc`; the `CompiledGrammar` overload forwards `g.Rules().Desc()` for the editor, and tests parse the `.arcsyntax` file text with `ParseGrammar` (no registry, no compile).

```cpp
TEST_CASE("vim word classes: blank, punctuation, word; bigWord folds punctuation into words", "[text-vim-chars]")
{
    const VimCharClass c;
    CHECK(c.Class(U' ', false) == 0);
    CHECK(c.Class(U'\t', false) == 0);
    CHECK(c.Class(U'\n', false) == 0);
    CHECK(c.Class(0, false) == 0);
    CHECK(c.Class(U' ', false) == 0);        // NBSP is blank, as in vim's utf_class
    CHECK(c.Class(U'a', false) == 2);
    CHECK(c.Class(U'_', false) == 2);
    CHECK(c.Class(U'.', false) == 1);
    CHECK(c.Class(U'.', true) == 1);
    CHECK(c.Class(U'a', true) == 1);              // bigWord: every non-blank is one class
    CHECK(c.Class(U'é', false) == 2);        // e-acute: \p{L}
    CHECK(c.Class(U'١', false) == 2);        // Arabic-Indic one: \p{N}
    CHECK(c.Class(U'—', false) == 1);        // em dash: punctuation
    CHECK(c.IsWord(U'中'));
}

TEST_CASE("vim word classes: the grammar's wordChars decide ASCII membership", "[text-vim-chars]")
{
    const VimCharClass css("A-Za-z0-9_\\-");
    CHECK(css.IsWord(U'-'));
    CHECK_FALSE(VimCharClass().IsWord(U'-'));
    const VimCharClass d("\\d_");
    CHECK(d.IsWord(U'7'));
    CHECK_FALSE(d.IsWord(U'a'));
}

TEST_CASE("vim word classes: the PCRE2 [K] class is generated, never \\w", "[text-vim-chars]")
{
    CHECK(VimCharClass().PcreClass() == "[0-9A-Z_a-z\\p{L}\\p{N}]");
    CHECK(VimCharClass().PcreClassNoDigits() == "[A-Z_a-z\\p{L}]");
    CHECK(VimCharClass("A-Za-z0-9_\\-").PcreClass() == "[\\-0-9A-Z_a-z\\p{L}\\p{N}]");
}

TEST_CASE("vim word classes: a copy answers alike and owns its own scratch", "[text-vim-chars]")
{
    VimCharClass a("A-Za-z0-9_\\-");
    CHECK(a.IsWord(U'é'));                         // memoized in a, matched through a's scratch
    const VimCharClass b = a;                      // copy: word set + memo, fresh MatchScratch
    CHECK(b.IsWord(U'-'));
    CHECK(b.IsWord(U'é'));
    CHECK(b.IsWord(U'ж'));                         // not memoized yet: b's own scratch matches
    CHECK_FALSE(b.IsWord(U'—'));
    a = VimCharClass();                            // assignment keeps a's scratch, replaces the set
    CHECK_FALSE(a.IsWord(U'-'));
    CHECK(a.IsWord(U'ж'));
}

TEST_CASE("vim language: comment, wordChars and indent come from the grammar file", "[text-vim-chars]")
{
    std::ifstream in(Arcane::Test::RepoRoot() / "data" / "Syntaxes" / "Lua.arcsyntax", std::ios::binary);
    REQUIRE(in.good());
    const std::string text{ std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>() };
    const auto lua = ParseGrammar(text);
    REQUIRE(lua.has_value());
    const VimLanguage l = VimLanguageFromGrammar(*lua);
    CHECK(l.name == "Lua");
    CHECK(l.lineComment == "--");
    CHECK(l.blockCommentBegin == "--[[");
    CHECK(l.blockCommentEnd == "]]");
    CHECK(VimCommentString(l) == "-- %s");                 // the line comment wins over the block pair
    CHECK(l.wordChars == "A-Za-z0-9_");
    CHECK_FALSE(l.indentIncrease.empty());
    CHECK_FALSE(l.indentDecrease.empty());

    GrammarDesc bare;                                      // a grammar without comment/indent keys
    bare.name = "Bare";
    bare.wordChars.clear();                                // "" never empties vim's word class
    const VimLanguage b = VimLanguageFromGrammar(bare);
    CHECK(b.name == "Bare");
    CHECK(b.wordChars == "A-Za-z0-9_");
    CHECK(VimCommentString(b).empty());

    VimLanguage block;
    block.blockCommentBegin = "/*";
    block.blockCommentEnd = "*/";
    CHECK(VimCommentString(block) == "/* %s */");
    CHECK(VimCommentString(VimLanguage{}).empty());     // Plain Text: no commentstring
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.hpp
#pragma once

// The vim options as one plain value (spec s6.4). Defaults are NEOVIM's (D13):
// Y = y$, hlsearch + incsearch on, startofline off, nrformats=bin,hex,
// scrolloff 0, wrapscan on. TE5d-1 fills this from editor.text.vim.* and the
// editor-wide editor.text.* indentation settings; until then the defaults hold.

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimOptions
    {
        bool          ignorecase = false;
        bool          smartcase = false;
        bool          hlsearch = true;
        bool          incsearch = true;
        bool          wrapscan = true;
        bool          gdefault = false;
        std::uint32_t timeoutlenMs = 1000;
        std::uint32_t scrolloff = 0;
        bool          startofline = false;
        bool          nrBin = true, nrHex = true, nrOctal = false, nrAlpha = false;
        bool          yankToEol = true;                 // Y = y$ (Neovim) vs yy (Vim)
        std::string   leader = "\\";
        bool          handleCtrlKeys = true;            // spec s6.6
        bool          useSystemClipboard = false;       // " aliases +
        // editor-wide text settings (spec s6.4: not vim-only)
        std::uint32_t tabSize = 4;
        std::uint32_t shiftWidth = 4;
        bool          expandTab = true;
        std::uint64_t multilineSearchMaxBytes = 64ull << 20;
        // (no cursor cap here: gb reads editor.text.maxCursors through the view's EditContext, TE5a-21)
    };

    // "bin,hex" -> the nr* flags. False (and `out` untouched) on an unknown item.
    [[nodiscard]] bool ParseNrFormats(std::string_view text, VimOptions& out);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatNrFormats(const VimOptions& o);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    bool ParseNrFormats(std::string_view text, VimOptions& out)
    {
        bool bin = false, hex = false, octal = false, alpha = false;
        while (!text.empty())
        {
            const std::size_t comma = text.find(',');
            const std::string_view item = text.substr(0, comma);
            if (item == "bin") bin = true;
            else if (item == "hex") hex = true;
            else if (item == "octal") octal = true;
            else if (item == "alpha") alpha = true;
            else if (!item.empty()) return false;
            if (comma == std::string_view::npos) break;
            text.remove_prefix(comma + 1);
        }
        out.nrBin = bin; out.nrHex = hex; out.nrOctal = octal; out.nrAlpha = alpha;
        return true;
    }

    std::string FormatNrFormats(const VimOptions& o)
    {
        std::string out;
        const auto add = [&out](bool on, std::string_view name) {
            if (!on) return;
            if (!out.empty()) out.push_back(',');
            out += name;
        };
        add(o.nrBin, "bin");
        add(o.nrOctal, "octal");
        add(o.nrHex, "hex");
        add(o.nrAlpha, "alpha");
        return out;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimLanguage.hpp
#pragma once

// What the vim layer takes from the document's grammar (spec s6.3 gc, s6.5
// [K], s11.3): comment tokens, the wordChars class body, and the indent rules
// `=` uses. Plain Text = the defaults (no comment, ASCII word chars). The
// source is TE3-7's GrammarDesc -- the parsed description, no compile needed;
// the CompiledGrammar overload reads the description its rules were built from.

#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct GrammarDesc;
    class CompiledGrammar;

    struct VimLanguage
    {
        std::string name = "Plain Text";
        std::string wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_";
        std::string lineComment;
        std::string blockCommentBegin, blockCommentEnd;
        std::string indentIncrease, indentDecrease;   // PCRE2 sources; empty = none
    };

    [[nodiscard]] VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const GrammarDesc& desc);
    [[nodiscard]] VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const CompiledGrammar& grammar);   // = (grammar.Rules().Desc())
    // Neovim's padded commentstring for this language: "// %s", "/* %s */", or "" (none).
    [[nodiscard]] std::string VimCommentString(const VimLanguage& language);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimLanguage.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimLanguage.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp"   // GrammarDesc (TE3-7), CompiledGrammar::Rules().Desc() (TE3-8)

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const GrammarDesc& desc)
    {
        VimLanguage out;
        if (!desc.name.empty()) out.name = desc.name;
        if (!desc.wordChars.empty()) out.wordChars = desc.wordChars;
        out.lineComment = desc.lineComment;
        out.blockCommentBegin = desc.blockCommentBegin;
        out.blockCommentEnd = desc.blockCommentEnd;
        out.indentIncrease = desc.indentIncrease;
        out.indentDecrease = desc.indentDecrease;
        return out;
    }

    VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const CompiledGrammar& grammar)
    {
        return VimLanguageFromGrammar(grammar.Rules().Desc());
    }

    std::string VimCommentString(const VimLanguage& language)
    {
        if (!language.lineComment.empty()) return language.lineComment + " %s";
        if (!language.blockCommentBegin.empty() && !language.blockCommentEnd.empty())
            return language.blockCommentBegin + " %s " + language.blockCommentEnd;
        return {};
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCharClass.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim's character classes for word motions and \k (spec s6.5, s11.3): class 0
// blank (space, tab, line end, NBSP), 1 punctuation, 2 word. ASCII word
// membership is the grammar's wordChars; every non-ASCII letter or digit
// (\p{L}\p{N}) is a word character, answered by PCRE2 and memoized.
//
// The PCRE2 probe runs through the class's OWN MatchScratch (CANON A6: a
// one-code-point match needs no settings limits, so it does not borrow
// VimGlobals::scratch, and pure vim code never reads settings). The compiled
// pattern is shared by every instance. MatchScratch is non-copyable and
// pinned to the first thread that matches, so a copy of a VimCharClass gets
// a fresh scratch; assignment keeps the target's scratch.

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp"   // MatchScratch, RegexLimits (TE3-2)

#include <bitset>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    class VimCharClass
    {
    public:
        explicit VimCharClass(std::string_view wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_");
        VimCharClass(const VimCharClass& other);
        VimCharClass& operator=(const VimCharClass& other);

        [[nodiscard]] int Class(char32_t cp, bool bigWord) const;
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsWord(char32_t cp) const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string PcreClass() const;          // [K]
        [[nodiscard]] std::string PcreClassNoDigits() const;  // [K] minus digits (vim \K, \I)

    private:
        [[nodiscard]] std::string AsciiMembers(bool withDigits) const;
        // \p{L} or \p{N} by PCRE2's tables, matched through m_scratch.
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsUnicodeLetterOrDigit(char32_t cp) const;

        std::bitset<128> m_ascii;
        mutable std::unordered_map<char32_t, bool> m_unicode;
        mutable MatchScratch m_scratch{ RegexLimits{} };
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCharClass.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCharClass.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKey.hpp"   // Utf8::Append (via TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp)

#include <memory>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        // Compiled once, shared read-only by every VimCharClass (TE3-2: a Regex
        // is immutable and thread-shareable). Under PCRE2_UTF (always on) a
        // \p{..} escape uses Unicode properties without RegexOptions::Ucp.
        // Null only if PCRE2 was built without Unicode support (TE3-1 builds it with).
        const std::shared_ptr<const Regex>& LetterOrDigitRegex()
        {
            static const std::shared_ptr<const Regex> s_regex = []() -> std::shared_ptr<const Regex> {
                auto compiled = Regex::Compile("^[\\p{L}\\p{N}]");
                return compiled ? *compiled : nullptr;
            }();
            return s_regex;
        }
    }

    bool VimCharClass::IsUnicodeLetterOrDigit(char32_t cp) const
    {
        const std::shared_ptr<const Regex>& re = LetterOrDigitRegex();
        if (!re) return false;
        std::string utf8;
        Utf8::Append(utf8, cp);
        return m_scratch.Match(*re, utf8, 0) == MatchStatus::Match;
    }

    VimCharClass::VimCharClass(const VimCharClass& other)
        : m_ascii(other.m_ascii), m_unicode(other.m_unicode), m_scratch(RegexLimits{})
    {
    }

    VimCharClass& VimCharClass::operator=(const VimCharClass& other)
    {
        if (this != &other)
        {
            m_ascii = other.m_ascii;
            m_unicode = other.m_unicode;   // m_scratch stays: it is this object's own match state
        }
        return *this;
    }

    VimCharClass::VimCharClass(std::string_view body)
    {
        const auto set = [this](char32_t lo, char32_t hi) {
            for (char32_t c = lo; c <= hi && c < 128; ++c) m_ascii.set(c);
        };
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < body.size())
        {
            char32_t c = static_cast<unsigned char>(body[i]);
            if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < body.size())
            {
                const char e = body[i + 1];
                i += 2;
                if (e == 'd') { set('0', '9'); continue; }
                if (e == 'w') { set('0', '9'); set('A', 'Z'); set('a', 'z'); set('_', '_'); continue; }
                c = static_cast<unsigned char>(e);
            }
            else
                ++i;
            if (i + 1 < body.size() && body[i] == '-')
            {
                char32_t hi = static_cast<unsigned char>(body[i + 1]);
                std::size_t step = 2;
                if (hi == '\\' && i + 2 < body.size()) { hi = static_cast<unsigned char>(body[i + 2]); step = 3; }
                set(c, hi);
                i += step;
                continue;
            }
            if (c < 128) m_ascii.set(c);
        }
    }

    bool VimCharClass::IsWord(char32_t cp) const
    {
        if (cp < 128) return m_ascii.test(cp);
        if (const auto it = m_unicode.find(cp); it != m_unicode.end()) return it->second;
        const bool word = IsUnicodeLetterOrDigit(cp);
        m_unicode.emplace(cp, word);
        return word;
    }

    int VimCharClass::Class(char32_t cp, bool bigWord) const
    {
        if (cp == 0 || cp == U' ' || cp == U'\t' || cp == U'\n' || cp == U' ') return 0;
        if (bigWord) return 1;
        return IsWord(cp) ? 2 : 1;
    }

    std::string VimCharClass::AsciiMembers(bool withDigits) const
    {
        std::string out;
        for (char32_t c = 0x21; c < 0x7F; ++c)
        {
            if (!m_ascii.test(c) || (!withDigits && c >= U'0' && c <= U'9')) continue;
            char32_t end = c;
            while (end + 1 < 0x7F && m_ascii.test(end + 1) && (withDigits || end + 1 < U'0' || end + 1 > U'9')) ++end;
            const auto emit = [&out](char32_t ch) {
                if (ch == U'\\' || ch == U']' || ch == U'[' || ch == U'^' || ch == U'-') out.push_back('\\');
                out.push_back(static_cast<char>(ch));
            };
            emit(c);
            if (end >= c + 2) { out.push_back('-'); emit(end); c = end; }
            else if (end == c + 1) { emit(end); c = end; }
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string VimCharClass::PcreClass() const { return "[" + AsciiMembers(true) + "\\p{L}\\p{N}]"; }
    std::string VimCharClass::PcreClassNoDigits() const { return "[" + AsciiMembers(false) + "\\p{L}]"; }
}
```

### Task TE5a-4: The vim key table and the count/register/operator grammar (spec s6.2, s6.3, s6.6 "this table is data")

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimKey`, `ParseKeys`, `FormatKeys` (TE5a-1).
- Produces:
  - `enum class VimMode { Normal, Insert, Replace, Visual, VisualLine, VisualBlock, OperatorPending, CommandLine }`, `bool IsVisual(VimMode)`, `std::string_view VimModeCode(VimMode)` (`n i R v V ^V no c`), `const char* VimModeLabel(VimMode)` (status strip text).
  - `enum class VimCmdKind`, `enum class VimArgKind { None, Literal, Name }`, `enum class VimModeBits`, `enum class VimMotionId`, `enum class VimOperatorId`, `enum class VimObjectId`, `enum class VimActionId` (full lists below; every id is implemented by the task the comment names).
  - `struct VimBinding { keys, modes, kind, id, inner, arg }`, `std::span<const VimBinding> VimBindings()`, `const std::vector<std::vector<VimKey>>& VimBindingKeys()` (parsed once, same order).
  - `struct VimParsed { count, reg, op, linewiseDouble, kind, id, inner, arg, keys; Count1(); Has(); template Id<E>(); }`, `enum class VimParseStatus { NeedMore, Complete, Invalid }`, `class VimCommandParser { Feed(const VimKey&, VimMode); Result(); Reset(); Idle(); OperatorPending(); AwaitingLiteral(); PendingText(); }`.

Vim's built-in keys are prefix-free, so the parser resolves as soon as a full binding matches; ambiguity only arises with remaps (the TE5d trie). The table is the s6.3 coverage as data; the s6.6 Ctrl chord rows are in it too, and TE5a-20 decides per mode whether vim claims a chord at all (`handleCtrlKeys`).

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimCommandParserTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandParser.hpp"

#include <set>
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    VimParseStatus FeedAll(VimCommandParser& p, std::string_view notation, VimMode mode = VimMode::Normal)
    {
        VimParseStatus s = VimParseStatus::NeedMore;
        for (const VimKey& k : *ParseKeys(notation))
        {
            s = p.Feed(k, mode);
            if (s != VimParseStatus::NeedMore) break;
        }
        return s;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: effective count = pre x post", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "2d3w") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    const VimParsed& r = p.Result();
    CHECK(r.count == 6u);
    REQUIRE(r.op.has_value());
    CHECK(*r.op == VimOperatorId::Delete);
    CHECK(r.kind == VimCmdKind::Motion);
    CHECK(r.Id<VimMotionId>() == VimMotionId::WordFwd);
    CHECK(FormatKeys(r.keys) == "2d3w");
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: doubled operators are linewise on the current line", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    for (const char* keys : { "dd", "yy", "cc", ">>", "<<", "==", "gUU", "gUgU", "guu", "g~~", "gcc" })
    {
        VimCommandParser p;
        INFO(keys);
        REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, keys) == VimParseStatus::Complete);
        CHECK(p.Result().linewiseDouble);
        CHECK(p.Result().kind == VimCmdKind::Operator);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: register prefix, counts around it, black hole", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "\"a2yy") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().reg == U'a');
    CHECK(p.Result().count == 2u);
    CHECK(*p.Result().op == VimOperatorId::Yank);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "3\"_dd") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().reg == U'_');
    CHECK(p.Result().count == 3u);
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: 0 is a motion unless a count is being typed", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "0") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimMotionId>() == VimMotionId::LineStart);
    CHECK(p.Result().count == 0u);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "100G") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().count == 100u);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimMotionId>() == VimMotionId::FileEnd);
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: literal and name arguments", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "d2f") == VimParseStatus::NeedMore);
    CHECK(p.AwaitingLiteral());
    CHECK(p.OperatorPending());
    CHECK(p.PendingText() == "d2f");
    REQUIRE(p.Feed(VimKey::Char(U'é'), VimMode::Normal) == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().arg == U'é');
    CHECK(p.Result().count == 2u);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "ma") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimActionId>() == VimActionId::SetMark);
    CHECK(p.Result().arg == U'a');
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "m") == VimParseStatus::NeedMore);
    CHECK_FALSE(p.AwaitingLiteral());                    // a mark NAME: Latin letters (spec s5.5)
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "<C-w>v") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimActionId>() == VimActionId::WindowCommand);
    CHECK(p.Result().arg == U'v');
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: text objects only after an operator or in Visual", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "gUiw") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(*p.Result().op == VimOperatorId::Upper);
    CHECK(p.Result().kind == VimCmdKind::TextObject);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimObjectId>() == VimObjectId::Word);
    CHECK(p.Result().inner);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "a(", VimMode::Visual) == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimObjectId>() == VimObjectId::Paren);
    CHECK_FALSE(p.Result().inner);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "i") == VimParseStatus::Complete);   // Normal: i is Insert, never a text-object prefix
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimActionId>() == VimActionId::InsertBefore);
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: an operator in Visual applies at once; mode-specific keys", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "d", VimMode::Visual) == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().kind == VimCmdKind::Operator);
    CHECK_FALSE(p.Result().linewiseDouble);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "u", VimMode::VisualLine) == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().kind == VimCmdKind::Operator);
    CHECK(*p.Result().op == VimOperatorId::Lower);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "u") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimActionId>() == VimActionId::Undo);
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: invalid sequences and Esc cancel", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    CHECK(FeedAll(p, "dx") == VimParseStatus::Invalid);
    p.Reset();
    CHECK(FeedAll(p, "d<Esc>") == VimParseStatus::Invalid);
    p.Reset();
    CHECK(FeedAll(p, "dc") == VimParseStatus::Invalid);     // an operator inside a pending operator
    p.Reset();
    CHECK(p.Idle());
}

TEST_CASE("vim key table: every row parses and no full binding is a prefix of another in the same mode", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    const auto bindings = VimBindings();
    const auto& keys = VimBindingKeys();
    REQUIRE(keys.size() == bindings.size());
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < bindings.size(); ++i)
    {
        INFO(std::string(bindings[i].keys));
        REQUIRE_FALSE(keys[i].empty());
        for (std::size_t j = 0; j < bindings.size(); ++j)
        {
            if (i == j || (static_cast<unsigned>(bindings[i].modes) & static_cast<unsigned>(bindings[j].modes)) == 0) continue;
            if (keys[j].size() <= keys[i].size()) continue;
            const bool prefix = std::equal(keys[i].begin(), keys[i].end(), keys[j].begin());
            INFO("prefix of " << std::string(bindings[j].keys));
            CHECK_FALSE(prefix);
        }
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim modes: nvim_get_mode codes and status labels", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    CHECK(VimModeCode(VimMode::Normal) == "n");
    CHECK(VimModeCode(VimMode::VisualBlock) == "^V");
    CHECK(VimModeCode(VimMode::OperatorPending) == "no");
    CHECK(std::string(VimModeLabel(VimMode::VisualLine)) == "VISUAL LINE");
    CHECK(IsVisual(VimMode::VisualBlock));
    CHECK_FALSE(IsVisual(VimMode::OperatorPending));
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCommand.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim's command vocabulary (spec s6.2, s6.3). Every id here is implemented by
// the task named in its comment; the key table (VimKeymap.cpp) maps key
// sequences to these ids per mode.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKey.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class VimMode : std::uint8_t { Normal, Insert, Replace, Visual, VisualLine, VisualBlock, OperatorPending, CommandLine };

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsVisual(VimMode m) noexcept
    {
        return m == VimMode::Visual || m == VimMode::VisualLine || m == VimMode::VisualBlock;
    }
    [[nodiscard]] std::string_view VimModeCode(VimMode m) noexcept;   // nvim_get_mode() codes: n i R v V ^V no c
    [[nodiscard]] const char* VimModeLabel(VimMode m) noexcept;       // "NORMAL", "INSERT", "VISUAL LINE", ...

    enum class VimCmdKind : std::uint8_t { Motion, Operator, TextObject, Action };
    enum class VimArgKind : std::uint8_t { None, Literal, Name };   // Literal: f t r (layout characters); Name: marks, registers, macros, Ctrl-W

    enum class VimModeBits : std::uint8_t { None = 0, Normal = 1, Visual = 2, OpPending = 4 };
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr VimModeBits operator|(VimModeBits a, VimModeBits b) noexcept
    {
        return static_cast<VimModeBits>(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(a) | static_cast<std::uint8_t>(b));
    }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool Any(VimModeBits a, VimModeBits b) noexcept
    {
        return (static_cast<std::uint8_t>(a) & static_cast<std::uint8_t>(b)) != 0;
    }

    enum class VimMotionId : std::uint16_t
    {
        Left, Right, Down, Up, DisplayDown, DisplayUp,                                    // TE5a-8
        LineStart, FirstNonBlank, LineEnd, LastNonBlank, FileStart, FileEnd, Column,      // TE5a-8
        FirstNonBlankDown, FirstNonBlankUp, CurrentLine,                                  // TE5a-8
        WordFwd, BigWordFwd, WordBack, BigWordBack, WordEnd, BigWordEnd,                  // TE5a-9
        WordEndBack, BigWordEndBack,                                                      // TE5a-9
        FindFwd, FindBack, TillFwd, TillBack, RepeatFind, RepeatFindReverse,              // TE5a-10
        MatchPair, SentenceBack, SentenceFwd, ParagraphBack, ParagraphFwd,                // TE5a-10
        ScreenTop, ScreenMiddle, ScreenBottom,                                            // TE5a-11
        SearchFwd, SearchBack, SearchNext, SearchPrev,                                    // TE5c-5
        SearchWordFwd, SearchWordBack, SearchPartialFwd, SearchPartialBack,               // TE5c-5
        MarkExact, MarkLine,                                                              // TE5b-6
        FoldNext, FoldPrev,                                                               // TE5c-15
    };

    enum class VimOperatorId : std::uint8_t
    {
        Delete, Change, Yank,                                  // TE5a-12
        IndentRight, IndentLeft, Reindent,                     // TE5a-13
        ToggleCase, Lower, Upper,                              // TE5a-13
        Comment,                                               // TE5a-14
        Fold,                                                  // TE5c-15
    };

    enum class VimObjectId : std::uint8_t
    {
        Word, BigWord, Sentence, Paragraph,                    // TE5a-16
        DoubleQuote, SingleQuote, BackQuote,                   // TE5a-17
        Paren, Brace, Bracket, Angle, Tag,                     // TE5a-17
    };

    enum class VimActionId : std::uint16_t
    {
        InsertBefore, Append, InsertFirstNonBlank, InsertColumnZero, AppendLineEnd, OpenBelow, OpenAbove,   // TE5a-5
        InsertAtLastInsert,                                                                                 // TE5b-6
        DeleteChar, DeleteCharBack, DeleteToEol, ChangeToEol, SubstituteChar, SubstituteLine, YankLine,     // TE5a-12
        PutAfter, PutBefore, PutAfterMoveCursor, PutBeforeMoveCursor,                                       // TE5a-12
        JoinLines, JoinLinesNoSpace, ToggleCaseChar,                                                        // TE5a-13
        Increment, Decrement,                                                                               // TE5a-15
        ScrollHalfDown, ScrollHalfUp, ScrollPageDown, ScrollPageUp, ScrollLineDown, ScrollLineUp,           // TE5a-11
        ScrollCenter, ScrollTop, ScrollBottom,                                                              // TE5a-11
        VisualChar, VisualLine, VisualBlock, VisualSwapEnds, VisualSwapCorner, ReselectVisual,              // TE5a-18
        VisualInsert, VisualAppend, VisualDeleteLines, VisualYankLines, VisualChangeLines,                  // TE5a-18
        ReplaceChar, ReplaceMode,                                                                           // TE5a-19
        WindowCommand,                                                                                      // TE5a-20
        AddNextMatch,                                                                                       // TE5a-21
        Undo, Redo, RepeatChange, RecordMacro, RunMacro, RunLastRecorded,                                   // TE5b-3/4/5
        SetMark, JumpOlder, JumpNewer, ChangeOlder, ChangeNewer,                                            // TE5b-6/8
        EnterExCommand, RepeatSubstitute, WriteQuit, QuitDiscard,                                           // TE5c-6/8/13
        FoldClose, FoldOpen, FoldToggle, FoldOpenAll, FoldCloseAll, FoldDelete,                             // TE5c-15
    };

    struct VimBinding
    {
        std::string_view keys;
        VimModeBits      modes = VimModeBits::None;
        VimCmdKind       kind = VimCmdKind::Action;
        std::uint16_t    id = 0;
        bool             inner = false;                 // text objects: i (true) / a (false)
        VimArgKind       arg = VimArgKind::None;
    };

    struct VimParsed
    {
        std::uint32_t                count = 0;         // effective (pre x post); 0 = none typed
        char32_t                     reg = 0;           // 0 = none
        std::optional<VimOperatorId> op;
        bool                         linewiseDouble = false;   // dd yy cc >> << == g~~ guu gUU gcc
        VimCmdKind                   kind = VimCmdKind::Action;
        std::uint16_t                id = 0;
        bool                         inner = false;
        char32_t                     arg = 0;
        std::vector<VimKey>          keys;              // every key of the command (status strip, dot-repeat)

        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t Count1() const { return count == 0 ? 1u : count; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool Has(VimActionId a) const { return kind == VimCmdKind::Action && id == static_cast<std::uint16_t>(a); }
        template <class E> [[nodiscard]] E Id() const { return static_cast<E>(id); }
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimKeymap.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKeymap.hpp"

#include <array>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        constexpr VimModeBits N = VimModeBits::Normal;
        constexpr VimModeBits V = VimModeBits::Visual;
        constexpr VimModeBits O = VimModeBits::OpPending;
        constexpr VimModeBits NV = N | V;
        constexpr VimModeBits NVO = N | V | O;
        constexpr VimModeBits VO = V | O;

        constexpr VimBinding M(std::string_view k, VimModeBits m, VimMotionId id, VimArgKind arg = VimArgKind::None)
        {
            return VimBinding{ k, m, VimCmdKind::Motion, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(id), false, arg };
        }
        constexpr VimBinding Op(std::string_view k, VimModeBits m, VimOperatorId id)
        {
            return VimBinding{ k, m, VimCmdKind::Operator, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(id), false, VimArgKind::None };
        }
        constexpr VimBinding I(std::string_view k, VimObjectId id) { return VimBinding{ k, VO, VimCmdKind::TextObject, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(id), true, VimArgKind::None }; }
        constexpr VimBinding A(std::string_view k, VimObjectId id) { return VimBinding{ k, VO, VimCmdKind::TextObject, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(id), false, VimArgKind::None }; }
        constexpr VimBinding Act(std::string_view k, VimModeBits m, VimActionId id, VimArgKind arg = VimArgKind::None)
        {
            return VimBinding{ k, m, VimCmdKind::Action, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(id), false, arg };
        }

            Act("u", N, VimActionId::Undo), Act("<C-r>", NV, VimActionId::Redo), Act(".", N, VimActionId::RepeatChange),
            Act("q", N, VimActionId::RecordMacro, VimArgKind::Name), Act("@", N, VimActionId::RunMacro, VimArgKind::Name),
            Act("Q", N, VimActionId::RunLastRecorded),
            Act("m", N, VimActionId::SetMark, VimArgKind::Name),
            Act("<C-o>", N, VimActionId::JumpOlder), Act("<C-i>", N, VimActionId::JumpNewer), Act("<Tab>", N, VimActionId::JumpNewer),
            Act("g;", N, VimActionId::ChangeOlder), Act("g,", N, VimActionId::ChangeNewer),
            Act(":", NV, VimActionId::EnterExCommand), Act("&", N, VimActionId::RepeatSubstitute),
            Act("ZZ", N, VimActionId::WriteQuit), Act("ZQ", N, VimActionId::QuitDiscard),
            Act("zc", NV, VimActionId::FoldClose), Act("zo", NV, VimActionId::FoldOpen), Act("za", NV, VimActionId::FoldToggle),
            Act("zR", NV, VimActionId::FoldOpenAll), Act("zM", NV, VimActionId::FoldCloseAll), Act("zd", NV, VimActionId::FoldDelete),

            // ---- actions: Visual only ----
            Act("o", V, VimActionId::VisualSwapEnds), Act("O", V, VimActionId::VisualSwapCorner),
            Act("I", V, VimActionId::VisualInsert), Act("A", V, VimActionId::VisualAppend),
            Act("X", V, VimActionId::VisualDeleteLines), Act("D", V, VimActionId::VisualDeleteLines),
            Act("Y", V, VimActionId::VisualYankLines),
            Act("C", V, VimActionId::VisualChangeLines), Act("S", V, VimActionId::VisualChangeLines), Act("R", V, VimActionId::VisualChangeLines),
        });
    }

    std::span<const VimBinding> VimBindings() { return kTable; }

    const std::vector<std::vector<VimKey>>& VimBindingKeys()
    {
        static const std::vector<std::vector<VimKey>> s_keys = [] {
            std::vector<std::vector<VimKey>> out;
            out.reserve(kTable.size());
            for (const VimBinding& b : kTable) out.push_back(ParseKeys(b.keys).value_or(std::vector<VimKey>{}));
            return out;
        }();
        return s_keys;
    }

    std::string_view VimModeCode(VimMode m) noexcept
    {
        switch (m)
        {
        case VimMode::Normal:          return "n";
        case VimMode::Insert:          return "i";
        case VimMode::Replace:         return "R";
        case VimMode::Visual:          return "v";
        case VimMode::VisualLine:      return "V";
        case VimMode::VisualBlock:     return "^V";
        case VimMode::OperatorPending: return "no";
        case VimMode::CommandLine:     return "c";
        }
        return "n";
    }

    const char* VimModeLabel(VimMode m) noexcept
    {
        switch (m)
        {
        case VimMode::Normal:          return "NORMAL";
        case VimMode::Insert:          return "INSERT";
        case VimMode::Replace:         return "REPLACE";
        case VimMode::Visual:          return "VISUAL";
        case VimMode::VisualLine:      return "VISUAL LINE";
        case VimMode::VisualBlock:     return "VISUAL BLOCK";
        case VimMode::OperatorPending: return "O-PENDING";
        case VimMode::CommandLine:     return "COMMAND";
        }
        return "NORMAL";
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandParser.hpp
#pragma once

// [count]["reg][count]operator[count]{motion | textobject} or [count]action
// (spec s6.2). Effective count = pre x post. Built-in keys are prefix-free, so
// a full match resolves at once; Esc or an unknown key is Invalid.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCommand.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class VimParseStatus : std::uint8_t { NeedMore, Complete, Invalid };

    class VimCommandParser
    {
    public:
        // `mode`: Normal, or a Visual mode (operator-pending is the parser's own state).
        VimParseStatus Feed(const VimKey& key, VimMode mode);
        [[nodiscard]] const VimParsed& Result() const { return m_parsed; }
        void Reset();
        [[nodiscard]] bool Idle() const { return m_parsed.keys.empty(); }
        [[nodiscard]] bool OperatorPending() const { return m_parsed.op.has_value() && !m_complete; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool AwaitingLiteral() const { return m_state == State::Arg && m_argKind == VimArgKind::Literal; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::string PendingText() const { return FormatKeys(m_parsed.keys); }

    private:
        enum class State : std::uint8_t { Start, Register, Arg };
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsDoubled() const;
        VimParseStatus Finish();

        State               m_state = State::Start;
        VimArgKind          m_argKind = VimArgKind::None;
        VimParsed           m_parsed;
        std::uint32_t       m_count1 = 0, m_count2 = 0;
        std::vector<VimKey> m_seq;      // keys of the binding being matched
        std::vector<VimKey> m_opKeys;   // the pending operator's own keys
        bool                m_complete = false;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandParser.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandParser.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKeymap.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("vim behaviour: a typed count saturates at 999999999 (normal.c)")
        constexpr std::uint32_t kMaxCount = 999999999u;

        std::uint32_t Saturate(std::uint64_t v) { return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(v, kMaxCount)); }

        bool IsRegisterName(char32_t c)
        {
            if ((c >= U'a' && c <= U'z') || (c >= U'A' && c <= U'Z') || (c >= U'0' && c <= U'9')) return true;
            return c == U'"' || c == U'-' || c == U'_' || c == U'+' || c == U'*' || c == U'/' || c == U':' || c == U'.' || c == U'%';
        }
    }

    void VimCommandParser::Reset()
    {
        m_state = State::Start;
        m_argKind = VimArgKind::None;
        m_parsed = VimParsed{};
        m_count1 = m_count2 = 0;
        m_seq.clear();
        m_opKeys.clear();
        m_complete = false;
    }

    bool VimCommandParser::IsDoubled() const
    {
        if (m_seq == m_opKeys) return true;
        // gUU, guu, g~~, gcc: the operator's last key repeated
        return m_opKeys.size() == 2 && m_opKeys[0] == VimKey::Char(U'g') && m_seq.size() == 1 && m_seq[0] == m_opKeys[1];
    }

    VimParseStatus VimCommandParser::Finish()
    {
        if (m_count1 != 0 || m_count2 != 0)
            m_parsed.count = Saturate(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(m_count1 == 0 ? 1 : m_count1) * (m_count2 == 0 ? 1 : m_count2));
        m_complete = true;
        return VimParseStatus::Complete;
    }

    VimParseStatus VimCommandParser::Feed(const VimKey& key, VimMode mode)
    {
        if (m_complete) Reset();
        m_parsed.keys.push_back(key);
        if (key.IsEsc()) return VimParseStatus::Invalid;

        if (m_state == State::Register)
        {
            if (!key.IsChar() || !IsRegisterName(key.ch)) return VimParseStatus::Invalid;
            m_parsed.reg = key.ch;
            m_state = State::Start;
            return VimParseStatus::NeedMore;
        }
        if (m_state == State::Arg)
        {
            if (!key.IsChar()) return VimParseStatus::Invalid;
            m_parsed.arg = key.ch;
            return Finish();
        }

        const bool visual = IsVisual(mode);
        if (m_seq.empty() && key.IsChar() && key.ch >= U'0' && key.ch <= U'9')
        {
            std::uint32_t& count = m_parsed.op ? m_count2 : m_count1;
            if (key.ch != U'0' || count != 0)
            {
                count = Saturate(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(count) * 10u + (key.ch - U'0'));
                return VimParseStatus::NeedMore;
            }
        }
        if (m_seq.empty() && !m_parsed.op && key == VimKey::Char(U'"'))
        {
            m_state = State::Register;
            return VimParseStatus::NeedMore;
        }

        m_seq.push_back(key);
        if (m_parsed.op && IsDoubled())
        {
            m_parsed.kind = VimCmdKind::Operator;
            m_parsed.linewiseDouble = true;
            return Finish();
        }

        const VimModeBits bits = m_parsed.op ? VimModeBits::OpPending : (visual ? VimModeBits::Visual : VimModeBits::Normal);
        const auto bindings = VimBindings();
        const auto& keys = VimBindingKeys();
        bool prefix = false;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < bindings.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (!Any(bindings[i].modes, bits)) continue;
            const std::vector<VimKey>& k = keys[i];
            if (k.size() < m_seq.size() || !std::equal(m_seq.begin(), m_seq.end(), k.begin())) continue;
            if (k.size() > m_seq.size()) { prefix = true; continue; }

            const VimBinding& b = bindings[i];
            if (b.kind == VimCmdKind::Operator && !visual)
            {
                if (m_parsed.op) return VimParseStatus::Invalid;      // "dc"
                m_parsed.op = static_cast<VimOperatorId>(b.id);
                m_opKeys = m_seq;
                m_seq.clear();
                return VimParseStatus::NeedMore;
            }
            m_parsed.kind = b.kind;
            m_parsed.id = b.id;
            m_parsed.inner = b.inner;
            if (b.kind == VimCmdKind::Operator) m_parsed.op = static_cast<VimOperatorId>(b.id);   // Visual: applies at once
            if (b.arg != VimArgKind::None)
            {
                m_state = State::Arg;
                m_argKind = b.arg;
                return VimParseStatus::NeedMore;
            }
            return Finish();
        }
        return prefix ? VimParseStatus::NeedMore : VimParseStatus::Invalid;
    }
}
```

  - Test helpers `Arcane::Test::ParseVimMarked`, `FormatVimMarked` (renamed from `ParseMarked`/`FormatMarked` so TE1-14's `Arcane::Text::Test::{ParseMarked, FormatMarked}` keep their names, CANON B17), `FakeVimHost`, `VimRig { Keys(notation); Marked(); Text(); Mode(); Wait(seconds); Globals(); Doc(); Commands(); model, buffer, selections, folds, display, context, host, bufferState, vim, now }`. The rig hosts an `Editor::TextModel` (CANON B23): `buffer`/`selections`/`folds`/`display` are references to the model's members, so the folds shift with edits through the model's own observer and the display is rebuilt by `VimText::SyncDisplay` exactly as in the editor; `context` is `Editor::DefaultEditContext(model)` and is the `VimDoc::context`.

Insert-mode text is typed by the view, not by vim: in Insert the view's input is enabled (`SetInputEnabled(true)`), `HandleKey` returns `handled = false` for a printable character, the view inserts it through its normal typing path, and tells vim with `OnInputHandled`. Vim owns every other Insert key (Esc, Enter with `autoindent`, Tab with `expandtab`/`smarttab`, Backspace with `backspace=indent,eol,start` + `smarttab`, Delete, arrows), so Neovim's insert rules hold. One insert session is one `BeginTransaction`/`EndTransaction` pair around everything typed (the `GroupUntil` of spec s3.3), so `u` (TE5b-3) undoes it in one step; arrow keys split it, as in vim (`:h ins-special-special`). The rig plays the view: it types unhandled printable characters at every cursor and calls `OnInputHandled`.

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimHost.hpp
#pragma once

// What the vim layer asks of the editor around it (spec s6.1): the four view
// hooks, the s5.5 keyboard state, the viewport in display rows, the clipboard,
// the message line / listing popups / command line, the search-match painter,
// and the document/window commands ex and Ctrl-W need. VimViewAdapter
// (TE5a-22) implements it over TextEditorView/TextDocument; tests use FakeVimHost.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class VimCursorShape : std::uint8_t { Block, Bar, Underline };

    struct VimKeyboardState
    {
        bool commandKeys = true;    // dead keys arrive bare and the layout's dead state is cleared
        bool latinLetters = true;   // letters come from the key's Latin letter (latinLettersInNormal)
        bool imeAllowed = false;    // the IME is off outside Insert/Replace/command line
        bool operator==(const VimKeyboardState&) const = default;
    };

    enum class VimFileCommand : std::uint8_t { Write, Quit, WriteQuit, WriteIfDirtyQuit, Edit, SaveAs, NextBuffer, PrevBuffer };
    enum class VimWindowCommand : std::uint8_t { SplitHorizontal, SplitVertical, FocusLeft, FocusDown, FocusUp, FocusRight, FocusNext, Close };

    struct VimHostResult
    {
        bool ok = true;
        std::string message;   // shown on the message line when not empty (an error when !ok)
    };

    class IVimHost
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IVimHost() = default;

        virtual void SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape shape) = 0;
        virtual void SetLineMode(bool linewise) = 0;
        virtual void SetInputEnabled(bool enabled) = 0;
        virtual void SetClipAtLineEnds(bool clip) = 0;
        virtual void SetKeyboard(const VimKeyboardState& state) = 0;

        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::uint32_t FirstVisibleRow() const = 0;   // display rows (DisplayMap)
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::uint32_t VisibleRows() const = 0;
        virtual void ScrollToRow(std::uint32_t firstDisplayRow) = 0;

        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::string ReadClipboard() = 0;
        virtual void WriteClipboard(std::string_view text) = 0;

        virtual void ShowMessage(std::string_view text, bool isError) = 0;
        virtual void ShowListing(std::string_view title, std::span<const std::string> lines) = 0;
        virtual void SetCommandLine(std::string_view text, std::size_t cursorByte) = 0;   // empty = hidden
        virtual void SetSearchHighlight(std::string_view pcre2Pattern) = 0;                // empty = none

        virtual VimHostResult RunFileCommand(VimFileCommand command, std::string_view argument, bool bang) = 0;
        virtual VimHostResult RunWindowCommand(VimWindowCommand command) = 0;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::optional<std::string> ReadFileText(std::string_view path) = 0;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::string DocumentPath() const = 0;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::vector<std::string> BufferList() = 0;
        virtual bool OpenAt(std::string_view path, Point point) = 0;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp
#pragma once

// One VimState per TextEditorView while editor.text.vim.enabled is on (spec
// s6.1). It owns the mode, the command parser and the insert session; it
// changes text only through VimText (TextCommands) and talks to the editor only
// through IVimHost. With vim off no VimState exists and no vim code runs.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandParser.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimContext.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimKeyResult
    {
        bool handled = true;   // false: the key falls through to the view (Insert text, unclaimed chords)
        bool beeped = false;   // the command failed: vim flushes typed-ahead keys (macros, :normal, the oracle's feedkeys)
    };

    class VimState
    {
    public:
        VimState(VimDoc doc, IVimHost& host, VimGlobals& globals, VimBufferState& bufferState,
                 VimOptions options = {}, VimLanguage language = {});
        ~VimState();
        VimState(const VimState&) = delete;
        VimState& operator=(const VimState&) = delete;

        VimKeyResult HandleKey(const VimKey& key, double nowSeconds);
        void Tick(double nowSeconds);
        void OnInputHandled(std::string_view text);   // the view typed `text` (Insert)
        void OnTransactionBegun();                     // a transaction vim did not start (the adapter filters its own)
        void OnTransactionUndone();
        void OnSelectionsChanged(bool byMouse);

        [[nodiscard]] VimMode Mode() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string PendingKeys() const;
        [[nodiscard]] VimKeyboardState Keyboard() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<VimCursor> Cursors() const;
        [[nodiscard]] const VimOptions& Options() const { return m_options; }
        void SetOptions(VimOptions options);
        [[nodiscard]] const VimLanguage& Language() const { return m_language; }
        void SetLanguage(VimLanguage language);
        [[nodiscard]] VimContext Context();

    private:
        struct InsertSession
        {
            bool          open = false;              // a buffer transaction is open
            VimActionId   entry = VimActionId::InsertBefore;
            std::uint32_t count = 1;
            AnchorSet::Id start = 0;                      // the primary cursor's session start (Left bias)
            bool          hasStart = false;
            bool          autoIndentPending = false; // o/O/Enter inserted an indent nothing has been typed after
            bool          typed = false;             // OnInputHandled seen this session
        };

        VimKeyResult FeedResolved(const VimKey& key);
        VimKeyResult HandleNormalOrVisual(const VimKey& key);
        VimKeyResult HandleInsert(const VimKey& key);
        void Execute(const VimParsed& p);
        void RunAction(const VimParsed& p);

        void BeginInsertSession(VimActionId entry, std::uint32_t count);
        void EndInsertSession();
        void MarkInsertStart();
        [[nodiscard]] std::string CapturedInsertText() const;
        void StartInsert(InsertEntry entry, const VimParsed& p);
        void OpenLine(bool below, const VimParsed& p);
        void LeaveInsertMode();
        void InsertNewline();
        void InsertTab();
        void InsertBackspace();
        void InsertDelete();
        void InsertMove(VimNamedKey key);
        void RepeatInsertForCount();
        void RemovePendingAutoIndent();

        void ApplyModeHooks();
        void ClampCursors();
        [[nodiscard]] VimCursor ToVim(const Selection& s) const;
        [[nodiscard]] Selection FromVim(const VimCursor& c, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal, std::uint32_t id) const;
        void Beep(std::string_view message = {});

        VimDoc            m_doc;
        IVimHost&         m_host;
        VimGlobals&       m_globals;
        VimBufferState&   m_bufferState;
        VimOptions        m_options;
        VimLanguage       m_language;
        VimCharClass      m_chars;
        VimMode           m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
        bool              m_hooksApplied = false;
        VimMode           m_appliedMode = VimMode::Normal;
        VimKeyboardState  m_appliedKeyboard{};
        VimCommandParser  m_parser;
        InsertSession     m_insert;
        AnchorSet         m_anchors;
        double            m_now = 0.0;
        bool              m_beeped = false;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <utility>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    VimState::VimState(VimDoc doc, IVimHost& host, VimGlobals& globals, VimBufferState& bufferState,
                       VimOptions options, VimLanguage language)
        : m_doc(doc), m_host(host), m_globals(globals), m_bufferState(bufferState),
          m_options(std::move(options)), m_language(std::move(language)), m_chars(m_language.wordChars)
    {
        m_doc.buffer.RegisterAnchors(m_anchors);
        VimText::SyncDisplay(m_doc);
        ClampCursors();
        ApplyModeHooks();
    }

    VimState::~VimState()
    {
        if (m_insert.open) EndInsertSession();
        m_doc.buffer.UnregisterAnchors(m_anchors);
    }

    VimContext VimState::Context()
    {
        return VimContext{ m_doc, m_host, m_globals, m_bufferState, m_options, m_language, m_chars, Mode() };
    }

    void VimState::SetOptions(VimOptions options) { m_options = std::move(options); }

    void VimState::SetLanguage(VimLanguage language)
    {
        m_language = std::move(language);
        m_chars = VimCharClass(m_language.wordChars);
    }

    VimMode VimState::Mode() const
    {
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Normal && m_parser.OperatorPending()) return VimMode::OperatorPending;
        return m_mode;
    }

    std::string VimState::PendingKeys() const { return m_parser.PendingText(); }

    VimKeyboardState VimState::Keyboard() const
    {
        switch (Mode())
        {
        case VimMode::Insert:
        case VimMode::Replace:
        case VimMode::CommandLine:
            return VimKeyboardState{ false, false, true };
        default:
            return VimKeyboardState{ true, !m_parser.AwaitingLiteral(), false };
        }
    }

    VimKeyResult VimState::HandleKey(const VimKey& key, double nowSeconds)
    {
        m_now = nowSeconds;
        VimText::SyncDisplay(m_doc);             // first: the folds' rows after any edit made outside vim (j/k, H/M/L read the display)
        VimKeyResult r = FeedResolved(key);
        r.beeped = std::exchange(m_beeped, false);
        ApplyModeHooks();
        return r;
    }

    void VimState::Tick(double nowSeconds) { m_now = nowSeconds; }

    VimKeyResult VimState::FeedResolved(const VimKey& key)
    {
        switch (m_mode)
        {
        case VimMode::Insert: return HandleInsert(key);
        default:              return HandleNormalOrVisual(key);
        }
    }

    VimKeyResult VimState::HandleNormalOrVisual(const VimKey& key)
    {
        if (key.IsEsc() && m_parser.Idle())
        {
            if (IsVisual(m_mode))
            {
                m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
                ClampCursors();
            }
            return {};
        }
        switch (m_parser.Feed(key, IsVisual(m_mode) ? m_mode : VimMode::Normal))
        {
        case VimParseStatus::NeedMore:
            return {};
        case VimParseStatus::Invalid:
            m_parser.Reset();
            if (!key.IsEsc()) Beep();
            return {};
        case VimParseStatus::Complete:
        {
            const VimParsed p = m_parser.Result();
            m_parser.Reset();
            Execute(p);
            return {};
        }
        }
        return {};
    }

    void VimState::Execute(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        switch (p.kind)
        {
        case VimCmdKind::Action:
            RunAction(p);
            break;
        case VimCmdKind::Motion:       // ExecuteMotion: TE5a-8; with an operator: TE5a-12
        case VimCmdKind::Operator:     // ExecuteOperator: TE5a-12
        case VimCmdKind::TextObject:   // ExtendVisualByObject: TE5a-18
            Beep();
            break;
        }
    }

    void VimState::OnInputHandled(std::string_view text)
    {
        if (text.empty()) return;
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
        m_insert.typed = true;
    }

    void VimState::OnTransactionBegun()
    {
        // An edit vim did not make (a menu paste, the find bar's Replace All):
        // the Visual selection it replaced is gone, so Visual ends.
        if (IsVisual(m_mode))
        {
            m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
            ClampCursors();
            ApplyModeHooks();
        }
    }

    void VimState::OnTransactionUndone()
    {
        if (IsVisual(m_mode)) m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Normal) ClampCursors();
        ApplyModeHooks();
    }

    void VimState::OnSelectionsChanged(bool byMouse)
    {
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Normal) ClampCursors();
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Insert && byMouse)
        {
            // a click inside Insert starts a new undoable insert, as an arrow key does
            EndInsertSession();
            BeginInsertSession(VimActionId::InsertBefore, 1);
            MarkInsertStart();
        }
    }

    void VimState::ApplyModeHooks()
    {
        const VimMode mode = Mode();
        if (!m_hooksApplied || mode != m_appliedMode)
        {
            switch (mode)
            {
            case VimMode::Insert:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Bar); m_host.SetLineMode(false);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(true); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(false); break;
            case VimMode::Replace:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Underline); m_host.SetLineMode(false);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(false); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(false); break;
            case VimMode::Visual:
            case VimMode::VisualBlock:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Block); m_host.SetLineMode(false);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(false); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(false); break;
            case VimMode::VisualLine:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Block); m_host.SetLineMode(true);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(false); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(false); break;
            case VimMode::OperatorPending:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Underline); m_host.SetLineMode(false);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(false); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(true); break;
            case VimMode::CommandLine:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Bar); m_host.SetLineMode(false);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(false); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(true); break;
            case VimMode::Normal:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Block); m_host.SetLineMode(false);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(false); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(true); break;
            }
            m_appliedMode = mode;
        }
        const VimKeyboardState kb = Keyboard();
        if (!m_hooksApplied || !(kb == m_appliedKeyboard))
        {
            m_host.SetKeyboard(kb);
            m_appliedKeyboard = kb;
        }
        m_hooksApplied = true;
    }

    VimCursor VimState::ToVim(const Selection& s) const
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        switch (m_mode)
        {
        case VimMode::Visual:
        {
            const Selection v = VimCursorModel::FromEditorVisual(r, s);
            return VimCursor{ v.anchor, v.head };
        }
        case VimMode::VisualLine:
            return VimCursor{ s.anchor, s.head };
        default:
            return VimCursor{ s.head, s.head };
        }
    }

    Selection VimState::FromVim(const VimCursor& c, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal, std::uint32_t id) const
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        switch (m_mode)
        {
        case VimMode::Visual:
            return VimCursorModel::ToEditorVisual(r, Selection{ id, c.anchor, c.head, goal });
        case VimMode::VisualLine:
            return Selection{ id, c.anchor, c.head, goal };
        case VimMode::Normal:
        {
            const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, c.head);
            return Selection{ id, o, o, goal };
        }
        default:
            return Selection{ id, c.head, c.head, goal };
        }
    }

    std::vector<VimCursor> VimState::Cursors() const
    {
        std::vector<VimCursor> out;
        for (const Selection& s : m_doc.selections.All()) out.push_back(ToVim(s));
        return out;
    }

    void VimState::ClampCursors()
    {
        if (m_mode != VimMode::Normal) return;
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        bool changed = false;
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, s.head);
            if (s.anchor != o || s.head != o) { s.anchor = s.head = o; changed = true; }
        }
        if (changed) VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::Beep(std::string_view message)
    {
        m_parser.Reset();
        m_beeped = true;                         // vim's beep_flush: typed-ahead keys after a failed command are dropped
        if (!message.empty()) m_host.ShowMessage(message, true);
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp
// VimState::RunAction: one case per VimActionId. Each later TE5 task adds the
// cases it implements; an id with no case yet beeps.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    void VimState::RunAction(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        switch (p.Id<VimActionId>())
        {
        case VimActionId::InsertBefore:        StartInsert(InsertEntry::Before, p); break;
        case VimActionId::Append:              StartInsert(InsertEntry::After, p); break;
        case VimActionId::InsertFirstNonBlank: StartInsert(InsertEntry::FirstNonBlank, p); break;
        case VimActionId::InsertColumnZero:    StartInsert(InsertEntry::ColumnZero, p); break;
        case VimActionId::AppendLineEnd:       StartInsert(InsertEntry::LineEnd, p); break;
        case VimActionId::OpenBelow:           OpenLine(true, p); break;
        case VimActionId::OpenAbove:           OpenLine(false, p); break;
        default:                               Beep(); break;
        }
    }
}
```
