```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimInsert.cpp
// Insert mode (spec s6.3 "Insert mode", s6.1 entering/leaving rules) with
// Neovim's defaults: autoindent, backspace=indent,eol,start, smarttab,
// expandtab from the editor-wide indentation settings.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        bool IsBlank(char32_t c) { return c == U' ' || c == U'\t'; }
    }

    void VimState::BeginInsertSession(VimActionId entry, std::uint32_t count)
    {
        if (!m_insert.open)
        {
            m_doc.buffer.BeginTransaction(m_doc.selections);
            m_insert.open = true;
        }
        m_insert.entry = entry;
        m_insert.count = std::max(1u, count);
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
        m_insert.typed = false;
    }

    void VimState::EndInsertSession()
    {
        if (m_insert.hasStart) { m_anchors.Remove(m_insert.start); m_insert.hasStart = false; }
        if (!m_insert.open) return;
        m_doc.buffer.EndTransaction(m_doc.selections);
        m_doc.buffer.BreakUndoGroup();           // the next session never merges into this one by undoGroupMs
        m_insert.open = false;
    }

    void VimState::MarkInsertStart()
    {
        if (m_insert.hasStart) m_anchors.Remove(m_insert.start);
        const auto all = m_doc.selections.All();
        m_insert.start = m_anchors.Add(Anchor{ all[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].head, Bias::Left });
        m_insert.hasStart = true;
    }

    std::string VimState::CapturedInsertText() const
    {
        if (!m_insert.hasStart) return {};
        const ByteOffset start = m_anchors.Get(m_insert.start).offset;
        const ByteOffset caret = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].head;
        if (caret <= start) return {};
        std::string out;
        m_doc.buffer.Text().CopyTo(ByteRange{ start, caret }, out);
        return out;
    }

    void VimState::StartInsert(InsertEntry entry, const VimParsed& p)
    {
        BeginInsertSession(p.Id<VimActionId>(), p.Count1());
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            s.anchor = s.head = VimCursorModel::EnterInsert(r, s.head, entry);
            s.goalColumn.reset();
        }
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        MarkInsertStart();
        m_mode = VimMode::Insert;
    }

    void VimState::OpenLine(bool below, const VimParsed& p)
    {
        BeginInsertSession(p.Id<VimActionId>(), p.Count1());
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::size_t>> rows;   // row, indent bytes
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, s.head);
            if (!rows.empty() && rows.back().first == row) continue;
            const std::string indent = VimText::LeadingWhitespace(r, row);
            rows.emplace_back(row, indent.size());
            if (below) ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineEnd(row), r.LineEnd(row) }, "\n" + indent });
            else       ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(row), r.LineStart(row) }, indent + "\n" });
        }
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < rows.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto [row, indentBytes] = rows[i];
            const ByteOffset caret = below ? VimText::MapThrough(r.LineEnd(row), ops, Bias::Right)
                                           : VimText::MapThrough(r.LineStart(row), ops, Bias::Left) + indentBytes;
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[std::min(i, sels.size() - 1)].id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), std::min(VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc), rows.size() - 1));
        MarkInsertStart();
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = true;
        m_mode = VimMode::Insert;
    }

    VimKeyResult VimState::HandleInsert(const VimKey& key)
    {
        if (key.IsEsc()) { LeaveInsertMode(); return {}; }
        if (key.ctrl) return VimKeyResult{ false };   // TE5a-20: the Insert column of the s6.6 chord table
        switch (key.named)
        {
        case VimNamedKey::Enter:     InsertNewline(); return {};
        case VimNamedKey::Tab:       if (key.shift) return VimKeyResult{ false }; InsertTab(); return {};
        case VimNamedKey::Backspace: InsertBackspace(); return {};
        case VimNamedKey::Delete:    InsertDelete(); return {};
        case VimNamedKey::Left: case VimNamedKey::Right: case VimNamedKey::Up:
        case VimNamedKey::Down: case VimNamedKey::Home: case VimNamedKey::End:
            InsertMove(key.named);
            return {};
        case VimNamedKey::None:      break;
        default:                     return VimKeyResult{ false };
        }
        return VimKeyResult{ false };   // a printable character: the view types it and calls OnInputHandled
    }

    void VimState::InsertNewline()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> ids;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset lo = std::min(s.anchor, s.head), hi = std::max(s.anchor, s.head);
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, lo);
            const std::string indent = VimText::LeadingWhitespace(r, row);   // autoindent: the current line's
            ByteOffset cut = lo;                                              // trailing blanks before the caret go
            while (cut > r.LineStart(row) && IsBlank(VimText::CodePointAt(r, cut - 1))) --cut;
            ByteOffset rest = hi;                                             // leading blanks of the moved text go
            while (rest < r.LineEnd(row) && IsBlank(VimText::CodePointAt(r, rest))) ++rest;
            if (!ops.empty() && cut < ops.back().range.end) continue;         // two carets in one blank run
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ cut, rest }, "\n" + indent });
            ids.push_back(s.id);
        }
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < ops.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.begin, ops, Bias::Right);
            after.push_back(Selection{ ids[i], caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), std::min(VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc), ids.size() - 1));
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = true;
    }

    void VimState::InsertTab()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset lo = std::min(s.anchor, s.head), hi = std::max(s.anchor, s.head);
            std::string text = "\t";
            if (m_options.expandTab)
            {
                const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, lo);
                const bool inIndent = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row) >= lo;              // smarttab
                const std::uint32_t width = std::max(1u, inIndent ? m_options.shiftWidth : m_options.tabSize);
                const std::uint32_t vcol = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, lo, m_options.tabSize);
                text.assign(width - vcol % width, ' ');
            }
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ lo, hi }, std::move(text) });
        }
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.begin, ops, Bias::Right);
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
    }

    void VimState::InsertBackspace()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = s.head;
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, caret);
            ByteOffset from = caret;
            if (caret == r.LineStart(row))
            {
                if (row == 0) continue;                                                 // nothing before the buffer start
                from = caret - 1;                                                       // backspace=eol: join
            }
            else if (m_options.expandTab && VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row) >= caret
                     && VimText::CodePointAt(r, caret - 1) == U' ')
            {
                const std::uint32_t sw = std::max(1u, m_options.shiftWidth);            // smarttab in the indent
                const std::uint32_t vcol = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, caret, m_options.tabSize);
                const std::uint32_t target = ((vcol - 1) / sw) * sw;
                std::uint32_t v = vcol;
                while (v > target && from > r.LineStart(row) && VimText::CodePointAt(r, from - 1) == U' ') { --from; --v; }
            }
            else
                from = VimText::PrevChar(r, caret);
            if (!ops.empty() && from < ops.back().range.end) continue;                 // two carets, one deletion
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ from, caret }, "" });
        }
        if (ops.empty()) return;
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(s.head, ops, Bias::Left);
            after.push_back(Selection{ s.id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::InsertDelete()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = s.head;
            const ByteOffset end = VimText::AtLineEnd(r, caret) ? std::min<ByteOffset>(caret + 1, r.Size()) : VimText::NextChar(r, caret);
            if (end == caret) continue;                                                 // at the end of the buffer
            if (!ops.empty() && caret < ops.back().range.end) continue;
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ caret, end }, "" });
        }
        if (ops.empty()) return;
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(s.head, ops, Bias::Left);
            after.push_back(Selection{ s.id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
    }

    void VimState::InsertMove(VimNamedKey key)
    {
        if (m_insert.autoIndentPending && (key == VimNamedKey::Up || key == VimNamedKey::Down)) RemovePendingAutoIndent();
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
        EndInsertSession();                      // the keys before and after undo separately (:h ins-special-special)
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, s.head);
            ByteOffset o = s.head;
            std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal;
            switch (key)
            {
            case VimNamedKey::Left:  o = VimText::PrevChar(r, s.head); break;
            case VimNamedKey::Right: o = VimText::NextChar(r, s.head); break;
            case VimNamedKey::Home:  o = r.LineStart(row); break;
            case VimNamedKey::End:   o = r.LineEnd(row); break;
            case VimNamedKey::Up:
            case VimNamedKey::Down:
            {
                const std::uint32_t vcol = s.goalColumn.value_or(VimText::VirtualColumn(r, s.head, m_options.tabSize));
                goal = vcol;
                if (key == VimNamedKey::Up && row == 0) break;
                if (key == VimNamedKey::Down && row + 1 >= r.LineCount()) break;
                const std::uint32_t target = key == VimNamedKey::Up ? row - 1 : row + 1;
                o = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, target, vcol, m_options.tabSize);
                break;
            }
            default: break;
            }
            s.anchor = s.head = o;
            s.goalColumn = goal;
        }
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        BeginInsertSession(VimActionId::InsertBefore, 1);
        MarkInsertStart();
    }

    void VimState::RepeatInsertForCount()
    {
        const std::string text = CapturedInsertText();
        if (text.empty() || m_insert.count <= 1) return;
        const bool lines = m_insert.entry == VimActionId::OpenBelow || m_insert.entry == VimActionId::OpenAbove;
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const std::string piece = lines ? "\n" + VimText::LeadingWhitespace(r, VimText::RowOf(r, s.head)) + text : text;
            std::string all;
            for (std::uint32_t i = 1; i < m_insert.count; ++i) all += piece;
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ s.head, s.head }, std::move(all) });
        }
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.begin, ops, Bias::Right);
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::RemovePendingAutoIndent()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, s.head);
            if (!VimText::IsBlankLine(r, row) || r.LineStart(row) == r.LineEnd(row)) continue;
            if (!ops.empty() && ops.back().range.begin == r.LineStart(row)) continue;
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(row), r.LineEnd(row) }, "" });
        }
        if (ops.empty()) return;
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(s.head, ops, Bias::Left);
            after.push_back(Selection{ s.id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
    }

    void VimState::LeaveInsertMode()
    {
        RepeatInsertForCount();
        if (m_insert.autoIndentPending) RemovePendingAutoIndent();
        EndInsertSession();                      // one insert session = one undo step (spec s6.3)
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            s.anchor = s.head = VimCursorModel::LeaveInsert(r, s.head);
            s.goalColumn.reset();
        }
        m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp
#pragma once

// The vim test rig: an Editor::TextModel (TE2-11 + TE4-12: buffer, selections,
// display, folds and the observer that shifts the folds with every edit) with a
// VimState over a FakeVimHost -- the same model the editor's views use, so the
// fold/display behaviour under test is the editor's (CANON B23). Marked text:
// U+02C7 (CB 87) is a vim cursor, U+00AB (C2 AB) a Visual anchor; the i-th
// anchor pairs with the i-th cursor. The rig plays the view: printable keys vim
// leaves unhandled in Insert are typed at every cursor and reported through
// OnInputHandled.

#include "TextEditor/Core/DisplayMap.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Test
{
    struct MarkedText
    {
        std::string text;
        std::vector<Arcane::Text::VimCursor> cursors;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] MarkedText ParseVimMarked(std::string_view marked);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatVimMarked(std::string_view text, std::span<const Arcane::Text::VimCursor> cursors, bool showAnchors);

    class FakeVimHost final : public Arcane::Text::IVimHost
    {
    public:
        Arcane::Text::VimCursorShape shape = Arcane::Text::VimCursorShape::Block;
        bool lineMode = false, inputEnabled = false, clip = false;
        Arcane::Text::VimKeyboardState keyboard{ false, false, true };
        std::uint32_t firstRow = 0, rows = 22;            // nvim --headless: 24 lines - cmdline - statusline
        std::string clipboard;
        std::vector<std::pair<std::string, bool>> messages;
        std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::vector<std::string>>> listings;
        std::string commandLine;
        std::size_t commandCursor = 0;
        std::string searchHighlight;
        std::vector<std::string> fileCommands;            // "Write|arg|!" per call
        std::vector<std::string> windowCommands;
        std::map<std::string, std::string> files;          // ReadFileText
        std::string path = "C:/vimrig/doc.txt";
        std::vector<std::string> buffers{ "C:/vimrig/doc.txt" };
        std::vector<std::pair<std::string, Arcane::Text::Point>> opened;
        Arcane::Text::VimHostResult nextFileResult{};

        void SetCursorShape(Arcane::Text::VimCursorShape s) override { shape = s; }
        void SetLineMode(bool on) override { lineMode = on; }
        void SetInputEnabled(bool on) override { inputEnabled = on; }
        void SetClipAtLineEnds(bool on) override { clip = on; }
        void SetKeyboard(const Arcane::Text::VimKeyboardState& s) override { keyboard = s; }
        std::uint32_t FirstVisibleRow() const override { return firstRow; }
        std::uint32_t VisibleRows() const override { return rows; }
        void ScrollToRow(std::uint32_t row) override { firstRow = row; }
        std::string ReadClipboard() override { return clipboard; }
        void WriteClipboard(std::string_view t) override { clipboard = std::string(t); }
        void ShowMessage(std::string_view t, bool e) override { messages.emplace_back(std::string(t), e); }
        void ShowListing(std::string_view title, std::span<const std::string> lines) override
        {
            listings.emplace_back(std::string(title), std::vector<std::string>(lines.begin(), lines.end()));
        }
        void SetCommandLine(std::string_view t, std::size_t c) override { commandLine = std::string(t); commandCursor = c; }
        void SetSearchHighlight(std::string_view p) override { searchHighlight = std::string(p); }
        Arcane::Text::VimHostResult RunFileCommand(Arcane::Text::VimFileCommand c, std::string_view arg, bool bang) override;
        Arcane::Text::VimHostResult RunWindowCommand(Arcane::Text::VimWindowCommand c) override;
        std::optional<std::string> ReadFileText(std::string_view p) override
        {
            const auto it = files.find(std::string(p));
            return it == files.end() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<std::string>(it->second);
        }
        std::string DocumentPath() const override { return path; }
        std::vector<std::string> BufferList() override { return buffers; }
        bool OpenAt(std::string_view p, Arcane::Text::Point pt) override { opened.emplace_back(std::string(p), pt); return true; }
    };

    class VimRig
    {
    public:
        explicit VimRig(std::string_view marked, Arcane::Text::VimLanguage language = {}, Arcane::Text::VimOptions options = {},
                        Arcane::Text::VimGlobals* sharedGlobals = nullptr);
        ~VimRig();
        VimRig(const VimRig&) = delete;
        VimRig& operator=(const VimRig&) = delete;

        void Keys(std::string_view notation);
        void Wait(double seconds);                         // advances the clock and Ticks (timeoutlen, TE5d)
        [[nodiscard]] std::string Marked() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string Text() const { return buffer.Text().ToString(); }
        [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::VimMode Mode() const { return vim->Mode(); }
        [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::VimGlobals& Globals() { return *m_globals; }
        [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::VimDoc Doc() { return Arcane::Text::VimDoc{ buffer, selections, folds, display, &context }; }
        // TE1's command class over the rig's model (undo/redo, SetSelections), as the view would build it.
        [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::TextCommands Commands() { return Arcane::Text::TextCommands(buffer, selections, context); }
        void TypeLikeTheView(std::string_view utf8);

    private:
        MarkedText m_marked;
        Arcane::Text::VimGlobals m_ownGlobals;
        Arcane::Text::VimGlobals* m_globals;

    public:
        Arcane::Editor::TextModel model;           // declared before the references below
        Arcane::Text::TextBuffer& buffer;          // = model.buffer
        Arcane::Text::SelectionSet& selections;    // = model.selections
        Arcane::Text::FoldModel& folds;            // = model.folds (shifted by the model's edit observer)
        Arcane::Text::DisplayMap& display;         // = model.display (rebuilt by VimText::SyncDisplay)
        Arcane::Text::EditContext context;         // Editor::DefaultEditContext(model): the VimDoc's context
        FakeVimHost host;
        Arcane::Text::VimBufferState bufferState;
        std::unique_ptr<Arcane::Text::VimState> vim;
        double now = 0.0;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimRig.cpp
#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Test
{
    using namespace Arcane::Text;

    namespace
    {
        constexpr std::string_view kCursor = "\xCB\x87";   // U+02C7
        constexpr std::string_view kAnchor = "\xC2\xAB";   // U+00AB
    }

    MarkedText ParseVimMarked(std::string_view marked)
    {
        MarkedText out;
        std::vector<ByteOffset> heads, anchors;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < marked.size();)
        {
            if (marked.substr(i, 2) == kCursor) { heads.push_back(out.text.size()); i += 2; continue; }
            if (marked.substr(i, 2) == kAnchor) { anchors.push_back(out.text.size()); i += 2; continue; }
            out.text.push_back(marked[i]);
            ++i;
        }
        if (heads.empty()) heads.push_back(0);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < heads.size(); ++i)
            out.cursors.push_back(VimCursor{ i < anchors.size() ? anchors[i] : heads[i], heads[i] });
        return out;
    }

    std::string FormatVimMarked(std::string_view text, std::span<const VimCursor> cursors, bool showAnchors)
    {
        std::vector<std::pair<ByteOffset, std::string_view>> marks;   // offset, marker
        for (const VimCursor& c : cursors)
        {
            if (showAnchors) marks.emplace_back(c.anchor, kAnchor);
            marks.emplace_back(c.head, kCursor);
        }
        // ascending offset; at one offset the anchor marker comes first
        std::stable_sort(marks.begin(), marks.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
            if (a.first != b.first) return a.first < b.first;
            return a.second == kAnchor && b.second == kCursor;
        });
        std::string out;
        std::size_t at = 0;
        for (const auto& [offset, marker] : marks)
        {
            const std::size_t o = std::min<std::size_t>(offset, text.size());
            out.append(text.substr(at, o - at));
            out.append(marker);
            at = o;
        }
        out.append(text.substr(at));
        return out;
    }

    VimHostResult FakeVimHost::RunFileCommand(VimFileCommand c, std::string_view arg, bool bang)
    {
        static constexpr const char* kNames[] = { "Write", "Quit", "WriteQuit", "WriteIfDirtyQuit", "Edit", "SaveAs", "NextBuffer", "PrevBuffer" };
        fileCommands.push_back(std::string(kNames[static_cast<int>(c)]) + "|" + std::string(arg) + "|" + (bang ? "!" : ""));
        return nextFileResult;
    }

    VimHostResult FakeVimHost::RunWindowCommand(VimWindowCommand c)
    {
        static constexpr const char* kNames[] = { "SplitHorizontal", "SplitVertical", "FocusLeft", "FocusDown", "FocusUp", "FocusRight", "FocusNext", "Close" };
        windowCommands.emplace_back(kNames[static_cast<int>(c)]);
        return {};
    }

    VimRig::VimRig(std::string_view marked, VimLanguage language, VimOptions options, VimGlobals* sharedGlobals)
        : m_marked(ParseVimMarked(marked)), m_globals(sharedGlobals ? sharedGlobals : &m_ownGlobals),
          model(Rope::FromUtf8(m_marked.text)), buffer(model.buffer), selections(model.selections),
          folds(model.folds), display(model.display), context(Arcane::Editor::DefaultEditContext(model))
    {
        std::vector<Selection> sels;
        for (const VimCursor& c : m_marked.cursors) sels.push_back(Selection{ selections.AllocateId(), c.head, c.head, std::nullopt });
        Commands().SetSelections(sels, sels.size() - 1);   // the last marker is the primary (newest)
        vim = std::make_unique<VimState>(Doc(), host, *m_globals, bufferState, std::move(options), std::move(language));
    }

    VimRig::~VimRig() { vim.reset(); }

    void VimRig::TypeLikeTheView(std::string_view utf8)
    {
        VimDoc doc = Doc();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ std::min(s.anchor, s.head), std::max(s.anchor, s.head) }, std::string(utf8) });
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.end, ops, Bias::Right);
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(doc));
        vim->OnInputHandled(utf8);
    }

    void VimRig::Keys(std::string_view notation)
    {
        const auto keys = ParseKeys(notation, vim->Options().leader);
        REQUIRE(keys.has_value());
        for (const VimKey& k : *keys)
        {
            now += 0.001;
            const VimKeyResult r = vim->HandleKey(k, now);
            if (r.beeped) break;                 // as Neovim's feedkeys: a failed command drops the typed-ahead rest
            if (!r.handled && k.IsChar() && vim->Mode() == VimMode::Insert)
            {
                std::string utf8;
                Utf8::Append(utf8, k.ch);
                TypeLikeTheView(utf8);
            }
        }
    }

    void VimRig::Wait(double seconds)
    {
        now += seconds;
        vim->Tick(now);
    }

    std::string VimRig::Marked() const
    {
        const std::vector<VimCursor> cursors = vim->Cursors();
        return FormatVimMarked(Text(), cursors, IsVisual(vim->Mode()));
    }
}
```

### Task TE5a-6: The `.vimcases` table format, its runner, and the first TE5a table (spec s11.3 table-driven cases)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimCases.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimCases.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimCasesTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimRig`, `ParseVimMarked` (TE5a-5), `VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const GrammarDesc&)` (TE5a-3), `std::expected<GrammarDesc, GrammarError> ParseGrammar(std::string_view)` + `GrammarError::Text()` (TE3-7, `TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp`), the engine grammar files `data/Syntaxes/{PlainText,JSON,Lua,HLSL,INI,Markdown}.arcsyntax` (TE3-21..29; stems are case-sensitive, CANON A6), `VimModeCode`, `Arcane::Test::RepoRoot()`.
- Produces:
  - The `.vimcases` format (below), read by this runner and by `scripts/vim-oracle.ps1` (TE5a-7).
  - `struct VimCaseRegister { char32_t name; char kind; std::string text; }`, `struct VimCase { name, grammar, sets, setregs, keys, in, out, mode, regs, divergence, line }`, `struct VimCaseFile { path, nvimVersion, handwritten, grammar, sets, cases }`, `VimCaseFile ParseVimCaseFile(std::string_view text, std::string path)`, `bool ApplyVimSet(VimOptions&, std::string_view assignment)`, `VimLanguage VimCaseLanguage(std::string_view grammarId)` (reads `data/Syntaxes/<Stem>.arcsyntax`, `ParseGrammar`, `VimLanguageFromGrammar(desc)`), `std::span<const std::pair<std::string_view, std::string_view>> VimCaseGrammarStems()` + `std::string_view VimCaseGrammarStem(std::string_view grammarId)` ("" = unknown id), `void RunVimCase(const VimCaseFile&, const VimCase&)`.
  - THE ONE grammar id table (CANON C TE5 item 6): `plain->PlainText, json->JSON, lua->Lua, hlsl->HLSL, ini->INI, markdown->Markdown`. `.vimcases` keep the lowercase ids; `VimCaseLanguage` and `scripts/vim-oracle.ps1`'s `$GrammarStems` (TE5a-7) both map through these six pairs, and `[text-vim-oracle]` checks the script lists exactly them.
  - The `[text-vim-cases]` runner over every `ArcaneTests/data/vim/*.vimcases`; each later TE5 task appends its cases to its pass's file (`te5a.vimcases`, `te5b.vimcases`, `te5c.vimcases`, `te5d.vimcases`; `multicursor.vimcases` is hand-written, TE5d-8).

**The format.** UTF-8, line oriented, `#` starts a comment line.

```
@nvim v0.11.4                      written and checked by the oracle (absent in an @handwritten file)
@handwritten                       not an oracle table (multi-cursor): the oracle skips the file
@grammar plain                     default grammar id for the file's cases (plain|json|lua|hlsl|ini|markdown;
                                   -> data/Syntaxes/PlainText|JSON|Lua|HLSL|INI|Markdown.arcsyntax)
@set tabstop=4 shiftwidth=4 expandtab   vim :set syntax, applied by both sides (repeatable)

=== <case name>
grammar: lua                        optional per-case grammar id
set: ignorecase smartcase           optional per-case :set items
setreg: a v "text"                  optional, repeatable: preload register a (kind v | V | b) with a JSON string
keys: <vim key notation, to the end of the line>
in: "<JSON string; U+02C7 marks the cursor>"
out: "<JSON string; U+02C7 cursor(s), U+00AB Visual anchor(s)>"
mode: n                             nvim_get_mode() code: n i R v V ^V no c
reg: a v "text"                     optional, repeatable: the register after the keys (the oracle fills listed names)
divergence: <why>                   Neovim differs on purpose; the expectation is Arcane's own and the oracle skips it
```

Oracle cases start in Normal mode with exactly one cursor and no anchor in `in:`; only `@handwritten` files may start with several cursors.

```cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Helpers/ConstantScan.hpp"   // RepoRoot
#include "Text/Helpers/VimCases.hpp"

#include <filesystem>

using namespace Arcane::Test;

TEST_CASE("vim cases: the format parses every field", "[text-vim-cases]")
{
    const char* text =
        "# comment\n"
        "@nvim v0.11.4\n"
        "@grammar lua\n"
        "@set tabstop=4 shiftwidth=4 expandtab\n"
        "\n"
        "=== dw deletes a word\n"
        "set: ignorecase\n"
        "setreg: a V \"x\\n\"\n"
        "keys: dw<Esc>\n"
        "in: \"\xCB\x87" "foo bar\"\n"
        "out: \"\xCB\x87" "bar\"\n"
        "mode: n\n"
        "reg: \" v \"foo \"\n"
        "=== second\n"
        "keys: x\n"
        "in: \"\xCB\x87" "a\\tb\"\n"
        "out: \"\xCB\x87" "\\tb\"\n"
        "mode: n\n"
        "divergence: on purpose\n";
    const VimCaseFile f = ParseVimCaseFile(text, "mem.vimcases");
    CHECK(f.nvimVersion == "v0.11.4");
    CHECK_FALSE(f.handwritten);
    CHECK(f.grammar == "lua");
    REQUIRE(f.sets.size() == 3u);
    REQUIRE(f.cases.size() == 2u);
    const VimCase& c = f.cases[0];
    CHECK(c.name == "dw deletes a word");
    CHECK(c.line == 6u);
    REQUIRE(c.sets.size() == 1u);
    REQUIRE(c.setregs.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(c.setregs[0].name == U'a');
    CHECK(c.setregs[0].kind == 'V');
    CHECK(c.setregs[0].text == "x\n");
    CHECK(c.keys == "dw<Esc>");
    CHECK(c.in == "\xCB\x87" "foo bar");
    CHECK(c.out == "\xCB\x87" "bar");
    CHECK(c.mode == "n");
    REQUIRE(c.regs.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(c.regs[0].name == U'"');
    CHECK(c.regs[0].text == "foo ");
    CHECK(f.cases[1].in == "\xCB\x87" "a\tb");
    CHECK(f.cases[1].divergence == "on purpose");
    CHECK(f.cases[1].grammar == "lua");          // inherits the file grammar
}

{
    REQUIRE(VimCaseGrammarStems().size() == 6u);
    CHECK(VimCaseGrammarStem("plain") == "PlainText");
    CHECK(VimCaseGrammarStem("json") == "JSON");
    CHECK(VimCaseGrammarStem("lua") == "Lua");
    CHECK(VimCaseGrammarStem("hlsl") == "HLSL");
    CHECK(VimCaseGrammarStem("ini") == "INI");
    CHECK(VimCaseGrammarStem("markdown") == "Markdown");

TEST_CASE("vim cases: every table in ArcaneTests/data/vim", "[text-vim-cases]")
{

    std::vector<std::filesystem::path> files;
    for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(dir))

        std::ifstream in(p, std::ios::binary);

        const VimCaseFile f = ParseVimCaseFile(ss.str(), p.filename().string());
```

```cpp
        std::string name, grammar, keys, in, out, mode, divergence;
        std::vector<std::string> sets;

    {

        bool handwritten = false;
        std::vector<std::string> sets;
        std::vector<VimCase> cases;
    };

    // $GrammarStems holds the same six pairs ([text-vim-oracle] checks it).
    [[nodiscard]] std::span<const std::pair<std::string_view, std::string_view>> VimCaseGrammarStems();
    [[nodiscard]] std::string_view VimCaseGrammarStem(std::string_view grammarId);   // "" = unknown id
    // The case's VimLanguage: the stem's file text -> ParseGrammar -> VimLanguageFromGrammar(desc).
    [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::VimLanguage VimCaseLanguage(std::string_view grammarId);
```

```
# ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases
# TE5a: cursor model, modes, motions, operators, text objects (spec s6.1-s6.3, s11.3).
@nvim v0.11.4
@grammar plain
@set tabstop=4 shiftwidth=4 expandtab

=== i inserts before the cursor; Esc steps back one
keys: ixy<Esc>
in: "abˇcd"
out: "abxˇycd"
mode: n

=== a appends after the cursor character
keys: axy<Esc>
in: "abˇcd"
out: "abcxˇyd"
mode: n

=== A appends at the line end
keys: Ax<Esc>
in: "aˇbc\nd"
out: "abcˇx\nd"
mode: n

=== I inserts before the first non-blank
keys: Ix<Esc>
in: "\t ab ˇc"
out: "\t ˇxab c"
mode: n

=== gI inserts in column 0
keys: gIx<Esc>
in: "  aˇb"
out: "ˇx  ab"
mode: n

=== a on an empty line stays on it
keys: ax<Esc>
in: "a\nˇ\nb"
out: "a\nˇx\nb"
mode: n

=== o copies the indent (autoindent)
keys: obar<Esc>
in: "  fˇoo\nbar"
out: "  foo\n  baˇr\nbar"
mode: n

=== O copies the indent of the current line
keys: Oy<Esc>
in: "x\n\tbˇar"
out: "x\n\tˇy\n\tbar"
mode: n

=== an untouched autoindent is removed on Esc
keys: o<Esc>
in: "    ˇfoo"
out: "    foo\nˇ"
mode: n

=== Enter drops the blanks around the split and indents the new line
keys: i<CR><Esc>
in: "  ab ˇ cd"
out: "  ab\n ˇ cd"
mode: n

=== Enter after trailing blanks truncates them
keys: A<CR>x<Esc>
in: "fooˇ  "
out: "foo\nˇx"
mode: n

=== Tab with expandtab fills to the next tabstop
keys: i<Tab><Esc>
in: "aˇb"
out: "a  ˇ b"
mode: n

=== Backspace in the indent removes back to a shiftwidth multiple (smarttab)
keys: i<BS><Esc>
in: "      ˇx"
out: "   ˇ x"
mode: n

=== Backspace at a line start joins lines (backspace=eol)
keys: i<BS><Esc>
in: "ab\nˇcd"
out: "aˇbcd"
mode: n

=== a count repeats the inserted text
keys: 3ia<Esc>
in: "ˇx"
out: "aaˇax"
mode: n

=== a count on o repeats the line
keys: 2oy<Esc>
in: "ˇx"
out: "x\ny\nˇy"
mode: n

=== Del in Insert deletes under the caret
keys: i<Del><Esc>
in: "aˇbc"
out: "ˇac"
mode: n

=== an arrow key in Insert moves the caret
keys: ix<Right>y<Esc>
in: "ˇab"
out: "xaˇyb"
mode: n

=== a key sequence can end in Insert mode
keys: ixy
in: "aˇb"
out: "axyˇb"
mode: i
```

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimCases.cpp
#include "Text/Helpers/VimCases.hpp"

#include "Helpers/ConstantScan.hpp"   // RepoRoot
#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp"

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

#include <array>
#include <charconv>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <sstream>

namespace Arcane::Test
{
    using namespace Arcane::Text;

    namespace
    {
        std::string JsonString(std::string_view literal, std::string_view where)
        {
            const nlohmann::json j = nlohmann::json::parse(literal, nullptr, false);
            INFO(where << ": " << std::string(literal));
            REQUIRE(j.is_string());
            return j.get<std::string>();
        }

        std::vector<std::string> Words(std::string_view s)
        {
            std::vector<std::string> out;
            std::istringstream in{ std::string(s) };
            for (std::string w; in >> w;) out.push_back(w);
            return out;
        }

        // "a v \"text\"" -> register spec
        VimCaseRegister ParseRegister(std::string_view value, std::string_view where)
        {
            VimCaseRegister r;
            const std::size_t sp1 = value.find(' ');
            const std::size_t sp2 = value.find(' ', sp1 + 1);
            INFO(where << ": " << std::string(value));
            REQUIRE(sp1 != std::string_view::npos);
            REQUIRE(sp2 != std::string_view::npos);
            const auto name = ParseKeys(value.substr(0, sp1));
            REQUIRE(name.has_value());
            REQUIRE(name->size() == 1u);
            r.name = (*name)[0].ch;
            r.kind = value[sp1 + 1];
            r.text = JsonString(value.substr(sp2 + 1), where);
            return r;
        }

        bool ParseUInt(std::string_view s, std::uint32_t& out)
        {
            const auto res = std::from_chars(s.data(), s.data() + s.size(), out);
            return res.ec == std::errc{} && res.ptr == s.data() + s.size();
        }
    }

    VimCaseFile ParseVimCaseFile(std::string_view text, std::string path)
    {
        VimCaseFile f;
        f.path = std::move(path);
        VimCase* current = nullptr;
        std::uint32_t lineNo = 0;
        std::size_t pos = 0;
        while (pos <= text.size())
        {
            const std::size_t nl = text.find('\n', pos);
            std::string_view line = text.substr(pos, nl == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view::npos : nl - pos);
            pos = nl == std::string_view::npos ? text.size() + 1 : nl + 1;
            ++lineNo;
            if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.remove_suffix(1);
            if (line.empty() || line.front() == '#') continue;
            const std::string where = f.path + ":" + std::to_string(lineNo);
            if (line.starts_with("@nvim ")) { f.nvimVersion = std::string(line.substr(6)); continue; }
            if (line == "@handwritten") { f.handwritten = true; continue; }
            if (line.starts_with("@grammar ")) { f.grammar = std::string(line.substr(9)); continue; }
            if (line.starts_with("@set ")) { for (std::string& w : Words(line.substr(5))) f.sets.push_back(std::move(w)); continue; }
            if (line.starts_with("=== "))
            {
                f.cases.emplace_back();
                current = &f.cases.back();
                current->name = std::string(line.substr(4));
                current->grammar = f.grammar;
                current->line = lineNo;
                continue;
            }
            INFO(where);
            REQUIRE(current != nullptr);
            const std::size_t colon = line.find(": ");
            REQUIRE(colon != std::string_view::npos);
            const std::string_view key = line.substr(0, colon), value = line.substr(colon + 2);
            if (key == "grammar") current->grammar = std::string(value);
            else if (key == "set") for (std::string& w : Words(value)) current->sets.push_back(std::move(w));
            else if (key == "setreg") current->setregs.push_back(ParseRegister(value, where));
            else if (key == "keys") current->keys = std::string(value);
            else if (key == "in") current->in = JsonString(value, where);
            else if (key == "out") current->out = JsonString(value, where);
            else if (key == "mode") current->mode = std::string(value);
            else if (key == "reg") current->regs.push_back(ParseRegister(value, where));
            else if (key == "divergence") current->divergence = std::string(value);
            else FAIL("unknown field '" << std::string(key) << "' at " << where);
        }
        return f;
    }

    bool ApplyVimSet(VimOptions& o, std::string_view a)
    {
        const std::size_t eq = a.find('=');
        if (eq != std::string_view::npos)
        {
            const std::string_view name = a.substr(0, eq), value = a.substr(eq + 1);
            std::uint32_t n = 0;
            if (name == "tabstop" || name == "ts")    return ParseUInt(value, n) && n > 0 && (o.tabSize = n, true);
            if (name == "shiftwidth" || name == "sw") return ParseUInt(value, n) && n > 0 && (o.shiftWidth = n, true);
            if (name == "scrolloff" || name == "so")  return ParseUInt(value, n) && (o.scrolloff = n, true);
            if (name == "timeoutlen" || name == "tm") return ParseUInt(value, n) && (o.timeoutlenMs = n, true);
            if (name == "nrformats" || name == "nf")  return ParseNrFormats(value, o);
            return false;
        }
        const bool off = a.starts_with("no");
        const std::string_view name = off ? a.substr(2) : a;
        bool* flag = nullptr;
        if (name == "expandtab" || name == "et")       flag = &o.expandTab;
        else if (name == "ignorecase" || name == "ic") flag = &o.ignorecase;
        else if (name == "smartcase" || name == "scs") flag = &o.smartcase;
        else if (name == "wrapscan" || name == "ws")   flag = &o.wrapscan;
        else if (name == "gdefault" || name == "gd")   flag = &o.gdefault;
        else if (name == "startofline" || name == "sol") flag = &o.startofline;
        else if (name == "hlsearch" || name == "hls")  flag = &o.hlsearch;
        else if (name == "incsearch" || name == "is")  flag = &o.incsearch;
        if (!flag) return false;
        *flag = !off;
        return true;
    }

    std::span<const std::pair<std::string_view, std::string_view>> VimCaseGrammarStems()
    {
        static constexpr std::array<std::pair<std::string_view, std::string_view>, 6> kStems{ {
            { "plain", "PlainText" },
            { "json", "JSON" },
            { "lua", "Lua" },
            { "hlsl", "HLSL" },
            { "ini", "INI" },
            { "markdown", "Markdown" },
        } };
        return kStems;
    }

    std::string_view VimCaseGrammarStem(std::string_view grammarId)
    {
        for (const auto& [id, stem] : VimCaseGrammarStems())
            if (id == grammarId) return stem;
        return {};
    }

    VimLanguage VimCaseLanguage(std::string_view grammarId)
    {
        INFO("grammar " << std::string(grammarId));
        const std::string_view stem = VimCaseGrammarStem(grammarId);
        REQUIRE_FALSE(stem.empty());                                   // an id outside the one table
        const std::filesystem::path path = RepoRoot() / "data" / "Syntaxes" / (std::string(stem) + ".arcsyntax");
        std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
        INFO("file " << path.generic_string());
        REQUIRE(in.good());
        const std::string text{ std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>() };
        const auto desc = ParseGrammar(text);
        if (!desc) FAIL(desc.error().Text());
        return VimLanguageFromGrammar(*desc);
    }

    void RunVimCase(const VimCaseFile& file, const VimCase& c)
    {
        VimOptions options;
        for (const std::string& s : file.sets) { INFO("@set " << s); REQUIRE(ApplyVimSet(options, s)); }
        for (const std::string& s : c.sets) { INFO("set: " << s); REQUIRE(ApplyVimSet(options, s)); }
        INFO("registers in a case need TE5a-12");
        REQUIRE(c.setregs.empty());
        REQUIRE(c.regs.empty());
        VimRig rig(c.in, VimCaseLanguage(c.grammar), options);
        rig.Keys(c.keys);
        INFO("keys: " << c.keys);
        INFO("in:   " << c.in);
        if (!c.divergence.empty()) INFO("divergence: " << c.divergence);
        CHECK(rig.Marked() == c.out);
        CHECK(std::string(VimModeCode(rig.Mode())) == c.mode);
    }
}
```

### Task TE5a-7: The headless Neovim oracle `scripts/vim-oracle.ps1` (spec D9, D13, s11.3)

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/vim-oracle.ps1`
- Create: `scripts/vim-oracle-driver.lua`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimOracleTablesTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the `.vimcases` format (TE5a-6), `ParseVimCaseFile`, `VimCaseGrammarStems()` (TE5a-6: the one id -> stem table the script's `$GrammarStems` must equal), `VimCommentString` (the same padded commentstring rule, `// %s`); the `.arcsyntax` JSON keys the script reads are TE3-7's file keys `comment.line` and `comment.block` (`[open, close]`), which `ParseGrammar` stores as `GrammarDesc::lineComment` / `blockCommentBegin` / `blockCommentEnd`.
- Produces: `scripts/vim-oracle.ps1 -Mode generate|verify [-Cases <globs>] [-Nvim <path>] [-Install]` with exit codes 0 (all verified / generated), 1 (mismatches or malformed table), 2 (Neovim missing or not the pinned version), 3 (a table named explicitly is `@handwritten`); `$PinnedVersion` (the one pin); the `[text-vim-oracle]` consistency test.

Dev-time only: no test ever needs Neovim (spec s11.3). The script pins one Neovim release and refuses any other, because defaults move between releases; bumping the pin is a deliberate re-bless (run `-Mode generate` on every table and review the diff). It runs `nvim --headless --clean -i NONE -n`, **never sets a filetype** (so no ftplugin or indent script loads), sets `commentstring` from the case's Arcane grammar with Neovim's padding (`// %s`), keeps `autoindent` on with no `indentexpr`/`smartindent`/`cindent`, and records the version in each table's `@nvim` line.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("vim oracle: every oracle table records the pinned Neovim; hand-written tables do not", "[text-vim-oracle]")
{
    const std::string script = ReadAll(RepoRoot() / "scripts" / "vim-oracle.ps1");
    std::smatch m;
    REQUIRE(std::regex_search(script, m, std::regex(R"(\$PinnedVersion\s*=\s*'(v\d+\.\d+\.\d+)')")));
    const std::string pin = m[1].str();
    for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(RepoRoot() / "ArcaneTests" / "data" / "vim"))
    {
        if (e.path().extension() != ".vimcases") continue;
        const VimCaseFile f = ParseVimCaseFile(ReadAll(e.path()), e.path().filename().string());
        INFO(f.path);
        if (f.handwritten) { CHECK(f.nvimVersion.empty()); continue; }
        CHECK(f.nvimVersion == pin);
        for (const VimCase& c : f.cases)
        {
            INFO(c.line << " " << c.name);
            CHECK_FALSE(c.keys.empty());
            CHECK(c.in.find("\xC2\xAB") == std::string::npos);              // oracle cases start in Normal
            CHECK(c.in.find("\xCB\x87") == c.in.rfind("\xCB\x87"));         // with exactly one cursor
            CHECK_FALSE(c.mode.empty());
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

Pin: the first execution of this task checks `https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/latest`; if it is newer than `v0.11.4`, the task sets `$PinnedVersion` to that release before generating anything (the initial pin, not a re-bless) and updates `@nvim` in `te5a.vimcases`. The D13 defaults (`Y`, `&`, `startofline`, `hlsearch`, `nrformats`) and the `gc` operator exist in every release from v0.10 on.

```powershell
# scripts/vim-oracle.ps1 -- the headless Neovim oracle for the vim behaviour tables
# (text editor spec D9, D13, s11.3). DEV-TIME ONLY: ArcaneTests never needs Neovim.
#
#   pwsh -File scripts/vim-oracle.ps1 -Mode verify                # every ArcaneTests/data/vim/*.vimcases
#   pwsh -File scripts/vim-oracle.ps1 -Mode generate -Cases ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5b.vimcases
#   pwsh -File scripts/vim-oracle.ps1 -Mode verify -Install       # fetch the pinned Neovim first
#
# Exit: 0 ok | 1 mismatches or a malformed table | 2 Neovim missing / not the pin | 3 an explicitly named table is @handwritten.
# Neovim is PINNED: defaults move between releases, so bumping $PinnedVersion is a deliberate re-bless
# (run -Mode generate on every table and review the diff of changed expectations).
# No filetype is ever set (ftplugins and indent scripts would replace Arcane's grammar rules);
# commentstring comes from the case's Arcane grammar with Neovim's padding ('// %s').
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateSet('generate', 'verify')][string]$Mode,
    [string[]]$Cases = @('ArcaneTests/data/vim/*.vimcases'),
    [string]$Nvim = '',
    [switch]$Install,
    [int]$TimeoutSeconds = 300
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PinnedVersion = 'v0.11.4'
$RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$CursorMark = [string][char]0x02C7
$AnchorMark = [string][char]0x00AB

function Get-PinnedNvimDir { Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "Arcane\tools\nvim-$PinnedVersion" }

function Find-Nvim {
    if ($Nvim) { return $Nvim }
    if ($env:ARCANE_NVIM) { return $env:ARCANE_NVIM }
    $local = Join-Path (Get-PinnedNvimDir) 'nvim-win64\bin\nvim.exe'
    if (Test-Path $local) { return $local }
    $onPath = Get-Command nvim -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($onPath) { return $onPath.Source }
    return $null
}

if ($Install) {
    $dir = Get-PinnedNvimDir
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null
    $zip = Join-Path $dir 'nvim-win64.zip'
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/download/$PinnedVersion/nvim-win64.zip" -OutFile $zip
    Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $dir -Force
}

$nvimExe = Find-Nvim
if (-not $nvimExe) { Write-Host "vim-oracle: Neovim not found (pass -Nvim, set ARCANE_NVIM, or use -Install for $PinnedVersion)"; exit 2 }
$versionLine = (& $nvimExe --version | Select-Object -First 1).Trim()
if ($versionLine -ne "NVIM $PinnedVersion") {
    Write-Host "vim-oracle: refusing '$versionLine': the oracle is pinned to NVIM $PinnedVersion (bumping the pin is a deliberate re-bless)"
    exit 2
}

# ---- the .vimcases reader (same format as ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimCases.cpp) ----
function Read-CaseFile([string]$path) {
    $lines = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
    foreach ($l in [IO.File]::ReadAllLines($path, $Utf8NoBom)) { $lines.Add($l) }
    $file = [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $path; Lines = $lines; Nvim = ''; Handwritten = $false; Grammar = 'plain';
                               Sets = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new(); Cases = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new() }
    $cur = $null
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {
        $l = $lines[$i]
        if ($l -eq '' -or $l.StartsWith('#')) { continue }
        if ($l.StartsWith('@nvim ')) { $file.Nvim = $l.Substring(6); continue }
        if ($l -eq '@handwritten') { $file.Handwritten = $true; continue }
        if ($l.StartsWith('@grammar ')) { $file.Grammar = $l.Substring(9); continue }
        if ($l.StartsWith('@set ')) { foreach ($w in ($l.Substring(5) -split '\s+')) { if ($w) { $file.Sets.Add($w) } }; continue }
        if ($l.StartsWith('=== ')) {
            $cur = [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $l.Substring(4); Line = $i; Grammar = $file.Grammar; Sets = @(); SetRegs = @(); Keys = '';
                                      In = $null; Out = $null; Mode = ''; Regs = @(); Divergence = ''; OutLine = -1; ModeLine = -1;
                                      RegLines = @(); InLine = -1 }
            $file.Cases.Add($cur); continue
        }
        if (-not $cur) { throw "${path}:$($i + 1): a field before the first '=== ' case" }
        $colon = $l.IndexOf(': ')
        if ($colon -lt 0) { throw "${path}:$($i + 1): not 'field: value'" }
        $key = $l.Substring(0, $colon); $value = $l.Substring($colon + 2)
        switch ($key) {
            'grammar'    { $cur.Grammar = $value }
            'set'        { $cur.Sets += @($value -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ }) }
            'setreg'     { $cur.SetRegs += ,(Read-RegSpec $value "${path}:$($i + 1)") }
            'keys'       { $cur.Keys = $value }
            'in'         { $cur.In = ($value | ConvertFrom-Json); $cur.InLine = $i }
            'out'        { $cur.Out = ($value | ConvertFrom-Json); $cur.OutLine = $i }
            'mode'       { $cur.Mode = $value; $cur.ModeLine = $i }
            'reg'        { $cur.Regs += ,(Read-RegSpec $value "${path}:$($i + 1)"); $cur.RegLines += $i }
            'divergence' { $cur.Divergence = $value }
            default      { throw "${path}:$($i + 1): unknown field '$key'" }
        }
    }
    return $file
}

function Read-RegSpec([string]$value, [string]$where) {
    $parts = $value.Split(' ', 3)
    if ($parts.Count -ne 3) { throw "${where}: register spec must be '<name> <v|V|b> <json>'" }
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $parts[0]; Kind = $parts[1]; Text = ($parts[2] | ConvertFrom-Json) }
}

# JSON string literal with non-ASCII left raw (ConvertTo-Json would \u-escape it).
function ConvertTo-JsonLiteral([string]$s) {
    $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    [void]$sb.Append('"')
    foreach ($ch in $s.ToCharArray()) {
        switch ([int]$ch) {
            0x22 { [void]$sb.Append('\"') }
            0x5C { [void]$sb.Append('\\') }
            0x0A { [void]$sb.Append('\n') }
            0x0D { [void]$sb.Append('\r') }
            0x09 { [void]$sb.Append('\t') }
            default { if ([int]$ch -lt 0x20) { [void]$sb.Append(('\u{0:x4}' -f [int]$ch)) } else { [void]$sb.Append($ch) } }
        }
    }
    [void]$sb.Append('"')
    return $sb.ToString()
}

# THE ONE .vimcases grammar id -> data/Syntaxes/<Stem>.arcsyntax table. ArcaneTests'
# VimCaseGrammarStems() (Text/Helpers/VimCases.cpp) holds the same six pairs and
# [text-vim-oracle] checks this line lists exactly them (stems are case-sensitive).
$GrammarStems = [ordered]@{ 'plain' = 'PlainText'; 'json' = 'JSON'; 'lua' = 'Lua'; 'hlsl' = 'HLSL'; 'ini' = 'INI'; 'markdown' = 'Markdown' }

# The Arcane grammar's commentstring with Neovim's padding ('// %s'); '' when the grammar has no comment
# (PlainText). The .arcsyntax keys are TE3-7's: "comment": { "line": ..., "block": [open, close] }.
$commentCache = @{}
function Get-CommentString([string]$grammar) {
    if ($commentCache.ContainsKey($grammar)) { return $commentCache[$grammar] }
    if (-not $GrammarStems.Contains($grammar)) { throw "unknown grammar id '$grammar' (not in `$GrammarStems)" }
    $stem = $GrammarStems[$grammar]
    $path = Join-Path $RepoRoot "data\Syntaxes\$stem.arcsyntax"
    if (-not (Test-Path $path)) { throw "grammar '$grammar' -> missing $path" }
    $g = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($path, $Utf8NoBom) | ConvertFrom-Json
    $cs = ''
    if ($g.comment -and $g.comment.line) { $cs = $g.comment.line + ' %s' }
    elseif ($g.comment -and $g.comment.block -and $g.comment.block.Count -eq 2) { $cs = $g.comment.block[0] + ' %s ' + $g.comment.block[1] }
    $commentCache[$grammar] = $cs
    return $cs
}

function Get-OptionName([string]$item) {
    $m = [regex]::Match($item, '^(?:no|inv)?([a-z]+)')
    return $m.Groups[1].Value
}

function Invoke-Oracle($file) {
    $inputCases = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
    $reset = [System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new()
    foreach ($c in $file.Cases) { foreach ($s in $c.Sets) { [void]$reset.Add((Get-OptionName $s)) } }
    for ($n = 0; $n -lt $file.Cases.Count; $n++) {
        $c = $file.Cases[$n]
        if ($c.Divergence) { continue }
        if ($c.In.Contains($AnchorMark)) { throw "$($file.Path):$($c.Line + 1): an oracle case starts in Normal mode (no anchor)" }
        $at = $c.In.IndexOf($CursorMark)
        if ($at -lt 0 -or $c.In.IndexOf($CursorMark, $at + 1) -ge 0) { throw "$($file.Path):$($c.Line + 1): an oracle case has exactly one cursor" }
        $before = $c.In.Substring(0, $at)
        $text = $c.In.Remove($at, 1)
        $row = ([regex]::Matches($before, "`n")).Count
        $lineStart = $before.LastIndexOf("`n") + 1
        $col = $Utf8NoBom.GetByteCount($before.Substring($lineStart))
        $regNames = @($c.Regs | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
        $setregs = @($c.SetRegs | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ name = $_.Name; kind = $_.Kind; text = $_.Text } })
        $inputCases.Add([pscustomobject]@{ id = $n; keys = $c.Keys; lines = @($text -split "`n"); row = $row; col = $col;
                                           sets = @($c.Sets); setregs = $setregs; regs = $regNames;
                                           commentstring = (Get-CommentString $c.Grammar) })
    }
    $inPath = [IO.Path]::GetTempFileName(); $outPath = [IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()
    $payload = [pscustomobject]@{ fileSets = @($file.Sets); resetOptions = @($reset); cases = $inputCases.ToArray() }
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($inPath, ($payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress), $Utf8NoBom)
    $driver = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'vim-oracle-driver.lua'
    $env:ARCANE_ORACLE_IN = $inPath; $env:ARCANE_ORACLE_OUT = $outPath
    $luafile = '"luafile ' + $driver + '"'      # Start-Process joins arguments with spaces: quote the -c command
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $nvimExe -ArgumentList @('--headless', '--clean', '-i', 'NONE', '-n', '-c', $luafile) -PassThru -NoNewWindow
    if (-not $p.WaitForExit($TimeoutSeconds * 1000)) { $p.Kill(); throw "$($file.Path): Neovim did not finish in $TimeoutSeconds s" }
    $result = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($outPath, $Utf8NoBom) | ConvertFrom-Json
    Remove-Item $inPath, $outPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($result.error) { throw "$($file.Path): driver error: $($result.error)" }
    $byId = @{}
    foreach ($r in $result.results) { $byId[[int]$r.id] = $r }
    return $byId
}

$exit = 0
$targets = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
foreach ($glob in $Cases) {
    $explicit = -not ($glob -match '[\*\?\[]')
    foreach ($item in Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $RepoRoot $glob) -File) { $targets.Add([pscustomobject]@{ File = $item; Explicit = $explicit }) }
}
foreach ($t in $targets) {
    $f = $t.File
    $file = Read-CaseFile $f.FullName
    if ($file.Handwritten) {
        if ($t.Explicit) { Write-Host "vim-oracle: $($f.Name) is @handwritten (not an oracle table)"; exit 3 }
        Write-Host "vim-oracle: skipping @handwritten $($f.Name)"; continue
    }
    $results = Invoke-Oracle $file
    $mismatch = 0; $skipped = 0; $checked = 0
    for ($n = $file.Cases.Count - 1; $n -ge 0; $n--) {
        $c = $file.Cases[$n]
        if ($c.Divergence) { $skipped++; continue }
        $r = $results[$n]
        if ($r.error) { Write-Host "ERROR $($f.Name):$($c.Line + 1) '$($c.Name)': $($r.error)"; $mismatch++; continue }
        $checked++
        if ($Mode -eq 'verify') {
            $bad = @()
            if ($c.Out -ne $r.out) { $bad += "  out   expected $(ConvertTo-JsonLiteral $c.Out)`n        neovim   $(ConvertTo-JsonLiteral $r.out)" }
            if ($c.Mode -ne $r.mode) { $bad += "  mode  expected $($c.Mode)   neovim $($r.mode)" }
            for ($k = 0; $k -lt $c.Regs.Count; $k++) {
                $want = $c.Regs[$k]; $got = $r.regs[$k]
                if ($want.Kind -ne $got.kind -or $want.Text -ne $got.text) {
                    $bad += "  reg $($want.Name)  expected $($want.Kind) $(ConvertTo-JsonLiteral $want.Text)   neovim $($got.kind) $(ConvertTo-JsonLiteral $got.text)"
                }
            }
            if ($bad.Count) { $mismatch++; Write-Host "MISMATCH $($f.Name):$($c.Line + 1) '$($c.Name)'  keys: $($c.Keys)"; $bad | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ } }
        } else {
            # generate: rewrite out / mode / reg lines in place (cases are walked bottom-up, so indices stay valid)
            $outText = 'out: ' + (ConvertTo-JsonLiteral $r.out)
            $modeText = 'mode: ' + $r.mode
            for ($k = $c.RegLines.Count - 1; $k -ge 0; $k--) {
                $file.Lines[$c.RegLines[$k]] = "reg: $($c.Regs[$k].Name) $($r.regs[$k].kind) $(ConvertTo-JsonLiteral $r.regs[$k].text)"
            }
            if ($c.ModeLine -ge 0) { $file.Lines[$c.ModeLine] = $modeText }
            if ($c.OutLine -ge 0) { $file.Lines[$c.OutLine] = $outText }
            if ($c.OutLine -lt 0 -and $c.ModeLine -lt 0) { $file.Lines.Insert($c.InLine + 1, $modeText); $file.Lines.Insert($c.InLine + 1, $outText) }
            elseif ($c.OutLine -lt 0) { $file.Lines.Insert($c.InLine + 1, $outText) }
            elseif ($c.ModeLine -lt 0) { $file.Lines.Insert($c.OutLine + 1, $modeText) }
        }
    }
    if ($Mode -eq 'generate') {
        $header = "@nvim $PinnedVersion"
        $idx = -1
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $file.Lines.Count; $i++) { if ($file.Lines[$i].StartsWith('@nvim ')) { $idx = $i; break } }
        if ($idx -ge 0) { $file.Lines[$idx] = $header } else {
            $at = 0
            while ($at -lt $file.Lines.Count -and $file.Lines[$at].StartsWith('#')) { $at++ }
            $file.Lines.Insert($at, $header)
        }
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($f.FullName, (($file.Lines -join "`n") + "`n"), $Utf8NoBom)
        Write-Host "generated $($f.Name): $checked cases ($skipped divergence cases kept as written)"
    } else {
        if ($file.Nvim -ne $PinnedVersion) { Write-Host "MISMATCH $($f.Name): @nvim '$($file.Nvim)' is not the pin $PinnedVersion"; $mismatch++ }
        Write-Host "verified $checked cases, $mismatch mismatches ($skipped divergence cases skipped) in $($f.Name)"
    }
    if ($mismatch) { $exit = 1 }
}
exit $exit
```

```lua
-- scripts/vim-oracle-driver.lua -- run by scripts/vim-oracle.ps1 inside
-- `nvim --headless --clean -i NONE -n`. Reads the cases from $ARCANE_ORACLE_IN,
-- writes {results = [...]} (or {error = "..."}) to $ARCANE_ORACLE_OUT, then quits.
-- It never sets a file type: ftplugins and indent scripts must not replace
-- Arcane's grammar rules (spec s11.3). The C++ test greps this file for the
-- option's name, so the word must not appear here.
local inPath, outPath = os.getenv('ARCANE_ORACLE_IN'), os.getenv('ARCANE_ORACLE_OUT')
local CURSOR, ANCHOR = '\203\135', '\194\171'   -- U+02C7, U+00AB
local MODES = { n = 'n', i = 'i', R = 'R', v = 'v', V = 'V', ['\22'] = '^V', no = 'no', c = 'c' }
local REGS = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-"'

local function split(text)
  local out = {}
  for line in (text .. '\n'):gmatch('(.-)\n') do out[#out + 1] = line end
  return out
end

local function setreg(spec)
  local lines = split(spec.text)
  if spec.kind == 'V' and #lines > 1 and lines[#lines] == '' then table.remove(lines) end
  local kind = spec.kind == 'b' and 'b' or spec.kind
  vim.fn.setreg(spec.name, lines, kind)
end

local function runCase(input, c)
  if vim.fn.reg_recording() ~= '' then vim.cmd('normal! q') end
  local old = vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()
  vim.cmd('enew!')
  if vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(old) and old ~= vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf() then vim.cmd('silent! bwipeout! ' .. old) end
  vim.cmd('silent! delmarks!')
  vim.cmd('silent! delmarks A-Z0-9')
  vim.cmd('clearjumps')
  for i = 1, #REGS do vim.fn.setreg(REGS:sub(i, i), {}) end
  vim.fn.setreg('/', '')
  vim.cmd('nohlsearch')
  for _, name in ipairs(input.resetOptions) do vim.cmd('set ' .. name .. '&') end
  for _, s in ipairs(input.fileSets) do vim.cmd('set ' .. s) end
  for _, s in ipairs(c.sets) do vim.cmd('set ' .. s) end
  vim.bo.commentstring = c.commentstring
  vim.bo.autoindent = true
  vim.bo.indentexpr = ''
  vim.bo.smartindent = false
  vim.bo.cindent = false
  vim.bo.undolevels = -1                                   -- the initial text is not undoable
  vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(0, 0, -1, false, c.lines)
  vim.bo.undolevels = -123456
  vim.bo.modified = false
  for _, spec in ipairs(c.setregs) do setreg(spec) end
  vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(0, { c.row + 1, c.col })
  local keys = vim.api.nvim_replace_termcodes(c.keys, true, true, true)
  vim.api.nvim_feedkeys(keys, 'tx!', false)                -- typed, executed now, Insert mode kept

  local mode = vim.api.nvim_get_mode().mode
  local lines = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(0, 0, -1, false)
  local cur = vim.api.nvim_win_get_cursor(0)
  local visual = mode == 'v' or mode == 'V' or mode == '\22'
  local function offset(row1, col0)
    local o = 0
    for i = 1, row1 - 1 do o = o + #lines[i] + 1 end
    return o + col0
  end
  local curCol = cur[2]
  if visual and vim.fn.winsaveview().curswant >= 2147483647 then curCol = #lines[cur[1]] end
  local marks = { { offset(cur[1], curCol), CURSOR } }
  if visual then
    local v = vim.fn.getpos('v')
    marks[#marks + 1] = { offset(v[2], v[3] - 1), ANCHOR }
  end
  table.sort(marks, function(a, b)
    if a[1] ~= b[1] then return a[1] > b[1] end
    return a[2] == CURSOR
  end)
  local text = table.concat(lines, '\n')
  for _, m in ipairs(marks) do text = text:sub(1, m[1]) .. m[2] .. text:sub(m[1] + 1) end
  local regs = {}
  for _, name in ipairs(c.regs) do
    local t = vim.fn.getregtype(name)
    local kind = 'v'
    if t == 'V' then kind = 'V' elseif t:sub(1, 1) == '\22' then kind = 'b' end
    regs[#regs + 1] = { name = name, kind = kind, text = vim.fn.getreg(name) }
  end
  if mode ~= 'n' then vim.api.nvim_feedkeys(vim.api.nvim_replace_termcodes('<C-\\><C-n>', true, true, true), 'nx', false) end
  return { id = c.id, out = text, mode = MODES[mode] or mode, regs = regs }
end

local ok, err = pcall(function()
  local input = vim.json.decode(table.concat(vim.fn.readfile(inPath, 'b'), '\n'))
  vim.o.lines = 24
  vim.o.columns = 80
  vim.o.more = false
  vim.o.swapfile = false
  local results = {}
  for _, c in ipairs(input.cases) do
    local okCase, res = pcall(runCase, input, c)
    results[#results + 1] = okCase and res or { id = c.id, error = tostring(res) }
  end
  vim.fn.writefile({ vim.json.encode({ results = results }) }, outPath, 'b')
end)
if not ok then vim.fn.writefile({ vim.json.encode({ error = tostring(err) }) }, outPath, 'b') end
vim.cmd('qa!')
```

**Files:**

- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExecute.cpp`

- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp` (TE5a-5: `VimState::Execute`, the `Motion` branch)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases` (append the section below)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimMotionsTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimContext`, `VimText::*`, `VimCursorModel::Clamp`, `VimOptions::startofline/tabSize`, `DisplayMap::BufferRowToDisplay/DisplayRowToBuffer/DisplayRowCount` (TE1-13), `bool FoldModel::Fold(const Rope&, FoldRange, FoldSource)` with `struct FoldRange { std::uint32_t headerRow, lastRow; }` (TE1-12; hides `headerRow+1..lastRow`; test only -- `VimState::HandleKey`'s `VimText::SyncDisplay` rebuilds the rig's display before the key runs), `VimRig` (`r.folds`, `r.buffer`).
- Produces:
  - `struct VimMotionArgs { id; count; arg; op; bool wrap; Count1(); }` -- the contract struct plus one additive field `wrap` (the `<BS>`/`<Space>` keys cross line ends, Neovim `whichwrap=b,s`; `h`/`l` do not).
  - `struct VimMotionTarget { offset; kind; jump; goal; noExclusiveAdjust; bool beep; }` -- contract struct plus additive `beep` (vim moved AND beeped: `w` on the last word of the file).
  - `std::optional<VimMotionTarget> ResolveMotion(VimContext&, ByteOffset from, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal, const VimMotionArgs&)`.
  - `struct VimRowSpan { first, last; }`, `VimRowSpan VimDisplayRowSpan(const VimContext&, std::uint32_t row)` (buffer rows a display row covers: a closed fold is one display row).
  - `ByteOffset VimLineTargetColumn(const VimContext&, std::uint32_t row, ByteOffset from, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal)` (first non-blank with `startofline`, else the goal virtual column -- Neovim's `nostartofline` default).
  - `VimMotionArgs VimMotionArgsOf(const VimParsed&)`.
  - `void VimState::ExecuteMotion(const VimParsed&)` -- locals `jumped`, `jumpFrom`; ends with `VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));` (contract hook for TE5b-8; Part B adds the VisualBlock early-return at its top).

Vertical motions count **display** rows (spec s3.6): a closed fold is one row for `j`/`k`, and the cursor lands on the fold's header line (`FoldRange::headerRow`; the display map comes from `VimText::SyncDisplay`, never from the fold model directly). The goal column is a virtual column (tabs expand by `tabSize`); `$` stores `VimText::kGoalEol` so later `j`/`k` stay at line ends. With `startofline` off (Neovim), `gg`/`G` keep the goal column. `l` stops on the last character in Normal; with an operator it may reach the line end (`dl` on the last char deletes it; on an empty line it is an empty range, no beep); in Visual it may reach the line end too (vim's `past_line` with `selection=inclusive`, so `v$`-like selections include the break).

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimMotionsTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.hpp"

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

TEST_CASE("vim motions: j and k count display rows; a closed fold is one row", "[text-vim-motions]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc\nd");
    REQUIRE(r.folds.Fold(r.buffer.Text(), FoldRange{ 1, 2 }, FoldSource::Manual));   // header row 1, hides row 2
    r.Keys("j");                                   // HandleKey syncs the display first (VimText::SyncDisplay)
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\n\xCB\x87" "b\nc\nd");    // onto the fold header line (headerRow 1)
    r.Keys("j");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\nb\nc\n\xCB\x87" "d");    // past the whole fold
    r.Keys("k");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\n\xCB\x87" "b\nc\nd");
}

TEST_CASE("vim motions: the goal column survives short lines; $ sticks to line ends", "[text-vim-motions]")
{
    VimRig r("abc\xCB\x87" "d\nx\nabcdef");
    r.Keys("jj");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "abcd\nx\nabc\xCB\x87" "def");
    VimRig e("a\xCB\x87" "b\nxyz");
    e.Keys("$j");
    CHECK(e.Marked() == "ab\nxy\xCB\x87" "z");
}

TEST_CASE("vim motions: tabs count as virtual columns", "[text-vim-motions]")
{
    VimRig r("\t\xCB\x87" "x\nabcdefgh");             // x sits at virtual column 4 (tabSize 4)
    r.Keys("j");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\tx\nabcd\xCB\x87" "efgh");
}

TEST_CASE("vim motions: l stops at the last char in Normal, reaches the line end for an operator", "[text-vim-motions]")
{
    VimRig r("ab\xCB\x87" "c\n\nz");
    VimContext ctx = r.vim->Context();
    VimMotionArgs plain;
    plain.id = VimMotionId::Right;
    CHECK_FALSE(ResolveMotion(ctx, 2, std::nullopt, plain).has_value());       // nothing to move to: beep
    VimMotionArgs op = plain;
    op.op = VimOperatorId::Delete;
    const auto t = ResolveMotion(ctx, 2, std::nullopt, op);
    REQUIRE(t.has_value());
    CHECK(t->offset == 3u);                                                     // the line end: dl deletes 'c'
    const auto empty = ResolveMotion(ctx, 4, std::nullopt, op);                // the empty line
    REQUIRE(empty.has_value());
    CHECK(empty->offset == 4u);                                                 // empty range, no beep
}

TEST_CASE("vim motions: gg and G keep the column with nostartofline; startofline goes to the first non-blank", "[text-vim-motions]")
{
    VimRig r("  ab\nxy\xCB\x87" "z");
    r.Keys("gg");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "  \xCB\x87" "ab\nxyz");
    VimOptions sol;
    sol.startofline = true;
    VimRig s("  ab\nxy\xCB\x87" "z", {}, sol);
    s.Keys("gg");
    CHECK(s.Marked() == "  \xCB\x87" "ab\nxyz");
    VimRig t("ab\n  cd\xCB\x87" "ef", {}, sol);
    t.Keys("gg");
    CHECK(t.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "ab\n  cdef");
}

TEST_CASE("vim motions: a failed motion beeps and flushes the typed-ahead keys", "[text-vim-motions]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "abc");
    r.Keys("hl");                                   // h fails at column 0: l never runs
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "abc");
}

TEST_CASE("vim motions: every cursor moves", "[text-vim-motions]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "ab\n\xCB\x87" "cd");
    r.Keys("$");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "b\nc\xCB\x87" "d");
}
```
