```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim motions (spec s6.3), resolved PER CURSOR: ResolveMotion takes one vim
// position and returns where the motion lands and its MotionKind
// (linewise / exclusive / inclusive, per vim). Vertical motions go through the
// DisplayMap (spec s3.6) so closed folds are one row. Operators turn the result
// into editor ranges (VimState::ExecuteOperator, TE5a-12).

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCommand.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimContext.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimMotionArgs
    {
        VimMotionId id = VimMotionId::Left;
        std::uint32_t count = 0;                    // 0 = none typed
        char32_t arg = 0;                           // f/t/F/T char, mark name
        std::optional<VimOperatorId> op;            // set when resolving for an operator
        bool wrap = false;                          // <BS>/<Space>: cross line ends (whichwrap=b,s)
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t Count1() const { return count == 0 ? 1u : count; }
    };

    struct VimMotionTarget
    {
        ByteOffset offset = 0;
        MotionKind kind = MotionKind::Exclusive;
        bool jump = false;                          // G gg % ( ) { } H M L n N * # / ? ` '
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal;          // keep (j k gj gk G gg H M L), kGoalEol ($); nullopt = reset
        bool noExclusiveAdjust = false;             // vim CA_NO_ADJ_OP_END
        bool beep = false;                          // the cursor moved AND vim beeps (w at the file's last word)
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<VimMotionTarget> ResolveMotion(VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from,
                                                              std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal, const VimMotionArgs& args);

    struct VimRowSpan { std::uint32_t first = 0, last = 0; };
    [[nodiscard]] VimRowSpan VimDisplayRowSpan(const VimContext& ctx, std::uint32_t row);
    [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset VimLineTargetColumn(const VimContext& ctx, std::uint32_t row, ByteOffset from,
                                                 std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal);
    [[nodiscard]] VimMotionArgs VimMotionArgsOf(const VimParsed& p);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        std::uint32_t LastRow(const Rope& r) { return r.LineCount() - 1; }

        bool LineEmpty(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row) { return r.LineStart(row) == r.LineEnd(row); }

        // A vertical move's landing column: the goal virtual column on `row`,
        // on the line's last char when the goal is past it (kGoalEol: the line end).
        ByteOffset ColumnOnRow(const VimContext& ctx, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t vcol)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            if (vcol == VimText::kGoalEol) return r.LineEnd(row);
            const ByteOffset o = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, vcol, ctx.options.tabSize);
            if (o == r.LineEnd(row) && !LineEmpty(r, row)) return VimText::PrevChar(r, o);
            return o;
        }

        std::uint32_t GoalOf(const VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal)
        {
            return goal.value_or(VimText::VirtualColumn(ctx.Text(), from, ctx.options.tabSize));
        }

        ByteOffset FirstNonBlankOn(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row)
        {
            const ByteOffset o = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row);
            if (o == r.LineEnd(row) && !LineEmpty(r, row)) return VimText::PrevChar(r, o);   // a blank line: its last char
            return o;
        }

        // vim cursor_down / cursor_up over DISPLAY rows; fails only when no move is possible.
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> RowsDown(const VimContext& ctx, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t n)
        {
            if (n == 0) return row;
            const std::uint32_t d = ctx.doc.display.BufferRowToDisplay(row);
            const std::uint32_t count = ctx.doc.display.DisplayRowCount();
            if (d + 1 >= count) return std::nullopt;
            return ctx.doc.display.DisplayRowToBuffer(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(std::uint64_t(d) + n, count - 1)));
        }

        std::optional<std::uint32_t> RowsUp(const VimContext& ctx, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t n)
        {
            if (n == 0) return row;
            const std::uint32_t d = ctx.doc.display.BufferRowToDisplay(row);
            if (d == 0) return std::nullopt;
            return ctx.doc.display.DisplayRowToBuffer(d >= n ? d - n : 0);
        }

        std::optional<VimMotionTarget> Left(const VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, const VimMotionArgs& a)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            ByteOffset o = from;
            std::uint32_t moved = 0;
            for (std::uint32_t n = a.Count1(); n > 0; --n, ++moved)
            {
                const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
                if (o > r.LineStart(row)) { o = VimText::PrevChar(r, o); continue; }
                if (!a.wrap || row == 0) break;
                // <BS> at column 0: onto the previous line; d/c take its line break (vim's special case)
                const bool takesBreak = a.op == VimOperatorId::Delete || a.op == VimOperatorId::Change;
                o = takesBreak ? r.LineEnd(row - 1) : VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, r.LineEnd(row - 1));
            }
            if (moved == 0) return std::nullopt;   // vim beeps only when the cursor did not move at all
            return VimMotionTarget{ o, MotionKind::Exclusive };
        }

        std::optional<VimMotionTarget> Right(const VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, const VimMotionArgs& a)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const bool pastEnd = a.op.has_value() || IsVisual(ctx.mode);
            ByteOffset o = from;
            std::uint32_t moved = 0;
            for (std::uint32_t n = a.Count1(); n > 0; --n, ++moved)
            {
                const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
                const ByteOffset end = r.LineEnd(row);
                const ByteOffset limit = (pastEnd || LineEmpty(r, row)) ? end : VimText::PrevChar(r, end);
                if (o < limit) { o = VimText::NextChar(r, o); continue; }
                if (!a.wrap || row >= LastRow(r)) break;
                o = r.LineStart(row + 1);
            }
            if (moved == 0)
            {
                if (a.op) return VimMotionTarget{ from, MotionKind::Exclusive };   // x on an empty line: nothing, no beep
                return std::nullopt;
            }
            return VimMotionTarget{ o, MotionKind::Exclusive };
        }

        VimMotionTarget Vertical(const VimContext& ctx, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t vcol, MotionKind kind)
        {
            VimMotionTarget t{ ColumnOnRow(ctx, row, vcol), kind };
            t.goal = vcol;
            return t;
        }

        VimMotionTarget LineJump(const VimContext& ctx, std::uint32_t row, ByteOffset from, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal)
        {
            VimMotionTarget t{ VimLineTargetColumn(ctx, row, from, goal), MotionKind::Linewise };
            t.jump = true;
            if (!ctx.options.startofline) t.goal = GoalOf(ctx, from, goal);
            return t;
        }
    }

    VimMotionArgs VimMotionArgsOf(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        VimMotionArgs a;
        a.id = p.Id<VimMotionId>();
        a.count = p.count;
        a.arg = p.arg;
        a.op = p.op;
        if (!p.keys.empty())
        {
            const VimKey& k = p.keys.back();
            a.wrap = k == VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Backspace) || k == VimKey::Char(U' ');
        }
        return a;
    }

    VimRowSpan VimDisplayRowSpan(const VimContext& ctx, std::uint32_t row)
    {
        const DisplayMap& dm = ctx.doc.display;
        const std::uint32_t d = dm.BufferRowToDisplay(row);
        VimRowSpan s;
        s.first = dm.DisplayRowToBuffer(d);
        s.last = d + 1 < dm.DisplayRowCount() ? dm.DisplayRowToBuffer(d + 1) - 1 : ctx.Text().LineCount() - 1;
        return s;
    }

    ByteOffset VimLineTargetColumn(const VimContext& ctx, std::uint32_t row, ByteOffset from, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal)
    {
        if (ctx.options.startofline) return FirstNonBlankOn(ctx.Text(), row);
        return ColumnOnRow(ctx, row, GoalOf(ctx, from, goal));
    }

    std::optional<VimMotionTarget> ResolveMotion(VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal,
                                                 const VimMotionArgs& a)
    {
        const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
        const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, from);
        switch (a.id)
        {
        case VimMotionId::Left:  return Left(ctx, from, a);
        case VimMotionId::Right: return Right(ctx, from, a);
        case VimMotionId::Down:
        case VimMotionId::DisplayDown:
        {
            const auto target = RowsDown(ctx, row, a.Count1());
            if (!target) return std::nullopt;
            return Vertical(ctx, *target, GoalOf(ctx, from, goal),
                            a.id == VimMotionId::Down ? MotionKind::Linewise : MotionKind::Exclusive);
        }
        case VimMotionId::Up:
        case VimMotionId::DisplayUp:
        {
            const auto target = RowsUp(ctx, row, a.Count1());
            if (!target) return std::nullopt;
            return Vertical(ctx, *target, GoalOf(ctx, from, goal),
                            a.id == VimMotionId::Up ? MotionKind::Linewise : MotionKind::Exclusive);
        }
        case VimMotionId::LineStart:
            return VimMotionTarget{ r.LineStart(row), MotionKind::Exclusive };
        case VimMotionId::FirstNonBlank:
            return VimMotionTarget{ FirstNonBlankOn(r, row), MotionKind::Exclusive };
        case VimMotionId::LineEnd:
        {
            const auto target = RowsDown(ctx, row, a.Count1() - 1);
            if (!target) return std::nullopt;
            VimMotionTarget t{ r.LineEnd(*target), MotionKind::Inclusive };
            t.goal = VimText::kGoalEol;
            return t;
        }
        case VimMotionId::LastNonBlank:
        {
            const auto target = RowsDown(ctx, row, a.Count1() - 1);
            if (!target) return std::nullopt;
            ByteOffset o = r.LineEnd(*target);
            while (o > r.LineStart(*target))
            {
                const ByteOffset prev = VimText::PrevChar(r, o);
                const char32_t c = VimText::CodePointAt(r, prev);
                o = prev;
                if (c != U' ' && c != U'\t') break;
            }
            return VimMotionTarget{ o, MotionKind::Inclusive };
        }
        case VimMotionId::FileStart:
            return LineJump(ctx, a.count == 0 ? 0u : std::min(a.count - 1, LastRow(r)), from, goal);
        case VimMotionId::FileEnd:
            return LineJump(ctx, a.count == 0 ? LastRow(r) : std::min(a.count - 1, LastRow(r)), from, goal);
        case VimMotionId::Column:
        {
            VimMotionTarget t{ ColumnOnRow(ctx, row, a.Count1() - 1), MotionKind::Exclusive };
            t.goal = a.Count1() - 1;
            return t;
        }
        case VimMotionId::FirstNonBlankDown:
        {
            const auto target = RowsDown(ctx, row, a.Count1());
            if (!target) return std::nullopt;
            return VimMotionTarget{ FirstNonBlankOn(r, *target), MotionKind::Linewise };
        }
        case VimMotionId::FirstNonBlankUp:
        {
            const auto target = RowsUp(ctx, row, a.Count1());
            if (!target) return std::nullopt;
            return VimMotionTarget{ FirstNonBlankOn(r, *target), MotionKind::Linewise };
        }
        case VimMotionId::CurrentLine:
        {
            const auto target = RowsDown(ctx, row, a.Count1() - 1);
            if (!target) return std::nullopt;
            return VimMotionTarget{ FirstNonBlankOn(r, *target), MotionKind::Linewise };
        }
        default:
            return std::nullopt;   // the ids later tasks implement (word, find, screen, search, marks, folds)
        }
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExecute.cpp
// VimState's motion and operator execution (spec s6.2): one resolver call per
// cursor, one SelectionSet / EditOp list for all of them.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    void VimState::ExecuteMotion(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        const VimMotionArgs args = VimMotionArgsOf(p);
        const ByteOffset jumpFrom = ToVim(sels[VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc)]).head;
        bool any = false, jumped = false, beep = false;
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const VimCursor c = ToVim(s);
            const std::optional<VimMotionTarget> t = ResolveMotion(ctx, c.head, s.goalColumn, args);
            if (!t) continue;
            any = true;
            jumped = jumped || t->jump;
            beep = beep || t->beep;
            s = FromVim(VimCursor{ IsVisual(m_mode) ? c.anchor : t->offset, t->offset }, t->goal, s.id);
        }
        if (!any) { Beep(); return; }
        if (beep) Beep();
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }
}
```

```cpp
    void VimState::Execute(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        switch (p.kind)
        {
        case VimCmdKind::Action:
            RunAction(p);
            break;
        case VimCmdKind::Motion:
            if (p.op) { Beep(); break; }   // an operator + motion: ExecuteOperator (TE5a-12)
            ExecuteMotion(p);
            break;
        case VimCmdKind::Operator:         // ExecuteOperator: TE5a-12
        case VimCmdKind::TextObject:       // ExtendVisualByObject: TE5a-16/18
            Beep();
            break;
        }
    }
```

### Task TE5a-9: Word motions w W b B e E ge gE (spec s6.3 Motions, s11.3 word characters)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.cpp` (TE5a-8: new word-scan helpers in the anonymous namespace; new `case`s in `ResolveMotion`)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimWordMotionsTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimCharClass::Class` (TE5a-3), `VimText::NextChar/PrevChar/CodePointAt/RowOf/AtLineEnd`, `ResolveMotion` (TE5a-8).
- Produces: `ResolveMotion` cases `WordFwd BigWordFwd WordBack BigWordBack WordEnd BigWordEnd WordEndBack BigWordEndBack`, including the operator rules TE5a-12 relies on: with an operator `w` stops at the end of the line on its last iteration (vim's `fwd_word(..., eol)`), the NUL position is pulled back onto the last char and the motion becomes inclusive (vim's `adjust_cursor`), and `cw`/`cW` on a non-blank is `ce`/`cE` (`end_word(..., stop=TRUE)`).

The algorithms are vim's `fwd_word`, `bck_word`, `end_word`, `bckend_word` over byte offsets: a line's end offset is vim's NUL position (class 0), `IncPos`/`DecPos` are vim's `inc()`/`dec()` (return 2 when stepping onto a line's NUL, 1 when crossing to another line, -1 at the file's ends). Word classes come from `VimCharClass` (grammar `wordChars` + `\p{L}\p{N}`), so `w` over `café` matches Neovim. Divergences, stated in the notes: vim's per-script CJK classes and the emoji class are folded into "word" / "punctuation"; word motions do not jump over closed folds.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("vim word motions: w with an operator stops at the end of the line, inclusive", "[text-vim-motions]")
{
    VimRig r("foo \xCB\x87" "bar\nbaz");
    const auto plain = Resolve(r, 4, VimMotionId::WordFwd);
    REQUIRE(plain.has_value());
    CHECK(plain->offset == 8u);                                   // the next line's word
    CHECK(plain->kind == MotionKind::Exclusive);
    const auto op = Resolve(r, 4, VimMotionId::WordFwd, VimOperatorId::Delete);
    REQUIRE(op.has_value());
    CHECK(op->offset == 6u);                                      // 'r': pulled back off the NUL
    CHECK(op->kind == MotionKind::Inclusive);
}

TEST_CASE("vim word motions: cw on a word is ce; on the word's last char it changes one char", "[text-vim-motions]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "foo bar");
    const auto cw = Resolve(r, 0, VimMotionId::WordFwd, VimOperatorId::Change);
    REQUIRE(cw.has_value());
    CHECK(cw->offset == 2u);
    CHECK(cw->kind == MotionKind::Inclusive);
    const auto last = Resolve(r, 2, VimMotionId::WordFwd, VimOperatorId::Change);
    REQUIRE(last.has_value());
    CHECK(last->offset == 2u);
}

TEST_CASE("vim word motions: at the file's end w moves to the last char; a FAILed count moves and beeps", "[text-vim-motions]")
{
    VimRig r("foo \xCB\x87" "bar");
    const auto t = Resolve(r, 4, VimMotionId::WordFwd);
    REQUIRE(t.has_value());
    CHECK(t->offset == 6u);                                          // fwd_word returns OK on the NUL; adjust_cursor
    CHECK_FALSE(t->beep);
    CHECK_FALSE(Resolve(r, 6, VimMotionId::WordFwd).has_value());   // already on the last char: FAIL, no move
    VimRig c("\xCB\x87" "a b");

    REQUIRE(three.has_value());
    CHECK(three->offset == 2u);                                      // moved to 'b', then FAILed: vim beeps
    CHECK(three->beep);
}

TEST_CASE("vim word motions: non-ASCII letters are word characters", "[text-vim-motions]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "caf\xC3\xA9 bar");
    r.Keys("w");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "caf\xC3\xA9 \xCB\x87" "bar");
```

```cpp
        // vim inc()/dec() over byte offsets: 2 = stepped onto a line's NUL (its end),
        // 1 = crossed to another line, 0 = moved within the line, -1 = at the file's end/start.
        int IncPos(const Rope& r, ByteOffset& o)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
            const ByteOffset end = r.LineEnd(row);
            if (o < end)
            {
                o = VimText::NextChar(r, o);
                return o == end ? 2 : 0;
            }
            if (row + 1 < r.LineCount()) { o = r.LineStart(row + 1); return 1; }
            return -1;
        }

        int DecPos(const Rope& r, ByteOffset& o)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
            if (o > r.LineStart(row)) { o = VimText::PrevChar(r, o); return 0; }
            if (row > 0) { o = r.LineEnd(row - 1); return 1; }
            return -1;
        }

        struct WordScan
        {
            const Rope& r;
            const VimCharClass& chars;
            bool big;

            [[nodiscard]] int Cls(ByteOffset o) const { return chars.Class(VimText::CodePointAt(r, o), big); }
            [[nodiscard]] bool OnEmptyLine(ByteOffset o) const
            {
                const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
                return r.LineStart(row) == r.LineEnd(row) && o == r.LineStart(row);
            }
            // vim skip_chars: true when the file's end/start was hit
            bool SkipChars(ByteOffset& o, int cls, bool forward) const
            {
                while (Cls(o) == cls)
                    if ((forward ? IncPos(r, o) : DecPos(r, o)) == -1) return true;
                return false;
            }
        };

        // vim fwd_word(count, bigword, eol): false = FAIL (the position may still have moved)
        bool FwdWord(const WordScan& w, ByteOffset& o, std::uint32_t count, bool eol)
        {
            while (count-- > 0)
            {
                const int sclass = w.Cls(o);
                const bool lastLine = VimText::RowOf(w.r, o) + 1 >= w.r.LineCount();
                int i = IncPos(w.r, o);
                if (i == -1 || (i >= 1 && lastLine)) return false;
                if (i >= 1 && eol && count == 0) return true;
                if (sclass != 0)
                    while (w.Cls(o) == sclass)
                    {
                        i = IncPos(w.r, o);
                        if (i == -1 || (i >= 1 && eol && count == 0)) return true;
                    }
                while (w.Cls(o) == 0)
                {
                    if (w.OnEmptyLine(o)) break;
                    i = IncPos(w.r, o);
                    if (i == -1 || (i >= 1 && eol && count == 0)) return true;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        // vim end_word(count, bigword, stop, empty)
        bool EndWord(const WordScan& w, ByteOffset& o, std::uint32_t count, bool stop, bool empty)
        {
            while (count-- > 0)
            {
                const int sclass = w.Cls(o);
                if (IncPos(w.r, o) == -1) return false;
                bool finished = false;
                if (w.Cls(o) == sclass && sclass != 0)
                {
                    if (w.SkipChars(o, sclass, true)) return false;
                }
                else if (!stop || sclass == 0)
                {
                    while (w.Cls(o) == 0)
                    {
                        if (empty && w.OnEmptyLine(o)) { finished = true; break; }
                        if (IncPos(w.r, o) == -1) return false;
                    }
                    if (!finished && w.SkipChars(o, w.Cls(o), true)) return false;
                }
                if (!finished) DecPos(w.r, o);   // overshot: one char back
                stop = false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // vim bck_word(count, bigword, stop)
        bool BckWord(const WordScan& w, ByteOffset& o, std::uint32_t count, bool stop)
        {
            while (count-- > 0)
            {
                const int sclass = w.Cls(o);
                if (DecPos(w.r, o) == -1) return false;
                bool finished = false;
                if (!stop || sclass == w.Cls(o) || sclass == 0)
                {
                    while (w.Cls(o) == 0)
                    {
                        if (w.OnEmptyLine(o)) { finished = true; break; }
                        if (DecPos(w.r, o) == -1) return true;   // the file's start: stop here
                    }
                    if (!finished && w.SkipChars(o, w.Cls(o), false)) return true;
                }
                if (!finished) IncPos(w.r, o);   // overshot: one char forward
                stop = false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // vim bckend_word(count, bigword, eol)
        bool BckEndWord(const WordScan& w, ByteOffset& o, std::uint32_t count, bool eol)
        {
            while (count-- > 0)
            {
                const int sclass = w.Cls(o);
                int i = DecPos(w.r, o);
                if (i == -1) return false;
                if (eol && i == 1) return true;
                if (sclass != 0)
                    while (w.Cls(o) == sclass)
                    {
                        i = DecPos(w.r, o);
                        if (i == -1 || (eol && i == 1)) return true;
                    }
                while (w.Cls(o) == 0)
                {
                    if (w.OnEmptyLine(o)) break;
                    i = DecPos(w.r, o);
                    if (i == -1 || (eol && i == 1)) return true;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        // vim adjust_cursor: never rest on a NUL past a non-empty line (outside Visual); the motion becomes inclusive
        void AdjustCursor(const VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, ByteOffset& o, MotionKind& kind)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            if (from >= o || IsVisual(ctx.mode)) return;
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
            if (o == r.LineEnd(row) && o > r.LineStart(row))
            {
                o = VimText::PrevChar(r, o);
                kind = MotionKind::Inclusive;
            }
        }

        // vim nv_wordcmd: w W e E (and cw = ce)
        std::optional<VimMotionTarget> WordCommand(const VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, const VimMotionArgs& a, bool big, bool wordEnd)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const WordScan w{ r, ctx.chars, big };
            MotionKind kind = wordEnd ? MotionKind::Inclusive : MotionKind::Exclusive;
            bool stop = false;
            if (!wordEnd && a.op == VimOperatorId::Change && !VimText::AtLineEnd(r, from))
            {
                const char32_t c = VimText::CodePointAt(r, from);
                if (c != U' ' && c != U'\t') { kind = MotionKind::Inclusive; wordEnd = true; stop = true; }   // cw = ce
            }
            ByteOffset o = from;
            const bool ok = wordEnd ? EndWord(w, o, a.Count1(), stop, false) : FwdWord(w, o, a.Count1(), a.op.has_value());
            AdjustCursor(ctx, from, o, kind);
            if (!ok && !a.op)
            {
                if (o == from) return std::nullopt;
                VimMotionTarget t{ o, kind };
                t.beep = true;
                return t;
            }
            return VimMotionTarget{ o, kind };
        }
```

### Task TE5a-10: f F t T ; , % and sentence / paragraph motions (spec s6.3 Motions)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.cpp` (TE5a-8/9: new helpers + `case`s)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimFindMotionsTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimGlobals::lastFind` (`VimFindState`, TE5a-5), `IncPos/DecPos/AdjustCursor` (TE5a-9), `VimDisplayRowSpan`, `VimLineTargetColumn` (TE5a-8).
- Produces: `ResolveMotion` cases `FindFwd FindBack TillFwd TillBack RepeatFind RepeatFindReverse MatchPair SentenceBack SentenceFwd ParagraphBack ParagraphFwd`; `bool VimUsesRegisterOne(VimMotionId)` (the motions vim deletes into `"1` even when small: `% ( ) { }` plus `` ` / ? n N``; TE5a-12 sets `VimOpArgs::forceNumbered` from it).

Neovim's `cpoptions` has no `;`, so `;`/`,` after `t`/`T` with count 1 skip the adjacent target (vim's `searchc`). `%` matches `()[]{}` with nesting across lines (Neovim's default `matchpairs`), starting from the first bracket at or after the cursor on the line; `{count}%` goes to that percentage of the file (linewise, nostartofline). Sentences and paragraphs are ports of vim's `findsent` and `findpar`; a paragraph or section boundary is an empty line or a form feed. Divergences (notes): `%` does not match `/* */` or `#if`/`#else`/`#endif` and ignores vim's quote heuristics; nroff macro lines (`.PP` ...) are not paragraph boundaries.

```cpp
    VimRig b("\xCB\x87" "zxzx", {}, {}, &shared);   // a split view shares the globals

}
```

```cpp
        // vim searchc: the count-th `c` on the cursor line; t/T stop one char short.
        std::optional<ByteOffset> FindChar(const Rope& r, ByteOffset from, char32_t c, bool forward, bool till,
                                           std::uint32_t count, bool skipFirst)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, from);
            const ByteOffset start = r.LineStart(row), end = r.LineEnd(row);
            ByteOffset o = from;
            bool stop = !skipFirst;
            while (count-- > 0)
            {
                for (;;)
                {
                    if (forward)
                    {
                        const ByteOffset n = VimText::NextChar(r, o);
                        if (n >= end) return std::nullopt;
                        o = n;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (o <= start) return std::nullopt;
                        o = VimText::PrevChar(r, o);
                    }
                    if (stop && VimText::CodePointAt(r, o) == c) break;
                    stop = true;
                }
            }
            if (till) o = forward ? VimText::PrevChar(r, o) : VimText::NextChar(r, o);
            return o;
        }

        std::optional<VimMotionTarget> Find(VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, VimMotionId id, char32_t c,
                                            std::uint32_t count, bool repeat)
        {
            const bool forward = id == VimMotionId::FindFwd || id == VimMotionId::TillFwd;
            const bool till = id == VimMotionId::TillFwd || id == VimMotionId::TillBack;
            const bool skipFirst = repeat && till && count == 1;   // Neovim cpoptions has no ';'
            const auto o = FindChar(ctx.Text(), from, c, forward, till, count, skipFirst);
            if (!o) return std::nullopt;
            return VimMotionTarget{ *o, forward ? MotionKind::Inclusive : MotionKind::Exclusive };
        }

        VimMotionId Reverse(VimMotionId id)
        {
            switch (id)
            {
            case VimMotionId::FindFwd:  return VimMotionId::FindBack;
            case VimMotionId::FindBack: return VimMotionId::FindFwd;
            case VimMotionId::TillFwd:  return VimMotionId::TillBack;
            default:                    return VimMotionId::TillFwd;
            }
        }

        bool IsOpenBracket(char ch) { return ch == '(' || ch == '[' || ch == '{'; }
        bool IsCloseBracket(char ch) { return ch == ')' || ch == ']' || ch == '}'; }
        char Partner(char ch)
        {
            switch (ch)
            {
            case '(': return ')'; case ')': return '(';
            case '[': return ']'; case ']': return '[';
            case '{': return '}'; default:  return '{';
            }
        }

        // vim findmatch over matchpairs "(:),{:},[:]": the first bracket at or after the cursor on its line,
        // then its partner with nesting, across lines (line by line; brackets are ASCII so UTF-8 is safe).
        std::optional<ByteOffset> MatchBracket(const Rope& r, ByteOffset from)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, from);
            const std::string line = VimText::Line(r, row);
            std::size_t col = static_cast<std::size_t>(from - r.LineStart(row));
            while (col < line.size() && !IsOpenBracket(line[col]) && !IsCloseBracket(line[col])) ++col;
            if (col >= line.size()) return std::nullopt;
            const char open = line[col], want = Partner(open);
            const bool forward = IsOpenBracket(open);
            int depth = 0;
            std::uint32_t at = row;
            std::string text = line;
            std::int64_t c = static_cast<std::int64_t>(col);
            for (;;)
            {
                c += forward ? 1 : -1;
                while (c < 0 || c >= static_cast<std::int64_t>(text.size()))
                {
                    if (forward ? at + 1 >= r.LineCount() : at == 0) return std::nullopt;
                    at = forward ? at + 1 : at - 1;
                    text = VimText::Line(r, at);
                    c = forward ? 0 : static_cast<std::int64_t>(text.size()) - 1;
                    if (text.empty()) c = forward ? 0 : -1;
                    if (text.empty()) continue;
                }
                const char ch = text[static_cast<std::size_t>(c)];
                if (ch == open) ++depth;
                else if (ch == want)
                {
                    if (depth == 0) return r.LineStart(at) + static_cast<ByteOffset>(c);
                    --depth;
                }
            }
        }

        bool IsWhite(char32_t c) { return c == U' ' || c == U'\t'; }
        bool InSet(char32_t c, std::u32string_view set) { return c != 0 && set.find(c) != std::u32string_view::npos; }

        // gchar_pos: NUL (0) at a line end
        char32_t CharAt(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o) { return VimText::AtLineEnd(r, o) ? 0 : VimText::CodePointAt(r, o); }

        // vim incl()/decl(): inc/dec that never rest on the NUL of a non-empty line
        int Incl(const Rope& r, ByteOffset& o)
        {
            int i = IncPos(r, o);
            if (i >= 1 && o != r.LineStart(VimText::RowOf(r, o))) i = IncPos(r, o);
            return i;
        }
        int Decl(const Rope& r, ByteOffset& o)
        {
            int i = DecPos(r, o);
            if (i == 1 && o != r.LineStart(VimText::RowOf(r, o))) i = DecPos(r, o);
            return i;
        }

        // vim startPS(lnum, NUL, FALSE): an empty line or a form feed starts a paragraph/section
        bool StartsParagraph(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row)
        {
            return r.LineStart(row) == r.LineEnd(row) || VimText::CodePointAt(r, r.LineStart(row)) == U'\f';
        }

        // vim findsent(dir, count)
        std::optional<ByteOffset> FindSentence(const Rope& r, ByteOffset pos, bool forward, std::uint32_t count)
        {
            const auto step = [&](ByteOffset& o) { return forward ? Incl(r, o) : Decl(r, o); };
            const auto rowStart = [&](ByteOffset o) { return o == r.LineStart(VimText::RowOf(r, o)); };
            bool noskip = false;
            while (count-- > 0)
            {
                bool found = false;
                if (CharAt(r, pos) == 0)
                {
                    do
                        if (step(pos) == -1) break;
                    while (CharAt(r, pos) == 0);
                    if (forward) found = true;
                }
                else if (forward && rowStart(pos) && StartsParagraph(r, VimText::RowOf(r, pos)))
                {
                    const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, pos);
                    if (row + 1 >= r.LineCount()) return std::nullopt;
                    pos = r.LineStart(row + 1);
                    found = true;
                }
                else if (!forward)
                    Decl(r, pos);

                if (!found)
                {
                    bool foundDot = false;   // back to the previous non-white non-punctuation char
                    for (;;)
                    {
                        const char32_t c = CharAt(r, pos);
                        if (!(IsWhite(c) || InSet(c, U".!?)]\"'"))) break;
                        ByteOffset t = pos;
                        if (Decl(r, t) == -1) break;
                        const std::uint32_t trow = VimText::RowOf(r, t);
                        if (forward && r.LineStart(trow) == r.LineEnd(trow)) break;
                        if (foundDot) break;
                        if (InSet(c, U".!?")) foundDot = true;
                        if (InSet(c, U")]\"'") && !InSet(CharAt(r, t), U".!?)]\"'")) break;
                        Decl(r, pos);
                    }
                    const std::uint32_t startRow = VimText::RowOf(r, pos);
                    for (;;)   // the end of the sentence
                    {
                        const char32_t c = CharAt(r, pos);
                        if (c == 0 || (rowStart(pos) && StartsParagraph(r, VimText::RowOf(r, pos))))
                        {
                            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, pos);
                            if (!forward && row != startRow) pos = r.LineStart(row + 1);
                            break;
                        }
                        if (c == U'.' || c == U'!' || c == U'?')
                        {
                            ByteOffset t = pos;
                            bool hitEnd = false;
                            char32_t after = 0;
                            do
                            {
                                if (IncPos(r, t) == -1) { hitEnd = true; break; }
                                after = CharAt(r, t);
                            } while (InSet(after, U")]\"'"));
                            if (hitEnd || IsWhite(after) || after == 0)
                            {
                                pos = t;
                                if (CharAt(r, pos) == 0) IncPos(r, pos);   // skip the NUL at the line end
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (step(pos) == -1)
                        {
                            if (count) return std::nullopt;
                            noskip = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                while (!noskip && IsWhite(CharAt(r, pos)))   // found: skip white space
                    if (Incl(r, pos) == -1) break;
            }
            return pos;
        }

        // vim findpar(&incl, dir, count, NUL, FALSE); returns {offset, inclusive}
        std::optional<std::pair<ByteOffset, bool>> FindParagraph(const VimContext& ctx, std::uint32_t row, bool forward,
                                                                 std::uint32_t count)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const std::int64_t last = r.LineCount() - 1, dir = forward ? 1 : -1;
            std::int64_t curr = row;
            const auto empty = [&](std::int64_t l) { return r.LineStart(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(l)) == r.LineEnd(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(l)); };
            while (count-- > 0)
            {
                bool didSkip = false;
                for (bool first = true;; first = false)
                {
                    if (!empty(curr)) didSkip = true;
                    bool foldSkipped = false;
                    if (first)
                    {
                        const VimRowSpan s = VimDisplayRowSpan(ctx, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(curr));
                        if (s.last > s.first) { curr = (forward ? std::int64_t(s.last) : std::int64_t(s.first)) + dir; foldSkipped = true; }
                    }
                    if (!first && didSkip && StartsParagraph(r, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(curr))) break;
                    if (foldSkipped) curr -= dir;
                    curr += dir;
                    if (curr < 0 || curr > last)
                    {
                        if (count) return std::nullopt;
                        curr -= dir;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            const std::uint32_t target = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(curr);
            if (target == static_cast<std::uint32_t>(last) && forward && !empty(curr))
                return std::pair{ VimText::PrevChar(r, r.LineEnd(target)), true };   // the last char, inclusive
            return std::pair{ r.LineStart(target), false };
        }
```

```cpp
    bool VimUsesRegisterOne(VimMotionId id)
    {
        switch (id)
        {
        case VimMotionId::MatchPair:
        case VimMotionId::SentenceBack: case VimMotionId::SentenceFwd:
        case VimMotionId::ParagraphBack: case VimMotionId::ParagraphFwd:
        case VimMotionId::MarkExact:
        case VimMotionId::SearchFwd: case VimMotionId::SearchBack:
        case VimMotionId::SearchNext: case VimMotionId::SearchPrev:
        case VimMotionId::SearchWordFwd: case VimMotionId::SearchWordBack:        // * # g* g# run through vim's normal_search
        case VimMotionId::SearchPartialFwd: case VimMotionId::SearchPartialBack:
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
        }
    }
```

### Task TE5a-11: H M L, scrolling and scrolloff -- Ctrl-D Ctrl-U Ctrl-F Ctrl-B Ctrl-E Ctrl-Y zz zt zb (spec s6.3 Motions, s6.4 scrolloff, s6.6)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.cpp` (TE5a-8..10: `ScreenTop/ScreenMiddle/ScreenBottom` cases)
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimScroll.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (TE5a-5: declare `Scroll`, `ScrollToCursor`, two members)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp` (TE5a-5: `VimState::HandleKey` calls `ScrollToCursor`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp` (TE5a-5: the scroll `case`s in `RunAction`)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimScrollTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `IVimHost::FirstVisibleRow/VisibleRows/ScrollToRow` (TE5a-5; vim's host hooks, in display rows -- in the editor TE5a-22's `VimViewAdapter` implements them as `view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow()`, `view.VisibleRowCount()` and `view.SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow(row)` (TE4-9; the new top is pending until the next `Draw` and `FirstVisibleDisplayRow()` reads it back at once, so a second scroll in the same frame builds on the first); the rig's `FakeVimHost` stores `firstRow`/`rows`), `DisplayMap`, `VimText::SyncDisplay` (TE5a-2), `VimLineTargetColumn` (TE5a-8), `VimOptions::scrolloff/startofline`.
- Produces: `ResolveMotion` cases `ScreenTop ScreenMiddle ScreenBottom`; `void VimState::Scroll(const VimParsed&)` (actions `ScrollHalfDown ScrollHalfUp ScrollPageDown ScrollPageUp ScrollLineDown ScrollLineUp ScrollCenter ScrollTop ScrollBottom`); `void VimState::ScrollToCursor()` (keeps the primary cursor `scrolloff` display rows inside the viewport after every key, only when the cursor moved); members `ByteOffset m_lastScrollHead`, `bool m_scrollTracked`. TE5a-20 routes the Normal/Visual Ctrl chords to these actions; TE5d-1 makes `scrolloff` a setting.

Rows are display rows (the host viewport is in display rows, spec s3.6). `Ctrl-D`/`Ctrl-U` scroll half a window (a count sets the amount for that command; vim also stores it in `'scroll'` -- a documented divergence) and move every cursor by the same number of rows, never past the buffer's ends; `Ctrl-D` stops scrolling once the last line is at the bottom, `Ctrl-F` lets the last line reach the top, as vim does. `H`/`L` respect `scrolloff` unless an operator is pending; `M` is the middle of the rows actually shown. With `nostartofline` every one of them keeps the goal column.

```cpp
using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    std::string Lines(int n)   // "0\n1\n...", the cursor on line 0
    {
        std::string s = "\xCB\x87";
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) s += std::to_string(i) + (i + 1 < n ? "\n" : "");
        return s;
    }
    std::uint32_t CursorRow(const VimRig& r)
    {

    }

TEST_CASE("vim scroll: Ctrl-D/U move the view and the cursor half a window", "[text-vim-scroll]")
{
    VimRig r(Lines(40));
    r.host.rows = 10;
    r.Keys("<C-d>");
    CHECK(r.host.firstRow == 5u);
    CHECK(CursorRow(r) == 5u);
    r.Keys("<C-u>");
    CHECK(r.host.firstRow == 0u);
    CHECK(CursorRow(r) == 0u);
    r.Keys("3<C-d>");
    CHECK(CursorRow(r) == 3u);
}

TEST_CASE("vim scroll: Ctrl-F/B page by a window minus two; Ctrl-E/Y by lines", "[text-vim-scroll]")
{
    VimRig r(Lines(40));
    r.host.rows = 10;
    r.Keys("<C-f>");
    CHECK(r.host.firstRow == 8u);
    CHECK(CursorRow(r) == 8u);
    r.Keys("<C-b>");
    CHECK(r.host.firstRow == 0u);
    CHECK(CursorRow(r) == 8u);                       // still on screen: stays
    r.Keys("gg<C-e>");
    CHECK(r.host.firstRow == 1u);
    CHECK(CursorRow(r) == 1u);                       // pushed down with the top line
    r.Keys("<C-y>");
    CHECK(r.host.firstRow == 0u);

    o.scrolloff = 2;
    VimRig r(Lines(40), {}, o);
    r.host.rows = 10;
    r.Keys("9j");
    CHECK(r.host.firstRow == 2u);                    // row 9 with 2 rows below it visible
    r.Keys("H");
    CHECK(CursorRow(r) == 4u);                       // H stays scrolloff rows below the top
}
```

```cpp
            t.jump = true;
            if (!ctx.options.startofline) t.goal = GoalOf(ctx, from, goal);
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimScroll.cpp
// Scrolling (spec s6.3, s6.6 Normal/Visual column): the viewport is the host's,
// in display rows (spec s3.6). Every cursor moves by the same number of rows;
// with nostartofline (Neovim) they keep their goal column.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    void VimState::Scroll(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const DisplayMap& dm = m_doc.display;
        const VimActionId id = p.Id<VimActionId>();
        const std::uint32_t rows = std::max(1u, m_host.VisibleRows());
        const std::uint32_t total = dm.DisplayRowCount();
        const std::uint32_t top = std::min(m_host.FirstVisibleRow(), total - 1);
        const std::uint32_t so = std::min(m_options.scrolloff, (rows - 1) / 2);
        const std::uint32_t page = rows > 2 ? rows - 2 : 1;
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        const VimCursor primary = ToVim(sels[VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc)]);
        const std::uint32_t cur = dm.BufferRowToDisplay(VimText::RowOf(r, primary.head));
        std::uint32_t newTop = top;
        std::int64_t delta = 0;
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> lineTarget;   // zz/zt/zb with a count: that buffer line first

        switch (id)
        {
        case VimActionId::ScrollHalfDown:
        {
            if (cur + 1 >= total) { Beep(); return; }
            const std::uint32_t amount = p.count ? p.count : std::max(1u, rows / 2);
            const std::uint32_t maxTop = total > rows ? total - rows : 0;
            newTop = std::max(top, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(std::uint64_t(top) + amount, maxTop)));
            delta = std::min<std::int64_t>(amount, std::int64_t(total) - 1 - cur);
            break;
        }
        case VimActionId::ScrollHalfUp:
        {
            if (cur == 0) { Beep(); return; }
            const std::uint32_t amount = p.count ? p.count : std::max(1u, rows / 2);
            newTop = top > amount ? top - amount : 0;
            delta = -std::min<std::int64_t>(amount, cur);
            break;
        }
        case VimActionId::ScrollPageDown:
        {
            if (top + 1 >= total) { Beep(); return; }
            newTop = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(std::uint64_t(top) + std::uint64_t(page) * p.Count1(), total - 1));
            const std::uint32_t minRow = std::min(newTop + so, total - 1);
            delta = cur < minRow ? std::int64_t(minRow) - cur : 0;
            break;
        }
        case VimActionId::ScrollPageUp:
        {
            if (top == 0) { Beep(); return; }
            const std::uint64_t back = std::uint64_t(page) * p.Count1();
            newTop = top > back ? static_cast<std::uint32_t>(top - back) : 0;
            const std::uint32_t maxRow = newTop + rows - 1 - so;
            delta = cur > maxRow ? -(std::int64_t(cur) - maxRow) : 0;
            break;
        }
        case VimActionId::ScrollLineDown:
        {
            newTop = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(std::uint64_t(top) + p.Count1(), total - 1));
            const std::uint32_t minRow = std::min(newTop + so, total - 1);
            delta = cur < minRow ? std::int64_t(minRow) - cur : 0;
            break;
        }
        case VimActionId::ScrollLineUp:
        {
            newTop = top > p.Count1() ? top - p.Count1() : 0;
            const std::uint32_t maxRow = newTop + rows - 1 - so;
            delta = cur > maxRow ? -(std::int64_t(cur) - maxRow) : 0;
            break;
        }
        case VimActionId::ScrollCenter:
        case VimActionId::ScrollTop:
        case VimActionId::ScrollBottom:
        {
            std::uint32_t c = cur;
            if (p.count)
            {
                lineTarget = std::min(p.count - 1, r.LineCount() - 1);
                c = dm.BufferRowToDisplay(*lineTarget);
            }
            if (id == VimActionId::ScrollTop)         newTop = c > so ? c - so : 0;
            else if (id == VimActionId::ScrollBottom) newTop = c + 1 + so > rows ? c + 1 + so - rows : 0;
            else                                      newTop = c > rows / 2 ? c - rows / 2 : 0;
            break;
        }
        default:
            return;
        }

        m_host.ScrollToRow(newTop);
        if (delta == 0 && !lineTarget) return;
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const VimCursor c = ToVim(s);
            std::uint32_t row = 0;
            if (lineTarget) row = *lineTarget;
            else
            {
                const std::int64_t d = std::clamp<std::int64_t>(std::int64_t(dm.BufferRowToDisplay(VimText::RowOf(r, c.head))) + delta,
                                                               0, std::int64_t(total) - 1);
                row = dm.DisplayRowToBuffer(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(d));
            }
            const std::uint32_t goal = s.goalColumn.value_or(VimText::VirtualColumn(r, c.head, m_options.tabSize));
            const ByteOffset o = VimLineTargetColumn(ctx, row, c.head, goal);
            s = FromVim(VimCursor{ IsVisual(m_mode) ? c.anchor : o, o },
                        m_options.startofline ? std::nullopt : std::optional<std::uint32_t>(goal), s.id);
        }
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::ScrollToCursor()
    {
        const auto all = m_doc.selections.All();
        if (all.empty()) return;
        const ByteOffset head = ToVim(all[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()]).head;
        if (m_scrollTracked && head == m_lastScrollHead) return;   // only when the cursor moved
        m_scrollTracked = true;
        m_lastScrollHead = head;
        const DisplayMap& dm = m_doc.display;
        const std::uint32_t rows = std::max(1u, m_host.VisibleRows());
        const std::uint32_t total = dm.DisplayRowCount();
        const std::uint32_t top = m_host.FirstVisibleRow();
        const std::uint32_t so = std::min(m_options.scrolloff, (rows - 1) / 2);
        const std::uint32_t d = dm.BufferRowToDisplay(VimText::RowOf(m_doc.buffer.Text(), head));
        std::uint32_t newTop = top;
        if (d < top + so)
            newTop = d > so ? d - so : 0;
        else if (d + so >= top + rows)
        {
            // never past the buffer's end for scrolloff alone, but always far enough to show the cursor
            const std::uint32_t maxTop = total > rows ? total - rows : 0;
            const std::uint32_t showCursor = d + 1 >= rows ? d + 1 - rows : 0;
            newTop = std::max(top, std::min(d + so + 1 - rows, std::max(maxTop, showCursor)));
        }
        if (newTop != top) m_host.ScrollToRow(newTop);
    }
}
```

### Task TE5a-12: Operators d c y, registers (minimal), x X D C s S Y, p P gp gP (spec s6.1 p/P rules, s6.2, s6.3 Operators/Registers)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimPut.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobals.hpp` (TE5a-5: `VimGlobals` gains `registers`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExecute.cpp` (TE5a-8: add `ExecuteOperator`, `VisualTargets`, `ExitVisual`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (TE5a-5: declarations)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp` (TE5a-8: `VimState::Execute`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp` (TE5a-5/11: new `case`s in `RunAction`)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimCases.cpp` (TE5a-6: `RunVimCase` runs the `setreg:`/`reg:` columns)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimOperatorsTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ResolveMotion`, `VimMotionArgsOf`, `VimUsesRegisterOne`, `VimDisplayRowSpan` (TE5a-8..10), `VimCursorModel::*` (TE5a-2), `BeginInsertSession/EndInsertSession/MarkInsertStart` (TE5a-5).
- Produces (contract names, plus the additive members listed):
  - `VimRegisters.hpp`: `enum class VimRegisterKind`, `struct VimRegisterValue { parts; kind; Text(); }`, `enum class VimRegisterOp { Yank, Delete, SmallDelete }`, `class VimRegisters { Store; Get; SetSpecial; List; IsValidName; }` exactly as the contract, plus additive `void Preload(char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value)` (vim's `setreg()`/`:let @a=`: writes the register without moving the unnamed pointer -- the `.vimcases` `setreg:` column). Minimal rules here: `0` for unnamed yanks, `-` for small deletes, `1` for other deletes (no 1..9 shift yet), `a-z` (named delete also lands in `1`), `_` black hole, `.`/`:`/`/` via `SetSpecial`. TE5b-1 completes the rules behind the same API.
  - `VimGlobals::registers`.
  - `VimOperators.hpp`: `struct VimOpTarget`, `struct VimOpArgs`, `VimOpOutcome RunOperator(...)` as the contract; `VimOpOutcome` gains additive `bool failed = false; bool autoIndentPending = false; std::string message;` (an operator that cannot run -- gc without a comment string -- and cc's autoindent). Helpers: `VimOpTarget VimLinewiseTarget(const Rope&, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow, std::uint32_t cursorId, ByteOffset origin)` (**linewise targets use the content form `[LineStart(first), LineEnd(last))`**; `RunOperator` expands to `LinewiseDeleteRange` itself, and also accepts the delete form when it is unambiguous), `struct VimRowRange { first, last; }`, `VimRowRange VimLinewiseRows(const Rope&, ByteRange)`, `enum class VimCaretRule`, `struct VimCaretPlan`, `void VimApplyWithCarets(VimContext&, std::vector<EditOp>, const std::vector<VimCaretPlan>&, bool clampNormal)` (apply once, then place every cursor on the NEW text), `ByteOffset VimOperatorStartCursor(const VimContext&, const VimOpTarget&)` (vim's `oap->start`: yank/case/comment cursor).
  - `VimState::ExecuteOperator(const VimParsed&)`, `std::vector<VimOpTarget> VimState::VisualTargets() const`, `void VimState::ExitVisual()`, `void VimState::Put(const VimParsed&, bool after, bool cursorAfterText)`, `void VimState::PutOverVisual(const VimParsed&, const VimRegisterValue&)`.

Every operator builds ONE `EditOp` list for all cursors (sorted, overlapping targets of two cursors collapse into one) and applies it once (spec s2.1, s6.2), so `u` undoes it in one step and multi-cursor composes. Cursor placement is vim's: a charwise delete leaves the cursor at the range start; a linewise `d`/`dd` with `nostartofline` restores the old screen column (vim's `old_col` after `OP_DELETE`); `c` enters Insert at the range start, and a linewise change keeps the first line's indent and arms the autoindent removal (vim `did_ai`); a yank moves the cursor to vim's `oap->start`. `do_pending_operator`'s exclusive rule is applied to every exclusive charwise motion: ending in column 0 of a later line, the end moves to the previous line's end (inclusive), or the motion becomes linewise when it started at or before the first non-blank. Register kinds: linewise text always ends with `\n`; a delete that is not linewise, stays on one line and is not one of vim's `use_reg_one` motions is a small delete. TE5a-16 (Part B) replaces the text-object branch of `ExecuteOperator`; Visual targets follow the contract (Visual: the inclusive editor selection; VisualLine: whole rows; VisualBlock: one inclusive piece per row, a block change keeps one cursor per piece so the typed text lands on every row).

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimOperatorsTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp"

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

namespace
{
    VimRegisterValue Chars(std::string s) { return VimRegisterValue{ { std::move(s) }, VimRegisterKind::Charwise }; }
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: yank -> 0, small delete -> -, delete -> 1, named, black hole", "[text-vim-operators]")
{
    Arcane::Test::FakeVimHost host;
    const VimOptions o;
    VimRegisters regs;
    regs.Store(0, Chars("y"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, host, o);
    CHECK(regs.Get(U'0', host, o)->Text() == "y");
    CHECK(regs.Get(0, host, o)->Text() == "y");                      // unnamed points at the last write
    regs.Store(0, Chars("s"), VimRegisterOp::SmallDelete, host, o);
    CHECK(regs.Get(U'-', host, o)->Text() == "s");
    CHECK(regs.Get(U'"', host, o)->Text() == "s");
    regs.Store(0, VimRegisterValue{ { "l\n" }, VimRegisterKind::Linewise }, VimRegisterOp::Delete, host, o);
    CHECK(regs.Get(U'1', host, o)->kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise);
    regs.Store(U'a', Chars("n"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, host, o);
    CHECK(regs.Get(U'a', host, o)->Text() == "n");
    CHECK(regs.Get(0, host, o)->Text() == "n");
    CHECK(regs.Get(U'0', host, o)->Text() == "y");                   // a named yank leaves "0 alone
    regs.Store(U'_', Chars("gone"), VimRegisterOp::Delete, host, o);
    CHECK(regs.Get(0, host, o)->Text() == "n");
    regs.Preload(U'b', Chars("p"));
    CHECK(regs.Get(0, host, o)->Text() == "n");                      // setreg() does not move the unnamed register
    regs.SetSpecial(U'/', "pat");
    CHECK(regs.Get(U'/', host, o)->Text() == "pat");
    CHECK_FALSE(regs.Get(U'z', host, o).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE("vim operators: one edit for every cursor, one undo step", "[text-vim-operators]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "foo bar\n\xCB\x87" "baz qux");
    r.Keys("dw");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "bar\n\xCB\x87" "qux");
    REQUIRE(r.Commands().Undo());
    CHECK(r.Text() == "foo bar\nbaz qux");
}

TEST_CASE("vim operators: a multi-cursor yank stores one part per cursor", "[text-vim-operators]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "ab\n\xCB\x87" "cd");
    r.Keys("yl");
    const auto v = r.Globals().registers.Get(0, r.host, r.vim->Options());
    REQUIRE(v.has_value());
    REQUIRE(v->parts.size() == 2u);
    CHECK(v->parts[0] == "a");
    CHECK(v->parts[1] == "c");
}

TEST_CASE("vim operators: a change of several cursors types at each", "[text-vim-operators]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "foo x\n\xCB\x87" "bar y");
    r.Keys("cwZ<Esc>");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "Z x\n\xCB\x87" "Z y");
    REQUIRE(r.Commands().Undo());                                  // the delete and the typing are one step
    CHECK(r.Text() == "foo x\nbar y");
}

TEST_CASE("vim put: an empty register beeps with E353", "[text-vim-operators]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a");
    r.Keys("\"zp");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(r.host.messages.empty());
    CHECK(r.host.messages.back().first == "E353: Nothing in register z");
    CHECK(r.Text() == "a");
}

TEST_CASE("vim put: a block register pads its rows", "[text-vim-operators]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "xy\nz");
    r.Globals().registers.Preload(U'a', VimRegisterValue{ { "ab", "c" }, VimRegisterKind::Blockwise });
    r.Keys("\"aP");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "abxy\nc z");
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim registers (spec s6.3 Registers). TE5a-12 implements the core rules
// ("0 yank, "- small delete, "1 delete, a-z, "_, the read-only . : /); TE5b-1
// completes them (1-9 shift, A-Z append, + * clipboard, useSystemClipboard,
// %, multi-cursor paste distribution) behind this same API.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimHost.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class VimRegisterKind : std::uint8_t { Charwise, Linewise, Blockwise };

    struct VimRegisterValue
    {
        std::vector<std::string> parts;               // >1: one per cursor or per block line; Linewise parts end with '\n'
        VimRegisterKind kind = VimRegisterKind::Charwise;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string Text() const;       // Linewise: parts concatenated; otherwise joined with '\n'
        bool operator==(const VimRegisterValue&) const = default;
    };

    enum class VimRegisterOp : std::uint8_t { Yank, Delete, SmallDelete };

    class VimRegisters
    {
    public:
        void Store(char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value, VimRegisterOp op, IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options);
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<VimRegisterValue> Get(char32_t name, IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options) const;
        void SetSpecial(char32_t name, std::string text);
        void Preload(char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value);   // setreg(): the unnamed register keeps pointing where it did
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, VimRegisterValue>> List(IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options) const;
        [[nodiscard]] static bool IsValidName(char32_t c);

    private:
        std::map<char32_t, VimRegisterValue> m_regs;
        std::map<char32_t, std::string> m_special;    // . : /
        char32_t m_unnamed = U'0';                    // the register " shows
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::string VimRegisterValue::Text() const
    {
        std::string out;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < parts.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (i > 0 && kind != VimRegisterKind::Linewise) out.push_back('\n');
            out += parts[i];
        }
        return out;
    }

    bool VimRegisters::IsValidName(char32_t c)
    {
        if ((c >= U'a' && c <= U'z') || (c >= U'A' && c <= U'Z') || (c >= U'0' && c <= U'9')) return true;
        return c == U'"' || c == U'-' || c == U'_' || c == U'+' || c == U'*' || c == U'/' || c == U':' || c == U'.' || c == U'%';
    }

    void VimRegisters::Store(char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value, VimRegisterOp op, IVimHost&, const VimOptions&)
    {
        if (name == U'_') return;                                           // the black hole
        if (name >= U'a' && name <= U'z')
        {
            if (op == VimRegisterOp::Delete) m_regs[U'1'] = value;          // vim: a big delete also lands in "1
            m_regs[name] = std::move(value);
            m_unnamed = name;
            return;
        }
        if (name != 0 && name != U'"') return;                              // A-Z, + and * arrive with TE5b-1
        switch (op)
        {
        case VimRegisterOp::Yank:        m_regs[U'0'] = std::move(value); m_unnamed = U'0'; break;
        case VimRegisterOp::SmallDelete: m_regs[U'-'] = std::move(value); m_unnamed = U'-'; break;
        case VimRegisterOp::Delete:      m_regs[U'1'] = std::move(value); m_unnamed = U'1'; break;
        }
    }

    std::optional<VimRegisterValue> VimRegisters::Get(char32_t name, IVimHost&, const VimOptions&) const
    {
        if (name == 0 || name == U'"') name = m_unnamed;
        if (const auto s = m_special.find(name); s != m_special.end())
            return VimRegisterValue{ { s->second }, VimRegisterKind::Charwise };
        if (const auto it = m_regs.find(name); it != m_regs.end()) return it->second;
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    void VimRegisters::SetSpecial(char32_t name, std::string text) { m_special[name] = std::move(text); }

    void VimRegisters::Preload(char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value) { m_regs[name] = std::move(value); }

    std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, VimRegisterValue>> VimRegisters::List(IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options) const
    {
        std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, VimRegisterValue>> out;
        std::u32string order = U"\"0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-.:/";
        for (const char32_t c : order)
            if (const auto v = Get(c, host, options)) out.emplace_back(c, *v);
        return out;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim operators (spec s6.2): every operator = expand each selection by the
// motion / object (VimState::ExecuteOperator), then ONE EditOp list for all
// cursors through VimText (TextCommands). Cursor placement runs on the new
// text (VimApplyWithCarets).

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimContext.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp"

#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimOpTarget
    {
        ByteRange range;                               // FINAL editor range; Linewise: [LineStart(first), LineEnd(last))
        MotionKind kind = MotionKind::Exclusive;
        bool block = false;
        std::uint32_t cursorId = 0;
        ByteOffset origin = 0;                         // the cursor's head before the operator
    };

    struct VimOpArgs
    {
        char32_t reg = 0;
        std::uint32_t count = 0;
        bool fromVisual = false;
        bool forceNumbered = false;                    // vim use_reg_one
    };

    struct VimOpOutcome
    {
        bool enterInsert = false;
        bool failed = false;                           // nothing changed; VimState beeps with `message`
        bool autoIndentPending = false;                // cc kept an indent: Esc with nothing typed removes it
        std::string message;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] VimOpOutcome RunOperator(VimContext& ctx, VimOperatorId op, std::span<const VimOpTarget> targets, const VimOpArgs& args);

    [[nodiscard]] VimOpTarget VimLinewiseTarget(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow,
                                                std::uint32_t cursorId, ByteOffset origin);
    struct VimRowRange { std::uint32_t first = 0, last = 0; };
    [[nodiscard]] VimRowRange VimLinewiseRows(const Rope& r, ByteRange range);
    [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset VimOperatorStartCursor(const VimContext& ctx, const VimOpTarget& t);

    enum class VimCaretRule : std::uint8_t
    {
        AtOffset,                 // the mapped offset
        BeforeMapped,             // one char before the mapped offset (the last char of inserted text)
        RowColumn,                // the mapped offset's row, at `vcol`
        RowFirstNonBlank,         // the mapped offset's row, first non-blank
        NextRowFirstNonBlank,     // the row after the mapped offset's, first non-blank
        Exact,                    // the mapped offset, never clamped (Insert)
    };
    struct VimCaretPlan
    {
        std::uint32_t id = 0;
        ByteOffset at = 0;        // a PRE-edit offset, mapped through the ops with `bias`
        Bias bias = Bias::Left;
        VimCaretRule rule = VimCaretRule::AtOffset;
        std::uint32_t vcol = 0;
        std::uint32_t plusBytes = 0;   // added after mapping, never past the mapped row's end (J's join column, gc's cursor column)
    };
    void VimApplyWithCarets(VimContext& ctx, std::vector<EditOp> ops, const std::vector<VimCaretPlan>& plans, bool clampNormal);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        VimRegisterKind KindOf(const VimOpTarget& t)
        {
            if (t.block) return VimRegisterKind::Blockwise;
            return t.kind == MotionKind::Linewise ? VimRegisterKind::Linewise : VimRegisterKind::Charwise;
        }

        std::string Extract(const Rope& r, ByteRange range)
        {
            std::string s;
            r.CopyTo(range, s);
            return s;
        }

        VimOpOutcome DeleteOrChange(VimContext& ctx, bool change, std::span<const VimOpTarget> targets, const VimOpArgs& args)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const bool block = targets.front().block;
            VimRegisterValue reg;
            reg.kind = KindOf(targets.front());
            std::vector<EditOp> ops;
            std::vector<VimCaretPlan> plans;
            VimOpOutcome out;
            out.enterInsert = change;
            bool multiLine = false;
            for (const VimOpTarget& t : targets)
            {
                EditOp op;
                std::string part;
                VimCaretPlan plan;
                plan.id = t.cursorId;
                if (t.kind == MotionKind::Linewise && !t.block)
                {
                    const VimRowRange rows = VimLinewiseRows(r, t.range);
                    part = VimCursorModel::LinewiseText(r, rows.first, rows.last);
                    if (change)
                    {
                        const ByteOffset keep = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, rows.first);   // autoindent: keep the indent
                        op = EditOp{ ByteRange{ keep, r.LineEnd(rows.last) }, "" };
                        plan.at = keep;
                        plan.rule = VimCaretRule::Exact;
                        out.autoIndentPending = keep > r.LineStart(rows.first);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        op = EditOp{ VimCursorModel::LinewiseDeleteRange(r, rows.first, rows.last), "" };
                        plan.at = op.range.begin;
                        plan.rule = VimCaretRule::RowColumn;   // nostartofline: vim restores old_col
                        plan.vcol = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, t.origin, ctx.options.tabSize);
                    }
                    multiLine = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    part = Extract(r, t.range);
                    if (part.find('\n') != std::string::npos) multiLine = true;
                    op = EditOp{ t.range, "" };
                    plan.at = t.range.begin;
                    plan.rule = change ? VimCaretRule::Exact : VimCaretRule::AtOffset;
                }
                if (!ops.empty() && op.range.begin < ops.back().range.end) continue;   // two cursors, one range
                ops.push_back(std::move(op));
                reg.parts.push_back(std::move(part));
                if (!block || change || plans.empty()) plans.push_back(plan);       // a deleted block keeps its top-left
            }
            const VimRegisterOp kind = (reg.kind == VimRegisterKind::Charwise && !multiLine && !args.forceNumbered)
                                           ? VimRegisterOp::SmallDelete : VimRegisterOp::Delete;
            ctx.globals.registers.Store(args.reg, std::move(reg), kind, ctx.host, ctx.options);
            VimApplyWithCarets(ctx, std::move(ops), plans, !change);
            return out;
        }

        VimOpOutcome Yank(VimContext& ctx, std::span<const VimOpTarget> targets, const VimOpArgs& args)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            VimRegisterValue reg;
            reg.kind = KindOf(targets.front());
            std::vector<Selection> after;
            for (const VimOpTarget& t : targets)
            {
                if (t.kind == MotionKind::Linewise && !t.block)
                {
                    const VimRowRange rows = VimLinewiseRows(r, t.range);
                    reg.parts.push_back(VimCursorModel::LinewiseText(r, rows.first, rows.last));
                }
                else
                    reg.parts.push_back(Extract(r, t.range));
                if (!t.block || after.empty())
                {
                    const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, VimOperatorStartCursor(ctx, t));
                    after.push_back(Selection{ t.cursorId, o, o, std::nullopt });
                }
            }
            ctx.globals.registers.Store(args.reg, std::move(reg), VimRegisterOp::Yank, ctx.host, ctx.options);
            const std::size_t primary = std::min(VimText::PrimaryIndex(ctx.doc), after.size() - 1);
            VimText::Select(ctx.doc, std::move(after), primary);
            return {};
        }
    }

    VimOpTarget VimLinewiseTarget(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow, std::uint32_t cursorId, ByteOffset origin)
    {
        return VimOpTarget{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(firstRow), r.LineEnd(lastRow) }, MotionKind::Linewise, false, cursorId, origin };
    }

    VimRowRange VimLinewiseRows(const Rope& r, ByteRange range)
    {
        VimRowRange rows{ VimText::RowOf(r, range.begin), VimText::RowOf(r, range.end) };
        // the LinewiseDeleteRange form: it ends at a later row's start, or starts on the break before the first row
        if (rows.last > rows.first && range.end == r.LineStart(rows.last) && range.end != r.LineEnd(rows.last)) --rows.last;
        if (rows.first < rows.last && range.begin == r.LineEnd(rows.first) && range.begin != r.LineStart(rows.first)) ++rows.first;
        return rows;
    }

    ByteOffset VimOperatorStartCursor(const VimContext& ctx, const VimOpTarget& t)
    {
        const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
        if (t.kind != MotionKind::Linewise || t.block) return t.range.begin;
        const VimRowRange rows = VimLinewiseRows(r, t.range);
        if (VimText::RowOf(r, t.origin) == rows.first) return t.origin;
        return VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, rows.first, VimText::VirtualColumn(r, t.origin, ctx.options.tabSize), ctx.options.tabSize);
    }

    void VimApplyWithCarets(VimContext& ctx, std::vector<EditOp> ops, const std::vector<VimCaretPlan>& plans, bool clampNormal)
    {
        std::stable_sort(ops.begin(), ops.end(), [](const EditOp& a, const EditOp& b) { return a.range.begin < b.range.begin; });
        std::vector<Selection> provisional;
        provisional.reserve(plans.size());
        for (const VimCaretPlan& p : plans)
        {
            const ByteOffset o = VimText::MapThrough(p.at, ops, p.bias);
            provisional.push_back(Selection{ p.id, o, o, std::nullopt });
        }
        if (provisional.empty()) provisional = VimText::Selections(ctx.doc);
        const std::size_t primary = std::min(VimText::PrimaryIndex(ctx.doc), provisional.size() - 1);
        VimText::Apply(ctx.doc, ops, provisional, primary);
        if (plans.empty()) return;
        const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> placed;
        placed.reserve(plans.size());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < plans.size(); ++i)
        {
            ByteOffset o = std::min<ByteOffset>(provisional[i].head, r.Size());
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
            o = std::min<ByteOffset>(o + plans[i].plusBytes, r.LineEnd(row));
            std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal;
            switch (plans[i].rule)
            {
            case VimCaretRule::AtOffset:
            case VimCaretRule::Exact:
                break;
            case VimCaretRule::BeforeMapped:
                if (o > r.LineStart(row)) o = VimText::PrevChar(r, o);
                break;
            case VimCaretRule::RowColumn:
                o = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, plans[i].vcol, ctx.options.tabSize);
                goal = plans[i].vcol;
                break;
            case VimCaretRule::RowFirstNonBlank:
                o = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row);
                break;
            case VimCaretRule::NextRowFirstNonBlank:
                o = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, std::min(row + 1, r.LineCount() - 1));
                break;
            }
            if (clampNormal && plans[i].rule != VimCaretRule::Exact) o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, o);
            placed.push_back(Selection{ plans[i].id, o, o, goal });
        }
        VimText::Select(ctx.doc, std::move(placed), primary);
    }

    VimOpOutcome RunOperator(VimContext& ctx, VimOperatorId op, std::span<const VimOpTarget> targets, const VimOpArgs& args)
    {
        if (targets.empty())
        {
            VimOpOutcome none;
            none.failed = true;
            return none;
        }
        switch (op)
        {
        case VimOperatorId::Delete: return DeleteOrChange(ctx, false, targets, args);
        case VimOperatorId::Change: return DeleteOrChange(ctx, true, targets, args);
        case VimOperatorId::Yank:   return Yank(ctx, targets, args);
        default:
        {
            VimOpOutcome none;   // the ids TE5a-13/14 and TE5c-15 add
            none.failed = true;
            return none;
        }
        }
    }
}
```
