```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMultiCursor.cpp
// gb: Sublime's add-next-match, reachable in vim's Normal mode (spec s6.2, s6.6).
// The scan and the cursor limit are TE1-17's (TextCommands::FindForward,
// ConfirmCursorCount); this file adds vim's word pick, whole-word filter and wrap.
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimTextObjects.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        bool WholeWordAt(const Rope& r, const VimCharClass& chars, ByteOffset b, ByteOffset e)
        {
            if (b > 0)
            {
                const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, b);
                const char32_t before = b > r.LineStart(row) ? VimText::CodePointAt(r, VimText::PrevChar(r, b)) : U'\n';
                if (chars.IsWord(before)) return false;
            }
            return !chars.IsWord(VimText::CodePointAt(r, e));
        }
    }

    std::optional<ByteOffset> FindNextLiteral(const Rope& r, std::string_view needle, ByteOffset from, bool wholeWord,
                                              const VimCharClass& chars, std::span<const Selection> taken)
    {
        if (needle.empty()) return std::nullopt;
        const auto acceptable = [&](ByteOffset a) {
            const ByteOffset e = a + needle.size();
            for (const Selection& s : taken)
                if (a < std::max(s.anchor, s.head) && e > std::min(s.anchor, s.head)) return false;
            return !wholeWord || WholeWordAt(r, chars, a, e);
        };
        // TE1-17's literal scan (chunk-straddling, multi-line needles included); gb only filters its hits
        const auto scan = [&](ByteOffset start, ByteOffset limit) -> std::optional<ByteOffset> {
            for (std::optional<ByteOffset> hit = TextCommands::FindForward(r, needle, start); hit && *hit < limit;
                 hit = TextCommands::FindForward(r, needle, *hit + 1))
                if (acceptable(*hit)) return hit;
            return std::nullopt;
        };
        if (const std::optional<ByteOffset> hit = scan(from, r.Size() + 1)) return hit;
        return scan(0, from);                                    // wrapped once: only matches starting before `from`
    }

    void VimState::AddNextMatch(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Normal)
        {
            VimContext ctx = Context();
            std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
            bool any = false;
            for (Selection& s : sels)
            {
                if (m_chars.Class(VimText::CodePointAt(r, s.head), false) == 0) continue;   // on blanks: no word
                const auto obj = ResolveTextObject(ctx, ByteRange{ s.head, s.head }, s.head, VimObjectArgs{ VimObjectId::Word, true, 1, false });
                if (!obj || obj->range.begin == obj->range.end) continue;
                s.anchor = obj->range.begin;
                s.head = obj->range.end;                          // the Visual (inclusive) editor range of the word
                s.goalColumn.reset();
                any = true;
            }
            if (!any) { Beep(); return; }
            m_mode = VimMode::Visual;
            m_gbWholeWord = true;
            VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
            return;
        }
        if (m_mode != VimMode::Visual) { Beep(); return; }
        // TE1-17's gate over the view's EditContext (editor.text.maxCursors) and its confirmCursors hook,
        // used as is: the adapter builds it with MakeEditContext(model) and no rerun action, so TE4-24's
        // hook refuses with a note (never a question) -- vim never clears or replaces it.
        const EditContext gate = m_doc.context ? *m_doc.context : EditContext{};
        for (std::uint32_t n = 0; n < p.Count1(); ++n)
        {
            std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
            if (!TextCommands(m_doc.buffer, m_doc.selections, gate).ConfirmCursorCount(sels.size() + 1))
            {
                m_host.ShowMessage("gb: " + std::to_string(gate.maxCursors) + " cursors is the limit (editor.text.maxCursors)", true);
                return;
            }
            const Selection& primary = sels[VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc)];
            const ByteOffset lo = std::min(primary.anchor, primary.head), hi = std::max(primary.anchor, primary.head);
            if (lo == hi) { Beep(); return; }
            std::string needle;
            r.CopyTo(ByteRange{ lo, hi }, needle);
            const std::optional<ByteOffset> at = FindNextLiteral(r, needle, hi, m_gbWholeWord, m_chars, sels);
            if (!at) { m_host.ShowMessage("gb: no more matches", false); return; }
            sels.push_back(Selection{ m_doc.selections.AllocateId(), *at, *at + needle.size(), std::nullopt });
            const std::size_t newest = sels.size() - 1;           // the newest selection is the primary (spec s3.4)
            VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), newest);
        }
    }
}
```

  - `TextEditorView::SetCursorShape/CursorShape`, `SetLineMode/LineMode`, `SetInputEnabled/InputEnabled`, `SetClipAtLineEnds/ClipAtLineEnds`, `SetEvents(TextViewEvents)`, `SetKeyInterceptor(TextKeyInterceptor)`, `ChordConsumed(std::string_view actionId)`, `NotifyTransactionBegun()`, `NotifyTransactionUndone()` (CANON A7 vim view hooks).
  - `TextInputHook::SetLatinLetters(bool)`, `LatinLetters()`; free `char32_t LatinLetterForVirtualKey(std::uint32_t vk, bool shift, bool capsLock)` (`TextInputHook.hpp`) (CANON A8).
    - Note (accepted, CANON A8): the Latin-letter path reads Ctrl/Alt/Shift and Caps Lock with Win32 `GetKeyState` inside the hook, not ImGui's io -- `io.KeyCtrl/KeyAlt/KeyShift` lag a frame inside the message pump and ImGui has no Caps Lock state. This is the hook's only Win32 key-state read.
  - `DispatchTextActions(EditorActions&, TextActionTarget&, const TextEditorView* keysView = nullptr)` (TE4-24's signature plus a defaulted parameter).
  - `VimKeyTranslate.hpp`: `kVimExperimental` (**defined here only**, CANON B15), `VimKeyFromChord(const KeyChord&)`, `VimKeyFromNamed(const TextKeyPress&)`, `ApplyVimKeyboard(TextInputHook&, const Text::VimKeyboardState&, bool latinLettersWanted)`, `ResetTextKeyboard(TextInputHook&)`, `QuitDecision`, `VimModeStatusText`, `OtherViewLiesIn(Text::VimWindowCommand, bool splitOpen, bool splitVertical, bool focusedIsPrimary)`, `PathToUtf8`, `Utf8ToPath`.
  - `VimViewAdapter.hpp`: `struct TextStatusVim { mode, pending, recording, message, messageIsError, commandLine, experimental }` and `void DrawVimStatus(const TextStatusVim&)` (TE5-owned, CANON A9); `VimViewAdapter` (an `IVimHost` over one view): `Vim()`, `SetLatinLettersWanted`, `RefreshContext()`, `Tick()`, `DrawOverlays()`, `TakeDeferred()`; `struct VimDeferredOp { TextDocument* doc; TextEditorView* view; std::function<void(TextDocument&, TextEditorView&)> run; }`; `VimViewAdapter::Services { DocumentHost* documents; std::function<EditorDocument*(const std::filesystem::path&, std::optional<Openers::FilePosition>)> openText; TextClipboard clipboard; std::function<double()> now; }`.
  - Test helper `Arcane::Test::{ScopedTestLayout, TextInputStroke, PlayStrokes}` (`ArcaneTests/src/Helpers/TextInputScript.hpp`).

The keyboard rules (spec s5.5): in Normal, Visual and operator-pending modes vim asks TE2-10's `TextInputHook` for command keys -- dead keys arrive bare with the layout's dead state cleared (`SetCommandMode`), the IME is off (`SetImeAllowed(false)`, which TE2-10 makes a real IME-context disassociation, CANON B24), and letters come from the key's Latin letter when `editor.text.vim.latinLettersInNormal` resolves to on (TE5a-23) -- except while `f t F T r` wait for a literal character, which keeps the layout's letters. Insert, Replace and the command line get the text keyboard: composition and IME on. The Latin-letter path is Arcane's own addition to TE2-10's hook: on a letter `WM_KEYDOWN` without Ctrl/Alt (read with `GetKeyState`, which is the thread's key state as of that message -- ImGui's `io.KeyCtrl/KeyAlt/KeyShift` lag a frame inside the message pump and carry no Caps Lock toggle) it appends the VK's Latin letter to the command-mode queue that `TakeCommandModeChars` drains and swallows the layout's `WM_CHAR` / `WM_DEADCHAR` for that keystroke; the key-down itself passes on, so SDL's key state stays right.

The hook is process-wide: the adapter whose view holds the keyboard pushes vim's keyboard state into it (`Tick`, every frame, after the mode may have changed), and `VimEditorRuntime::FrameBoundary` (TE5a-23) resets it to the text keyboard (`ResetTextKeyboard`) whenever no vim view holds the keyboard, so a plain text view or another widget never inherits command mode.

The adapter is the one place TE2/TE4/TE7 names are consumed by the vim layer. Every document and window operation a vim command asks for (`:q`, `:e`, `:sp`, `Ctrl-W c`, `:bn`, a global mark in another file) is **deferred** (`TakeDeferred`) and run by `VimEditorRuntime` at the frame boundary (TE5a-23), never inside the key dispatch: closing a document there would destroy the adapter and the `VimState` that is still on the call stack, and opening one would grow `DocumentHost`'s list while `DrawAll` iterates it. Files open only through `Services::openText` (TE7's `FileOpener`, CANON A10), never `DocumentHost::OpenAt`.

Each view's `VimDoc` is built over `doc.ModelOf(view)` (TE4-17: that view's `TextModel` -- buffer, selections, folds, display) with `VimDoc::context = &m_context`, an `EditContext` member the adapter refreshes from `doc.MakeEditContext(model)` (TE4-24) when it attaches, when settings publish (`VimEditorRuntime::OnSettingsPublished` calls `RefreshContext`) and once per frame before vim handles that frame's first key -- so vim's commands get the document's indentation, word characters, comment tokens, cursor limit and cursor-confirm hook exactly as the default bindings do. The adapter passes **no rerun action** (`MakeEditContext(model)`, never `MakeEditContext(model, action)`): TE4-24's hook then turns a refused cursor count into the document's note, never a Yes/No question, and vim (`gb`, TE5a-21, and every multi-cursor path) uses that hook as is -- it never clears or replaces `confirmCursors`.

hlsearch (CANON B19): the adapter owns a second `SearchHighlightOverlay` (the find bar owns the first), attached with `view.AddOverlay` and removed on detach, fed by its own `VisibleMatchCache` over a `CompiledQuery` built from `SearchQuery{ text = <the translated pcre2>, regex = true, caseSensitive = true, forceMultiline = translated.multiline }`. `IVimHost::SetSearchHighlight` (TE5a-5) carries only the translated pcre2 string; TE5c-1's `VimPattern::Translate` puts `(?m)` first exactly when `TranslatedPattern::multiline` is set, so the adapter reads the flag back as `pcre2.starts_with("(?m)")`. Like the find bar, a multi-line query is not painted (`VisibleMatchCache` is the single-line path), and neither are vim's `\%V` / `\%23l` predicates (TE5c-16's `VimDivergences()` rows).

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Helpers/TextInputScript.hpp
#pragma once

// Test seam for TE2-10's TextInputHook (CANON A8, TE5a-22): a real keyboard
// layout loaded the way TE2-10's ScopedLayout test helper does it, and each
// keystroke played as the synthetic MSG sequence Windows produces -- the
// WM_KEYDOWN, then the WM_DEADCHAR / WM_CHAR TranslateMessage would post
// (computed with ToUnicodeEx on that layout, dead-key state kept) -- every one
// fed to TextInputHook::OnMessage. What the view would read is returned through
// TE2-10's own BuildTextInputFrame (command-mode characters first).

#include "TextEditor/View/TextInput.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextInputHook.hpp"

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Test
{
    // TE2-10's ScopedLayout pattern: loads the layout, unloads it only when this scope loaded it.
    class ScopedTestLayout
    {
    public:
        ScopedTestLayout(const wchar_t* klid, WORD expectedLanguage)
        {
            const int count = ::GetKeyboardLayoutList(0, nullptr);
            std::vector<HKL> before(static_cast<std::size_t>(count));
            ::GetKeyboardLayoutList(count, before.data());
            m_hkl = ::LoadKeyboardLayoutW(klid, KLF_NOTELLSHELL);
            m_loadedHere = m_hkl && std::find(before.begin(), before.end(), m_hkl) == before.end();
            m_ok = m_hkl && LOWORD(reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(m_hkl)) == expectedLanguage;
        }
        ~ScopedTestLayout() { if (m_loadedHere) ::UnloadKeyboardLayout(m_hkl); }
        ScopedTestLayout(const ScopedTestLayout&) = delete;
        ScopedTestLayout& operator=(const ScopedTestLayout&) = delete;
        [[nodiscard]] bool Ok() const { return m_ok; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uintptr_t Id() const { return reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(m_hkl); }
    private:
        HKL  m_hkl = nullptr;
        bool m_loadedHere = false;
        bool m_ok = false;
    };

    struct TextInputStroke
    {
        std::uint32_t vk = 0;
        bool shift = false;
        bool altGr = false;      // Ctrl + Right Alt held
        bool capsLock = false;
    };

    namespace Detail
    {
        // ToUnicodeEx without the keep-state flag on Space consumes a pending dead key.
        inline void ClearDeadKeyState(HKL hkl)
        {
            const BYTE none[256] = {};
            wchar_t buf[8] = {};
            const UINT scan = ::MapVirtualKeyExW(VK_SPACE, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC, hkl);
            (void)::ToUnicodeEx(VK_SPACE, scan, none, buf, 8, 0, hkl);
            (void)::ToUnicodeEx(VK_SPACE, scan, none, buf, 8, 0, hkl);
        }
    }

    // Plays `strokes` on `layout` through `hook` and returns the frame the view would build.
    // The thread's key state is set per stroke (SetKeyboardState) so GetKeyState inside the
    // hook sees the stroke's Shift / AltGr / Caps Lock, and restored afterwards.
    inline Editor::TextInputFrame PlayStrokes(Editor::TextInputHook& hook, const ScopedTestLayout& layout,
                                              const std::vector<TextInputStroke>& strokes)
    {
        const HKL hkl = reinterpret_cast<HKL>(layout.Id());
        hook.RefreshLayout(layout.Id());
        BYTE saved[256] = {};
        (void)::GetKeyboardState(saved);
        Detail::ClearDeadKeyState(hkl);
        Editor::RawTextInput raw;
        raw.layoutHasAltGr = hook.Layout().hasAltGr;
        for (const TextInputStroke& s : strokes)
        {
            BYTE state[256] = {};
            if (s.shift) state[VK_SHIFT] = state[VK_LSHIFT] = 0x80;
            if (s.altGr) state[VK_CONTROL] = state[VK_LCONTROL] = state[VK_MENU] = state[VK_RMENU] = 0x80;
            if (s.capsLock) state[VK_CAPITAL] = 0x01;
            (void)::SetKeyboardState(state);
            raw.rightAltDown = raw.rightAltDown || s.altGr;

            const UINT scan = ::MapVirtualKeyExW(s.vk, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC, hkl);
            MSG down{};
            down.message = WM_KEYDOWN;
            down.wParam = s.vk;
            down.lParam = static_cast<LPARAM>(1u | (scan << 16));
            if (!hook.OnMessage(&down))
                continue;                                    // swallowed: TranslateMessage never sees it
            wchar_t buf[8] = {};
            const int n = ::ToUnicodeEx(s.vk, scan, state, buf, 8, 0, hkl);   // TranslateMessage's translation
            MSG ch{};
            ch.lParam = down.lParam;
            if (n < 0)
            {
                ch.message = WM_DEADCHAR;                    // passed on = it composes with the next key
                ch.wParam = buf[0];
                (void)hook.OnMessage(&ch);
                continue;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            {
                ch.message = WM_CHAR;
                ch.wParam = buf[i];
                if (hook.OnMessage(&ch))
                    raw.chars.push_back(static_cast<char32_t>(buf[i]));   // what SDL would queue as text
            }
        }
        (void)::SetKeyboardState(saved);
        Detail::ClearDeadKeyState(hkl);
        raw.commandModeChars = hook.TakeCommandModeChars();
        return Editor::BuildTextInputFrame(raw);
    }
}
```

```cpp
TEST_CASE("vim keyboard: Ctrl chords become vim keys only for Labelled Ctrl+letter and Ctrl+[; TE2-10's named keys", "[text-vim-keyboard]")

    CHECK(Editor::VimKeyFromChord(*Editor::ParseKeyChord("Ctrl+[")) == Text::VimKey::Ctrl(U'['));
    CHECK_FALSE(Editor::VimKeyFromChord(*Editor::ParseKeyChord("Ctrl+Shift+R")).has_value());

          == Text::VimKey::Named(Text::VimNamedKey::Tab, true));
    CHECK(Editor::VimKeyFromNamed(Editor::TextKeyPress{ Editor::TextNamedKey::Enter }) == Text::VimKey::Named(Text::VimNamedKey::Enter));
    CHECK(Editor::VimKeyFromNamed(Editor::TextKeyPress{ Editor::TextNamedKey::PageDown, false, true, false })
          == Text::VimKey::Named(Text::VimNamedKey::PageDown, true));
    CHECK_FALSE(Editor::VimKeyFromNamed(Editor::TextKeyPress{ Editor::TextNamedKey::Home, true, false, false }).has_value());   // Ctrl+Home stays text.documentStart
    CHECK_FALSE(Editor::VimKeyFromNamed(Editor::TextKeyPress{ Editor::TextNamedKey::Left, false, false, true }).has_value());
    CHECK(Editor::VimKeyFromNamed(Editor::TextKeyPress{ Editor::TextNamedKey::Insert }) == Text::VimKey::Named(Text::VimNamedKey::Insert));   // X24

}

    CHECK_FALSE(Editor::OtherViewLiesIn(VimWindowCommand::FocusLeft, true, true, true));
    CHECK(Editor::OtherViewLiesIn(VimWindowCommand::FocusLeft, true, true, false));

    CHECK(Editor::OtherViewLiesIn(VimWindowCommand::FocusUp, true, false, false));
    CHECK_FALSE(Editor::OtherViewLiesIn(VimWindowCommand::FocusRight, true, false, true));

    hook.SetLatinLetters(true);
    CHECK(PlayStrokes(hook, ru, { { 'F', true } }).text == "F");                      // Shift+F: the capital
    CHECK(PlayStrokes(hook, ru, { { 'F', false, false, true } }).text == "F");        // Caps Lock
    CHECK(PlayStrokes(hook, ru, { { VK_OEM_1 } }).text == "\xD0\xB6");               // U+0436: not a letter VK, the layout's character
    CHECK(PlayStrokes(hook, ru, { { 'F' }, { 'J' } }).text == "fj");                  // one swallowed character per keystroke
    hook.SetLatinLetters(false);
    CHECK(PlayStrokes(hook, ru, { { 'F' } }).text == "\xD0\xB0");
```

```cpp
    bool TextInputHook::OnMessage(void* msgPtr)
    {
        const MSG& msg = *static_cast<const MSG*>(msgPtr);
        if (msg.message == WM_SETFOCUS || msg.message == WM_KEYDOWN)
            NoteImeWindow(msg.hwnd);   // passed on either way
        if (msg.message == WM_INPUTLANGCHANGE)
        {
            RefreshLayout(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(msg.lParam));   // lParam: the new HKL
            return true;
        }
        if (msg.message == WM_KEYDOWN)
        {
            m_dropNextChar = false;   // a new keystroke: nothing is pending from the previous one
            if (m_latinLetters)
            {
                // GetKeyState is the thread's key state as of this message (ImGui's io lags a frame
                // inside the pump and has no Caps Lock toggle). Ctrl or Alt held (AltGr included):
                // the key is a chord or AltGr text, never a Latin letter.
                const bool ctrl = (::GetKeyState(VK_CONTROL) & 0x8000) != 0;
                const bool alt = (::GetKeyState(VK_MENU) & 0x8000) != 0;
                if (!ctrl && !alt)
                {
                    const char32_t latin = LatinLetterForVirtualKey(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(msg.wParam),
                                                                    (::GetKeyState(VK_SHIFT) & 0x8000) != 0,
                                                                    (::GetKeyState(VK_CAPITAL) & 0x0001) != 0);
                    if (latin != 0)
                    {
                        m_commandChars.push_back(latin);   // the vim key is the key's Latin letter (spec s5.5)
                        m_dropNextChar = true;             // the layout's own character for this keystroke goes
                    }
                }
            }
            return true;   // the key-down itself continues: SDL's key state stays right
        }
        if (m_dropNextChar && (msg.message == WM_CHAR || msg.message == WM_DEADCHAR))
        {
            m_dropNextChar = false;
            if (msg.message == WM_DEADCHAR)
                ConsumeDeadKeyState(m_layout.layout != 0 ? m_layout.layout : ActiveKeyboardLayout());
            return false;  // swallowed before it reaches SDL's text queue
        }
        if (m_commandMode && msg.message == WM_DEADCHAR)
        {
            m_commandChars.push_back(static_cast<char32_t>(msg.wParam));
            ConsumeDeadKeyState(m_layout.layout != 0 ? m_layout.layout : ActiveKeyboardLayout());
            return false;   // swallowed: nothing composes with the next key
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextViewHooks.hpp
#pragma once

// The small hook surface the view exposes to the vim layer (spec s6.1):
// cursor shape, line mode, input enabled, clip at line ends, the four events,
// and a key interceptor consulted before the view's own handling and before
// any text.* / shared-verb row fires. With vim off nothing is installed and
// the view behaves as TE2/TE4 built it.

#include "Input/EditorActions.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextInput.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    enum class TextCursorShape : std::uint8_t { Bar, Block, Underline };

    struct TextCaretBox { float x0 = 0.f, y0 = 0.f, x1 = 0.f, y1 = 0.f; };

    // The caret rectangle for the cell at (x, y): Bar is barWidth wide, Block the
    // whole cell, Underline barWidth tall at the cell's bottom.
    [[nodiscard]] inline TextCaretBox CaretBoxFor(TextCursorShape shape, float x, float y, float cellWidth, float lineHeight, float barWidth)
    {
        switch (shape)
        {
        case TextCursorShape::Block:     return TextCaretBox{ x, y, x + cellWidth, y + lineHeight };
        case TextCursorShape::Underline: return TextCaretBox{ x, y + lineHeight - barWidth, x + cellWidth, y + lineHeight };
        case TextCursorShape::Bar:       break;
        }
        return TextCaretBox{ x, y, x + barWidth, y + lineHeight };
    }

    struct TextViewEvents
    {
        std::function<void(std::string_view)> inputHandled;        // typed text the view inserted (IME commits included)
        std::function<void()>                 transactionBegun;    // an editing command ran outside vim (row, paste, cut, find bar)
        std::function<void()>                 transactionUndone;   // the document's undo/redo ran
        std::function<void(bool byMouse)>     selectionsChanged;   // a click or drag moved selections
    };

    struct TextKeyInterceptor
    {
        std::function<bool(char32_t)>            character;   // true = consumed, the view does not type it
        std::function<bool(const KeyChord&)>     chord;       // Ctrl+letter / Ctrl+[ presses; true = consumed, no row fires
        std::function<bool(const TextKeyPress&)> named;       // TE2-10's named keys; true = consumed, no row fires
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/VimKeyTranslate.cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/VimKeyTranslate.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/View/TextInputHook.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    std::optional<Text::VimKey> VimKeyFromChord(const KeyChord& chord)
    {
        if (!chord.ctrl || chord.alt || chord.shift || chord.super || chord.type != KeyType::Labelled) return std::nullopt;
        if (chord.key >= 'a' && chord.key <= 'z') return Text::VimKey::Ctrl(static_cast<char32_t>(chord.key));   // SDL keycodes: lowercase ASCII
        if (chord.key >= 'A' && chord.key <= 'Z') return Text::VimKey::Ctrl(static_cast<char32_t>(chord.key - 'A' + 'a'));
        if (chord.key == '[') return Text::VimKey::Ctrl(U'[');
        return std::nullopt;                                     // Ctrl+F4, Ctrl+arrows ...: the action table's
    }

    std::optional<Text::VimKey> VimKeyFromNamed(const TextKeyPress& k)
    {
        using Text::VimKey;
        using Text::VimNamedKey;
        if (k.ctrl || k.alt) return std::nullopt;
        switch (k.key)
        {
        case TextNamedKey::Escape:    return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Esc);
        case TextNamedKey::Enter:     return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Enter);
        case TextNamedKey::Tab:       return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Tab, k.shift);
        case TextNamedKey::Backspace: return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Backspace);
        case TextNamedKey::Delete:    return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Delete);
        case TextNamedKey::Up:        return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Up, k.shift);
        case TextNamedKey::Down:      return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Down, k.shift);
        case TextNamedKey::Left:      return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Left, k.shift);
        case TextNamedKey::Right:     return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Right, k.shift);
        case TextNamedKey::Home:      return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Home, k.shift);
        case TextNamedKey::End:       return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::End, k.shift);
        case TextNamedKey::PageUp:    return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::PageUp, k.shift);
        case TextNamedKey::PageDown:  return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::PageDown, k.shift);
        case TextNamedKey::Insert:                               // vim's <Insert> (cross-fix X24): i in Normal, the Insert/Replace toggle
            if (k.shift) return std::nullopt;                    // Shift+Insert is not a vim key: it stays the editor's
            return VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Insert);
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    void ApplyVimKeyboard(TextInputHook& hook, const Text::VimKeyboardState& state, bool latinLettersWanted)
    {
        hook.SetCommandMode(state.commandKeys);
        hook.SetLatinLetters(state.latinLetters && latinLettersWanted);
        hook.SetImeAllowed(state.imeAllowed);    // TE2-10 disassociates / restores the IME context (CANON B24)
    }

    void ResetTextKeyboard(TextInputHook& hook)
    {
        Text::VimKeyboardState text;
        text.commandKeys = false;
        text.latinLetters = false;
        text.imeAllowed = true;
        ApplyVimKeyboard(hook, text, false);
    }

    Text::VimHostResult QuitDecision(bool dirty, bool bang)
    {
        if (dirty && !bang) return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "E37: No write since last change (add ! to override)" };
        return Text::VimHostResult{};
    }

    std::string VimModeStatusText(Text::VimMode mode)
    {
        switch (mode)
        {
        case Text::VimMode::Insert:      return "-- INSERT --";
        case Text::VimMode::Replace:     return "-- REPLACE --";
        case Text::VimMode::Visual:      return "-- VISUAL --";
        case Text::VimMode::VisualLine:  return "-- VISUAL LINE --";
        case Text::VimMode::VisualBlock: return "-- VISUAL BLOCK --";
        default:                         return {};
        }
    }

    bool OtherViewLiesIn(Text::VimWindowCommand direction, bool splitOpen, bool splitVertical, bool focusedIsPrimary)
    {
        using Text::VimWindowCommand;
        if (!splitOpen) return false;
        switch (direction)
        {
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusNext:  return true;
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusLeft:  return splitVertical && !focusedIsPrimary;
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusRight: return splitVertical && focusedIsPrimary;
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusUp:    return !splitVertical && !focusedIsPrimary;
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusDown:  return !splitVertical && focusedIsPrimary;
        default:                           return false;
        }
    }

    std::string PathToUtf8(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        const std::u8string u8 = path.u8string();
        return std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(u8.data()), u8.size());
    }

    std::filesystem::path Utf8ToPath(std::string_view utf8)
    {
        return std::filesystem::path(std::u8string(reinterpret_cast<const char8_t*>(utf8.data()), utf8.size()));
    }
}
```

```cpp
        // A named key as the KeyChord its text.* row is bound to (Home -> text.lineStart, ...),
        // in ParseKeyChord's own key names (TextNamedKey order).
        std::optional<KeyChord> ChordOfNamedKey(const TextKeyPress& k)
        {
            static constexpr const char* kNames[] = { "Left", "Right", "Up", "Down", "Home", "End", "PageUp", "PageDown",
                                                      "Backspace", "Delete", "Enter", "Tab", "Escape" };
            std::string text;
            if (k.ctrl) text += "Ctrl+";
            if (k.shift) text += "Shift+";
            if (k.alt) text += "Alt+";
            text += kNames[static_cast<std::size_t>(k.key)];
            return ParseKeyChord(text);
        }
```

and the members:

```cpp
    bool TextEditorView::ChordConsumed(std::string_view actionId) const
    {
        if (m_consumedChords.empty()) return false;
        const std::optional<KeyChord> chord = EditorActions::Get().ChordOf(actionId);
        if (!chord || !chord->Bound()) return false;
        for (const KeyChord& c : m_consumedChords)
            if (SameKey(c, *chord)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    void TextEditorView::InterceptKeys(TextInputFrame& in)
    {
        if (!m_interceptor.character && !m_interceptor.chord && !m_interceptor.named && m_inputEnabled)
            return;                                              // vim off: the view behaves as TE2/TE4 built it
        // 1. Ctrl+letter and Ctrl+[: TE2-10's stream never carries chords (they are EditorActions'),
        //    so the view reads them from ImGui and hands each to the interceptor first.
        if (m_interceptor.chord && !in.altGrHeld)
        {
            const ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
            if (io.KeyCtrl)
                for (int i = 0; i <= 26; ++i)
                {
                    const ImGuiKey key = i < 26 ? static_cast<ImGuiKey>(ImGuiKey_A + i) : ImGuiKey_LeftBracket;
                    if (!ImGui::IsKeyPressed(key, true)) continue;
                    std::string text = "Ctrl+";
                    if (io.KeyShift) text += "Shift+";
                    if (io.KeyAlt) text += "Alt+";
                    text += i < 26 ? static_cast<char>('A' + i) : '[';
                    const std::optional<KeyChord> chord = ParseKeyChord(text);
                    if (chord && m_interceptor.chord(*chord)) m_consumedChords.push_back(*chord);
                }
        }
        // 2. Named keys: a consumed one is removed, and its chord recorded so the text.* row
        //    bound to it (Home -> text.lineStart, Esc ...) does not fire too.
        if (m_interceptor.named)
            std::erase_if(in.keys, [this](const TextKeyPress& k)
            {
                if (!m_interceptor.named(k)) return false;
                if (const std::optional<KeyChord> c = ChordOfNamedKey(k)) m_consumedChords.push_back(*c);
                return true;
            });
        // 3. Characters (command-mode characters first, TE2-10's frame order).
        std::string kept;
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < in.text.size())
        {
            const Text::Utf8::Unit u = Text::Utf8::DecodeAt(in.text, i);
            const std::size_t n = std::max<std::size_t>(1, u.length);
            if (!(m_interceptor.character && u.valid && m_interceptor.character(u.cp)))
                kept.append(in.text, i, n);
            i += n;
        }
        in.text = m_inputEnabled ? std::move(kept) : std::string{};
    }
```

and `TextActions.cpp` (add `#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"`):

```cpp
    int DispatchTextActions(EditorActions& actions, TextActionTarget& target, const TextEditorView* keysView)
    {
        actions.MarkContextActive(ActionContext::TextDocument);
        int ran = 0;
        for (const TextActionRow& row : kTextActionTable)
        {
            const bool fired = row.repeats ? actions.PressedRepeat(row.desc.id) : actions.Pressed(row.desc.id);
            if (!fired) continue;
            if (keysView && keysView->ChordConsumed(row.desc.id)) continue;   // vim took this chord (spec s6.1)
            if (keysView) keysView->NotifyTransactionBegun();                  // a row's motion splits an insert session as vim's arrows do
            target.RunTextAction(row.action);
            ++ran;
        }
        return ran;
    }
```

`TextDocument::ApplySharedVerbs` (TE2-18): its parameter is renamed `verbs` and the body starts with the filter below (the rest of TE2-18's body is unchanged and keeps reading `v`); after its undo/redo calls ran it reports them:

```cpp
    void TextDocument::ApplySharedVerbs(const TextSharedVerbs& verbs, bool& requestClose)
    {
        // TE5a-22 (spec s6.1): a chord the focused view's key interceptor (vim) consumed this
        // frame -- Ctrl+R, Ctrl+V, Ctrl+W ... -- never fires its shared verb as well.
        TextSharedVerbs v = verbs;
        const TextEditorView& keysView = FocusedView();
        if (keysView.ChordConsumed("edit.undo")) v.undo = false;
        if (keysView.ChordConsumed("edit.redo") || keysView.ChordConsumed("edit.redoAlt")) v.redo = false;
        if (keysView.ChordConsumed("edit.cut")) v.cut = false;
        if (keysView.ChordConsumed("edit.copy")) v.copy = false;
        if (keysView.ChordConsumed("edit.paste")) v.paste = false;
        if (keysView.ChordConsumed("document.close")) v.close = false;      // Ctrl+W is vim's window prefix; Ctrl+F4 still closes
        if ((v.cut || v.paste) && !ReadOnly()) keysView.NotifyTransactionBegun();
        // ... TE2-18's body (undo, redo, copy/cut, paste, reveal, close) ...
        if ((v.undo || v.redo) && !ReadOnly()) keysView.NotifyTransactionUndone();
    }
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/VimViewAdapter.hpp
#pragma once

// One VimState over one TextEditorView: the IVimHost implementation (spec
// s6.1), the key interception, hlsearch painting and the vim status-strip
// slot. Document and window operations are DEFERRED (TakeDeferred) to the
// frame boundary, never run inside a key dispatch.

#include "Project/Openers/FileOpener.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchWorker.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextAreaOverlays.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextClipboard.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextViewHooks.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class DocumentHost;
    class EditorDocument;
    class TextDocument;
    class TextEditorView;

    // The vim segment of the status strip (CANON A9: TE5-owned, drawn into TE4-19's
    // StatusSlot::VimMode by DrawVimStatus).
    struct TextStatusVim
    {
        std::string mode;                 // "NORMAL", "-- INSERT --", "-- VISUAL LINE --" ...
        std::string pending;              // the typed keys of an unfinished command
        std::string recording;            // "recording @q" (TE5b-5)
        std::string message;              // the last ShowMessage
        bool        messageIsError = false;
        std::string commandLine;          // ":s/a/b" while the command line is open
        bool        experimental = false; // kVimExperimental: the spec D12 badge
    };
    void DrawVimStatus(const TextStatusVim& status);

    struct VimDeferredOp
    {
        TextDocument*   doc = nullptr;
        TextEditorView* view = nullptr;
        std::function<void(TextDocument&, TextEditorView&)> run;
    };

    class VimViewAdapter final : public Text::IVimHost
    {
    public:
        struct Services
        {
            DocumentHost* documents = nullptr;   // close, :ls / :bn (never an open route)
            // Opens a file in the Arcane text editor (TE5a-23 wires it to FileOpener::OpenWith, CANON A10).
            std::function<EditorDocument*(const std::filesystem::path&, std::optional<Openers::FilePosition>)> openText;
            TextClipboard           clipboard = ImGuiTextClipboard();   // TE2-18
            std::function<double()> now;
        };

        VimViewAdapter(TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view, Text::VimGlobals& globals, Text::VimBufferState& bufferState,
                       Text::VimOptions options, Text::VimLanguage language, Services services);
        ~VimViewAdapter() override;
        VimViewAdapter(const VimViewAdapter&) = delete;
        VimViewAdapter& operator=(const VimViewAdapter&) = delete;

        [[nodiscard]] Text::VimState& Vim() { return *m_vim; }
        void SetLatinLettersWanted(bool wanted);
        // m_context := doc.MakeEditContext(doc.ModelOf(view)) (TE4-24): the VimDoc's EditContext.
        void RefreshContext();
        void Tick();                                            // timeoutlen, keyboard state, status: once per frame
        void DrawOverlays();                                    // the :marks / :reg / :jumps / :ls listing popup
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<VimDeferredOp> TakeDeferred();

        // ---- IVimHost ----
        void SetCursorShape(Text::VimCursorShape shape) override;
        void SetLineMode(bool linewise) override;
        void SetInputEnabled(bool enabled) override;
        void SetClipAtLineEnds(bool clip) override;
        void SetKeyboard(const Text::VimKeyboardState& state) override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t FirstVisibleRow() const override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t VisibleRows() const override;
        void ScrollToRow(std::uint32_t firstDisplayRow) override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string ReadClipboard() override;
        void WriteClipboard(std::string_view text) override;
        void ShowMessage(std::string_view text, bool isError) override;
        void ShowListing(std::string_view title, std::span<const std::string> lines) override;
        void SetCommandLine(std::string_view text, std::size_t cursorByte) override;
        void SetSearchHighlight(std::string_view pcre2Pattern) override;
        Text::VimHostResult RunFileCommand(Text::VimFileCommand command, std::string_view argument, bool bang) override;
        Text::VimHostResult RunWindowCommand(Text::VimWindowCommand command) override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::string> ReadFileText(std::string_view path) override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string DocumentPath() const override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> BufferList() override;
        bool OpenAt(std::string_view path, Text::Point point) override;

    private:
        bool Dispatch(const Text::VimKey& key);
        void PushKeyboard();
        void PublishStatus();
        void RefreshHighlight();                                // the visible hlsearch matches (overlay source)
        [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path ResolvePath(std::string_view arg) const;
        void Defer(std::function<void(TextDocument&, TextEditorView&)> run);

        TextDocument&                    m_doc;
        TextEditorView&                  m_view;
        Services                         m_services;
        Text::EditContext                m_context;            // VimDoc::context points here (stable: non-movable)
        int                              m_contextFrame = -1;  // ImGui frame of the last RefreshContext
        std::string                      m_hlPattern;          // the pcre2 pattern hlsearch paints ("" = none)
        Text::CompiledQuery              m_hlQuery;
        std::uint64_t                    m_hlGeneration = 0;
        Text::VisibleMatchCache          m_hlCache;
        std::vector<Text::ByteRange>     m_hlVisible;
        SearchHighlightOverlay           m_hlOverlay{ [this]
        {
            RefreshHighlight();
            return MatchHighlights{ m_hlVisible, std::nullopt };
        } };
        std::unique_ptr<Text::VimState>  m_vim;
        Text::VimKeyboardState           m_keyboard{};
        bool                             m_latinWanted = false;
        bool                             m_inDispatch = false;
        std::string                      m_message;
        bool                             m_messageError = false;
        std::string                      m_commandLine;
        std::string                      m_listingTitle;
        std::vector<std::string>         m_listing;
        bool                             m_listingOpen = false;
        std::vector<VimDeferredOp>       m_deferred;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/VimViewAdapter.cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/VimViewAdapter.hpp"

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSearchLimits.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextInputHook.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextStatusStrip.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/VimKeyTranslate.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <imgui.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>

#include <utility>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        TextCursorShape ToViewShape(Text::VimCursorShape s)
        {
            switch (s)
            {
            case Text::VimCursorShape::Block:     return TextCursorShape::Block;
            case Text::VimCursorShape::Underline: return TextCursorShape::Underline;
            case Text::VimCursorShape::Bar:       break;
            }
            return TextCursorShape::Bar;
        }

        std::vector<TextDocument*> TextDocuments(DocumentHost* host)
        {
            std::vector<TextDocument*> out;
            if (!host) return out;
            host->ForEach([&out](EditorDocument& d) {
                if (auto* t = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(&d)) out.push_back(t);
            });
            return out;
        }
    }

    void DrawVimStatus(const TextStatusVim& s)
    {
        if (!s.commandLine.empty())
        {
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(s.commandLine.c_str());
            ImGui::SameLine();
        }
        else if (!s.message.empty())
        {
            if (s.messageIsError) ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_PlotLinesHovered));
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(s.message.c_str());
            if (s.messageIsError) ImGui::PopStyleColor();
            ImGui::SameLine();
        }
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(s.mode.c_str());
        if (!s.recording.empty())
        {
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(s.recording.c_str());
        }
        if (!s.pending.empty())
        {
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", s.pending.c_str());
        }
        if (s.experimental)
        {
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextDisabled("Experimental");
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("Vim mode is Experimental until the full vim behaviour suite passes (spec D12).");
        }
    }

    VimViewAdapter::VimViewAdapter(TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view, Text::VimGlobals& globals, Text::VimBufferState& bufferState,
                                   Text::VimOptions options, Text::VimLanguage language, Services services)
        : m_doc(doc), m_view(view), m_services(std::move(services))
    {
        m_view.SetKeyInterceptor(TextKeyInterceptor{
            [this](char32_t ch) { return Dispatch(Text::VimKey::Char(ch)); },
            [this](const KeyChord& chord) {
                const std::optional<Text::VimKey> k = VimKeyFromChord(chord);
                return k ? Dispatch(*k) : false;
            },
            [this](const TextKeyPress& key) {
                const std::optional<Text::VimKey> k = VimKeyFromNamed(key);
                return k ? Dispatch(*k) : false;
            } });
        m_view.SetEvents(TextViewEvents{
            [this](std::string_view text) { if (m_vim) m_vim->OnInputHandled(text); },
            [this] { if (m_vim && !m_inDispatch) m_vim->OnTransactionBegun(); },
            [this] { if (m_vim && !m_inDispatch) m_vim->OnTransactionUndone(); },
            [this](bool byMouse) {
                if (!m_vim || m_inDispatch) return;
                m_inDispatch = true;                            // vim's own selection change must not re-enter
                m_vim->OnSelectionsChanged(byMouse);
                m_inDispatch = false;
                PublishStatus();
            } });
        m_view.AddOverlay(&m_hlOverlay);
        TextModel& model = m_doc.ModelOf(m_view);               // TE4-17: this view's buffer, selections, folds, display
        RefreshContext();
        m_vim = std::make_unique<Text::VimState>(Text::VimDoc{ model.buffer, model.selections, model.folds, model.display, &m_context },
                                                 *this, globals, bufferState, std::move(options), std::move(language));
        PublishStatus();
    }

    VimViewAdapter::~VimViewAdapter()
    {
        m_vim.reset();                                          // ends an open insert session through the hooks below
        m_view.RemoveOverlay(&m_hlOverlay);
        m_view.SetKeyInterceptor({});
        m_view.SetEvents({});
        m_view.SetCursorShape(TextCursorShape::Bar);            // back to the plain editor (vim off)
        m_view.SetLineMode(false);
        m_view.SetInputEnabled(true);
        m_view.SetClipAtLineEnds(false);
        if (m_view.KeyboardActive()) ResetTextKeyboard(TextInputHook::Get());
        m_doc.StatusStrip().SetSlot(StatusSlot::VimMode, {});   // a split's other vim view republishes on its next Tick
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::RefreshContext()
    {
        m_context = m_doc.MakeEditContext(m_doc.ModelOf(m_view));
        m_contextFrame = ImGui::GetFrameCount();
    }

    bool VimViewAdapter::Dispatch(const Text::VimKey& key)
    {
        if (!m_vim) return false;
        if (ImGui::GetFrameCount() != m_contextFrame) RefreshContext();   // once per frame, before vim's first key
        m_message.clear();
        m_inDispatch = true;
        const Text::VimKeyResult r = m_vim->HandleKey(key, m_services.now ? m_services.now() : ImGui::GetTime());
        m_inDispatch = false;
        PublishStatus();
        return r.handled;
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::SetLatinLettersWanted(bool wanted)
    {
        m_latinWanted = wanted;
        PushKeyboard();
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::Tick()
    {
        if (!m_vim) return;
        m_vim->Tick(m_services.now ? m_services.now() : ImGui::GetTime());
        PushKeyboard();                                         // focus may have moved to this view
        PublishStatus();
    }

    std::vector<VimDeferredOp> VimViewAdapter::TakeDeferred() { return std::exchange(m_deferred, {}); }

    void VimViewAdapter::Defer(std::function<void(TextDocument&, TextEditorView&)> run)
    {
        m_deferred.push_back(VimDeferredOp{ &m_doc, &m_view, std::move(run) });
    }

    // The input hook is process-wide: only the view that holds the keyboard drives it.
    void VimViewAdapter::PushKeyboard()
    {
        if (m_view.KeyboardActive()) ApplyVimKeyboard(TextInputHook::Get(), m_keyboard, m_latinWanted);
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::PublishStatus()
    {
        if (!m_vim) return;
        if (&m_doc.FocusedView() != &m_view) return;            // a split's focused view owns the document's strip
        TextStatusVim s;
        const std::string modeText = VimModeStatusText(m_vim->Mode());
        s.mode = modeText.empty() ? std::string(Text::VimModeLabel(m_vim->Mode())) : modeText;
        s.pending = m_vim->PendingKeys();
        s.message = m_message;
        s.messageIsError = m_messageError;
        s.commandLine = m_commandLine;
        s.experimental = kVimExperimental;
        m_doc.StatusStrip().SetSlot(StatusSlot::VimMode, [s = std::move(s)] { DrawVimStatus(s); });
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::DrawOverlays()
    {
        if (m_listingOpen)
        {
            ImGui::OpenPopup("##vimlisting");
            m_listingOpen = false;
        }
        if (ImGui::BeginPopup("##vimlisting"))
        {
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(m_listingTitle.c_str());
            ImGui::Separator();
            for (const std::string& line : m_listing) ImGui::TextUnformatted(line.c_str());
            if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Enter)) ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
            ImGui::EndPopup();
        }
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::SetCursorShape(Text::VimCursorShape shape) { m_view.SetCursorShape(ToViewShape(shape)); }
    void VimViewAdapter::SetLineMode(bool linewise) { m_view.SetLineMode(linewise); }
    void VimViewAdapter::SetInputEnabled(bool enabled) { m_view.SetInputEnabled(enabled); }
    void VimViewAdapter::SetClipAtLineEnds(bool clip) { m_view.SetClipAtLineEnds(clip); }

    void VimViewAdapter::SetKeyboard(const Text::VimKeyboardState& state)
    {
        m_keyboard = state;
        PushKeyboard();
    }

    std::uint32_t VimViewAdapter::FirstVisibleRow() const { return m_view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow(); }
    std::uint32_t VimViewAdapter::VisibleRows() const { return m_view.VisibleRowCount(); }
    void VimViewAdapter::ScrollToRow(std::uint32_t row) { m_view.SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow(row); }   // TE4-9 (CANON A7)

    std::string VimViewAdapter::ReadClipboard()
    {
        return m_services.clipboard.get ? m_services.clipboard.get() : std::string{};
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::WriteClipboard(std::string_view text)
    {
        if (m_services.clipboard.set) m_services.clipboard.set(std::string(text));
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::ShowMessage(std::string_view text, bool isError)
    {
        m_message = std::string(text);
        m_messageError = isError;
        PublishStatus();
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::ShowListing(std::string_view title, std::span<const std::string> lines)
    {
        m_listingTitle = std::string(title);
        m_listing.assign(lines.begin(), lines.end());
        m_listingOpen = true;
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::SetCommandLine(std::string_view text, std::size_t)
    {
        m_commandLine = std::string(text);
        PublishStatus();
    }

    // hlsearch (CANON B19): vim's translated pattern compiled as TE4's regex query and painted
    // by this adapter's own SearchHighlightOverlay (the find bar keeps its own).
    void VimViewAdapter::SetSearchHighlight(std::string_view pattern)
    {
        if (pattern == m_hlPattern) return;
        m_hlPattern = std::string(pattern);
        m_hlQuery = Text::CompiledQuery{};
        m_hlVisible.clear();
        m_hlCache.Invalidate();
        ++m_hlGeneration;
        if (pattern.empty()) return;
        Text::SearchQuery q;
        q.text = m_hlPattern;
        q.regex = true;
        q.caseSensitive = true;                                 // the translation already carries \c / smartcase
        // TE5c-1's VimPattern::Translate emits "(?m)" as the FIRST token exactly when
        // TranslatedPattern::multiline is set (a vim pattern's own "(" is escaped), so this IS
        // translated.multiline -- IVimHost::SetSearchHighlight carries only the pcre2 text.
        q.forceMultiline = m_hlPattern.starts_with("(?m)");
        m_hlQuery = Text::TextSearch::Compile(q, std::string_view{});   // no whole-word option: word chars unused
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::RefreshHighlight()
    {
        m_hlVisible.clear();
        if (!m_hlQuery.Valid() || m_hlQuery.multiline) return;  // multi-line queries are not painted (as the find bar)
        const Text::DisplayMap& display = m_view.Display();
        const std::uint32_t rows = display.DisplayRowCount();
        if (rows == 0) return;
        const std::uint32_t first = display.DisplayRowToBuffer(std::min(m_view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow(), rows - 1));
        const std::uint32_t last = display.DisplayRowToBuffer(std::min(m_view.LastVisibleDisplayRow(), rows - 1));
        const std::span<const Text::ByteRange> v = m_hlCache.Get(m_view.Buffer().Snapshot(), m_hlQuery, m_hlGeneration, first, last,
                                                                 SearchLimitsFromSettings(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()));
        m_hlVisible.assign(v.begin(), v.end());
    }

    std::filesystem::path VimViewAdapter::ResolvePath(std::string_view arg) const
    {
        const std::filesystem::path p = Utf8ToPath(arg);
        if (p.is_absolute()) return p;
        const auto base = m_doc.CanonicalPath();                // by value (CANON A7)
        return base.parent_path() / p;
    }

    Text::VimHostResult VimViewAdapter::RunFileCommand(Text::VimFileCommand command, std::string_view argument, bool bang)
    {
        using Text::VimFileCommand;
        const Text::VimHostResult cannotWrite{ false, "E212: Can't open file for writing" };
        // :q in a split closes the window (TE4-17's CloseView); otherwise the document.
        const auto closeWindowOrDoc = [this](bool discard) {
            if (m_doc.SplitOpen())
            {
                Defer([](TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view) { doc.CloseView(view); });
                return;
            }
            DocumentHost* host = m_services.documents;
            Defer([host, discard](TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView&) {
                if (!host) return;
                host->RequestClose(&doc);
                if (discard && host->HasPendingConfirm() && host->PendingConfirmDoc() == &doc) host->ConfirmDiscard();
            });
        };
        switch (command)
        {
        case VimFileCommand::Write:
            if (!argument.empty()) return m_doc.SaveAs(ResolvePath(argument)) ? Text::VimHostResult{} : cannotWrite;
            return m_doc.Save() ? Text::VimHostResult{ true, "\"" + DocumentPath() + "\" written" } : cannotWrite;
        case VimFileCommand::Quit:
        {
            if (!m_doc.SplitOpen())
            {
                const Text::VimHostResult d = QuitDecision(m_doc.Dirty(), bang);
                if (!d.ok) return d;
            }
            closeWindowOrDoc(bang);
            return {};
        }
        case VimFileCommand::WriteQuit:
            if (!m_doc.Save()) return cannotWrite;
            closeWindowOrDoc(false);
            return {};
        case VimFileCommand::WriteIfDirtyQuit:
            if (m_doc.Dirty() && !m_doc.Save()) return cannotWrite;
            closeWindowOrDoc(false);
            return {};
        case VimFileCommand::Edit:
        {
            if (argument.empty())
            {
                const Text::VimHostResult d = QuitDecision(m_doc.Dirty(), bang);
                if (!d.ok) return d;
                Defer([](TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView&) { doc.ReloadFromDisk(); });
                return {};
            }
            if (!m_services.openText) return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "E32: No file name" };
            const std::filesystem::path target = ResolvePath(argument);
            auto open = m_services.openText;                    // FileOpener (CANON A10), never DocumentHost::OpenAt
            Defer([open, target](TextDocument&, TextEditorView&) { (void)open(target, std::nullopt); });
            return {};
        }
        case VimFileCommand::SaveAs:
            if (argument.empty()) return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "E471: Argument required" };
            return m_doc.SaveAs(ResolvePath(argument)) ? Text::VimHostResult{} : cannotWrite;
        case VimFileCommand::NextBuffer:
        case VimFileCommand::PrevBuffer:
        {
            const std::vector<TextDocument*> docs = TextDocuments(m_services.documents);
            const auto it = std::find(docs.begin(), docs.end(), &m_doc);
            if (docs.size() < 2 || it == docs.end()) return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "E85: There is no listed buffer" };
            const std::size_t i = static_cast<std::size_t>(it - docs.begin());
            const std::size_t n = docs.size();
            TextDocument* next = docs[command == VimFileCommand::NextBuffer ? (i + 1) % n : (i + n - 1) % n];
            DocumentHost* host = m_services.documents;
            Defer([host, next](TextDocument&, TextEditorView&) {
                const std::vector<TextDocument*> open = TextDocuments(host);   // an earlier op may have closed it
                if (std::find(open.begin(), open.end(), next) != open.end()) host->Focus(next);   // TE7-9
            });
            return {};
        }
        }
        return {};
    }

    Text::VimHostResult VimViewAdapter::RunWindowCommand(Text::VimWindowCommand command)
    {
        using Text::VimWindowCommand;
        switch (command)
        {
        case VimWindowCommand::SplitHorizontal: Defer([](TextDocument& d, TextEditorView&) { d.OpenSplit(false); }); break;   // stacked
        case VimWindowCommand::SplitVertical:   Defer([](TextDocument& d, TextEditorView&) { d.OpenSplit(true); }); break;    // side by side
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusLeft:
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusDown:
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusUp:
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusRight:
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusNext:
            // TE4-17 has at most two views: the other one, when it lies that way; else beep.
            if (!OtherViewLiesIn(command, m_doc.SplitOpen(), m_doc.SplitVertical(), &m_view == &m_doc.View()))
                return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "" };
            Defer([](TextDocument& d, TextEditorView&) { d.FocusOtherView(); });
            break;
        case VimWindowCommand::Close:
            if (!m_doc.SplitOpen()) return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "E444: Cannot close last window" };
            Defer([](TextDocument& d, TextEditorView& v) { d.CloseView(v); });
            break;
        }
        return {};
    }

    std::optional<std::string> VimViewAdapter::ReadFileText(std::string_view path)
    {
        std::ifstream in(ResolvePath(path), std::ios::binary);
        if (!in) return std::nullopt;
        std::stringstream ss;
        ss << in.rdbuf();
        return ss.str();
    }

    std::string VimViewAdapter::DocumentPath() const { return PathToUtf8(m_doc.CanonicalPath()); }

    std::vector<std::string> VimViewAdapter::BufferList()
    {
        std::vector<std::string> out;
        for (TextDocument* d : TextDocuments(m_services.documents)) out.push_back(PathToUtf8(d->CanonicalPath()));
        return out;
    }

    // Global marks in another file (TE5b-7) and `:e` open through FileOpener (CANON A10). The
    // position is the mark's line, column 1: the documented 'A column divergence (VimDivergences).
    bool VimViewAdapter::OpenAt(std::string_view path, Text::Point point)
    {
        if (!m_services.openText) return false;
        const std::filesystem::path target = Utf8ToPath(path);
        const Openers::FilePosition at{ point.row + 1, 1 };
        auto open = m_services.openText;
        Defer([open, target, at](TextDocument&, TextEditorView&) { (void)open(target, at); });
        return true;
    }
}
```

`editor.text.vim.enabled` is live (spec s6.1): turning it on attaches a `VimViewAdapter` (and so a `VimState`) to every open text view; turning it off destroys them, which restores the plain view (Bar caret, input on, no interception, the hlsearch overlay removed, the status slot cleared, the text keyboard back) -- with it off no vim code runs. `VimEditorRuntime::FrameBoundary` (called once per frame, after `DocumentHost::DrawAll`) reads the published settings, applies the difference, refreshes the regex limits of the one vim `MatchScratch` (`m_globals.scratch.SetLimits(ToSyntaxLimits(Settings<TextSettings>()).regex)`, also done at construction) and every adapter's `EditContext` (`RefreshContext`, i.e. `doc.MakeEditContext(model)`), re-resolves "Latin letters: Auto" against the active layout (`!TextInputHook::Get().Layout().lettersLatin`), ticks every adapter (timeoutlen, keyboard state, status strip), resets the input hook to the text keyboard when no vim view holds the keyboard, and then runs the deferred document/window operations. Files vim opens (`:e`, a global mark) go through `SetFileOpener`'s `FileOpener::OpenWith(p, OpenerId::ArcaneText(), at).document` (CANON A10); the `DocumentHost` stays only for closing documents and the buffer list (`:q`, `:ls`, `:bn`). The status strip's vim slot shows the Experimental badge (`kVimExperimental`, TE5a-22) for as long as VIM-GATE has not dropped it.

```cpp
    bool ResolveLatinLetters(VimLatinLetters setting, bool layoutNonLatin)
    {
        switch (setting)
        {
        case VimLatinLetters::On:   return true;
        case VimLatinLetters::Off:  return false;
        case VimLatinLetters::Auto: break;
        }
        return layoutNonLatin;
    }

    VimRuntimeChange DiffVimRuntime(const std::optional<VimRuntimeState>& before, const VimRuntimeState& after)
    {
        VimRuntimeChange c;
        const bool wasOn = before && before->enabled;
        c.attach = after.enabled && !wasOn;
        c.detach = !after.enabled && wasOn;
        c.options = after.enabled && wasOn && (!(before->options == after.options) || before->latin != after.latin);
        return c;
    }
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/VimEditorRuntime.hpp
#pragma once

// The editor's vim runtime (spec s6.1): the process-wide VimGlobals, one
// VimBufferState per TextDocument (shared by its split views), and one
// VimViewAdapter per TextEditorView while editor.text.vim.enabled is on.
// FrameBoundary runs once per frame after DocumentHost::DrawAll: it applies
// settings changes live, ticks every adapter, then runs their deferred
// document/window operations.

#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/VimKeyTranslate.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/VimViewAdapter.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobals.hpp"

#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    class FileOpener;
}

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class DocumentHost;
    class TextDocument;
    class TextEditorView;

    class VimEditorRuntime
    {
    public:
        static VimEditorRuntime& Get();

        void SetDocumentHost(DocumentHost* host) { m_documents = host; }    // close, :ls, :bn (never an open route)
        void SetFileOpener(Openers::FileOpener* files) { m_files = files; } // :e and global marks (CANON A10)
        [[nodiscard]] Text::VimGlobals& Globals() { return m_globals; }
        [[nodiscard]] Text::VimBufferState& BufferState(TextDocument& doc);

        void Register(TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view);     // every view a TextDocument creates (TE2-15, TE4-17)
        void Unregister(TextEditorView& view);                      // before the view is destroyed
        void Attach(TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view);
        void Detach(TextEditorView& view);
        void OnSettingsPublished();
        void FrameBoundary();
        void ForEachVim(const std::function<void(Text::VimState&)>& fn);
        [[nodiscard]] VimViewAdapter* AdapterFor(const TextEditorView& view);

    private:
        VimEditorRuntime();                                         // sets the vim MatchScratch's regex limits

        struct Entry
        {
            TextDocument*                   doc = nullptr;
            TextEditorView*                 view = nullptr;
            std::unique_ptr<VimViewAdapter> adapter;
        };
        [[nodiscard]] VimRuntimeState Current() const;
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsRegistered(const TextEditorView* view) const;
        [[nodiscard]] static bool LatinWanted(VimLatinLetters setting);

        DocumentHost*                                                        m_documents = nullptr;
        Openers::FileOpener*                                                 m_files = nullptr;
        Text::VimGlobals                                                     m_globals;
        std::vector<Entry>                                                   m_entries;
        std::map<const TextDocument*, std::unique_ptr<Text::VimBufferState>> m_bufferStates;
        std::optional<VimRuntimeState>                                       m_applied;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/VimEditorRuntime.cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/VimEditorRuntime.hpp"

#include "Project/Openers/FileOpener.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextInputHook.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimLanguage.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <imgui.h>

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    VimEditorRuntime& VimEditorRuntime::Get()
    {
        static VimEditorRuntime s_runtime;
        return s_runtime;
    }

    VimEditorRuntime::VimEditorRuntime()
    {
        // The one vim MatchScratch (TE5a-13) runs under the editor's regex limits (TE3-3); pure vim
        // code never reads settings.
        m_globals.scratch.SetLimits(ToSyntaxLimits(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()).regex);
    }

    Text::VimBufferState& VimEditorRuntime::BufferState(TextDocument& doc)
    {
        std::unique_ptr<Text::VimBufferState>& slot = m_bufferStates[&doc];
        if (!slot) slot = std::make_unique<Text::VimBufferState>();
        return *slot;
    }

    VimRuntimeState VimEditorRuntime::Current() const
    {
        const TextVimSettings& vim = Arcane::Settings<TextVimSettings>();
        return VimRuntimeState{ vim.enabled, ReadVimOptions(vim, Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()), vim.latinLettersInNormal };
    }

    bool VimEditorRuntime::LatinWanted(VimLatinLetters setting)
    {
        return ResolveLatinLetters(setting, !TextInputHook::Get().Layout().lettersLatin);   // CANON A8
    }

    bool VimEditorRuntime::IsRegistered(const TextEditorView* view) const
    {
        return std::any_of(m_entries.begin(), m_entries.end(), [view](const Entry& e) { return e.view == view; });
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::Register(TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view)
    {
        if (IsRegistered(&view)) return;
        m_entries.push_back(Entry{ &doc, &view, nullptr });
        if (Current().enabled) Attach(doc, view);
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::Unregister(TextEditorView& view)
    {
        const auto it = std::find_if(m_entries.begin(), m_entries.end(), [&view](const Entry& e) { return e.view == &view; });
        if (it == m_entries.end()) return;
        const TextDocument* doc = it->doc;
        it->adapter.reset();                                    // the adapter restores the view before the view goes
        m_entries.erase(it);
        const bool lastView = std::none_of(m_entries.begin(), m_entries.end(), [doc](const Entry& e) { return e.doc == doc; });
        if (lastView) m_bufferStates.erase(doc);
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::Attach(TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view)
    {
        for (Entry& e : m_entries)
        {
            if (e.view != &view || e.adapter) continue;
            const VimRuntimeState state = Current();
            Text::VimLanguage language;
            if (const Text::GrammarSnapshot grammar = doc.Grammar())          // TE4-11; null = Plain Text
                language = Text::VimLanguageFromGrammar(*grammar);           // the CompiledGrammar overload (TE5a-3)
            VimViewAdapter::Services services;
            services.documents = m_documents;
            services.openText = [this](const std::filesystem::path& path, std::optional<Openers::FilePosition> at) -> EditorDocument*
            {
                // Read at call time: SetFileOpener may come after the first attach.
                return m_files ? m_files->OpenWith(path, Openers::OpenerId::ArcaneText(), at).document : nullptr;
            };
            services.now = [] { return ImGui::GetTime(); };
            e.adapter = std::make_unique<VimViewAdapter>(doc, view, m_globals, BufferState(doc), state.options, std::move(language), services);
            e.adapter->SetLatinLettersWanted(LatinWanted(state.latin));
        }
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::Detach(TextEditorView& view)
    {
        for (Entry& e : m_entries)
            if (e.view == &view) e.adapter.reset();
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::OnSettingsPublished()
    {
        const VimRuntimeState now = Current();
        const VimRuntimeChange change = DiffVimRuntime(m_applied, now);
        if (change.attach)
            for (Entry& e : m_entries) Attach(*e.doc, *e.view);
        if (change.detach)
            for (Entry& e : m_entries) e.adapter.reset();
        if (change.options)
            for (Entry& e : m_entries)
                if (e.adapter) e.adapter->Vim().SetOptions(now.options);
        // Every publish: the regex limits of the one vim MatchScratch and each view's EditContext
        // (doc.MakeEditContext(model): indentation, word chars, comment tokens, cursor limit).
        m_globals.scratch.SetLimits(ToSyntaxLimits(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()).regex);
        for (Entry& e : m_entries)
            if (e.adapter) e.adapter->RefreshContext();
        m_applied = now;
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::FrameBoundary()
    {
        OnSettingsPublished();                                  // live: the published block is read once per frame
        const bool latin = m_applied && LatinWanted(m_applied->latin);   // Auto follows a layout switch
        bool vimHasKeyboard = false;
        std::vector<VimDeferredOp> ops;
        for (Entry& e : m_entries)
        {
            if (!e.adapter) continue;
            e.adapter->SetLatinLettersWanted(latin);
            e.adapter->Tick();
            vimHasKeyboard = vimHasKeyboard || e.view->KeyboardActive();
            for (VimDeferredOp& op : e.adapter->TakeDeferred()) ops.push_back(std::move(op));
        }
        if (!vimHasKeyboard)
            ResetTextKeyboard(TextInputHook::Get());            // no vim view holds the keyboard: text entry everywhere
        for (VimDeferredOp& op : ops)
            if (op.run && IsRegistered(op.view)) op.run(*op.doc, *op.view);   // an earlier op may have closed it
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::ForEachVim(const std::function<void(Text::VimState&)>& fn)
    {
        for (Entry& e : m_entries)
            if (e.adapter) fn(e.adapter->Vim());
    }

    VimViewAdapter* VimEditorRuntime::AdapterFor(const TextEditorView& view)
    {
        for (Entry& e : m_entries)
            if (e.view == &view) return e.adapter.get();
        return nullptr;
    }
}
```

In `TextDocument.cpp` (TE2-15 / TE4-17) -- three hooks, include `"TextEditor/View/VimEditorRuntime.hpp"`:

1. Wherever a `TextEditorView` is created -- the constructor's primary view (TE2-15) and the second view in TE4-17's `OpenSplit` -- right after the view exists: `VimEditorRuntime::Get().Register(*this, view);` (`View()` / `*m_secondView`).
2. Wherever a view is destroyed -- TE4-17's `CloseView` / `CloseSplit` (the secondary view) and the destructor (every view) -- right before it is destroyed: `VimEditorRuntime::Get().Unregister(view);`.
3. At the end of `TextDocument::Draw`: `if (VimViewAdapter* a = VimEditorRuntime::Get().AdapterFor(FocusedView())) a->DrawOverlays();`.

In `EditorApp.cpp`, right after TE7-9's `InstallFileOpener();` call (the `FileOpener` must exist; `m_documents` already does), with `#include "TextEditor/View/VimEditorRuntime.hpp"` beside the other text-editor includes:


**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `IVimHost::ReadClipboard/WriteClipboard/DocumentPath` (TE5a-5; in the editor the adapter, TE5a-22, implements the clipboard pair over TE2-18's `TextClipboard { set; get; }` -- `TextDocumentServices::clipboard`, `ImGuiTextClipboard()` -- and the path from `TextDocument::CanonicalPath()`, by value), `VimOptions::useSystemClipboard` (TE5a-3), `VimCursorModel::PasteOffset/PasteRow/Clamp` (TE5a-2), `VimText::*`, `VimRig` (TE5a-5), `TextVimSettings`, `ReadVimOptions` (TE5a-23), `Arcane::Test::RequireDefault/ScopedCodeLayer` (`Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp`).
- Produces (API of CONTRACT.md unchanged, plus):
  - `static bool VimRegisters::IsWritable(char32_t)`
  - `void StoreDeletedText(VimRegisters& regs, char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value, bool forceNumbered, IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options)` -- the one delete/change store: `forceNumbered` = the operator's motion was `% ( ) \` / ? n N { }` (vim `use_reg_one`).
  - `void VimState::PutRegister(const VimParsed& p, bool after, bool cursorAfterText)`, `void VimState::PutBlock(const VimRegisterValue& v, std::uint32_t count, bool after, bool cursorAfterText)`
  - `TextVimSettings::useSystemClipboard` (`editor.text.vim.useSystemClipboard`, default false) and `ReadVimOptions` mapping it.

Rules (Neovim `register.c` / `ops.c`): a yank with no register writes `"0`; with a register, only that register. A delete or change writes the named register if one is given, then -- when it is linewise, spans lines, or its motion forces it -- shifts `"1`..`"8` into `"2`..`"9` and writes `"1` (the unnamed register then points at `"1` unless the name was an append); a one-line charwise delete with no register writes `"-`. Uppercase appends: charwise onto charwise concatenates; any linewise side makes the result linewise with the appended text on new lines. `"_` discards. `"+` and `"*` are the system clipboard (one on Windows); the text vim wrote keeps its kind while the clipboard still holds it, otherwise clipboard text ending in a line break reads linewise. `useSystemClipboard` (Neovim `clipboard=unnamedplus`) turns "no register" into `"+` for writes and reads. `"%` is the document path; `".` `":` `"/` are read-only (set by vim itself through `SetSpecial`). A value has one part per cursor after a multi-cursor yank; a put with as many cursors as parts gives cursor *i* part *i*, any other put gives every cursor the whole text.
