```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobalMarks.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim's file marks A-Z (spec s6.3): a canonical path (the TextDocument key,
// spec s5.3) and a position, process-wide in VimGlobals.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <map>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimGlobalMark
    {
        std::string path;
        Point point;
    };

    class VimGlobalMarks
    {
    public:
        void Set(char32_t name, VimGlobalMark mark) { m_marks[name] = std::move(mark); }
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<VimGlobalMark> Get(char32_t name) const
        {
            const auto it = m_marks.find(name);
            return it == m_marks.end() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<VimGlobalMark>(it->second);
        }
        void Remove(char32_t name) { m_marks.erase(name); }
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, VimGlobalMark>> List() const
        {
            return std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, VimGlobalMark>>(m_marks.begin(), m_marks.end());
        }

    private:
        std::map<char32_t, VimGlobalMark> m_marks;
    };

    // A Point in `rope`, clamped to an existing row and column.
    [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset VimPointToOffset(const Rope& rope, Point point);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobalMarks.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobalMarks.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    ByteOffset VimPointToOffset(const Rope& rope, Point point)
    {
        const std::uint32_t row = std::min(point.row, rope.LineCount() - 1);
        const ByteOffset start = rope.LineStart(row);
        return start + std::min<ByteOffset>(point.col, rope.LineEnd(row) - start);
    }
}
```

`VimMarkMotion.cpp` -- `ResolveMarkMotion` becomes:

```cpp
    std::optional<VimMotionTarget> ResolveMarkMotion(VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, const VimMotionArgs& args)
    {
        (void)from;
        const char32_t name = args.arg == U'`' ? U'\'' : args.arg;
        const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
        std::optional<ByteOffset> at;
        if (name >= U'A' && name <= U'Z')
        {
            const std::optional<VimGlobalMark> g = ctx.globals.globalMarks.Get(name);
            if (!g || g->path != ctx.host.DocumentPath()) return std::nullopt;   // other files: VimState::Execute opens them
            at = ctx.bufferState.marks.Get(name);
            if (!at) at = VimPointToOffset(r, g->point);
        }
        else
            at = ctx.bufferState.marks.Get(name);
        if (!at) return std::nullopt;
        ByteOffset o = std::min<ByteOffset>(*at, r.Size());
        const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
        if (ctx.bufferState.lastVisualMode == VimMode::VisualLine)
        {
            if (name == U'<') o = r.LineStart(row);
            if (name == U'>') o = r.LineEnd(row);
        }
        VimMotionTarget t;
        t.jump = true;
        if (args.id == VimMotionId::MarkLine)
        {
            t.offset = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row);
            t.kind = MotionKind::Linewise;
        }
        else
        {
            t.offset = o;
            t.kind = MotionKind::Exclusive;
        }
        return t;
    }
```

`SetMarkCommand`, `AttachBufferState`, `DetachBufferState` become, `SyncGlobalMarks` is added, and `BeforeVimEdit`'s `if (any) m_bufferState.marks.EraseRows(lo, hi, before);` becomes the block below:

```cpp
    void VimState::SetMarkCommand(char32_t name)
    {
        if (!VimMarks::IsSettable(name)) { Beep(); return; }
        if (name == U'`') name = U'\'';
        const VimCursor c = ToVim(m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()]);
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(name, c.head);
        if (name >= U'A' && name <= U'Z')
        {
            const std::string path = m_host.DocumentPath();
            if (!path.empty()) m_globals.globalMarks.Set(name, VimGlobalMark{ path, m_doc.buffer.Text().OffsetToPoint(c.head) });
        }
    }

    void VimState::SyncGlobalMarks()
    {
        const std::string path = m_host.DocumentPath();
        if (path.empty()) return;
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        for (const auto& [name, mark] : m_globals.globalMarks.List())
            if (mark.path == path)
                if (const std::optional<ByteOffset> at = m_bufferState.marks.Get(name))
                    m_globals.globalMarks.Set(name, VimGlobalMark{ path, r.OffsetToPoint(*at) });
    }

    void VimState::AttachBufferState()
    {
        m_bufferState.marks.Attach(m_doc.buffer);
        const std::string path = m_host.DocumentPath();
        if (path.empty()) return;
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        if (const auto it = m_globals.fileMarks.find(path); it != m_globals.fileMarks.end())
            for (const auto& [name, point] : it->second) m_bufferState.marks.Set(name, VimPointToOffset(r, point));
        for (const auto& [name, mark] : m_globals.globalMarks.List())
            if (mark.path == path) m_bufferState.marks.Set(name, VimPointToOffset(r, mark.point));
    }

    void VimState::DetachBufferState()
    {
        const std::string path = m_host.DocumentPath();
        if (!path.empty())
        {
            SyncGlobalMarks();
            std::map<char32_t, Point>& saved = m_globals.fileMarks[path];
            saved.clear();
            const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
            for (const auto& [name, at] : m_bufferState.marks.List())
                if (name >= U'a' && name <= U'z') saved[name] = r.OffsetToPoint(at);
        }
        m_bufferState.marks.Detach(m_doc.buffer);
    }
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `AnchorSet` (`AnchorSet::Id`, `Add(Anchor{ offset, bias })`, `Get(id).offset`, `Remove`; TE1-5), `TextBuffer::RegisterAnchors/UnregisterAnchors` (TE1-8), `ExecuteMotion`'s `jumped` / `jumpFrom` and trailing `Select` (TE5a-8), `AfterVimEdit` / `FinishInsertCapture` (TE5b-6).
- Produces:
  - `class VimJumpList { explicit VimJumpList(AnchorSet&); void Record(ByteOffset at, const Rope&); std::optional<ByteOffset> Move(std::int32_t count, ByteOffset current, const Rope&); std::vector<std::string> Listing(const Rope&) const; std::size_t Size() const; std::size_t Index() const; }`
  - `class VimChangeList { Attach; Detach; void Add(ByteOffset at, const Rope&); Size; At; Generation; std::vector<std::string> Listing(const Rope&) const; }`
  - `void VimState::RecordJump(ByteOffset from)` (public: Part D's search, `:N` and other jumps call it), `const VimJumpList& VimState::Jumps() const` (TE5c-14 `:jumps`)
  - `VimBufferState::changes`

Neovim semantics (`mark.c`): a jump (`G gg % ( ) { } H M L n N * # / ? `` ` `` `' ``...) appends the position it left to this view's list (100 entries) and sets the `''` mark. `Ctrl-O` first drops entries that a later entry duplicates on the same row (keeping their index right), and -- when the index is past the end -- appends the current position before stepping back, so `Ctrl-I` can return; out of range is a beep. The change list is per buffer (100 entries): a change on the same row as the newest entry and within 79 columns of it updates that entry (`textwidth` 0 -> 79, vim's `changed_common`), otherwise appends; `g;` / `g,` walk it from the newest end, with vim's `E662` / `E663` / `E664` at the ends. Each view's position in the change list resets to the end whenever the list grows.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimJumpListTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimChangeList.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimJumpList.hpp"

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

TEST_CASE("vim jumps: Ctrl-O from the newest end inserts the current position first", "[text-vim-jumps]")
{
    TextBuffer buffer(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\nc\nd"));
    AnchorSet anchors;
    buffer.RegisterAnchors(anchors);
    {
        VimJumpList j(anchors);
        const Rope& r = buffer.Text();
        j.Record(0, r);                        // G from row 0
        j.Record(6, r);                        // gg from row 3
        CHECK(j.Index() == 2u);
        const auto back = j.Move(-1, 0, r);    // at row 0 again: row 0 is added, the older row-0 entry dropped
        REQUIRE(back.has_value());
        CHECK(*back == 6u);
        CHECK_FALSE(j.Move(-1, 6, r).has_value());
        const auto fwd = j.Move(1, 6, r);
        REQUIRE(fwd.has_value());
        CHECK(*fwd == 0u);
    }
    buffer.UnregisterAnchors(anchors);
}

TEST_CASE("vim jumps: the list keeps 100 entries", "[text-vim-jumps]")
{
    std::string text;
    for (int i = 0; i < 150; ++i) text += "x\n";
    TextBuffer buffer(Rope::FromUtf8(text));
    AnchorSet anchors;
    buffer.RegisterAnchors(anchors);
    {
        VimJumpList j(anchors);
        for (ByteOffset row = 0; row < 150; ++row) j.Record(row * 2, buffer.Text());
        CHECK(j.Size() == 100u);
    }
    buffer.UnregisterAnchors(anchors);
}

    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "alpha\nbeta\ngamma");
    r.Keys("G");

    SelectionSet second;
    TextCommands(r.buffer, second, r.context).SetSelections({ Selection{ second.AllocateId(), 0, 0, std::nullopt } }, 0);
    VimDoc otherDoc = r.Doc();                             // the rig's buffer, folds, display and edit context...
    VimState other(VimDoc{ otherDoc.buffer, second, otherDoc.folds, otherDoc.display, otherDoc.context },   // ...with its own selections

TEST_CASE("vim changes: same-row changes within 79 columns update the newest entry", "[text-vim-jumps]")
{
    TextBuffer buffer(Rope::FromUtf8(std::string(200, 'x') + "\ny"));
    VimChangeList c;
    c.Attach(buffer);
    const Rope& r = buffer.Text();
    c.Add(0, r);
    c.Add(50, r);
    CHECK(c.Size() == 1u);
    CHECK(c.At(0) == 50u);
    c.Add(150, r);
    CHECK(c.Size() == 2u);
    c.Add(201, r);
    CHECK(c.Size() == 3u);

}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimJumpList.hpp
#pragma once

// A view's jump list (spec s6.3; Neovim mark.c setpcmark / movemark /
// cleanup_jumplist): positions are anchors, so edits move them.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    class VimJumpList
    {
    public:
        explicit VimJumpList(AnchorSet& anchors) : m_anchors(anchors) {}
        ~VimJumpList();
        VimJumpList(const VimJumpList&) = delete;
        VimJumpList& operator=(const VimJumpList&) = delete;

        void Record(ByteOffset at, const Rope& rope);                                   // setpcmark
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<ByteOffset> Move(std::int32_t count, ByteOffset current, const Rope& rope);   // Ctrl-O < 0, Ctrl-I > 0
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> Listing(const Rope& rope) const;         // :jumps
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t Size() const { return m_entries.size(); }
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t Index() const { return m_index; }

    private:
        void Cleanup(const Rope& rope);   // an entry with a later entry on the same row goes

        AnchorSet& m_anchors;
        std::vector<AnchorSet::Id> m_entries;
        std::size_t m_index = 0;          // == size: past the newest entry
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimJumpList.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimJumpList.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <format>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("vim behaviour: JUMPLISTSIZE -- the jump list keeps 100 entries (:h jumplist)")
        constexpr std::size_t kJumpListSize = 100;
    }

    VimJumpList::~VimJumpList()
    {
        for (const AnchorSet::Id id : m_entries) m_anchors.Remove(id);
    }

    void VimJumpList::Record(ByteOffset at, const Rope& rope)
    {
        (void)rope;
        if (m_entries.size() >= kJumpListSize)
        {
            m_anchors.Remove(m_entries.front());
            m_entries.erase(m_entries.begin());
        }
        m_entries.push_back(m_anchors.Add(Anchor{ at, Bias::Left }));
        m_index = m_entries.size();
    }

    void VimJumpList::Cleanup(const Rope& rope)
    {
        std::vector<AnchorSet::Id> kept;
        std::size_t index = m_index;
        for (std::size_t from = 0; from < m_entries.size(); ++from)
        {
            if (m_index == from) index = kept.size();
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(rope, m_anchors.Get(m_entries[from]).offset);
            bool later = false;
            for (std::size_t i = from + 1; i < m_entries.size() && !later; ++i)
                later = VimText::RowOf(rope, m_anchors.Get(m_entries[i]).offset) == row;
            if (later) m_anchors.Remove(m_entries[from]);
            else kept.push_back(m_entries[from]);
        }
        if (m_index >= m_entries.size()) index = kept.size();
        m_entries = std::move(kept);
        m_index = index;
    }

    std::optional<ByteOffset> VimJumpList::Move(std::int32_t count, ByteOffset current, const Rope& rope)
    {
        Cleanup(rope);
        if (m_entries.empty()) return std::nullopt;
        const auto size = static_cast<std::int64_t>(m_entries.size());
        auto index = static_cast<std::int64_t>(m_index);
        if (index + count < 0 || index + count >= size) return std::nullopt;
        if (m_index == m_entries.size())
        {
            Record(current, rope);                      // the first Ctrl-O after a jump remembers where it came from
            m_index = m_entries.size() - 1;             // ...and skips that new entry
            index = static_cast<std::int64_t>(m_index);
            if (index + count < 0) return std::nullopt;
        }
        m_index = static_cast<std::size_t>(index + count);
        return m_anchors.Get(m_entries[m_index]).offset;
    }

    std::vector<std::string> VimJumpList::Listing(const Rope& rope) const
    {
        std::vector<std::string> out{ " jump line  col file/text" };
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_entries.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset at = m_anchors.Get(m_entries[i]).offset;
            const Point p = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(at, rope.Size()));
            const std::size_t distance = i < m_index ? m_index - i : i - m_index;
            std::string text = VimText::Line(rope, p.row);
            text.erase(0, text.find_first_not_of(" \t") == std::string::npos ? text.size() : text.find_first_not_of(" \t"));
            out.push_back(std::format("{}{:>3} {:>5} {:>4} {}", i == m_index ? '>' : ' ', distance, p.row + 1, p.col, text));
        }
        if (m_index >= m_entries.size()) out.emplace_back(">");
        return out;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimChangeList.hpp
#pragma once

// A buffer's change list (spec s6.3 g; g,; vim changed_common): positions are
// anchors; nearby changes on one row share the newest entry.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    class VimChangeList
    {
    public:
        void Attach(TextBuffer& buffer) { buffer.RegisterAnchors(m_anchors); }
        void Detach(TextBuffer& buffer) { buffer.UnregisterAnchors(m_anchors); }
        void Add(ByteOffset at, const Rope& rope);
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t Size() const { return m_entries.size(); }
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset At(std::size_t i) const { return m_anchors.Get(m_entries[i]).offset; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t Generation() const { return m_generation; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> Listing(const Rope& rope) const;   // :changes form

    private:
        AnchorSet m_anchors;
        std::vector<AnchorSet::Id> m_entries;
        std::uint64_t m_generation = 0;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimChangeList.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimChangeList.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <format>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("vim behaviour: JUMPLISTSIZE also caps the change list at 100 entries")
        constexpr std::size_t kChangeListSize = 100;
        ARC_CONSTANT("vim behaviour: changed_common treats textwidth 0 as 79 columns when merging changes")
        constexpr std::uint32_t kMergeColumns = 79;
    }

    void VimChangeList::Add(ByteOffset at, const Rope& rope)
    {
        ++m_generation;
        bool add = m_entries.empty();
        if (!add)
        {
            const Point last = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(At(m_entries.size() - 1), rope.Size()));
            const Point now = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(at, rope.Size()));
            add = last.row != now.row || last.col + kMergeColumns < now.col || now.col + kMergeColumns < last.col;
        }
        if (add)
        {
            if (m_entries.size() >= kChangeListSize)
            {
                m_anchors.Remove(m_entries.front());
                m_entries.erase(m_entries.begin());
            }
            m_entries.push_back(m_anchors.Add(Anchor{ at, Bias::Left }));
            return;
        }
        m_anchors.Set(m_entries.back(), Anchor{ at, Bias::Left });                // the newest entry always moves to the newest change
    }

    std::vector<std::string> VimChangeList::Listing(const Rope& rope) const
    {
        std::vector<std::string> out{ "change line  col text" };
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_entries.size(); ++i)
        {
            const Point p = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(At(i), rope.Size()));
            out.push_back(std::format("{:>6} {:>5} {:>4} {}", m_entries.size() - i, p.row + 1, p.col, VimText::Line(rope, p.row)));
        }
        return out;
    }
}
```

```cpp
    void VimState::RecordJump(ByteOffset from)
    {
        m_jumps.Record(from, m_doc.buffer.Text());
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(U'\'', from);
    }

    void VimState::JumpCommand(std::int32_t count)
    {
        const Selection prim = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()];
        const std::optional<ByteOffset> target = m_jumps.Move(count, prim.head, m_doc.buffer.Text());
        if (!target) { Beep(); return; }
        const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(m_doc.buffer.Text(), *target);
        VimText::Select(m_doc, { Selection{ prim.id, o, o, std::nullopt } }, 0);
    }

    void VimState::ChangeCommand(std::int32_t count)
    {
        const VimChangeList& list = m_bufferState.changes;
        if (list.Size() == 0) { Beep("E664: Changelist is empty"); return; }
        if (m_changeGeneration != list.Generation())
        {
            m_changeIndex = list.Size();                         // a new change: walk again from the newest end
            m_changeGeneration = list.Generation();
        }
        auto n = static_cast<std::int64_t>(m_changeIndex);
        const auto len = static_cast<std::int64_t>(list.Size());
        if (n + count < 0)
        {
            if (n == 0) { Beep("E662: At start of changelist"); return; }
            n = 0;
        }
        else if (n + count >= len)
        {
            if (n == len - 1) { Beep("E663: At end of changelist"); return; }
            n = len - 1;
        }
        else
            n += count;
        m_changeIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
        const Selection prim = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()];
        const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(m_doc.buffer.Text(), list.At(m_changeIndex));
        VimText::Select(m_doc, { Selection{ prim.id, o, o, std::nullopt } }, 0);
    }
```

## Pass TE5c: ex commands and the pattern translator

Pass (c) turns vim's regex dialect into PCRE2 (`VimPattern::Translate`, every row of spec s6.5 plus the documented divergences), runs it through TE3's `Regex` on the line path or the materialized multi-line path (`VimSearch`), and builds the command line (`:` `/` `?`), the ex parser with ranges, and every ex command spec s6.3 lists, plus the fold commands. All cases land in `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5c.vimcases`; each task that adds cases checks them against the pinned Neovim before its code is written (Neovim wins on a mismatch: fix the expectation and the code together and list the correction in the task report).

Organisation inside Part D (deviation from the contract's one-line split, same task ids): the command-line editor itself (typing, history, Ctrl-R) lands in TE5c-5 because `/` and `?` need it first; TE5c-6 adds `:` entry, the ex parser and the ex command table on top of it.

### Task TE5c-1: VimPattern core -- magic levels, groups, alternation, quantifiers, backrefs, case, `~` (spec s6.5 rows 1-4, `\c \C`, `~`, `^ $`)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimPattern.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimPattern.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimPatternTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Utf8::Append` (TE1-1).
- Produces (contract names, plus the members marked *added*):
  - `struct VimPatternOptions { bool ignorecase, smartcase, ignoreSmartcase; std::string kClass, kClassNoDigits, lastSubstitute; }`
  - `enum class VimPositionKind { Line, Column, VirtualColumn, InVisual }`, `struct VimPositionPredicate { kind; value; std::uint32_t group; /* added: PCRE2 capture of its empty marker group */ }`
  - `struct TranslatedPattern { std::string pcre2; bool multiline; std::vector<VimPositionPredicate> predicates; std::vector<std::uint32_t> groups; /* added: user group k+1 -> PCRE2 capture number */ }`
  - `struct VimPatternError { std::string message; }`
  - `namespace VimPattern { std::expected<TranslatedPattern, VimPatternError> Translate(std::string_view, const VimPatternOptions&); bool HasUppercase(std::string_view); std::string EscapeForStar(std::string_view) /* TE5c-3 */; }`

The translator reads the pattern once. Every source item is first normalised to how it would be written under `\m` (the "magic-canonical" unit: a character plus "written with a backslash or not"), so one parser serves all four levels and `\v \m \M \V` switch the normalisation table from that point on. The output is self-contained: case (`(?i)`/`(?-i)`) and multi-line (`(?m)`) are prefixes, so the compile cache keys on the text alone. Position predicates (TE5c-3) are empty capture groups `()` whose offsets the search checks after PCRE2 returns, so user groups are renumbered through `groups` and `\1` becomes `\g{N}`.

In this task the class escapes, collections, `\_` items, `\z` items, `\@` lookarounds and every `\%` item but `\%(` take the documented-divergence error path (`E: unsupported pattern item ...`); TE5c-2 and TE5c-3 replace those six functions with their translations.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimPatternTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimPattern.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    std::string T(std::string_view p, const VimPatternOptions& o = {})
    {
        const auto r = VimPattern::Translate(p, o);
        INFO(std::string(p) << " -> " << (r ? r->pcre2 : r.error().message));
        REQUIRE(r.has_value());
        return r->pcre2;
    }

    std::string E(std::string_view p, const VimPatternOptions& o = {})
    {
        const auto r = VimPattern::Translate(p, o);
        INFO(std::string(p) << " -> " << (r ? r->pcre2 : std::string()));
        REQUIRE_FALSE(r.has_value());
        return r.error().message;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim pattern s6.5: magic \\( \\) \\| \\{n,m} \\+ \\? \\=", "[text-vim-pattern]")
{
    CHECK(T("\\(ab\\)\\|c") == "(ab)|c");
    CHECK(T("a\\{2,3}") == "a{2,3}");
    CHECK(T("a\\{2}") == "a{2}");
    CHECK(T("a\\{2,}") == "a{2,}");
    CHECK(T("a\\{,3}") == "a{0,3}");
    CHECK(T("a\\{}") == "a*");
    CHECK(T("a\\{2,3\\}") == "a{2,3}");                 // vim also accepts \} as the close
    CHECK(T("a\\+b\\?c\\=") == "a+b?c?");
    CHECK(T("a*.") == "a*.");
    CHECK(T("(a)|{}+?=") == "\\(a\\)\\|\\{\\}\\+\\?=");  // without the backslash they are literal
    CHECK(T("a\\.b\\*c\\[") == "a\\.b\\*c\\[");
}

TEST_CASE("vim pattern s6.5: non-greedy \\{-} forms", "[text-vim-pattern]")
{
    CHECK(T("a\\{-}") == "a*?");
    CHECK(T("a\\{-1,3}") == "a{1,3}?");
    CHECK(T("a\\{-2,}") == "a{2,}?");
    CHECK(T("a\\{-,4}") == "a{0,4}?");
    CHECK(T("a\\{-2}") == "a{2}");                      // exactly n: greedy and lazy are the same
}

TEST_CASE("vim pattern s6.5: \\%( \\) is a non-capturing group; user groups renumber", "[text-vim-pattern]")
{
    const auto r = VimPattern::Translate("\\%(ab\\)*\\(c\\)\\1", {});
    REQUIRE(r.has_value());
    CHECK(r->pcre2 == "(?:ab)*(c)\\g{1}");
    CHECK(r->groups == std::vector<std::uint32_t>{ 1 });
    CHECK_FALSE(r->multiline);
}

TEST_CASE("vim pattern s6.5: \\v \\m \\M \\V switch the table from that point on", "[text-vim-pattern]")
{
    CHECK(T("\\v(a|b)+c{2}") == "(a|b)+c{2}");
    CHECK(T("\\v\\(a\\)") == "\\(a\\)");               // escaped under \v = literal
    CHECK(T("\\Ma.b*") == "a\\.b\\*");
    CHECK(T("\\Ma\\.b\\*") == "a.b*");
    CHECK(T("\\Va.b*") == "a\\.b\\*");
    CHECK(T("\\Va\\.b\\*") == "a.b*");
    CHECK(T("a.\\Va.\\ma.") == "a.a\\.a.");
    CHECK(T("\\v(a)\\m(b)") == "(a)\\(b\\)");
}

TEST_CASE("vim pattern s6.5: ^ and $ are anchors only where vim says", "[text-vim-pattern]")
{
    CHECK(T("^a$") == "^a$");
    CHECK(T("a^b$c") == "a\\^b\\$c");
    CHECK(T("\\(^a\\|^b\\)$") == "(^a|^b)$");
    CHECK(T("a$\\|b") == "a$|b");
    CHECK(T("\\V^a$") == "\\^a\\$");
    CHECK(T("\\V\\^a\\$") == "^a$");
    CHECK(T("^*") == "^\\*");                            // a multi after ^ is literal
}

TEST_CASE("vim pattern: literals, escapes, backrefs and errors", "[text-vim-pattern]")
{
    CHECK(T("a/b\\/c") == "a/b/c");
    CHECK(T("\\\\") == "\\\\");
    CHECK(T("1+1") == "1\\+1");
    CHECK(T("caf\xC3\xA9") == "caf\xC3\xA9");
    CHECK(T("\\t\\e\\r\\b") == "\\t\\x1b\\r\\x08");
    CHECK(T("*a") == "\\*a");
    CHECK(E("\\(a\\)\\2").find("E65") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(E("\\(a").find("E54") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(E("a\\)").find("E55") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(E("a**").find("E61") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(E("\\+a").find("E64") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(E("a\\{x}").find("E554") != std::string::npos);
}

TEST_CASE("vim pattern s6.5: \\n routes to the multi-line path", "[text-vim-pattern]")
{
    const auto r = VimPattern::Translate("a\\nb", {});
    REQUIRE(r.has_value());
    CHECK(r->multiline);
    CHECK(r->pcre2 == "(?m)a\\nb");
}

TEST_CASE("vim pattern s6.5: \\c \\C anywhere decide case for the whole pattern; smartcase", "[text-vim-pattern]")
{
    VimPatternOptions ic;
    ic.ignorecase = true;
    VimPatternOptions scs = ic;
    scs.smartcase = true;
    VimPatternOptions star = scs;
    star.ignoreSmartcase = true;
    CHECK(T("fo\\co") == "(?i)foo");
    CHECK(T("\\Cfoo", ic) == "(?-i)foo");
    CHECK(T("foo", ic) == "(?i)foo");
    CHECK(T("foo") == "foo");
    CHECK(T("Foo", scs) == "Foo");
    CHECK(T("foo", scs) == "(?i)foo");
    CHECK(T("Foo", star) == "(?i)Foo");                 // * and # ignore smartcase, honour ignorecase
    CHECK(T("a\\Mb", scs) == "(?i)ab");                 // an escaped capital is not an upper-case letter
    CHECK(VimPattern::HasUppercase("aB"));
    CHECK_FALSE(VimPattern::HasUppercase("a\\Cb\\V"));
}

TEST_CASE("vim pattern s6.5: ~ is the escaped previous substitute string", "[text-vim-pattern]")
{
    VimPatternOptions o;
    o.lastSubstitute = "a.b";
    CHECK(T("x~", o) == "x(?:a\\.b)");
    CHECK(T("x\\~", o) == "x~");
    CHECK(T("\\M~", o) == "~");
    CHECK(T("\\M\\~", o) == "(?:a\\.b)");
    CHECK(T("~") == "(?:)");
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimPattern.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim patterns -> PCRE2 (spec s6.5). A pure function used by / ? * # :s :g :v
// and :sort /pat/. The output carries its own case and multi-line prefixes;
// position predicates (\%23l \%23c \%23v \%V) are empty marker groups checked
// after PCRE2 returns a candidate. Anything outside the s6.5 table is a
// documented divergence: "E: unsupported pattern item `...`".

#include <cstdint>
#include <expected>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimPatternOptions
    {
        bool ignorecase = false;
        bool smartcase = false;
        bool ignoreSmartcase = false;                       // * and # (spec s6.5)
        std::string kClass = "[0-9A-Z_a-z\\p{L}\\p{N}]";    // VimCharClass::PcreClass() of the document
        std::string kClassNoDigits = "[A-Z_a-z\\p{L}]";     // VimCharClass::PcreClassNoDigits()
        std::string lastSubstitute;                         // ~
    };

    enum class VimPositionKind : std::uint8_t { Line, Column, VirtualColumn, InVisual };

    struct VimPositionPredicate
    {
        VimPositionKind kind = VimPositionKind::Line;
        std::uint32_t value = 0;     // 1-based, as vim writes it
        std::uint32_t group = 0;     // the PCRE2 capture number of its empty marker group
        bool operator==(const VimPositionPredicate&) const = default;
    };

    struct TranslatedPattern
    {
        std::string pcre2;
        bool multiline = false;
        std::vector<VimPositionPredicate> predicates;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> groups;   // user group k+1 -> PCRE2 capture number
        bool operator==(const TranslatedPattern&) const = default;
    };

    struct VimPatternError
    {
        std::string message;
    };

    namespace VimPattern
    {
        [[nodiscard]] std::expected<TranslatedPattern, VimPatternError> Translate(std::string_view vimPattern, const VimPatternOptions& options);
        [[nodiscard]] bool HasUppercase(std::string_view vimPattern);   // smartcase: a capital outside a backslash item
        [[nodiscard]] std::string EscapeForStar(std::string_view word); // * / # (TE5c-3)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimPattern.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimPattern.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKey.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <optional>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Text::VimPattern
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("vim behaviour: at most nine \\( groups (E51)")
        constexpr std::size_t kMaxUserGroups = 9;

        enum class Magic : std::uint8_t { VeryMagic, Magic, NoMagic, VeryNoMagic };

        // One source item in MAGIC-canonical form: `esc` is how the item would be
        // written under \m (true = with a backslash).
        struct Unit
        {
            char32_t c = 0;
            bool esc = false;
            std::size_t len = 0;          // source bytes, backslash included
            bool levelSwitch = false;
            Magic level = Magic::Magic;
        };

        bool In(char32_t c, std::u32string_view set) { return set.find(c) != std::u32string_view::npos; }

        std::size_t DecodeAt(std::string_view s, std::size_t i, char32_t& cp)
        {
            const auto b0 = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]);
            std::size_t len = 0;
            if (b0 < 0x80) { cp = b0; return 1; }
            if ((b0 & 0xE0) == 0xC0) { len = 2; cp = b0 & 0x1F; }
            else if ((b0 & 0xF0) == 0xE0) { len = 3; cp = b0 & 0x0F; }
            else if ((b0 & 0xF8) == 0xF0) { len = 4; cp = b0 & 0x07; }
            else { cp = b0; return 1; }
            if (i + len > s.size()) { cp = b0; return 1; }
            for (std::size_t k = 1; k < len; ++k) cp = (cp << 6) | (static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i + k]) & 0x3F);
            return len;
        }

        void AppendLiteral(std::string& out, std::string_view bytes)
        {
            if (bytes.size() == 1 && std::string_view("\\^$.|?*+()[]{}").find(bytes[0]) != std::string_view::npos)
                out.push_back('\\');
            out.append(bytes);
        }

        std::string EscapedItem(char32_t c)
        {
            std::string s = "\\";
            Utf8::Append(s, c);
            return s;
        }

        VimPatternError Unsupported(std::string_view item)
        {
            return VimPatternError{ "E: unsupported pattern item `" + std::string(item) + "`" };
        }

        class Translator
        {
        public:
            Translator(std::string_view src, const VimPatternOptions& o) : m_src(src), m_opt(o) {}
            std::expected<TranslatedPattern, VimPatternError> Run();

        private:
            using Error = std::optional<VimPatternError>;
            [[nodiscard]] Unit Peek(std::size_t at) const;
            Error Plain(const Unit& u);
            Error Escaped(const Unit& u);
            void Atom(std::string_view text);
            void ZeroWidth(std::string_view text);
            Error Quantifier(std::string_view q, bool literalWhenAlone);
            Error OpenGroup(bool capturing);
            Error CloseGroup();
            void Alternation();
            Error Brace();
            Error Backref(char32_t digit);
            Error Percent();                                  // TE5c-3 completes
            Error Underscore();                               // TE5c-2
            Error Collection(bool withNewline);               // TE5c-2
            Error ClassEscape(char32_t c, bool withNewline);  // TE5c-2
            Error ZItem();                                    // TE5c-3
            Error Lookaround();                               // TE5c-3
            Error Predicate(VimPositionKind kind, std::uint32_t value);
            [[nodiscard]] bool DollarIsSpecial() const;

            std::string_view m_src;
            const VimPatternOptions& m_opt;
            std::size_t m_pos = 0;
            Magic m_level = Magic::Magic;
            std::string m_out;
            std::size_t m_atom = std::string::npos;   // where the last atom starts in m_out
            bool m_multiDone = false;                 // the last atom already has a multi
            bool m_branchStart = true;                // ^ is an anchor here
            std::vector<std::size_t> m_groupStarts;
            std::uint32_t m_pcreGroups = 0;
            std::vector<std::uint32_t> m_userGroups;
            int m_case = 0;                           // +1 \c, -1 \C
            bool m_multiline = false;
            bool m_topAlternation = false;
            bool m_zs = false;
            std::optional<std::size_t> m_ze;          // m_out offset of \ze
            std::vector<VimPositionPredicate> m_predicates;
        };

        Unit Translator::Peek(std::size_t at) const
        {
            Unit u;
            char32_t c = 0;
            const std::size_t l = DecodeAt(m_src, at, c);
            if (c == U'\\' && at + 1 < m_src.size())
            {
                char32_t d = 0;
                const std::size_t dl = DecodeAt(m_src, at + 1, d);
                u.c = d;
                u.len = 1 + dl;
                if (d == U'v' || d == U'm' || d == U'M' || d == U'V')
                {
                    u.levelSwitch = true;
                    u.level = d == U'v' ? Magic::VeryMagic : d == U'm' ? Magic::Magic : d == U'M' ? Magic::NoMagic : Magic::VeryNoMagic;
                    return u;
                }
                switch (m_level)
                {
                case Magic::VeryMagic:   u.esc = !In(d, U"()|{}+?=@%<>"); break;
                case Magic::Magic:       u.esc = true; break;
                case Magic::NoMagic:     u.esc = !In(d, U".*[~"); break;
                case Magic::VeryNoMagic: u.esc = !In(d, U".*[~^$"); break;
                }
                return u;
            }
            u.c = c;
            u.len = l;
            switch (m_level)
            {
            case Magic::VeryMagic:   u.esc = In(c, U"()|{}+?=@%<>"); break;
            case Magic::Magic:       u.esc = false; break;
            case Magic::NoMagic:     u.esc = In(c, U".*[~"); break;
            case Magic::VeryNoMagic: u.esc = In(c, U".*[~^$"); break;
            }
            return u;
        }

        void Translator::Atom(std::string_view text)
        {
            m_atom = m_out.size();
            m_out.append(text);
            m_multiDone = false;
            m_branchStart = false;
        }

        void Translator::ZeroWidth(std::string_view text)
        {
            m_out.append(text);
            m_atom = std::string::npos;
            m_multiDone = false;
            m_branchStart = false;
        }

        Translator::Error Translator::Quantifier(std::string_view q, bool literalWhenAlone)
        {
            if (m_atom == std::string::npos)
            {
                if (literalWhenAlone) { Atom("\\*"); return {}; }
                return VimPatternError{ "E64: " + std::string(q) + " follows nothing" };
            }
            if (m_multiDone) return VimPatternError{ "E61: Nested " + std::string(q) };
            m_out.append(q);
            m_multiDone = true;
            return {};
        }

        Translator::Error Translator::OpenGroup(bool capturing)
        {
            m_groupStarts.push_back(m_out.size());
            if (capturing)
            {
                if (m_userGroups.size() >= kMaxUserGroups) return VimPatternError{ "E51: Too many \\(" };
                m_userGroups.push_back(++m_pcreGroups);
                m_out += "(";
            }
            else
                m_out += "(?:";
            m_atom = std::string::npos;
            m_multiDone = false;
            m_branchStart = true;
            return {};
        }

        Translator::Error Translator::CloseGroup()
        {
            if (m_groupStarts.empty()) return VimPatternError{ "E55: Unmatched \\)" };
            const std::size_t start = m_groupStarts.back();
            m_groupStarts.pop_back();
            m_out += ")";
            m_atom = start;
            m_multiDone = false;
            m_branchStart = false;
            return {};
        }

        void Translator::Alternation()
        {
            m_out += "|";
            if (m_groupStarts.empty()) m_topAlternation = true;
            m_atom = std::string::npos;
            m_multiDone = false;
            m_branchStart = true;
        }

        Translator::Error Translator::Brace()
        {
            const std::size_t close = m_src.find('}', m_pos);
            if (close == std::string_view::npos) return VimPatternError{ "E554: Syntax error in \\{...}" };
            std::string_view body = m_src.substr(m_pos, close - m_pos);
            m_pos = close + 1;
            if (!body.empty() && body.back() == '\\') body.remove_suffix(1);
            bool lazy = false;
            if (!body.empty() && body.front() == '-') { lazy = true; body.remove_prefix(1); }
            std::size_t commas = 0;
            for (const char ch : body)
            {
                if (ch == ',') ++commas;
                else if (ch < '0' || ch > '9') return VimPatternError{ "E554: Syntax error in \\{...}" };
            }
            if (commas > 1) return VimPatternError{ "E554: Syntax error in \\{...}" };
            std::string q;
            bool exact = false;
            if (body.empty()) q = "*";
            else if (commas == 0) { q = "{" + std::string(body) + "}"; exact = true; }
            else
            {
                const std::size_t comma = body.find(',');
                const std::string_view lo = body.substr(0, comma), hi = body.substr(comma + 1);
                q = "{" + (lo.empty() ? std::string("0") : std::string(lo)) + "," + std::string(hi) + "}";
            }
            if (lazy && !exact) q += "?";
            return Quantifier(q, false);
        }

        Translator::Error Translator::Backref(char32_t digit)
        {
            const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(digit - U'0');
            if (n == 0 || n > m_userGroups.size()) return VimPatternError{ "E65: Illegal back reference" };
            Atom("\\g{" + std::to_string(m_userGroups[n - 1]) + "}");
            return {};
        }

        Translator::Error Translator::Predicate(VimPositionKind kind, std::uint32_t value)
        {
            m_predicates.push_back(VimPositionPredicate{ kind, value, ++m_pcreGroups });
            ZeroWidth("()");
            return {};
        }

        bool Translator::DollarIsSpecial() const
        {
            if (m_pos >= m_src.size()) return true;
            const Unit next = Peek(m_pos);
            return !next.levelSwitch && next.esc && (next.c == U'|' || next.c == U')' || next.c == U'n');
        }

        Translator::Error Translator::Plain(const Unit& u)
        {
            const std::string_view bytes = m_src.substr(m_pos - u.len, u.len);
            switch (u.c)
            {
            case U'^':
                if (m_branchStart) { ZeroWidth("^"); return {}; }
                break;
            case U'$':
                if (DollarIsSpecial()) { ZeroWidth("$"); return {}; }
                break;
            case U'.': Atom("."); return {};
            case U'*': return Quantifier("*", true);
            case U'[': return Collection(false);
            case U'~':
            {
                std::string lit;
                std::size_t i = 0;
                while (i < m_opt.lastSubstitute.size())
                {
                    char32_t cp = 0;
                    const std::size_t l = DecodeAt(m_opt.lastSubstitute, i, cp);
                    AppendLiteral(lit, std::string_view(m_opt.lastSubstitute).substr(i, l));
                    i += l;
                }
                Atom("(?:" + lit + ")");
                return {};
            }
            default: break;
            }
            std::string lit;
            AppendLiteral(lit, bytes);
            Atom(lit);
            return {};
        }

        Translator::Error Translator::Escaped(const Unit& u)
        {
            switch (u.c)
            {
            case U'(': return OpenGroup(true);
            case U')': return CloseGroup();
            case U'|': Alternation(); return {};
            case U'{': return Brace();
            case U'+': return Quantifier("+", false);
            case U'?':
            case U'=': return Quantifier("?", false);
            case U'<':
            case U'>': return ClassEscape(u.c, false);
            case U'@': return Lookaround();
            case U'%': return Percent();
            case U'_': return Underscore();
            case U'z': return ZItem();
            case U'n': m_multiline = true; Atom("\\n"); return {};
            case U't': Atom("\\t"); return {};
            case U'e': Atom("\\x1b"); return {};
            case U'r': Atom("\\r"); return {};
            case U'b': Atom("\\x08"); return {};
            case U'c': m_case = 1; return {};
            case U'C': m_case = -1; return {};
            case U'&': return Unsupported("\\&");
            default: break;
            }
            if (u.c >= U'1' && u.c <= U'9') return Backref(u.c);
            if (In(u.c, U"dDxXoOwWhHaAlLuUsSkKiI")) return ClassEscape(u.c, false);
            if ((u.c >= U'a' && u.c <= U'z') || (u.c >= U'A' && u.c <= U'Z') || u.c == U'0') return Unsupported(EscapedItem(u.c));
            // an escaped non-letter is that character (\/ \\ \. \* \[ \~ \^ \$ ...)
            std::string lit;
            AppendLiteral(lit, m_src.substr(m_pos - u.len + 1, u.len - 1));
            Atom(lit);
            return {};
        }

        // ---- the items TE5c-2 / TE5c-3 translate; until then they are reported as unsupported ----
        Translator::Error Translator::Percent()
        {
            if (m_pos < m_src.size() && m_src[m_pos] == '(') { ++m_pos; return OpenGroup(false); }
            return Unsupported("\\%");
        }
        Translator::Error Translator::Underscore() { return Unsupported("\\_"); }
        Translator::Error Translator::Collection(bool) { return Unsupported("[...]"); }
        Translator::Error Translator::ClassEscape(char32_t c, bool) { return Unsupported(EscapedItem(c)); }
        Translator::Error Translator::ZItem() { return Unsupported("\\z"); }
        Translator::Error Translator::Lookaround() { return Unsupported("\\@"); }

        std::expected<TranslatedPattern, VimPatternError> Translator::Run()
        {
            while (m_pos < m_src.size())
            {
                const Unit u = Peek(m_pos);
                m_pos += u.len;
                if (u.levelSwitch) { m_level = u.level; continue; }
                const Error e = u.esc ? Escaped(u) : Plain(u);
                if (e) return std::unexpected(*e);
            }
            if (!m_groupStarts.empty()) return std::unexpected(VimPatternError{ "E54: Unmatched \\(" });
            if ((m_zs || m_ze) && m_topAlternation)
                return std::unexpected(VimPatternError{ "E: unsupported pattern item `\\zs`/`\\ze` in a pattern with a top-level \\| (spec s6.5: top level only)" });
            std::string body = m_out;
            if (m_ze) body = body.substr(0, *m_ze) + "(?=" + body.substr(*m_ze) + ")";
            std::string prefix = m_multiline ? "(?m)" : "";
            if (m_case > 0) prefix += "(?i)";
            else if (m_case < 0) prefix += "(?-i)";
            else if (m_opt.ignorecase && !(m_opt.smartcase && !m_opt.ignoreSmartcase && HasUppercase(m_src))) prefix += "(?i)";
            TranslatedPattern t;
            t.pcre2 = prefix + body;
            t.multiline = m_multiline;
            t.predicates = m_predicates;
            t.groups = m_userGroups;
            return t;
        }
    }

    bool HasUppercase(std::string_view p)
    {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (p[i] == '\\') { ++i; continue; }
            if (p[i] >= 'A' && p[i] <= 'Z') return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    std::string EscapeForStar(std::string_view word)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const char ch : word)
        {
            if (std::string_view("\\/.*$^~[").find(ch) != std::string_view::npos) out.push_back('\\');
            out.push_back(ch);
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::expected<TranslatedPattern, VimPatternError> Translate(std::string_view vimPattern, const VimPatternOptions& options)
    {
        Translator t(vimPattern, options);
        return t.Run();
    }
}
```

(`EscapeForStar` is defined here already because it is one line; its test arrives with its first user in TE5c-3.)

**Files:**

- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimPatternClassesTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE5c-1 `Translator`; `VimCharClass::PcreClass/PcreClassNoDigits` (TE5a-3) as the source of `VimPatternOptions::kClass/kClassNoDigits`; TE3 `Regex::Compile(std::string_view, RegexOptions) -> std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const Regex>, RegexError>`, `MatchScratch` (`Match`, `Group(0, b, e)`), `RegexLimits`, `MatchStatus` (to prove `\<` against a non-`\w` word character; the test owns a local `MatchScratch`, it has no `VimGlobals`).
- Produces: the translations below (no new names).

`[K]` is the document's word class (grammar `wordChars` + `\p{L}\p{N}`), never PCRE's `\w`. A negated class never matches the line break (vim's `\D` does not match end-of-line), so it is emitted as `[^...\n]`; the `\_` form adds the break (`[...\n]` / `[^...]`) and routes the pattern to the multi-line path.

```cpp
        std::string WithNewline(std::string_view cls)
```

```cpp
        Translator::Error Translator::ClassEscape(char32_t c, bool withNewline)
        {
            const auto cls = [&](std::string_view body, bool negated) {
                if (negated) Atom("[^" + std::string(body) + (withNewline ? "" : "\\n") + "]");
                else         Atom("[" + std::string(body) + (withNewline ? "\\n" : "") + "]");
            };
            switch (c)
            {
            case U'd': cls("0-9", false); break;           case U'D': cls("0-9", true); break;
            case U'x': cls("0-9A-Fa-f", false); break;     case U'X': cls("0-9A-Fa-f", true); break;
            case U'o': cls("0-7", false); break;           case U'O': cls("0-7", true); break;
            case U'w': cls("0-9A-Za-z_", false); break;    case U'W': cls("0-9A-Za-z_", true); break;
            case U'h': cls("A-Za-z_", false); break;       case U'H': cls("A-Za-z_", true); break;
            case U'a': cls("A-Za-z", false); break;        case U'A': cls("A-Za-z", true); break;
            case U'l': cls("a-z", false); break;           case U'L': cls("a-z", true); break;
            case U'u': cls("A-Z", false); break;           case U'U': cls("A-Z", true); break;
            case U's': cls(" \\t", false); break;          case U'S': cls(" \\t", true); break;
            case U'k':
            case U'i': Atom(withNewline ? WithNewline(m_opt.kClass) : m_opt.kClass); break;
            case U'K':
            case U'I': Atom(withNewline ? WithNewline(m_opt.kClassNoDigits) : m_opt.kClassNoDigits); break;
            case U'<':
                if (withNewline) return Unsupported("\\_<");
                ZeroWidth("(?<!" + m_opt.kClass + ")(?=" + m_opt.kClass + ")");
                return {};
            case U'>':
                if (withNewline) return Unsupported("\\_>");
                ZeroWidth("(?<=" + m_opt.kClass + ")(?!" + m_opt.kClass + ")");
                return {};
            default:
                return Unsupported(EscapedItem(c));
            }
            if (withNewline) m_multiline = true;
            return {};
        }

        Translator::Error Translator::Collection(bool withNewline)
        {
            const std::size_t n = m_src.size();
            std::size_t i = m_pos;
            std::string body;
            bool negated = false, newline = withNewline, closed = false;
            if (i < n && m_src[i] == '^') { negated = true; ++i; }
            if (i < n && m_src[i] == ']') { body += "\\]"; ++i; }
            while (i < n)
            {
                const char ch = m_src[i];
                if (ch == ']') { closed = true; ++i; break; }
                if (ch == '[' && i + 1 < n && (m_src[i + 1] == ':' || m_src[i + 1] == '=' || m_src[i + 1] == '.'))
                {
                    const char kind = m_src[i + 1];
                    const std::size_t end = m_src.find(std::string{ kind, ']' }, i + 2);
                    if (end == std::string_view::npos) { body += "\\["; ++i; continue; }
                    const std::string name(m_src.substr(i + 2, end - i - 2));
                    if (kind == '=') return Unsupported("[[=" + name + "=]]");
                    if (kind == '.') return Unsupported("[[." + name + ".]]");
                    static constexpr std::string_view kPosix[] = { "alnum", "alpha", "blank", "cntrl", "digit", "graph",
                                                                   "lower", "print", "punct", "space", "upper", "xdigit" };
                    bool posix = false;
                    for (const std::string_view p : kPosix) posix = posix || p == name;
                    if (posix) body += "[:" + name + ":]";
                    else if (name == "return") body += "\\r";
                    else if (name == "tab") body += "\\t";
                    else if (name == "escape") body += "\\x1b";
                    else if (name == "backspace") body += "\\x08";
                    else if (name == "ident" || name == "keyword") body += m_opt.kClass.substr(1, m_opt.kClass.size() - 2);
                    else return Unsupported("[:" + name + ":]");
                    i = end + 2;
                    continue;
                }
                if (ch == '\\' && i + 1 < n)
                {
                    const char e = m_src[i + 1];
                    switch (e)
                    {
                    case 'e':  body += "\\x1b"; i += 2; continue;
                    case 't':  body += "\\t"; i += 2; continue;
                    case 'r':  body += "\\r"; i += 2; continue;
                    case 'b':  body += "\\x08"; i += 2; continue;
                    case 'n':  body += "\\n"; newline = true; i += 2; continue;
                    case '\\': body += "\\\\"; i += 2; continue;
                    case ']':  body += "\\]"; i += 2; continue;
                    case '^':  body += "\\^"; i += 2; continue;
                    case '-':  body += "\\-"; i += 2; continue;
                    case 'd': case 'o': case 'x': case 'u': case 'U':
                        return Unsupported(std::string("[\\") + e + "...]");            // code-point items: divergence
                    default:   body += "\\\\"; ++i; continue;                          // a literal backslash, then the char
                    }
                }
                if (ch == '[') { body += "\\["; ++i; continue; }
                body += ch;
                ++i;
            }
            if (!closed) { Atom("\\["); return {}; }                                    // vim: an unclosed [ is literal
            m_pos = i;
            if (negated) Atom("[^" + body + (newline ? "" : "\\n") + "]");
            else         Atom("[" + body + (newline ? "\\n" : "") + "]");
            if (newline) m_multiline = true;
            return {};
        }

        Translator::Error Translator::Underscore()
        {
            if (m_pos >= m_src.size()) return Unsupported("\\_");
            const char ch = m_src[m_pos];
            if (ch == '[') { ++m_pos; return Collection(true); }
            if (ch == '.') { ++m_pos; m_multiline = true; Atom("(?s:.)"); return {}; }
            if (ch == '^') { ++m_pos; ZeroWidth("^"); return {}; }
            if (ch == '$') { ++m_pos; ZeroWidth("$"); return {}; }
            if (std::string_view("dDxXoOwWhHaAlLuUsSkKiI<>").find(ch) != std::string_view::npos)
            {
                ++m_pos;
                return ClassEscape(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch), true);
            }
            return Unsupported(std::string("\\_") + ch);
        }
```

`kPosix` holds only string views (no numeric literal), so ConstantGuardTest does not flag it.

### Task TE5c-3: VimPattern positions -- `\zs \ze`, `\%^ \%$`, `^ $` per path, `\%V \%23l \%23c \%23v`, `\@` lookarounds, the divergence list (spec s6.5 rows 10, 13-16, divergences)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimPattern.cpp` (replace the TE5c-1 bodies of `Translator::Percent`, `Translator::ZItem`, `Translator::Lookaround`; add includes)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimPatternPositionsTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE5c-1 `Translator`, `Predicate`, `m_ze/m_zs/m_topAlternation` and the `Run` check that rejects `\zs`/`\ze` beside a top-level `\|`.
- Produces: the translations below; `VimPattern::EscapeForStar` (written in TE5c-1) now tested.

`\zs` becomes PCRE2's `\K` emitted at the top level only (never inside a lookaround, so `PCRE2_EXTRA_ALLOW_LOOKAROUND_BSK` is never needed); `\ze` wraps the rest of the top-level pattern in `(?=...)`. Either inside a group, or in a pattern with a top-level `\|`, is the documented divergence with its error. `\%^`/`\%$` force the multi-line path, where `\A`/`\z` mean start/end of file; the line path never sees them, so `\A` can never match at every line. On the multi-line path the `(?m)` prefix keeps `^`/`$` per line; on the line path the subject is the line, so they are exact without it.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("vim pattern: the PCRE-expressible \\@ lookarounds", "[text-vim-pattern]")
{
    CHECK(T("\\(foo\\)\\@=") == "(?=(foo))");

    CHECK(T("\\(x\\)\\@<=y") == "(?<=(x))y");
    CHECK(T("x\\@<!y") == "(?<!x)y");
    CHECK(T("\\(ab\\)\\@>") == "(?>(ab))");
    CHECK(T("x\\@2<=y") == "(?<=x)y");

    CHECK(E("\\@=a").find("E64") != std::string::npos);
```

```cpp
        Translator::Error Translator::Percent()
        {
            const std::size_t n = m_src.size();
            if (m_pos >= n) return Unsupported("\\%");
            const char ch = m_src[m_pos];
            switch (ch)
            {
            case '(': ++m_pos; return OpenGroup(false);
            case '^': ++m_pos; m_multiline = true; ZeroWidth("\\A"); return {};
            case '$': ++m_pos; m_multiline = true; ZeroWidth("\\z"); return {};
            case 'V': ++m_pos; return Predicate(VimPositionKind::InVisual, 0);
            case '[': return Unsupported("\\%[...]");
            case 'd': case 'x': case 'o': case 'u': case 'U':
            {
                std::size_t end = m_pos + 1;
                while (end < n && std::isxdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(m_src[end]))) ++end;
                return Unsupported("\\%" + std::string(m_src.substr(m_pos, end - m_pos)));   // code-point items
            }
            default: break;
            }
            if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9')
            {
                std::uint64_t value = 0;
                std::size_t end = m_pos;
                while (end < n && m_src[end] >= '0' && m_src[end] <= '9')
                {
                    value = std::min<std::uint64_t>(value * 10 + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(m_src[end] - '0'), UINT32_MAX);
                    ++end;
                }
                if (end < n && (m_src[end] == 'l' || m_src[end] == 'c' || m_src[end] == 'v'))
                {
                    const char kind = m_src[end];
                    m_pos = end + 1;
                    return Predicate(kind == 'l' ? VimPositionKind::Line : kind == 'c' ? VimPositionKind::Column : VimPositionKind::VirtualColumn,
                                     static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value));
                }
                return Unsupported("\\%" + std::string(m_src.substr(m_pos, end - m_pos + (end < n ? 1 : 0))));
            }
            return Unsupported("\\%" + std::string(1, ch));     // \%# \%' \%< \%> ...: outside the s6.5 table
        }

        Translator::Error Translator::ZItem()
        {
            if (m_pos >= m_src.size()) return Unsupported("\\z");
            const char ch = m_src[m_pos++];
            if (ch != 's' && ch != 'e') return Unsupported(std::string("\\z") + ch);
            const std::string item = ch == 's' ? "\\zs" : "\\ze";
            if (!m_groupStarts.empty())
                return VimPatternError{ "E: unsupported pattern item `" + item + "` inside a group (spec s6.5: top level only)" };
            if (m_ze) return VimPatternError{ "E: unsupported pattern item `" + item + "` after \\ze" };
            if (ch == 's') { m_zs = true; ZeroWidth("\\K"); }
            else { m_ze = m_out.size(); m_atom = std::string::npos; m_multiDone = false; }
            return {};
        }

        Translator::Error Translator::Lookaround()
        {
            const std::size_t n = m_src.size();
            std::size_t i = m_pos;
            while (i < n && m_src[i] >= '0' && m_src[i] <= '9') ++i;     // \@123<=: PCRE2 needs no byte limit
            const std::string_view rest = m_src.substr(i);
            std::string open;
            std::size_t take = 0;
            if (rest.starts_with("<="))      { open = "(?<="; take = 2; }
            else if (rest.starts_with("<!")) { open = "(?<!"; take = 2; }
            else if (rest.starts_with("="))  { open = "(?=";  take = 1; }
            else if (rest.starts_with("!"))  { open = "(?!";  take = 1; }
            else if (rest.starts_with(">"))  { open = "(?>";  take = 1; }
            else return Unsupported("\\@" + std::string(rest.substr(0, rest.empty() ? 0 : 1)));
            if (m_atom == std::string::npos) return VimPatternError{ "E64: \\@ follows nothing" };
            m_pos = i + take;
            m_out.insert(m_atom, open);
            m_out += ")";
            if (open == "(?>") m_multiDone = false;               // an atomic group is still an atom
            else { m_atom = std::string::npos; m_multiDone = false; }
            return {};
        }
```

A lookbehind PCRE2 cannot compile (an unbounded `\(a*\)\@<=`) fails at compile time; `VimPatternCache::Get` (TE5c-4) reports it as `E: unsupported pattern item ...` with PCRE2's reason -- the "beyond the PCRE-expressible subset" divergence of s6.5.

### Task TE5c-4: VimSearch -- line path, multi-line path, predicates, limits, wrapscan, the per-document pattern cache (spec s4.2, s6.5)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSearch.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSearch.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobals.hpp` (VimBufferState gains the pattern cache)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimSearchTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE3-2 `Regex::Compile(std::string_view, RegexOptions) -> std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const Regex>, RegexError>` (`RegexError::message`), `MatchScratch` (`Match`, `Group(i, b, e)`, group 0 = the whole match), `MatchStatus`, `RegexLimits` (the chunk's Consumed block); `VimGlobals::scratch` (the one vim `MatchScratch`, TE5a-13) -- callers pass it in `VimSearchEnv::scratch`; `TranslatedPattern` (TE5c-1); `VimText::Line/RowOf/VirtualColumn` (TE5a-2); `Rope::ToString/LineStart/LineEnd/LineCount/OffsetToPoint`.
- Produces:
  - `class VimCompiledPattern { VimCompiledPattern(TranslatedPattern, std::shared_ptr<const Regex>); Pattern(); Re() -> const Regex&; }`, `using VimPatternHandle = std::shared_ptr<const VimCompiledPattern>`
  - `class VimPatternCache { std::expected<VimPatternHandle, std::string> Get(const TranslatedPattern&); void Clear(); std::size_t Size() const; }`
  - `struct VimSearchMatch { ByteRange range; std::vector<std::optional<ByteRange>> groups; }` (user group k+1 at [k])
  - `enum class VimSearchStatus { Found, NotFound, LimitHit, TooLarge, Error }`
  - `struct VimSearchEnv { const Rope& rope; MatchScratch& scratch; std::uint64_t multilineMaxBytes; std::uint32_t tabSize; std::optional<ByteRange> visualArea; }` (`scratch` is the caller's: `VimGlobals::scratch` in vim, a local `MatchScratch{ RegexLimits{} }` in pure tests)
  - `struct VimFindResult { status; match; wrapped; }`, `struct VimFindAllResult { status; matches; }`
  - `VimFindAllResult VimFindAll(const VimSearchEnv&, const VimCompiledPattern&, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow)`
  - `VimFindResult VimFindNext(const VimSearchEnv&, const VimCompiledPattern&, ByteOffset from, bool forward, bool wrapscan)`
  - `std::string VimSearchMessage(VimSearchStatus, std::string_view vimPattern, bool forward, bool wrapscan)`
  - `VimBufferState::patterns` (a `VimPatternCache`; patterns are compiled once per distinct translated text + predicates and cached per document as `std::shared_ptr<const Regex>`, spec s6.5).

Every match runs through the ONE `MatchScratch` the caller hands in (`VimSearchEnv::scratch` = `VimGlobals::scratch`, whose limits the editor sets from `ToSyntaxLimits(Settings<TextSettings>()).regex`; pure vim code never reads settings). Single-line patterns run row by row on a copy of the row (the subject is the line, so `^`/`$` are exact without `MatchFlags::NotBol/NotEol`). Patterns that can span lines run once against a materialized copy of the whole text, refused above `editor.text.multilineSearchMaxMB` (`VimOptions::multilineSearchMaxBytes`). A PCRE2 limit hit stops the search and reports it (spec s4.2: "a find or :s pattern that hits it stops and says so in the vim message line"). Predicates are checked on each candidate at their marker group's offset; a rejected candidate resumes one character later. Note: vim's line path copies the whole row; rows past `longLineMaxBytes` are searched whole, not in windows (the windowed matching of s4.2 is TE4's find-bar concern; vim correctness wins here and the row copy is linear).

```cpp
TEST_CASE("vim search: the line path forward, backward and around the end", "[text-vim-search]")
{
    const Rope r = Rope::FromUtf8("foo bar\nbar foo");
    MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{} };
    VimPatternCache cache;
    const VimPatternHandle p = Compile(cache, "bar");
    const VimSearchEnv env{ r, scratch };
    VimFindResult f = VimFindNext(env, *p, 0, true, true);
    REQUIRE(f.status == VimSearchStatus::Found);
    CHECK(f.match.range.begin == 4u);
    CHECK_FALSE(f.wrapped);
    f = VimFindNext(env, *p, 4, true, true);
    CHECK(f.match.range.begin == 8u);
    f = VimFindNext(env, *p, 8, true, true);
    CHECK(f.match.range.begin == 4u);
    CHECK(f.wrapped);
    CHECK(VimFindNext(env, *p, 8, true, false).status == VimSearchStatus::NotFound);
    f = VimFindNext(env, *p, 8, false, true);
    CHECK(f.match.range.begin == 4u);
    f = VimFindNext(env, *p, 4, false, true);
    CHECK(f.match.range.begin == 8u);
    CHECK(f.wrapped);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSearch.hpp
#pragma once

// Running translated vim patterns over a document (spec s4.2, s6.5). The line
// path copies one row into the subject; patterns that can span lines run on a
// materialized copy of the text, refused above multilineSearchMaxMB. Every
// match goes through the caller's MatchScratch (VimGlobals::scratch: one per
// thread, limits set by the editor). Compiled patterns are cached per
// document by their translated text.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimPattern.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <expected>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    class VimCompiledPattern
    {
    public:
        VimCompiledPattern(TranslatedPattern pattern, std::shared_ptr<const Regex> regex)
            : m_pattern(std::move(pattern)), m_regex(std::move(regex)) {}
        [[nodiscard]] const TranslatedPattern& Pattern() const { return m_pattern; }
        [[nodiscard]] const Regex& Re() const { return *m_regex; }

    private:
        TranslatedPattern m_pattern;
        std::shared_ptr<const Regex> m_regex;   // never null: Get only builds a pattern from a successful Compile
    };

    using VimPatternHandle = std::shared_ptr<const VimCompiledPattern>;

    class VimPatternCache
    {
    public:
        [[nodiscard]] std::expected<VimPatternHandle, std::string> Get(const TranslatedPattern& pattern);
        void Clear() { m_byKey.clear(); }
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t Size() const { return m_byKey.size(); }

    private:
        std::unordered_map<std::string, VimPatternHandle> m_byKey;
    };

    struct VimSearchMatch
    {
        ByteRange range;
        std::vector<std::optional<ByteRange>> groups;   // user group k+1 at [k]
    };

    enum class VimSearchStatus : std::uint8_t { Found, NotFound, LimitHit, TooLarge, Error };

    struct VimSearchEnv
    {
        const Rope& rope;
        MatchScratch& scratch;                          // VimGlobals::scratch (TE5a-13); every Match goes through it
        std::uint64_t multilineMaxBytes = 64ull << 20;  // VimOptions::multilineSearchMaxBytes
        std::uint32_t tabSize = 4;
        std::optional<ByteRange> visualArea;            // \%V: the last Visual area
    };

    struct VimFindResult
    {
        VimSearchStatus status = VimSearchStatus::NotFound;
        VimSearchMatch match;
        bool wrapped = false;
    };

    struct VimFindAllResult
    {
        VimSearchStatus status = VimSearchStatus::Found;
        std::vector<VimSearchMatch> matches;            // non-overlapping, ascending
    };

    // Every match whose start lies on rows [firstRow, lastRow].
    [[nodiscard]] VimFindAllResult VimFindAll(const VimSearchEnv& env, const VimCompiledPattern& pattern,
                                              std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow);
    // The next match strictly after `from` (forward) or strictly before it (backward), wrapping when allowed.
    [[nodiscard]] VimFindResult VimFindNext(const VimSearchEnv& env, const VimCompiledPattern& pattern,
                                            ByteOffset from, bool forward, bool wrapscan);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string VimSearchMessage(VimSearchStatus status, std::string_view vimPattern, bool forward, bool wrapscan);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSearch.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimSearch.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        std::size_t NextUtf8(std::string_view s, std::size_t i)
        {
            if (i >= s.size()) return s.size() + 1;
            ++i;
            while (i < s.size() && (static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]) & 0xC0) == 0x80) ++i;
            return i;
        }

        // Reads the marker groups of env.scratch's last successful Match.
        bool PredicatesHold(const VimSearchEnv& env, const TranslatedPattern& t, ByteOffset base)
        {
            for (const VimPositionPredicate& p : t.predicates)
            {
                std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
                if (!env.scratch.Group(p.group, b, e)) return false;   // p.group is the PCRE2 capture of the empty marker
                const ByteOffset at = base + b;
                const Point pt = env.rope.OffsetToPoint(at);
                switch (p.kind)
                {
                case VimPositionKind::Line:          if (pt.row + 1 != p.value) return false; break;
                case VimPositionKind::Column:        if (pt.col + 1 != p.value) return false; break;
                case VimPositionKind::VirtualColumn: if (VimText::VirtualColumn(env.rope, at, env.tabSize) + 1 != p.value) return false; break;
                case VimPositionKind::InVisual:
                    if (!env.visualArea || at < env.visualArea->begin || at >= env.visualArea->end) return false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        // Copies the whole match and the user groups (t.groups: user group k+1 -> PCRE2 capture) of
        // env.scratch's last successful Match; `whole` is its group 0.
        VimSearchMatch ToMatch(const VimSearchEnv& env, const TranslatedPattern& t, ByteRange whole, ByteOffset base)
        {
            VimSearchMatch out;
            out.range = ByteRange{ base + whole.begin, base + whole.end };
            for (const std::uint32_t g : t.groups)
            {
                std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
                if (env.scratch.Group(g, b, e)) out.groups.push_back(ByteRange{ base + b, base + e });
                else out.groups.push_back(std::nullopt);   // the group did not participate
            }
            return out;
        }

        // Matches in `subject` (which sits at buffer offset `base`) starting in [startMin, startMax].
        VimSearchStatus Scan(const VimSearchEnv& env, const VimCompiledPattern& p, std::string_view subject, ByteOffset base,
                             std::size_t startMin, std::size_t startMax, std::vector<VimSearchMatch>& out)
        {
            std::size_t pos = startMin;
            while (pos <= subject.size() && pos <= startMax)
            {
                const MatchStatus r = env.scratch.Match(p.Re(), subject, pos);
                if (r == MatchStatus::LimitHit) return VimSearchStatus::LimitHit;
                if (r == MatchStatus::Error) return VimSearchStatus::Error;
                if (r == MatchStatus::NoMatch) break;
                std::size_t wb = 0, we = 0;
                if (!env.scratch.Group(0, wb, we)) return VimSearchStatus::Error;   // group 0 is always set on a Match
                if (wb > startMax) break;
                if (!PredicatesHold(env, p.Pattern(), base)) { pos = NextUtf8(subject, wb); continue; }
                out.push_back(ToMatch(env, p.Pattern(), ByteRange{ wb, we }, base));
                pos = we > wb ? we : NextUtf8(subject, we);
            }
            return VimSearchStatus::Found;
        }

        VimFindResult Picked(const VimSearchMatch& m, bool wrapped)
        {
            VimFindResult r;
            r.status = VimSearchStatus::Found;
            r.match = m;
            r.wrapped = wrapped;
            return r;
        }
    }

    std::expected<VimPatternHandle, std::string> VimPatternCache::Get(const TranslatedPattern& pattern)
    {
        std::string key = pattern.pcre2;
        for (const VimPositionPredicate& p : pattern.predicates)
            key += "|" + std::to_string(static_cast<int>(p.kind)) + ":" + std::to_string(p.value) + ":" + std::to_string(p.group);
        if (const auto it = m_byKey.find(key); it != m_byKey.end()) return it->second;
        // Case and multi-line live in the translated text's (?i)/(?m) prefixes, so no RegexOptions are needed.
        std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const Regex>, RegexError> re = Regex::Compile(pattern.pcre2);
        if (!re) return std::unexpected("E: unsupported pattern item (PCRE2: " + re.error().message + ")");
        VimPatternHandle h = std::make_shared<const VimCompiledPattern>(pattern, std::move(*re));
        m_byKey.emplace(std::move(key), h);
        return h;
    }

    VimFindAllResult VimFindAll(const VimSearchEnv& env, const VimCompiledPattern& p, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow)
    {
        VimFindAllResult out;
        const Rope& r = env.rope;
        lastRow = std::min(lastRow, r.LineCount() - 1);
        if (firstRow > lastRow) return out;
        if (p.Pattern().multiline)
        {
            if (r.Size() > env.multilineMaxBytes) { out.status = VimSearchStatus::TooLarge; return out; }
            const std::string all = r.ToString();
            out.status = Scan(env, p, all, 0, r.LineStart(firstRow), r.LineEnd(lastRow), out.matches);
            return out;
        }
        for (std::uint32_t row = firstRow; row <= lastRow; ++row)
        {
            const std::string line = VimText::Line(r, row);
            const VimSearchStatus s = Scan(env, p, line, r.LineStart(row), 0, line.size(), out.matches);
            if (s != VimSearchStatus::Found) { out.status = s; return out; }
        }
        return out;
    }

    VimFindResult VimFindNext(const VimSearchEnv& env, const VimCompiledPattern& p, ByteOffset from, bool forward, bool wrapscan)
    {
        VimFindResult res;
        const Rope& r = env.rope;
        const std::uint32_t rows = r.LineCount();
        if (p.Pattern().multiline)
        {
            const VimFindAllResult all = VimFindAll(env, p, 0, rows - 1);
            if (all.status != VimSearchStatus::Found) { res.status = all.status; return res; }
            if (forward)
            {
                for (const VimSearchMatch& m : all.matches) if (m.range.begin > from) return Picked(m, false);
                if (wrapscan && !all.matches.empty()) return Picked(all.matches.front(), true);
            }
            else
            {
                for (auto it = all.matches.rbegin(); it != all.matches.rend(); ++it) if (it->range.begin < from) return Picked(*it, false);
                if (wrapscan && !all.matches.empty()) return Picked(all.matches.back(), true);
            }
            return res;
        }
        const std::uint32_t fromRow = VimText::RowOf(r, from);
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i <= rows; ++i)
        {
            const bool wrapped = forward ? fromRow + i >= rows : i > fromRow;
            if (wrapped && !wrapscan) break;
            const std::uint32_t row = forward ? (fromRow + i) % rows : (fromRow + rows - (i % rows)) % rows;
            const VimFindAllResult rowAll = VimFindAll(env, p, row, row);
            if (rowAll.status != VimSearchStatus::Found) { res.status = rowAll.status; return res; }
            const auto accept = [&](const VimSearchMatch& m) {
                if (i == 0) return forward ? m.range.begin > from : m.range.begin < from;
                if (i == rows) return forward ? m.range.begin <= from : m.range.begin >= from;
                return true;
            };
            if (forward)
            {
                for (const VimSearchMatch& m : rowAll.matches) if (accept(m)) return Picked(m, wrapped);
            }
            else
            {
                for (auto it = rowAll.matches.rbegin(); it != rowAll.matches.rend(); ++it) if (accept(*it)) return Picked(*it, wrapped);
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    std::string VimSearchMessage(VimSearchStatus status, std::string_view vimPattern, bool forward, bool wrapscan)
    {
        const std::string pat(vimPattern);
        switch (status)
        {
        case VimSearchStatus::Found:    return {};
        case VimSearchStatus::NotFound:
            if (!wrapscan) return (forward ? "E385: Search hit BOTTOM without match for: " : "E384: Search hit TOP without match for: ") + pat;
            return "E486: Pattern not found: " + pat;
        case VimSearchStatus::LimitHit:
            return "E: the pattern hit editor.text.regexMatchLimit / regexDepthLimit and stopped: " + pat;
        case VimSearchStatus::TooLarge:
            return "E: the pattern spans lines and the file is larger than editor.text.multilineSearchMaxMB: " + pat;
        case VimSearchStatus::Error:    return "E: pattern error: " + pat;
        }
        return {};
    }
}
```

**Files:**

- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.cpp` (Part A, TE5a-8: `ResolveMotion` cases)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimSearchCommandsTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimMotionArgs`, `VimMotionTarget`, `ResolveMotion` (TE5a-8); `VimRegisters::SetSpecial/Get` (TE5a-12); `VimBufferState::marks` (`VimMarks::Get`), `lastVisualMode`, `hasLastVisual` (TE5b-6); `VimState::ExecuteMotion/ExecuteOperator` (TE5a-8/12, reached through `Execute`); `VimPattern`, `VimSearch` (TE5c-1..4); `VimGlobals::scratch` (the vim `MatchScratch`, TE5a-13; `VimSearchEnvFor` hands it to `VimSearchEnv::scratch`); `VimCharClass::IsWord/PcreClass/PcreClassNoDigits`; `Utf8::DecodeAt` (TE1-1); `IVimHost::SetSearchHighlight(std::string_view pcre2)` (TE5a-5; vim's own host hook -- the adapter paints it with its `SearchHighlightOverlay`, CANON B19).
- Produces:
  - `struct VimSearchState { std::string lastPattern; bool lastForward = true; bool highlight = false; std::string lastSubPattern, lastSubReplacement, lastSubFlags; bool lastNoSmartcase = false; /* added */ }`; `VimGlobals::search`, `VimGlobals::searchHistory`, `VimGlobals::commandHistory` (contract names).
  - `VimSearchCommands.hpp`: `kVimHistoryMax`, `VimPatternOptionsFor`, `VimSearchEnvFor`, `VimLastVisualArea`, `VimCompileForContext`, `VimWordForStar`, `VimStarPattern`, `ResolveSearchMotion`, `VimPushHistory`.
  - `VimState` (private): `enum class CmdLineKind { Ex, SearchForward, SearchBackward, SubstituteConfirm }`, `struct CommandLine`, `m_cmdline`, `HandleCommandLine`, `BeginSearchCommandLine`, `EnterCommandLine`, `LeaveCommandLine`, `SubmitCommandLine`, `SubmitSearch`, `ShowCommandLine`, `UpdateIncrementalSearch`, `BrowseHistory`.

`/` and `?` are the parser's `SearchFwd`/`SearchBack` motions; `Execute` intercepts them and opens the command line with the parsed command (count, register, pending operator) waiting. Enter stores the pattern as the last search pattern and direction, then executes that same command as `SearchNext` -- so `d/foo<CR>`, `v/foo<CR>` and `3/foo<CR>` all go through Part A's motion/operator paths unchanged, and the typed command-line keys are appended to `VimParsed::keys` for dot-repeat. `*`/`#` take the keyword under or after the cursor (else the non-blank word), wrap it in `\<`/`\>` when its ends are keyword characters, escape it for magic, and ignore smartcase (remembered with the pattern, so a following `n` ignores it too, as vim does). Every search turns `hlsearch` painting on through `IVimHost::SetSearchHighlight`; `incsearch` paints the typed pattern and scrolls to its next match while typing, and Esc restores the view.
