### Task TE5c-9: `:s///c` -- interactive confirmation (spec s6.3 "`c` prompts per match")

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExSubstitute.cpp` (the confirm branch + the session)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandLine.cpp` (route keys while confirming)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (confirm members)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5c.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimSubstituteConfirmTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ExSubstituteEdits` (TE5c-8), `CmdLineKind::SubstituteConfirm` (TE5c-5), `RunExWithUndo` (keeps the transaction open while confirming, TE5c-6).
- Produces: `VimState` private `struct SubstituteConfirm`, `m_subConfirm`, `BeginSubstituteConfirm`, `HandleSubstituteConfirm`, `PromptSubstitute`, `ApplyConfirmed`, `FinishSubstituteConfirm`.

The matches are computed once; each accepted one is applied at its original offset shifted by the growth of the replacements before it (they are applied in ascending order). The whole session is one transaction: `BeginSubstituteConfirm` opens a nested `BeginTransaction` that stays open after `RunExWithUndo` returns, and `FinishSubstituteConfirm` closes it, so `u` undoes every accepted replacement at once. Keys: `y` replace and go on, `n` skip, `a` replace this and all remaining, `l` replace this and stop, `q`/Esc stop, Ctrl-E/Ctrl-Y scroll. The cursor ends on the last match that was offered (vim: "when interactive leave cursor on the match").

and add:

```cpp
    VimHostResult VimState::BeginSubstituteConfirm(std::vector<EditOp> ops)
    {
        m_doc.buffer.BeginTransaction(m_doc.selections);     // closed by FinishSubstituteConfirm: one undo step
        m_subConfirm = SubstituteConfirm{};
        m_subConfirm.pending = std::move(ops);
        m_subConfirm.active = true;
        m_cmdline = CommandLine{};
        m_cmdline.kind = CmdLineKind::SubstituteConfirm;
        m_mode = VimMode::CommandLine;
        PromptSubstitute();
        return {};
    }

    void VimState::PromptSubstitute()
    {
        SubstituteConfirm& c = m_subConfirm;
        if (c.next >= c.pending.size()) { FinishSubstituteConfirm(); return; }
        const EditOp& op = c.pending[c.next];
        const ByteOffset at = static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.range.begin) + c.delta);
        c.lastOffered = at;
        const std::uint32_t id = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].id;
        VimText::Select(m_doc, { Selection{ id, at, at, std::nullopt } }, 0);
        m_host.SetCommandLine("replace with " + op.text + " (y/n/a/q/l/^E/^Y)?", 0);
    }

    void VimState::ApplyConfirmed(std::size_t index)
    {
        SubstituteConfirm& c = m_subConfirm;
        const EditOp& op = c.pending[index];
        const ByteRange at{ static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.range.begin) + c.delta),
                            static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.range.end) + c.delta) };
        const std::uint32_t id = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].id;
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, { EditOp{ at, op.text } }, { Selection{ id, at.begin, at.begin, std::nullopt } }, 0);
        c.delta += static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.text.size()) - static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.range.end - op.range.begin);
    }

    void VimState::FinishSubstituteConfirm()
    {
        if (!m_subConfirm.active) return;
        m_subConfirm.active = false;
        m_host.SetCommandLine("", 0);
        m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
        m_cmdline = CommandLine{};
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, std::min<ByteOffset>(m_subConfirm.lastOffered, r.Size()));
        const std::uint32_t id = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].id;
        VimText::Select(m_doc, { Selection{ id, o, o, std::nullopt } }, 0);
        m_doc.buffer.EndTransaction(m_doc.selections);
        m_doc.buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
    }

    VimKeyResult VimState::HandleSubstituteConfirm(const VimKey& key)
    {
        SubstituteConfirm& c = m_subConfirm;
        if (key.IsEsc() || key == VimKey::Char(U'q')) { FinishSubstituteConfirm(); return {}; }
        if (key.ctrl && (key.ch == U'e' || key.ch == U'y'))
        {
            const std::uint32_t first = m_host.FirstVisibleRow();
            m_host.ScrollToRow(key.ch == U'e' ? first + 1 : (first > 0 ? first - 1 : 0));
            return {};
        }
        if (!key.IsChar()) return {};
        switch (key.ch)
        {
        case U'y': ApplyConfirmed(c.next++); PromptSubstitute(); break;
        case U'l': ApplyConfirmed(c.next++); FinishSubstituteConfirm(); break;
        case U'n': ++c.next; PromptSubstitute(); break;
        case U'a':
            while (c.next < c.pending.size())
            {
                c.lastOffered = static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(c.pending[c.next].range.begin) + c.delta);
                ApplyConfirmed(c.next++);
            }
            FinishSubstituteConfirm();
            break;
        default: break;                            // other keys are ignored (vim beeps and asks again)
        }
        return {};
    }
```

### Task TE5c-10: `:g` / `:v` / `:g!` (spec s6.3 Ex)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExGlobal.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimEx.cpp` (table rows), `VimState.hpp` (handler)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5c.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimExGlobalTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1 `AnchorSet` (`AnchorSet::Id`, `Add(Anchor{ offset, bias })`, `Get(id).offset`), `TextBuffer::RegisterAnchors/UnregisterAnchors`; `RunExLine` (TE5c-6), `m_inGlobal`, `m_globalPrint`, `ExPrint`; the search glue (TE5c-5).
- Produces: `VimState::ExGlobal` (rows `global`, `vglobal`).

Vim marks the matching lines first, then runs the command on each marked line that still exists, top to bottom, with the cursor at the line's start. Arcane marks a line with two anchors: its start (right bias, so text inserted at the line start -- `normal I//`, `O` -- keeps the mark on the original line) and the start of the next line (left bias). A deleted line collapses both to one offset, so it is skipped -- that is what makes `:g/^$/d` and `:g/^/m0` work. The empty last line, whose two anchors always coincide, is recognised separately. The default command is `p`, collected into one listing. `:g` inside `:g` is E147. All commands run inside the one ex transaction (one undo step).

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExGlobal.cpp
// :g/pat/cmd, :g!/pat/cmd, :v/pat/cmd (spec s6.3).
#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimSearchCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <set>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    VimHostResult VimState::ExGlobal(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        if (m_inGlobal) return VimHostResult{ false, "E147: Cannot do :global recursive" };
        const bool invert = cmd.bang || cmd.name == "vglobal";
        const std::string_view args = cmd.args;
        if (args.empty()) return VimHostResult{ false, "E35: No previous regular expression" };
        const char delim = args[0];
        std::size_t i = 1;
        std::string pattern;
        while (i < args.size() && args[i] != delim)
        {
            if (args[i] == '\\' && i + 1 < args.size())
            {
                if (args[i + 1] == delim) pattern += delim == '/' ? std::string("\\/") : std::string(1, delim);
                else { pattern += args[i]; pattern += args[i + 1]; }
                i += 2;
                continue;
            }
            pattern += args[i++];
        }
        if (i < args.size()) ++i;
        std::string command(args.substr(i));
        if (command.empty()) command = "p";
        if (pattern.empty()) pattern = m_globals.search.lastPattern;
        if (pattern.empty()) return VimHostResult{ false, "E35: No previous regular expression" };
        m_globals.search.lastPattern = pattern;
        m_globals.search.lastNoSmartcase = false;
        m_globals.registers.SetSpecial(U'/', pattern);

        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t first = cmd.rangeGiven ? cmd.firstRow : 0;
        const std::uint32_t last = cmd.rangeGiven ? cmd.lastRow : r.LineCount() - 1;
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        const auto compiled = VimCompileForContext(ctx, pattern, false);
        if (!compiled) return VimHostResult{ false, compiled.error() };
        const VimFindAllResult all = VimFindAll(VimSearchEnvFor(ctx), **compiled, first, last);
        if (all.status != VimSearchStatus::Found) return VimHostResult{ false, VimSearchMessage(all.status, pattern, true, true) };
        std::set<std::uint32_t> hits;
        for (const VimSearchMatch& m : all.matches) hits.insert(VimText::RowOf(r, m.range.begin));
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> marked;
        for (std::uint32_t row = first; row <= last; ++row)
            if (hits.contains(row) != invert) marked.push_back(row);
        if (marked.empty())
            return VimHostResult{ true, (invert ? "Pattern found in every line: " : "Pattern not found: ") + pattern };

        AnchorSet anchors;
        m_doc.buffer.RegisterAnchors(anchors);
        struct Mark { AnchorSet::Id start, end; };
        std::vector<Mark> marks;
        for (const std::uint32_t row : marked)
        {
            const ByteOffset next = row + 1 < r.LineCount() ? r.LineStart(row + 1) : r.Size();
            marks.push_back(Mark{ anchors.Add(Anchor{ r.LineStart(row), Bias::Right }), anchors.Add(Anchor{ next, Bias::Left }) });
        }
        m_inGlobal = true;
        m_globalPrint.clear();
        VimHostResult firstError;
        for (const Mark& mk : marks)
        {
            const Rope& now = m_doc.buffer.Text();
            const ByteOffset s = anchors.Get(mk.start).offset, e = anchors.Get(mk.end).offset;
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(now, s);
            const bool emptyLastLine = s == now.Size() && now.LineStart(row) == now.LineEnd(row) && s == now.LineStart(row);
            if (e <= s && !emptyLastLine) continue;                 // the line was deleted by an earlier command
            const std::uint32_t id = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].id;
            VimText::Select(m_doc, { Selection{ id, now.LineStart(row), now.LineStart(row), std::nullopt } }, 0);
            const VimHostResult res = RunExLine(command);
            if (!res.ok && firstError.ok) firstError = res;
        }
        m_inGlobal = false;
        m_doc.buffer.UnregisterAnchors(anchors);
        if (!m_globalPrint.empty()) m_host.ShowListing(":global", m_globalPrint);
        m_globalPrint.clear();
        ClampCursors();
        return firstError;
    }
}
```

### Task TE5c-11: `:sort` with `n u i r` and `/pat/` (spec s6.3 Ex)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExSort.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExSort.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimEx.cpp` (table row), `VimState.hpp` (handler)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5c.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimExSortTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE5c-4/5 search glue (`VimCompileForContext`, `VimCompiledPattern::Re()`, `VimSearchMessage`); TE3-2 `MatchScratch::Match/Group(0, b, e)`, `MatchStatus` through `VimGlobals::scratch` (TE5a-13: the one vim scratch; a limit hit refuses the sort with the s4.2 message); TE5c-6 `PlaceCursorFirstNonBlank`.
- Produces: `VimState::ExSort` (row `sort`, min `sor`); in `VimExSort.hpp`: `struct VimSortOptions { numeric, unique, ignoreCase, reverse, onMatch, hasPattern; std::string pattern; }`, `std::expected<VimSortOptions, std::string> ParseSortArgs(std::string_view)`, `using VimSortMatcher`, `std::vector<std::string> VimSortLines(std::vector<std::string>, const VimSortOptions&, const VimSortMatcher&)` (pure).

Vim's rules (`:h :sort`): the key is the whole line; with `/pat/` it is the text after the match, or the match itself with `r`; a line where the pattern does not match has an empty key, so those lines come first in their original order. `n` sorts on the first decimal number in the key (one leading `-` included); lines without a number sort before the others, in their original order. `i` compares ignoring ASCII case, `!` reverses, ties keep the original order, `u` keeps the first of each run of equal lines (equal numbers with `n`). The cursor ends on the first non-blank of the range's first line. An empty `//` uses the last search pattern.

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExSort.hpp
#pragma once

// :sort (spec s6.3): options n u i r and /pat/, and the pure line sort.

#include <cstddef>
#include <expected>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimSortOptions
    {
        bool numeric = false, unique = false, ignoreCase = false, reverse = false, onMatch = false, hasPattern = false;
        std::string pattern;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<VimSortOptions, std::string> ParseSortArgs(std::string_view args);

    // `match(line)` -> the [begin, end) of the pattern's first match, or nullopt.
    using VimSortMatcher = std::function<std::optional<std::pair<std::size_t, std::size_t>>(const std::string&)>;
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> VimSortLines(std::vector<std::string> lines, const VimSortOptions& options, const VimSortMatcher& match);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExSort.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimExSort.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimSearchCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdint>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::expected<VimSortOptions, std::string> ParseSortArgs(std::string_view a)
    {
        VimSortOptions o;
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < a.size())
        {
            const char c = a[i];
            if (c == ' ' || c == '\t') { ++i; continue; }
            if (c == 'n') { o.numeric = true; ++i; continue; }
            if (c == 'u') { o.unique = true; ++i; continue; }
            if (c == 'i') { o.ignoreCase = true; ++i; continue; }
            if (c == 'r') { o.onMatch = true; ++i; continue; }
            if (!std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) && c != '"' && c != '|')
            {
                std::size_t j = i + 1;
                std::string pat;
                while (j < a.size() && a[j] != c)
                {
                    if (a[j] == '\\' && j + 1 < a.size()) { pat += a[j]; pat += a[j + 1]; j += 2; continue; }
                    pat += a[j++];
                }
                o.pattern = std::move(pat);
                o.hasPattern = true;
                i = j < a.size() ? j + 1 : j;
                continue;
            }
            return std::unexpected("E474: Invalid argument: " + std::string(a.substr(i)));
        }
        return o;
    }

    namespace
    {
        struct SortItem
        {
            std::string line, key;
            bool hasNumber = false;
            std::int64_t number = 0;
            std::size_t index = 0;
        };

        void ParseNumber(SortItem& it)
        {
            const std::string& k = it.key;
            std::size_t d = 0;
            while (d < k.size() && !std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(k[d]))) ++d;
            if (d == k.size()) return;
            const bool negative = d > 0 && k[d - 1] == '-';
            std::int64_t v = 0;
            while (d < k.size() && std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(k[d])))
                v = std::min<std::int64_t>(v * 10 + (k[d++] - '0'), INT64_MAX / 10);
            it.hasNumber = true;
            it.number = negative ? -v : v;
        }

        int Compare(std::string_view a, std::string_view b, bool ignoreCase)
        {
            const std::size_t n = std::min(a.size(), b.size());
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            {
                int x = static_cast<unsigned char>(a[i]), y = static_cast<unsigned char>(b[i]);
                if (ignoreCase) { x = std::tolower(x); y = std::tolower(y); }
                if (x != y) return x < y ? -1 : 1;
            }
            return a.size() == b.size() ? 0 : (a.size() < b.size() ? -1 : 1);
        }
    }

    std::vector<std::string> VimSortLines(std::vector<std::string> lines, const VimSortOptions& o, const VimSortMatcher& match)
    {
        std::vector<SortItem> items;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < lines.size(); ++i)
        {
            SortItem it;
            it.line = std::move(lines[i]);
            it.index = i;
            if (o.hasPattern)
            {
                const auto m = match(it.line);
                if (m) it.key = o.onMatch ? it.line.substr(m->first, m->second - m->first) : it.line.substr(m->second);
            }
            else
                it.key = it.line;
            if (o.numeric) ParseNumber(it);
            items.push_back(std::move(it));
        }
        const auto raw = [&](const SortItem& a, const SortItem& b) {
            if (o.numeric)
            {
                if (a.hasNumber != b.hasNumber) return a.hasNumber ? 1 : -1;
                if (a.number != b.number) return a.number < b.number ? -1 : 1;
                return 0;
            }
            return Compare(a.key, b.key, o.ignoreCase);
        };
        std::sort(items.begin(), items.end(), [&](const SortItem& a, const SortItem& b) {
            int c = raw(a, b);
            if (o.reverse) c = -c;
            if (c == 0) return a.index < b.index;
            return c < 0;
        });
        std::vector<std::string> out;
        const SortItem* prev = nullptr;
        for (const SortItem& it : items)
        {
            if (o.unique && prev)
            {
                const bool same = o.numeric ? (prev->hasNumber == it.hasNumber && prev->number == it.number)
                                            : Compare(prev->line, it.line, o.ignoreCase) == 0;
                if (same) continue;
            }
            out.push_back(it.line);
            prev = &it;
        }
        return out;
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExSort(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        auto parsed = ParseSortArgs(cmd.args);
        if (!parsed) return VimHostResult{ false, parsed.error() };
        VimSortOptions o = std::move(*parsed);
        o.reverse = cmd.bang;
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t first = cmd.rangeGiven ? cmd.firstRow : 0;
        const std::uint32_t last = cmd.rangeGiven ? cmd.lastRow : r.LineCount() - 1;
        VimSortMatcher matcher;
        VimPatternHandle compiled;
        std::string pattern;
        MatchStatus failure = MatchStatus::Match;   // the first LimitHit/Error the matcher saw
        if (o.hasPattern)
        {
            pattern = o.pattern.empty() ? m_globals.search.lastPattern : o.pattern;
            if (pattern.empty()) return VimHostResult{ false, "E35: No previous regular expression" };
            VimContext ctx = Context();
            const auto c = VimCompileForContext(ctx, pattern, false);
            if (!c) return VimHostResult{ false, c.error() };
            compiled = *c;
            // Every line matches through the one vim MatchScratch (VimGlobals::scratch, TE5a-13).
            matcher = [compiled, &scratch = m_globals.scratch, &failure](const std::string& line)
                -> std::optional<std::pair<std::size_t, std::size_t>> {
                const MatchStatus st = scratch.Match(compiled->Re(), line, 0);
                if (st == MatchStatus::LimitHit || st == MatchStatus::Error)
                {
                    if (failure == MatchStatus::Match) failure = st;
                    return std::nullopt;
                }
                std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
                if (st != MatchStatus::Match || !scratch.Group(0, b, e)) return std::nullopt;
                return std::make_pair(b, e);
            };
        }
        std::vector<std::string> lines;
        for (std::uint32_t row = first; row <= last; ++row) lines.push_back(VimText::Line(r, row));
        const std::vector<std::string> sorted = VimSortLines(lines, o, matcher);
        if (failure == MatchStatus::LimitHit)   // spec s4.2: a pattern that hits the limit stops and says so; nothing is sorted
            return VimHostResult{ false, VimSearchMessage(VimSearchStatus::LimitHit, pattern, true, true) };
        if (failure == MatchStatus::Error)
            return VimHostResult{ false, VimSearchMessage(VimSearchStatus::Error, pattern, true, true) };
        std::string text;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sorted.size(); ++i) { if (i) text.push_back('\n'); text += sorted[i]; }
        std::string old;
        r.CopyTo(ByteRange{ r.LineStart(first), r.LineEnd(last) }, old);
        if (text != old)
        {
            const std::uint32_t id = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].id;
            VimText::Apply(m_doc, { EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(first), r.LineEnd(last) }, std::move(text) } },
                           { Selection{ id, r.LineStart(first), r.LineStart(first), std::nullopt } }, 0);
        }
        PlaceCursorFirstNonBlank(first);
        return {};
    }
}
```

### Task TE5c-12: the `:map` family -- session remap storage and listing (spec s6.3 Ex, s6.4 "`:map` adds a session-only remap")

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRemap.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRemap.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExMap.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobals.hpp` (`sessionRemaps`), `VimEx.cpp` (rows), `VimState.hpp` (handlers)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimRemapTableTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ParseKeys`, `FormatKeys` (TE5a-1); `VimOptions::leader`.
- Produces (contract names + listing helpers): `enum class VimRemapModes : std::uint8_t { Normal = 1, Visual = 2, OpPending = 4, Insert = 8 }`, `constexpr std::uint8_t operator|(VimRemapModes, VimRemapModes)`, `constexpr std::uint8_t Bits(VimRemapModes)`, `struct VimRemap { std::uint8_t modes; std::vector<VimKey> from, to; bool recursive; std::string fromText, toText; }`, `class VimRemapTable { Add; Remove; All; Clear; }`, `struct VimMapCommandInfo { std::uint8_t modes; bool recursive; bool unmap; }`, `std::optional<VimMapCommandInfo> VimMapCommand(std::string_view fullName, bool bang)`, `std::string VimRemapModeText(std::uint8_t)`, `std::vector<std::string> VimRemapListing(std::span<const VimRemap>, std::uint8_t modes, std::span<const VimKey> lhsPrefix)`; `VimGlobals::sessionRemaps`; `VimState::ExMap`, `VimState::ExUnmap`.

`:map` and friends only store remaps here (session-only: the table is never archived); TE5d-3 builds the key trie that resolves them together with the `editor.text.vim.remaps` setting, so the tests in this task check the table and the listing, not key resolution. `<Leader>` expands at definition time, as in vim. Mode letters: `map` = n+v+o, `map!` = i, `nmap n`, `vmap v` (Arcane has Visual, no Select), `omap o`, `imap i`; the `noremap` forms are non-recursive. A mapping for some modes of an existing `from` replaces only those modes. `<silent>` is accepted and ignored; `<buffer> <expr> <nowait> <unique> <script>` are documented divergences (no buffer-local or expression maps in v1).

The listing layout is vim's: the mode letters padded to 3 columns, the lhs padded to 12, then `*  ` for a non-recursive mapping or three spaces, then the rhs.

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRemap.hpp
#pragma once

// Session remaps from the :map family (spec s6.4: session only). TE5d-3 builds
// the key trie that resolves these together with editor.text.vim.remaps.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKey.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class VimRemapModes : std::uint8_t { Normal = 1, Visual = 2, OpPending = 4, Insert = 8 };

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint8_t Bits(VimRemapModes m) noexcept { return static_cast<std::uint8_t>(m); }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint8_t operator|(VimRemapModes a, VimRemapModes b) noexcept { return static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Bits(a) | Bits(b)); }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint8_t operator|(std::uint8_t a, VimRemapModes b) noexcept { return static_cast<std::uint8_t>(a | Bits(b)); }

    struct VimRemap
    {
        std::uint8_t modes = 0;
        std::vector<VimKey> from, to;
        bool recursive = true;
        std::string fromText, toText;   // as typed (listings, persistence)
    };

    class VimRemapTable
    {
    public:
        void Add(VimRemap remap);                                                  // replaces `from` in remap.modes only
        bool Remove(std::uint8_t modes, const std::vector<VimKey>& from);         // false: nothing was mapped there
        [[nodiscard]] std::span<const VimRemap> All() const { return m_remaps; }
        void Clear() { m_remaps.clear(); }

    private:
        std::vector<VimRemap> m_remaps;
    };

    struct VimMapCommandInfo
    {
        std::uint8_t modes = 0;
        bool recursive = true;
        bool unmap = false;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<VimMapCommandInfo> VimMapCommand(std::string_view fullName, bool bang);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string VimRemapModeText(std::uint8_t modes);
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> VimRemapListing(std::span<const VimRemap> remaps, std::uint8_t modes, std::span<const VimKey> lhsPrefix);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRemap.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRemap.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    void VimRemapTable::Add(VimRemap remap)
    {
        for (VimRemap& r : m_remaps)
            if (r.from == remap.from) r.modes = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(r.modes & ~remap.modes);
        std::erase_if(m_remaps, [](const VimRemap& r) { return r.modes == 0; });
        m_remaps.push_back(std::move(remap));
    }

    bool VimRemapTable::Remove(std::uint8_t modes, const std::vector<VimKey>& from)
    {
        bool removed = false;
        for (VimRemap& r : m_remaps)
            if (r.from == from && (r.modes & modes) != 0)
            {
                r.modes = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(r.modes & ~modes);
                removed = true;
            }
        std::erase_if(m_remaps, [](const VimRemap& r) { return r.modes == 0; });
        return removed;
    }

    std::optional<VimMapCommandInfo> VimMapCommand(std::string_view name, bool bang)
    {
        const std::uint8_t nvo = VimRemapModes::Normal | VimRemapModes::Visual | VimRemapModes::OpPending;
        const std::uint8_t ins = Bits(VimRemapModes::Insert);
        struct Row { std::string_view name; std::uint8_t modes; bool recursive; bool unmap; };
        const Row rows[] = {
            { "map", nvo, true, false },       { "noremap", nvo, false, false },   { "unmap", nvo, true, true },
            { "nmap", Bits(VimRemapModes::Normal), true, false },    { "nnoremap", Bits(VimRemapModes::Normal), false, false },
            { "nunmap", Bits(VimRemapModes::Normal), true, true },
            { "vmap", Bits(VimRemapModes::Visual), true, false },    { "vnoremap", Bits(VimRemapModes::Visual), false, false },
            { "vunmap", Bits(VimRemapModes::Visual), true, true },
            { "omap", Bits(VimRemapModes::OpPending), true, false }, { "onoremap", Bits(VimRemapModes::OpPending), false, false },
            { "ounmap", Bits(VimRemapModes::OpPending), true, true },
            { "imap", ins, true, false },      { "inoremap", ins, false, false },  { "iunmap", ins, true, true },
        };
        for (const Row& r : rows)
            if (r.name == name)
            {
                VimMapCommandInfo info{ r.modes, r.recursive, r.unmap };
                if (bang && (name == "map" || name == "noremap" || name == "unmap")) info.modes = ins;   // map! = Insert (+ cmdline in vim)
                return info;
            }
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    std::string VimRemapModeText(std::uint8_t m)
    {
        const std::uint8_t nvo = VimRemapModes::Normal | VimRemapModes::Visual | VimRemapModes::OpPending;
        std::string out;
        if ((m & nvo) == nvo) out = " ";
        else
        {
            if (m & Bits(VimRemapModes::Normal)) out += 'n';
            if (m & Bits(VimRemapModes::Visual)) out += 'v';
            if (m & Bits(VimRemapModes::OpPending)) out += 'o';
        }
        if (m & Bits(VimRemapModes::Insert)) out += 'i';
        return out;
    }

    std::vector<std::string> VimRemapListing(std::span<const VimRemap> remaps, std::uint8_t modes, std::span<const VimKey> prefix)
    {
        std::vector<std::string> out;
        for (const VimRemap& r : remaps)
        {
            if ((r.modes & modes) == 0) continue;
            if (prefix.size() > r.from.size() || !std::equal(prefix.begin(), prefix.end(), r.from.begin())) continue;
            std::string line = VimRemapModeText(r.modes);
            line.resize(std::max<std::size_t>(line.size(), 3), ' ');
            std::string lhs = FormatKeys(r.from);
            lhs.resize(std::max<std::size_t>(lhs.size(), 12), ' ');
            line += lhs;
            line += r.recursive ? "   " : "*  ";
            line += FormatKeys(r.to);
            out.push_back(std::move(line));
        }
        return out;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExMap.cpp
// :map :nmap :vmap :imap :omap, the noremap forms and the unmap forms (spec s6.3).
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRemap.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <cctype>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        bool StartsWithNoCase(std::string_view s, std::string_view p)
        {
            if (s.size() < p.size()) return false;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); ++i)
                if (std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i])) != std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(p[i]))) return false;
            return true;
        }

        // Strips the leading <...> map arguments. Returns an error for the ones Arcane does not support.
        std::optional<std::string> StripMapArguments(std::string_view& args)
        {
            for (;;)
            {
                while (!args.empty() && args.front() == ' ') args.remove_prefix(1);
                if (StartsWithNoCase(args, "<silent>")) { args.remove_prefix(8); continue; }
                for (const std::string_view bad : { "<buffer>", "<expr>", "<nowait>", "<unique>", "<script>" })
                    if (StartsWithNoCase(args, bad)) return "E: unsupported :map argument " + std::string(bad) + " (a documented divergence)";
                return std::nullopt;
            }
        }
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExMap(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        const auto info = VimMapCommand(cmd.name, cmd.bang);
        if (!info) return VimHostResult{ false, "E492: Not an editor command: " + cmd.name };
        std::string_view args = cmd.args;
        if (const auto err = StripMapArguments(args)) return VimHostResult{ false, *err };
        const std::size_t sp = args.find(' ');
        const std::string_view lhs = args.substr(0, sp);
        std::string_view rhs = sp == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view() : args.substr(sp + 1);
        while (!rhs.empty() && rhs.front() == ' ') rhs.remove_prefix(1);
        if (rhs.empty())
        {
            const auto prefix = ParseKeys(lhs, m_options.leader);
            const std::vector<std::string> lines = VimRemapListing(m_globals.sessionRemaps.All(), info->modes,
                                                                   prefix ? std::span<const VimKey>(*prefix) : std::span<const VimKey>());
            if (lines.empty()) return VimHostResult{ true, "No mapping found" };
            m_host.ShowListing(":" + cmd.name, lines);
            return {};
        }
        const auto from = ParseKeys(lhs, m_options.leader);
        const auto to = ParseKeys(rhs, m_options.leader);
        if (!from || !to || from->empty()) return VimHostResult{ false, "E474: Invalid argument" };
        m_globals.sessionRemaps.Add(VimRemap{ info->modes, *from, *to, info->recursive, std::string(lhs), std::string(rhs) });
        return {};
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExUnmap(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        const auto info = VimMapCommand(cmd.name, cmd.bang);
        if (!info) return VimHostResult{ false, "E492: Not an editor command: " + cmd.name };
        std::string_view args = cmd.args;
        if (const auto err = StripMapArguments(args)) return VimHostResult{ false, *err };
        while (!args.empty() && args.back() == ' ') args.remove_suffix(1);
        const auto from = ParseKeys(args, m_options.leader);
        if (!from || from->empty()) return VimHostResult{ false, "E474: Invalid argument" };
        if (!m_globals.sessionRemaps.Remove(info->modes, *from)) return VimHostResult{ false, "E31: No such mapping" };
        return {};
    }
}
```

### Task TE5c-13: `:w :q :wq :x :q! :e :sav :r`, `ZZ ZQ`, `:sp :vs :bn :bp :ls` (spec s6.3 Ex, D8 split views)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExFiles.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimEx.cpp` (rows), `VimState.hpp` (handlers), `VimActions.cpp` (`WriteQuit`, `QuitDiscard`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimExFilesTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `IVimHost::RunFileCommand/RunWindowCommand/ReadFileText/DocumentPath/BufferList/ShowListing` (TE5a-5). TE5a-22's `VimViewAdapter` implements them over the canonical editor names (CANON A7/A10, C TE5 items 11 and 18): `:e`/`:sp file` open through the adapter's `Services::openText` (FileOpener `OpenWith(p, Openers::OpenerId::ArcaneText(), at)`, never `DocumentHost::OpenAt`); `:w`/`:wq`/`:x`/`:sav` through `TextDocument::Dirty()/Save()/SaveAs(path)`, `:e!` through `ReloadFromDisk()`; `:sp`/`:vs` through `OpenSplit(bool vertical)`; window focus through `FocusOtherView()` (when the other view lies in that direction, else a `VimHostResult{ false, ... }`); `:q` of a split view through `CloseView(view)`; the current view is `FocusedView()`. This task writes no editor-side code: the vim layer only names the intent.
- Produces: handlers `ExWrite`, `ExWriteQuit`, `ExXit`, `ExQuit`, `ExEdit`, `ExSaveAs`, `ExRead`, `ExSplit`, `ExVsplit`, `ExBnext`, `ExBprevious`, `ExBuffers`; the `ZZ`/`ZQ` actions.

The vim layer does not know about files: it names the intent (`VimFileCommand`, `VimWindowCommand`) and the host does it, including vim's refusals (the adapter answers `:q` on a dirty document with `E37: No write since last change (add ! to override)`). `:r` is vim's own: the file's text (CRLF folded to LF, one final line break dropped) is inserted below the addressed line (`:0r` above the first), and the cursor goes to the first new line's first non-blank. These go through the fake host in tests; there are no Neovim cases (no files in the oracle).

```cpp
    CHECK(r.host.messages.back() == std::pair<std::string, bool>{ "E484: Can't open file missing.txt", true });
    r.host.files[r.host.path] = "self";
    r.Keys("gg:r<CR>");
    CHECK(r.Text().starts_with("  x\nself\n"));
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExFiles.cpp
// :w :q :wq :x :q! :e :sav :r, :sp :vs :bn :bp :ls (spec s6.3): intents for the host.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <format>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        std::string Trimmed(std::string_view s)
        {
            while (!s.empty() && s.back() == ' ') s.remove_suffix(1);
            return std::string(s);
        }
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExWrite(const VimExCommand& cmd)     { return m_host.RunFileCommand(VimFileCommand::Write, Trimmed(cmd.args), cmd.bang); }
    VimHostResult VimState::ExWriteQuit(const VimExCommand& cmd) { return m_host.RunFileCommand(VimFileCommand::WriteQuit, Trimmed(cmd.args), cmd.bang); }
    VimHostResult VimState::ExXit(const VimExCommand& cmd)       { return m_host.RunFileCommand(VimFileCommand::WriteIfDirtyQuit, Trimmed(cmd.args), cmd.bang); }
    VimHostResult VimState::ExQuit(const VimExCommand& cmd)      { return m_host.RunFileCommand(VimFileCommand::Quit, "", cmd.bang); }
    VimHostResult VimState::ExEdit(const VimExCommand& cmd)      { return m_host.RunFileCommand(VimFileCommand::Edit, Trimmed(cmd.args), cmd.bang); }
    VimHostResult VimState::ExBnext(const VimExCommand& cmd)     { return m_host.RunFileCommand(VimFileCommand::NextBuffer, "", cmd.bang); }
    VimHostResult VimState::ExBprevious(const VimExCommand& cmd) { return m_host.RunFileCommand(VimFileCommand::PrevBuffer, "", cmd.bang); }
    VimHostResult VimState::ExSplit(const VimExCommand&)         { return m_host.RunWindowCommand(VimWindowCommand::SplitHorizontal); }
    VimHostResult VimState::ExVsplit(const VimExCommand&)        { return m_host.RunWindowCommand(VimWindowCommand::SplitVertical); }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExSaveAs(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        const std::string path = Trimmed(cmd.args);
        if (path.empty()) return VimHostResult{ false, "E471: Argument required" };
        return m_host.RunFileCommand(VimFileCommand::SaveAs, path, cmd.bang);
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExRead(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        const std::string name = Trimmed(cmd.args).empty() ? m_host.DocumentPath() : Trimmed(cmd.args);
        const std::optional<std::string> raw = m_host.ReadFileText(name);
        if (!raw) return VimHostResult{ false, "E484: Can't open file " + name };
        std::string text;
        text.reserve(raw->size());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < raw->size(); ++i)
        {
            if ((*raw)[i] == '\r' && i + 1 < raw->size() && (*raw)[i + 1] == '\n') continue;
            text.push_back((*raw)[i]);
        }
        if (!text.empty() && text.back() == '\n') text.pop_back();
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t below = cmd.rangeGiven ? cmd.line2 : PrimaryRow() + 1;   // 1-based line to insert below; 0 = top
        EditOp op;
        std::uint32_t firstNewRow = 0;
        if (below == 0) { op = EditOp{ ByteRange{ 0, 0 }, text + "\n" }; firstNewRow = 0; }
        else
        {
            const ByteOffset at = r.LineEnd(std::min(below, r.LineCount()) - 1);
            op = EditOp{ ByteRange{ at, at }, "\n" + text };
            firstNewRow = std::min(below, r.LineCount());
        }
        const std::uint32_t id = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].id;
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, { op }, { Selection{ id, op.range.begin, op.range.begin, std::nullopt } }, 0);
        PlaceCursorFirstNonBlank(firstNewRow);
        return {};
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExBuffers(const VimExCommand&)
    {
        const std::vector<std::string> buffers = m_host.BufferList();
        const std::string current = m_host.DocumentPath();
        std::vector<std::string> lines;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < buffers.size(); ++i)
            lines.push_back(std::format("{:>3} {}   \"{}\"", i + 1, buffers[i] == current ? "%a" : "  ", buffers[i]));
        m_host.ShowListing(":ls", lines);
        return {};
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExListings.cpp
// :marks :reg :display :jumps (spec s6.3): popup listings in vim's layout.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <format>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("presentation: :reg shows at most this many bytes of a register (vim cuts at the window width)")
        constexpr std::size_t kRegisterPreviewBytes = 60;

        bool Wanted(std::string_view filter, char32_t name)
        {
            if (filter.empty()) return true;
            std::string utf8;
            Utf8::Append(utf8, name);
            return filter.find(utf8) != std::string_view::npos;
        }

        std::string Name(char32_t c)
        {
            std::string s;
            Utf8::Append(s, c);
            return s;
        }
    }

    std::string VimRegisterListingText(const VimRegisterValue& v)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const char c : v.Text())
        {
            if (out.size() >= kRegisterPreviewBytes) break;
            if (c == '\n') out += "^J";
            else if (c == '\t') out += "^I";
            else out.push_back(c);
        }
        return out;
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExMarks(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<std::string> lines{ "mark line  col file/text" };
        for (const auto& [name, at] : m_bufferState.marks.List())
        {
            if (!Wanted(cmd.args, name)) continue;
            const Point p = r.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(at, r.Size()));
            std::string text = VimText::Line(r, p.row);
            const std::size_t lead = text.find_first_not_of(" \t");
            text = lead == std::string::npos ? std::string() : text.substr(lead);
            lines.push_back(std::format(" {} {:>6} {:>4} {}", Name(name), p.row + 1, p.col, text));
        }
        for (const auto& [name, mark] : m_globals.globalMarks.List())
        {
            if (!Wanted(cmd.args, name)) continue;
            lines.push_back(std::format(" {} {:>6} {:>4} {}", Name(name), mark.point.row + 1, mark.point.col, mark.path));
        }
        if (lines.size() == 1) return VimHostResult{ false, "E283: No marks matching \"" + cmd.args + "\"" };
        m_host.ShowListing(":marks", lines);
        return {};
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExRegisters(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        std::vector<std::string> lines{ "Type Name Content" };
        for (const auto& [name, value] : m_globals.registers.List(m_host, m_options))
        {
            if (!Wanted(cmd.args, name)) continue;
            const char type = value.kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise ? 'l' : value.kind == VimRegisterKind::Blockwise ? 'b' : 'c';
            lines.push_back(std::format("  {}  \"{}   {}", type, Name(name), VimRegisterListingText(value)));
        }
        m_host.ShowListing(":registers", lines);
        return {};
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExJumps(const VimExCommand&)
    {
        std::vector<std::string> lines{ " jump line  col file/text" };
        for (std::string& l : m_jumps.Listing(m_doc.buffer.Text())) lines.push_back(std::move(l));
        m_host.ShowListing(":jumps", lines);
        return {};
    }
}
```

Expectation note: `" a      1    0 one"` is `" " + name + " " + {:>6} + " " + {:>4} + " " + text`; the jump lines' format is Part C's (`VimJumpList::Listing`), so this task asserts only the header and that the `G` jump is listed.

### Task TE5c-15: folds -- `zc zo za zR zM zd`, `zf{motion}`, `zj zk` over FoldModel (spec s6.3 Folds, s3.6, s4.6)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimFolds.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimFolds.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp` (fold action cases), `VimMotions.cpp` (Part A: `FoldNext`/`FoldPrev` cases), `VimOperators.cpp` (Part A: the `Fold` operator), `VimState.hpp` (fold members)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5c.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimFoldsTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1-12 `FoldModel` (`Fold(const Rope&, FoldRange, FoldSource)`, `UnfoldInnermost(const Rope&, row)`, `Folded(const Rope&)` -- closed folds only, `static IndentRegions(const Rope&, tabSize)`), `struct FoldRange { headerRow, lastRow; }`, `FoldSource::Manual`; TE3-19 `FoldModel::MarkerFolds()` (`std::span<const MarkerFold>`, `MarkerFold { beginRow, endRow }`), `FoldModel::FoldableAt` (through `ToggleFoldAt`); TE4-12 `TextEditor/Core/FoldActions.hpp`: `InnermostFoldHeader(const FoldModel&, const Rope&, row, tabSize)`, `FoldCommands::ToggleFoldAt/FoldAll/UnfoldAll` (each syncs the display itself); `VimText::SyncDisplay(VimDoc&)` (TE5a-2, after every raw `FoldModel` change); `DisplayMap::BufferRowToDisplay/DisplayRowToBuffer`; Part A `ResolveMotion`'s switch and `RunOperator` (contract shapes); `VimOpTarget`, `VimOpOutcome`.
- Produces: `std::optional<VimMotionTarget> ResolveFoldMotion(VimContext&, ByteOffset from, const VimMotionArgs&)`, `VimOpOutcome RunFoldOperator(VimContext&, std::span<const VimOpTarget>)`, `VimState::FoldAction(VimActionId)`, `VimState::MoveCursorsOutOfClosedFolds()`; file-local zj/zk helpers `ClosedFoldHiding`, `FoldRegions`, `NextFoldStart`, `PrevFoldEnd` in `VimFolds.cpp` (over `FoldModel::IndentRegions`, `MarkerFolds()`, `Folded(rope)`; there is no `FoldModel::Recompute`).

Folds are per view (spec s5.1 split view), so they act on `VimDoc::folds`; `j`/`k` already step over closed folds through the `DisplayMap` (TE5a-8). Arcane's `FoldModel` stores only CLOSED folds (a fold in the model is closed; there is no open/closed flag): `zf` is `folds.Fold(rope, FoldRange{ first, last }, FoldSource::Manual)`; `zc` closes the innermost foldable region around the cursor (`InnermostFoldHeader`, then `FoldCommands::ToggleFoldAt`, which folds `FoldableAt(header)` -- marker region first, then indentation); `zo` and `zd` are `folds.UnfoldInnermost(rope, row)`; `za` is one or the other; `zR`/`zM` are `FoldCommands::UnfoldAll/FoldAll`. Every raw `FoldModel` change is followed by `VimText::SyncDisplay` (the `FoldCommands` sync themselves). After a fold closes, every cursor inside it moves to the fold's first line (vim's `foldAdjustCursor`). `zj`/`zk` move to the next fold's start / the previous fold's end over the regions vim can see -- `FoldModel::IndentRegions`, the grammar's `MarkerFolds()` and the closed folds (`Folded(rope)`, where zf-made folds live), minus regions whose header a closed fold hides -- and are linewise motions usable with operators. Divergences (TE5c-16's list): Arcane folds by indentation by default (spec s4.6) while Neovim's default `foldmethod` is manual, so `zc` on an indentation fold has no Neovim equivalent; and an opened fold is forgotten (Arcane keeps only closed folds), so `zc` after `zo` re-closes the indentation region -- a `zf` fold opened by `zo`/`zR` is gone, so a later `zc`/`zM` cannot re-close it. The oracle cases use `zf`-made folds that are never reopened, which both sides agree on.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("vim folds: zf creates a closed fold; j steps over it", "[text-vim-folds]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc\nd");
    r.Keys("zfj");
    CHECK(Closed(r) == std::vector<FoldRange>{ { 0, 1 } });   // headerRow 0, lastRow 1
    r.Keys("j");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\nb\n\xCB\x87" "c\nd");
    CHECK(r.Text() == "a\nb\nc\nd");                         // folds never change text
}

TEST_CASE("vim folds: zc zo za zR zM zd over an indentation region", "[text-vim-folds]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\n  b\n  c\nd");
    r.Keys("zc");                                             // the region headed at row 0
    CHECK(Closed(r) == std::vector<FoldRange>{ { 0, 2 } });
    r.Keys("zo");
    CHECK(Closed(r).empty());
    r.Keys("jzc");                                            // from inside the region: the innermost one around the row
    CHECK(Closed(r) == std::vector<FoldRange>{ { 0, 2 } });
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "a\n  b\n  c\nd");          // the cursor goes to the closed fold's first line
    r.Keys("za");
    CHECK(Closed(r).empty());
    r.Keys("za");
    CHECK(Closed(r) == std::vector<FoldRange>{ { 0, 2 } });
    r.Keys("zR");
    CHECK(Closed(r).empty());
    r.Keys("zM");
    CHECK(Closed(r) == std::vector<FoldRange>{ { 0, 2 } });
    r.Keys("zd");
    CHECK(Closed(r).empty());
    r.Keys("Gzc");                                            // row 3 lies in no region
    CHECK(r.host.messages.back() == std::pair<std::string, bool>{ "E490: No fold found", true });
}

{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc\nd");
    r.Keys("zfjzo");
    CHECK(Closed(r).empty());                                 // FoldModel keeps only closed folds
    r.Keys("jzc");                                            // Neovim re-closes the zf fold; Arcane has no region here
    CHECK(Closed(r).empty());
    CHECK(r.host.messages.back() == std::pair<std::string, bool>{ "E490: No fold found", true });
    r.Keys("zfjzR");
    CHECK(Closed(r).empty());
    r.Keys("zM");                                             // flat text: no indentation region to re-close
    CHECK(Closed(r).empty());
}

TEST_CASE("vim folds: zj zk and Visual zf", "[text-vim-folds]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc\nd\ne");
    r.Keys("jjVjzfgg");
    CHECK(Closed(r) == std::vector<FoldRange>{ { 2, 3 } });
    r.Keys("zj");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\nb\n\xCB\x87" "c\nd\ne");
    r.Keys("Gzk");                                            // the closed fold's end is hidden: the cursor lands on its first line
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\nb\n\xCB\x87" "c\nd\ne");
}

{

    r.Keys("zj");
```

```cpp
// Vim's fold commands over the view's FoldModel (spec s6.3 Folds).

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp"

#include <optional>
#include <span>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<VimMotionTarget> ResolveFoldMotion(VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, const VimMotionArgs& args);
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimFolds.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimFolds.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldActions.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        // The outermost closed fold that hides `row` (its header excluded): vim counts a closed fold as one line.
        std::optional<FoldRange> ClosedFoldHiding(const std::vector<FoldRange>& closed, std::uint32_t row)
        {
            std::optional<FoldRange> outer;
            for (const FoldRange& f : closed)
                if (row > f.headerRow && row <= f.lastRow && (!outer || f.headerRow < outer->headerRow)) outer = f;
            return outer;
        }

        // Every fold region zj/zk can see: the indentation regions, the grammar's marker regions and the closed
        // folds (zf-made ones live only there), minus those whose header a closed fold hides. Arcane keeps no open
        // folds, so a zf fold that zo/zR opened is not among them (VimDivergences: "opened folds").
        std::vector<FoldRange> FoldRegions(const VimContext& ctx, const std::vector<FoldRange>& closed)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            std::vector<FoldRange> all = FoldModel::IndentRegions(r, ctx.options.tabSize);
            for (const MarkerFold& m : ctx.doc.folds.MarkerFolds()) all.push_back(FoldRange{ m.beginRow, m.endRow });
            all.insert(all.end(), closed.begin(), closed.end());
            std::erase_if(all, [&](const FoldRange& f) {
                return f.lastRow <= f.headerRow || ClosedFoldHiding(closed, f.headerRow).has_value();
            });
            return all;
        }

        // zj: the nearest region header below `row`.
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> NextFoldStart(const std::vector<FoldRange>& regions, std::uint32_t row)
        {
            std::optional<std::uint32_t> best;
            for (const FoldRange& f : regions)
                if (f.headerRow > row && (!best || f.headerRow < *best)) best = f.headerRow;
            return best;
        }

        // zk: the nearest region end above `row`.
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> PrevFoldEnd(const std::vector<FoldRange>& regions, std::uint32_t row)
        {
            std::optional<std::uint32_t> best;
            for (const FoldRange& f : regions)
                if (f.lastRow < row && (!best || f.lastRow > *best)) best = f.lastRow;
            return best;
        }
    }

    std::optional<VimMotionTarget> ResolveFoldMotion(VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, const VimMotionArgs& args)
    {
        const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
        const std::vector<FoldRange> closed = ctx.doc.folds.Folded(r);
        const std::vector<FoldRange> regions = FoldRegions(ctx, closed);
        std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, from);
        bool moved = false;
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < args.Count1(); ++i)
        {
            const std::optional<std::uint32_t> next = args.id == VimMotionId::FoldNext ? NextFoldStart(regions, row)
                                                                                       : PrevFoldEnd(regions, row);
            if (!next) break;
            row = *next;
            moved = true;
        }
        if (!moved) return std::nullopt;
        if (const std::optional<FoldRange> hiding = ClosedFoldHiding(closed, row)) row = hiding->headerRow;   // foldAdjustCursor
        const std::uint32_t vcol = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, from, ctx.options.tabSize);
        VimMotionTarget t;
        t.offset = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, vcol, ctx.options.tabSize);
        t.kind = MotionKind::Linewise;
        t.goal = vcol;
        return t;
    }

    VimOpOutcome RunFoldOperator(VimContext& ctx, std::span<const VimOpTarget> targets)
    {
        const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(ctx.doc);
        for (const VimOpTarget& t : targets)
        {
            const std::uint32_t first = VimText::RowOf(r, t.range.begin);
            const ByteOffset lastByte = t.range.end > t.range.begin ? t.range.end - 1 : t.range.begin;
            const std::uint32_t last = std::max(first, VimText::RowOf(r, lastByte));
            ctx.doc.folds.Fold(r, FoldRange{ first, last }, FoldSource::Manual);   // a one-line range hides nothing: Fold refuses it
            for (Selection& s : sels)
                if (s.id == t.cursorId)
                {
                    const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, r.LineStart(first)
                        + std::min<ByteOffset>(t.origin - r.LineStart(VimText::RowOf(r, t.origin)), r.LineEnd(first) - r.LineStart(first)));
                    s.anchor = s.head = o;
                }
        }
        VimText::SyncDisplay(ctx.doc);   // raw FoldModel change: rebuild the display rows
        VimText::Select(ctx.doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(ctx.doc));
        return {};
    }

    void VimState::MoveCursorsOutOfClosedFolds()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        bool changed = false;
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, s.head);
            const std::uint32_t top = m_doc.display.DisplayRowToBuffer(m_doc.display.BufferRowToDisplay(row));
            if (top == row) continue;
            const std::uint32_t vcol = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, s.head, m_options.tabSize);
            s.anchor = s.head = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, top, vcol, m_options.tabSize));
            changed = true;
        }
        if (changed) VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::FoldAction(VimActionId id)
    {
        FoldModel& f = m_doc.folds;
        const Rope& rope = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t tab = m_options.tabSize;
        const std::uint32_t row = PrimaryRow();
        // A closed fold heads or hides the row. Arcane's FoldModel holds only closed folds: an opened fold is gone.
        const auto inClosedFold = [&] {
            for (const FoldRange& fr : f.Folded(rope))
                if (row >= fr.headerRow && row <= fr.lastRow) return true;
            return false;
        };
        // zc: close the innermost foldable region around the row (marker region first, then indentation).
        const auto closeAt = [&]() -> bool {
            if (inClosedFold()) return true;   // already closed: nothing to do
            const std::optional<std::uint32_t> header = InnermostFoldHeader(f, rope, row, tab);
            return header && FoldCommands::ToggleFoldAt(f, m_doc.display, rope, *header, tab);   // folds FoldableAt(header), syncs the display
        };
        bool ok = true;
        switch (id)
        {
        case VimActionId::FoldClose:
            ok = closeAt();
            break;
        case VimActionId::FoldOpen:
            if (f.UnfoldInnermost(rope, row)) VimText::SyncDisplay(m_doc);
            else ok = InnermostFoldHeader(f, rope, row, tab).has_value();   // an open region: nothing to open, no error
            break;
        case VimActionId::FoldToggle:
            if (inClosedFold())
            {
                f.UnfoldInnermost(rope, row);
                VimText::SyncDisplay(m_doc);
            }
            else ok = closeAt();
            break;
        case VimActionId::FoldOpenAll:
            FoldCommands::UnfoldAll(f, m_doc.display, rope);   // zR never fails
            break;
        case VimActionId::FoldCloseAll:
            FoldCommands::FoldAll(f, m_doc.display, m_doc.selections, rope, tab);   // zM never fails
            break;
        case VimActionId::FoldDelete:
            ok = f.UnfoldInnermost(rope, row);   // only a closed fold exists to delete
            if (ok) VimText::SyncDisplay(m_doc);
            break;
        default:
            ok = false;
            break;
        }
        if (!ok) { Beep("E490: No fold found"); return; }
        MoveCursorsOutOfClosedFolds();
    }
}
```

**Interfaces:**

- Produces: `struct VimDivergence { std::string_view item; std::string_view behaviour; std::string_view reason; }`, `std::span<const VimDivergence> VimDivergences()` -- the one list "listed in the vim help page" (s6.5): the Vim Preferences page (TE5d-5) shows it, and the oracle's divergence notes (`divergence:` lines) cite its items.

Every pattern item `VimPattern::Translate` rejects as unsupported, and every behaviour TE5c implements differently from Neovim on purpose, has a row; the test proves each rejected item's error names an item in the list, so a new divergence cannot ship undocumented.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimDivergencesTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimDivergences.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimPattern.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimSubstitute.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    bool Listed(std::string_view message)
    {
        for (const VimDivergence& d : VimDivergences())
            if (message.find(d.item) != std::string_view::npos) return true;
        return false;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim divergences: every unsupported pattern item is documented", "[text-vim-pattern]")
{
    for (const char* p : { "a\\%[bc]", "\\%d123", "\\%x2a", "\\%u20ac", "[[=a=]]", "[[.a.]]", "a\\@x", "\\%#", "\\%'a",
                           "\\%<3l", "\\z(a\\)", "\\f", "\\p", "a\\&b", "\\(a\\zsb\\)", "foo\\zebar\\|baz", "[\\d65]" })
    {
        const auto r = VimPattern::Translate(p, {});
        INFO(p);
        REQUIRE_FALSE(r.has_value());
        CHECK(r.error().message.starts_with("E: unsupported pattern item"));
        CHECK(Listed(r.error().message));
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim divergences: behaviour rows exist for the documented non-pattern differences", "[text-vim-pattern]")
{
    for (const char* item : { "=", "\\n in a :s replacement", "\\u \\U \\l \\L", "/pat/e", "zc on indentation folds",
                              "opened folds", "\\%V \\%23l in hlsearch", "multi-line hlsearch", "smartcase",
                              "word classes", "virtual columns", ":map <buffer>" })
    {
        INFO(item);
        bool found = false;
        for (const VimDivergence& d : VimDivergences()) found = found || d.item == item;
        CHECK(found);
    }
    CHECK(VimExpandReplacement("a\\nb", "", {}) == "a\nb");            // the \n row's behaviour
    for (const VimDivergence& d : VimDivergences())
    {
        CHECK_FALSE(d.behaviour.empty());
        CHECK_FALSE(d.reason.empty());
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimDivergences.hpp
#pragma once

// The documented vim divergences (spec s6.5 "documented divergence (listed in
// the vim help page and in the oracle's divergence notes)", s11.3). One row per
// item; VimPattern's unsupported-item errors name the item.

#include <span>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimDivergence
    {
        std::string_view item;        // as the error / the case note names it
        std::string_view behaviour;   // what Arcane does
        std::string_view reason;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::span<const VimDivergence> VimDivergences();
}
```

```cpp
            { "smartcase", "only ASCII capitals make a pattern case-sensitive", "the upper-case test is ASCII in v1" },
            { "word classes", "CJK and emoji are one punctuation-or-word class", "Arcane's class is wordChars + \\p{L}\\p{N} (s11.3); vim splits scripts" },
            { "virtual columns", "every character is one column wide", "wide glyphs count 1 (ImGui text limits, s1.2)" },
            { ":map <buffer>", "E: unsupported :map argument", "no buffer-local, expression, nowait, unique or script maps in v1" },
        });
    }

    std::span<const VimDivergence> VimDivergences() { return kDivergences; }
}
```

The array's initializer holds only string literals (no numeric literal), so ConstantGuardTest does not flag it.

```
CONSUMED THAT THE CONTRACT DOES NOT STATE EXPLICITLY (requirements on Parts A/C)
- Part C, TE5b-4 FeedKeys: must type printable Insert-mode keys that VimState leaves unhandled (VimText::Apply at every cursor +
  OnInputHandled), exactly as VimRig::TypeLikeTheView does; :normal (TE5c-7) and :g/.../normal depend on it.
- Part A, TE5a-8 ExecuteMotion: must Beep() when no cursor moved (ResolveMotion returned nullopt for all), so a failed search
  flushes typed-ahead keys like vim's E486.
- Part A, TE5a-8 ResolveMotion: the ids SearchNext/SearchPrev/SearchWord*/SearchPartial* and FoldNext/FoldPrev return nullopt
  until TE5c-5 / TE5c-15 replace those cases.
- Part A, TE5a-12 RunOperator: TE5c-15 makes `if (op == VimOperatorId::Fold) return RunFoldOperator(ctx, targets);` its first
  statement; ExecuteOperator must not move the cursor again after a Fold outcome.
- Part A / Part C, the "1-9 rule for % ( ) ` / ? n N { }": `/pat<CR>` and `?pat<CR>` execute as the SearchNext motion id, so
  forceNumbered must cover SearchNext, SearchPrev (and the * # g* g# ids).

  VimMarks::List, m_jumps.Listing(rope), RecordJump -- as the contract names them.

- Part A, TE5a-13: `MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{} }` in VimGlobals (VimGlobals is therefore non-copyable; nothing in
  TE5c copies it). VimSearchEnvFor passes it as VimSearchEnv::scratch; :sort's matcher captures it by reference. The editor
  (TE5a-23 VimEditorRuntime) sets its limits; pure TE5c tests own a local `MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{} }`.
- Part A, TE5a-2: VimText::SyncDisplay(VimDoc&) after every raw FoldModel change (zf, zo, za-open, zd); TE4-12's
  FoldCommands::ToggleFoldAt/FoldAll/UnfoldAll sync the display themselves.

DEVIATIONS (and why)
- The command-line editor lands in TE5c-5 (needed by / and ?), TE5c-6 adds `:` and the ex parser; same ids, same deliverables.
- The ex table is a function-local static inside VimState::ExCommandTable() (still in VimEx.cpp) so member pointers may name
  private handlers.
- Added struct members listed with * above (marker groups for exact \%l \%c \%v \%V positions; user-group renumbering; * #
  remembering "ignore smartcase" for the following n as vim does; raw 1-based addresses for :0r / :m0).
- :j reimplements vim's do_join in VimExCommands.cpp (JoinRowsText); Part A's J (TE5a-13) has its own copy -- unify into one
  function when both exist (the oracle cases for J and :j pin the same rules).

SPEC REQUIREMENTS NOT PLACED / GAPS
- s4.2 "lines past longLineMaxBytes are matched in windows": the vim line path copies the whole row (correctness first);
  windowed matching stays TE4's find-bar concern.
- \%V in VisualBlock is approximated by the block's charwise span.
- :s///c inside :g is refused (E) in v1.
- 'report' / 'shortmess' messages are approximations (only "N substitutions on M lines" above 2 lines, and the wrap message).
```

## Pass TE5d: options, remaps, persistence

Pass (d) turns the Neovim defaults that TE5a-3 froze into `VimOptions` into real `editor.text.vim.*` settings (spec s6.4, D13), adds vim's `:set` with session-only semantics on the settings system's Console rung, puts a key trie with `timeoutlen` in front of every key vim resolves (`:map` entries from TE5c-12 plus the `editor.text.vim.remaps` table), gives vim its Preferences page with the Experimental badge, persists marks/registers/history in the editor user folder, and shows on the Shortcuts page what each vim-shadowed chord means. It closes with the hand-written multi-cursor table, its separate review, and the full oracle suite run that VIM-GATE consumes.

### Task TE5d-1: The full `editor.text.vim.*` settings block with Neovim defaults (spec s6.4, s8, D13)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp` (the `TextVimSettings` struct TE5a-23 created and TE5b-1 extended)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.cpp` (the `TextVimSettings` reflection block + `ARC_SETTINGS(TextVimSettings)` and `ReadVimOptions`, created by TE5a-23 after the `EditorConsoleSettings.cpp` pattern -- struct in the header, reflection in the .cpp)
- Modify: `scripts/settings-frozen-names.txt` (sorted name list; `editor.ui.*` rows at lines 413+ show the ordering)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/src/SweepTextVimTest.cpp` (created by TE5a-23, extended by TE5b-1)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimOptionsReadTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Arcane::Editor::TextVimSettings { enabled, handleCtrlKeys, latinLettersInNormal, useSystemClipboard }`, `enum class VimLatinLetters` (TE5a-23, TE5b-1), `Arcane::Editor::TextSettings { std::uint32_t tabSize; bool insertSpaces; }` (TE1-15), `TextSettings::multilineSearchMaxMB` (`std::uint32_t`, TE4-3) -- read only, owned by those tasks, `Arcane::Text::VimOptions`, `ParseNrFormats` (TE5a-3), `Arcane::Test::RequireDefault`, `ScopedCodeLayer` (`ArcaneTests/src/Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp:19-81`), `CVarRegistry::Describe` (`CVarRegistry.hpp:456`), `CVarDescInfo` (`CVarRegistry.hpp:105-121`).
- Produces: `TextVimSettings` gains `ignorecase, smartcase, hlsearch, incsearch, wrapscan, gdefault` (bool), `timeoutlen` (`std::uint32_t` ms), `scrolloff` (`std::uint32_t`), `startofline` (bool), `nrformats` (string), `yankToEol` (bool), `leader` (string), `remaps` (string, JSON, Hidden -- the Vim page edits it, TE5d-5), `persistState` (bool); `Arcane::Text::VimOptions Arcane::Editor::ReadVimOptions(const TextVimSettings&, const TextSettings&)` maps every field (complete version). Cvar names `editor.text.vim.<field>`.

The settings system's field types are bool/int/float/double/string/enum (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp:18-20`), so `nrformats`, `leader` and the remap table are strings. Every default is Neovim's (D13, s6.4): ignorecase off, smartcase off, hlsearch on, incsearch on, wrapscan on, gdefault off, timeoutlen 1000, scrolloff 0, startofline off, nrformats `bin,hex`, `Y` = `y$`, leader `\`. Integral fields are `std::uint32_t` (the settings type rule; sweep values `CVarValue::UInt32`), so `ReadVimOptions` copies `timeoutlen` and `scrolloff` straight into `VimOptions::timeoutlenMs` / `scrolloff` (already `std::uint32_t`, TE5a-3) -- the registry's `Range` keeps them in bounds, no sign clamp is needed. Shift width IS Arcane's single editor-wide indent width (`editor.text.tabSize`; spec s6.4 amended: `:set sw` and `:set ts` move together), so `ReadVimOptions` maps both `tabstop` (`tabSize`) and `shiftwidth` (`shiftWidth`) from it.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimOptionsReadTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"

using namespace Arcane;

TEST_CASE("vim options: ReadVimOptions maps every editor.text.vim field and the editor-wide indentation", "[text-vim-options]")
{
    Editor::TextVimSettings v;
    v.handleCtrlKeys = false;
    v.useSystemClipboard = true;
    v.ignorecase = true;
    v.smartcase = true;
    v.hlsearch = false;
    v.incsearch = false;
    v.wrapscan = false;
    v.gdefault = true;
    v.timeoutlen = 300u;
    v.scrolloff = 5u;
    v.startofline = true;
    v.nrformats = "octal,alpha";
    v.yankToEol = false;
    v.leader = ",";
    Editor::TextSettings t;
    t.tabSize = 2u;
    t.insertSpaces = false;
    t.multilineSearchMaxMB = 8u;

    const Text::VimOptions o = Editor::ReadVimOptions(v, t);
    CHECK_FALSE(o.handleCtrlKeys);
    CHECK(o.useSystemClipboard);
    CHECK(o.ignorecase);
    CHECK(o.smartcase);
    CHECK_FALSE(o.hlsearch);
    CHECK_FALSE(o.incsearch);
    CHECK_FALSE(o.wrapscan);
    CHECK(o.gdefault);
    CHECK(o.timeoutlenMs == 300u);
    CHECK(o.scrolloff == 5u);
    CHECK(o.startofline);
    CHECK(Text::FormatNrFormats(o) == "octal,alpha");
    CHECK_FALSE(o.yankToEol);
    CHECK(o.leader == ",");
    CHECK(o.tabSize == 2u);
    CHECK(o.shiftWidth == 2u);              // one editor-wide indent width (spec s6.4)
    CHECK_FALSE(o.expandTab);
    CHECK(o.multilineSearchMaxBytes == (8ull << 20));
}

TEST_CASE("vim options: defaults read as Neovim's; bad text falls back to the default; zero widths clamp to 1", "[text-vim-options]")
{
    const Text::VimOptions d = Editor::ReadVimOptions(Editor::TextVimSettings{}, Editor::TextSettings{});
    const Text::VimOptions neovim;
    CHECK(d.ignorecase == neovim.ignorecase);
    CHECK(d.hlsearch == neovim.hlsearch);
    CHECK(d.timeoutlenMs == neovim.timeoutlenMs);
    CHECK(Text::FormatNrFormats(d) == "bin,hex");
    CHECK(d.yankToEol);
    CHECK(d.leader == "\\");

    Editor::TextVimSettings bad;
    bad.nrformats = "hex,unsigned";         // unknown item: the whole value is refused
    bad.leader.clear();                     // an empty leader would make <Leader> vanish
    bad.timeoutlen = 0u;                    // 0 is a legal timeoutlen (act at once), copied as is
    Editor::TextSettings zero;
    zero.tabSize = 0u;                      // a zero indent width / search cap never reaches vim
    zero.multilineSearchMaxMB = 0u;
    const Text::VimOptions b = Editor::ReadVimOptions(bad, zero);
    CHECK(Text::FormatNrFormats(b) == "bin,hex");
    CHECK(b.leader == "\\");
    CHECK(b.timeoutlenMs == 0u);
    CHECK(b.tabSize == 1u);
    CHECK(b.shiftWidth == 1u);
    CHECK(b.multilineSearchMaxBytes == (1ull << 20));
}
```

```cpp
TEST_CASE("sweep: the editor.text.vim options register with Neovim's defaults (D13)", "[sweep][text-vim]")

    using Arcane::Test::RequireDefault;

    RequireDefault("editor.text.vim.scrolloff", CVarValue::UInt32(0u));
    RequireDefault("editor.text.vim.startofline", CVarValue::Bool(false));
    RequireDefault("editor.text.vim.nrformats", CVarValue::String("bin,hex"));
    RequireDefault("editor.text.vim.yankToEol", CVarValue::Bool(true));

    RequireDefault("editor.text.vim.remaps", CVarValue::String("[]"));
    RequireDefault("editor.text.vim.persistState", CVarValue::Bool(true));

    CVarRegistry& reg = CVarRegistry::Get();
    for (const std::string_view n : { "editor.text.vim.ignorecase", "editor.text.vim.smartcase", "editor.text.vim.hlsearch",
                                      "editor.text.vim.incsearch", "editor.text.vim.wrapscan", "editor.text.vim.gdefault",

                                      "editor.text.vim.nrformats", "editor.text.vim.yankToEol", "editor.text.vim.leader",
                                      "editor.text.vim.remaps", "editor.text.vim.persistState" })
    {
        const std::optional<CVarDescInfo> d = reg.Describe(n);
        INFO("cvar " << std::string(n));
        REQUIRE(d.has_value());
        CHECK(d->audience == Audience::Editor);
        CHECK(d->scope == SettingScope::PreferencesMachine);
        CHECK(d->apply == ApplyMode::Live);
        CHECK(d->categoryPath == "Text Editor/Vim");

    REQUIRE(tm->min.has_value());
    CHECK(tm->min->AsUInt32() == 0u);
    REQUIRE(tm->max.has_value());
    CHECK(tm->max->AsUInt32() == 10000u);
}
```

```cpp
    // editor.text.vim.* (spec s6.4, D13: NEOVIM defaults). Per-machine
    // preferences; `:set` writes the Console rung (session only, TE5d-2).
    struct TextVimSettings
    {
        bool            enabled = false;                                 // TE5a-23 (spec s6.1: off = no vim code runs)
        bool            handleCtrlKeys = true;                           // TE5a-23 (spec s6.6)
        VimLatinLetters latinLettersInNormal = VimLatinLetters::Auto;    // TE5a-23 (spec s5.5)
        bool            useSystemClipboard = false;                      // TE5b-1 (Neovim clipboard=unnamedplus)
        bool            ignorecase = false;
        bool            smartcase = false;
        bool            hlsearch = true;
        bool            incsearch = true;
        bool            wrapscan = true;
        bool            gdefault = false;
        std::uint32_t   timeoutlen = 1000;                               // ms (settings type rule: integral = uint32)
        std::uint32_t   scrolloff = 0;
        bool            startofline = false;
        std::string     nrformats = "bin,hex";
        bool            yankToEol = true;                                // Y = y$ (Neovim) / yy (Vim)
        std::string     leader = "\\";
        std::string     remaps = "[]";                                   // JSON: [{"mode","from","to","recursive"}] (TE5d-4)
        bool            persistState = true;                             // TE5d-6
        bool operator==(const TextVimSettings&) const = default;         // TE5a-23
    };
```

```cpp
    Text::VimOptions ReadVimOptions(const TextVimSettings& vim, const TextSettings& text)
    {
        Text::VimOptions o;
        o.handleCtrlKeys = vim.handleCtrlKeys;
        o.useSystemClipboard = vim.useSystemClipboard;
        o.ignorecase = vim.ignorecase;
        o.smartcase = vim.smartcase;

        o.timeoutlenMs = vim.timeoutlen;                            // both std::uint32_t; the cvar Range bounds them
        o.scrolloff = vim.scrolloff;
        o.startofline = vim.startofline;
        (void)Text::ParseNrFormats(vim.nrformats, o);              // an unknown item leaves Neovim's bin,hex
        o.yankToEol = vim.yankToEol;
        o.leader = vim.leader.empty() ? std::string("\\") : vim.leader;
        o.tabSize = std::max(1u, text.tabSize);                     // TE1-15, std::uint32_t
        o.shiftWidth = o.tabSize;                                   // tabstop and shiftwidth: one indent width (spec s6.4 amended)

        return o;                                                   // (no maxCursors mirror: gb reads the EditContext, TE5a-21)
```

### Task TE5d-2: `:set` -- session-only options on the Console rung (spec s6.4)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSetOption.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSetOption.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimHost.hpp` (TE5a-5: add `VimSessionOption` and the pure virtual `IVimHost::SetSessionOption`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (TE5a-5: declare `VimHostResult ExSet(const VimExCommand&)`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimEx.cpp` (TE5c-6: one row in `kVimExCommands`, the `ExSet` definition)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp/.cpp` (`ApplyVimSessionOption`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/VimViewAdapter.hpp/.cpp` (TE5a-22: the `SetSessionOption` override)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp` (TE5a-5: `FakeVimHost` records session options)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimCases.cpp` (TE5a-6: `ApplyVimSet` uses the production parser)
- Create: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5d.vimcases`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimSetTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimExCommand`, `VimExSpec`, `kVimExCommands`, `VimState::RunExLine` (TE5c-6), `VimOptions`, `ParseNrFormats`, `FormatNrFormats` (TE5a-3), `CVarRegistry::Find/Set/ClearRung/Publish/RungValue` (`CVarRegistry.hpp:331-470`), `SetBy::Console` (`CVarTypes.hpp:83`, a session rung that is never archived).
- Produces:
  - `enum class VimOptionType : std::uint8_t { Bool, Number, String }`, `struct VimOptionInfo { std::string_view name, abbrev; VimOptionType type; std::string_view cvar; }`, `std::span<const VimOptionInfo> VimOptionTable()`, `const VimOptionInfo* FindVimOption(std::string_view)`, `std::string FormatVimOption(const VimOptions&, const VimOptionInfo&)`.
  - `struct VimSessionOption { std::string cvar; VimOptionType cvarType; bool boolValue; std::uint32_t numberValue; std::string stringValue; bool reset; }`, `struct VimSetResult { bool ok; std::string message; std::vector<VimSessionOption> changes; }`, `VimSetResult ApplySetArguments(VimOptions&, std::string_view args)`, `bool ApplySetAssignment(VimOptions&, std::string_view item)`.
  - `virtual VimHostResult IVimHost::SetSessionOption(const VimSessionOption&) = 0`; `VimHostResult VimState::ExSet(const VimExCommand&)`; ex row `set`/`se`.
  - `Arcane::Text::VimHostResult Arcane::Editor::ApplyVimSessionOption(CVarRegistry&, const Text::VimSessionOption&)`.

`:set` changes a value for the **session only** (spec s6.4): it writes the cvar's **Console** rung, which the settings archive never writes, so the Preferences page keeps its permanent value and shows the row as "Overridden by Console" with Clear override. The VimState that ran `:set` updates its own `VimOptions` at once; the publish re-reads `ReadVimOptions` for every vim view (TE5a-23's `VimEditorRuntime::OnSettingsPublished`), so all views agree, as vim's global options do. Forms: `opt` `noopt` `invopt` `opt!` `opt&` `opt?` `opt=v` `opt:v` `opt+=v` `opt-=v` `opt^=v`, several per line; `:set` alone lists the options that differ from Neovim's default, `:set all` lists every option. Supported vim names: `ignorecase ic`, `smartcase scs`, `hlsearch hls`, `incsearch is`, `wrapscan ws`, `gdefault gd`, `startofline sol`, `timeoutlen tm`, `scrolloff so`, `nrformats nf`, `clipboard cb` (`unnamedplus`/`unnamed` <-> `useSystemClipboard`), and the editor-wide `tabstop ts`, `shiftwidth sw`, `expandtab et` (spec s6.4: not vim-only; `ts` and `sw` are Arcane's one indent width, `editor.text.tabSize`). Documented differences: `opt&` drops the session value (back to the Preferences value, not vim's built-in default), and `ts`/`sw` move together.

```cpp
    REQUIRE(r.ok);

    CHECK(o.timeoutlenMs == 2000u);

    const Test::ScopedCodeLayer codeLayer;

    struct ConsoleRungGuard   // a failed REQUIRE must not leak the session value into a later random-order case
    {

    } guard{ reg };
    const std::optional<CVarValue> userBefore = reg.RungValue("editor.text.vim.ignorecase", SetBy::EditorUser);

    on.cvar = "editor.text.vim.ignorecase";
```
